# Standard Operating Procedure: Chemical Mechanical Planarization of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs

Sub-nanometer surface planarization of inter-layer oxide dielectrics (ILD) and tungsten contact plugs prior to bitline metallization.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** ILD Fused Silica Slurry and Polyurethane Polishing Pad Procurement & Qualification  
**Module:** Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs / Wet Chemistry  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 3  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Procurement & Inward  │
│           QC           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Pad Break-in &     │
│      Conditioning      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Baseline Test Polish  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Metrology &       │
│     Qualification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Slurry & Pad Inward Inspection & Verification:**
   - Verify lot Certificate of Analysis (CoA) for fumed/colloidal fused silica slurry: confirm alkaline pH stability, particle size distribution, and specific gravity.
   - Inspect microporous polyurethane pads (e.g., concentric/perforated groove profiles) for surface blemishes, groove depth uniformity, and vacuum seal integrity before mounting onto the 180nm CMP platen.

2. **Platen Mount & Pad Break-In Conditioning:**
   - Strip old adhesive and mount the new polyurethane pad onto the CMP platen; apply uniform pressure roller lamination to prevent micro-bubble entrapment.
   - Run ex-situ/in-situ diamond disk pad conditioning:
     - Conditioning Downforce: 5 to 7 lbf (~22 to 31 N).
     - Disk Sweep: 10 to 19 RPM across 100% of usable pad radius with ultra-pure DI water flush (1000 mL/min) for 20 minutes to dress pad asperities and establish uniform surface roughness ($Ra$).

3. **Slurry Loop Stabilization & Flow Rate Calibration:**
   - Connect silica slurry line through peristaltic delivery loop; calibrate slurry delivery arm flow rate to $150 \pm 10\text{ mL/min}$.
   - Ensure continuous recirculation/agitation to prevent silica particle agglomeration and micro-scratch defectivity.

4. **Qualification Polish on Blanket & Patterned Test Wafers:**
   - Load monitor wafers: 100mm/200mm blanket thermal/TEOS ILD oxide monitors and LPCVD $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ stop-layer monitor wafers (LPCVD $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask film baseline: refractive index $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$).
   - Run standard baseline polish cycle:
     - Platen Speed: 60 to 90 RPM.
     - Carrier Head Speed: 55 to 85 RPM.
     - Downforce: 3.0 to 4.5 psi (~20.7 to 31.0 kPa).
     - Polish Time: 60 seconds with in-situ conditioning.
   - Post-CMP Cleaning: Transfer immediately to double-sided PVA brush scrubber with dilute ammonium hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$) chemistry followed by spin rinse drying (SRD).

5. **Post-CMP Metrology & Sign-Off:**
   - Measure pre- and post-polish oxide thickness using multi-point spectroscopic ellipsometry (49-point polar map).
   - Characterize ILD-to-$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ polishing selectivity and micro-scratch density using darkfield defect inspection.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
       ILD Slurry & Pad Qualification Metrics
 ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
1│ ░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ 2800    │ Oxide Removal Rate (A/min)
2│ ▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒ 4                │ NU % (WIWNU 1-sigma)
3│ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ 30                      │ Selectivity (ILD:Si3N4)
4│ █ 0.05                                       │ Defect Density (def/cm2)
 └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 0                                           3000
```

1. **Oxide Polish Rate:** $\ge 2,500\text{ \AA/min}$ (target: $2,800 \pm 200\text{ \AA/min}$ under standard carrier downforce and platen velocity).
2. **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU):** $\le 4.0\%$ ($1\sigma$, 49-point ellipsometry map, $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
3. **Selectivity ($\text{ILD Oxide} : \text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ Hard Mask):** $\ge 30:1$, preserving stop-layer $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ film integrity ($n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$).
4. **Micro-scratch Defect Density:** $\le 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ at $\ge 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ threshold on darkfield inspection.

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks:**
  - $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask baseline optical properties ($n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$) used for stop-layer remaining thickness and selectivity metrology.
  - Verification of film integrity under intrinsic stress conditions (~1 GPa tensile) to ensure zero delamination during downforce shear loading.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Planarization planar window requirements for stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) interconnects, access transistor topology ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), and tungsten plug (W-plug) contact integration.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-1-01` | **Thermosonic Ball Wirebond Shear & Wire Pull Mechanical Strength Test** | Dage 4000 / Nordson Microtester Bond Pull & Ball Shear Test System | 1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-1-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with uncured epoxy: Wash with copious soap and warm water (do not use solvents like acetone which increase dermal absorption). Eye contact with silica dicing slurry: Flush at eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dicing saw fully enclosed with continuous high-volume DI water mist shroud. Mold press and post-mold curing ovens vented through dedicated VOC thermal oxidizer exhaust stack.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Silicon dicing slurry centrifuged and segregated into solid cake for non-hazardous landfill. Cured thermoset epoxy scrap disposed of as regulated solid waste.

| **Silver-Filled Conductive Die Attach Adhesive** | `7440-22-4` | Electronic Grade Silver Flake | `70-80 wt% Ag in epoxy base` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Saw-diced wafer mounted on UV dicing tape, clean and dry with zero particulate or water residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Epoxy die-attached, cured, and thermosonically wirebonded to leadframe/substrate pads prior to molding.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation of exposed aluminum/copper bond pads degrades thermosonic ball bond adhesion, inducing high electrical contact resistance or catastrophic non-stick bond pad lifts.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of ILD Fused Silica Slurry and Polyurethane Polishing Pad Procurement & Qualification: BEOL metallization, electrical die sort (EDS), wafer backgrinding/dicing, and wirebond plastic encapsulation successfully yield JEDEC-qualified DRAM packaged units.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization

**Category**: Planarization | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## ILD Oxide CMP Slurry Selection and Polishing Pad Conditioning Setup

- **Project**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy Node**: [Architecture & Integration] > [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > [Planarization] > ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization > **ILD Oxide CMP Slurry Selection and Polishing Pad Conditioning Setup**
- **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make
- **Role**: Domain Expert AI (Gemini Multi-Agent Council)
- **Knowledge Base Entry**: [`ild_oxide_cmp_slurry_pad_conditioning.md`](./docs/knowledge/ild_oxide_cmp_slurry_pad_conditioning.md)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Slurry Preparation &  │
│    pH Verification     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Polyurethane Pad    │
│       Break-In &       │
│      Conditioning      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wafer Mount & Head   │
│       Downforce        │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  ILD Oxide Polishing   │
│       Execution        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Post-CMP Megasonic   │
│   Clean & Metrology    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Slurry Preparation & Chemical Formulation
1. **Slurry Selection**: Utilize a high-purity alkaline fumed/colloidal silica ($\text{SiO}_2$) nanoparticle slurry formulated for inter-layer dielectric oxide (PETEOS / BPSG / HDP-CVD oxide) over 180nm W-plug contacts and crown-type stacked capacitor topologies.
2. **Particle Sizing & Solids**: Maintain mean abrasive particle size at **$30\text{ to }50\text{ nm}$** with total solids concentration calibrated at **$12.0\text{ wt\% to }15.0\text{ wt\%}$**.
3. **pH & Circulation**: Stabilize slurry chemistry at **$\text{pH } 10.5\text{ to }11.0$** using potassium hydroxide ($\text{KOH}$) and deionized water (DIW) recirculation. Slurry loop must maintain continuous peristaltic circulation at **$150\text{ to }200\text{ mL/min}$** with point-of-use (POU) $0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ depth filtration to prevent micro-scratching.

#### Step 2: Polishing Pad Selection & Break-In
1. **Pad Specifications**: Mount an open-pore rigid polyurethane polishing pad (concentric grooved or XY-grid geometry, density $0.75\text{ to }0.85\text{ g/cm}^3$) backed with sub-pad cushion onto the temperature-regulated platen.
2. **Pad Break-in Protocol**: Prior to production wafer processing, execute a **$30\text{-minute}$ ex-situ pad break-in** using high-resistivity DIW ($18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) and conditioning slurry at **$65\text{ rpm}$** platen speed.

#### Step 3: Diamond Disc Conditioner Setup & Kinematics
1. **Conditioner Tooling**: Install a $100\text{ mm}$ diameter diamond conditioner disc embedded with **$100\text{-grit}$ sintered diamond abrasives**.
2. **Conditioner Head Motion**: Configure sinusoidal sweeping across the pad radius:
   - **Conditioner Downforce**: **$5.0\text{ to }7.0\text{ psi}$** ($34.5\text{ to }48.3\text{ kPa}$).
   - **Conditioner Head Rotation**: **$80\text{ rpm}$** in synchronous co-rotation with the platen.
   - **Conditioning Mode**: In-situ conditioning active throughout polish cycles to sustain stable pad surface roughness ($R_a = 4.0\text{ to }6.5\ \mu\text{m}$) and prevent slurry glazing.

#### Step 4: Polishing Process Recipe Execution
1. **Kinematics & Platen Speed**: Set main platen rotation speed to **$70\text{ rpm}$** and carrier head counter-rotation to **$65\text{ rpm}$**.
2. **Wafer Carrier Downforce**: Apply multi-zone membrane polishing downforce of **$3.5\text{ to }4.2\text{ psi}$** across inner/outer zones with retaining ring pressure adjusted to **$5.0\text{ to }5.5\text{ psi}$** to suppress wafer-edge over-polishing.
3. **Dispense & Run-Time**: Deliver slurry at **$180\text{ mL/min}$** directly to the inner pad track. Polish duration calibrated to clear inter-level topography targeting an ILD removal amount tailored to accommodate subsequent Metal-1 ($350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ Al-Cu) integration.

#### Step 5: Post-CMP Rinse & Megasonic Scrub
1. Transfer wafer to post-CMP wet clean module.
2. Subject wafer to dilute ammonium hydroxide/hydrogen peroxide ($\text{SC-1}$, $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{H}_2\text{O} = 1:1:5$) with megasonic agitation ($0.8\text{ to }1.0\text{ MHz}$) followed by polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) brush scrubbing to eliminate residual silica slurry abrasives.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                                                        
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░                               │
Defect Density (cm^-2)┤░                               │
                      │▒▒▒▒▒                           │
      Step Height (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒                           │
             WIWNU (%)┤▓                               │
                      │▓                               │
 Removal Rate (nm/min)┤████████████████████████████████│
                      │████████████████████████████████│
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                       0      70      140    210    280 
```

| Metric Target | Specified Parameter Value | Physical Units | Metrology Tool / Technique |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Oxide Removal Rate (MRR)** | **$260\text{ to }300$** | $\text{nm/min}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Film Thickness Reflectometer (49-point map) |
| **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU)** | **$\le 3.5$** | $\%$ ($1\sigma$) | 49-point polar map with $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion |
| **Residual Dielectric Step Height** | **$\le 35$** | $\text{nm}$ | High-Resolution Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) / Profilometry |
| **Post-Clean Defect Density** | **$\le 0.08$** | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Laser Surface Particle Inspection ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ bin size) |

---

### Literature Context Citations

1. **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture with crown/cylinder topologies, and tungsten plug ($W\text{-plug}$) drain contacts requiring planar ILD topography to preserve the minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ storage capacitance budget and leakage limits below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **`Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects`**:
   - Back-end planarization baseline for subsequent metal-1 layer interconnects ($\text{Al-}0.5\%\text{ Cu}$ alloy, nominal film thickness $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$, $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$), which dictates strict global planarity to eliminate photolithographic depth-of-focus defocus and metal stringers.
3. **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
   - Bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$, high-$k$ dielectric EOT around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$, and gate oxide physical thickness ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) defining structural aspect ratios and step-height limits across active array and periphery regions.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Selecting a fumed versus colloidal silica slurry for 180nm ILD planarization directly impacts defect density, Prestonian polishing kinetics, and post-CMP brush scrubber cleanability. Pad conditioning sweeping velocity profile and diamond dresser downforce must be integrated into the tool recipe PLC to ensure stable cut-rate and pad roughness (Ra ~ 4-6 um) across a 1000-wafer pad lifetime without inducing within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) drift.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM backend ILD oxide (PECVD TEOS / Silane oxide), a KOH- or NH4OH-stabilized colloidal silica slurry with mean particle size 50-70 nm at alkaline pH (10.5-11.2) provides optimal selectivity, minimizing micro-scratching compared to fumed silica. In-situ pad conditioning using a 100-grit diamond disc at 5-7 psi downforce is required to prevent pad glazing, maintain slurry transport grooves, and sustain a steady oxide removal rate of 250-300 nm/min.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying proprietary formulated CMP slurries introduces single-vendor lock-in and shelf-life instability due to particle agglomeration (max 6-month shelf life under 15-25°C storage). Procuring semiconductor-grade diamond conditioner discs (e.g., 3M or Entegris compatible) and concentrated colloidal silica requires secondary sourcing channels and automated local Day-Tank slurry dilution/filtration units (0.5 um POE filters) to ensure supply continuity.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procurement and qualification of slurry drums, conditioner heads, and polyurethane polishing pads (e.g., IC1000 k-groove type) must adhere to the 4-week timeline before pilot baseline tapeout lot arrival. Tool downtime for pad break-in (dummy wafer seasoning for 30 minutes) and dresser qualification must be tracked against MPW line utilization targets.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Slurry particle agglomeration or large particle counts (LPC > 1.0 um) causing severe micro-scratches and killer dielectric punch-through during subsequent metallization.
1. Pad glazing and conditioning disc diamond loss leading to drastic oxide removal rate decay (>25% drop over 50 wafers) and severe within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU > 8%).
1. Slurry dry-out on wafer surface during post-CMP transfer causing irreversible particle adhesion and post-clean defect clustering.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-1-01` | **Oxide Removal Rate and Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity Qualification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / Film Thickness Metrology (e.g., KLA ASET-F5x / Therma-Wave Opti-Probe) with 49-point polar map, 3mm edge exclusion. | 1. Measure baseline 49-point oxide thickness on 3 monitor wafers. 2. Mount wafer onto CMP head, set downforce to 4.0 psi, platen speed to 93 rpm, carrier speed to 87 rpm, and activate in-situ pad conditioning at 6.0 psi disc force. 3. Polish for 60 seconds with continuous colloidal silica slurry dispensing at 150 mL/min. 4. Transfer wafer to post-CMP wet buffer station, perform standard megasonic DI water rinse, and spin-dry. 5. Remeasure 49-point oxide thickness. 6. Calculate mean removal rate (nm/min) and 1-sigma WIWNU (%). | `Pass if Mean Oxide Removal Rate is between 250 nm/min and 300 nm/min, and 1-sigma Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) is <= 4.0%.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-1-02` | **Post-CMP Defect Density and Micro-Scratch Inspection** | Laser Scanning Surface Defect Inspection Tool (e.g., KLA-Tencor Surfscan SP1/SP2) calibrated to 0.18 um defect sensitivity threshold. | 1. Load dried post-CMP monitor wafer into defect inspection tool. 2. Execute full-surface darkfield laser scattering scan at 0.18 um defect threshold (3mm edge exclusion). 3. Classify defects into particle contaminants, area defects, and micro-scratches using automated defect review imaging. 4. Record total adder defect count and micro-scratch count per wafer. | `Pass if Total Defect Density is <= 0.15 defects/cm2 (total defect count <= 47 defects per 200mm wafer) and micro-scratch count is <= 2 scratches per wafer.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical-resistant nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and splash-proof safety goggles, Neoprene chemical apron, Steel-toe ESD safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately flush affected skin with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. Eye contact: Irrigate exposed eyes with tepid water from plumbed eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes, holding eyelids open; seek immediate medical attention. Inhalation of dried aerosolized slurry: Move victim to fresh air; provide oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on CMP wet enclosure maintaining negative pressure (-0.05 to -0.1 inches water column) and face velocity >= 100 FPM at tool access doors to exhaust alkaline mist and ammonia vapors.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: CMP effluent contains high suspended silica solids and alkaline pH. Direct spent slurry to dedicated CMP industrial waste treatment: automated equalization tank with continuous pH adjustment using sulfuric acid (H2SO4) to pH 6.5-8.5, followed by coagulant/flocculant dosing, filter-press sludge cake removal, and continuous turbidity monitoring prior to drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Colloidal Silicon Dioxide (Amorphous Silica)** | `7631-86-9` | Semiconductor Grade (Slurry suspension) | `10-25 wt%` |
| **Potassium Hydroxide (Stabilizer)** | `1310-58-3` | TraceMetal Grade | `0.1-0.5 wt%` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (pH adjuster / post-clean)** | `1336-21-6` | VLSI Grade | `1.0-3.0 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: As-deposited PECVD TEOS oxide, dry, hydrophobic/organically clean surface free from metallic contamination (post-deposition queue cleared).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, fully planarized oxide surface, submerged in post-CMP wet buffer bath or transferred into double-sided brush scrubber clean within queue time.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding 30 minutes in ambient air before post-CMP cleaning allows residual alkaline slurry and sub-micron silica nanoparticles to dry out, forming irreversible chemical bonds (covalent siloxane bridging) on the wafer surface, causing catastrophic defect clustering and complete scrubber ineffectiveness.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Qualified ILD CMP colloidal silica slurry specification, automated Day-Tank filtration scheme, and diamond pad conditioning recipe establishing reproducible oxide removal rates (250-300 nm/min) and defect density compliant with 180nm DRAM backend baseline.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CMP_Oxide_Slurry_Conditioning_Recipe_Spec.pdf`
- [ ] `ILD_CMP_RemovalRate_WIWNU_49pt_Metrology.csv`
- [ ] `Post_CMP_Laser_Surface_Defect_Map_SP2.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean PECVD oxide removal rate under baseline recipe conditions** | `275 nm/min` | +/- 25 nm/min | Pre- and post-CMP 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry measurement on 200mm monitor wafers |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU 1-sigma) across 49 points** | `3.0 %` | <= 4.0 % | Standard deviation divided by mean of 49-point oxide removal thickness profile with 3mm edge exclusion |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-CMP scrubbed surface total defect density at 0.18 um threshold** | `0.08 defects/cm2` | <= 0.15 defects/cm2 | Unpatterned wafer surface inspection using KLA SP2 darkfield laser scatterometry |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Three consecutive 200mm TEOS monitor wafers achieve removal rate of 250-300 nm/min with WIWNU <= 4.0%, total post-clean defect count <= 47 defects/wafer (<= 0.15 defects/cm2) with <= 2 micro-scratches, and pad cut-rate stability verified across a 50-wafer marathon run without requiring manual dresser intervention.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Prestonian DoE Matrix Execution for Downforce, Platen Speed, and Flow Rates

**Category**: Planarization | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The Prestonian DoE (MRR = Kp * P * V) must couple downforce (1.5–5.0 psi) and relative platen/carrier velocity (30–90 rpm) to multi-zone carrier backpressures (retaining ring, zone 1, zone 2). Operating without closed-loop eddy-current or optical endpoint detection (EPD) risks severe intra-die and within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU), propagating depth-of-focus (DoF) lithography budget violations across dense 180nm DRAM cell arrays and peripheral CMOS.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Preston's empirical equation deviates at non-linear regimes: hydrodynamic slurry aquaplaning occurs at elevated platen speeds (>85 rpm) and slurry starvation at flow rates below 120 mL/min, shifting wear kinetics from boundary friction to fluid lubrication. For 180nm TEOS/HDP ILD planarization, slurry chemistry (fumed/colloidal silica at pH 10.5–11.0 with KOH/NH4OH) must maintain pad conditioner diamond cut rates and pad grooving (IC1000/Suba-IV) to prevent micro-scratching, chatter marks, and severe dishing/erosion on underlying polysilicon or active area structures.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-source reliance on commercial fumed silica slurries (e.g., Cabot SS-25 or Klebosol series) and 30-grit diamond conditioner disks presents high lead-time volatility. Sourcing open-spec slurry concentrates with stabilized shelf-lives, point-of-use (POU) dilution loops, and multi-vendor qualification for polyurethane perforated/grooved pads is mandatory to prevent fab line-down events.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: DoE execution must fit into an 8-shift cycle budget without causing queue-time breaches for post-CMP megasonic clean and post-dielectric deposition lots. Failure to freeze the Prestonian response surface model (RSM) on schedule directly stalls downstream contact plug etch (W-plug lithography) and physical DRC tapeout milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Slurry starvation causing localized pad dry-out, thermal runaway (>65°C), and catastrophic micro-scratching through ILD into DRAM wordlines.
1. Over-polishing and pattern-dependent erosion/dishing leading to uncorrectable depth-of-focus margin loss during 248nm DUV stepper contact/via exposure.
1. Non-Prestonian edge roll-off (ERO) or center-fast profiles driven by mismatched carrier-to-platen velocity ratios, exceeding the 5% WIWNU signoff ceiling.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-2-01` | **Full-Factorial Prestonian Response Surface & Material Removal Rate (MRR) Characterization** | Dual-axis rotational CMP polisher with multi-zone pneumatic carrier head, point-of-use (POU) ultrasonic slurry flowmeter, and 49-point automated spectroscopic ellipsometer (film thickness tool). | 1. - **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level C chemical splash suit (polyethylene-coated Tyvek), Chemical-resistant butyl rubber gloves over nitrile under-gloves, ANSI Z87.1 full-face shield combined with indirect-vent chemical splash goggles, Closed-toe steel-toe chemical protective boots with neoprene soles
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Flush exposed skin immediately with copious flowing water for minimum 15 minutes; remove contaminated clothing. Eye contact: Irrigate eyes continuously using dedicated eyewash station for at least 20 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation. | Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: As-deposited HDP-CVD / PECVD TEOS oxide, dry, particle-inspected (<20 particles @ >0.18 µm), hydrophobic/hydrophilic stable with zero organic or post-litho photoresist residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic fully planarized ILD oxide, double-sided megasonic brush cleaned, marangoni/spin dried, zero slurry drying residue or crystalline crusting.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Irreversible slurry nanoparticle agglomeration and drying on wafer surface creating unremovable ceramic micro-particles; ambient moisture adsorption inducing localized dielectric breakdown degradation and severe pinhole/micro-masking during subsequent contact etch.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified Prestonian empirical DoE matrix establishing optimized operating window (3.0–3.8 psi downforce, 60–70 rpm platen speed, 160–200 mL/min slurry flow) for 180nm DRAM TEOS ILD planarization, providing stable removal rate, sub-3% WIWNU, and validated post-polish surface roughness.

- [ ] `PRESTON_DOE_RSM_REGRESSION_MODEL.csv`
- [ ] `ILD_OXIDE_CMP_49PT_UNIFORMITY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `POST_CMP_DEFECT_MAP_AND_AFM_SURFACE.tiff`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU 1-sigma standard deviation)** | `2.8%` | + 0.7% max (hard limit ≤ 3.5%) | 49-point polar map thickness profiling with 3mm edge exclusion |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-CMP surface root-mean-square roughness (Rq)** | `2.2 Å` | ± 0.5 Å (hard limit ≤ 3.0 Å) | Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) 10 µm x 10 µm scan area |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Preston response model achieves R² ≥ 0.985 across downforce/velocity parameter space, zero run-to-run pad thermal runaway, post-clean defect count < 30 total defects (>0.18 µm) on 200mm monitor wafers, and formal signoff approval from both Planarization Module Lead and Physical Integration Signoff Engineer.

critics.systems_engineer: The Prestonian DoE (MRR = Kp * P * V) must couple downforce (1.5–5.0 psi) and relative platen/carrier velocity (30–90 rpm) to multi-zone carrier backpressures (retaining ring, zone 1, zone 2). Operating without closed-loop eddy-current or optical endpoint detection (EPD) risks severe intra-die and within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU), propagating depth-of-focus (DoF) lithography budget violations across dense 180nm DRAM cell arrays and peripheral CMOS.
critics.domain_expert: Preston's empirical equation deviates at non-linear regimes: hydrodynamic slurry aquaplaning occurs at elevated platen speeds (>85 rpm) and slurry starvation at flow rates below 120 mL/min, shifting wear kinetics from boundary friction to fluid lubrication. For 180nm TEOS/HDP ILD planarization, slurry chemistry (fumed/colloidal silica at pH 10.5–11.0 with KOH/NH4OH) must maintain pad conditioner diamond cut rates and pad grooving (IC1000/Suba-IV) to prevent micro-scratching, chatter marks, and severe dishing/erosion on underlying polysilicon or active area structures.
critics.supply_chain: Single-source reliance on commercial fumed silica slurries (e.g., Cabot SS-25 or Klebosol series) and 30-grit diamond conditioner disks presents high lead-time volatility. Sourcing open-spec slurry concentrates with stabilized shelf-lives, point-of-use (POU) dilution loops, and multi-vendor qualification for polyurethane perforated/grooved pads is mandatory to prevent fab line-down events.
critics.laya_pm: DoE execution must fit into an 8-shift cycle budget without causing queue-time breaches for post-CMP megasonic clean and post-dielectric deposition lots. Failure to freeze the Prestonian response surface model (RSM) on schedule directly stalls downstream contact plug etch (W-plug lithography) and physical DRC tapeout milestones.
critical_failure_modes: Slurry starvation causing localized pad dry-out, thermal runaway (>65°C), and catastrophic micro-scratching through ILD into DRAM wordlines.
Over-polishing and pattern-dependent erosion/dishing leading to uncorrectable depth-of-focus margin loss during 248nm DUV stepper contact/via exposure.
Non-Prestonian edge roll-off (ERO) or center-fast profiles driven by mismatched carrier-to-platen velocity ratios, exceeding the 5% WIWNU signoff ceiling.

# Standard Operating Procedure: ILD Oxide Test Coupon Preparation & Pre-Polish Ellipsometric Profiling

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pre-polish ellipsometric wafer mapping must maintain spatial coordinate fidelity with post-CMP metrology stations; coordinate translation offsets between the coupon loader and the optical stage will corrupt radial within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) and Prestonian removal rate calculations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For plasma-enhanced CVD (PECVD) TEOS or silane-based ILD oxide films around 800-1000 nm thickness, fitting Delta and Psi without accounting for the native oxide/sub-oxide interface layer and surface roughness induces cross-correlation between film thickness (t) and refractive index (n), requiring a constrained Cauchy dispersion model where k=0 across 400-800 nm wavelengths.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Test coupon dicing and cleaving from 200mm pilot wafers introduces particulate contamination and edge-exclusion variations; dedicated coupon vacuum chuck fixtures must be standardized across Vietnamese foundry metrology tooling to prevent edge-bead chipping and stage downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Coupon preparation and baseline mapping must not bottleneck the Prestonian DoE polishing queue; the ellipsometry cycle time per coupon across 49 measurement points must remain under 6 minutes to stay synchronized with the CMP platen availability schedule.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Optical parameter cross-coupling: Over-parameterization of the Cauchy model resulting in false refractive index inflation (n > 1.48) and inaccurate pre-CMP oxide thickness baseline by > 30 nm.
1. Organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption: Extended cleanroom ambient exposure forming adventitious hydrocarbon layers on virgin oxide coupons, shifting phase angle Delta and skewing raw thickness measurements.
1. Particulate-induced vacuum chuck tilt: Backside micro-cleave debris causing coupon focal plane misalignment, defocusing the optical beam and degrading signal-to-noise ratio in spectroscopic polarization detection.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-2-1-01` | **49-Point Pre-Polish ILD Film Thickness and Refractive Index Profiling** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Rotating Compensator type, 240-1000 nm spectral range, automated theta-r mapping stage, micro-spot optical beam size 50 um) | 1. Load 40mm x 40mm ILD oxide test coupon onto vacuum chuck with alignment fiducial at origin (0,0). 2. Establish automated 49-point polar grid mapping pattern with 3 mm edge exclusion. 3. Acquire spectroscopic Psi and Delta spectra from 350 nm to 850 nm at an incident angle of 70.0 degrees. 4. Fit experimental spectra using a validated Cauchy dispersion model: n(lambda) = A_n + B_n / lambda^2 with extinction coefficient k fixed to 0. 5. Extract thickness map, mean thickness, refractive index at 632.8 nm, and standard deviation. | `Mean baseline thickness within 800.0 nm ± 20.0 nm; within-coupon non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) <= 1.5%; mean refractive index n(632.8 nm) = 1.458 ± 0.008; Mean Squared Error (MSE) of model fit <= 2.5 across all 49 points.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-2-1-02` | **Dynamic Surface Cleanliness & Organic AMC Desorption Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer with environmental purge cell, surface particle counter / optical darkfield scatterometer. | 1. Position coupon at center site (0,0). 2. Record raw Delta and Psi angles at 632.8 nm continuously for 120 seconds under constant 10 sccm high-purity N2 flow. 3. Inspect raw Delta drift over time to quantify hydrocarbon/moisture phase shift. 4. Transfer coupon to darkfield surface particle inspection tool to measure macro-defects and micro-particles. | `Phase angle Delta temporal drift <= 0.05 degrees over 120 seconds; surface particulate count (defect size >= 0.20 um) <= 5 particles per coupon area (40mm x 40mm).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol), UV-blocking ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses (certified for broadband xenon/deuterium source exposure), Static-dissipative ESD lab coat/smock, Cleanroom bouffant cap and face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation of IPA vapors: Move person immediately to fresh air; seek medical attention if irritation persists. Eye contact with IPA solvent: Flush eyes with sterile eye-wash solution for at least 15 minutes while lifting eyelids. Skin contact: Wash affected dermal area thoroughly with soap and DI water; remove contaminated cleanroom garments. In case of optical beam exposure: Shield eyes immediately; seek evaluation by occupational ophthalmology if flash-blindness or retinal discomfort occurs.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted in Class 100 cleanroom laminar flow bench with HEPA filtration (downflow velocity 0.45 m/s ± 20%); solvent wipe station equipped with local solvent exhaust duct maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA solvent wipes and saturated cleaning swabs segregated in dedicated flammables airtight containment bins for incineration disposal; no corrosive acidic/alkaline waste generated during dry optical profiling.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade (>= 99.9%) | `100%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2 Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.5 (99.9995%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: As-deposited PECVD ILD silicon oxide (TEOS-based) or post-cleave coupon, dry, free of gross particulate debris and solvent residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pre-CMP optically profiled coupon with characterized thickness and refractive index map, sealed in vacuum-sealed antistatic carrier or nitrogen-purged FOUP/cassette.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and airborne molecular contamination (adventitious organic film buildup) will alter dielectric surface wettability and modify phase polarization angle Delta, distorting pre-polish optical baseline and producing inaccurate Prestonian removal rate calculations.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful baseline characterization of ILD oxide test coupons providing verified spatial film thickness, dispersion index parameters, and cleanroom queue-time tracking ready for Prestonian DoE CMP polishing matrix.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ild_coupon_pre_polish_thickness_map.csv`
- [ ] `ild_ellipsometry_dispersion_fit_report.pdf`
- [ ] `coupon_surface_particle_defects.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Pre-CMP coupon mean oxide thickness conformity** | `800.0 nm` | ± 20.0 nm | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry 49-point spatial area average across 350-850 nm |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Optical model fitting goodness-of-fit error** | `1.2 MSE` | <= 2.5 MSE | Unweighted Levenberg-Marquardt regression MSE algorithm on Delta/Psi spectra |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dielectric film refractive index at helium-neon reference wavelength** | `1.458` | ± 0.008 | Extracted Cauchy parameterization at lambda = 632.8 nm |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All coupons show goodness-of-fit MSE <= 2.5 with refractive index 1.458 ± 0.008 and complete 49-point thickness spatial maps generated and validated without hardware errors, with final artifacts logged in the metrology database prior to queue-time expiration.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## PECVD TEOS/Silane Oxide Deposition on Bare Test Coupons

**Context Path:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)` > `180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation` > `Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs` > `Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide CMP Recipe Optimization and Polish` > `ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization` > `Prestonian DoE Matrix Execution for Downforce, Platen Speed, and Flow Rates` > `ILD Oxide Test Coupon Preparation & Pre-Polish Ellipsometric Profiling` > `PECVD TEOS/Silane Oxide Deposition on Bare Test Coupons`  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm CMOS DRAM (Gen 3)  
**Action Type:** Buy / Tool Execution  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Bare Si Test Coupons  │
│    (P-type <100>)      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Pre-Clean: Native    │
│      Oxide Strip       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Chamber Conditioning  │
│   & Base Vacuum Pump   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  PECVD TEOS / Silane   │
│    Oxide Deposition    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Post-Dep Densify &   │
│   Metrology Profiling  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Cleaning & Degreasing:**
   - Mount prime P-type (100) bare silicon test coupons into a wet bench carrier.
   - Perform standard clean: immersion in dilute HF (DHF 50:1, room temperature, 60 seconds) to completely strip native oxide until surface dewets.
   - Cascade rinse in deionized (DI) water ($>18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) for 5 minutes, spin-rinse dry with filtered $\text{N}_2$.
   - Transfer coupons immediately to the PECVD loadlock to prevent re-oxidation.

2. **Chamber Base Vacuum & Thermal Stabilization:**
   - Pump loadlock and transfer coupons onto the heated substrate susceptor in the PECVD process chamber.
   - Evacuate chamber using turbomolecular/cryo pumping subsystem down below $2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ base pressure to eliminate residual background atmospheric moisture and oxygen contaminants.
   - Ramp and hold substrate chuck temperature at $350^\circ\text{C} - 400^\circ\text{C}$ with backside He flow for 3 minutes for thermal equilibration.

3. **Pre-Deposition In-Situ Plasma Pre-Treatment:**
   - Introduce high-purity process inert/carrier gas ($\text{Ar}$ or $\text{N}_2$, $99.999\%$ 5N purity) at working pressure ($3\text{ to }5\text{ mTorr}$ pre-flow).
   - Strike low-power RF plasma clean (100 W, 13.56 MHz, 15 s) to desorb surface moisture and condition the silicon coupon interface.

4. **PECVD Oxide Deposition Run (Silane / TEOS Chemistry):**
   - Direct process gases into showerhead:
     - **Precursor Line:** Silane ($\text{SiH}_4$) or vaporized Tetraethyl orthosilicate (TEOS) carrier.
     - **Oxidant / Diluent Line:** High-purity $\text{N}_2\text{O}$ / $\text{O}_2$ with Ar carrier diluent.
   - Adjust throttle valve to stabilize chamber process pressure at $1.0 - 2.5\text{ Torr}$.
   - Ignite RF plasma power at $250 - 450\text{ W}$ (13.56 MHz mixed with low-frequency bias if stress tuning is required).
   - Deposit ILD blank oxide targeted for CMP Prestonian DoE removal rate runs: calibrated deposition rate maintained at $50\text{ to }100\text{ nm/min}$ until target bulk ILD thickness (e.g., $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ nominal baseline) is achieved.

5. **Chamber Purge, Pump Down, and Unload:**
   - Extinguish RF plasma; isolate precursor supply valves.
   - Purge chamber with 5N $\text{N}_2$ through three cycles of cycle-purge pumpdown.
   - Transfer coupons back to the vacuum cooling station in the loadlock and cool to $< 80^\circ\text{C}$ under $\text{N}_2$ before venting to atmospheric pressure.

6. **Post-Deposition Densification & Pre-CMP Metrology:**
   - Perform optional furnace densification / outgassing anneal in forming gas ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\text{ }95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes).
   - Transfer to spectroscopic ellipsometer for pre-polish thickness mapping and refractive index profiling across the coupon.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Film Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $350.0$ | $\pm 5.0\%$ ($\pm 17.5\text{ nm}$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / C-V Accumulation ($C_{ox}$) |
| **Deposition Rate** | $50.0 - 100.0$ | Stable within $\pm 3.0\%$ | $\text{nm/min}$ | In-situ timer / optical thickness profiler |
| **Chamber Base Pressure** | $< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}$ | Upper limit | $\text{Torr}$ | Ion Gauge / Penning Gauge |
| **Refractive Index ($n$ @ 632.8 nm)** | $1.460$ | $\pm 0.020$ ($1.440 - 1.480$) | Unitless ($n$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Thickness Metrology Precision** | Baseline | $\pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | High-Frequency (1 MHz) MOSCAP $C_{ox}$ Extraction |

---

### 3. Citations & Verified Literature Traceability

- **Base Chamber Vacuum ($< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$), Inert Purity (Ar 99.999%), Deposition Rate ($50 - 100\text{ nm/min}$), Thickness Target ($350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$), and Anneal Atmosphere ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\text{ }95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 min):**
  - *Source:* `Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects`
- **Substrate Type (P-type (100) Si) & Precision Thickness Extraction ($\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ via $C_{ox} = (\epsilon_{ox} \cdot \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$):**
  - *Source:* `Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction`
- **Integration Context (180nm Lithography / Stacked Topology Inter-Layer Integration):**
  - *Source:* `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Deposition of PECVD TEOS/silane oxide directly onto bare test coupons for Prestonian CMP calibration introduces baseline drift if the underlying substrate-dielectric mechanical interface is not matched to full-stack DRAM ILD wafers. Film stress (compressive target -100 to -180 MPa) must be tightly controlled during RF plasma deposition to prevent coupon bow or film delamination during high downforce (4-7 psi) CMP polishing routines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Silane-based PECVD (SiH4 + N2O/O2) produces oxides with higher Si-OH and Si-H trap bond concentrations and lower density compared to TEOS/O2 plasma-enhanced oxides, leading to elevated polish rates (30-50% faster in silica slurries). If TEOS is selected, liquid delivery vapor injection temperature (110-120°C) and carrier helium flow must maintain stable molar dosing to avoid refractive index (n) shifts away from stoichiometric 1.458-1.462.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: TEOS precursors require dedicated heated delivery lines, bubblers, and liquid injection valves prone to clogging, whereas silane (SiH4) involves ultra-high-purity cylinder manifold infrastructure with pyrophoric gas safety restrictions. Precursor lead times in local pilot lines require maintaining 3-month dual-source qualification for both TEOS (electronic grade 99.9999%) and SiH4/N2O feedstocks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Coupon preparation is on the critical path for calibrating the ILD CMP baseline for 180nm metal stacks. Batch-to-batch thickness variation (>2% 1-sigma across 1000 nm target) will skew the Preston equation shear coefficient (kp) extraction, requiring coupon re-deposition loops that burn N2 storage shelf-life and tool availability.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Compressive film stress excursion exceeding -250 MPa causing coupon warping and edge-chipping/flaking under high CMP downforce
1. Gas-phase homogeneous nucleation from excessive chamber pressure/RF power generating micron-scale dielectric 'snow' particles that cause catastrophic CMP gouges and scratch defects
1. Incomplete degassing or moisture absorption in PECVD films resulting in erratic CMP removal rates and erratic C-V Dit extraction metrics (>1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2)

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-2-1-1-01` | **Post-Deposition Dielectric Film Thickness and Refractive Index Profiling** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Woollam M-2000 or equivalent multi-wavelength ellipsometer, beam spot size <= 100 um) | 1. Mount coupon on vacuum stage. 2. Measure spectral psi and delta across 250 nm to 1000 nm at 65°, 70°, and 75° angles of incidence across a 9-point radial pattern (center, 4 mid-radius, 4 edge points at 3 mm edge exclusion). 3. Fit data using a Cauchy/Sellmeier dielectric model for SiO2. 4. Record mean thickness (t_ox) and refractive index (n at 632.8 nm). | `Mean thickness t_ox = 1000.0 nm +/- 30.0 nm (3%), within-coupon non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) <= 1.5%, refractive index n = 1.460 +/- 0.005 at 632.8 nm.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-2-1-1-02` | **PECVD Oxide Film Intrinsic Stress and Surface Particle Density Verification** | Dual-wavelength Laser Wafer/Coupon Bow Profilometer (Toho FLX or equivalent) and Darkfield Laser Particle Scanner (KLA-Tencor Surfscan or optical defect inspection tool) | 1. Measure post-deposition curvature radius R2 at 25°C. 2. Calculate film stress via Stoney's equation using substrate thickness (525 um for 100 mm test coupon) and elastic moduli. 3. Transfer coupon to darkfield laser particle counter and map defect count for particle diameter >= 0.20 um with 3 mm edge exclusion. | `Film residual stress: Compressive between -100 MPa and -180 MPa (no tensile shift); Particle adder density: <= 0.15 defects/cm^2 for particles >= 0.20 um (zero particles > 1.0 um).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom flame-retardant anti-static cleanroom suit, Heavy-duty chemical-resistant butyl/fluoroelastomer outer gloves over double nitrile cleanroom gloves, Full face shield (polycarbonate ANSI Z87.1 approved), Continuous optical personal multi-gas monitor (calibrated for SiH4 and pyrophoric hydrides)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Silane/Pyrophoric Gas: Immediately evacuate area upon alarm; if ignited, do not extinguish flame unless source gas can be remotely shut off to prevent explosive reignition. Burns: Flush skin with copious tepid water for >= 15 min, apply sterile dry dressing, seek emergency medical care. Inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air, administer high-flow medical oxygen if breathing is labored, do not induce vomiting.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Gas cabinet and delivery lines must maintain negative pressure continuous purge (>150 Pa negative differential, >= 200 fpm face velocity). Reactor exhaust must route through an active thermal/combustion or dry decomposition scrubber (burn-wet or point-of-use catalytic abatement) to react pyrophoric SiH4 and fluorinated NF3 byproducts before municipal HVAC exhaust.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Liquid TEOS condensate traps must be drained into dedicated organic solvent disposal vessels. Scrubbed scrubber wastewater containing SiO2 particulates and fluoride ions must undergo primary calcium hydroxide (lime) precipitation (forming CaF2 sludge) and secondary pH neutralization (pH 6.5-8.5) before discharge into industrial effluent systems.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silane (SiH4)** | `7803-62-5` | Grade 6.0 (99.9999% semiconductor grade) | `100% Compressed Gas (or 2-5% SiH4 in He/Ar balance)` |
| **Tetraethyl orthosilicate (TEOS)** | `78-10-4` | VLSI/MOS Grade (99.999%) | `>= 99.9% Liquid` |
| **Nitrous Oxide (N2O)** | `10024-97-2` | Electronic Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100% Compressed Gas` |
| **Nitrogen Trifluoride (NF3, Chamber Clean)** | `7783-54-2` | Electronic Grade 4.5 (99.995%) | `100% Liquefied Gas` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-cleaned Si coupon with native chemical oxide stripped via 100:1 DHF clean, DI water rinsed to 18.2 MOhm-cm resistivity, and dried via isopropyl alcohol (IPA) Marangoni dryer (hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated surface).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: As-deposited PECVD SiO2 dielectric film with stoichiometric Si-O bonding, target thickness 1000 nm, specular hydrophilic finish, stored in sealed purged FOUP or dry N2 desiccator box (RH < 5%).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture adsorption into porous/non-annealed PECVD oxide forming surface silanol (Si-OH) networks, driving uncontrolled slurry interaction, erratic Prestonian removal rate (>25% error), and surface haze/microroughness during CMP.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery of 100 mm / 150 mm bare silicon test coupons coated with exactly 1000 nm (+/- 3%) PECVD SiO2 (TEOS/Silane-derived) exhibiting controlled compressive stress (-100 to -180 MPa), uniform refractive index (1.460 +/- 0.005), and particle defect density < 0.15 cm^-2, fully qualified for baseline Prestonian DoE CMP polishing.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PECVD_Oxide_Coupon_Ellipsometry_9pt_Profile.csv`
- [ ] `PECVD_FilmStress_and_Curvature_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `KLA_Laser_Surface_Particle_Defect_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean film thickness of deposited PECVD oxide layer across 9-point radial map** | `1000.0 nm` | +/- 30.0 nm | Multi-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry (Woollam M-2000) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Optical refractive index at 632.8 nm wavelength** | `1.460` | +/- 0.005 | Spectroscopic ellipsometry optical constant regression fitting |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Residual thin-film mechanical stress** | `-140 MPa (compressive)` | +/- 40 MPa | Laser substrate curvature profilometry via Stoney's equation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Batch validation of all coupon deliverables confirming t_ox within 970-1030 nm, within-coupon 1-sigma thickness non-uniformity <= 1.5%, stress within -100 to -180 MPa, defect density <= 0.15 particles/cm^2 (>= 0.20 um), sealed inside purged dry N2 canister within 30 min of chamber exit, and signed off by Thin Films Module Owner and CMP Lead.
