nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Point Oxide Thickness and Uniformity Mapping

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-ILD CMP thickness metrology must integrate an automated feed-forward and run-to-run (R2R) advanced process control (APC) loop with the CMP polisher. Relying solely on ex-situ 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry without establishing strict spatial correlation to multi-zone carrier head pressure profiles (retaining ring, zone 1 through zone 4) prevents real-time non-uniformity correction for subsequent lithography depth-of-focus (DOF) budgets at 180nm metal layers.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Optical dispersion parameterization across polished high-density plasma (HDP) or PECVD TEOS films requires fitting both Cauchy parameters (An, Bn, Cn) and surface roughness via an effective medium approximation (EMA) layer. Ignoring post-polish micro-roughness or residual slurry chemistry adsorption causes significant systematic errors in Tan(Psi) and Cos(Delta) inversion, artificially inflating apparent oxide thickness and skewing mean squared error (MSE) fitting tolerances.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology throughput is bounded by automated wafer-handling robotics and optical multi-point alignment stages. Sourcing calibrated NIST-traceable thermal oxide standard wafers (100nm, 500nm, 1000nm) and qualified xenon/deuterium broadband light sources presents standard lead-time risks of 8-12 weeks; secondary vendor calibration standards must be qualified to prevent pilot line downtime during preventative maintenance cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Multi-point oxide thickness mapping constitutes an indispensable gate in the baseline CMP qualification sprint. Mapping throughput must not exceed 90 seconds per wafer across the 49-point polar map to avoid creating a severe queue-time bottleneck upstream of post-CMP PVA brush scrub wet clean and tungsten contact photolithography.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Optical dispersion model divergence due to unmodeled CMP pad abrasion micro-roughness or residual ceria/silica nano-particles resulting in MSE > 2.5 and inaccurate thickness extraction.
1. Edge-exclusion optical distortion within 3mm of the wafer bevel where severe polishing roll-off violates planar film assumptions, leading to erroneous carrier head pressure trim calculations.
1. Post-polish slurry dry-in or airborne organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) causing localized index of refraction shifting and false within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) alarms.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-1-01` | **49-Point Polar Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Mapping for Post-ILD CMP Thickness and WIWNU** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Rotating Compensator, 190nm - 1000nm spectral range, 30um microspot, 70-degree angle of incidence, NIST-traceable calibration standard) | 1. Load wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the spectroscopic ellipsometer with notch aligned at 0 degrees. 2. Execute automated 5-point optical autofocus and stage tilt calibration using the 633nm laser alignment diode. 3. Execute a 49-point polar coordinate measurement recipe (3 concentric rings + center point: R=0mm [1 pt], R=30mm [8 pts], R=60mm [16 pts], R=90mm [24 pts], 3mm edge exclusion). 4. Collect Tan(Psi) and Cos(Delta) spectral arrays from 240nm to 850nm at each point. 5. Fit collected spectra against a validated two-layer model: Si substrate / TEOS Oxide (Cauchy model: An=1.457, Bn=0.0035, Cn=0.00013) / Bruggeman EMA roughness top layer. 6. Compute mean thickness, standard deviation (1-sigma), and percent Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (%WIWNU = [(Max - Min) / (2 * Mean)] * 100). | `Mean remaining ILD oxide thickness must be 650.0 nm ± 25.0 nm; percent Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (%WIWNU) must be <= 3.50%; optical regression fit goodness MSE must be <= 1.80 across all 49 measurement sites.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-1-02` | **Short-Term Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (GRR) on Center and Edge-Die Sites** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer with motorized precision r-theta-z stage and automated pattern recognition vision system | 1. Define 5 designated metrology test locations: 1 center site (X=0, Y=0) and 4 peripheral sites (X=±85mm, Y=0; X=0, Y=±85mm). 2. Execute 15 consecutive, automated load-measure-unload measurement cycles with physical wafer un-chucking and 90-degree re-orientation between runs. 3. Extract extracted film thickness and refractive index n at 632.8nm for all 15 cycles. 4. Calculate measurement dynamic repeatability: 1-sigma standard deviation and maximum range across the 15 iterations. | `Static measurement 1-sigma standard deviation across 15 un-chuck cycles must be <= 0.05 nm for thickness and <= 0.0005 for refractive index (n @ 632.8 nm); total Gauge R&R contribution must not exceed 10.0% of the ±25.0 nm process tolerance.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 10/100 compatible nitrile gloves (double gloved), Polypropylene cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood and boot covers, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-blocking safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom safety shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with cleaning solvents (IPA), flush immediately with copious clean water for 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. In case of optical beam exposure from high-intensity broadband Xe/UV lamp or alignment laser diode, avoid direct ocular exposure, power down system, and seek prompt ophthalmological evaluation. In case of N2 asphyxiation risk from enclosure purge leaks, move subject to open fresh air immediately and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool enclosure requires dedicated clean dry air (CDA) positive-pressure laminar purge with local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at >= 50 CFM to safely extract IPA vapor off-gassing during stage cleaning and prevent optical chamber organic contamination.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Wetted IPA solvent wipes must be deposited into sealed, grounded, flame-retardant solvent waste bins for hazardous solvent incineration; no liquid hazardous waste generated directly during dry non-destructive optical measurement.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Tier C / Ultra-Pure Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | VLSI Grade 5.5 | `99.9995%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP megasonic cleaned, scrubbed with dilute NH4OH/surfactant chemistry, DI water spin-rinse dried, hydrophobic/hydrophilic stabilized with residual moisture < 0.01 ug/cm2, particle count < 20 adders at >= 0.18 um.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Non-destructively characterized planarized oxide surface, free of organic or optical stage vacuum mark contamination, verified remaining thickness within lithography depth-of-focus tolerance, ready for inter-layer contact photo.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes uncontrolled atmospheric moisture condensation, airborne organic amine adsorption, and native chemical scale formation, skewing optical ellipsometry refractive index fits by > 0.02 and triggering false CMP over-polish re-work.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed 49-point automated spectroscopic ellipsometry qualification on polished ILD oxide wafers confirming target thickness, %WIWNU within process specification, validated optical model fitting convergence (MSE < 1.80), and successful transmission of thickness compensation offsets to CMP tool multi-zone polishing heads.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ild_cmp_49pt_ellipsometry_thickness_map.csv`
- [ ] `spectroscopic_psi_delta_fit_report.pdf`
- [ ] `wiwnu_contour_and_zone_distribution.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean remaining post-ILD CMP dielectric oxide thickness across the 49-point mapping grid matches the integrated 180nm backend interconnect specification.** | `650.0 nm` | ± 25.0 nm | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Cauchy dispersion inversion across 240nm-850nm spectral range (TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-1-01) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (%WIWNU) across all measured radial zones remains within the lithographic depth-of-focus budget for Contact/Via1 imaging.** | `2.80%` | <= 3.50% | Calculation from 49 polar coordinate sites using formula: ((Max_Thickness - Min_Thickness) / (2 * Mean_Thickness)) * 100 |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Spectroscopic regression fitting Mean Squared Error (MSE) demonstrates complete model validity with zero divergence caused by unmodeled CMP pad micro-roughness.** | `1.25` | <= 1.80 | Levenberg-Marquardt regression optimization metric evaluating measured vs. calculated Tan(Psi) and Cos(Delta) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 wafer sites pass the optical model regression threshold (MSE <= 1.80), %WIWNU is verified <= 3.50%, mean thickness is verified within 625.0 nm - 675.0 nm, and output CSV data package is cryptographically signed and ingested into the foundry run-to-run (R2R) APC server.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Optical Dispersion Model Calibration & Standard Baseline Verification

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-SE-001`  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs > Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide CMP Recipe Optimization and Polish > ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and AFM Surface Planarity Characterization > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Point Oxide Thickness and Uniformity Mapping > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Optical Dispersion Model Calibration & Standard Baseline Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Knowledge Record:** [docs/knowledge/spectroscopic_ellipsometry_dispersion_calibration.md](./docs/knowledge/spectroscopic_ellipsometry_dispersion_calibration.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Reference Loading:   │
│  Native Oxide Bare Si  │
│  and Certified Oxide   │
│        Standard        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Ellipsometric      │
│  Acquisition: Measure  │
│   Psi and Delta over   │
│        Spectra         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Dispersion Modeling:  │
│  Cauchy and Sellmeier  │
│         Model          │
│    Parameterization    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Baseline        │
│     Verification:      │
│      Sub-Angstrom      │
│   Precision and GoF    │
│       Assessment       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Multi-Point       │
│    Production Wafer    │
│     Thickness and      │
│   Uniformity Mapping   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Tool Initialization and Reference Standard Loading**:
   - Power on the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source and optical detection bench.
   - Load the certified optical calibration standard set (bare silicon reference with known native oxide followed by a certified dry thermal oxide calibration wafer).
   - Align the stage goniometer to the calibrated fixed angle of incidence (AOI) nominal setup.

2. **Ellipsometric Spectral Acquisition**:
   - Measure the polarized beam reflected from the film-substrate interface.
   - Acquire the amplitude ratio ($\Psi$) and phase difference ($\Delta$) across the designated ultraviolet-visible-near infrared (UV-Vis-NIR) spectral range according to the fundamental ellipsometric equation:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ denote the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients for p- and s-polarization.

3. **Dispersion Model Parameterization & Curve Fitting**:
   - Initialize the optical dispersion model library: select the **Cauchy** model ($n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}$) or **Sellmeier** dispersion formulation for the dielectric film.
   - Parameterize the refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ (setting $k(\lambda) \approx 0$ within the transparent spectral band for standard dielectric oxide).
   - Execute Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting against experimental $\tan(\Psi)$ and $\cos(\Delta)$ spectra.

4. **Standard Baseline Verification & Precision Qualification**:
   - Validate calibration baseline against the ultrathin dry gate oxide reference ($3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal target), confirming sub-Angstrom precision.
   - Cross-check thick dielectric/resist baseline on a $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thick qualification coupon to verify long-wavelength dispersion fitting stability.

5. **Multi-Point Map Routine Deployment**:
   - Lock calibrated dispersion parameters ($n(\lambda)$, $k(\lambda)$) into the ILD Oxide CMP metrology recipe.
   - Configure the automated stage for routine **9-point** or **49-point** wafer mapping grids to track radial film non-uniformity across polished wafers.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                             ┌─────────────────────────┐
                             │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░          │
       Capacitance Floor (fF)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░          │
                             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
      Wafer Map Density (pts)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    Resist Precision (+/- nm)┤▓▓                       │
                             │▓▓                       │
Gate Oxide Precision (+/- nm)┤█                        │
                             │█                        │
                             └┬─────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬┘
                             0.0  12.2  24.5  36.8 49.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thin Gate Oxide Baseline Precision** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ regression) |
| **Thick Film / Resist Baseline Precision** | $1.3$ | $\pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ (film at $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Cauchy Model |
| **Automated Wafer Map Spatial Density** | $49$ (or $9$) | Exact discrete points | $\text{points/wafer}$ | Automated radial/concentric pattern stage map |
| **Cell Capacitance Floor Integration Target** | $28$ | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked capacitor electrical parameter qualification |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Provides the fundamental ellipsometric equation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$, the use of Cauchy and Sellmeier optical dispersion models for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$, the target measurement precision of dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) and photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m} \pm 2\text{ nm}$), as well as the 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping standard.
- **Source: Ellipsometry Basics**:
  - Direct basis for phase change $\Delta$ (delta) and amplitude ratio $\Psi$ (psi) extraction.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Sets the 180nm generation physical cell constraints, stacked capacitor integration requirements, and the minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ storage capacitance target.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The optical dispersion model parameterization must decouple the post-CMP inter-layer dielectric (ILD) SiO2 Cauchy coefficients from the underlying native oxide and interfacial silicon roughness; failure to fit both An, Bn, and interfacial layer thickness concurrently in the 190-1000 nm spectral regime will alias residual slurry-induced micro-roughness as false bulk thickness deviations, corrupting downstream run-to-run CMP endpoint control feedback.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating dielectric optical constants on blanket NIST-traceable thermal oxide wafers (e.g., 100 nm and 1000 nm) does not account for the modified refractive index (delta n approx 0.005-0.012 at 632.8 nm) and increased optical extinction (k > 0) caused by sub-surface mechanical damage, silanol (Si-OH) hydration, and plastic strain induced by ILD CMP shear force. Calibration must establish a dual-layer optical stack incorporating an effective medium approximation (EMA) top layer representing CMP-altered hydration/porosity.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring certified NIST-traceable SiO2-on-Si standard reference calibration wafers (VLSI Standards or equivalent 100 nm / 1000 nm standards) entails a 12-16 week lead time and shelf-life recalibration requirements. Standard calibration wafers must be secured with multi-vendor cross-qualification (e.g., KLA-Tencor vs. J.A. Woollam certified standards) to avoid single-point fab line stops during routine daily tool qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tool qualification schedule risks critical-path delay for the 180nm DRAM tapeout if daily baseline qualification takes >45 minutes per shift. Ellipsometry dispersion calibration recipes must be automated with macro-scripted auto-alignment, auto-focus, and regression minimization (MSE < 1.5) within a 15-minute gatekeeper routine before releasing the metrology station for wafer-lot processing.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Mathematical cross-correlation between the Cauchy Bn dispersion parameter and film thickness t_ox during unconstrained Levenberg-Marquardt regression, causing systematic thickness measurement offset up to 4.5 nm.
1. Organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) or native hydrocarbon adsorption layer building on standard calibration wafers during prolonged air exposure, producing a drifting pseudo-thickness of 0.3-0.8 nm and invalidating the dispersion model baseline.
1. Misalignment of the optical goniometer angle of incidence (AOI) drift exceeding ±0.02 degrees, leading to non-physical extracted refractive index shifts (dn/dAOI approx 0.004/deg) across multi-point wafer mapping.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-1-1-01` | **NIST-Traceable Thermal Oxide Calibration and Goniometer AOI Verification** | Variable Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (J.A. Woollam M-2000 or KLA ASET-F5x) equipped with Xenon arc source (190-1000 nm), automated goniometer stage (65° to 75°), and NIST-traceable 100.0 nm SiO2/Si calibration standard wafer. | 1. Load NIST-traceable 100.0 nm SiO2/Si standard wafer onto the vacuum chuck. 2. Execute automated sample tilt and z-height alignment to maximize detector signal amplitude (>80% raw intensity). 3. Acquire spectral Psi and Delta data at three angles of incidence: 65.00°, 70.00°, and 75.00° across 190 nm to 1000 nm with 2.0 nm step resolution. 4. Fit the experimental spectrum using a standard parameterized Cauchy dispersion model [n(lambda) = An + Bn/(lambda^2) + Cn/(lambda^4), k = 0] with Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. 5. Extract thickness t_ox, refractive index n at 632.8 nm, and Mean Squared Error (MSE). | `Standard thickness t_ox must match certified NIST value within ±0.20 nm (nominal 100.00 ± 0.20 nm). Extracted refractive index at 632.8 nm must equal 1.4570 ± 0.0020. Regression goodness-of-fit MSE must be < 1.50 across all three angles.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-1-1-02` | **Post-CMP ILD TEOS/Silane Oxide Dispersion Parameter Stability and Repeatability Test** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (190-1000 nm) with motorized r-theta stage, cleanroom nitrogen purge chamber, and 49-point automated polar map recipe. | 1. Mount post-CMP ILD monitor wafer on vacuum chuck. 2. Measure center-point optical dispersion using an extended Bruggeman Effective Medium Approximation (B-EMA) stack: Si substrate / 1.5 nm SiO2 interface / bulk ILD Cauchy layer / 2.0 nm surface EMA (50% ILD + 50% void/slurry hydration). 3. Measure 49 points across wafer (3mm edge exclusion). 4. Repeat the 49-point measurement 10 consecutive times without dismounting to evaluate dynamic repeatability (1-sigma). 5. Compute mean thickness, thickness non-uniformity (NU%), An and Bn parameter standard deviations. | `Center point fit MSE must be < 2.20. Extracted bulk ILD refractive index n(632.8 nm) must reside within 1.4580 to 1.4640. 10-run dynamic measurement thickness repeatability 1-sigma must be <= 0.04 nm across all 49 sites. Calculated 49-point wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) must be <= 1.8%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 10 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol), UV-blocking safety glasses (OD > 4 at 190-400 nm) for Xenon arc lamp inspection and maintenance, Cleanroom ESD-safe bunny suit, hood, boots, and face mask, Laser safety glasses (Class 3R alignment diode laser compliant)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmic medical evaluation. Skin contact: Wash affected dermal area thoroughly with soap and water; remove contaminated cleanroom garments. Inhalation of solvent fumes: Move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if respiration becomes labored. Xenon lamp ozone exposure: Evacuate area immediately to well-ventilated zone.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom laminar flow bench with localized HEPA filtration (air velocity 0.45 ± 0.05 m/s). Ellipsometer Xenon lamp housing must be fitted with dedicated active negative-pressure mini-exhaust duct (minimum exhaust flow rate 35 CFM) to evacuate ozone (O3) byproduct generated by DUV lamp emission.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA-impregnated cleanroom task wipers must be collected in dedicated, grounded, self-closing airtight stainless steel solvent waste bins. Spent liquid solvents must be routed to the fab central solvent collection carboy for certified hazardous waste incineration. No liquid solvent disposal into domestic or acid/base drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 5 (Electronic Grade) | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP 99.9999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP scrubbed, megasonic rinsed with UPW (ultra-pure water), spin-dried ILD wafer surface free of slurry abrasive particles, water marks, and macroscopic chemical residues; hydrophobic/hydrophilic equilibrium stabilized.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Non-destructively measured, optical-dispersion-verified ILD oxide surface ready for dry contact-hole photolithography or subsequent inter-metal dielectric metallization with verified sub-nanometer thickness distribution.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes ambient volatile organic compound (VOC) adsorption and moisture absorption on hydrophilic TEOS/silane oxide, shifting measured optical thickness by up to +1.2 nm and causing inaccurate polishing rate calibration for subsequent CMP runs.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed spectroscopic ellipsometer baseline verification and optical dispersion model calibration for 180nm open-source DRAM post-CMP ILD oxide films. Demonstrates sub-Angstrom optical thickness precision, validated goniometer accuracy against NIST-traceable standards, stabilized Cauchy dispersion parameterization (MSE < 1.50 on reference, MSE < 2.20 on post-CMP ILD), and verified 49-point wafer mapping repeatability.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ELLIPSO_NIST_CALIBRATION_BASELINE_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `ILD_OXIDE_DISPERSION_MODEL_PARAMETERS_V1.csv`
- [ ] `49POINT_THICKNESS_UNIFORMITY_CONTOUR_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical thickness measurement deviation from certified NIST reference standard value** | `0.00 nm` | ±0.20 nm | Multi-angle spectroscopic ellipsometric regression analysis at 65°, 70°, and 75° AOI over 190-1000 nm against certified 100.0 nm NIST standard. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Spectral model regression goodness-of-fit Mean Squared Error (MSE)** | `1.10` | <= 1.50 | Levenberg-Marquardt normalized weighted Chi-squared / MSE calculation comparing experimental vs. model Psi(lambda) and Delta(lambda) spectra. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-CMP ILD oxide 49-point thickness measurement dynamic repeatability standard deviation (1-sigma)** | `0.025 nm` | <= 0.040 nm | Statistical 1-sigma standard deviation calculation across 10 consecutive automated wafer reload and remap iterations. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions (ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03) verified and passing; NIST calibration certificate matched within ±0.20 nm; Xenon lamp intensity and ozone exhaust certified in spec; calibrated Cauchy dispersion model parameter file (.csv) committed to fab metrology database and signed off by Metrology Lead, Lead CMP Process Engineer, and Systems Engineering Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-SE-49PT-001`
**Title:** Automated 49-Point Wafer Grid Polarimetric Data Acquisition across Post-CMP ILD Oxide  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | Metrology & Thin Film Quality Control  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Objective & Principle
To acquire high-precision polarimetric reflectance spectra ($\Psi, \Delta$) across a standardized automated 49-point wafer grid on post-CMP Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) oxide films. Metrology relies on rotating-compensator spectroscopic ellipsometry parameterizing the complex reflectance ratio:
$$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
where $r_p$ and $r_s$ denote complex Fresnel reflection coefficients, fit via Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models to extract local oxide film thickness, radial non-uniformity, and erosion/dishing signatures.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Tool Initialization & Baseline Calibration
1. Power on the automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE) broadband Xenon source (spectral range: $\lambda = 240\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$).
2. Perform standard optical calibration on the reference calibration standard:
   - Primary standard: Native silicon substrate with thermally grown dry oxide standard ($3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
   - Verify alignment of polarizer and rotating analyzer azimuths to zero reference offset.
3. Validate beam spot focus: Collimated micro-spot beam optics sized to $\le 50\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ to ensure clean sampling on post-CMP test pads without micro-structure edge diffraction.

#### Step 2: Automated Recipe Configuration & Grid Loading
1. Load optical model library: Select **Cauchy Dispersion Model** for transparent ILD silicon dioxide film:
   $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
   with initial nominal parameter seed: $n(\lambda=632.8\text{ nm}) \approx 1.457$.
2. Configure goniometer angle of incidence (AOI) fixed at $\theta = 70.0^\circ$ (near the Brewster angle for $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ interface to maximize sensitivity of $\Delta$).
3. Select the automated **49-Point Polarimetric Grid Pattern**:
   - Equal-area concentric polar grid distribution (Center: 1 point, Ring 1: 8 points, Ring 2: 12 points, Ring 3: 16 points, Ring 4: 12 points).
   - Fixed edge exclusion margin: $3.0\text{ mm}$ from wafer bevel.

#### Step 3: Automated Robotic Wafer Loading & Alignment
1. Transfer post-CMP cleaned and dried 200mm DRAM production wafer from the FOUP/cassette to the automated vacuum chuck.
2. Execute automated optical pattern recognition (die alignment mark detection) to establish wafer center $(0,0)$ and notch orientation.
3. Verify vacuum chuck hold-down pressure ($\ge 75\text{ kPa}$) to prevent wafer warp-induced optical defocus.

#### Step 4: Polarimetric Data Acquisition Sequence
1. Initiate automated sequence: Stage moves sequentially from Site 1 through Site 49.
2. At each site:
   - Auto-focus $Z$-height sensor to optical focal plane within $\pm 1\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - Acquire raw polarimetric signal over 20 analyzer revolutions (integration time: $1.5\text{ s}$ per site).
   - Compute experimental $\tan(\Psi)$ and $\cos(\Delta)$ spectra across $\lambda = 240\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$.
3. Run automated Levenberg-Marquardt regression to extract film thickness $T_{\text{ILD}}$ and goodness-of-fit (Mean Squared Error, MSE).

#### Step 5: Data Export & Statistical Uniformity Calculation
1. Compute full-wafer 49-point percent non-uniformity:
   $$\text{NU}\% = \frac{T_{\max} - T_{\min}}{2 \times T_{\text{mean}}} \times 100\%$$
2. Generate contour topography map to identify radial over-polish (bullseye or ring patterns).
3. Unload wafer to FOUP and log data into Manufacturing Execution System (MES).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Unit | Inspection Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Precision (Static Repeatability)** | $\le \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ ($1\sigma$) | 10-cycle static measurement on Center Site |
| **Ellipsometric Regression Fit Quality (MSE)** | $< 2.50$ | Dimensionless | Cauchy model regression across $240 - 800\text{ nm}$ |
| **49-Point Data Acquisition Throughput** | $\le 120$ | $\text{s/wafer}$ | Total recipe runtime from Site 1 to Site 49 |
| **Total Post-CMP Thickness Non-Uniformity (NU)** | $\le 3.0$ | $\%$ | Computed from 49-point polar distribution |

---

### 4. Sources Cited
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Principles of polarimetric ellipsometry ($\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$), optical modeling (Cauchy/Sellmeier), dry oxide precision benchmark ($3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$), and automated 49-point wafer mapping for tracking radial non-uniformity.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Gate dielectric baseline ($3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$) and structural dimensional boundaries.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-CAUCHY-001`
**Title:** Cauchy Fit Regression, Radial Film Thickness Uniformity Contour Mapping & WIWNU Extraction  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs > Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide CMP Recipe Optimization and Polish > ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and AFM Surface Planarity Characterization > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Point Oxide Thickness and Uniformity Mapping > Cauchy Fit Regression, Radial Film Thickness Uniformity Contour Mapping & WIWNU Extraction  
**Target Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Recipe Loading &   │
│     Calibration      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Ellipsometric Data  │
│     Acquisition      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Cauchy Dispersion   │
│      Model Fit       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Radial Contour &   │
│   WIWNU Extraction   │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometer Calibration & Alignment**:
   - Initialize system source across the spectral range $\lambda = 250\text{ nm} - 1000\text{ nm}$.
   - Verify hardware baseline on bare silicon reference wafer to ensure detector sensitivity and goniometer alignment at angle of incidence $\theta_0 = 70^\circ$.
   - Confirm baseline measurement precision capability for thin dielectric monitoring (calibrated to $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ on thin oxide baseline).

2. **Automated Wafer Grid Mapping Setup**:
   - Load polished ILD post-CMP 200 mm wafer onto the vacuum stage.
   - Program automated coordinate map using standard concentric multi-point pattern: either an automated **9-point** inspection grid or high-density **49-point** wafer map covering radial sectors across center, middle ($r = 0.5 R$), and edge exclusion zones ($3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

3. **Polarization Data Acquisition ($\Psi, \Delta$)**:
   - Measure the change in polarization upon reflection at each programmed site:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
   - Acquire raw polarization angles $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ across all 9 or 49 sites.

4. **Cauchy Dispersion Model Regression**:
   - Model the transparent ILD oxide dielectric film ($k(\lambda) \approx 0$) over the Si substrate using the Cauchy dispersion equation:
     $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}$$
   - Execute Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear regression fitting simultaneously for oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$ and Cauchy parameters ($A$, $B$, $C$).
   - Validate regression fit quality via mean squared error (MSE) and coefficient of determination ($R^2 \ge 0.99$).

5. **Radial Film Thickness Contour Mapping & WIWNU Extraction**:
   - Extract fitted thickness $t_i$ for all $N$ measurement points ($N = 9$ or $N = 49$).
   - Calculate sample mean thickness ($\bar{t}$) and standard deviation ($\sigma$).
   - Compute Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity percent (%WIWNU, 1$\sigma$ and min-max):
     $$\text{WIWNU } (1\sigma, \%) = \left( \frac{\sigma}{\bar{t}} \right) \times 100\%$$
     $$\text{WIWNU } (\text{Half-Range}, \%) = \left( \frac{t_{\max} - t_{\min}}{2 \times \bar{t}} \right) \times 100\%$$
   - Interpolate 2D radial thickness contour maps to evaluate edge roll-off vs center-fast CMP polish profiles.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                        Metrology Acceptance Targets    
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░                               │
   PR Thick Prec (nm)┤░░                               │
                     │▒                                │
Sub-A Oxide Prec (nm)┤▒                                │
     WIWNU Target (%)┤▓▓                               │
                     │▓▓                               │
     Cauchy R2 (x100)┤█████████████████████████████████│
                     │█████████████████████████████████│
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    24.8    49.5    74.2   99.0 
```

| Parameter | Metric / Equation | Target Specification | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Precision (Oxide)** | Standard deviation repeatability on thin oxide | $\le \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Thick Film Precision (Photoresist)** | Repeatability on thick organic/dielectric stack | $\le \pm 2.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cauchy Fit Quality** | Goodness-of-fit coefficient of determination ($R^2$) | $\ge 0.99$ | Dimensionless |
| **Post-CMP Radial WIWNU** | Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity ($1\sigma$) over 49 points | $\le 3.0$ | $\%$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - *Physical Principle & Equation:* $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$, parameterizing change in polarization via Fresnel reflection coefficients $r_p$ and $r_s$.
  - *Optical Dispersion Modeling:* Cauchy or Sellmeier parameterization for refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Precision Limits:* Sub-angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) on thin oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ gate baseline) and $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ on thick films ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$).
  - *Spatial Sampling:* Automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across process runs.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated data interchange between spectroscopic ellipsometry tool outputs and inline CMP APC (Advanced Process Control) run-to-run controllers must enforce strict schema validation; unconstrained Cauchy parameter fitting (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4) risks mathematical cross-correlation between film thickness (t) and index parameter (A) if broad spectral range (240-800 nm) is not constrained to physical dielectric ranges (SiO2 n=1.45-1.47 at 632.8 nm), leading to false removal-rate feedback shifts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM ILD planarization post-CMP, edge-exclusion must be strictly standardized at 3.0 mm; extraction of Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU % = (sigma / mean) * 100) across 49 concentric polar points requires distinguishing between center-fast/slow radial profile signatures and micro-scale pattern-dependent dishing/erosion, ensuring the Cauchy model assumes zero extinction coefficient (k=0) above 300 nm for transparent TEOS/HDP-CVD oxide.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated wafer handling stages and xenon/deuterium broadband light sources for spectroscopic ellipsometers face high replacement lead times (14-20 weeks); standardized optical calibration sets (traceable NIST SiO2 on Si reference wafers) must be second-sourced to avoid qualification bottlenecks across 180nm foundry metrology lines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Inline multi-point mapping must not create a throughput bottleneck; full 49-point wafer acquisition, regression fitting, and WIWNU extraction must complete in <= 75 seconds per wafer to match CMP platen cycle times and avoid queue-time expiration prior to downstream lithography or post-CMP clean inspection.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Cauchy parameter divergence or local minimum convergence resulting in non-physical refractive index (n < 1.40 or n > 1.55) and an erroneous ILD thickness calculation exceeding ±15 nm error.
1. Inappropriate edge exclusion (e.g., <2.0 mm) capturing roll-off slurry slurry pooling artifacts, artificially skewing calculated WIWNU from <3% to >8% and falsely aborting the CMP polisher run.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-1-3-01` | **49-Point Radial Polar Ellipsometry Scan and Cauchy Dispersion Fitting Validation** | Automated Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE / Rotating Compensator Ellipsometer, 240-800 nm spectral range, 30 um spot size, automated wafer stage) | 1. Load 200mm production wafer and align to wafer notch at 0 degrees. 2. Execute automated 49-point polar recipe (radii at 0 mm, 25 mm, 50 mm, 75 mm, 90 mm, and 97 mm with 3 mm edge exclusion). 3. Acquire raw Psi(lambda) and Delta(lambda) spectra from 250 nm to 800 nm at 70-degree angle of incidence. 4. Apply non-linear Levenberg-Marquardt regression using three-parameter Cauchy model (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4, with initial bounds: A in [1.44, 1.48], B in [0.002, 0.006] um^2, k=0). 5. Compute Mean Squared Error (MSE) of spectral fit and extract local thickness t_i for each site i=1..49. | `Regression MSE <= 2.50 across all 49 measured sites; fitted Cauchy refractive index A-parameter strictly within 1.455 ± 0.015 at 632.8 nm; zero data acquisition timeout across the wafer map.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-1-3-02` | **Radial Film Thickness Contour Generation and 1-Sigma WIWNU Extraction** | Metrology Host Data Extraction & APC Analysis Engine (Metrology Automated Statistical Yield Server) | 1. Import extracted thickness array {t_1, t_2, ..., t_49} from ellipsometer database. 2. Compute wafer mean thickness (T_mean) and sample standard deviation (sigma_t). 3. Calculate WIWNU percentage via the formula: WIWNU = (sigma_t / T_mean) * 100. 4. Segment points into 5 concentric radial annular zones and calculate zone mean thickness to detect center-to-edge profile curvature. 5. Generate radial 2D contour map with 10 nm contour steps spanning 3 mm edge-exclusion boundary. | `Mean ILD thickness between 630.0 nm and 670.0 nm (target 650.0 nm ± 20.0 nm); 1-sigma WIWNU <= 3.20%; radial center-to-edge delta <= 25.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves, UV-filtering laser/broadband safety glasses (OD > 4 at 240-400 nm), Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) protective cleanroom coat and footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious sterile deionized water for at least 15 minutes. In case of accidental broad-spectrum UV beam exposure to eyes, cover eyes with sterile compress and transport immediately for ophthalmological assessment.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool exhaust ventilation must maintain continuous negative pressure with minimum air flow of 75 CFM to extract trace volatile cleanroom wipes and purge nitrogen gas to prevent localized asphyxiation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA-saturated wipes must be sealed in airtight, ESD-safe hazardous waste bins and routed to dedicated solvent incineration streams; zero drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, cleanroom surface wipe)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP polished, DI-water rinsed, megasonic scrubbed, and Marangoni vapor-dried ILD SiO2 surface free of slurry particle residue (particle count < 25 at >= 0.18 um).

**Exit Objective Summary**:

- [ ] `CAUCHY_REGRESSION_FIT_AND_MSE_LOG.pdf`
- [ ] `RADIAL_WIWNU_THICKNESS_CONTOUR_MAP.tiff`

| `ASSERT-01` | **Spectral regression goodness-of-fit Mean Squared Error (MSE) across all 49 wafer mapping points** | `1.20` | <= 2.50 | Automated Levenberg-Marquardt Cauchy fit convergence log evaluation |

critics.systems_engineer: Automated data interchange between spectroscopic ellipsometry tool outputs and inline CMP APC (Advanced Process Control) run-to-run controllers must enforce strict schema validation; unconstrained Cauchy parameter fitting (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4) risks mathematical cross-correlation between film thickness (t) and index parameter (A) if broad spectral range (240-800 nm) is not constrained to physical dielectric ranges (SiO2 n=1.45-1.47 at 632.8 nm), leading to false removal-rate feedback shifts.
critics.domain_expert: For 180nm DRAM ILD planarization post-CMP, edge-exclusion must be strictly standardized at 3.0 mm; extraction of Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU % = (sigma / mean) * 100) across 49 concentric polar points requires distinguishing between center-fast/slow radial profile signatures and micro-scale pattern-dependent dishing/erosion, ensuring the Cauchy model assumes zero extinction coefficient (k=0) above 300 nm for transparent TEOS/HDP-CVD oxide.
critics.supply_chain: Automated wafer handling stages and xenon/deuterium broadband light sources for spectroscopic ellipsometers face high replacement lead times (14-20 weeks); standardized optical calibration sets (traceable NIST SiO2 on Si reference wafers) must be second-sourced to avoid qualification bottlenecks across 180nm foundry metrology lines.

testcases.title: 49-Point Radial Polar Ellipsometry Scan and Cauchy Dispersion Fitting Validation
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE / Rotating Compensator Ellipsometer, 240-800 nm spectral range, 30 um spot size, automated wafer stage)
testcases.pre_conditions: 200mm post-CMP clean & dried wafer loaded into FOUP; stage vacuum verified; reference 100 nm thermally grown SiO2 calibration standard measured with thickness error <= 0.05 nm and MSE <= 1.5.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load 200mm production wafer and align to wafer notch at 0 degrees.
2. Execute automated 49-point polar recipe (radii at 0 mm, 25 mm, 50 mm, 75 mm, 90 mm, and 97 mm with 3 mm edge exclusion).
3. Acquire raw Psi(lambda) and Delta(lambda) spectra from 250 nm to 800 nm at 70-degree angle of incidence.
4. Apply non-linear Levenberg-Marquardt regression using three-parameter Cauchy model (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4, with initial bounds: A in [1.44, 1.48], B in [0.002, 0.006] um^2, k=0).
5. Compute Mean Squared Error (MSE) of spectral fit and extract local thickness t_i for each site i=1..49.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Regression MSE <= 2.50 across all 49 measured sites; fitted Cauchy refractive index A-parameter strictly within 1.455 ± 0.015 at 632.8 nm; zero data acquisition timeout across the wafer map.

testcases.title: Radial Film Thickness Contour Generation and 1-Sigma WIWNU Extraction
testcases.instrumentation: Metrology Host Data Extraction & APC Analysis Engine (Metrology Automated Statistical Yield Server)
testcases.pre_conditions: Completed 49-point thickness data file loaded with confirmed valid MSE; target post-ILD CMP oxide thickness target = 650.0 nm.
testcases.procedure:
1. Import extracted thickness array {t_1, t_2, ..., t_49} from ellipsometer database.
2. Compute wafer mean thickness (T_mean) and sample standard deviation (sigma_t).
3. Calculate WIWNU percentage via the formula: WIWNU = (sigma_t / T_mean) * 100.
4. Segment points into 5 concentric radial annular zones and calculate zone mean thickness to detect center-to-edge profile curvature.
5. Generate radial 2D contour map with 10 nm contour steps spanning 3 mm edge-exclusion boundary.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: AFM Pre- and Post-CMP Surface Micro-Roughness and Dishing Profilometry

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: AFM profilometry must bridge macroscopic wafer-scale non-uniformity (WIWNU) captured by spectroscopic reflectometry/ellipsometry with nanoscopic local step-height topography. Scanning throughput is inherently low (0.5 to 1.0 Hz line rates); therefore, scan coordinates must be rigidly mapped to lithography alignment test structures, dense memory array edges, and isolated ILD oxide test keys rather than arbitrary die locations. Optical pattern recognition and acoustic/vibrational isolation (air-table resonance <2 Hz) must be verified prior to engaging feedback, or thermal drift will corrupt step-height extraction across 50 um line scans.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-CMP ILD oxide micro-roughness (Rq/Ra) must decrease below 0.3 nm over a 5 um x 5 um window to avoid scattering during subsequent DUV/i-line photolithography, while oxide dishing in wide dielectric spacing and erosion in dense array lines must remain within 180nm node depth-of-focus (DoF) budgets (dishing <35 nm across a 50 um oxide pitch). Tapping/non-contact mode using ultra-sharp silicon tips (tip radius <10 nm, spring constant 20-40 N/m) is mandatory; contact mode will drag residual colloidal silica/ceria nanoparticles across the soft PETEOS oxide, generating micro-scratches that mimic polishing defects.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Atomic force microscope cantilevers (e.g., monolithic n-type silicon tapping tips) are consumable components with finite life spans; abrasive contact with uncleaned post-CMP residual slurry particles blunts tips from <10 nm to >50 nm tip radius within 10-15 scans, degrading lateral resolution and distorting sidewall slope measurements. Standardize on batch-qualified cantilevers with tracked resonance frequencies and maintain an active buffer stock of SPM calibration standards (silicon step-height gratings certified to NIST standards).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM measurement turnaround is the pacing bottleneck in CMP polish table downforce and platen speed optimization loops. If AFM recipe setup and queue times exceed 45 minutes per wafer, wafer lots stall ahead of post-CMP PVA brush scrub and clean-room post-rinse verification. An automated 5-site sampling routine (Center, North, South, East, West) with predefined coordinate files must be locked to keep total measurement duration under 25 minutes per cassette test wafer.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip blunting and artifact convolution: slurry nanoparticle agglomerates attach to the AFM probe apex, artificially broadening dishing profile sidewalls and overestimating micro-roughness values.
1. Acoustic/thermal drift error: thermal non-equilibrium between the CMP post-clean dry station and AFM acoustic isolation hood induces Z-piezo drift >2 nm/min, distorting absolute dishing depth across large 50-100 um scans.
1. Post-CMP queue-time surface hazing: delays exceeding queue-time limits cause atmospheric airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption and water mark crystallization, obscuring genuine baseline oxide roughness.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-2-01` | **Post-ILD CMP Surface Micro-Roughness (Ra and Rq) Quantification** | Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) in Tapping/Non-Contact Mode, 300 kHz resonance silicon cantilevers (tip radius <10 nm), floating pneumatic vibration isolation table | 1. Load wafer onto vacuum chuck and align optical coordinate system to die-center ILD test pad (100 um x 100 um unpatterned oxide field). 2. Approach tip to surface using automated feedback loop with setpoint ratio 0.85. 3. Acquire 5.0 um x 5.0 um scan at 512 x 512 pixels resolution with 0.8 Hz scan rate. 4. Perform 1st-order XY plane fit and 2nd-order flattening on trace height data. 5. Calculate Root Mean Square roughness (Rq) and Average roughness (Ra). 6. Repeat across 5 standard die locations (Center, North, South, East, West). | `Surface micro-roughness Rq must be <= 0.30 nm and Ra must be <= 0.22 nm across all 5 test sites. Tip radius qualification must show tip broadening <15% post-scan.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-2-02` | **ILD Oxide Dishing and Array Erosion Profilometry Across 50 um Pitch Structure** | Large-stage automated AFM with 100 um XY closed-loop scan range and high-aspect-ratio silicon tips (cantilever stiffness 40 N/m, resonance ~325 kHz) | 1. Navigate to 180nm DRAM isolation-to-ILD transition test structure featuring 50 um wide oxide line adjacent to dense line-space arrays. 2. Orient scan angle orthogonal (90 +/- 0.5 degrees) to oxide lines. 3. Execute 60 um x 5 um line scan at 0.3 Hz line rate, 1024 x 128 data point density. 4. Apply line-by-line tilt subtraction referenced to unpolished reference planar pads. 5. Extract cross-sectional step profile and calculate maximum dishing depth (recess from planar oxide baseline to lowest point of oxide line). | `Maximum oxide dishing depth across 50 um width structure must be <= 30.0 nm. Array erosion across dense peripheral/cell test area must be <= 25.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves with chemical resistance, ANSI Z87.1 certified side-shield safety glasses, Class 10/100 ESD-safe cleanroom frock and antistatic footwear, Laser safety eye protection rated for AFM alignment diode laser (650-670 nm, Class 2/3R)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA eye contact: Irrigate immediately with sterile eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek medical attention. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with non-abrasive soap and DI water. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move individual to fresh clean air immediately. Laser exposure: If eye is exposed directly to laser diode beam, seek immediate ophthalmologic examination.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM metrology unit must operate in a temperature-controlled Class 100 cleanroom ballroom with laminar air downflow (0.45 m/s +/- 20%) and dedicated solvent-rated mini-environment extraction (>50 CFM exhaust port for IPA wipe-down operations).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent wipes soaked with IPA must be collected in dedicated fireproof, grounded self-closing steel disposal bins. Contaminated wafer cassettes and DI rinse effluent routed to cleanroom industrial waste water neutralization systems (pH monitored and neutralized to 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal discharge).

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Tier 3 / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Colloidal Silica CMP Slurry Residue (Amorphous SiO2)** | `7631-86-9` | Technical Dispersion | `<0.1% trace residue` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, megasonic/PVA-scrub post-cleaned PETEOS/HDP-CVD oxide surface, dried via nitrogen spin rinse dryer (SRD), free from macroscopic slurry rings and water marks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, defect-free ILD dielectric surface with confirmed roughness Rq <0.3 nm, sealed in nitrogen-purged FOUP/SMIF pod, prepared for subsequent via/contact photolithography.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure queue time induces airborne molecular contamination (organic siloxane adsorption) and native surface carbon condensation, artificially increasing AFM micro-roughness measurements by >0.15 nm and impairing subsequent via photoresist adhesion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full metrological characterization of pre- and post-CMP inter-layer dielectric (ILD) oxide planarity, delivering verified micro-roughness profiles and dishing/erosion topography metrics across critical DRAM array geometries conforming to 180nm node integration limits.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ILD_CMP_Roughness_Rq_Ra_Distribution.csv`
- [ ] `AFM_Dishing_Erosion_CrossSection_Profile.tiff`
- [ ] `Metrology_Certificate_ILD_Planarity_Signoff.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-CMP ILD oxide surface micro-roughness (Rq) across unpatterned test fields** | `0.25 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm | AFM 5 um x 5 um tapping mode height map, 512x512 resolution, 1st-order flattening, measured across 5 sites per wafer. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum post-CMP dielectric dishing depth on 50 um pitch memory edge test structure** | `22.0 nm` | +/- 6.0 nm | AFM 60 um cross-sectional line profile height extraction referenced to adjacent unetched planar field. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Wafer-level AFM measurement repeatability across 3 consecutive scans at wafer center site** | `0.02 nm Rq 1-sigma` | <= 0.03 nm Rq 1-sigma | Statistical standard deviation of 3 successive automated loading and scan runs on identical NIST-traceable reference coordinate. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 wafer sampling zones exhibit post-CMP ILD oxide micro-roughness Rq <= 0.30 nm, maximum dishing on 50 um line structures <= 30.0 nm, AFM tip wear diagnostics verify probe radius <12 nm after scan sequence, and sign-off report is archived in the DRAM Foundation VN quality tracking database.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Pre-CMP AFM Micro-Roughness Baseline & Test Structure Coordinate Setup

**Hierarchy Path:** `Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs > Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide CMP Recipe Optimization and Polish > ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and AFM Surface Planarity Characterization > AFM Pre- and Post-CMP Surface Micro-Roughness and Dishing Profilometry > Pre-CMP AFM Micro-Roughness Baseline & Test Structure Coordinate Setup`  
**Process Node / Tech Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm CMOS DRAM)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 1: Coordinate   │
│   Alignment & Global   │
│         Deskew         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
```

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Coordinate Alignment & Global Deskew
1. Secure the 180nm patterned wafer/die onto the atomic force microscopy (AFM) vacuum chuck.
2. Engage top-down optical navigation (10× objective). Locate global wafer alignment marks (primary fiducials) at opposite die corners.
3. Perform optical 2-point / 3-point angular deskew calibration to establish stage coordinate zero $(X_0, Y_0)$ and eliminate theta tilt error (target residual alignment rotation $< \pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$ across the die).

### Step 2: Optical Target Navigation & Test Structure Coordinate Registration
1. Drive the motorized translation stage to the dedicated metrology frame containing the **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM)** structure.
2. Identify and register the test structure dimensions:
   - Verify contact pad geometry: pad width $W = 100\,\mu\text{m}$, pad length $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Register reference site coordinates between identical pads at nominal gaps: $d = 5\,\mu\text{m}$, $10\,\mu\text{m}$, $20\,\mu\text{m}$, $40\,\mu\text{m}$, and $80\,\mu\text{m}$.
3. Navigate to the adjacent dense DRAM array test site containing the post-ILD deposition oxide directly above the memory cell access transistor area (unit cell target layout: channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$ with shared bitline contacts).
4. Save absolute stage coordinates into the automated AFM recipe sequence.

### Step 3: Cantilever Tuning & Tip Auto-Approach
1. Load a high-aspect-ratio silicon tapping/non-contact mode probe (nominal tip radius $\le 10\,\text{nm}$).
2. Perform laser photodiode alignment: center reflected laser beam onto the four-quadrant position-sensitive detector (sum signal $> 2.0\,\text{V}$, lateral/vertical offset $< 0.1\,\text{V}$).
3. Auto-tune cantilever drive frequency: identify fundamental resonance peak ($\sim 250\text{--}350\,\text{kHz}$) and set operating setpoint amplitude to $70\text{--}80\%$ of free resonance amplitude.
4. Initiate soft piezo auto-approach onto the ILD oxide target site in the $5\,\mu\text{m}$ inter-pad gap.

### Step 4: Multi-Scale Pre-CMP Scan Execution
1. **Micro-Scale Field Scan ($10\,\mu\text{m} \times 10\,\mu\text{m}$):**
   - Position tip in the center of the $d = 10\,\mu\text{m}$ TLM gap.
   - Scan parameters: scan field size $= 10\,\mu\text{m} \times 10\,\mu\text{m}$, resolution $= 512 \times 512$ pixels, slow scan rate $= 0.5\text{--}1.0\,\text{Hz}$, scan angle $= 0^\circ$.
2. **High-Resolution Micro-Roughness Scan ($5\,\mu\text{m} \times 5\,\mu\text{m}$):**
   - Position tip over the $d = 5\,\mu\text{m}$ gap and over the dense cell array field ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$ layout zone).
   - Scan parameters: scan field size $= 5\,\mu\text{m} \times 5\,\mu\text{m}$, resolution $= 512 \times 512$ pixels, scan rate $= 0.8\,\text{Hz}$.
3. Record height, phase, and amplitude feedback channels to capture pre-CMP topography baseline, step height transitions, and deposition grain structure.

### Step 5: Data Post-Processing & Pre-CMP Baseline Logging
1. Apply 1st-order and 2nd-order polynomial plane fit (flattening) to correct for sample tilt and piezo bow across line scans.
2. Extract surface statistics: root-mean-square roughness ($R_q$ / $S_q$), average roughness ($R_a$ / $S_a$), and peak-to-valley range ($R_t$ / $S_z$).
3. Archive pre-CMP baseline coordinate map and roughness values in the lot tracking run card to serve as the reference comparator for post-CMP oxide planarization and erosion/dishing evaluation.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Deskew & Navigation Accuracy** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical stage encoder verification across fiducials |
| **Pre-CMP ILD Field Surface Roughness ($R_q$)** | $\le 0.85$ | $\text{nm}$ | AFM $5\,\mu\text{m} \times 5\,\mu\text{m}$ flattened height channel statistics |
| **TLM Test Structure Geometry Verification** | $W = 100 \pm 1$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50 \pm 1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | AFM topographic line profile across pad boundaries |
| **TLM Inter-Pad Baseline Gap Registration** | $d = 5.0 \pm 0.1$, $10.0 \pm 0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Lateral step-height coordinate measurement |

---

## 3. Literature & Source Context Citations

1. **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity:**
   - Pad layout geometry ($W = 100\,\mu\text{m}$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\,\mu\text{m}$) and spacing sequence ($d = 5\,\mu\text{m}$, $10\,\mu\text{m}$, $20\,\mu\text{m}$, $40\,\mu\text{m}$, $80\,\mu\text{m}$) directly defined and referenced for navigation coordinates, baseline gaps, and profilometry scan regions.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - 180nm DRAM access transistor target cell dimensions ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$), shared bitline contacts, and ILD dielectric top surface over tungsten plugs (W-plug) cited for dense cell array coordinate registration.
3. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
   - Stage alignment tolerance baseline ($\pm 5\,\mu\text{m}$) cited for optical alignment, stage registration, and deskew tolerance targets.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: AFM metrology throughput is inherently low (<2 sites/hour for high-resolution 10x10 um scans). Deploying high-density coordinate navigation on a macroscopic stage without rigorous optical-to-piezo reference cross-calibration introduces an Abbe offset error up to 3.5 um, preventing reproducible relocation of 180nm dense DRAM array test structures across pre- and post-CMP runs.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Pre-CMP ILD (PECVD TEOS/O3-TEOS) topography displays distinct high-frequency micro-roughness (Rq ~ 0.8-1.5 nm) superimposed on litho/etch step-height patterns (typically 400-500 nm). If tapping-mode cantilever drive amplitude and setpoint ratios are improperly tuned (e.g. setpoint ratio > 0.85 in damp air), capillary meniscus forces induce tip-sample snapping and false height artifacts, obscuring true pre-polish baseline Ra/Rq values.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Silicon AFM cantilever probe supply (nominal tip radius < 7 nm, spring constant 40 N/m, resonant frequency ~300 kHz) suffers from high attrition rates during high-aspect-ratio trench scanning. Transitioning to diamond-coated or solid diamond probes ensures tip longevity but quadruples tip replacement cost; local buffer stock must maintain minimum 50 probes of qualified lot numbers to prevent line halts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Coordinate registration for 9 distinct wafer metrology sites (die center, edge exclusion 3mm, dense DRAM array, open field scribe line) must be locked in a standardized GDSII-to-tool coordinate recipe prior to CMP run authorization, else metrology bottlenecks will breach downstream 4-hour pre-CMP queue time limits.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. AFM tip apex blunting or chipping during pre-CMP high-step topography navigation, artificially damping measured Ra/Rq micro-roughness and falsifying post-CMP planarization efficiency calculations.
1. Loss of global die coordinate alignment (theta and origin drift > 1.0 um) between pre-CMP AFM and post-CMP review, resulting in AFM scanning non-identical planarization pads and invalidating dishing/erosion differential profiles.
1. Environmental acoustic and floor vibration coupling (> 1.5 um/s RMS at 10-50 Hz) during baseline scan, generating periodic horizontal striping artifacts that distort PSD (Power Spectral Density) roughness baselines.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-2-1-01` | **Pre-CMP ILD Baseline Micro-Roughness Verification on DRAM Dense Array and Open Oxide Field** | Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) in Tapping/Non-Contact Mode with acoustic vibration isolation chamber, active anti-vibration table, silicon tip with nominal tip radius < 7 nm, resonance frequency ~300 kHz, force constant ~42 N/m. | 1. Load wafer onto vacuum chuck and align optical alignment pattern to wafer notch and primary fiducials. 2. Navigate optical microscope to Site 1 (open field oxide) and lower cantilever in automated approach mode. 3. Execute 5 um x 5 um tapping-mode scan at 512 x 512 pixels resolution at a scan rate of 0.5 Hz, setpoint ratio 0.70. 4. Extract flattened topography using 1st-order line flattening and calculate arithmetic roughness Ra and root-mean-square roughness Rq. 5. Move stage to Site 2 (dense DRAM cell array baseline) and repeat 10 um x 10 um scan. 6. Repeat measurements across 5 designated dies (Center, North, South, East, West). | `Open field baseline Rq must fall within 0.85 nm to 1.45 nm with 3-sigma repeatability < 0.10 nm across all 5 dies; tip wear check post-scan must confirm tip apex radius remains <= 10 nm with zero tip-loss artifacts.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-2-1-02` | **Test Structure Metrology Site Global & Local Coordinate Repeatability Setup** | AFM automated stage navigation system coupled with high-resolution motorized optical video microscope (sub-micron optical encoder resolution <= 0.1 um) and closed-loop piezo scanner (XY range 100 um x 100 um). | 1. Perform automated 3-point wafer mapping to register global coordinate origin (0,0) and wafer notch offset angle theta. 2. Direct automated stage to drive sequentially to 9 predefined coordinate pairs corresponding to DRAM test structures. 3. At each coordinate, engage optical pattern recognition to register fiducial cross marks. 4. Record optical stage encoder coordinates (X_meas, Y_meas) versus programmed GDSII design coordinates (X_gds, Y_gds). 5. Unload wafer, reload wafer after 180-degree rotation compensation, and re-run sequence to calculate relocation offset repeatability delta_XY. | `Absolute positioning accuracy across all 9 metrology sites must be |X_meas - X_gds| <= 0.80 um and |Y_meas - Y_gds| <= 0.80 um; repositioning repeatability delta_XY on reloaded wafer must be <= 0.35 um.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom ESD-safe anti-static smock and hood, Cleanroom conductive ESD booties and heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Rinse cautiously with water for minimum 15 minutes at cleanroom eye wash station; seek medical evaluation if irritation persists. Skin contact: Wash with mild cleanroom soap and DI water. Inhalation of IPA fumes: Remove victim to fresh clean air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM acoustic/environmental enclosure vented with laminar flow exhaust maintaining positive HEPA-filtered clean air velocity of 0.45 m/s ± 20%; solvent prep bench under dedicated local VOC exhaust with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA lint-free wipes collected in dedicated hazardous flammables closed waste bins; spent solvents segregated in grounded, labeled flammable solvent carboys for certified hazardous cleanroom waste disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Tier 3 / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2 Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited PECVD TEOS ILD oxide layer, dry, free of organic photoresist residue, DI water rinse dried with UHP N2 gun, particulate count < 10 particles @ >= 0.2 um per 200mm wafer.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Baseline AFM surface mapped and coordinate locked; tip-contact-free inspection verified; surface protected against airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and moisture condensation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and airborne molecular organosilicon/hydrocarbon condensation on ILD oxide alters native surface energy, shifting CMP slurry wetting and pad friction dynamics, leading to non-uniform oxide removal rates and micro-scratching during subsequent CMP polish.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full baseline micro-roughness profile (Ra, Rq, Rmax) and exact optical/piezo test structure coordinate map generated and validated across 9 wafer sites for 200mm 180nm DRAM test wafers prior to ILD oxide CMP recipe dispatch.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PRE_CMP_AFM_ROUGHNESS_BASELINE_LOT_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM_180NM_TEST_STRUCTURE_COORDINATE_MAP_RECIPE.xml`
- [ ] `SURFACE_TOPOGRAPHY_TOP_VIEW_AND_3D_PSD_METROLOGY.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |

| `ASSERT-01` | **Pre-CMP unpolished PECVD TEOS ILD field oxide baseline root-mean-square micro-roughness (Rq) over 5x5 um scan area** | `1.15 nm` | ± 0.25 nm | Non-contact AFM 512x512 topography profile flattened by 1st-order polynomial, calculated via ISO 4287 standard. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Optical-to-piezo stage coordinate relocation accuracy to DRAM dense memory array center fiducial** | `0.00 um` | ± 0.50 um | Closed-loop optical microscope patterned feature recognition verified against AFM tip scan center offset. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Power Spectral Density (PSD) high-frequency baseline noise floor of AFM metrology system inside acoustic enclosure** | `0.04 nm` | <= 0.06 nm RMS | Static zero-scan cantilever noise evaluation on single crystal silicon reference standard. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 designated DRAM metrology locations scanned and recorded with valid tip integrity verified (tip apex radius <= 10 nm post-scan); baseline roughness data and coordinate recipe successfully parsed into CMP dispatch system; wafer transferred to dry N2 purge pod within 60 minutes of ambient air exposure.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Info
- **Title**: Procurement of High-Aspect-Ratio AFM Probes for Deep Topography & Dishing Scan
- **System**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy**: `[Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > [Planarization] > Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs > Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide CMP Recipe Optimization and Polish > ILD Oxide CMP Downforce, Platen Speed, and Slurry Flow Recipe Optimization > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and AFM Surface Planarity Characterization > AFM Pre- and Post-CMP Surface Micro-Roughness and Dishing Profilometry > Procurement of High-Aspect-Ratio AFM Probes for Deep Topography & Dishing Scan`
- **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)
- **Action Type**: Buy

---

### Procurement & Qualification Lifecycle Workflow

## 1. Scope & Objective
Procure and qualify commercial high-aspect-ratio (HAR) Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) cantilever probes engineered for non-destructive tapping/non-contact mode scanning across deep topography features—specifically stacked crown capacitor trenches and tungsten contact plugs (W-plugs) between adjacent memory cells with access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, down to patterned depths up to $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ ($1300\text{ nm}$) to profile post-CMP dishing and ILD oxide erosion.

---

## 2. Dimensional Target Scale

```text

                      │░                               │
       Tip Radius Spec┤░                               │
                      │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│

                       0      325     650    975   1300
```
