---

## 3. Step-by-Step Procurement & Receiving Procedure

### Step 1: Technical Specification Definition
1. **Tip Geometry Requirements**:
   - Aspect ratio: Minimum $\ge 10:1$ (nominal $12:1$ to $15:1$) with focused ion beam (FIB) sharpened or high-density carbon (HDC) cylindrical spike.
   - Usable spike length: $\ge 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ to profile aspect features including photoresist steps up to $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ ($1300\text{ nm}$) without cantilever cone-beam contact.
   - Nominal tip radius ($R_{tip}$): $\le 10\text{ nm}$ (ensuring lateral resolution inside the $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$ feature limits).
   - Half-cone angle at tip apex: $\le 6^\circ$ over the terminal $1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ spike length.
2. **Cantilever Dynamics**:
   - Resonant frequency ($f_0$): $300\text{ kHz} \pm 50\text{ kHz}$ for intermittent contact/tapping mode in air.
   - Spring constant ($k$): $40\text{ N/m} \pm 10\text{ N/m}$ to prevent sample damage while maintaining high phase sensitivity.
   - Reflex backside coating: $30\text{ nm}$ Aluminum coating for stable laser deflection signal.

### Step 2: Vendor RFQ, Sourcing & Lot Packaging Standards
1. Issue Request for Quotation (RFQ) to semiconductor metrology probe manufacturers (e.g., Olympus, Bruker, NanoWorld, or Mikromasch).
2. Mandate antistatic ESD-safe gel-box packaging with individual vacuum release/pocket compartments (10 probes/box or 50 probes/wafer chip strip) with cleanroom Grade ISO 4 (Class 10) packaging.
3. Require vendor Certificate of Analysis (CoA) providing lot-specific SEM tip inspection images and laser vibrometer resonance test data.

### Step 3: Receiving Inspection & Verification Protocol
1. **Packaging Integrity & ESD Inspection**:
   - Transfer incoming lot to ISO 5 cleanroom bench.
   - Inspect shipping box shock indicators and verify gel-pack seal integrity under an inspection stereo microscope.
2. **Physical Sampling & Dimension Qualification**:
   - Select 2 probes per lot of 50 for incoming QA.
   - Measure cantilever resonance spectrum on the metrology AFM head: confirm fundamental harmonic peak $f_0$ falls strictly within the $250\text{ kHz} - 350\text{ kHz}$ acceptance envelope.
   - Run a test scan over an etched silicon calibration standard grid with deep vertical trenches ($1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ pitch, $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ step height) to quantify sidewall convolution and verify tip clearance across $180\text{ nm}$ gap spaces.

### Step 4: Metrology Tool Handover & Storage
1. Assign approved lot numbers and store in dry Nitrogen ($N_2$) purge cabinet at relative humidity $\le 20\%$, temperature $21^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$.
2. Log batch details into the fab Manufacturing Execution System (MES) ready for dispatch to CMP ILD dishing inspection.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Nominal Tip Apex Radius ($R_{tip}$) | $\le 10.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Vendor CoA / Field-Emission SEM Calibration |
| **AC-02** | Effective High-Aspect-Ratio Spike Length | $\ge 2.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Metrology Profile Scan on $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ step grid |
| **AC-03** | Cantilever Fundamental Resonance Frequency ($f_0$) | $300 \pm 50$ ($250 \text{ to } 350$) | $\text{kHz}$ | AFM Cantilever Laser Sweep / Auto-Tune |
| **AC-04** | Cantilever Spring Constant ($k$) | $40 \pm 10$ ($30 \text{ to } 50$) | $\text{N/m}$ | Thermal Noise Method / Sader Calculation |

---

## 5. Source Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Informs unit cell access transistor channel dimensions: length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked crown capacitor over bitline (COB), and tungsten plug (W-plug) geometries necessitating HAR probe geometry for accurate deep topography and dishing scans.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - Establishes micro-topography reference baseline step height metrics (Shipley 1813 photoresist thickness $\sim 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ / $1300\text{ nm}$) dictating tip spike clearance length $> 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Highlights surface metrology precision standards and cross-correlation requirements between optical dielectric thickness and high-resolution scanning probe profilometry.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: High-aspect-ratio (HAR) AFM cantilever tips with aspect ratios >= 10:1 exhibit extreme mechanical compliance along lateral axes, making them prone to severe tip-convolution artifacts, lateral deflection ringing, and premature tip fracture when profiling steep vertical trenches (>500 nm deep ILD trenches or contact plug step-heights). The metrology tool recipe must integrate strict piezo drive-amplitude feedback, non-contact tapping mode, and dynamic approach speeds under 0.2 um/s to avoid destructive bottom-impact crashes while maintaining scan throughput across 200 mm wafer mapping stations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Profiling oxide dishing and tungsten plug erosion in 180nm CMP structures requires a tip apex radius <= 10 nm combined with a cone full-angle <= 12 degrees to reach the bottom corners of dense array trenches without side-wall convolution. Standard conical silicon probes fail to resolve trench-bottom root-mean-square roughness (Rq) accurately; carbon nanotube (CNT) tipped or high-density diamond-like carbon (DLC) whisker tips are mandatory to withstand abrasive residual slurry micro-particles without undergoing apex blunting after single-die scans.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specialty high-aspect-ratio silicon/diamond AFM probes have extended lead times of 12 to 16 weeks and exhibit steep volume attrition rates due to wafer-edge handling and automated exchange breakages. Dual-sourcing between qualified vendors (e.g., Olympus/Bruker HAR series and MikroMasch High-Res series) and procuring wafer-level gel-packs under positive inert N2 packing is critical to prevent stock-out disruptions during CMP polish campaign iterations.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Cost per measured wafer site escalates dramatically if HAR probes degrade after measuring fewer than 15 sites per tip. The metrology SOP must mandate automated probe resonance frequency and Q-factor sanity qualification runs on a dedicated calibration grating before and after every wafer lot measurement to prevent false-positive CMP dishing rejections or scrap due to uncalibrated cantilever wear.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex snapping or fracture during steep trench descent resulting in truncated dishing profile data and physical tip debris contamination on the active wafer die.
1. Apex wear and widening from abrasive silica/ceria slurry residues expanding effective tip radius beyond 15 nm, artificially masking narrow trench bottom dishing.
1. Static charge accumulation and capillary condensation between probe tip and hydrophilic post-CMP oxide surface leading to snap-in latching and cantilevering catastrophic drift.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-2-2-01` | **HAR AFM Tip Geometry and Aspect Ratio Verification on Deep Silicon Calibration Grating** | Atomic Force Microscope (Park Systems NX-HDP / Bruker Dimension Icon) operating in non-contact tapping mode equipped with a traceable 3D critical dimension calibration grating (pitch 200 nm, depth 500 nm, vertical sidewall 89.5 deg). | 1. Load traceable deep-trench calibration artifact onto vacuum chuck. 2. Perform automated tip resonance sweep and auto-tune amplitude setpoint to 80% free amplitude. 3. Engage tip with landing speed 0.15 um/s. 4. Execute a 2 um x 2 um scan with 512 x 512 pixels at 0.3 Hz line rate across 3 consecutive grating ridges. 5. Extract cross-sectional profiles and compute apparent sidewall angle, trench-bottom depth reach, and reconstructed tip apex radius using blind tip reconstruction algorithms. | `Reconstructed tip apex radius <= 10.0 nm; aspect ratio >= 10:1 over the terminal 200 nm length; full depth profiling reach >= 495.0 nm of nominal 500 nm grating depth without sidewall shadowing artifact (>85 deg measured slope).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-2-2-02` | **Post-CMP Dishing and Erosion Profilometry Resolution on 180nm ILD Oxide Test Array** | Automated 200mm Wafer Fab In-line AFM with automated cassette-to-cassette wafer handler, vibration isolation platform (< 0.5 um/s2 RMS), and acoustic enclosure. | 1. Transfer wafer to AFM chuck and perform optical pattern recognition alignment on ILD dishing test macro (dense array 180nm line/space and isolated 10 um bond pad). 2. Position probe over the center, middle, and edge test dies (5-point wafer map). 3. Perform 20 um x 5 um tapping scans perpendicular to metal pitch orientation at scan rate 0.25 Hz. 4. Run baseline tilt correction, line flatten (order 1), and extract depth step-height delta between dielectric field and polished plug features. 5. Repeat scan at site 1 after 15 site scans to verify zero probe-induced degradation. | `Profile resolves step-height depth with vertical resolution <= 0.1 nm; measured isolated oxide dishing repeatability across 3 consecutive scans on same site within +/- 1.5 nm; post-run tip resonance frequency drift <= 0.5%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving recommended during solvent swap), UV-blocking ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses, Anti-static cleanroom ESD lab coat with wrist grounding strap, Cleanroom bouffant cap and face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious cleanroom DI water for 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, evacuate operator to fresh air. HAR silicon cantilevers present micro-puncture hazard: dispose of fractured probe fragments using dedicated sharp ESD tweezers into hazardous sharps containers.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM acoustic/environmental enclosure must maintain positive laminar HEPA/ULPA downflow (ISO Class 3/5 interior air) with local extraction exhaust (min 50 CFM) active during any IPA-assisted chuck cleaning or probe solvent degreasing.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Wetted wipes and solvent waste collected in designated sealed flammable waste receptacles for hazardous chemical incineration; depleted AFM silicon probe chips collected in rigid plastic sharps containers labeled 'Silicon Micro-Sharps/Bio-Mechanical Hazard'.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) cleanroom substrate cleaner** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 5 (Ultra-pure) | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DIW)** | `7732-18-5` | 18.2 MOhm-cm at 25 deg C | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP oxide surface cleaned, scrubbed, rinsed, and dried. Surface must be free of residual abrasive slurry particulates, organic surfactant films, and water marks; contact angle < 15 degrees.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: AFM mapped oxide/ILD surface free of probe contact gouging, indentation marks, or tip shed debris, stored under purged dry nitrogen environment (RH < 5%).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture adsorption from ambient cleanroom air forms a 1-3 nm capillary meniscus layer on the hydrophilic oxide surface, causing anomalous AFM adhesion forces, probe tip sticking (phase jumping), and inaccurate shallow dishing/roughness measurements.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful technical procurement, incoming geometric qualification, and production validation of High-Aspect-Ratio (AR >= 10:1, tip radius <= 10 nm) AFM cantilevers enabling reproducible sub-nanometer deep trench profiling and ILD oxide dishing metrology for 180nm DRAM CMP optimization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `HAR_AFM_Probe_Lot_Incoming_Inspection_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Calibration_Grating_3D_Reconstruction_Metrology.csv`
- [ ] `Post_ILD_CMP_Dishing_Erosion_HighRes_Scan_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Tip Apex Aspect Ratio over terminal 200 nm cone height** | `12:1` | +/- 2:1 (minimum 10:1) | Blind tip estimation algorithm and cross-sectional calibration grating trace on Park NX-HDP AFM |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Nominal Tip Apex Radius of Curvature** | `8.0 nm` | +2.0 nm / -3.0 nm (maximum 10.0 nm) | High-resolution TEM vendor coupon cross-check and deconvolution trace on certified titanium roughness standard |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Cantilever Free Resonance Frequency Stability across 15 production die scans** | `300.0 kHz` | +/- 1.5 kHz | Automated thermal tune resonance spectrum scan prior to wafer entry and post 15-site recipe completion |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Receipt, vacuum inspection, and multi-point calibration verification of 100% of procured probe lots on traceable deep-trench standards showing zero geometric non-conformances, followed by automated execution of 5 consecutive wafer dishing maps without tip fracture or apex degradation exceeding 10 nm.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Post-CMP AFM Dishing, Erosion & RMS Surface Roughness Profilometry Characterization

- **Project**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy**: [Architecture & Integration] > [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > [Planarization] > [Metrology]
- **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm CMOS) | **Action Type**: Buy / Metrology Inspection
- **Micro-Knowledge Record**: Captured in [`docs/knowledge/post_cmp_afm_profilometry.md`](./docs/knowledge/post_cmp_afm_profilometry.md)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Load 180nm Post-CMP   │
│         Wafer          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     AFM Cantilever     │
│     Calibration &      │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Tapping-Mode ILD RMS  │
│   Roughness Scan 5x5   │
│           um           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   W-Plug High-Aspect   │
│  Dishing Profilometry  │
│          Scan          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dense DRAM Cell     │
│     Array Erosion      │
│   Profilometry Scan    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Metrology Signoff vs  │
│  Acceptance Criteria   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chamber Conditioning**:
   - Transfer the post-CMP cleaned 200 mm wafer into the Class 1 cleanroom AFM isolation acoustic enclosure ($T = 21.0 \pm 0.2^\circ\text{C}$, $\text{RH} = 45 \pm 3\%$).
   - Engage pneumatic vibration-isolation platform and purge chuck with high-purity dry $N_2$ at $10\text{ kPa}$ backpressure.

2. **Probe Selection & Calibration**:
   - Mount a high-aspect-ratio (HAR) diamond-like carbon coated n-type silicon cantilever (nominal tip radius $R_{\text{tip}} \le 7\text{ nm}$, half-cone angle $\le 10^\circ$, nominal resonance frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$, spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$).
   - Align the 4-quadrant position-sensitive photodetector (PSPD) laser spot to maximize sum signal ($> 6.0\text{ V}$, deflection error adjusted to $0.0 \pm 0.05\text{ V}$).
   - Perform automated tip resonance frequency auto-tune; set operating drive amplitude at $90\%$ of free resonance amplitude ($A_0 \approx 20\text{ nm}$) using Intermittent Contact (Tapping Mode) to prevent tip wear and surface shearing.

3. **Field ILD Surface Micro-Roughness Profilometry**:
   - Navigate optics to the unpatterned scribe-line Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) oxide region adjacent to the memory core.
   - Acquire a $5.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 5.0\,\mu\text{m}$ scan area at $512 \times 512\text{ pixels}$, scan rate $0.50\text{ Hz}$ (tip velocity $5.0\,\mu\text{m/s}$), integral gain $I_{\text{gain}} = 1.2$, proportional gain $P_{\text{gain}} = 2.0$.
   - Apply 1st-order line-flattening and calculate the root-mean-square surface micro-roughness ($R_q / \text{RMS}$).

4. **Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) Dishing Profilometry**:
   - Step the stage to the cell drain contact via array connecting the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) to the stacked capacitor node.
   - Execute a localized high-density scan ($2.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$, $512 \times 512\text{ pixels}$, scan rate $0.30\text{ Hz}$).
   - Extract cross-sectional profiles through the center of 10 adjacent W-plugs. Measure dishing depth as the vertical distance from the surrounding ILD oxide surface datum plane to the lowest point of the recessed tungsten plug core.

5. **Dense Memory Cell Array Oxide Erosion Profilometry**:
   - Reposition scan window over the transition boundary separating the dense $8F^2 / 6F^2$ DRAM cell array from the open peripheral field oxide.
   - Perform a long-range profilometry trace ($40.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 10.0\,\mu\text{m}$, $1024 \times 256\text{ pixels}$, scan rate $0.20\text{ Hz}$).
   - Define reference plane on the unpatterned field oxide; compute array erosion as the differential oxide thickness loss across the high-density cell matrix.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                        │░░░░░░                        │
  ILD Surface Rq (0.1nm)┤░░░░░░                        │
     W-Plug Dishing (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒     │
                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒     │
Dense Array Erosion (nm)┤██████████████████████████████│
                        │██████████████████████████████│
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                        0.0    5.5    11.0   16.5  22.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Hard Upper Limit | Inspection Unit | Metrology Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Field ILD Surface RMS Roughness ($R_q$)** | $\le 0.25\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.35\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Tapping-Mode AFM ($5\times 5\,\mu\text{m}$) |
| **W-Plug Contact Dishing ($D_{\text{plug}}$)** | $\le 12.0\text{ nm}$ | $\le 18.0\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | HAR-AFM Profile ($L=180\text{ nm}, W=220\text{ nm}$) |
| **Dense Cell Array Erosion ($E_{\text{array}}$)** | $\le 15.0\text{ nm}$ | $\le 22.0\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | AFM Boundary Step Profilometry ($40\,\mu\text{m}$) |
| **Boundary Step Height Delta ($\Delta Z_{\text{edge}}$)** | $\le 18.0\text{ nm}$ | $\le 25.0\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Long-range AFM Line Trace |

---

### Citations & Contextual Grounding

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Cell unit dimensions: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Structural geometry: $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline layout with tungsten plug (W-plug) connection from drain contact to stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/MIM cell, demanding strict planarization to preserve depth-of-focus (DOF) and eliminate capacitive/resistive interconnect variability.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) characterization must close the loop with the chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) station and upstream ILD deposition. While spectroscopic ellipsometry delivers macro-scale wafer-level thickness uniformity, it completely averages out sub-micron oxide dishing over dense arrays and tungsten plug erosion. AFM provides the required nanometer-scale vertical resolution, but its low throughput (piezo scanner scan rates under 1.0 Hz for high-density 512x512 lines) introduces a severe metrology bottleneck in the pilot line workflow.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, post-CMP topography requires precise differentiation between dielectric dishing in wide open oxide areas, oxide erosion within high-density metal/poly pitch structures, and micro-scratch induced RMS roughness degradation. Using tapping/non-contact mode with high-aspect-ratio silicon tips (nominal tip radius < 10 nm) is mandatory to prevent tip dulling or sample surface dragging artifacts that artificially inflate Ra and Rq values or under-sample sharp dishing sidewalls.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: AFM cantilever tips (single-crystal silicon with conductive or hard diamond-like carbon coating) are consumables with rapid degradation rates when scanning rough post-CMP slurried topographies. Lead times for specialized probes can reach 6 to 10 weeks, necessitating dual-sourcing agreements and stringent incoming tip-radius qualification protocols to avoid metrology stalls during 180nm pilot runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM metrology queue-time constraints must be strictly scheduled within the production flow. If wafers remain unmeasured or uncleaned post-CMP, residual slurry dry-in or atmospheric moisture absorption will introduce false RMS micro-roughness spikes and corrosive micro-pitting, resulting in spurious recipe parameter re-tuning and unnecessary project delays.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. AFM tip apex breakage or particle pick-up causing tip convolution artifacts, misinterpreting tip wear as artificially reduced dishing depths or doubled step edges.
1. Post-CMP slurry residue crystallizing on the dielectric surface during prolonged queue-time, distorting RMS roughness calculations by >200%.
1. Piezoelectric scanner Z-axis non-linearity or thermal drift inducing false parabolic baseline curvatures across large 20 um x 20 um dishing profilometry scans.

critics.systems_engineer: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) characterization must close the loop with the chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) station and upstream ILD deposition. While spectroscopic ellipsometry delivers macro-scale wafer-level thickness uniformity, it completely averages out sub-micron oxide dishing over dense arrays and tungsten plug erosion. AFM provides the required nanometer-scale vertical resolution, but its low throughput (piezo scanner scan rates under 1.0 Hz for high-density 512x512 lines) introduces a severe metrology bottleneck in the pilot line workflow.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm node, post-CMP topography requires precise differentiation between dielectric dishing in wide open oxide areas, oxide erosion within high-density metal/poly pitch structures, and micro-scratch induced RMS roughness degradation. Using tapping/non-contact mode with high-aspect-ratio silicon tips (nominal tip radius < 10 nm) is mandatory to prevent tip dulling or sample surface dragging artifacts that artificially inflate Ra and Rq values or under-sample sharp dishing sidewalls.
critics.supply_chain: AFM cantilever tips (single-crystal silicon with conductive or hard diamond-like carbon coating) are consumables with rapid degradation rates when scanning rough post-CMP slurried topographies. Lead times for specialized probes can reach 6 to 10 weeks, necessitating dual-sourcing agreements and stringent incoming tip-radius qualification protocols to avoid metrology stalls during 180nm pilot runs.
critics.laya_pm: AFM metrology queue-time constraints must be strictly scheduled within the production flow. If wafers remain unmeasured or uncleaned post-CMP, residual slurry dry-in or atmospheric moisture absorption will introduce false RMS micro-roughness spikes and corrosive micro-pitting, resulting in spurious recipe parameter re-tuning and unnecessary project delays.

Piezoelectric scanner Z-axis non-linearity or thermal drift inducing false parabolic baseline curvatures across large 20 um x 20 um dishing profilometry scans.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: ILD Planarity Characterization and CMP Recipe Correlation Analysis

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-CMP ILD residual thickness variation directly cascades into tungsten contact/via etch depth variance across array versus periphery blocks. If within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) exceeds 3.5%, downstream photolithography depth-of-focus (DOF) margin at 180nm i-line/KrF (budgeted at <= 250 nm) will collapse, inducing bridging or necking on Metal-1 routing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Slurry abrasive particle agglomeration and Prestonian removal rate non-linearities (dP/dt vs. velocity) lead to localized micro-scratching and pattern-dependent dishing/erosion over dense DRAM storage node contact (SNC) arrays. Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) multi-layer Cauchy models must decouple top oxide thickness from underlying polysilicon gate topography using rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA) or fixed-site micro-spot (<= 30 um) optical pads.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Colloidal silica slurry batches (specifically 50-70 nm particle size with potassium hydroxide or ammonia stabilizers) exhibit shelf-life degradation and zeta-potential drift beyond 90 days. Sourcing calibrated AFM tip cantilevers (tip radius < 10 nm) and cleanroom-qualified optical reference standard wafers (NIST-traceable thermal SiO2) faces lead times exceeding 8 to 12 weeks in Southeast Asia fab hubs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Characterization turnaround time must be strictly throttled to prevent WIP gating. Offline AFM surface roughness and SE 49-point wafer mapping cannot exceed 45 minutes per monitor wafer, or CMP platen optimization experiments will stall pilot line throughput below the target of 5 wafers per hour.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe oxide dishing (> 45 nm) and dielectric erosion in dense array patterns leading to metal shorting during subsequent contact plug CMP.
1. Micro-scratch formation from dried silica abrasive slurry agglomerates resulting in inter-layer dielectric breakdown (TDDB) failure under > 3.0 MV/cm stress.
1. Miscorrelation between spectroscopic ellipsometry optical models and AFM physical step-height metrology caused by unresolved multi-film interface roughness.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-3-01` | **Within-Wafer Thickness Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) by 49-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (wavelength range 240-800 nm, 30 um micro-spot optics, 70-degree incident angle) | 1. Mount wafer on automated vacuum chuck with notch at 6 o'clock. 2. Align coordinate system to center and notch fiducial. 3. Execute 49-point polar map (3mm edge exclusion). 4. Acquire polarization angles Psi and Delta from 240 nm to 800 nm at each site. 5. Fit spectra using a calibrated Cauchy SiO2 dispersion model (n = 1.457 at 632.8 nm, k = 0). 6. Extract mean oxide thickness, standard deviation (sigma), and calculate WIWNU% = (1-sigma / Mean) * 100. | `Pass if mean post-CMP ILD thickness is 450 nm ± 15 nm, and WIWNU is <= 3.0% (1-sigma). Fail if WIWNU > 3.0% or model fitting goodness-of-fit (R^2) < 0.990.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-3-02` | **Post-CMP Dielectric Surface Roughness and Dishing Characterization by Tapping-Mode AFM** | Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with silicon cantilever (tip radius < 8 nm, spring constant 40 N/m, resonant frequency ~300 kHz), acoustic isolation chamber | 1. Engage tip in tapping mode at central dense DRAM SNC array test structure (50 um x 50 um area). 2. Scan a 10 um x 10 um field at 0.5 Hz line scan rate with 512 x 512 pixel resolution. 3. Apply first-order line flatten to remove sample tilt. 4. Calculate root-mean-square roughness (Rq) across oxide field. 5. Perform cross-sectional step-height line profile across 50 um dense-to-isolated pattern transition to extract array dishing depth. | `Pass if field SiO2 surface roughness Rq <= 0.35 nm and maximum dishing across dense array structures <= 25.0 nm. Fail if Rq > 0.40 nm, dishing > 30.0 nm, or if micro-scratches deeper than 5.0 nm are observed.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN 374 certified), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles, Class 100 anti-static ESD cleanroom lab coat / bunny suit, Chemical-resistant neoprene sleeve protectors during wet slurry handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact: Flush immediately with copiously running DI water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. In case of eye contact: Irrigate exposed eye at emergency eye-wash station for >= 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek urgent medical attention. Inhalation of dried silica aerosol: Move casualty immediately to fresh air; maintain open airway and administer supplemental oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on CMP wet platen shroud maintaining >= 100 FPM capture velocity at enclosure face; specialized cleanroom recirculating air handling with active HEPA/ULPA filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate alkaline CMP slurry runoff into dedicated CMP slurry waste drains. Treat effluent in acid-base neutralization tank using dilute sulfuric acid (H2SO4, 5-10%) to adjust pH to 6.5-8.5 prior to flocculation with polyaluminum chloride to precipitate suspended colloidal silica.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Amorphous Colloidal Silicon Dioxide (Abrasive Slurry)** | `7631-86-9` | Semiconductor Slurry Grade (Particle size 50-70 nm) | `10.0-15.0 wt%` |
| **Potassium Hydroxide (Slurry pH Stabilizer)** | `1310-58-3` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / MOS) | `0.1-0.5 wt% (pH 10.5-11.2)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (CMP Additive / Oxidizer)** | `7722-84-1` | Semiconductor Grade (UP-S) | `1.0-3.0 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, post-P-CMP megasonic scrub cleaned, DI water rinsed, spin-dried, particulate contamination < 15 defects @ > 0.18 um.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized planarized SiO2 film, surface roughness Rq <= 0.35 nm, packaged in sealed FOUP with inert N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended air exposure causes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (hydrocarbons and ambient boron/phosphorus vapors) and native surface re-hydration/carbonation, corrupting ellipsometric optical modeling and promoting moisture-induced defect crystallization prior to tungsten plug contact hole lithography.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete within-wafer ILD planarity characterization correlating CMP process parameters (downforce, platen speed, slurry dispense rate) with dielectric film removal rate, WIWNU, pattern dishing, and nanoscale surface roughness for 180nm DRAM tapeout qualification.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ILD_CMP_49pt_Ellipsometry_Thickness_Uniformity_Map.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM_Cell_PostCMP_AFM_Dishing_Roughness_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `CMP_Prestonian_Removal_Rate_Correlation_Matrix.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-CMP Inter-Layer Dielectric within-wafer non-uniformity across 49 measurement points** | `2.2%` | ± 0.5% | Automated 49-point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry with Cauchy model fitting (240-800 nm) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Nanoscale field oxide surface roughness (Rq) over 10 um x 10 um area** | `0.28 nm` | +0.07 / -0.05 nm | Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) with sub-8nm tip radius |
| `ASSERT-03` | **DRAM dense storage node contact array oxide dishing depth relative to isolation oxide field** | `18.0 nm` | ± 5.0 nm | High-resolution AFM cross-sectional step-height profiling across 50 um transition |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal signoff requires meeting all quantitative assertions across 3 consecutive monitor wafers, validation of Preston equation correlation coefficient (R^2 >= 0.96) between downforce-velocity product and removal rate, zero micro-scratch defects > 5.0 nm depth, and signed approval by both the CMP Module Lead and Metrology Systems Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry 49-Point Dielectric Thickness Mapping Across Post-CMP Wafers

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-180-049`  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) > Planarization & Metrology  
**Metrology Principle:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan\Psi \cdot e^{i\Delta}$)  
**Persisted Micro-Knowledge:** [docs/knowledge/sop_post_cmp_ellipsometry_49pt.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_post_cmp_ellipsometry_49pt.md)

---

### Metrology Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Pre-Metrology      │
│  Standard Calibration  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wafer Loading and    │
│    Notch Alignment     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pattern Recognition   │
│  and 49-Pt Coordinate  │
│          Grid          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spectroscopic      │
│      Polarization      │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Dispersion Modeling   │
│  Cauchy or Sellmeier   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Uniformity and  │
│    CMP Correlation     │
│        Mapping         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step SOP Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Measurement Tool Initialization & Reference Calibration
1. Power up the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source (Xe arc lamp / Deuterium-Halogen continuum) and allow thermal stabilization for $\ge 30\text{ min}$.
2. Perform baseline calibration on a certified silicon wafer standard with known native/thermal $\mathrm{SiO_2}$ ($3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal dry thermal oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
3. Verify baseline measurement precision is within $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) before testing production post-CMP wafers.

### Step 2: Wafer Handling, Loading, and Notch Orientation
1. Transfer the post-CMP cleaned and dried 180nm DRAM wafer from the cassette onto the vacuum chuck using an automated end-effector.
2. Engage vacuum hold-down ($\ge 75\text{ kPa}$ differential pressure).
3. Align wafer notch/flat to $0^\circ$ coordinate orientation via automated optical pre-aligner.

### Step 3: Optical Stage Alignment & Pattern Recognition
1. Set the optical goniometer angle of incidence ($\Phi$) to $70.0^\circ$ (Brewster angle vicinity for $\mathrm{Si}/\mathrm{SiO_2}$ stack sensitivity).
2. Execute automated pattern recognition on ILD test metrology pads (minimum $50\,\mu\text{m} \times 50\,\mu\text{m}$ clear scribe-line oxide field free of tungsten plug topography).
3. Auto-focus using the z-height optical sensor to optimize reflection intensity across both detector arms.

### Step 4: 49-Point Polar/Cartesian Wafer Mapping Grid Setup
1. Load the automated 49-point sampling template configured across concentric rings:
   - **Zone 0 (Center):** 1 site at $(0, 0)\text{ mm}$.
   - **Zone 1 (Inner ring, $0.25R$):** 8 sites at $45^\circ$ angular increments.
   - **Zone 2 (Mid-radius ring, $0.50R$):** 12 sites at $30^\circ$ angular increments.
   - **Zone 3 (Outer ring, $0.75R$):** 16 sites at $22.5^\circ$ angular increments.
   - **Zone 4 (Periphery ring, $0.90R$):** 12 sites at $30^\circ$ angular increments with a fixed $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion.

### Step 5: Spectroscopic Data Acquisition ($\Psi, \Delta$)
1. At each of the 49 test coordinates, sweep the wavelength spectrum over $\lambda = 250\text{ nm}$ to $850\text{ nm}$.
2. Measure the complex reflectance ratio $\rho$:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   recording $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ raw polarization spectra.

### Step 6: Dielectric Dispersion Modeling & Regression Fitting
1. Fit measured $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ curves using Cauchy dispersion parameterization for transparent ILD oxide:
   $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
   *(For high-$\kappa$ capacitor/dielectric stacks containing $\mathrm{Si_3N_4}$, $\mathrm{Ta_2O_5}$, or ONO with $\kappa > 15$, switch to Sellmeier / Tauc-Lorentz oscillator formulation).*
2. Extract physical film thickness $t_i$ ($i = 1 \dots 49$) and goodness-of-fit metric (mean squared error / regression $R^2$).

### Step 7: Thickness Uniformity Calculation & CMP Feedback Correlation
1. Compute mean thickness $\bar{t}$, standard deviation $\sigma$, and Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity percent:
   $$\text{WIWNU } (1\sigma \%) = \left( \frac{\sigma}{\bar{t}} \right) \times 100\%$$
2. Generate radial thickness contour map and feed zone thickness deltas back to the CMP tool recipe controller (head zone downforce adjustments: inner zone, center zone, retaining ring).

---

| Metric # | Inspection Metric Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Acceptance Limit | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Standard Reference Precision (on $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal oxide) | $3.50$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-02** | Thick Dielectric / Resist Metrology Uncertainty Limit | $\le 2.0$ | $\pm 2.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-03** | 49-Point Dielectric Thickness Goodness-of-Fit ($R^2$ Regression) | $> 0.990$ | Min $0.985$ | dimensionless |
| **AC-04** | Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) on cell dielectric ($\mathrm{Si_3N_4} / \mathrm{Ta_2O_5}$) | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\pm 0.10$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

## 3. Literature & Context Citations

This procedure is established directly from the verified project context:
1. **Physical Principle & Dispersion Model:** Sourced from *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology* — defines $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$, Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$, dry gate oxide calibration precision target of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ on $3.5\text{ nm}$ oxide, photoresist tolerance of $\pm 2\text{ nm}$, and 49-point wafer mapping protocol.
2. **Dielectric Stack Properties:** Sourced from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — defines ONO triple dielectric and $\mathrm{Ta_2O_5}/\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$ stacks with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, stacked capacitor tungsten plug (W-plug) topography integration, and 28 fF capacitance budget.
3. **Oxidation & EOT References:** Sourced from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* — confirms dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ producing $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\mathrm{SiO_2}$, and stacked cell capacitor EOT specification of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ for $\mathrm{Si_3N_4} / \mathrm{Ta_2O_5}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated 49-point polar/concentric mapping requires precise stage synchronization and coordinate alignment with the notch/flat orientation to decouple tool-induced radial thickness gradients from CMP polishing non-uniformity (WIWNU). The stage optical encoder must maintain sub-micron positioning repeatability across 200mm wafers, and robotic end-effector handoff must not induce localized backside micro-scratches or particulate contamination that artificially skews optical autofocus or height z-tracking across dies.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-CMP dielectric ILD surfaces feature residual chemical modification, sub-surface mechanical damage, and slurry nanoparticle residue that directly perturb Fresnel boundary conditions. Applying standard bulk Cauchy or Sellmeier models without accounting for surface micro-roughness via an effective medium approximation (Bruggeman EMA with 50% void fraction) or water moisture adsorption will lead to mathematical parameter correlation between thickness t and refractive index n(lambda), corrupting Mean Squared Error (MSE) minimization.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Spectroscopic ellipsometer broadband Xenon arc lamps degrade significantly after 1,000 operational hours, causing UV spectral radiance roll-off below 240 nm and increasing spectral noise in Delta measurements. Deuterium/halogen reference sources and certified silicon dioxide calibration standards (traceable to NIST/VLSI Standards at 100 nm and 1000 nm oxide steps) must maintain dual-sourcing contracts to prevent wafer inspection tool downtime in the pilot line.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing full 49-point polar maps on 100% of production monitor wafers introduces unacceptable metrology queue bottlenecks, exceeding the 45-second per-wafer inline budget. To maintain inline takt time, recipes must enforce a gated execution structure: high-speed 9-point screening during baseline verification with automated recipe escalation to 49-point comprehensive mapping only when WIWNU exceeds 3.5% or when qualifying new CMP polishing pads.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Slurry nanoparticle residue or water mark contamination causing localized optical scattering, triggering false high Mean Squared Error (MSE > 2.5) fit rejections or severe autofocus z-axis tracking failures.
1. Parameter cross-correlation between ILD thickness and refractive index in the Cauchy dispersion model due to unaccounted CMP surface roughness layers, leading to systematic oxide thickness underestimation (>5 nm error).
1. Wafer thermal expansion or stage coordinate misalignment causing measurement spot overlap with metal underlying topography/scribe-line features rather than flat unpatterned ILD test pads.

| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-3-1-02` | **Ellipsometric Multi-Site Measurement Static Repeatability and Dispersion Stability Test** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer with motorized goniometer and stabilized Xenon arc light source | 1. Position measurement beam at center site (Site 1) and four orthogonal peripheral sites (Sites 13, 25, 37, 49 at r = 90 mm). 2. Without unchucking, perform 30 consecutive dynamic measurement cycles per site, recalculating auto-focus and auto-tilt between cycles. 3. Extract optical film thickness (t) and refractive index n at lambda = 632.8 nm for each run. 4. Compute 1-sigma standard deviation for thickness and refractive index across all 30 measurements per site. | `Thickness 1-sigma standard deviation <= 0.05 nm (sub-Angstrom repeatability); Refractive Index n (at 632.8 nm) = 1.4580 ± 0.0020 with 1-sigma deviation <= 0.0005 across all 5 test sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, double gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-blocking safety glasses, ESD-safe cleanroom coveralls with integrated hood and conductive booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA wipes: Flush affected eyes with continuous isotonic eye wash for >= 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent fumes, relocate personnel immediately to fresh air. Non-chemical physical hazard: High-intensity UV arc lamp exposure hazard; deactivate lamp power supply and verify interlocks before chamber maintenance.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar airflow (Class 100 / ISO 5) with positive pressure displacement; instrument internal optics enclosure equipped with dedicated N2 purge (0.5 L/min) and local vacuum exhaust to prevent ozone accumulation from DUV lamp operation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes must be collected in closed, vapor-rated hazardous waste bins dedicated to flammable solvent solid wastes; tool chuck purge effluents route to cleanroom industrial exhaust ducting.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) cleanroom wipes** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 | `70% in ultra-pure DI water` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purge and Chuck Float)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed and megasonic-spin-dried post-CMP ILD oxide surface, free of residual slurry nanoparticles (silica/ceria) and organic corrosion inhibitor passivates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-verified clean dielectric oxide surface with complete 49-point spatial thickness profile, immediately transferred into FOUP or purged SMIF pod.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess ambient exposure causes airborne organic volatile contamination (hydrocarbons) and moisture adsorption forming a 0.5–1.2 nm adventitious organic/water layer, falsifying ellipsometric index fitting (n) and causing downstream tungsten contact via etch micro-masking.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full 49-point concentric spectroscopic ellipsometry wafer map executed successfully on post-CMP ILD oxide wafers. Optical model demonstrates robust parameter convergence with Bruggeman EMA roughness correction, providing quantitative verification of mean oxide thickness, radial WIWNU profile, and wafer-level planarity within fab baseline tolerances.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ild_post_cmp_49pt_thickness_map.csv`
- [ ] `spectroscopic_ellipsometry_fitting_report.pdf`
- [ ] `polar_wiwnu_thickness_contour_plot.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-CMP ILD mean dielectric thickness across 49 measurement sites meets target planarized thickness** | `450.0 nm` | ± 15.0 nm | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Levenberg-Marquardt Cauchy model fitting of Psi and Delta spectra from 240 nm to 780 nm |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU 1-sigma percentage) across the 49-point concentric array (3 mm edge exclusion)** | `2.2%` | <= 3.0% | Automated statistical calculation: (Standard Deviation of 49 thickness measurements / Wafer Mean Thickness) * 100 |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Spectral model goodness of fit Mean Squared Error (MSE) across all 49 points** | `1.15` | <= 1.80 | Unweighted root mean square difference between measured and modeled tan(Psi) and cos(Delta) curves |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 wafer map points successfully measured with zero optical autofocus or MSE threshold faults (MSE <= 1.80); calculated WIWNU <= 3.0%; mean thickness within 450.0 ± 15.0 nm; data artifacts automatically committed to wafer metrology datastore and verified by Process Integration Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## AFM Surface Micro-Roughness and DRAM Dense Array Dishing/Erosion Profiling

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-AFM-180NM-001`  
**Process Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 3) | Planarization & Metrology  
**Module:** Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics (ILD) & Tungsten (W) Plugs  
**Knowledge Record:** [docs/afm_roughness_dishing_sop.md](./docs/afm_roughness_dishing_sop.md)

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
│      Wafer Load &      │
│     Pre-Alignment      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Tip Calibration &    │
│       Auto-Tune        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Micro-Roughness     │

```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Wafer Reception and Pre-Inspection Alignment:**
   - Transfer the post-CMP cleaned wafer onto the automated AFM vacuum chuck under ISO Class 1 mini-environment.
   - Use optical navigation to align the wafer notch and register global die fiducials. Locate the test die containing the $1\text{T}1\text{C}$ stacked-capacitor memory array ($8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline layout, wordline and bitline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
2. **AFM Probe Selection and Cantilever Resonance Tuning:**
   - Mount an ultra-sharp, high-aspect-ratio single-crystal silicon cantilever probe (tip radius nominal $R_{\text{tip}} < 5\text{ nm}$, cone half-angle $< 15^\circ$, spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$, resonant frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
   - Execute automated laser-photodiode beam centering. Auto-tune oscillation frequency at an operational driving setpoint amplitude of $15\text{ nm} - 20\text{ nm}$ in tapping (non-contact) mode to eliminate lateral shear damage to fine oxide features.
3. **Blanket Field ILD Micro-Roughness Scan:**
   - Drive the probe stage to a designated unpatterned ILD field adjacent to the cell array ($20\ \mu\text{m} \times 20\ \mu\text{m}$ open dielectric window).
   - Execute a high-resolution $2.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ area scan at $512 \times 512$ points, scan rate of $0.8\text{ Hz}$ ($1.6\ \mu\text{m/s}$ tip velocity).
   - Perform 1st-order plane fit and 2nd-order flattening to filter tilt, then extract root-mean-square roughness ($R_q$) and arithmetic average roughness ($R_a$).
4. **Dense Memory Array Scan (Intra-Cell Topography & Plug Recess):**
   - Step probe to the dense memory core array containing access transistor contacts ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and tungsten plugs connecting to stacked capacitor nodes.
   - Run a $5.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ scan ($1024 \times 1024$ data points, scan rate $0.5\text{ Hz}$) perpendicular to the bitlines ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch).
   - Extract cross-sectional line profiles along the pitch axis to measure individual tungsten plug recess/protrusion relative to adjacent ILD oxide.
5. **Macro-Array Dishing and Erosion Profile (Array vs. Periphery Step):**
   - Reposition the AFM scan window to span the transition boundary between the dense memory array core and wide peripheral field oxide.
   - Configure a long-range scan profile: $60.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ ($1024 \times 128$ points, scan rate $0.25\text{ Hz}$).
   - Measure macro-dishing across the center of the dense array block and dielectric erosion depth at the dense-to-isolated boundary step.
6. **Data Post-Processing & Recipe Feedback:**
   - Calculate statistical mean, 3-sigma uniformity across 5 site locations (Center, North, South, East, West).
   - Export line height profiles into the CMP metrology database to tune CMP platen speed, polish downforce, and slurry selectivity.

---

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Applied access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and tungsten plug (W-plug) contact interface architecture connecting stacked capacitor storage nodes above drain contacts.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Applied bitline and wordline pitch specifications ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) and stacked capacitor ($8F^2 / 6F^2$) core layout parameters to calibrate the AFM raster line frequency, scan window dimensions, and dense array dishing profile boundaries.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: AFM profiling of ILD micro-roughness and array dishing must correlate directly with upstream oxide CMP Prestonian polishing metrics (downforce, platen speed) and feed forward into downstream contact photolithography depth-of-focus (DoF) budgets. The primary architectural risk is scan-drift and tip convolution across high-aspect-ratio memory cell arrays (180nm pitch), where piezo creep and thermal drift can distort dishing profiles (>15 nm error) across wide 50x50 um scan windows, leading to inaccurate CMP recipe feedback.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dense 180nm DRAM cell arrays exhibit severe pattern-dependent polish rates compared to open field oxide due to localized pressure differentiation. Tapping-mode AFM using high-aspect-ratio single-crystal silicon tips (tip radius < 10 nm) is mandatory to prevent shear-induced surface scratches while accurately tracking array erosion and wordline/bitline oxide dishing. Surface micro-roughness (Rq) must remain sub-0.3 nm to prevent scattering and resist adhesion failure during subsequent critical mask levels.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal AFM cantilevers with ultra-sharp tips (nominal tip radius < 7 nm, spring constant 40 N/m) have long lead times and high attrition rates in pilot cleanroom lines. Tip degradation from scanning abrasive silica/ceria slurry residues will artificially inflate apparent roughness and blur dishing step heights. A standardized tip qualification protocol and dual-sourcing strategy for probes (e.g., Olympus AC160TS, Bruker NCHV) must be maintained to ensure consistent data across multi-wafer CMP run splits.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM characterization is an inherently low-throughput metrology bottleneck (15-30 minutes per die location). To prevent holding CMP post-clean lots beyond allowable Q-time limits, scanning must be restricted to a standardized 9-site sampling plan across 200mm wafers, focusing on dedicated test keys (nested dense array vs. isolated field oxide) before releasing the wafer lot to pre-metal dielectric (PMD) or contact plug deposition.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex wear and convolution leading to underestimation of array erosion depth and false-positive micro-roughness compliance.
1. Acoustic and floor vibration coupling causing high-frequency vertical z-noise (>0.15 nm RMS), masking actual ILD surface polish striations.
1. Airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and moisture adsorption during extended ambient queue times forming a capillary meniscus that distorts tapping phase and topographical height profiles.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-3-2-01` | **DRAM Dense Cell Array Dishing and Erosion Depth Profiling** | Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) in Tapping/Non-Contact Mode with Acoustic Enclosure and Vibration Isolation Table; High-Aspect-Ratio Silicon Tip (Nominal Tip Radius < 10 nm, Resonance Frequency ~300 kHz) | 1. Load wafer onto motorized vacuum chuck and align optical coordinate system to die center test structure containing 180nm pitch dense memory cell array adjacent to 50x50 um open field oxide. 2. Engage AFM cantilever in tapping mode with drive amplitude set to 80% free vibration amplitude. 3. Execute 60x60 um scan perpendicular to array boundary at 0.5 Hz scan rate and 512x512 line resolution. 4. Apply 1st-order line-by-line flatten correction and extract cross-sectional step height profile across the array-to-field boundary. 5. Measure maximum oxide dishing depth within array and overall array oxide erosion relative to outer field oxide reference plane across 9 standard wafer sites. | `Array oxide dishing depth <= 12.0 nm across all 9 sites; total array oxide erosion depth <= 20.0 nm; tip wear check shows calibration step height repeatability within ±0.3 nm.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-2-3-3-2-02` | **Field ILD Oxide Post-CMP Surface Micro-Roughness Characterization** | Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) in Tapping Mode; Ultra-Sharp Silicon Cantilever (Tip Radius < 7 nm, Force Constant ~40 N/m); Acoustic Isolation Chamber | 1. Position probe over unpatterned field oxide monitor region (5 mm from die edge). 2. Acquire 2.0x2.0 um high-resolution scan at 1.0 Hz scan rate, 512x512 data points. 3. Perform 2nd-order polynomial background subtraction to remove sample tilt and bow. 4. Compute Root-Mean-Square Roughness (Rq / RMS) and Average Roughness (Ra) over full scan area. 5. Inspect phase-contrast image for micro-scratches or embedded slurry nanoparticle clusters. | `Surface micro-roughness Rq <= 0.25 nm (target <= 0.20 nm); maximum peak-to-valley height (Rmax) <= 2.5 nm; zero detected embedded slurry nanoparticles or micro-scratches with depth > 1.5 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV and impact safety glasses, Full cleanroom ESD gown, hood, and conductive shoe covers, Point-of-use laser safety precautions for AFM optical lever alignment diode (Class 2/3R)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of clean running water or saline solution for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash affected area thoroughly with soap and water; remove contaminated gloves. Inhalation of organic vapors: Move person to fresh air immediately; seek medical attention if irritation or dizziness persists. Direct laser beam ocular exposure: Disengage power immediately and refer for ophthalmologic examination.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating laminar flow hood (Class 100/ISO 5) equipped with ULPA filters; AFM acoustic enclosure equipped with passive low-velocity HEPA exhaust to prevent micro-air currents that induce cantilever oscillation instability.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and solvent residue must be segregated into closed, dedicated flammable solvent waste containers grounded against ESD; empty wafer rinses drained to dedicated organic/acid-base neutralization drain systems per fab environmental compliance protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DIW)** | `7732-18-5` | Ultra-Pure Water (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Compressed N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Electronic Grade 5.0 | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly polished ILD oxide wafer immediately post-CMP megasonic cleaner and SRD, hydrophilic surface termination (contact angle < 10 degrees), dried and particle-neutralized.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, non-destructively probed ILD oxide wafer with validated micro-roughness and dishing, sealed in purged ultra-clean FOUP/cassette ready for contact lithography.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess ambient exposure causes airborne organic volatile adsorption (hydrocarbon contamination) and water film condensation on hydrophilic oxide surfaces, leading to inaccurate AFM phase/topography imaging and catastrophic resist footing/peeling during subsequent contact hole photolithography.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified AFM topographical characterization of post-CMP ILD oxide surface, providing nanometer-accurate quantification of dense 180nm DRAM array dishing, array erosion, and open-field micro-roughness to qualify the CMP recipe before releasing lots to contact plug patterning.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ild_cmp_afm_dishing_erosion_profile_9pt.csv`
- [ ] `ild_surface_microroughness_rq_map.tiff`
- [ ] `afm_metrology_qa_signoff_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Field ILD Oxide RMS Micro-Roughness (Rq) over 2x2 um scan area** | `0.20 nm` | +0.05 nm / -0.05 nm | AFM tapping mode scan with 2nd-order polynomial background subtraction, averaged over 9 wafer mapping sites. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum 180nm DRAM Cell Dense Array Oxide Dishing Depth** | `10.0 nm` | +2.0 nm / -5.0 nm | Cross-sectional AFM line profile extraction across 60x60 um scan over array-field transition boundary. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dense Array Total Dielectric Erosion Depth Relative to Field Reference** | `15.0 nm` | +5.0 nm / -5.0 nm | AFM step height analysis comparing mean z-height of unpatterned field oxide to array top plane. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 designated wafer sites show Rq <= 0.25 nm, maximum array dishing <= 12.0 nm, and array erosion <= 20.0 nm; calibration tip check confirms post-run tip apex radius < 10 nm with zero tip-induced artifact flags; metrology lead and CMP process engineer co-sign the QA sign-off report.
