# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Site Post-CMP Wafer Surface Roughness and Micro-Scratch Topography Mapping

**Module**: Metrology / CMP Defect & Topography Characterization  
**Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip / SKY130 MPW Implementation)  
**Action Type**: Make  
**Document Ref**: [`docs/knowledge/post_cmp_afm_metrology.md`](./docs/knowledge/post_cmp_afm_metrology.md)

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Recipe Setup and    │
│       Engagement       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Multi-Site Tapping   │
│        AFM Scan        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Flattening and     │
│  Roughness Extraction  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Micro-Scratch Depth   │
│       Profiling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│  Disposition vs 180nm  │
│         Specs          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### 1. Environmental Stabilization & Wafer Loading
1. Verify the AFM acoustic and active vibration isolation enclosure is floating with ambient temperature stabilized at **$21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** and relative humidity at **$40 \pm 5\%$**.
2. Mount the post-CMP deionized (DI) water-rinsed and spin-dried 200 mm production wafer onto the vacuum chuck. Engage vacuum clamp at **$\ge 75\ \text{kPa}$**.
3. Align wafer notch/flat to the primary stage datum orientation ($0^\circ$).

#### 2. Probe Selection & Dynamic Resonance Tuning
1. Load a high-aspect ratio silicon probe (tip apex radius $r_{\text{tip}} < 10\ \text{nm}$, nominal cantilever stiffness $k \approx 40\ \text{N/m}$, nominal free resonance frequency $f_0 \approx 300\ \text{kHz}$).
2. Align the AFM optical lever diode laser onto the distal cantilever edge; maximize the four-quadrant photodiode sum signal ($V_{\text{sum}} \ge 6.0\ \text{V}$) with vertical and lateral deflection centered at **$0.00 \pm 0.05\ \text{V}$**.
3. Execute auto-tune sweep across $280\ \text{kHz} - 320\ \text{kHz}$. Select the drive frequency $f_{\text{drive}}$ slightly offset below the resonance peak by **$-500\ \text{Hz}$** to avoid tip-sample bi-stability.
4. Establish free oscillation amplitude $A_0 = 20\ \text{nm}$ (peak-to-peak) and configure the tapping setpoint amplitude ratio $A_{\text{sp}} / A_0 = 0.75 - 0.80$ to minimize sample indentation damage on soft ILD oxide and prevent dulling of the tip on exposed tungsten plugs (W-plugs).

#### 3. Multi-Site Recipe Coordinate Execution
Execute an automated 9-point wafer mapping protocol (Center, 4 Half-Radius at $r = 45\ \text{mm}$, 4 Edge-Exclusion sites at $r = 92\ \text{mm}$, with a $5\ \text{mm}$ edge exclusion):
- **Site Type A (DRAM Cell Array)**: Target the dense stacked capacitor over bitline ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$) cell area containing tungsten plugs (W-plug) sharing adjacent access transistors ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$).
- **Site Type B (Peripheral Circuitry)**: Target the field ILD oxide adjacent to minimum contact hole dimensions ($0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$) and Metal 1 routing channels (minimum pitch $0.34\ \mu\text{m}$, minimum width $0.14\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Scan Settings**:
  - Scan Field Size: **$5.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$** (high-resolution topography) followed by **$20.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 20.0\ \mu\text{m}$** (micro-scratch surveying).
  - Scan Resolution: **$512 \times 512$ pixels** (yielding an in-plane step resolution of $9.77\ \text{nm/pixel}$ for $5\ \mu\text{m}$ scans).
  - Scan Rate: **$0.8\ \text{Hz}$** lines per second (linear tip velocity: $8.0\ \mu\text{m/s}$).
  - Integral Gain ($K_i$) & Proportional Gain ($K_p$): Auto-optimized to trace feedback error without ringing artifacts.

#### 4. Topography Data Processing & Micro-Scratch Metrology
1. Apply a first-order line-by-line flatten and a second-order polynomial surface tilt plane-fit across the raw Z-sensor height data channel to eliminate wafer bow and piezo non-linearities.
2. Calculate Root-Mean-Square roughness ($R_q$) and Average roughness ($R_a$) over clean $1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ sub-regions of the planarized ILD oxide.
3. Apply automated threshold masking to identify negative topography depressions (scratches). Extract the maximum scratch trench depth ($Z_{\text{depth}}$) and cross-sectional full-width at half-maximum (FWHM).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │██████                               │
  Grid Resolution┤██████                               │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   Overlay Budget┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Max Scratch Depth┤▒▒▒▒▒                                │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒                                │
 ILD Rq Roughness┤░                                    │
                 │░                                    │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0      8.8     17.5     26.2    35.0 
```

1. **Post-CMP ILD Surface Micro-Roughness ($R_q$ / RMS)**:
   - **Target**: $\le 0.40\ \text{nm}$
   - **Upper Control Limit (UCL)**: $\le 0.50\ \text{nm}$ ($1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ field).
2. **Maximum Micro-Scratch Depth ($Z_{\text{depth}}$)**:
   - **Target**: $\le 4.2\ \text{nm}$ (Must not breach the physical manufacturing placement grid resolution of **$0.005\ \mu\text{m} = 5.0\ \text{nm}$**).
   - **Critical Scrap Limit**: $\ge 5.0\ \text{nm}$ (Causes fatal lithographic depth-of-focus defocus and residual tungsten stringer bridging).
3. **Micro-Scratch Width / Pitch Defect Extent**:
   - **Target**: Maximum scratch width $\le 35\ \text{nm}$ (Strictly bounded by the maximum permissible overlay error budget of $\le 35\ \text{nm}$ to prevent contact hole open circuits or bridging across the $0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$ contact boundary).
4. **W-Plug Recess / Coring Height Variation ($\Delta Z_{\text{plug-ILD}}$)**:
   - **Target**: $0.0\ \text{nm} \le \Delta Z \le 5.0\ \text{nm}$ relative to adjacent ILD oxide across the access transistor drain contact node.

---

### Context Citations & Technical Justification

- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - The physical placement grid resolution is **$0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\ \text{nm}$)**, defining the maximum allowable vertical defect and micro-scratch depth limit ($< 5\ \text{nm}$) before features snap off-grid or produce lithography defocus.
  - The maximum permissible overlay error between gate poly and active diffusion is **$\le 35\ \text{nm}$**, bounding lateral scratch width limits.
  - Metal 1 minimum width is **$0.14\ \mu\text{m}$** with a minimum pitch of **$0.34\ \mu\text{m}$**, and minimum contact hole dimension is **$0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$**, establishing the baseline pattern densities for ILD CMP topography verification.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Validates the active memory cell topology: access transistor channel length **$L = 180\ \text{nm}$**, width **$W = 220\ \text{nm}$**, with a stacked capacitor erected above the drain contact via tungsten plug (**W-plug**), requiring sub-nanometer post-CMP planarization to avoid sub-threshold/junction leakage exceeding **$1\ \text{fA/cell}$** at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Multi-site AFM mapping must feed automated coordinate transforms directly to downstream lithography stepper stage leveling tables. For 180nm nodes, depth of focus (DOF) budget is constrained (DOF = k2 * (lambda / NA^2) >= 0.5 um); uncompensated high-frequency micro-roughness (>0.4 nm Sq) combined with low-frequency dishing/erosion degrades focus margins across die fields, leading to critical dimension (CD) variations in subsequent contact hole and metal-1 patterning.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Tapping-mode AFM on post-CMP ILD TEOS/oxide must distinguish between benign slurry abrasive chatter marks and severe fractured micro-scratches caused by agglomerated silica particles or pad debris. 9-point or 13-point site sampling across a 200mm wafer with 10 um x 10 um scan windows is required to quantify both Root-Mean-Square surface roughness (Sq/Rq) and scratch depth profiles, ensuring scratch depths do not exceed 15 nm to prevent subsequent tungsten plug bridging.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal silicon AFM cantilevers with tip radius < 10 nm (e.g., standard tapping-mode tips with resonance frequencies ~300 kHz and force constants ~40 N/m) have finite operational lifespans before tip wear distorts roughness quantification. Sourcing certified cantilever batches and implementing tip qualification protocols against calibration pitch standards is critical to avoid artificial roughness broadening and supply bottlenecks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM metrology throughput is inherently low compared to full-wafer optical scatterometry or darkfield inspection. The protocol must enforce fixed site sampling (e.g., 9-site pattern covering center, middle, and 5mm edge-exclusion zones) and automate scan recipe sequences to fit within the 45-minute post-CMP inspection gate without causing queue bottlenecks for downstream post-clean and passivation deposition.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. AFM tip apex convolution and chipping causing under-reporting of micro-scratch depths or artificial inflation of average surface roughness (Rq/Sq).
1. Wafer surface contamination via airborne organic condensation or moisture uptake during prolonged ambient exposure, obscuring nanoscale oxide topography.
1. Vibrational acoustic decoupling or thermal stage drift causing scan line distortions and false step-height artifacts in automated multi-site mapping.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-2-3-01` | **9-Site Post-CMP TEOS ILD Surface Roughness (Sq/Rq) Topography Scan** | Automated Fab Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with acoustic enclosure, active vibration isolation table, and silicon cantilevers (tip radius < 10 nm, nominal resonant frequency ~300 kHz, spring constant ~40 N/m). | 1. Load wafer onto electrostatic chuck with notch alignment at 6 o'clock. 2. Auto-align coordinates to wafer center. 3. Navigate sequentially to 9 standard metrology sites (Center, [R=45mm at 0, 90, 180, 270 deg], [R=95mm at 45, 135, 225, 315 deg]). 4. At each site, engage tip in tapping mode at 15% amplitude setpoint reduction. 5. Acquire 10 um x 10 um topography scan at 512 x 512 pixels with scan rate of 0.5 Hz. 6. Apply 1st-order plane flattening and calculate Sq (RMS roughness) and mean height distribution. | `Sq (RMS surface roughness) <= 0.35 nm across all 9 measured sites; wafer-level mean Sq <= 0.30 nm with standard deviation <= 0.05 nm.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-2-3-02` | **Slurry Micro-Scratch Depth and Density Topography Profiling** | Automated Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscope equipped with automated defect review (ADR) software module and high-resolution silicon cantilevers. | 1. Import optical defect coordinate table. 2. Auto-navigate to top 5 defect coordinate sites flagged as linear scratches. 3. Execute local optical camera fine-alignment. 4. Acquire 20 um x 20 um high-resolution AFM tapping-mode scan centered on target coordinate (1024 x 1024 resolution, 0.3 Hz). 5. Extract cross-sectional depth profile perpendicular to scratch axis using 5-line averaged cross-section. 6. Quantify maximum scratch depth, scratch width (FWHM), and residual pile-up edge lip height. | `Maximum micro-scratch depth <= 12.0 nm; scratch width (FWHM) <= 80 nm; pile-up lip height <= 2.0 nm; zero catastrophic tears (>20 nm depth) across all sampled defect sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (12-inch, powder-free, double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified clear UV/laser eye protection, Cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood, ESD boots, and conductive ground strap, Non-shedding cleanroom face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of cleanroom eyewash water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids apart; seek prompt medical evaluation. Skin contact: Wash affected skin thoroughly with DI water. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move individual to fresh cleanroom air or outdoors. Laser safety: In case of optical beam alignment exposure, avoid direct eye contact with Class 2/3R cantilever deflection laser diode (670 nm); report any flash exposure to cleanroom safety officer.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM metrology tool operates inside ISO Class 4 (Class 10) mini-environment laminar flow hood with active HEPA/ULPA filtration maintaining 0.45 m/s downward velocity. Solvent wipe-down station requires localized exhaust ventilation with capture velocity >= 0.5 m/s connected to General Cleanroom VOC Exhaust.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA cleaning wipes and contaminated swab waste must be disposed of in dedicated, flame-resistant, grounded stainless-steel solvent waste cans. DI rinse drainage discharged into industrial waste neutralization system (IWNS) maintaining pH within 6.0 - 9.0 before municipal effluent release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 / VLSI | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DIW)** | `7732-18-5` | Ultra-pure Semiconductor Grade (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP ILD TEOS surface cleaned via PVA brush scrub with dilute ammonium hydroxide (NH4OH) chemistry, megasonic rinsed, spin-dried, and free of macroscopic slurry residue or water marks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: AFM-inspected, particle-free planarized oxide surface with verified Sq roughness <= 0.35 nm, sealed in nitrogen-purged FOUP, ready for optical defect verification or pre-metal contact photolithography.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient Q-time promotes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (organic volatile condensation and moisture chemisorption), altering cantilever adhesion forces, falsifying nanoscale roughness measurements, and nucleating irreversible native surface haze.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Multi-site tapping-mode AFM topography mapping across 9 wafer sites on post-CMP TEOS ILD demonstrating uniform nanoscale planarization with RMS roughness (Sq) <= 0.35 nm and zero critical micro-scratches exceeding 12 nm depth, fully qualifying the wafer for subsequent lithography processing.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `AFM_9Site_SurfaceRoughness_Summary_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Topography_HeightMap_Site1to9_RawMatrix.csv`
- [ ] `MicroScratch_CrossSection_Profile_DefectReview.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wafer-level mean root-mean-square surface roughness (Sq) across 9 distributed 10 um x 10 um scan areas** | `0.28 nm` | +0.07 nm / -0.10 nm | Automated 1st-order flattened 512x512 tapping-mode AFM height distribution calculation |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum peak-to-valley micro-scratch trench depth on target defect review sites** | `8.0 nm` | +4.0 nm / -6.0 nm | Multi-line cross-sectional step profiling extracted perpendicular to scratch axis in AFM analysis suite |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Measurement repeatability (1-sigma) across 3 consecutive scans at wafer center site without tip change** | `0.02 nm` | +0.01 nm / -0.01 nm | Standard deviation of repeated Sq determinations on static qualification target |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 metrology sites demonstrate Sq <= 0.35 nm, maximum scratch depth at defect sites does not exceed 12.0 nm, AFM tip resonance degradation is < 2% post-mapping, and data artifact files are cryptographically checksummed and uploaded to the metrology database.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Surface Roughness Sq-Sa Parameter Extraction and Scratch Defect Density Quantification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Surface Roughness Sq-Sa Parameter Extraction and Scratch Defect Density Quantification: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## AFM Topography Raw Height Field Preprocessing and Flattening
**Process Level:** Sub-module Metrology / Post-CMP Planarization Characterization  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Document Link:** [`SOP-MET-AFM-001_afm_flattening.md`](./docs/sop/SOP-MET-AFM-001_afm_flattening.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Raw AFM Height Map   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Data Conditioning &   │
│     Spike Removal      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Planar Bow       │
│      Correction:       │
│       Polynomial       │
│      Subtraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Line-by-Line      │
│      Mean/Median       │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Feature Masking &    │
│  Zero-Plane Baseline   │
│     Normalization      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Flattened Topography  │
│      Height Field      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Raw Height Grid Ingestion & Coordinate Check:**
   - Ingest cantilever deflection / Z-piezo sensor matrix ($512 \times 512$ or $1024 \times 1024$ raster) across the scanned ILD oxide field ($5\,\mu\text{m} \times 5\,\mu\text{m}$ to $20\,\mu\text{m} \times 20\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Match sampling step $\Delta x, \Delta y$ to the foundry physical placement grid ($0.005\,\mu\text{m} = 5\,\text{nm}$).
2. **Outlier Despiking:**
   - Run a $3 \times 3$ moving window median filter to trap cantilever feedback loss spikes. Tag any pixel deviating $> 5\sigma$ or $> 15\,\text{nm}$ step discontinuity; interpolate via 8-neighbor bilinear interpolation.
3. **Global Planar Bow & Tilt Subtraction:**
   - Perform 2nd-order surface leveling:
     $$Z_{\text{corrected}}(x,y) = Z_{\text{raw}}(x,y) - \left(a_0 + a_1 x + a_2 y + a_3 x^2 + a_4 y^2 + a_5 xy\right)$$
   - Restrict polynomial order to $\le 2$ to prevent mathematical over-fitting and false depression artifacts.
4. **Masked Line-by-Line Median Alignment:**
   - Apply binary exclusion mask $M(x,y) = 0$ on tungsten plugs (W-plugs) and contact holes ($0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$), and $M(x,y) = 1$ on planar ILD oxide.
   - Subtract unmasked median line height $\tilde{Z}(y_i)$ from each raster line $y_i$ to eliminate fast-scan line-hopping and thermal Z-drift without edge-trenching.
5. **Zero-Plane Baseline Normalization:**
   - Set the mean height of unmasked polished oxide to $\bar{Z}_{\text{ILD}} = 0.00\,\text{nm}$ and export for $S_q / S_a$ roughness and scratch quantification.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                                                        
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
    Peak Mask Excl.┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                   │▒▒▒▒                               │
   Line Scan Offset┤▒▒▒▒                               │
   Z-Baseline Drift┤▓▓▓                                │
                   │▓▓▓                                │
Residual Tilt Angle┤██                                 │
                   │██                                 │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                  0.00     0.24    0.47     0.71   0.95 
```

1. **Residual Macro Tilt:** Unmasked surface slope residual $\le 0.02^\circ$ ($\le 0.35\,\text{mrad}$).
2. **Line-to-Line Median Discontinuity:** Inter-raster line height offset $\le 0.08\,\text{nm}$ ($3\sigma$).
3. **Z-Baseline Measurement Repeatability:** Zero-plane drift across consecutive runs $\le \pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$ (sub-Angstrom precision).
4. **Pattern Step Masking Fidelity:** Feature exclusion boundary conformity $\ge 95\%$ on contact hole features ($0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$) and dense bitline structures.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources Cited
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
  - $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$) physical placement grid; $0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ minimum contact hole dimension.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
  - Sub-Angstrom precision standard of $\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$ for baseline dielectric film thickness and leveling stability.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture and tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnect topography.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Raw AFM height profiles over CMP-polished oxide ILD exhibit significant piezo bow, thermal tip drift, and scanner non-orthogonality that, if corrected with naive high-order polynomial leveling, artificially suppress macroscopic dishing and dielectric thickness erosion across 180nm metal line arrays. Flattening algorithms must strictly decouple tilt/scanner curvature from authentic CMP topographic signatures using feature-exclusion masking, ensuring that processed Sa/Sq values correlate accurately with downstream lithographic depth-of-focus (DOF >= 0.5 um) margins and spectroscopic ellipsometry thickness wafer maps.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Tapping-mode AFM data on ILD oxide films prone to micro-scratches and chatter marks must be preprocessed using line-by-line median or polynomial line leveling with strict threshold masking. If micro-scratches or tungsten plug recesses are included in the baseline line-fit calculations, dark streak artifacts ('shadowing' or artificially elevated flanking topography) will be introduced into the matrix, distorting subsequent ISO 25178 Sq/Sa roughness calculations and obscuring sub-nanometer polish damage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: AFM cantilever probe supply (silicon tips with tip radius < 10 nm, spring constant 20-80 N/m, resonant frequency ~300 kHz) faces tight fab stocking quotas. Rapid tip bluntness or breakage caused by harsh engage parameters or contaminated post-CMP surfaces increases probe consumption rates, causing metrology station bottlenecks that stall lot turn-around times and CMP polish pad conditioning qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM data processing and flattening pipelines must be automated via standardized batch scripts rather than manual operator leveling to guarantee statistical reproducibility across 200mm pilot line shifts. Failure to enforce consistent algorithm execution (e.g. fixed 1st-order line-fit with 3-sigma exclusion) introduces operator-dependent roughness reporting, jeopardizing CMP module sign-off and milestone delivery for the 180nm DRAM tapeout schedule.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Artificial topography suppression: Over-flattening via unmasked 2nd/3rd-order polynomial surface fitting that distorts genuine ILD oxide step heights, CMP dishing, and shallow micro-scratch profiles.
1. Streak artifact generation: Failure to exclude deep chatter scratches or recessed tungsten plug boundaries during 1D line-by-line flattening, causing horizontal streak artifacts across adjacent scan lines.
1. Tip degradation bias: Acquisition of raw height data using a chipped or contaminated AFM tip (radius > 25 nm), resulting in tip-convolution filtering that artificially lowers raw Sa/Sq roughness prior to software leveling.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-3-1-01` | **AFM Raw Height Field Flattening Verification on Standard Step-Height and Scratch Reference** | Atomic Force Microscope (Bruker Dimension Icon or Park Systems NX-HPS) in tapping mode, equipped with calibrated 100 nm step-height / silicon pitch standard (VLSI Standards). | 1. Import raw .spm / .xps height channel data into automated preprocessing engine. 2. Apply outlier pixel detection using 3-sigma threshold to eliminate tip-loss/parachuting glitches. 3. Execute 1st-order line-by-line polynomial leveling with dynamic feature masking (excluding topographic steps > 3 nm from baseline fit). 4. Apply 2nd-order bow correction to compensate for Z-scanner parabolic distortion. 5. Export processed 2D floating-point matrix and residual map. | `Certified step-height value retained within 100 nm +/- 0.8 nm (error < 1.0%); baseline root-mean-square tilt across plateau regions < 0.05 nm/um; zero streak artifacts (flanking intensity delta < 0.08 nm across scratch edges).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-3-1-02` | **Post-ILD Oxide CMP Roughness Preprocessing Stability and Reproducibility Test** | Automated Fab AFM Workstation with wafer chucking for 200mm wafers, automated batch script for offline height field preprocessing. | 1. Ingest raw height fields from all 9 sites into batch preprocessor. 2. Run automated flattening protocol: zero-order line alignment followed by 1st-order plane subtraction with mask-locked baseline. 3. Compute surface area roughness Sa and root-mean-square Sq according to ISO 25178. 4. Perturb masking threshold by +/- 10% and re-evaluate Sa/Sq sensitivity across 5 consecutive runs. | `Sa roughness measurement across reference oxide field must yield between 0.15 nm and 0.35 nm; algorithmic flattening repeatability across perturbation runs must show standard deviation sigma(Sq) <= 0.015 nm (3-sigma < 5% of nominal value).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 / ISO 5 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses, Full static-dissipative cleanroom bunny suit with ESD-compliant footwear, Chemical-resistant neoprene apron and sleeve covers during solvent wipe maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of solvent eye contact, flush immediately with cleanroom eyewash station water for a minimum of 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. For inhalation of solvent vapors, evacuate personnel to fresh cleanroom air supply. For skin contact, remove contaminated gloves/apparel and rinse skin thoroughly with deionized water. Laser safety precaution: AFM optical lever uses Class 2 / 3R laser diode (670 nm); avoid direct beam exposure to ocular tissue.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM metrology tool operates inside acoustic and thermal environmental enclosure connected to cleanroom laminar airflow (downflow velocity 0.45 m/s +/- 20%). Solvent cleaning of stage or sample mounts must be conducted under dedicated chemical wet bench local exhaust ventilation (LEV) with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA and acetone wipes must be sealed in airtight, antistatic solvent disposal bags and deposited into dedicated flammables waste receptacles. Liquid solvent rinses must be segregated in grounded, labeled solvent carboys for hazardous chemical waste reclamation; no drain disposal allowed.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / SLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade (MOS) | `99.5%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly polished ILD TEOS oxide wafer following post-CMP double-sided megasonic PVA brush scrub and spin-rinse-dry (SRD); surface hydrophylic, free of slurry particles and organic surfactant residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Flattened, calibrated 2D AFM topography matrices stored in secure fab database; wafer returned to sealed FOUP/pod under UHP N2 purge ready for downstream spectroscopic ellipsometry or lithography track.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess ambient air exposure leads to airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (volatile organic compounds and moisture condensation) and native oxide/silanol clustering on ILD surface, artificially inflating raw Sa/Sq roughness by > 0.15 nm and causing probe tip contamination during scanning.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable completion of the raw AFM height field preprocessing pipeline for post-CMP ILD oxide wafers on the 180nm DRAM process. The deliverable guarantees artifact-free, calibrated 2D topographic matrices with decoupled scanner bow and tilt, enabling sub-Angstrom precision extraction of ISO 25178 Sa/Sq roughness and scratch defect metrics.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `AFM_ILD_CMP_Flattened_Topography_Matrix.csv`
- [ ] `AFM_Preprocessing_Residual_and_Bow_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `AFM_Calibrated_Height_Field_Image_16bit.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual scanner tilt across flattened baseline planar oxide zones** | `0.02 nm/um` | <= 0.05 nm/um | Linear regression slope evaluation over unmasked oxide planar regions across 512 scan lines. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-flattening surface roughness Sa on reference planar TEOS ILD oxide** | `0.22 nm` | +/- 0.06 nm | ISO 25178 Sa areal roughness computation across masked 5 um x 5 um processed field. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Step-height preservation fidelity across micro-features post-flattening** | `100.0%` | +/- 1.5% | Pre- vs. post-processing profile differential on certified calibration step standard. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Automated pipeline successfully processes all 9 site scans per wafer without streak artifacts (residual edge delta <= 0.08 nm), meets all quantitative assertions, archives calibrated .csv matrices and .tiff height maps into the fab metrology database, and completes metrology sign-off within the established 45-minute air Q-time limit.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): $S_a$ / $S_q$ Areal Surface Roughness Parameter Extraction and Statistical Profiling

**Node / Process Path:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Foundry Tapeout & PDK > CMP of ILD & W-Plugs > ILD Oxide CMP Recipe Optimization and Polish > Post-CMP Metrology > Tapping-Mode AFM Scan > Roughness $S_q$/$S_a$ Parameter Extraction and Statistical Profiling  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Load & Align  │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Tapping AFM Scan   │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│ Flattening & Plane   │
│         Fit          │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Sa & Sq Parameter   │
│      Extraction      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│     Statistical      │
│     Profiling &      │
│      Pass/Fail       │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Scan Calibration & Sample Loading
1. Load post-CMP planarized ILD wafer with stacked-capacitor DRAM array regions onto the atomic force microscope (AFM) vibration-isolated vacuum chuck.
2. Initialize tapping-mode cantilever with ultra-sharp silicon probe tip (nominal tip radius $R < 10\text{ nm}$). Verify cantilever drive resonance frequency ($\sim 300\text{ kHz}$) and calibrate Z-piezo deflection sensitivity.
3. Perform optical alignment to locate ILD dielectric oxide fields above active 180nm transistor arrays ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and tungsten plug (W-plug) contact vias.

### Step 2: Tapping-Mode Nanoscale Scan Execution
1. Set scan area to $5.0\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 5.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ (scaled directly to the $0.005\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ / $5\text{ nm}$ manufacturing grid).
2. Set scan resolution to $512 \times 512$ or $1024 \times 1024$ data points with a line scan rate of $0.5\text{ Hz}$ to $1.0\text{ Hz}$ to prevent probe drag and tip-induced sample scratching.
3. Execute automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial roughness and film non-uniformity across center, mid-radius, and wafer edge zones.

### Step 3: Topographic Data Pre-Processing & Leveling
1. Apply 1st-order polynomial plane tilt correction (line-by-line subtraction) and 2nd-order bow flattening to eliminate wafer bow and piezo scanner non-linear drift.
2. Filter outlier z-data spikes using a threshold filter matching the dry gate oxide metrology vertical sensitivity scale ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).

### Step 4: Areal Roughness Parameter Extraction ($S_a$ and $S_q$)
1. Extract Areal Arithmetic Mean Deviation ($S_a$):
   $$S_a = \frac{1}{M \cdot N} \sum_{k=0}^{M-1} \sum_{l=0}^{N-1} |z(x_k, y_l) - \bar{z}|$$
2. Extract Areal Root Mean Square (RMS) Surface Roughness ($S_q$):
   $$S_q = \sqrt{\frac{1}{M \cdot N} \sum_{k=0}^{M-1} \sum_{l=0}^{N-1} (z(x_k, y_l) - \bar{z})^2}$$
3. Quantify peak-to-valley height ($S_z$) and residual micro-scratch defect density across the ILD polish field.

### Step 5: Statistical Profiling and Lot Disposition
1. Aggregate multi-site scan parameters into statistical run charts across the 9-point/49-point grid.
2. Calculate lot mean $\mu(S_q)$, standard deviation $\sigma(S_q)$, and verify consistency with downstream DUV lithography depth of focus budgets.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                  AFM Metrology Acceptance Limits       
           ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
           │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
 Grid Pitch┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
           │▒                                          │
Z Precision┤▒                                          │
  Sa Target┤▓▓▓                                        │
           │▓▓▓                                        │
  Sq Target┤████                                       │
           │████                                       │
           └┬──────────┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬┘
           0.0        1.2       2.5        3.8      5.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Post-CMP ILD RMS Surface Roughness ($S_q$)** | $\le 0.35$ | Max $0.45$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Post-CMP Areal Mean Roughness ($S_a$)** | $\le 0.28$ | Max $0.35$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AFM Vertical Measurement Precision ($\sigma_z$)** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\le 0.08$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Metrology Placement / Sampling Grid Resolution** | $0.005$ ($5$) | Exact grid lock | $\mu\text{m}$ ($\text{nm}$) |

---

## 4. Context Citations

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Sub-Angstrom vertical metrology precision reference ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
   - Automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping methodology for tracking cross-wafer non-uniformity.
2. **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
   - Physical placement grid resolution established at $0.005\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
   - Active gate dimensions ($0.15\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ / $150\text{ nm}$) and contact hole constraints ($0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) requiring planar ILD topologies to stay within DUV ($248\text{ nm}$) depth-of-focus constraints.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor unit cell baseline ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture connected through tungsten plug contacts.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-CMP ILD oxide topography directly governs lithographic focus margin in downstream metal-1 patterning. Given a Depth of Focus (DOF) window of >= 0.5 um in 180nm DUV lithography, high-frequency areal surface roughness (Sa, Sq) extracted via AFM must be cleanly decoupled from low-frequency within-die (WID) dishing and erosion to prevent systematic metrology aliasing across the 49-point wafer map.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Tapping-mode AFM scanning on polished silicon dioxide films must use high-aspect-ratio, ultrasharp silicon tips (nominal tip radius <= 10 nm) operating in the repulsive intermittent-contact regime to prevent tip-induced convolutional broadening. Tilt correction and second-order polynomial flattening algorithms must be strictly standardized prior to calculating ISO 25178 areal parameters (Sa, Sq) over 5 um x 5 um and 1 um x 1 um scan fields.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Atomic Force Microscopy consumable throughput is bottlenecked by tip apex degradation from residual abrasive ceria/silica slurry nanoparticles. Standardizing on commercially accessible antimony-doped silicon probes (e.g., resonance ~300 kHz, force constant ~40 N/m) with a rigorous 10-wafer qualification cadence ensures stable operational expense and vendor fungibility.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM metrology represents a critical serial bottleneck within the post-CMP Q-time loop. Full-wafer 49-point AFM scanning is physically prohibitive; metrology recipes must deploy an optimized 9-point statistical sampling plan within a strict 60-minute window post-cleaning to prevent particulate redeposition or moisture-induced surface modification.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex blunting or contamination by residual slurry nanoparticles causing artificial suppression of measured high-frequency Sq/Sa roughness.
1. Improper background polynomial plane-subtraction filtering that artifactually skews areal roughness by confusing macro-scale oxide dishing with micro-roughness.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-3-2-01` | **Areal Surface Roughness Sa and Sq Parameter Extraction on Polished ILD Oxide** | Automated 200mm Fab Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with 10nm tip radius silicon cantilever | 1. Load wafer onto vibration-isolated vacuum chuck; align wafer notch. 2. Navigate optical pattern recognition to die locations (Center, +/-X, +/-Y 9-site map). 3. Engage tapping mode at setpoint ratio 0.75-0.80 and resonant frequency ~300 kHz. 4. Execute 5 um x 5 um area scan at 512 x 512 pixel resolution with a scan rate of 0.5 Hz. 5. Apply standardized 2nd-order polynomial plane flattening to raw topography height data. 6. Extract ISO 25178 Sa (arithmetic mean height) and Sq (root-mean-square height). | `Average Sa <= 0.25 nm across all 9 measurement sites; average Sq <= 0.35 nm; individual site Sq must not exceed 0.45 nm.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-3-2-02` | **AFM Tip Qualification and Metrology Repeatability Verification** | Automated Tapping-Mode AFM and Certified Silicon Dioxide / Mica Roughness Reference Standard | 1. Perform 10 consecutive tapping-mode scans on the certified calibration artifact (5 um x 5 um). 2. Measure apex tip radius using tip-check blind reconstruction standard. 3. Compute 1-sigma standard deviation of Sq roughness across the 10 repeated cycles. 4. Evaluate scan trace-retrace line profile coincidence error. | `AFM tip radius <= 10.0 nm; 1-sigma repeatability of Sq <= 0.02 nm; trace-retrace profile discrepancy < 2.0%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves, Anti-static ESD lab coat / cleanroom bunny suit, ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For chemical contact from IPA: Wash skin with soap and water; flush eyes with eyewash station for 15 minutes. For AFM laser exposure: Avoid direct eye reflection; power down diode laser immediately during alignment servicing.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom laminar flow hood (Class 1 / ISO 3) with localized passive HEPA filtration and mini-environment enclosure.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA-wetted wipes disposed of into dedicated airtight solvent waste bins; spent silicon cantilevers collected in marked sharps/silicon scrap container.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, for optical stage wiping)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (for stage purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic clean oxide surface post-megasonic clean and SRD, verified dry and free of visible water marks or slurry stains.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized dry ILD oxide surface, vacuum sealed in FOUP/cassette, ready for downstream spectroscopic ellipsometry thickness validation or pre-metal lithography.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne organic hydrocarbon condensation and particulate settling on oxide surface, causing false-positive AFM roughness spikes and masking actual post-polish micro-scratches.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full statistical profiling and spatial distribution mapping of post-CMP ILD oxide surface roughness parameters (Sa, Sq) across a 9-point wafer layout, demonstrating sub-0.35 nm RMS smoothness compatible with 180nm DUV lithography DOF constraints.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ILD_PostCMP_AFM_Roughness_9Point_Data.csv`
- [ ] `ILD_Surface_Areal_Topography_5um_Map.tiff`
- [ ] `AFM_Metrology_Statistical_Profiling_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Areal Root Mean Square Surface Roughness (Sq)** | `0.28 nm` | +/- 0.07 nm | ISO 25178 height extraction on flattened 5 um x 5 um tapping-mode AFM scans across 9 wafer sites |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Areal Arithmetic Mean Surface Roughness (Sa)** | `0.22 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm | ISO 25178 height extraction on flattened 5 um x 5 um tapping-mode AFM scans across 9 wafer sites |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Instrument Measurement Repeatability (1-sigma Sq)** | `0.015 nm` | <= 0.020 nm | 10-cycle continuous static-repeat scan evaluation on central wafer test site |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 wafer locations exhibit Sq <= 0.35 nm without uncorrectable trace-retrace artifacts or micro-scratch defects exceeding 1.5 nm depth, signed off by Metrology Module Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Micro-Scratch Defect Thresholding and Spatial Density Quantification

- **WBS Path**: `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `Foundry Tapeout & PDK` > `Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP)` > `Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide CMP Recipe Optimization and Polish` > `Post-CMP Metrology` > `Automated Micro-Scratch Defect Thresholding and Spatial Density Quantification`
- **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm scale)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Target Node Level**: Leaf Node (Execution SOP)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│           Post-CMP Wafer Substrate Transfer            │
│       (DI Water Cleansed & Spin-Dried ILD Wafer)       │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│             Automated Wafer Macro-Mapping              │
│       (49-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Grid)       │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│           Tapping-Mode AFM Scan Acquisition            │
│        (High-Aspect Si Tip, 512 x 512 Grid Map)        │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│            AFM Topography Plane Flattening             │
│        (2nd-Order Polynomial Subtraction & Sq)         │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│         Automated Micro-Scratch Segmentation           │
│     (Depth Threshold >= 3.5 nm, Length >= 180 nm)      │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│        Spatial Defect Density Quantification D_scratch  │
│        (Cross-Correlation Across Die Coordinates)      │
│                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Pre-Inspection Stage Calibration & Registration**:
   - Secure the post-CMP planarized Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) wafer onto the vibration-isolated vacuum chuck.
   - Execute coordinate registration aligning the wafer notch to within $\pm 0.05^\circ$ angular deviation.

2. **Automated Thickness & Uniformity Macro-Grid Screening**:
   - Perform an automated **49-point wafer mapping** scan using spectroscopic reflectometry/ellipsometry measuring polarization parameters $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$ across the wafer radius.
   - Fit $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ spectra to Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models to verify ILD oxide thickness across the wafer within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ target film non-uniformity bounds before micro-inspection.

3. **Tapping-Mode AFM Area Scan Acquisition**:
   - Position the AFM scan head over pre-selected high-risk radial sites (wafer center, mid-radius, and edge-exclusion zones $> 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Engage a high-resonance silicon cantilever (nominal resonant frequency $\sim 300\text{ kHz}$, tip radius $\le 10\text{ nm}$) in non-destructive tapping mode.
   - Acquire a $20\ \mu\text{m} \times 20\ \mu\text{m}$ scan field at $512 \times 512$ pixel resolution at a line rate of $0.5\text{ Hz}$ to avoid tip-induced trench distortion.

4. **Surface Topography Pre-Processing & Plane Leveling**:
   - Apply line-by-line mean flattening and a 2nd-order polynomial plane subtraction to correct sample tilt and piezoelectric bow.
   - Extract areal roughness parameters: average roughness ($S_a$) and root-mean-square roughness ($S_q$). Ensure post-polish baseline planar field roughness satisfies $S_q \le 0.25\text{ nm}$.

5. **Automated Micro-Scratch Defect Thresholding**:
   - Apply a negative morphological depth filter setting the micro-scratch threshold $Z_{\text{threshold}} \ge 3.5\text{ nm}$ below the local mean planar surface (matching the critical dry gate oxide equivalent thickness).
   - Execute connected-component directional pixel labeling:
     - Filter defect features by aspect ratio ($L / W \ge 5.0$) and minimum continuous path length $L_{\text{scratch}} \ge 180\text{ nm}$ (matching 180nm access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$) to distinguish true slurry micro-scratches from isolated pitting.

6. **Spatial Density Calculation & Defect Die Mapping**:
   - Compute spatial micro-scratch defect density:
     $$D_{\text{scratch}} = \frac{N_{\text{scratches}}}{A_{\text{inspected}}} \quad \left[\text{defects/cm}^2\right]$$
   - Correlate coordinates with the active DRAM cell layout topology to flag potential bitline contact or stacked capacitor W-plug bridging risks.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │███████                          │
Measured Post-CMP ILD┤███████                          │
   Target Defect Spec┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                    0.00    0.25    0.50    0.75   1.00 
```

| Metric Parameter | Operational Target Metric | Unit | Inspection Tool / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Micro-Scratch Depth Threshold** | $\ge 3.5$ (Critical Defect Trigger) | $\text{nm}$ | Tapping-Mode AFM Line-Profile Extraction |
| **Micro-Scratch Length Threshold** | $\ge 180$ (Access Channel Length $L$) | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Morphological Feature Segmentation |
| **Post-CMP Surface Roughness ($S_q$)** | $\le 0.25$ | $\text{nm}$ | Tapping-Mode AFM Area Metrology ($20 \times 20\ \mu\text{m}$) |
| **Spatial Micro-Scratch Defect Density ($D_{\text{scratch}}$)** | $< 0.20$ | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Automated Multi-Die Raster Inspection |
| **Macro Film Thickness Uniformity** | 49-point automated map with $\le \pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ Cauchy model fit) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Applied for non-destructive dielectric thickness validation ($\rho = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$) and the **automated 49-point wafer mapping** strategy tracking radial film thickness variation to sub-nanometer and $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ tolerances.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Provides physical dimensional constraints for defect sizing: unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (defining the minimum critical scratch length $L_{\text{scratch}}$ capable of bridging adjacent memory cells and W-plugs).

---

> [!NOTE]
> Micro-knowledge entry created and saved to [docs/knowledge/micro_scratch_metrology_180nm.md](./docs/knowledge/micro_scratch_metrology_180nm.md) adhering to DRAM Foundation VN council standards.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated micro-scratch detection across large-area ILD oxide surfaces requires balancing high spatial resolution with metrology throughput. Relying strictly on high-resolution tapping-mode AFM scans (e.g., 20x20 um windows) yields severe sampling bias unless tightly coupled to optical wafer inspection or automated stage mapping. If the algorithmic thresholding relies on simple height-threshold binarization without prior 2nd-order surface tilt/bow leveling and high-pass spatial frequency filtering, low-frequency wafer waviness will register as false-positive scratch troughs.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-CMP ILD oxide micro-scratches in 180nm DRAM architectures typically stem from agglomerated colloidal silica or alumina slurry particles (>0.5 um) or fractured pad debris. In tapping-mode AFM, tip convolution effects artificially widen narrow scratch profiles (true width ~20-50 nm appears as >80 nm) while tip wear reduces apparent scratch depth. Threshold segmentation must operate on calibrated depth (depth threshold >= 1.5 nm below baseline Sq plane) and aspect ratio (length/width >= 5) to robustly distinguish elongated abrasive scratches from isotropic pitting or slurry pinholes.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tapping-mode AFM cantilevers with ultra-sharp silicon tips (nominal tip radius < 10 nm, spring constant 40 N/m, resonant frequency ~300 kHz) suffer rapid tip blunting when dragging across abrasive micro-scratch edges during automated profiling. Sourcing high-durability diamond-like carbon (DLC) coated or solid diamond tips is critical to prevent frequent calibration drift, high consumable burn rates, and procurement lead-time bottlenecks during multi-point wafer mapping runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Automated scratch density quantification must deliver deterministic cycle times (<15 minutes per 9-site inspection run) to avoid exceeding downstream metallization queue times. If AFM image processing and thresholding require manual operator tuning of segmentation seeds or filter kernels, metrology turns into a bottleneck, jeopardizing fab line takt time and batch traceability.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. AFM tip apex fracturing or contamination by slurry residue, inducing artificial double-tip imaging artifacts that duplicate scratch counts and skew spatial density statistics.
1. Algorithmic misclassification of CMP slurry pitting or water marks as directional micro-scratches due to unconstrained aspect-ratio thresholding in the defect morphology filter.
1. Threshold drift caused by uncompensated thermal piezostage drift during long automated raster scans, generating false depth gradients across the scan window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Load wafer into AFM chuck and perform automated 9-site sampling across center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion (5 mm) zones. 2. Capture a 20 um x 20 um scan (512 x 512 pixels) at each site with scan rate 0.8 Hz. 3. Apply 2nd-order polynomial background leveling and line-by-line median subtraction. 4. Execute automated depth segmentation using a threshold of z <= -1.8 nm relative to mean surface plane. 5. Apply morphological feature extraction: calculate feature length, width, and aspect ratio (length/width). 6. Classify features with depth >= 1.8 nm and aspect ratio >= 5.0 as verified micro-scratches. 7. Output total detected scratch count, max scratch depth, and spatial coordinates. | `Algorithm correctly identifies 100% of synthetic/calibrated scratch features (depth >= 1.8 nm, length >= 200 nm); false positive count on virgin thermal oxide reference <= 0 defects per 400 um^2; measurement repeatability of max scratch depth across 3 consecutive scans within ±0.2 nm.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-1-3-3-3-3-02` | **Full-Wafer 9-Point Spatial Scratch Density Quantification and Uniformity Mapping** | Automated Stage Atomic Force Microscope with programmable 9-point coordinate navigation and multi-channel data acquisition | 1. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom antistatic ESD bunny suit and ESD-safe footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA: immediately flush with copious amounts of clean deionized water or eye-wash solution for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors: move individual to fresh cleanroom air; seek medical attention if irritation or dizziness persists. For high-pressure gas injection injuries, seek immediate emergency medical care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operate within a certified Class 100 laminar flow hood or Class 1 cleanroom bay with constant downflow velocity of 0.45 ± 0.05 m/s. Local solvent exhaust required if open wipe solvent reservoirs exceed 50 mL.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked cleanroom wipes in dedicated, grounded, flame-retardant hazardous chemical waste bins labeled for flammable organic waste. No chemical drain dumping permitted.

| **Nitrogen (Pressurized Gas for Blow-Off/Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, 99.9999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP polished ILD SiO2, clean, rinsed with ultra-pure DI water and Marangoni dried; free of slurry crust, water stains, and organic residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, defect-mapped ILD oxide surface, vacuum-desorbed, zero organic contamination from AFM cantilevers, ready for tungsten plug contact photolithography.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive ambient air exposure causes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption, organic hydrocarbon condensation, and atmospheric particle deposition onto polished oxide surfaces, creating false defect counts and impairing downstream contact hole photoresist adhesion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Automated tapping-mode AFM topography acquisition and Python/Gwyddion-based spatial thresholding pipeline successfully deployed across 9 standard wafer coordinates, establishing quantifiable baseline micro-scratch defect density and depth distributions on post-CMP ILD oxide for 180nm DRAM fabrication.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `scratch_morphology_raw_coordinates.csv`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Critical micro-scratch cut-off depth threshold precision** | `1.80 nm` | ±0.15 nm | AFM vertical z-piezo calibrated against NIST standard step height before automated run |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Spatial defect classification false positive rate on pristine calibration reference** | `0.0 defects / 400 um^2` | +1.0 defect / 400 um^2 | Automated scan execution on prime thermal oxide wafer run under identical filtering parameters |

> Researcher sign-off requires: 1) Automated 9-site AFM run completed without tip-breakage or z-scanner runaway, 2) All raw .tiff topography datasets leveled and processed with zero unhandled software exceptions, 3) Generated density report showing mean defect density <= 1.11e5 scratches/cm^2 with no individual scratch exceeding 4.0 nm in depth, and 4) Complete signoff signed by Domain Expert and Metrology Module Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Tungsten (W) Plug Overburden CMP and Selective Endpoint Clearing

**Category**: Planarization | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Tungsten CMP endpoint detection must maintain sub-3-second optical emission or motor current resolution across 200mm wafers to avoid excessive oxide erosion and plug recess in high-density 8F^2 DRAM cell array bitline and storage node contacts. Non-uniform over-polishing compromises node contact resistance and risks contact punch-through into source/drain junctions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Achieving selective clearing of the Ti/TiN barrier metal without gouging the W-plug requires a dual-platen sequence: Platen 1 high-selectivity acidic slurry for bulk W overburden removal, followed by Platen 2 soft landing with a selective barrier slurry (Ti/TiN:SiO2 > 3:1, W:SiO2 ~ 1:1) to suppress micro-scratching, plug coring (<15 nm recess), and galvanic corrosion at the W/TiN interface.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Fumed silica vs. colloidal silica W-CMP slurries formulated with ferric nitrate (Fe(NO3)3) oxidizers face strict contamination scrutiny in open-source fab lines due to mobile ion cross-contamination. Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) based acidic formulations with organic complexing agents must be secured with secondary sourcing for ultra-pure grades and dedicated refrigerated storage.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Planarization throughput must sustain >= 22 wafers per hour (WPH) with pad lifetime exceeding 600 wafers to prevent bottlenecking the 180nm MPW pilot lot. Any uncharacterized pad glazing or slurry drift leading to rework directly imperils the tight tapeout tape-in schedule.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe tungsten plug recess/coring exceeding 25 nm resulting in high storage-node contact resistance and open circuits to the bottom capacitor plate.
1. Incomplete Ti/TiN barrier clearance in dense array perimeter causing inter-bitline contact bridging and catastrophic array short circuits.
1. Galvanic erosion and keyhole pull-out caused by acidic post-CMP rinse delay inducing cell leakage current exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-01` | **Tungsten Plug Recess and Array Oxide Erosion Metrology** | High-resolution In-line Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) and Cross-sectional Scanning Electron Microscopy (X-SEM) | 1. Load wafer into in-line AFM automated cassette. 2. Navigate to predefined test structures across 9 sites (center, mid-radius, edge exclusion 3mm) in the 8F^2 memory array and scribe lines. 3. Execute 5 um x 5 um AFM scans across dense contact arrays with 256 lines at 1.0 Hz scan rate. 4. Extract line profiles across 20 adjacent W contacts per site to measure depth delta between ILD field oxide and W plug center (recess/coring). 5. Measure field oxide step height relative to low-density peripheral logic regions to quantify oxide erosion. | `W-plug recess/coring <= 12.0 nm across all 9 sites; array oxide erosion <= 25.0 nm; 3-sigma within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) < 5.0%.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-02` | **Post-W CMP Surface Cleanliness, Defectivity, and Residual Sheet Resistance** | Darkfield Optical Surface Defect Inspection System (KLA-Tencor Surfscan) and Four-Point Probe Sheet Resistance Mapper | 1. Transfer wafer to laser surface defect scanner calibrated to 0.12 um sensitivity threshold. 2. Map full-wafer surface defectivity excluding 3mm edge bead area. 3. Classify defects into micro-scratches, slurry particle residues, and voiding. 4. Transfer wafer to Four-Point Probe sheet resistance mapper. 5. Perform 49-point polar map across wafer to confirm total sheet resistance of open field oxide confirms infinite resistance (complete metallic clearance). | `Total defect count (particle + micro-scratch) <= 30 defects/wafer at >= 0.15 um size; zero metallic Ti/TiN/W residue stringers detected; four-point probe sheet resistance > 1.0E+8 Ohm/sq across all non-contact dielectric test pads.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Acid-resistant neoprene/nitrile blended gauntlet gloves (double gloved), Full chemical splash face shield with ANSI Z87.1 splash goggles underneath, Chemical-resistant PTFE/Tychem apron and sleeves, Steel-toe electrostatic dissipative (ESD) cleanroom safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with acidic/oxidizer slurries, immediately flush with copious running water for minimum 15 minutes. For HF exposure, flush with water for 2 minutes and immediately massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected skin until medical personnel arrive. In case of eye contact, irrigate with eyewash solution for 20 minutes with eyelids held wide open. Seek immediate emergency medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous acid exhaust ventilation on CMP platen enclosures and post-CMP cleaner stations with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); automated differential pressure interlocking shut-off on exhaust drop below 0.35 m/s.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated heavy metal and slurry drainage line. Tungsten and iron-containing CMP slurry effluents must pass through secondary flocculation/precipitation tanks, followed by continuous automated acid-base neutralization (pH adjusted to 6.5 - 8.5) and particulate filtration prior to municipal sewer discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Stabilized Semiconductor Grade)** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI C9 Tier 3 (UPW) | `30.0% w/w` |
| **Ferric Nitrate Nonahydrate (Alternative Oxidizer)** | `7782-61-8` | VLSI / SEMI Grade | `2.0% - 5.0% w/v` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (Post-CMP Cleaner)** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI C7 Tier 2 | `28.0% - 30.0% w/w` |
| **Dilute Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade 0.5% | `0.5% w/w` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited CVD Tungsten film (350-450 nm) with 20 nm Ti/TiN adhesion liner, specular metallic appearance, root-mean-square roughness Rq < 18 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Planarized dielectric surface with flush/co-planar W plugs, zero visible metal film residue, hydrophilic post-megasonic oxide termination with contact angle < 10 degrees.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Galvanic corrosion at the bimetallic W-TiN boundary accelerated by atmospheric moisture and trace post-polish acidic residues, creating severe plug voids, high contact resistance, and cell retention failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete removal of tungsten overburden and underlying Ti/TiN barrier layer across 200mm wafers, providing an ultra-planarized dielectric surface with plug coring under 12 nm, zero metallic bridging defects, and total contact resistance meeting the 180nm DRAM 8F^2 cell access specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TC_CMP_W_REMOVAL_AFM_EROSION_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `KLA_SURFSCAN_W_CMP_DEFECT_MAP.pdf`
- [ ] `CROSS_SECTION_TEM_W_PLUG_INTERFACE.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum tungsten plug recess (coring) inside memory cell contact array** | `8.0 nm` | +/- 4.0 nm | In-line tapping-mode AFM 9-point array measurement |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual titanium/tungsten metallic trace bridge count post-CMP cleaning** | `0 bridges` | +0 bridges | KLA automated darkfield defect inspection and SEM review |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Storage node contact chain resistance (10,000 contact Kelvin chain)** | `4.5 Ohm/contact` | <= 1.2 Ohm/contact | Automated parametric wafer probing at 25°C |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Complete clearance of barrier metal across full wafer (sheet resistance > 1.0E+8 Ohm/sq), 9-point AFM recess confirmed <= 12 nm, zero metallic micro-bridging defects, and signed off by both Lead Planarization Engineer and DRAM Integration Lead.
