### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP TEOS/HDP oxide surface, megasonic cleaned and spin-rinse dried, free of organic slurry surfactant films and residual abrasive silica nanoparticles.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Optically characterized, particle-free, dry planar ILD dielectric surface with validated remaining thickness profile, stored under continuous dry N2 purge FOUP ready for barrier/seed deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time causes airborne organic amine and hydrocarbon contamination, surface silanol bond hydration, and moisture uptake in micro-scratched ILD oxide, distorting optical index models and promoting subsequent M1 barrier adhesion delamination and tungsten via high-resistance opens.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full optical calibration and 49-point spatial dielectric loss profiling completed for post-W/TiN CMP 180nm wafers, establishing baseline ILD removal uniformity, verifying remaining inter-metal dielectric thickness within integration tolerance, and ensuring complete barrier clearance verification prior to metallization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `ILD_LOSS_49PT_POLAR_MAP_LOT2201.csv`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Remaining post-CMP ILD oxide thickness across central die regions** | `450.0 nm` | +/- 15.0 nm | Spectroscopic ellipsometry 49-point wafer mapping on dedicated scribe line unpatterned test pads (70x70 um) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Across-wafer dielectric loss non-uniformity (WIWNU)** | `3.50%` | <= 4.80% | Calculation from polar 49-point delta-thickness array: ((Max_loss - Min_loss) / (2 * Mean_loss)) * 100 |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 wafer map points exhibit Levenberg-Marquardt regression MSE < 2.50, mean remaining ILD thickness satisfies 450.0 +/- 15.0 nm with WIWNU <= 4.80%, optical calibration drift remains under 0.05 nm across the operational run, and data files are fully committed to the fab yield and SPC database.

Measurement cycle time must not exceed 90 seconds per wafer for a 49-point radial map, maintaining a lot throughput rate of at least 20 wafers per hour. Exceeding metrology budget delays lot movement past the permissible 120-minute Q-time window, triggering expensive solvent re-cleans and re-qualification cycles.
critical_failure_modes: Slurry residue embedding and nanoscale surface micro-roughness induce strong optical depolarization, causing regression non-convergence in the Levenberg-Marquardt fitting algorithm and generating catastrophic false ILD erosion thickness readouts.

Beam positioning misalignment on macro test pads (under 50x50 um) causes the oblique incident beam (70-75 deg angle of incidence) to illuminate adjacent tungsten plug arrays, inducing anomalous metallic absorption extinction (k > 0) within a nominal dielectric layer.

Moisture absorption and silanol (Si-OH) group formation on freshly planarized TEOS surfaces during prolonged ambient air exposure shifts Delta angle values, resulting in apparent film swelling and masking up to 8 nm of actual dielectric over-polish loss.

testcases.title: NIST-Traceable Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Angle Calibration and Wavelength Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Rotating Compensator Ellipsometer, 193 nm - 1000 nm spectral range, auto-goniometer +/- 0.01 deg, micro-spot optical objective 30x30 um) and certified NIST-traceable 100.0 nm SiO2/Si calibration standard wafer.
testcases.pre_conditions: Ellipsometer light source stabilized for >= 60 minutes; cleanroom class 100 ambient temperature controlled at 21.0 +/- 0.5 deg C, relative humidity at 40 +/- 3%; certified calibration wafer inspected for zero particle contamination (defects < 0.1 um = 0).
testcases.procedure: 1. Load NIST-traceable 100.0 nm SiO2/Si reference standard onto vacuum chuck. 2. Perform automated optical beam alignment and tilt optimization to achieve detector signal intensity > 85% across 250-800 nm spectrum. 3. Acquire Psi and Delta spectra at angles of incidence (AOI) 65.0 deg, 70.0 deg, and 75.0 deg over the wavelength range 240 nm to 850 nm. 4. Execute regression fit against standard SiO2 dispersion library using Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm. 5. Record extracted film thickness, refractive index at 632.8 nm, mean squared error (MSE), and repeatability across 10 static consecutive cycles.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Refractive index n(632.8 nm) = 1.4570 +/- 0.0015; Absolute extracted thickness = 100.00 +/- 0.15 nm; Goodness-of-fit Mean Squared Error (MSE) < 1.50; 10-cycle static measurement standard deviation (1-sigma) < 0.03 nm.

testcases.title: Post-W/TiN CMP 49-Point Polar ILD Oxide Loss and Radial Non-Uniformity Mapping
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Production Spectroscopic Ellipsometer equipped with recipe-driven pattern recognition alignment, 30 um micro-spot optics, and 200 mm automated FOUP/SMIF wafer handling robot.
testcases.pre_conditions: Production 200 mm DRAM test vehicle wafer processed through multi-step W bulk polish, selective TiN barrier polish, double-sided brush scrubber, and megasonic dry clean; pre-CMP incoming ILD thickness wafer map loaded into station data buffer; recipe programmed with 49-point polar coordinate map (3 mm edge exclusion).
testcases.procedure: 1. Transfer wafer via automated robotic arm to ellipsometer chuck and engage backside vacuum. 2. Execute optical pattern recognition alignment using die-corner fiducials to position micro-spot within 70x70 um unpatterned ILD test pads. 3. Acquire spectroscopic polarization data (Psi, Delta) from 250 nm to 800 nm at AOI = 70.0 deg across all 49 map sites. 4. Model optical stack as Si substrate / ILD SiO2 (Cauchy model: A_n = 1.455, B_n = 0.0035 um^2) / EMA Roughness Layer (1.5 nm nominal, 50% void). 5. Subtract post-CMP thickness map from pre-CMP thickness map to compute delta-thickness (ILD loss) across center, middle, and edge zones. 6. Calculate Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU % = (Max - Min) / (2 * Mean) * 100).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Regression MSE < 2.50 across all 49 sites; Total post-CMP ILD dielectric loss across wafer center and middle sites = 45.0 nm +/- 6.0 nm; Edge zone (radius > 90 mm) ILD loss delta <= 12.0 nm compared to center; Overall Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) <= 4.80%.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom-certified nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol)
UV-absorbing Class 3B laser/broadband safety glasses certified for 190 nm - 450 nm optical radiation
Static-dissipative cleanroom gown, hood, facemask, and conductive ESD booties
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Skin exposure to IPA: Flush affected skin area with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. Eye exposure to IPA or high-intensity optical radiation: Rinse eyes immediately at certified eye-wash station for >= 15 minutes, holding eyelids apart; seek prompt medical evaluation. Inhalation of nitrogen purge displacement atmosphere: Move victim immediately to fresh air; if breathing is labored, administer oxygen; initiate CPR if pulse/respiration ceases.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Tool exhaust connection to cleanroom solvent/VOC dedicated duct maintaining minimum exhaust velocity of 35 standard cubic feet per minute (SCFM) and static pressure differential of -0.25 to -0.50 in. w.g.; chamber nitrogen enclosure equipped with continuous low-oxygen ambient monitor with audible/visual alarm thresholds set at 19.5% O2.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: IPA-soaked optical cleaning swabs and wipes must be sealed in airtight, antistatic hazardous waste receptacles and routed to segregated flammable solvent disposal. Tool nitrogen purge effluent is discharged directly through certified facility scrubbed exhaust.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic post-CMP TEOS/HDP oxide surface, megasonic cleaned and spin-rinse dried, free of organic slurry surfactant films and residual abrasive silica nanoparticles.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Optically characterized, particle-free, dry planar ILD dielectric surface with validated remaining thickness profile, stored under continuous dry N2 purge FOUP ready for barrier/seed deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding ambient air queue time causes airborne organic amine and hydrocarbon contamination, surface silanol bond hydration, and moisture uptake in micro-scratched ILD oxide, distorting optical index models and promoting subsequent M1 barrier adhesion delamination and tungsten via high-resistance opens.

expected_result.summary: Full optical calibration and 49-point spatial dielectric loss profiling completed for post-W/TiN CMP 180nm wafers, establishing baseline ILD removal uniformity, verifying remaining inter-metal dielectric thickness within integration tolerance, and ensuring complete barrier clearance verification prior to metallization.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: NIST calibration standard film thickness extraction accuracy
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Multi-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry regression fit against calibrated Cauchy model at 65, 70, and 75 degrees AOI

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Remaining post-CMP ILD oxide thickness across central die regions
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Spectroscopic ellipsometry 49-point wafer mapping on dedicated scribe line unpatterned test pads (70x70 um)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Across-wafer dielectric loss non-uniformity (WIWNU)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Resolution AFM Profilometry for Tungsten Plug Dishing and Erosion

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-AFM-0180-WPLUG`  
**Process Level:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip / Metrology  
**Target Structure:** Tungsten (W) Contact / Drain Plug over Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm (Gen 3 nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│   Wafer Load, Vacuum Chuck & Thermal Soak    │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Pattern Alignment & Die Site Selection (49- │
│                    Point)                    │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│   Tapping-Mode High-Res AFM Profilometry     │
│                     Scan                     │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│ 1D/2D Topographic Trace: Dishing & Array     │
│              Erosion Extraction              │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Operational Procedure

#### Step 1: Wafer Loading & Environment Stabilization
1. Transfer post-CMP wafer to the automated AFM metrology station enclosure.
2. Clamp wafer securely onto the electrostatic/vacuum chuck under Class 1 laminar airflow.
3. Allow thermal stabilization for $\ge 120\text{ s}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ to mitigate thermal drift below $0.05\text{ nm/s}$.

#### Step 2: Optical Co-Site Navigation & Pattern Alignment
1. Engage high-magnification optical alignment camera to locate DRAM array test dies across an automated **49-point wafer map** tracking radial planarization non-uniformity across the wafer.
2. Align scanning coordinates precisely to the memory cell matrix containing:
   - Access transistor active region: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Shared bitline contacts and stacked capacitor drain contact tungsten plugs (W-plugs) erected beneath crown/MIM capacitor landing sites.

#### Step 3: Probe Tip Selection & Tapping-Mode AFM Scan Execution
1. Load a high-aspect-ratio silicon AFM probe tip (nominal tip radius $\le 5\text{ nm}$, cantilever resonant frequency $\approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
2. Engage probe in **Tapping Mode** (intermittent contact) to prevent shear scratching and metal smearing of the soft polished tungsten plug surface.
3. Set scan parameters:
   - Field of View (FOV): $5.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 5.0\,\mu\text{m}$ (encompassing dense W-plug arrays and adjacent field ILD oxide).
   - Scan Resolution: $512 \times 512$ data points (lateral step size $\approx 9.77\text{ nm/pixel}$).
   - Scan Rate: $0.5\text{ Hz}$ to $1.0\text{ Hz}$.

#### Step 4: Topographic Data Extraction & Metrology Quantification
1. Apply 1st-order polynomial line-leveling across surrounding field ILD oxide reference planes.
2. Extract cross-sectional profiles through isolated and array W-plugs:
   - **Isolated Plug Dishing ($\Delta h_\text{dish}$):** Measure step-height difference from adjacent unpolished ILD oxide flat surface to the lowest recessed nadir of the $180\text{ nm}$ tungsten plug core.
   - **Array Oxide Erosion ($\Delta h_\text{erode}$):** Measure ILD dielectric height loss in dense $8F^2 / 6F^2$ plug arrays relative to isolated field oxide.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Target / Threshold | Measurement Method / Tool | Pass / Fail Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isolated W-Plug Dishing** | Recess depth $\le 15.0\text{ nm}$ | High-Resolution AFM 1D line profile across plug center | **Pass:** $\le 15.0\text{ nm}$; **Fail:** $> 15.0\text{ nm}$ (risk of open capacitor contact) |
| **Array Oxide Erosion** | ILD oxide loss $\le 20.0\text{ nm}$ | AFM step height relative to field oxide reference | **Pass:** $\le 20.0\text{ nm}$; **Fail:** $> 20.0\text{ nm}$ (excessive dielectric thinning) |
| **Measurement Vertical Precision** | Repeatability $1\sigma \le 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\le \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) | Dynamic repeat profiling on static calibration standard | **Pass:** $1\sigma \le 0.05\text{ nm}$ |
| **Wafer Spatial Coverage** | Automated 49-point wafer mapping | Multi-site recipe tracking across center, mid-radius, and edge | **Pass:** Full 49/49 sites scanned and quantified |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations

- **[Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Validates unit cell layout dimensions: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms physical topology of tungsten plug (W-plug) connection erected above the drain contact to interface with stacked crown/MIM capacitors.
- **[Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  - Validates multi-site inspection protocol utilizing automated **49-point wafer mapping** to evaluate cross-wafer planarization and film non-uniformity.
  - Establishes baseline high-precision vertical resolution criteria ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: AFM measurement throughput in automated inline fabs is inherently slow (<2 sites/minute for high-density tapping scans). Integrating AFM profilometry directly downstream of TiN barrier clear CMP without site-specific pattern-recognition fiducials risks becoming the overall fab cycle-time bottleneck. Scan coordinate recipes must link dynamically to GDSII contact/via density layouts to capture worst-case dense-array erosion (e.g. 50% density DRAM cell arrays) versus isolated plug dishing (e.g. peripheral decoders) with adaptive stepping.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node dimensions, contact plug diameter is nominally 240-280 nm with aspect ratios >= 3. Using conventional tapping mode AFM tips with nominal tip radius >10 nm and cone angles >= 20 degrees introduces severe tip-convolution artifacts, underestimating true plug dishing depth and failing to resolve plug-to-ILD seam recesses. Ultra-sharp silicon tips (tip radius <2 nm, aspect ratio >10:1) with non-contact or true non-destructive peak-force tapping mode are mandatory to prevent tip dulling, tungsten pull-out, or native oxide alteration during profiling.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal silicon AFM cantilevers with high-aspect-ratio diamond-like carbon (DLC) or ultrasharp tetrahedral silicon tips suffer from short operational lifetimes (<40 production wafer scans per cantilever due to wear and contamination). Sourcing specialized metrology probes requires qualified dual-vendor contracts and automated tip-characterization test-grid protocols to prevent unexpected inline yield stalls caused by tip bluntness.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM profilometry must deliver quantitative dishing and erosion feedback to the CMP module within a 45-minute feedback window to enable closed-loop run-to-run (R2R) polish time and down-force trim. If AFM recipe run-time exceeds 25 minutes per cassette audit wafer, wafer lots must be gated into dry N2 stockers to avoid queue-time expiration prior to Metal 1 barrier deposition.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip wear and convolution artifact leading to false-negative dishing reporting (<10 nm apparent depth when actual dishing exceeds 35 nm), resulting in inter-metal dielectric pooling and Metal 1 shorts.
1. Probe-induced mechanical scratch damage or particle generation across active DRAM bitline contact regions due to excessive cantilever deflection setpoint in contact or intermittent contact modes.
1. Galvanic micro-corrosion accelerated during AFM staging under ambient humidity, where tungsten plugs recessed below SiO2/TiN interfaces undergo local oxidation (WO3 growth), distorting physical step-height metrology.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-2-2-3-2-01` | **Isolated Tungsten Plug Dishing Step-Height and Seam Profilometry** | Automated 200mm In-line Metrology AFM (Bruker Dimension FastScan or equivalent) equipped with high-aspect-ratio silicon cantilevers (tip radius <= 2 nm, resonance frequency 300 kHz, spring constant 40 N/m) and acoustic isolation enclosure. | 1. Align wafer notch and load recipe with automated pattern recognition targeting isolated contact vias (nominal CD 250 nm, pitch 2.5 um) at 9 standard radial sites (center, mid-radius 4-point, edge exclusion 3 mm 4-point). 2. Execute high-resolution non-contact/tapping mode scan over a 2.0 um x 2.0 um scan field at 512 x 512 pixels, scan rate 1.0 Hz, integral gain optimized to minimize trace-retrace error (<0.2 nm). 3. Extract 1D cross-sectional topography line profiles across the center of 5 consecutive isolated tungsten plugs per site. 4. Calculate plug dishing depth defined as the vertical offset (Delta Z) between the mean planar ILD oxide baseline and the lowest point of the tungsten plug core. 5. Log mean dishing, maximum dishing, and tungsten core roughness (Rq). | `Isolated tungsten plug dishing must satisfy: Mean dishing depth between 5.0 nm and 20.0 nm; maximum dishing across all 9 sites <= 28.0 nm; plug-to-ILD recess step height 3-sigma across wafer <= 6.0 nm. Any scan showing dishing > 30.0 nm or tip-convolution distortion (trace-retrace delta > 0.8 nm) is a FAIL.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-2-2-3-2-02` | **Dense DRAM Bitline Contact Array Oxide Erosion and Array Step Profilometry** | Automated Fab In-line Atomic Force Profiler (AFP) / AFM with calibrated XYZ closed-loop capacitive sensors and automated long-range profilometry capability. | 1. Navigate automated stage to dense DRAM bitline contact array blocks (contact CD 240 nm, pitch 480 nm, 50% pattern density) adjacent to wide unpatterned ILD field oxide regions at center, 50% radius, and 95% radius dies. 2. Execute a 20.0 um x 5.0 um profile scan across the dense array-to-field boundary, perpendicular to array edges, scan resolution 1024 x 256 pixels, scan rate 0.5 Hz. 3. Apply first-order line leveling to the wide field oxide reference plane outside the array. 4. Determine oxide erosion as the step-height difference between the reference unpatterned field oxide plane and the mean ILD level within the dense contact array core. 5. Concurrently extract intra-array peak-to-valley plug dishing amplitude across 20 consecutive contacts. | `Array oxide erosion must be <= 35.0 nm across all tested dies; total array step-height variation across wafer diameter <= 12.0 nm; dense array tungsten plug dishing must remain between 8.0 nm and 22.0 nm. Any site showing oxide erosion > 40.0 nm or catastrophic oxide rip-out is a FAIL.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Full cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood, ESD boots, and conductive wrist strap for sample handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with IPA: Flush affected area immediately with clean flowing water or eye wash for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move individual to fresh air. If irritation or dizziness persists, seek immediate medical attention. In case of cryogenic or compressed gas line leak (N2), evacuate the area to prevent asphyxiation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM acoustic/environmental enclosure must maintain local laminar HEPA filtration with an integrated exhaust purge port venting to general fab volatile solvent exhaust at a minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and cleaning swabs must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-resistant solvent waste cans and disposed of as regulated hazardous organic chemical waste according to local environmental regulations. Spent silicon cantilevers must be disposed of in designated sharp bio/solid contaminated containers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for manual chuck/tip cleaning** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `>= 99.8%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2) for pneumatic stage and purge** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, Grade 6.0) | `>= 99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP polished surface, fully cleared of bulk tungsten and TiN liner overburden, scrubbed free of colloidal silica slurry particulates, rinsed with megasonic UPW, and dried with zero visible watermark residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pristine, non-scratched, particle-free planar surface with characterized tungsten plug topology, ready for pre-metal degas, PVD Ti/TiN barrier liner deposition, and Metal 1 aluminum/copper metallization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure to ambient cleanroom air promotes galvanic oxidation between the electronegative tungsten plug and adjacent TiN/ILD barrier, inducing porous tungsten trioxide (WO3) nodule growth, volumetric expansion, moisture uptake, and localized micro-corrosion that degrades Metal 1 contact resistance (Rc) and causes contact open failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical verification and quantitative mapping of isolated tungsten plug dishing and dense DRAM array oxide erosion post-CMP on 180nm MPW test vehicle. The package confirms ILD integrity and planarity within strict tolerance boundaries without inducing surface damage or exceeding inline queue times, qualifying the wafer lot for immediate Metal 1 metallization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_Plug_CMP_Dishing_Erosion_9pt_Map.csv`
- [ ] `AFM_HighRes_3D_Topography_Contact_Array.tiff`
- [ ] `CMP_Planarization_Metrology_Signoff_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean isolated tungsten plug dishing depth across all qualified wafer sample locations** | `12.0 nm` | +/- 6.0 nm | Non-contact high-aspect-ratio AFM 1D cross-sectional step-height profiling averaged across 9 dies. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Dense DRAM bitline contact array oxide erosion relative to adjacent field dielectric** | `20.0 nm` | <= 15.0 nm (Upper limit: 35.0 nm) | Long-range 20 um AFM scan line-leveling against unpatterned field oxide. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-AFM measurement surface scratch and particulate adder density** | `0 adders` | <= 2 adders >= 0.18 um per 200mm wafer | Automated dark-field laser scattering surface defect inspection post-AFM unload. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 audit dies satisfy dishing depth <= 28.0 nm and dense array erosion <= 35.0 nm with zero probe-induced tip-crash gouges; calibration check on reference pitch standard verifies cantilever tip radius < 3.0 nm prior to and post run; all quantitative metrology data logged to fab SPC system with Cpk >= 1.33, followed by QA engineering sign-off in the MES within the 30-minute air queue-time window.

In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move individual to fresh air. If irritation or dizziness persists, seek immediate medical attention. In case of cryogenic or compressed gas line leak (N2), evacuate the area to prevent asphyxiation.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: AFM acoustic/environmental enclosure must maintain local laminar HEPA filtration with an integrated exhaust purge port venting to general fab volatile solvent exhaust at a minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Used IPA wipes and cleaning swabs must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-resistant solvent waste cans and disposed of as regulated hazardous organic chemical waste according to local environmental regulations. Spent silicon cantilevers must be disposed of in designated sharp bio/solid contaminated containers.

q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Excessive exposure to ambient cleanroom air promotes galvanic oxidation between the electronegative tungsten plug and adjacent TiN/ILD barrier, inducing porous tungsten trioxide (WO3) nodule growth, volumetric expansion, moisture uptake, and localized micro-corrosion that degrades Metal 1 contact resistance (Rc) and causes contact open failures.

The package confirms ILD integrity and planarity within strict tolerance boundaries without inducing surface damage or exceeding inline queue times, qualifying the wafer lot for immediate Metal 1 metallization.

quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Long-range 20 um AFM scan line-leveling against unpatterned field oxide.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Post-AFM measurement surface scratch and particulate adder density
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated dark-field laser scattering surface defect inspection post-AFM unload.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## SOP-MET-180-WPLUG-008: Brightfield Optical Defect Scanning and Post-CMP Particle Review

### Process Flow Diagram
```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Post-CMP Wafer      │
│  Cassette Unloading   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Automated Alignment  │
│  & Brightfield Scan   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ Die-to-Die Threshold  │
│   & Defect Binning    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ High-Mag Defect Review│
│ (Slurry / W Bridging) │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ Lot Disposition       │
│ & Acceptance Gate     │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP establishes the automated brightfield optical defect inspection and defect review protocol following Tungsten (W) plug chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) and selective TiN/dielectric endpoint clearance on 180nm DRAM architectures. The objective is to identify residual metallic tungsten stringers, micro-scratches, slurry residue, and particle defects that threaten DRAM storage node contact isolation across the bitline and wordline grid.

---

### 2. Physical Equipment & Configuration
- **Inspection System**: Automated patterned wafer brightfield optical defect inspection system equipped with broad-band DUV/visible illumination and automated TDI (Time Delay and Integration) image sensors.
- **Review Station**: High-resolution optical/semiconductor review station with automated defect coordinate transfer.
- **Substrate**: 200 mm p-type Si wafers with 180nm DRAM cell arrays (8F² / 6F² folded bitline layout, unit cell channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Wafer Loading & Recipe Selection
1. Transfer post-CMP cleaned and dried wafer lot from the cleanroom FOUP/cassette to the inspection load port.
2. Select inspection recipe: `180NM_DRAM_W_CMP_BF_PITCH360`.
3. Verify coordinate alignment targets using cell array alignment marks; align wafer notch to $0^\circ \pm 0.05^\circ$.

#### Step 2: Brightfield Optical Scan Calibration & Polarization Setup
1. Configure illumination mode to Brightfield Normal Incidence with broad-band optical illumination.
2. Optimize optical polarization angle to maximize optical contrast between polished planar ILD oxide dielectric and reflective recessed tungsten contacts (W-plugs).
3. Set scan pixel resolution to $0.10\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($100\text{ nm}$) to resolve critical bridge defects across the $360\text{ nm}$–$400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline array pitch.

#### Step 3: Full-Die & Array Die-to-Die Scanning
1. Initiate high-speed raster scan across all active die, excluding a $3.0\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion zone.
2. Apply die-to-die (D2D) and cell-to-cell (repeating memory cell) optical image subtraction algorithms:
   - Identify intensity gradient discrepancies exceeding baseline grey-level threshold (> 3.5 $\sigma$ array noise).
   - Log $X, Y$ coordinates, defect patch intensity, and bounding box area into the Klarf defect map.

#### Step 4: Automated Defect Binning & Coordinate Review
1. Classify detected anomalies into defect bins:
   - **Bin 10 (Critical Metallic Bridge)**: Reflective tungsten streaks bridging adjacent contact plugs across the $360\text{ nm}$ pitch.
   - **Bin 20 (Residual Slurry Particles)**: Spherical or clustered dielectric/abrasive particles ($\ge 0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
   - **Bin 30 (Micro-Scratches / Chattering)**: Linear polishing gouges across ILD oxide.
   - **Bin 40 (Plug Dishing / Pull-out)**: Missing plug void or severe local dishing.
2. Sample top 50 Pareto defects per wafer for automated high-magnification ($100\times$, NA $\ge 0.9$) optical review and capture defect review images.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target | Measurement Method | Reference Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Max Residual Particle Size** | $< 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) across cell array | Brightfield Optical Defect Scan (D2D / C2C algorithm) | Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ |
| **Metallic W-Bridging Defect Density** | $0.00\text{ defects/cm}^2$ (Zero bridge defects along $360\text{ nm}$–$400\text{ nm}$ pitch) | Brightfield Optical Scan & Defect Binning (Bin 10) | Bitline and wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) |
| **Total Killer Defect Density ($D_0$)** | $\le 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ | Full-wafer Klarf defect map ($3.0\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion) | 180nm DRAM 1T1C array yield standards |
| **Sub-surface Residual Dielectric Loss Non-Uniformity** | $\le \pm 2\text{ nm}$ radial variation | 49-point automated wafer map correlation | Ellipsometry/Reflectometry mapping ($\pm 2\text{ nm}$ film precision) |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry defines access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, with shared bitline contact and stacked capacitor connected via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Defines automated 49-point wafer mapping and precision benchmarks ($\pm 2\text{ nm}$) for tracking film thickness and dielectric uniformity post-processing.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Establishes 1-Transistor 1-Capacitor (1T1C) architecture with $8F^2 / 6F^2$ layout and bitline/wordline pitch of approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-2-2-3-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-2-2-3-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Brightfield Optical Defect Scanning and Post-CMP Particle Review: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-CMP-MET-038`
### Title: Post-CMP Plug Recess Metrology and Dielectric Erosion AFM Inspection
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs > Tungsten (W) Plug Overburden CMP and Selective Endpoint Clearing > Multi-Step W Bulk Polish and Selective TiN/Dielectric Endpoint Clearance > Post-CMP Plug Recess Metrology and Dielectric Erosion AFM Inspection  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│   Pre-Scan Alignment   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Automated AFM      │
│  Surface Profilometry  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │    │                        │
│  Array W-Plug Recess   │    │  Field Oxide Erosion   │
│    Depth Extraction    │    │  & Dishing Metrology   │
│                        │    │                        │
└───────────┬────────────┘    └────────────┬───────────┘
            │                              │
            │ ╭────────────────────────────╯
            ▼ ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Statistical Process   │
│  Control & Pass/Fail   │
│      Disposition       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Preparation & Probe Tip Qualification**:
   - Initialize automated In-line Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) with high-aspect-ratio silicon tip (nominal tip radius $\le 5\text{ nm}$, cantilever spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$, resonant frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
   - Run tip qualification against a certified step-height grating standard; verify tip apex dilation $< 2\text{ nm}$ prior to production scan.
2. **Wafer Alignment & Target Navigation**:
   - Transfer wafer from post-CMP spin-rinse-dry (SRD) clean station under Class 1 laminar flow.
   - Align global pattern fiducials and navigate to:
     - **Location A (Dense Cell Array)**: Stacked capacitor contact W-plugs over access transistor drain (channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, cell array layout $8F^2 / 6F^2$, pitch $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
     - **Location B (Isolated Array/Periphery Boundary)**: Dense array-to-field dielectric interface to assess macro-erosion.
3. **High-Resolution Surface Topography Scan**:
   - Acquire non-contact / tapping-mode topographic scans:
     - Scan window: $5.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 5.0\,\mu\text{m}$ (dense memory array) and $20.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 20.0\,\mu\text{m}$ (array boundary).
     - Pixel density: $512 \times 512$ points at a scan rate of $0.5\text{ Hz}$.
4. **Plug Recess & Dielectric Erosion Extraction**:
   - Perform automated plane leveling (1st-order flattening) referencing the non-eroded bulk inter-layer dielectric (ILD) oxide plane.
   - Extract cross-sectional depth profiles through the center of tungsten plugs connecting to the drain contact / bitline contact nodes.
   - Calculate tungsten plug recess depth: $\Delta Z_{\text{recess}} = Z_{\text{dielectric\_surface}} - Z_{\text{W\_plug\_center}}$.
   - Calculate oxide dielectric erosion across dense plug arrays relative to isolated field oxide.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                    Post-CMP Metrology Control Limits   
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░                                    │
 Surface Rq (nm)┤░░                                    │
Max Erosion (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒            │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒            │
 Max Recess (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0      3.8       7.5     11.2    15.0 
```

| Parameter | Measurement Target / Limit | Engineering Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Plug Recess ($\Delta Z_{\text{recess}}$)** | **$\le 15.0\text{ nm}$** (Target: $5.0 \pm 3.0\text{ nm}$) | Prevents open/high-resistance contact to the crown-shaped storage node or bitline contact ($L=180\text{ nm}, W=220\text{ nm}$). |
| **Array Dielectric Oxide Erosion** | **$\le 10.0\text{ nm}$** | Preserves ILD thickness budget above access transistor gates and prevents dielectric thinning over 360–400 nm pitch wordlines. |
| **Post-CMP Surface Roughness ($R_q$ / RMS)** | **$\le 0.40\text{ nm}$** | Ensures defect-free planar interface for subsequent stacked capacitor dielectric deposition (ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, EOT $3-4\text{ nm}$). |
| **Plug Protrusion / Residual Overburden** | **$0.0\text{ nm}$ (Negative tolerance: none)** | Complete removal of TiN liner and bulk tungsten overburden to prevent inter-plug bridging shorts across the $360-400\text{ nm}$ pitch array. |

---

### 3. Citations & Literature Context Integration

- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Cell architecture is based on $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline layouts with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
  - Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and shared bitline contacts define the contact pitch and active area constraints.
  - Contact connection integrity via W-plug directly underpins the stacked capacitor structure (target capacitance $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack, keeping leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - Validates bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, critical for AFM scan line density and step-profiling resolution across the array.
  - Supports the strict surface planarization requirement necessary prior to deposited high-$\kappa$ capacitor dielectrics with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-CMP AFM metrology of tungsten plug recess and ILD erosion directly bounds contact resistance variability across the 180nm 8F^2 memory array. If AFM line scans fail to sample edge-die versus center-die dishing, unmodeled step height variations will propagate directly into stacked capacitor landing lithography, causing depth-of-focus defocus and marginal MIM bottom-electrode contact area.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node dimensions (contact diameter ~220 nm, aspect ratio ~3.5:1), tungsten coring and plug recess must be constrained within 10 nm to 25 nm below the ILD plane. Over-recess (>35 nm) creates seam voiding and inadequate liner coverage during subsequent barrier metal deposition, whereas under-polishing leaves residual TiN/W bridging shorts between adjacent bitline/storage node contacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying ultra-sharp high-aspect-ratio diamond-like carbon (DLC) coated AFM tips creates an operational bottleneck under Buy/commercial MPW conditions. Tip apex degradation after scanning abrasive post-CMP residue requires dedicated tip qualification protocols and secondary validation via spectroscopic ellipsometry or cross-sectional CD-SEM to avoid tool downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM scanning is notoriously throughput-limited (~3 to 5 wafers per hour for multi-site inspection). For MPW runs, we must enforce a strict 9-point macro-array sampling plan focused on cell array dense contact fields versus peripheral isolated test structures, ensuring metrology cycle time fits within the 4-hour post-clean Q-time envelope.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe tungsten plug recess (>35 nm) causing open-circuit failure or excessive contact resistance (>40 Ohm/contact) at the capacitor node contact interface.
1. Inter-layer dielectric (ILD) field erosion exceeding 20 nm leading to bitline/wordline dielectric breakdown and lithographic depth-of-focus margin loss during subsequent capacitor patterning.
1. Tip convolution and tip apex rounding artifacts yielding false-negative plug recess measurements and undetected planarization bridging shorts.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-2-3-01` | **Dense Array Tungsten Plug Recess Depth and Coring Profile via Tapping-Mode AFM** | Automated In-Line Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with high-aspect-ratio silicon cantilevers (tip radius < 5 nm, aspect ratio > 5:1, nominal resonance ~300 kHz) | 1. Load wafer onto cleanroom AFM chuck with automated pattern recognition to locate dense cell array contact fields (8F^2 contact pitch = 360 nm). 2. Calibrate tip height and scan a 2.0 um x 2.0 um area at 512 x 512 lines resolution with a scan rate of 0.5 Hz in non-contact/tapping mode. 3. Extract perpendicular cross-sectional topographic line profiles across at least 10 consecutive tungsten plugs per site across a 9-point radial map. 4. Calculate mean plug recess depth relative to adjacent planar ILD oxide field and assess plug center coring depth. | `Mean tungsten plug recess depth across all 9 points must be 18.0 nm ± 6.0 nm (acceptable range: 12.0 nm to 24.0 nm); plug center coring depth must not exceed 8.0 nm; 3-sigma within-wafer recess non-uniformity must be <= 12%.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-2-3-02` | **Oxide Field Erosion and Micro-Dishing Assessment via Large-Area AFM Profilometry** | In-line Atomic Force Profiler (AFP) / Long-Scan AFM with automated step-height analysis software and Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE) cross-check | 1. Navigate stage to boundary region between dense contact array (50% pattern density) and open peripheral field oxide (>95% oxide density). 2. Perform a 50 um x 10 um long-scan topographic profile across the density transition boundary at 0.25 Hz. 3. Apply baseline tilt leveling to peripheral field oxide and quantify dielectric field step height drop (ILD erosion) and within-array oxide loss. 4. Correlate erosion step height with absolute oxide film thickness measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry at 3 adjacent reference pads. | `Total dielectric field erosion at the dense array boundary must be <= 15.0 nm; within-array oxide dishing must be <= 10.0 nm; optical SE verification must confirm remaining ILD thickness over active region >= 450.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser safety splash goggles, Static-dissipative cleanroom bunny suit and conductive booties, Chemical-resistant apron and face shield during solvent swab decontamination of AFM sample stage
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA solvent, wash immediately with copious DI water for 15 minutes. For eye splash, rinse at dedicated eye wash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open and seek medical evaluation. Class 2/3R laser diode exposure: immediately power down optical head and seek ophthalmological examination.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM metrology enclosure maintained under certified laminar flow hood with HEPA filtration (0.1 um cut-off) and localized solvent mini-exhaust delivering >= 100 linear feet per minute face velocity for chuck maintenance.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent cleaning wipes and IPA swabs disposed of in certified flammable solvent solid waste bins; liquid solvent rinses segregated into solvent carboy waste streams for dedicated incineration; no drain disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 4 | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DIW)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type 1 (>18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, brush-scrubbed and megasonic-cleaned TEOS/W surface, dried via Marangoni/spin dryer, verified free of slurry particulates and moisture stains.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Particulate-free, validated planarized surface with verified 15-20 nm plug recess, immediately transferred in purged FOUP to post-CMP pre-clean/barrier metal sputter deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time triggers native oxide growth (WOx) and atmospheric airborne molecular contamination (boron/amine condensation) inside recessed plugs, degrading contact adhesion and spiking contact resistance > 100 Ohm.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full metrological characterization and statistical process control signoff of post-W-CMP plug recess depth, plug coring, and ILD dielectric erosion across dense 8F^2 cell arrays and peripheral regions on 180nm DRAM test wafers, proving compliance for stacked capacitor bottom-electrode integration.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_Plug_Recess_AFM_9pt_Map_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Dense_Array_Oxide_Erosion_Profilometry_Data.csv`
- [ ] `HighRes_Plug_Recess_3D_Topography_RawScan.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean tungsten plug recess depth across dense contact arrays** | `18.0 nm` | ± 4.0 nm | 512-line tapping-mode AFM cross-sectional extraction averaged over 9 wafer test dies |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total inter-layer dielectric (ILD) boundary erosion between array and open field** | `12.0 nm` | <= 15.0 nm maximum | 50 um AFM step-height profiling cross-verified with spectroscopic reflectometry |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of sampled 9-point sites satisfy plug recess within 12.0 nm to 22.0 nm with zero detected surface tungsten bridge shorts, ILD erosion <= 15.0 nm, and total cleanroom inspection completed within the 30-minute ambient Q-time budget.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Post-CMP Plug Recess Profilometry and Residual Metal Defect Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-CMP metrology for 180nm tungsten contact and via plugs must accurately isolate plug recess (dishing/erosion) from field ILD oxide loss to avoid cascading integration failures. If W plug recess exceeds 30 nm, downstream Ti/TiN barrier and Al-Cu Metal 1 deposition will suffer severe step coverage thinning, micro-voiding, and catastrophic contact resistance degradation across dense memory array borders compared to isolated periphery contacts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: High-aspect-ratio AFM profilers and broadband brightfield/darkfield defect inspection systems must be tuned specifically to detect residual tungsten nano-puddles, micro-scratches, and galvanic 'keyhole' plug coring. In Gen 3 (180nm node), incomplete clearing of the Ti/TiN liner creates residual metallic bridging strings across inter-plug spaces (pitch ~500 nm), triggering inter-bitline or contact-to-gate leakage paths exceeding the 10 pA per node limit.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology consumables—specifically ultra-sharp high-aspect-ratio diamond-like carbon (DLC) coated AFM tips and post-CMP clean chemical consumables (surfactant-enriched citric acid / NH4OH)—exhibit lead times exceeding 12 weeks. Premature tip apex wear or tip-radius degradation during automated 49-point wafer profiling leads to false-positive recess readings and unbudgeted tool downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Balancing sampling frequency against line throughput is critical: 100% wafer inspection with high-resolution AFM is non-viable for pilot runs. Profilometry and darkfield defect inspection must adhere strictly to a 5-wafer-per-lot pilot gating scheme (49-point optical review + 9-site AFM cross-check), keeping total metrology cycle time under 25 minutes per cassette to prevent violating the tight post-CMP clean Q-time window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Excessive W plug coring/dishing (>35 nm) causing open circuits or intolerable Rc spikes (>15 Ohms/contact) after Metal 1 barrier deposition.
1. Residual Ti/W metallic filament shorting between adjacent dense contact plugs due to incomplete polish clearing or poor end-point detection.
1. Post-CMP slurry abrasive (silica/alumina) residue retention causing dielectric breakdown and lithography focus distortion during subsequent Metal 1 exposure.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-01` | **Automated AFM Profilometry of W Plug Recess and Array Erosion** | Atomic Force Profiler (AFP) / In-line CD-AFM with calibrated high-aspect-ratio silicon tips (tip radius < 10 nm, aspect ratio > 10:1) | 1. Load wafer onto electrostatic chuck with notch oriented at 0 degrees. 2. Align automated optical pattern recognition system to target 180nm dense contact array test structures (pitch 500 nm, plug CD 220 nm) and isolated test plugs across 9 standard radial monitoring sites. 3. Acquire 2.0 um x 2.0 um AFM topographical scans in non-contact/tapping mode at 0.5 Hz scan rate and 512 x 512 resolution. 4. Extract cross-sectional surface profile profiles intersecting 10 consecutive plugs per site. 5. Measure maximum plug depth relative to the surrounding ILD planar plane (plug recess/dishing) and ILD plane loss across dense arrays relative to isolated field oxide (oxide erosion). | `Tungsten plug recess depth across all 9 inspection sites must be 15 nm ± 5 nm (absolute upper limit <= 25 nm); dense array oxide erosion must be <= 20 nm; isolated plug dishing must not exceed 20 nm.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-02` | **Laser Darkfield/Brightfield Inspection for Residual Metal Bridging and Slurry Defects** | Broadband Laser-based Patterned Wafer Defect Inspection System (e.g., KLA-Tencor 28xx series or equivalent broadband darkfield/brightfield platform) | 1. Perform full-surface wafer inspection using broadband UV darkfield illumination in high-sensitivity metal-residue mode. 2. Scan entire 200mm wafer surface for anomalous light scattering signals indicating residual metallic films, bridging flakes, micro-scratches, and slurry clusters. 3. Sort defect coordinate map into defect bins using automatic defect classification (ADC). 4. Re-measure the top 50 highest-urgency defect locations using integrated high-magnification review optics and automated SEM review (SEM-EDX) to verify elemental presence of W, Ti, or Si/Al slurry abrasive. | `Total killer defect count (W residual bridging, micro-scratches > 1 um length, or metallic shorts) must be 0 per wafer; total allowable random defect density for particles > 90 nm must be <= 0.05 defects/cm2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, minimum 8 mil thickness), Chemical-splash safety goggles with ANSI Z87.1 certification, Full-face splash shield during chemical transfer or bath maintenance, Acid/alkali-resistant Tyvek apron and polypropylene sleeves, Cleanroom-grade ESD-safe protective footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin Exposure: Immediately flush affected skin with copious amounts of flowing deionized water for at least 15 minutes; remove contaminated cleanroom garments. Eye Exposure: Flush eyes at the nearest eyewash station for a minimum of 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open; seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation. Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Never induce vomiting in an unconscious individual; rinse mouth with copious water and obtain emergency medical assistance immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid/corrosive localized exhaust ventilation (LEV) on metrology wet clean handling stations maintaining a capture face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) ± 10%; in-line VOC/chemical air scrubbing tied to wet-bench scrubber ducts; continuous laminar downflow Class 1 cleanroom filtration (0.1 um ULPA).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Post-CMP cleaning effluents containing dilute ammonium hydroxide and citric acid must be routed to the Dedicated Acid/Base Neutralization (AWN) system. Effluent is automatically neutralized via automated dosing of 10% H2SO4 or 10% NaOH to maintain pH within 6.5 to 8.5 before biological discharge. W-containing particulate slurry rinse water must pass through a specialized metal precipitate settling and microfiltration stage before final drainage.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Citric Acid Anhydrous (Post-CMP Clean / Chelating Agent)** | `77-92-9` | VLSI / SEMI Grade C8 | `1.0 - 2.0 wt%` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (Brush Scrub Cleaning Solution)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic / SEMI Grade 1 | `0.5 - 1.5 wt%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Residual CMP Slurry Oxidizer Remnants)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic / SEMI Grade 1 | `< 0.5 wt% residual` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed and dried hydrophilic planarized surface post-W CMP with fully cleaved tungsten overburden, exposed Ti/TiN contact liners, and planarized TEOS/BPSG ILD oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-cleared, residue-free, passivated metallic tungsten plug surface with intact native oxide layer (< 1 nm), zero chemical contamination, and dry nitrogen environment.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time causes severe galvanic corrosion between the tungsten plug and surrounding Ti/TiN barrier layer, driving accelerated plug pitting ('volcano' corrosion), moisture-induced uncontrolled tungsten trioxide (WO3) growth, and irreversible airborne organic contamination that severely degrades contact resistance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical verification and metrological clearance of post-W CMP 180nm contact plugs, certifying plug recess within structural tolerances, total clearing of overburden metal films across dense array boundaries, and complete absence of bridging defects prior to PVD Ti/TiN/Al-Cu Metal 1 deposition.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_CMP_PLUG_RECESS_49PT_AFM_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `POST_CMP_DEFECT_PARETO_AND_DENSITY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `HIGH_RES_CORING_AND_RESIDUAL_DEFECT_SEM_GALLERY.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Tungsten plug recess depth in dense memory array contacts relative to adjacent ILD oxide plane** | `15.0 nm` | ±5.0 nm (Upper Spec Limit <= 25.0 nm) | Automated CD-AFM cross-sectional depth profiling across 9 radial wafer sites (10 plugs sampled per site) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Killer defect density (residual W/Ti bridging strings, micro-scratches, and metallic flakes > 180nm)** | `0.00 defects/cm2` | 0 killer defects detected across 100% active die area (3.0 mm edge exclusion) | Full-wafer broadband laser darkfield inspection correlated with automated review SEM-EDX |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) field oxide erosion across dense contact arrays relative to isolated field** | `12.0 nm` | ±6.0 nm (Upper Spec Limit <= 20.0 nm) | Spectroscopic ellipsometry and profilometry differential step-height analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Lot-level metrology sign-off requires 100% fulfillment of ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03 on all sampled pilot wafers, complete zero-defect verification for metallic bridging on the inspection wafer map, and signed electronic QA authorization confirming transfer to Metal 1 PVD within the prescribed 4-hour N2 storage window.

Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Never induce vomiting in an unconscious individual; rinse mouth with copious water and obtain emergency medical assistance immediately.

quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated CD-AFM cross-sectional depth profiling across 9 radial wafer sites (10 plugs sampled per site)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Killer defect density (residual W/Ti bridging strings, micro-scratches, and metallic flakes > 180nm)
quantitative_assertions.tolerance: 0 killer defects detected across 100% active die area (3.0 mm edge exclusion)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) field oxide erosion across dense contact arrays relative to isolated field

# Standard Operating Procedure: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) Plug Recess and Dishing Profilometry

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: AFM scanning is notoriously throughput-limited compared to optical scatterometry or broad-beam profilometers; integrating inline AFM for plug recess and dishing across a 200mm/300mm wafer requires strict sampling strategies (e.g., 9-site fixed die indexing) to prevent metrology starvation and severe tool queue bottlenecks ahead of Metal-1 barrier deposition.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, tungsten contact and via plugs typically have an aspect ratio of 3:1 to 4:1 with nominal diameters of ~220-250nm. AFM cantilever tip geometry is the primary artifact generator: high-aspect-ratio (HAR) diamond-like carbon or silicon tips with cone angles <10° and nominal tip radii <5nm are mandatory to trace the true bottom of a 20-50nm recessed W-plug without edge-clipping or aspect-ratio convolution artifacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specialized ultra-sharp AFM probes (HAR-NC tips) experience rapid wear and breakage on abrasive CMP surfaces containing residual colloidal silica or alumina slurry particles, leading to substantial consumables expense and probe replenishment lead times of 8 to 12 weeks from single-source precision silicon micromachining vendors.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The balance between scan resolution (high pixel density needed for accurate sub-nanometer step-height extraction) and recipe execution time must stay strictly under 18 minutes per wafer for a 9-site inspection run; exceeding this time window invalidates downstream Metal-1 queue time targets.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip dilation/convolution artifact falsely under-reporting tungsten plug recess depth due to premature cantilever tip apex blunting or chipping
1. Piezo scanner thermal/creep drift causing quadratic baseline bow that obscures dielectric erosion and array dishing across dense contact fields
1. Sample-tip electrostatic pull-in or surface contamination adhesion causing false-positive metal residue peaks or destructive cantilever snap-down

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-01` | **Dense DRAM Array Tungsten Plug Recess and Micro-Dishing Metrology** | Automated Fab Cleanroom AFM (Tapping/Non-Contact Mode, High-Aspect-Ratio Silicon Tip radius < 5 nm, piezoresistive Z-actuator with closed-loop optical deflection) | 1. Load 200mm test wafer onto active vibration-isolation AFM stage. 2. Align pattern recognition to dense array contact test structure (250nm contact pitch, 1:1 line/space ratio). 3. Engage HAR-AFM tip in non-contact tapping mode at resonance frequency 300 kHz (free amplitude 15 nm, 80% setpoint). 4. Execute 2.0 um x 2.0 um scan at 512 x 512 pixels with scan rate 0.5 Hz across 9 standard lithography fields (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right, 4 Corners). 5. Apply first-order line leveling to reference adjacent ILD (TEOS/SiN) plane and extract cross-sectional step profiles across 10 consecutive tungsten plugs per site. | `Average Tungsten plug recess depth must fall within 25.0 nm ± 7.0 nm (no plug exceeding 35.0 nm recess); contact array dielectric dishing must be <= 12.0 nm across all 9 measured sites.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-02` | **Isolated Contact Tungsten Residual Overburden and Erosion Verification** | High-Resolution Automated In-line AFM coupled with secondary electron verification or tip-sample impedance sensing | 1. Move stage coordinates to isolated contact pads (nominal 250nm plug isolated by >= 2 um oxide field). 2. Acquire 5.0 um x 5.0 um topography image (512 x 512 lines) at 0.75 Hz scan speed. 3. Perform plane-fit correction excluding plug features. 4. Run automated threshold segmentation algorithm to detect any positive topographical protrusion (residual metallic W islands) above the surrounding ILD reference plane. 5. Measure maximum peak height relative to field oxide. | `Zero residual tungsten protrusions detected above ILD datum (maximum acceptable peak height <= 1.0 nm above oxide plane); isolated plug recess between 15.0 nm and 30.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile Gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/Laser Safety Eyewear (filtered for AFM 670nm diode beam), Static-dissipative ESD-safe cleanroom coat and footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious low-pressure laminar DI water for at least 15 minutes. Skin contact: Wash affected region with mild neutral soap and water. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move victim immediately to fresh air; provide artificial respiration if breathing ceases. Accidental laser beam exposure: Cover eyes with sterile non-adherent pad and seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM acoustic/thermal isolation enclosure equipped with dedicated local laminar flow HEPA unit (0.45 m/s face velocity) maintaining Class 1 cleanroom environment; solvent vapor mini-exhaust port rated at >= 25 CFM during chuck maintenance cleans.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Wetted wipes with electronic-grade IPA collected into grounded, airtight hazardous solvent waste bins; spent AFM cantilevers disposed of in certified sharps container for silicon micro-debris.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for stage/chuck maintenance** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Grade 1) | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purified/Compressed)** | `7727-37-9` | UHP Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, brush-cleaned, dry post-W CMP surface with thin native oxide passivation and zero macroscopic slurry residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, non-destructive AFM scanned wafer surface free from mechanical tip-scratch defects, ready for immediate transfer to Metal-1 degas and Ti/TiN barrier sputter deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding allowable air queue time causes rapid uncontrolled native tungsten oxide (WOx) and atmospheric carbon contamination build-up inside plug recesses, increasing plug contact resistance (Rc) by >40% and risking catastrophic adhesion failure/delamination of the subsequent TiN/Ti/Al-Cu metallization stack.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full nine-site automated AFM profilometry baseline establishing tungsten plug recess, array dishing, and post-CMP metal clearing across the 180nm open-source DRAM contact mask layer, meeting stringent physical specifications prior to Metal-1 metallization.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_CMP_AFM_Plug_Recess_9Site_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Post_CMP_Array_Dishing_Profilometry_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `HighRes_AFM_Topography_Contact_Array.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean tungsten plug recess depth across array test structures** | `25.0 nm` | ± 5.0 nm | 512x512 HAR-AFM profile height analysis extracted across 9 die locations |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum contact array field dielectric dishing/erosion** | `8.0 nm` | <= 12.0 nm | Second-order step line subtraction comparing dense array baseline against adjacent wide oxide boundary |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Residual tungsten overburden island occurrence** | `0 islands` | 0 per 5x5 um field (>1nm height) | Automated AFM peak-threshold topology defect classification |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 9 wafer measurement sites demonstrate mean tungsten plug recess within 20.0-30.0 nm, field dishing <= 12.0 nm, zero residual W islands, and complete AFM inspection artifact logging uploaded to the PDK metrology database within the 45-minute post-clean Q-time window.
