# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## AFM Calibration and High-Aspect-Ratio Tip Selection for W-Plug Metrology

### 1. Process & Metrology Architecture Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Inspect HAR Probe    │
│          Tip           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Calibrate XY and Z   │
│       Piezo PZT        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Align Laser onto    │
│       Cantilever       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Scan W-Plug Array on  │
│    360-400nm Pitch     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Extract Plug Recess   │
│   & Dishing Profile    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) Tip Qualification & Selection**:
   - Select an ultra-sharp, tilted High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) probe specifically engineered for sub-200nm contact holes (aspect ratio $\ge 10:1$, apex radius $r \le 10\text{ nm}$, cone half-angle $\le 3^\circ$, spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$, resonant frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
   - Inspect probe integrity via SEM or tip-reconstruction characterization standard (whisker/tip-check grating). Discard tips exceeding $15\text{ nm}$ tip apex wear.

2. **Optical Head Alignment & Deflection Calibration**:
   - Mount cantilever into AFM fluid/ambient holder. Align $670\text{ nm}$ diode laser beam spot onto the backside gold-coated reflex pad of the cantilever.
   - Adjust position-sensitive 4-quadrant photodiode to balance photodetector sum signal ($V_{\text{sum}} \ge 6.0\text{ V}$) and null horizontal/vertical differential voltages to $0.00\text{ V} \pm 0.05\text{ V}$.

3. **Scanner Piezo (XYZ) Multi-Axis Calibration**:
   - Load certified traceable silicon calibration grating (certified $20.0\text{ nm} \pm 0.3\text{ nm}$ Z-step height and lateral $100.0\text{ nm}$ 2D pitch).
   - Engage in Tapping / Non-Contact mode at oscillation amplitude $A_0 = 20\text{ nm}$ with setpoint ratio $A_{\text{sp}}/A_0 = 0.85$.
   - Execute closed-loop piezo calibration at scan rate $0.5\text{ Hz}$ across a $2.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ field. Correct Z-piezo sensitivity and XY non-linearity/orthogonality.

4. **180nm DRAM Cell Tungsten (W) Plug Array Metrology**:
   - Transfer wafer post-W-CMP to vibration-isolated AFM stage under class 1 mini-environment.
   - Position probe over memory cell array targeting W-plug drain contacts connected to the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $= 360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Run fine raster scan ($512 \times 512$ data points across $1.5\,\mu\text{m} \times 1.5\,\mu\text{m}$, scan rate $0.3\text{ to } 0.5\text{ Hz}$, slow axis orthogonal to bitline pitch).

5. **Profile Extraction & Defect Analysis**:
   - Apply 1st-order line flatten and plane-fit to eliminate sample tilt.
   - Extract cross-sectional profiles through W-plug centers: evaluate W-plug recess relative to surrounding Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) oxide plane and detect seam hollows or oxide dishing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                    AFM Metrology Metric Thresholds     
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░                                       │
  Z-Scale Step┤░                                       │
              │▒▒                                      │
XY Scale Calib┤▒▒                                      │
Tip Wear Limit┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
  Recess Depth┤████████████████████████████████████████│
              │████████████████████████████████████████│
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0       8.8      17.5     26.2     35.0 
```

1. **W-Plug Post-CMP Recess Depth**: Recess depth relative to adjacent ILD oxide field must be **$\le 35.0\text{ nm}$** (nominal $15.0\text{ nm} - 25.0\text{ nm}$) across the $180\text{ nm}$ contact diameter.
2. **AFM Z-Axis Step Calibration Residual Error**: Certified step height deviation **$\le 0.3\text{ nm}$** against the $20.0\text{ nm}$ certified step standard.
3. **Lateral (XY) Scale Linearity**: Grid pitch scanning measurement residual error **$\le 0.5\%$** across the $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline array pitch.
4. **Tip Apex Radius Wear Threshold**: Effective tip radius after scan sequence **$\le 15.0\text{ nm}$** (initial specification $\le 10.0\text{ nm}$).

---

### 4. Sources Cited
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; drain contact connects to stacked capacitor via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$; stacked capacitor cell contact design rules.

---
> [!NOTE]
> Micro-knowledge for this SOP has been recorded in [afm_wplug_calibration.md](./docs/knowledge/afm_wplug_calibration.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: AFM profilometry integration into the 180nm W-CMP feedback loop requires strict decoupling of tip-sample convolution artifacts from genuine plug recess. For 180nm contact/via plugs with diameter ~0.22 um and recess depths of 10-40 nm, standard conical silicon tips (half-cone angle > 18 deg, tip radius ~10 nm) fail to accurately profile the bottom sidewall transition, leading to an artificially shallow recess reading. Furthermore, tool throughput must be balanced: 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping at 0.5 Hz line scan rates introduces prohibitive wafer-dwell latency in the inline metrology bay, directly colliding with post-CMP scrub and clean queue times.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) AFM tips (aspect ratio >= 10:1, tilt-compensated FIB-milled silicon or diamond-like carbon spikes with shank diameter < 50 nm) are mandatory to prevent premature sidewall touching in contact vias. Cantilever stiffness must be calibrated via thermal noise or Sader method to maintain contact force below 5 nN in tapping/non-contact mode, preventing plastic deformation or gouging of the softened post-CMP tungsten plug surface while avoiding tip apex chipping on hard surrounding inter-layer dielectric (ILD TEOS/SiON). Calibration standards must employ certified 1D/2D pitch and step-height silicon gratings with traceable sub-Angstrom uncertainty.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: HAR diamond-coated and focused ion beam (FIB)-machined AFM probes have single-vendor dependencies and lead times extending to 12-16 weeks with high per-unit replacement costs ($150-$300/probe). Given that HAR tips undergo rapid wear or catastrophic fracture within 40-60 scan hours under automated wafer handling, a dual-sourcing procurement agreement with secondary suppliers (e.g., Olympus/Bruker/NanoWorld equivalents) and a localized safety stock buffer of at least 50 pre-characterized cantilever assemblies are required to maintain foundry inline operation.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Procurement and qualification of HAR AFM probes directly determine the readiness of the post-CMP module signoff. Qualification must complete within 2 weeks of probe batch receipt, requiring clear gate criteria: tip apex radius verification < 12 nm, resonance frequency stability within 5% across 200 consecutive scans, and Gauge R&R < 1.0% matching the fab-wide metrology variance ceiling. Probe qualification delays will stall the W-plug overburden clearing signoff, halting the downstream M1 metallization sequence.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex fracture or premature rounding from excessive contact force during engagement, causing severe tip-convolution dilation and underestimating W-plug recess depth by > 35%
1. Cantilever tilt misalignment relative to deep contact via sidewalls, resulting in asymmetric shadowing and false ILD dishing artifacts during scan direction reversal
1. Piezo scanner non-linearity and thermal creep over extended wafer profiling, shifting the calibrated Z-height zero baseline by > 3 nm across an automated 9-point run

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

critics.systems_engineer: AFM profilometry integration into the 180nm W-CMP feedback loop requires strict decoupling of tip-sample convolution artifacts from genuine plug recess. For 180nm contact/via plugs with diameter ~0.22 um and recess depths of 10-40 nm, standard conical silicon tips (half-cone angle > 18 deg, tip radius ~10 nm) fail to accurately profile the bottom sidewall transition, leading to an artificially shallow recess reading. Furthermore, tool throughput must be balanced: 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping at 0.5 Hz line scan rates introduces prohibitive wafer-dwell latency in the inline metrology bay, directly colliding with post-CMP scrub and clean queue times.
critics.domain_expert: High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) AFM tips (aspect ratio >= 10:1, tilt-compensated FIB-milled silicon or diamond-like carbon spikes with shank diameter < 50 nm) are mandatory to prevent premature sidewall touching in contact vias. Cantilever stiffness must be calibrated via thermal noise or Sader method to maintain contact force below 5 nN in tapping/non-contact mode, preventing plastic deformation or gouging of the softened post-CMP tungsten plug surface while avoiding tip apex chipping on hard surrounding inter-layer dielectric (ILD TEOS/SiON). Calibration standards must employ certified 1D/2D pitch and step-height silicon gratings with traceable sub-Angstrom uncertainty.
critics.supply_chain: HAR diamond-coated and focused ion beam (FIB)-machined AFM probes have single-vendor dependencies and lead times extending to 12-16 weeks with high per-unit replacement costs ($150-$300/probe). Given that HAR tips undergo rapid wear or catastrophic fracture within 40-60 scan hours under automated wafer handling, a dual-sourcing procurement agreement with secondary suppliers (e.g., Olympus/Bruker/NanoWorld equivalents) and a localized safety stock buffer of at least 50 pre-characterized cantilever assemblies are required to maintain foundry inline operation.
critics.laya_pm: Procurement and qualification of HAR AFM probes directly determine the readiness of the post-CMP module signoff. Qualification must complete within 2 weeks of probe batch receipt, requiring clear gate criteria: tip apex radius verification < 12 nm, resonance frequency stability within 5% across 200 consecutive scans, and Gauge R&R < 1.0% matching the fab-wide metrology variance ceiling. Probe qualification delays will stall the W-plug overburden clearing signoff, halting the downstream M1 metallization sequence.
critical_failure_modes: Tip apex fracture or premature rounding from excessive contact force during engagement, causing severe tip-convolution dilation and underestimating W-plug recess depth by > 35%
Cantilever tilt misalignment relative to deep contact via sidewalls, resulting in asymmetric shadowing and false ILD dishing artifacts during scan direction reversal
Piezo scanner non-linearity and thermal creep over extended wafer profiling, shifting the calibrated Z-height zero baseline by > 3 nm across an automated 9-point run

# Standard Operating Procedure: Tapping-Mode AFM Scan Across Dense Array Bitline and Node Contact W-Plugs

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dense array tungsten (W) contact plugs for 180nm DRAM (pitch ~360-400nm, plug diameter ~180-220nm) introduce severe local topography variations post-CMP. Excessive plug recess (>25 nm) creates catastrophic aspect-ratio dependent step-coverage failure during subsequent barrier/bitline metallization (PVD/CVD TiN/Al-Cu deposition), leading to open contact vias or elevated contact resistance (Rc > 15 Ohm/via). Conversely, under-polishing leaves residual W-stringers on ILD-1 that short adjacent bitlines and storage node contacts. Tapping-mode AFM must provide absolute z-height profiling with sub-nanometer accuracy across array boundary regions where pattern-density transitions exacerbate micro-dishing and erosion.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In tapping mode (intermittent contact), tip convolution effects significantly distort steep contact hole sidewalls and recess depth measurements. Using standard silicon tips (tip radius 8-10 nm, cone half-angle >15 deg) in a 200 nm diameter plug recessed by 20-30 nm prevents the apex from reaching the true W-plug bottom, under-reporting recess depth by up to 40%. High-aspect-ratio (HAR) diamond-like carbon (DLC) or single-crystal silicon tips with cone angles <5 deg and tip radii <2 nm are mandatory. Drive frequency must be tuned slightly below cantilever free resonance (typically f0 ~ 300 kHz, Q ~ 400 in air) with setpoint amplitude ratio (Asp/A0) maintained between 0.75 and 0.85 to avoid engaging in the destructive net-attractive/net-repulsive bistable transition regime over inhomogeneous W vs. SiO2 material interfaces.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: HAR AFM probes (e.g., Bruker HPI-type or Olympus high-aspect cantilevers) suffer rapid tip wear and catastrophic apex chipping when scanning transition edges of abrasive-polished surfaces, resulting in tip replacement intervals of less than 3-5 full-field wafer scans. Single-source dependencies on Japanese or European AFM probe micromachining vendors present substantial supply continuity risks for high-volume 180nm MPW runs. Second-source qualification of coated DLC probes and automated tip-qualification grating scans must be integrated into the pilot-line operation SOP.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM metrology represents an operational throughput bottleneck; high-resolution tapping scans (512x512 pixels at 0.5-1.0 Hz line rate over 5 um x 5 um dense array fields) require 8-12 minutes per measurement site. Implementing full 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping on every post-CMP lot creates unacceptable line pacing delays and threatens CMP-to-clean Q-time limits. AFM must be gated to a 5-point statistical sampling protocol (Center, North, South, East, West) coupled to fast optical reflectometry/ellipsometry screening to maintain line takt time under 45 minutes per wafer boat.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex fracture or degradation during array boundary traversal leading to artificial topographic blunting and false-negative pass on plug recess depth.
1. Phase-bistability jumping between attractive and repulsive regimes over metal-dielectric boundaries causing feedback oscillation, ringing artifacts, and corrupted surface roughness (Rq) metrics.
1. Post-CMP slurry abrasive residue (nanocolloidal silica/alumina) agglomeration on plug recesses causing false topographic spike artifacts and misclassification of plug dishing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-01` | **Machine-Measurable Plug Recess Profilometry across Dense Array W-Plugs** | Automated 200mm Wafer Cleanroom Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) equipped with High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) Silicon Tip (cone half-angle <5 deg, tip radius <= 2.0 nm, resonance frequency ~300 kHz, spring constant ~40 N/m) and Optical Beam Deflection (OBD) laser feedback. | 1. Move stage to coordinate for Array Bitline Contact (BLC) site at Wafer Center. 2. Auto-align laser on cantilever apex and tune drive frequency to f = f0 - 200 Hz with free vibration amplitude A0 = 20 nm. 3. Engage tip with setpoint ratio Asp/A0 = 0.80. 4. Acquire 5 um x 5 um scan window at 512 x 512 pixel resolution and 0.5 Hz scan rate (tip velocity 5.0 um/s) oriented orthogonal to bitline run direction. 5. Apply first-order line flatten and plane fit across surrounding ILD-1 reference plateau. 6. Extract depth profile across 20 consecutive W-plugs and calculate mean recess depth (d_recess) relative to ILD-1 oxide plane. 7. Repeat for 4 peripheral die locations (North, South, East, West at 10 mm edge exclusion). | `Target plug recess depth must satisfy 8.0 nm <= mean d_recess <= 18.0 nm across all 5 measured array sites, with standard deviation 1-sigma <= 2.5 nm. No single plug recess shall exceed 25.0 nm (bitline open contact limit) or be elevated above ILD-1 surface plane (recess < 0 nm, residual tungsten protrusion defect).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-02` | **Field Oxide Erosion and Micro-Dishing Metrology at Array-to-Periphery Boundary** | Automated Fab Tapping-Mode AFM with Large-Range Decoupled Piezo XY Scanner (>=50 um travel) and Sub-Angstrom Z-Sensor Resolution. | 1. Position probe over the boundary transition zone between the high-density memory cell array (50% pattern density) and low-density periphery test structure (0% pattern density). 2. Acquire a 20 um x 5 um tapping-mode topographic scan (1024 x 256 pixels, scan rate 0.3 Hz, fast axis spanning across boundary). 3. Apply baseline tilt subtraction using the periphery unpatterned field oxide as reference level (Z = 0 nm). 4. Calculate total oxide erosion (Z_ref - Z_array_ILD) and micro-dishing of the outermost tungsten contact lines. 5. Compute root-mean-square roughness (Rq) of the planarized ILD-1 oxide surface between plug gaps. | `Total array oxide erosion must be <= 35.0 nm relative to the periphery field oxide. Dielectric inter-plug surface roughness Rq must be <= 0.35 nm. Maximum edge-plug micro-dishing must not exceed 20.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN ISO 374-1), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser safety splash goggles (attenuation for 670 nm / 850 nm AFM diode lasers), Full electrostatic discharge (ESD) cleanroom coverall gown with conductive footwear, Class 100 HEPA-filtered cleanroom face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Immediately flush eyes at cleanroom emergency eye wash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move victim to clean air environment immediately; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. Skin exposure: Remove contaminated cleanroom gloves and rinse skin with copious DI water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tapping AFM must be operated inside a temperature-controlled acoustic enclosure equipped with active laminar clean air flow exhausting at 0.5 m/s. Dedicated chemical solvent exhaust ducting required at sample prep and IPA cleaning station (minimum 100 CFM face velocity).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA lint-free wipes and contaminated consumable swabs must be disposed of in designated sealed, flame-resistant hazardous waste bins under local volatile organic compound (VOC) abatement exhaust. No chemical drain dumping permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI/ULSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DIW)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type E-1.1 Microelectronics Grade | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP polished surface, passivation monolayer intact from post-CMP citric acid/ammonia brush scrub, residual slurry abrasive count < 25 particles/wafer, surface moisture fully evaporated via IPA vapor dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry, non-contact contaminated wafer topography map verified; surface native oxide thickness on tungsten plug <= 0.8 nm; zero probe-induced physical scratching or carbonaceous tip deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time (>30 min) causes uncontrolled galvanic corrosion at the W/TiN/oxide junction, accelerated room-ambient oxidation forming thick non-stoichiometric WO3 (>2.5 nm) which causes contact resistance spikes, and airborne organic volatile molecular contamination (VOC) promoting severe tip adhesion artifacts during AFM tracking.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Quantitative 3D topography profile across dense memory array bitline and storage node W-contacts generated via calibrated tapping-mode AFM, establishing verified compliance of tungsten plug recess, array oxide erosion, and dielectric surface roughness prior to barrier metallization deposition.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_PLUG_RECESS_METROLOGY_REPORT_GEN3.pdf`
- [ ] `ARRAY_AFM_TOPOGRAPHY_RAW_DATA_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `CALIBRATED_AFM_HEIGHT_MAP_TIFF_ARRAY_5X5UM.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean tungsten plug recess depth across array bitline contact field** | `13.0 nm` | +/- 4.0 nm | Line cross-section profilometry averaging 20 adjacent contact plugs per die across 5 wafer sites extracted from flattened tapping-mode AFM height channels. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Max array field oxide erosion relative to periphery isolation plane** | `22.0 nm` | <= 35.0 nm maximum limit | 20 um transition boundary step-height extraction from decoupled XY-piezo AFM scan profile. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-CMP ILD-1 inter-plug dielectric root-mean-square roughness (Rq)** | `0.22 nm` | <= 0.35 nm maximum limit | Standard ASME B46.1 2D surface texture calculation over 1 um x 1 um exclusion zones devoid of metal contacts. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 wafer map sampling sites exhibit 100% compliance with ASSERT-01, ASSERT-02, and ASSERT-03; zero detected tungsten residual bridging defects across contact spaces; Q-time from scrub unload to metrology signoff documented <= 30 minutes in MES; principal metrology researcher and integration lead digital signatures logged.

Second-source qualification of coated DLC probes and automated tip-qualification grating scans must be integrated into the pilot-line operation SOP.
critics.laya_pm: AFM metrology represents an operational throughput bottleneck; high-resolution tapping scans (512x512 pixels at 0.5-1.0 Hz line rate over 5 um x 5 um dense array fields) require 8-12 minutes per measurement site. Implementing full 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping on every post-CMP lot creates unacceptable line pacing delays and threatens CMP-to-clean Q-time limits. AFM must be gated to a 5-point statistical sampling protocol (Center, North, South, East, West) coupled to fast optical reflectometry/ellipsometry screening to maintain line takt time under 45 minutes per wafer boat.
critical_failure_modes: Tip apex fracture or degradation during array boundary traversal leading to artificial topographic blunting and false-negative pass on plug recess depth.
Phase-bistability jumping between attractive and repulsive regimes over metal-dielectric boundaries causing feedback oscillation, ringing artifacts, and corrupted surface roughness (Rq) metrics.
Post-CMP slurry abrasive residue (nanocolloidal silica/alumina) agglomeration on plug recesses causing false topographic spike artifacts and misclassification of plug dishing.

testcases.title: Machine-Measurable Plug Recess Profilometry across Dense Array W-Plugs
testcases.instrumentation: Automated 200mm Wafer Cleanroom Tapping-Mode Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) equipped with High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) Silicon Tip (cone half-angle <5 deg, tip radius <= 2.0 nm, resonance frequency ~300 kHz, spring constant ~40 N/m) and Optical Beam Deflection (OBD) laser feedback.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer has completed W-CMP overburden clear, post-CMP PVA brush scrub with megasonic rinse, and isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor drying; particle count <20 adders at >0.15 um; loaded into AFM environmental enclosure under Class 1 laminar flow (22 +/- 0.5 deg C, 45 +/- 3% RH).
testcases.procedure: 1. Move stage to coordinate for Array Bitline Contact (BLC) site at Wafer Center. 2. Auto-align laser on cantilever apex and tune drive frequency to f = f0 - 200 Hz with free vibration amplitude A0 = 20 nm. 3. Engage tip with setpoint ratio Asp/A0 = 0.80. 4. Acquire 5 um x 5 um scan window at 512 x 512 pixel resolution and 0.5 Hz scan rate (tip velocity 5.0 um/s) oriented orthogonal to bitline run direction. 5. Apply first-order line flatten and plane fit across surrounding ILD-1 reference plateau. 6. Extract depth profile across 20 consecutive W-plugs and calculate mean recess depth (d_recess) relative to ILD-1 oxide plane. 7. Repeat for 4 peripheral die locations (North, South, East, West at 10 mm edge exclusion).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Target plug recess depth must satisfy 8.0 nm <= mean d_recess <= 18.0 nm across all 5 measured array sites, with standard deviation 1-sigma <= 2.5 nm. No single plug recess shall exceed 25.0 nm (bitline open contact limit) or be elevated above ILD-1 surface plane (recess < 0 nm, residual tungsten protrusion defect).

testcases.title: Field Oxide Erosion and Micro-Dishing Metrology at Array-to-Periphery Boundary
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Fab Tapping-Mode AFM with Large-Range Decoupled Piezo XY Scanner (>=50 um travel) and Sub-Angstrom Z-Sensor Resolution.
testcases.pre_conditions: AFM scanner lateral/vertical calibration verified within +/-0.5% using certified 100 nm step-height and 3.0 um pitch 2D silicon calibration grating (VLSI Standards).
testcases.procedure: 1. Position probe over the boundary transition zone between the high-density memory cell array (50% pattern density) and low-density periphery test structure (0% pattern density). 2. Acquire a 20 um x 5 um tapping-mode topographic scan (1024 x 256 pixels, scan rate 0.3 Hz, fast axis spanning across boundary). 3. Apply baseline tilt subtraction using the periphery unpatterned field oxide as reference level (Z = 0 nm). 4. Calculate total oxide erosion (Z_ref - Z_array_ILD) and micro-dishing of the outermost tungsten contact lines. 5. Compute root-mean-square roughness (Rq) of the planarized ILD-1 oxide surface between plug gaps.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total array oxide erosion must be <= 35.0 nm relative to the periphery field oxide. Dielectric inter-plug surface roughness Rq must be <= 0.35 nm. Maximum edge-plug micro-dishing must not exceed 20.0 nm.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN ISO 374-1)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser safety splash goggles (attenuation for 670 nm / 850 nm AFM diode lasers)
Full electrostatic discharge (ESD) cleanroom coverall gown with conductive footwear
Class 100 HEPA-filtered cleanroom face mask
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Eye contact with IPA: Immediately flush eyes at cleanroom emergency eye wash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation. Inhalation of solvent vapors: Move victim to clean air environment immediately; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. Skin exposure: Remove contaminated cleanroom gloves and rinse skin with copious DI water.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Tapping AFM must be operated inside a temperature-controlled acoustic enclosure equipped with active laminar clean air flow exhausting at 0.5 m/s. Dedicated chemical solvent exhaust ducting required at sample prep and IPA cleaning station (minimum 100 CFM face velocity).
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: IPA lint-free wipes and contaminated consumable swabs must be disposed of in designated sealed, flame-resistant hazardous waste bins under local volatile organic compound (VOC) abatement exhaust. No chemical drain dumping permitted.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic post-CMP polished surface, passivation monolayer intact from post-CMP citric acid/ammonia brush scrub, residual slurry abrasive count < 25 particles/wafer, surface moisture fully evaporated via IPA vapor dry.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Dry, non-contact contaminated wafer topography map verified; surface native oxide thickness on tungsten plug <= 0.8 nm; zero probe-induced physical scratching or carbonaceous tip deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding air Q-time (>30 min) causes uncontrolled galvanic corrosion at the W/TiN/oxide junction, accelerated room-ambient oxidation forming thick non-stoichiometric WO3 (>2.5 nm) which causes contact resistance spikes, and airborne organic volatile molecular contamination (VOC) promoting severe tip adhesion artifacts during AFM tracking.

expected_result.summary: Quantitative 3D topography profile across dense memory array bitline and storage node W-contacts generated via calibrated tapping-mode AFM, establishing verified compliance of tungsten plug recess, array oxide erosion, and dielectric surface roughness prior to barrier metallization deposition.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean tungsten plug recess depth across array bitline contact field
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Line cross-section profilometry averaging 20 adjacent contact plugs per die across 5 wafer sites extracted from flattened tapping-mode AFM height channels.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Max array field oxide erosion relative to periphery isolation plane
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 20 um transition boundary step-height extraction from decoupled XY-piezo AFM scan profile.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Post-CMP ILD-1 inter-plug dielectric root-mean-square roughness (Rq)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Standard ASME B46.1 2D surface texture calculation over 1 um x 1 um exclusion zones devoid of metal contacts.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 5 wafer map sampling sites exhibit 100% compliance with ASSERT-01, ASSERT-02, and ASSERT-03; zero detected tungsten residual bridging defects across contact spaces; Q-time from scrub unload to metrology signoff documented <= 30 minutes in MES; principal metrology researcher and integration lead digital signatures logged.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Metrology-SOP-W-CMP-AFM-001: COTS High-Aspect-Ratio AFM Tip Selection and Cantilever Resonance Tuning

### 1. Document Context & Traceability
- **Node & Architecture:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN), 1T1C stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), $8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline layout.
- **Upstream Process:** Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Tungsten (W) Plugs and Inter-Layer Dielectrics (ILD).
- **Target Feature:** Dense array bitline contact and storage node contact W-plugs ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
- **Metrology Station:** Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) operating in tapping / intermittent-contact mode for post-CMP plug recess and dishing characterization.

---

### 2. Workflow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Tip Selection: AR   │
│  gte 5:1, Radius lte  │
│         10 nm         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Laser Alignment and  │
│  Photodiode Zeroing   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Resonance Frequency  │
│   Sweep: 250 to 350   │
│          kHz          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Resonance Peak     │
│    Tuning: -500 Hz    │
│        Offset         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Drive Amplitude    │
│  Calibration: 1.0 to  │
│    1.5 V Free RMS     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Quality Factor Q    │
│  Verification: Q gte  │
│          350          │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Physical Context & Metrology Baseline

```text
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░                                   │
Cap Target (fF)┤░░░░                                   │
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
    Cell W (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
    Cell L (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
     Pitch (nm)┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                0        95       190       285     380 
```

---

### 4. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: COTS High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) Probe Selection
1. Inspect the COTS silicon probe wafer gel-box under optical microscope ($50\times$).
2. Select an n-doped single-crystal silicon probe engineered for tapping-mode metrology on dense pitch topography:
   - **Tip Radius of Curvature ($R_{tip}$):** $\le 10\text{ nm}$ nominal (guarantees penetration into $L = 180\text{ nm}$ contacts without sidewall convolution).
   - **Aspect Ratio (AR):** $\ge 5:1$ (tilted tip cone half-angle $< 10^\circ$ over the top $200\text{ nm}$).
   - **Nominal Spring Constant ($k$):** $25\text{ to }48\text{ N/m}$ (tapping mode).
   - **Nominal Natural Resonance Frequency ($f_0$):** $300\text{ kHz}$ (rated range: $270\text{ to }330\text{ kHz}$).
3. Mount the probe chip onto the AFM fluid/air scan head holder using conductive vacuum tweezers. Secure probe clamp screw to $0.05\text{ N}\cdot\text{m}$ torque.

#### Step 2: Optical Laser Alignment & Photodiode Zeroing
1. Position the optical deflection laser spot onto the distal end of the cantilever back-side (Al-coated reflector).
2. Maximize the total sum signal on the position-sensitive four-quadrant photodiode ($V_{\text{sum}} \ge 6.0\text{ V}$).
3. Adjust the horizontal and vertical photodetector mirrors until:
   - **Vertical deflection signal ($A - B$):** $0.00\text{ V} \pm 0.05\text{ V}$.
   - **Lateral deflection signal ($C - D$):** $0.00\text{ V} \pm 0.05\text{ V}$.

#### Step 3: Resonance Frequency Sweep & Thermal Tune
1. Open the AFM frequency auto-tune interface in air at $23.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and relative humidity $40\% \pm 5\%$.
2. Execute a wide piezo-acoustic frequency sweep from $250\text{ kHz}$ to $350\text{ kHz}$ with drive voltage initially set to $50\text{ mV}$.
3. Locate the primary cantilever fundamental flexural oscillation mode peak ($f_0 \approx 290 - 315\text{ kHz}$).

#### Step 4: Drive Amplitude Calibration and Operating Offset
1. Adjust the dither piezo drive amplitude such that the free-air oscillation amplitude ($A_0$) reaches $1.0\text{ V to }1.5\text{ V}$ RMS (equivalent to $\sim 20 - 30\text{ nm}$ peak-to-peak amplitude).
2. Apply a standard tapping-mode phase-stabilization offset: set the operational drive frequency $f_{\text{drive}} = f_0 - 500\text{ Hz}$ (slight downward offset on the left shoulder of the resonance peak to prevent intermittent phase flips between attractive and repulsive regimes during scanning across W-plug recesses).
3. Set the initial scanning setpoint amplitude ratio:
   $$r_{\text{sp}} = \frac{A_{\text{set}}}{A_0} = 0.75 \text{ to } 0.80$$

#### Step 5: Quality Factor ($Q$) and Cleanliness Acceptance
1. Fit the resonance curve using a Lorentzian model to calculate the mechanical Quality Factor:
   $$Q = \frac{f_0}{\Delta f_{-3\text{dB}}}$$
2. Verify that $Q \ge 350$ in ambient cleanroom air (confirming absence of particulate contamination, liquid bridging, or fractured cantilever substrate).

---

### 5. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Resonance Frequency ($f_0$)** | $300.0$ | $\pm 30.0$ ($270.0 - 330.0$) | $\text{kHz}$ | Auto-tune lorentzian peak detection |
| **Mechanical Quality Factor ($Q$)** | $400$ | $\ge 350$ | dimensionless | Full-width half-maximum ($\Delta f_{-3\text{dB}}$) |
| **Free Vibration Amplitude ($A_0$)** | $1.20$ | $\pm 0.20$ ($1.00 - 1.40$) | $\text{V RMS}$ | Photodiode lock-in RMS amplitude |
| **Operating Frequency Offset ($\Delta f$)** | $-500$ | $\pm 50$ ($-450 \text{ to } -550$) | $\text{Hz}$ | Instrument drive frequency synthesizer |

---

### 6. Source Context Citations

1. **Cell Layout & Pitch Constraints:**
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
     "Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells. Stacked Capacitor Topology: Crown-shaped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) structure erected above the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug)."
   - Confirms the physical contact aperture requiring probe aspect ratio $\ge 5:1$ and radius $\le 10\text{ nm}$ to avoid sidewall artifacts.
2. **Dense Array Architecture & Critical Dimensions:**
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
     "A classic 180nm DRAM cell uses a 1-Transistor 1-Capacitor (1T1C) architecture with an 8F^2 or 6F^2 cell layout... Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately 360 nm to 400 nm."  
     Establishes the periodic pitch over which post-CMP dishing and plug recesses occur.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Selecting high-aspect-ratio (HAR) tapping-mode AFM tips for dense array W-plug recess profilometry requires a critical balance between tip apex radius (nominal <= 10 nm) and aspect ratio (>= 5:1 over the first 200 nm). Cantilever stiffness must be properly matched: overly compliant levers (k < 10 N/m) cause capillary snap-in on post-CMP hydrophilic oxide surfaces, while excessively stiff cantilevers (k > 50 N/m) exert high shear forces that induce premature tip apex fracture, distorting true recess depth into false-positive shallow readings.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm DRAM node, contact plug openings are nominally 200 nm to 240 nm with expected CMP recess depths of 15 nm to 45 nm. Standard tetrahedral or pyramidal tips suffer from geometric tip convolution against sidewalls, preventing true bottom tracking. A tilt-compensated, beam-shaped HAR silicon tip (half-cone angle <= 3 degrees) driven at its primary resonance (typically 280 kHz to 330 kHz) in the attractive/intermittent tapping regime (free amplitude ~20 nm, setpoint amplitude ratio ~0.75) is mandatory to accurately track dishing and recess without causing tip ringing or sidewall imaging artifacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: COTS HAR silicon probes (e.g., Olympus AR5-NCHR, Bruker HIRS-SS, or BudgetSensors Tap300DLC) exhibit steep lead times (6 to 12 weeks) and lot-to-lot resonance frequency deviations of up to 15%. Sourcing must establish dual-vendor qualified inventory of pre-aligned wafer-level chips with diamond-like carbon (DLC) wear-resistant coatings, backed by incoming batch inspection of cantilever resonance spectra and apex radii to prevent fab metrology line halts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM metrology throughput is inherently low (< 2 wafers/hour for detailed dense array profiling). Tip wear and resonance drift during unattended recipe execution threaten production cycle times. We require strict tip qualification gates, automated thermal tune drift tracking, and a hard scan-line distance limit per tip (< 250 um total cumulative scan distance) before mandatory automated tip-check calibration on a reference grid.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex fracture or chipping during tracking into high-aspect-ratio contact holes, leading to tip broadening artifacts and systematic underestimation of tungsten recess depth.
1. Capillary snap-in and meniscus entrapment due to residual moisture on post-CMP oxide/W surfaces, causing intermittent damping loss, cantilever instability, and catastrophic tip shearing.
1. Acoustic/thermal resonance frequency drift exceeding the PLL lock-in bandwidth, resulting in loss of feedback control, tip crashes, and irreversible scratching of the 180nm W-plug array.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-1-01` | **COTS HAR Cantilever Resonance Frequency & Q-Factor Thermal Tune Calibration** | Automated Industrial Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with optical beam deflection detector and thermal noise power spectral density analyzer | 1. Position cantilever 2.0 mm above sample surface to eliminate near-surface squeeze-film damping. 2. Acquire thermal noise deflection spectrum from 10 kHz to 500 kHz with 1024-point FFT averaging over 10 seconds. 3. Fit the primary flexural resonance peak using a Simple Harmonic Oscillator (SHO) model to extract resonance frequency (f_0) and quality factor (Q). 4. Drive cantilever piezo-acoustically across a +/- 5 kHz window around f_0 to measure phase response and ensure symmetric Lorentzian line shape. | `Primary resonance frequency f_0 must fall within 280.0 kHz to 340.0 kHz; quality factor Q in air must be >= 450; cantilever spring constant k determined via Sader method must be within 30.0 N/m to 48.0 N/m; phase response must exhibit monotonic 180-degree transition across resonance.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-1-02` | **HAR Tip Apex Profilometry and Aspect Ratio Verification on 180nm Tungsten Plug Test Structure** | Tapping-Mode In-Line Automated Metrology AFM equipped with tilt-compensated piezoceramic scanner and closed-loop Z-linear sensor (noise floor < 0.03 nm RMS) | 1. Engage tip in amplitude-modulation mode with free amplitude A_0 = 18.0 nm and setpoint amplitude A_sp = 13.5 nm (ratio 0.75). 2. Acquire a 2.0 um x 2.0 um scan across 5x5 W-plug array at 0.5 Hz line scan rate (512x512 pixels). 3. Extract cross-sectional profiles through centerlines of 10 consecutive tungsten plugs. 4. Calculate apparent plug bottom depth, sidewall profile slope angle, and repeatability across 5 consecutive scans on the same site. | `Measured plug recess depth must demonstrate 1-sigma repeatability <= 0.35 nm across 5 consecutive scans; extracted sidewall slope angle must be >= 82 degrees indicating full tip penetration without sidewall convolution; tip apex broadening after 5 scans must be < 1.0 nm shift in apparent contact diameter.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, Class 100 compatible), Polycarbonate UV/laser-rated safety glasses (OD4+ at 670nm/850nm cantilever laser wavelength), Electrostatic discharge (ESD) wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Full cleanroom gowning (lint-free suit, hood, boots, and face mask)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA solvent, flush immediately with copious amounts of eye-wash water or clean running water for at least 15 minutes. In case of accidental direct laser eye exposure, remove subject immediately from beam path, cover affected eye, and seek ophthalmological medical attention immediately. No chemical antidote required.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM acoustic/vibration enclosure operated inside Class 10/100 laminar flow cleanroom with dedicated laminar flow down-plenum (0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s face velocity). Solvent prep bench requires local exhaust ventilation (LEV) with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s for IPA cleaning of probe holders.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free swab wipes and cleaning solvent effluents must be segregated into dedicated labeled flammable solvent carboys (Class IB) and transferred to the fab hazardous waste disposal stream. Broken silicon cantilever chip fragments must be collected in puncture-proof sharps containers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 6.0 | `>= 99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP de-ionized water megasonic scrubbed, double-sided PVA brush cleaned, and spin-rinse dried; hydrophilic surface with native oxide thickness < 0.6 nm and zero residual slurry abrasives.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: AFM characterization completed with localized physical tip-contact marks < 0.05 nm depth; surface maintained particulate-free (< 5 particles > 0.15 um adder per wafer) and dry.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure limits causes progressive atmospheric hydrocarbon contamination and native moisture condensation on the tungsten plug and surrounding TEOS/low-k dielectric, producing capillary meniscus forces that destabilize AFM tapping resonance, induce tip-sticking artifacts, and cause systematic measurement errors in recess depth of up to 4 to 8 nm.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> COTS high-aspect-ratio AFM tip selection protocol and automated tapping-mode resonance tuning procedure successfully qualified for 180nm DRAM dense array tungsten plug recess and dishing metrology. Probes reliably resolve plug depths with sub-nanometer vertical repeatability and zero sidewall convolution artifacts across production test wafers.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `HAR_AFM_Cantilever_Tuning_and_QFactor_Calibration_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `W_Plug_Array_180nm_Recess_Dishing_Raw_Profiles.csv`
- [ ] `Pre_Post_Scan_Tip_Apex_Wear_and_Broadening_Topography.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Cantilever fundamental flexural resonance frequency tuning accuracy relative to SHO fitted thermal peak** | `315.0 kHz` | +/- 15.0 kHz | Automated thermal noise power spectral density fitting and lock-in sweep analysis |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Dense array 180nm W-plug recess depth vertical measurement 1-sigma repeatability** | `0.30 nm` | <= 0.35 nm | Multi-site 5-run dynamic repeatability AFM profilometry across 10 discrete contact plugs |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Tip aspect ratio sidewall clearance angle inside 200nm contact opening** | `85.0 deg` | >= 82.0 deg | Deconvoluted slope profile analysis on 180nm contact test structures |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit sign-off requires meeting all 3 quantitative assertions, continuous Q-factor stability (> 450 with drift < 3% over 1 hour), zero tip apex chipping verified via blind reconstruction on an ISO-certified tip characterizer grid, and automated delivery of all three signed calibration and profile data artifacts into the DRAM Foundation VN metrology repository.

testcases.instrumentation: Automated Industrial Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with optical beam deflection detector and thermal noise power spectral density analyzer
testcases.pre_conditions: HAR AFM probe chip mounted in tapping-mode holder under ambient cleanroom environment (22.0 +/- 0.5 deg C, 40 +/- 3% RH); laser spot aligned on cantilever distal end with photodiode sum signal > 4.5 V and differential balance < 0.1 V.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position cantilever 2.0 mm above sample surface to eliminate near-surface squeeze-film damping. 2. Acquire thermal noise deflection spectrum from 10 kHz to 500 kHz with 1024-point FFT averaging over 10 seconds. 3. Fit the primary flexural resonance peak using a Simple Harmonic Oscillator (SHO) model to extract resonance frequency (f_0) and quality factor (Q). 4. Drive cantilever piezo-acoustically across a +/- 5 kHz window around f_0 to measure phase response and ensure symmetric Lorentzian line shape.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Primary resonance frequency f_0 must fall within 280.0 kHz to 340.0 kHz; quality factor Q in air must be >= 450; cantilever spring constant k determined via Sader method must be within 30.0 N/m to 48.0 N/m; phase response must exhibit monotonic 180-degree transition across resonance.

testcases.title: HAR Tip Apex Profilometry and Aspect Ratio Verification on 180nm Tungsten Plug Test Structure
testcases.instrumentation: Tapping-Mode In-Line Automated Metrology AFM equipped with tilt-compensated piezoceramic scanner and closed-loop Z-linear sensor (noise floor < 0.03 nm RMS)
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer loaded with 180nm node test die post-W CMP clearing; cantilever tuned per TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-1-01; target area located at dense array bitline contact test pad (pitch 360 nm, nominal contact diameter 200 nm).
testcases.procedure: 1. Engage tip in amplitude-modulation mode with free amplitude A_0 = 18.0 nm and setpoint amplitude A_sp = 13.5 nm (ratio 0.75). 2. Acquire a 2.0 um x 2.0 um scan across 5x5 W-plug array at 0.5 Hz line scan rate (512x512 pixels). 3. Extract cross-sectional profiles through centerlines of 10 consecutive tungsten plugs. 4. Calculate apparent plug bottom depth, sidewall profile slope angle, and repeatability across 5 consecutive scans on the same site.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Measured plug recess depth must demonstrate 1-sigma repeatability <= 0.35 nm across 5 consecutive scans; extracted sidewall slope angle must be >= 82 degrees indicating full tip penetration without sidewall convolution; tip apex broadening after 5 scans must be < 1.0 nm shift in apparent contact diameter.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, Class 100 compatible)
Polycarbonate UV/laser-rated safety glasses (OD4+ at 670nm/850nm cantilever laser wavelength)
Electrostatic discharge (ESD) wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor
Full cleanroom gowning (lint-free suit, hood, boots, and face mask)
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA solvent, flush immediately with copious amounts of eye-wash water or clean running water for at least 15 minutes. In case of accidental direct laser eye exposure, remove subject immediately from beam path, cover affected eye, and seek ophthalmological medical attention immediately. No chemical antidote required.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: AFM acoustic/vibration enclosure operated inside Class 10/100 laminar flow cleanroom with dedicated laminar flow down-plenum (0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s face velocity). Solvent prep bench requires local exhaust ventilation (LEV) with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s for IPA cleaning of probe holders.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent IPA lint-free swab wipes and cleaning solvent effluents must be segregated into dedicated labeled flammable solvent carboys (Class IB) and transferred to the fab hazardous waste disposal stream. Broken silicon cantilever chip fragments must be collected in puncture-proof sharps containers.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Post-CMP de-ionized water megasonic scrubbed, double-sided PVA brush cleaned, and spin-rinse dried; hydrophilic surface with native oxide thickness < 0.6 nm and zero residual slurry abrasives.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: AFM characterization completed with localized physical tip-contact marks < 0.05 nm depth; surface maintained particulate-free (< 5 particles > 0.15 um adder per wafer) and dry.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding air exposure limits causes progressive atmospheric hydrocarbon contamination and native moisture condensation on the tungsten plug and surrounding TEOS/low-k dielectric, producing capillary meniscus forces that destabilize AFM tapping resonance, induce tip-sticking artifacts, and cause systematic measurement errors in recess depth of up to 4 to 8 nm.

expected_result.summary: COTS high-aspect-ratio AFM tip selection protocol and automated tapping-mode resonance tuning procedure successfully qualified for 180nm DRAM dense array tungsten plug recess and dishing metrology. Probes reliably resolve plug depths with sub-nanometer vertical repeatability and zero sidewall convolution artifacts across production test wafers.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Cantilever fundamental flexural resonance frequency tuning accuracy relative to SHO fitted thermal peak
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated thermal noise power spectral density fitting and lock-in sweep analysis

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Dense array 180nm W-plug recess depth vertical measurement 1-sigma repeatability
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Multi-site 5-run dynamic repeatability AFM profilometry across 10 discrete contact plugs

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Tip aspect ratio sidewall clearance angle inside 200nm contact opening
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Deconvoluted slope profile analysis on 180nm contact test structures

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Researcher exit sign-off requires meeting all 3 quantitative assertions, continuous Q-factor stability (> 450 with drift < 3% over 1 hour), zero tip apex chipping verified via blind reconstruction on an ISO-certified tip characterizer grid, and automated delivery of all three signed calibration and profile data artifacts into the DRAM Foundation VN metrology repository.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Tapping-Mode Scan Execution Over Dense Bitline and Storage Node W-Plugs  
**Document Link:** [sop_tapping_mode_afm_w_plugs.md](./docs/sop_tapping_mode_afm_w_plugs.md)  
**Process Step:** Post-CMP Plug Recess Profilometry & Residual Metal Metrology (180nm Open-Source DRAM)

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│   Pre-Scan Alignment   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Tip Engagement &    │
│    Resonance Tuning    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Tapping-Mode Scan    │
│       Execution        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Topography & Recess   │
│  Metrology Extraction  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Alignment & Optical Site Navigation**:
   - Secure the post-W-CMP 200 mm wafer on the vibration-isolated AFM vacuum chuck.
   - Navigate optics to the dense memory array test macro containing the $8F^2$ ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$) and $6F^2$ ($0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$) cell layouts with bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
2. **Cantilever Selection & Resonance Auto-Tuning**:
   - Install a high-aspect-ratio (HAR) silicon probe (nominal tip radius $r < 5\text{ nm}$, half-cone angle $< 10^\circ$, nominal resonance $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$, spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$).
   - Set free oscillation amplitude $A_0 = 20.0\text{ nm}$.
   - Auto-tune and engage feedback at a tapping setpoint ratio ($A_{sp} / A_0$) between $0.75$ and $0.80$ to suppress tip wear while maintaining contact sensitivity.
3. **High-Density Raster Scan Execution**:
   - Set scan window dimensions to $2.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ (capturing $>5$ bitline/wordline pitches).
   - Set resolution to $512 \times 512$ pixels (sampling density $\approx 3.9\text{ nm/pixel}$, providing $>45$ data points across the $180\text{ nm}$ plug diameter).
   - Set raster scan rate to $1.0\text{ Hz}$ ($4.0\ \mu\text{m/s}$ tip velocity) along the fast axis oriented orthogonal to bitlines.
4. **Data Extraction & Flattening**:
   - Apply 1st-order line-by-line planar leveling referenced to the surrounding ILD oxide field.
   - Extract cross-sectional profiles through access transistor contacts ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Calculate plug recess depth and array-level dishing.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  AFM Metrology Key Parameters (nm & Hz)
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │██                                 │
     Scan Line Rate┤██                                 │
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓       │
 Tip Res. Amplitude┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓       │
   Max Dishing Spec┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Recess Depth Target┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0      6.2    12.5     18.8   25.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Upper / Lower Limits | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Plug Recess Depth** | $15.0$ | $5.0$ to $25.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Dense Array W-CMP Dishing** | $\le 15.0$ | $\le 25.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Contact Array Pitch Fidelity** | $360.0\text{ to }400.0$ | $\pm 5.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Post-CMP Surface Roughness ($R_q$)** | $\le 0.35$ | $\le 0.50$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 3. Citations of Literature Context
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact geometry; stacked capacitor erected over drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$) and $6F^2$ open bitline footprint ($0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$) at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F^2 folded bitline 180nm DRAM cell architecture (0.259 µm² footprint), excessive W-plug recess directly modulates the bottom interface profile and series contact resistance (Rc) of the storage node contact (SNC) and bitline contact (BLC). A plug recess exceeding 15 nm increases the aspect ratio for subsequent bottom electrode TiN barrier deposition, causing degraded step coverage and parasitic contact resistance shifts that eat directly into the signal margin budget (Cb/Cs nominal 5:1 to 9:1, Cs >= 28 fF). AFM tapping-mode feedback must be tuned with optimal free-amplitude setpoints (Asp/A0 ≈ 0.70 to 0.80) to prevent tip wear artifacts from miscalculating the true 180nm plug recess depth across array boundaries.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: High-aspect-ratio (HAR) diamond-like carbon (DLC) or ultrasharp silicon tips (tip radius < 5 nm, cone angle < 15°) operated in tapping mode (intermittent contact) are mandatory to accurately penetrate the 180nm diameter tungsten plug cavity without sidewall convolution masking the bottom contour. At dense array pitches (~360nm pitch), squeeze-film air damping and capillary meniscus forces from residual humidity can lead to bistable tapping regimes, creating artificial height jumps. Scan rates must not exceed 0.3 Hz line rate with scan areas confined to 2 µm x 2 µm to ensure tracking error is under 0.2 nm across dense-to-isolated dielectric transition zones.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal silicon AFM tips with high aspect ratios exhibit limited operational lifetimes (typically 4-6 hours under continuous dense tapping mode), leading to potential tip breakage and tool downtime. Sourcing calibrated AFM cantilevers with spring constants between 20-40 N/m and resonant frequencies ~300 kHz (e.g., Olympus or Bruker-equivalent probe arrays) requires multi-vendor pre-qualification to avoid critical wafer metrology bottlenecks during MPW lot validation.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tapping-mode AFM inline sampling is inherently low-throughput compared to optical scatterometry or CD-SEM, requiring approximately 15 to 20 minutes per site (9-point wafer mapping consumes ~3 hours). To maintain the lot cycle time targets of the 180nm commercial MPW schedule, AFM metrology must be gated to sacrificial pilot wafers or restricted to 3 key array sites (wafer center, mid-radius, edge) before release to post-CMP scrub and dielectric capping.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex fracture or degradation causing tip convolution artifacts, leading to an underestimation of W-plug recess depth by >40% and improper qualification of over-polished wafers.
1. Capillary meniscus adhesion and phase bistability leading to tip ringing and tracking loss over dense ILD/tungsten interfaces, producing false-positive dishing alarms or wafer surface pitting.
1. Electrostatic discharge (ESD) or mechanical tip dragging during automated engagement, resulting in physical scraping and foreign particulate generation across active memory array regions.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-2-01` | **Dense Array Bitline Contact (BLC) W-Plug Recess and Oxide Erosion Metrology** | Automated Fab-Grade Atomic Force Microscope (Bruker Dimension Icon / Park NX-Wafer equivalent) with High-Aspect-Ratio Silicon Tip (Rc < 7 nm, k = 42 N/m, f0 = 320 kHz) | 1. Load 200mm post-W-CMP patterned wafer onto the vacuum chuck and perform automated optical pattern recognition on array test die (Site 1: Center, Site 2: Slot 4 edge). 2. Engage tapping mode using amplitude setpoint ratio Asp/A0 = 0.75 in dry N2 mini-environment purge. 3. Execute 2.0 µm x 2.0 µm scan at 0.25 Hz line rate, 512 x 512 lines resolution across dense BLC matrix (nominal 180nm contact diameter, 360nm pitch). 4. Extract cross-sectional height profiles orthogonal to bitline routing across 10 contiguous BLC plugs. 5. Compute average plug recess relative to adjacent ILD oxide plane and calculate maximum dielectric erosion. | `Average W-plug recess must be between 5.0 nm and 12.0 nm across all measured array sites; array dielectric erosion must be <= 15.0 nm; tip tracking error must be < 0.25 nm with zero observed phase bistability spikes.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-2-02` | **Storage Node Contact (SNC) Dishing and Micro-Roughness Verification** | Atomic Force Microscope equipped with conductive/diamond-like carbon coated tip and automated cross-section profiling software module | 1. Move stage to cell array perimeter transition zone (dense storage node plug array bordering wide perimeter grounding bus). 2. Initiate non-destructive tapping mode scan over 3.0 µm x 3.0 µm area at 0.3 Hz, collecting trace and retrace channels. 3. Verify trace/retrace overlap discrepancy is less than 0.3 nm to rule out tip stall or feedback delay. 4. Apply 1st-order flattening plane to the surrounding undisturbed field oxide. 5. Measure peak-to-valley dishing across the 180nm node plugs and calculate surface roughness (Sq and Ra) across the top W core. | `Tungsten plug dishing <= 8.0 nm; W-surface micro-roughness Ra <= 0.8 nm; trace-to-retrace hysteresis <= 0.3 nm; zero residual tungsten micro-bridging or pooling detected on adjacent dielectric surfaces.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV and impact-resistant safety glasses, Full cleanroom ESD gowning with conductive shoe covers and wrist grounding strap during manual sample handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation of IPA vapors: Move individual immediately to fresh, uncontaminated air. In case of eye contact with solvent: Flush eyes continuously with clean running water or sterile isotonic saline for at least 15 minutes while keeping eyelids open; consult cleanroom medical personnel. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with non-ionic soap and DI water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Acoustic enclosure and tip exchange module must be integrated with local cleanroom exhaust maintaining >= 50 FPM face velocity; clean dry air (CDA) or N2 purge box for cantilever tip storage with zero backdraft.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of IPA-saturated cleanroom wipes and broken cantilever silicon wafers into dedicated solvent-contaminated solid hazardous waste containers in accordance with EPA RCRA guidelines; ensure grounding of solvent containers to prevent ESD flash fires.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (Tool Purge / Desiccator)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 99.9999% | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, post-CMP scrubbed and dried wafer surface with tungsten plugs cleared of slurry particulate, free of residual colloidal silica, and devoid of visible water marks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Mechanically unscratched, contamination-free planarized surface with validated W-plug recess profile, purged and vacuum-sealed in dry nitrogen FOUP ready for barrier TiN / ILD capping deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding atmospheric Q-time induces spontaneous tungsten galvanic corrosion (WOx trioxide formation) driven by humidity and trace fluorine/chlorine residues, creating uncontrolled plug swelling, voiding, and severe plug contact resistance divergence.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful non-destructive tapping-mode AFM characterization of dense 180nm BLC and SNC tungsten contact plugs across center, mid, and edge array sectors. The inspection validates that W-plug recess and array dielectric erosion remain strictly within the 180nm CMOS DRAM process window, preventing open-circuit defects and excessive contact resistance before subsequent metal-1 / bottom-electrode deposition.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_PLUG_RECESS_METROLOGY_REPORT_DIE3X3.pdf`
- [ ] `AFM_TOPOGRAPHY_SURFACE_ROUGHNESS_TRACE.csv`
- [ ] `HIGH_RES_TAPPING_3D_PLUG_TOPOMAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean contact plug recess across dense array bitline W-contacts** | `8.5 nm` | +/- 3.5 nm | Multi-site automated AFM cross-section step-height extraction across 10 consecutive plugs per die |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Inter-layer dielectric (ILD) array erosion depth relative to unpolished reference perimeter** | `10.0 nm` | <= 5.0 nm | AFM step profile analysis between dense array field oxide and adjacent isolated scribe-line test macro |
| `ASSERT-03` | **AFM tip convolution tracking integrity ratio (trace versus retrace correlation)** | `0.99` | >= 0.95 | Cross-correlation calculation between forward trace and backward retrace topography channels |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All measured sites must exhibit W-plug recess between 5.0 nm and 12.0 nm with zero tip-breakage artifacts, ILD erosion <= 15.0 nm, and formal automated export of metrology CSV files and signed PDF validation sheet into the fab MES lot tracking database.
