# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 3D Topography Extraction and Plug Recess/Dishing Metrology Analysis

**Document Code:** `SOP-MET-180-CMP-AFM-01`  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Target Structure:** Dense Array Bitline Contacts and Storage Node Tungsten (W) Plugs  
**Module:** Planarization (CMP) / In-line Metrology  

---

### Metrology Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Wafer Loading &     │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   AFM Tip Engagement   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Array Scan Execution  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Plane Leveling &    │
│    Line Flattening     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Depth & Recess     │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Substrate Loading, Global Alignment & Site Registration
1. Transfer post-W CMP 200 mm wafer into the automated Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) cassette station under Class 1 mini-environment cleanroom conditions.
2. Perform vacuum chucking and optical pattern recognition on global alignment fiducials.
3. Drive stage to target memory array test structures:
   - Dense memory cell array containing shared bitline contacts and storage node contacts ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, wordline/bitline pitch = $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Run 9-point or 49-point wafer map sampling across radial zones (center, middle, edge-exclusion $3\text{ mm}$) to identify CMP polish radial non-uniformity.

#### Step 2: Cantilever Calibration & Tapping-Mode Engagement
1. Utilize a high-aspect-ratio (HAR) etched silicon cantilever with tip apex radius $R_{\text{tip}} < 10\text{ nm}$ and half-cone angle $\le 10^\circ$ (cantilever spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$, resonance frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
2. Align 4-quadrant position-sensitive photodetector (PSPD) laser spot to balance horizontal and vertical photodiode currents within $\pm 0.05\text{ V}$.
3. Set free oscillation amplitude $A_0 = 15.0\text{ nm}$ and setpoint ratio $r_{\text{sp}} = A / A_0 = 0.80 - 0.85$ to maintain gentle repulsive intermittent contact, eliminating lateral shear force and protecting W-plug edges.

#### Step 3: High-Density 3D Topography Scan
1. Configure scan window to $2.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$, encompassing a minimum of $5 \times 5$ contact plug pitches ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch).
2. Set raster resolution to $512 \times 512\text{ pixels}$ ($3.9\text{ nm/pixel}$ lateral spatial resolution).
3. Set scan rate to $0.5\text{ Hz}$ line scan rate (tip velocity $2.0\,\mu\text{m/s}$) with integral gain ($I_{\text{gain}}$) optimized to minimize trace-retrace error below $0.2\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 4: Digital Image Post-Processing & Plane Leveling
1. Apply first-order tilt plane leveling ($Z = aX + bY + c$) calculated exclusively across the planar Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD oxide) field.
2. Apply line-by-line zero-order flattening with automated feature masking enabled to exclude recessed tungsten plugs and prevent line streak artifacts.
3. Filter high-frequency thermal tip noise via a $3 \times 3$ Gaussian spatial convolution kernel ($< 0.1\text{ nm}$ cutoff).

#### Step 5: Automated Plug Recess, Oxide Dishing & Erosion Extraction
1. Extract orthogonal step-height cross-sectional profiles through plug centerlines across both bitline and wordline pitch axes ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
2. Determine reference ILD plane elevation ($Z_{\text{ILD}}$) by linear baseline fitting across adjacent oxide plateaus.
3. Compute **W-Plug Recess Depth** ($D_{\text{recess}}$) as:
   $$D_{\text{recess}} = Z_{\text{ILD}} - Z_{\text{plug\_bottom}}$$
4. Compute **Array Dishing / Erosion** across dense plug arrays relative to isolated wide field oxide regions.
5. Export automated wafer-level summary metrics (mean, 3-sigma non-uniformity) to manufacturing execution system (MES).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                Post-W CMP AFM Metrology Limits (nm)  
              ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░         │
Peak-to-Valley┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░         │
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
 Oxide Dishing┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                      │
  Recess Limit┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 Recess Target┤███████████████████████               │
              │███████████████████████               │
              └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
               0        5        10       15       20 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method & Conditions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **W-Plug Recess Depth ($D_{\text{recess}}$)** | $\mathbf{12.0 \pm 3.0}$ (Max Upper Limit: $\le \mathbf{20.0}$) | $\text{nm}$ | Automated AFM step-height extraction from reference ILD baseline to tungsten contact plug bottom |
| **Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Dishing** | $\le \mathbf{8.0}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Peak-to-valley depression across oxide field between dense array contacts ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch) |
| **Total Array Profile Peak-to-Valley ($R_t$)** | $\le \mathbf{15.0}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Max elevation difference across $2.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ dense bitline/storage node plug scan window |
| **Wafer-Level Recess Uniformity ($3\sigma$)** | $\le \mathbf{2.5}$ | $\text{nm}$ | 49-point automated wafer map AFM profiling across 200 mm substrate |

---

### 3. Verified Literature Citations

This procedure is directly calibrated using the provided verified physical parameters:
1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor geometry: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Shared bitline contacts and stacked capacitor drain contacts interconnected via Tungsten plugs (W-plugs) below capacitor crown/MIM stacks.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - Bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$, establishing the spatial period for AFM line profile extraction and raster field of view sizing.
3. **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
   - Automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping schemes to track film planarization and radial non-uniformity across polishing and post-CMP metrology steps.

*Knowledge documentation persisted to [sop_afm_plug_recess_dishing.md](./docs/sop_afm_plug_recess_dishing.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated 3D topography extraction across dense DRAM array contacts (node and bitline W-plugs at 180nm pitch) requires atomic force microscopy (AFM) image deconvolution to separate probe cantilever tip-convolution artifacts from genuine oxide erosion and tungsten dishing. If tip wear broadens tip radius beyond 10 nm, measured plug recess will falsely read shallower than reality, inducing uncompensated focus offset errors in downstream M1 photolithography (exceeding the ±250 nm Rayleigh DOF budget).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Tapping-mode AFM must balance cantilever amplitude setpoint (oscillation damping ratio 0.65-0.75) against surface adhesion forces to prevent tip crashing on recessed metal plugs while avoiding intermittent tip-loss over high-aspect contact boundaries. Dishing within isolated large landing pads (>1.5 um) versus dense array plug recess (<0.35 um) exhibits different chemical-mechanical wear dynamics; dual-site calibration referencing field TEOS/BPSG dielectric reference planes is critical for baseline tilt compensation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal silicon cantilevers with diamond-like carbon (DLC) or ultrasharp doped-Si tips (<5 nm nominal radius, resonant frequency ~300 kHz, force constant ~40 N/m) have high wear rates when scanning abrasive post-CMP surfaces; tip attrition risks stalling in-line 200mm wafer inline QA runs without localized second-source tip qualified vendors.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology scan throughput in tapping-mode is slow (~10-15 minutes per 5 um x 5 um 512x512 site across 9 sample sites per wafer). Metrology sampling must be restricted to 5 critical die sites per wafer (center, 4 corners) during inline production monitoring to maintain fab cycle-time targets below 45 minutes total queue time before M1 barrier/seed deposition.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip radius convolution broadening (>15 nm) leading to underestimation of W-plug recess depth by >40%, masking severe plug voiding or over-polishing
1. Piezoelectric scanner Z-axis non-linearity or thermal drift (>2.5 nm/min) corrupting absolute height calibration between field oxide and contact core
1. Galvanic micro-corrosion pitting along the W/TiN liner/dielectric triple boundary misinterpreted as mechanical dishing during automated threshold segmentation

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-3-01` | **Automated High-Resolution Tapping-Mode AFM Scan of Dense Array Bitline Contacts** | Automated In-Line 200mm Wafer Fab AFM (Bruker Dimension Icon or equivalent) equipped with ultrasharp silicon tips (nominal tip radius < 5 nm, spring constant 42 N/m, resonant frequency 320 kHz), acoustic isolation enclosure, and integrated optical navigation camera. | 1. Load wafer into automated AFM FOUP chamber under Class 1 laminar downflow. 2. Pattern-recognize alignment fiducials at center die [Site 0,0] and move to dense memory array bitline contact matrix (contact diameter 220 nm, pitch 440 nm). 3. Engage tapping-mode probe with free amplitude 18 nm, setpoint amplitude ratio 0.70. 4. Execute 5 um x 5 um 3D scan at 0.50 Hz scan rate, 512 lines x 512 points, Z-range 50 nm. 5. Apply 1st-order flattening plane using the surrounding planarized TEOS oxide matrix as zero-height datum. 6. Extract depth profile across 20 consecutive W-plugs and compute mean plug recess depth and 3-sigma variance. | `Mean W-plug recess relative to surrounding dielectric surface must be between 5.0 nm and 20.0 nm; 3-sigma recess variation across the 20-plug cross-section < 4.0 nm; maximum single-plug recess must not exceed 25.0 nm; no residual W protrusions (height > 0 nm above oxide plane).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-2-3-02` | **Wide-Field AFM Profilometry for Large Metal Pad Dishing and Field Oxide Erosion Metrology** | Automated In-Line 200mm Wafer Fab AFM with calibrated high-aspect ratio diamond-coated probe tip (tip radius < 15 nm, cone angle < 15 degrees) and calibrated laser interferometer Z-sensor. | 1. Step stage to peripheral bond pad/test key test structure (isolated 10 um x 10 um W landing pad). 2. Acquire a 25 um x 25 um tapping-mode scan covering the pad and adjacent field oxide at 0.35 Hz, 512 x 512 resolution. 3. Perform 2nd-order polynomial background subtraction to eliminate stage bow. 4. Generate profile vector centered across the 10 um pad edge-to-edge. 5. Extract dishing depth (maximum sagitta below pad periphery) and calculate oxide erosion delta against reference scribe line field oxide. | `Pad dishing sagitta <= 35.0 nm; field oxide erosion <= 25.0 nm; step transition profile from TiN liner to field oxide exhibits no edge undercut / keyhole notch deeper than 10.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/laser safety glasses, Full cleanroom ESD bunny suit and electrostatic-dissipative boots, Laser safety goggles certified for 670 nm / 850 nm diode laser alignment
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA: Flush affected area immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes at cleanroom safety eyewash/shower station. In case of optical laser exposure or eye flash: Seek immediate ophthalmologic evaluation. Inhalation: Move victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool enclosure must maintain continuous local mini-environment laminar flow (exhaust velocity >= 0.45 m/s) with ULPA filtration and localized solvent vapor exhaust for manual stage cleaning ports.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: IPA cleaning wipes and contaminated consumables must be disposed of in sealed, grounded, fire-rated solvent waste cans and vented cleanroom solvent exhaust receptacles per fab hazmat protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade (SEMI C12) | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen (compressed purge gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 6.0 | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP brush scrubber cleaned, spin-rinse dried (SRD), particulate count < 30 adders at >0.15 um, fully cleared of colloidal silica/alumina slurry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metrology-verified passivated surface; W-plug recess verified within spec; zero surface scratch damage from AFM contact; ready for Metal 1 (M1) Ti/TiN barrier layer PVD deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture and atmospheric oxygen exposure beyond 30 min in air induces galvanic oxidation and corrosion of exposed W plugs at the TiN/W interface, forming porous tungsten oxides (WO3), resulting in elevated contact resistance (>150 Ohm/contact) and plug delamination during M1 sputter pre-clean.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full 3D surface topography map and statistical extraction report validating that W-plug recess depths in dense DRAM cell bitline/node contacts and large peripheral landing pads fall strictly within PDK tolerance, verifying zero CMP residual metal bridging and ensuring planarity compatibility for 180nm Metal-1 photolithography.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_CMP_Plug_Recess_3D_Topography_Map.tiff`
- [ ] `Array_Contact_Recess_Dishing_Statistics.csv`
- [ ] `Metrology_Certificate_Signoff_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Dense array contact W-plug recess depth relative to adjacent ILD oxide plane** | `12.5 nm` | ±7.5 nm | 512x512 tapping-mode AFM surface profiling across 20 array plug contacts with baseline-flattened oxide reference plane |
| `ASSERT-02` | **10 um x 10 um peripheral contact pad tungsten dishing depth** | `20.0 nm` | +15.0 nm / -10.0 nm | Cross-sectional profilometry line scan across pad center using calibrated AFM Z-sensor |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) field oxide erosion in dense array region** | `15.0 nm` | ±10.0 nm | Differential height measurement between unpatterned scribe line dielectric and dense contact field oxide |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 measured wafer sample locations meet ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03 with zero instances of unpolished tungsten stringers (>0 nm) and maximum plug recess <= 25.0 nm; Q-time to M1 barrier PVD logged with >= 15 minutes remaining.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Quantitative Step-Height Extraction of W-Plug Recess and ILD Oxide Dishing

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Sub-nanometer height extraction on high-aspect-ratio 180nm contact plugs requires rigorous separation of genuine W-plug recess from piezo-scanner non-linearities and thermal drift. The AFM scan strategy must enforce dual-direction tracing (trace/retrace) and automated tilt-correction algorithms (second-order polynomial surface subtraction) across the dense 180nm cell array to avoid conflating local dielectric field dishing with global wafer bow or scanner creep.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, tungsten plug recess beyond 25 nm severely degrades first-level metal (M1) step coverage and increases contact resistance variance, while ILD oxide dishing exceeding 30 nm narrows the lithographic depth-of-focus (DOF budget is ~500 nm). The AFM cantilever tip geometry is the primary physical filter: a standard pyramidal tip with nominal radius >15 nm will suffer from tip convolution inside narrow 220 nm plug openings, necessitating high-aspect-ratio (HAR) diamond-like carbon or silicon tips with tip cone angles <15 degrees to measure the true plug floor.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specialized high-aspect-ratio AFM probes (such as CDR or HAR-DLC tips) have lead times exceeding 8 to 12 weeks with limited vendor redundancy. Scanning high-density array contacts rapidly accelerates tip wear; probe tip apex degradation must be benchmarked against calibration grating standards every 15 wafers to prevent artificial recess under-reporting and premature stock exhaustion.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM metrology represents a severe throughput bottleneck compared to inline spectroscopic ellipsometry or scatterometry, with typical site acquisition times running 3 to 5 minutes per die. Measurement sampling plans must be optimized to a 5-point cross-wafer layout focused strictly on critical dense memory array and isolated periphery test structures to maintain overall lot cycle-time targets within fab dispatch schedules.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip convolution artifact causing severe underestimation of tungsten plug recess due to AFM tip apex sidewall contact prior to reaching the plug bottom
1. Over-polishing induced severe oxide erosion (>45 nm) leading to shorting or open circuit defects during subsequent Metal-1 integration
1. Surface contamination or galvanic micro-corrosion of tungsten during post-CMP queue delay altering step-height profiles and distorting AFM feedback tracking

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-3-01` | **Quantitative Contact Plug W-Recess Extraction via Tapping-Mode AFM** | Automated Industrial Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with sub-Angstrom Z-noise floor (<0.03 nm RMS) equipped with High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) Silicon Cantilever Tip (nominal tip radius <5 nm, aspect ratio >10:1) | 1. Align wafer notch and navigate optical coordinate system to Die (0,0), Center, and Edge array test modules (dense 180nm DRAM storage node contacts and bitline contact plugs). 2. Dishing >30.0 nm constitutes an immediate CMP overpolish process failure.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/laser safety splash goggles, Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom frock with conductive wrist straps, Full face shield for chemical clean prep bench
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with chemical residuals, flush affected areas immediately with excess deionized water for at least 15 minutes at the emergency eyewash/safety shower station. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move individual to fresh air immediately. For laser radiation exposure from AFM optical head (Class 2/3R laser diode), seek immediate ophthalmic medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM acoustic/vibration enclosure must maintain dedicated internal downflow mini-environment HEPA filtration (Class 1) and continuous air exchange of 45-60 air changes per hour, with local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on manual cleaning/solvent prep stations maintaining face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.5 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent and IPA-saturated wipe waste must be segregated into dedicated grounded, fire-rated steel hazardous solvent bins. Post-CMP rinse effluent containing trace ammonia must be routed to the fab automated Acid-Base Neutralization (ABN) system for pH adjustment to 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (post-CMP brush trace rinse residual)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade | `<0.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP polished surface, brush scrubbed, megasonic rinsed, and Marangoni dried; free of abrasive silica/alumina slurry particles and free of standing water films.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Passivated, cleanroom-ambient stable surface with confirmed step-height topography; zero physical scratch damage or cantilever tip-crash marks on active cell areas.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time triggers atmospheric galvanic corrosion between the tungsten plug and titanium/titanium nitride adhesion liner, yielding tungsten trioxide (WO3) bloom that alters surface topography, degrades plug contact resistance, and invalidates AFM profilometry extraction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable metrological sign-off confirming quantitative AFM extraction of tungsten plug recess depth and dielectric oxide dishing profiles across 180nm DRAM test modules, demonstrating full compliance with lithographic depth-of-focus and Metal-1 deposition topography design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_Plug_Recess_AFM_Topography_Mapping_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `ILD_Oxide_Dishing_StepHeight_RawData.csv`
- [ ] `HighRes_AFM_TappingMode_Phase_Topography.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean Tungsten Plug Recess across 180nm dense contact array** | `12.5 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Automated AFM step-height histogram extraction on 50 plugs/site over 5 wafer points |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Oxide Dishing at array boundary** | `18.0 nm` | <= 25.0 nm maximum | 30 um cross-sectional AFM profilometry step-height extraction against unpatterned field oxide baseline |
| `ASSERT-03` | **AFM Measurement Repeatability (1-sigma Z-height precision)** | `0.15 nm` | <= 0.30 nm | 10 consecutive static scan repetitions over certified 20.0 nm step height standard |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 5 wafer sampling points show mean W-plug recess between 7.5 nm and 17.5 nm, maximum ILD oxide dishing <= 25.0 nm, AFM measurement 1-sigma repeatability <= 0.30 nm, and zero uncorrectable tip convolution or tip-crash artifacts detected across all scanned dies.

The AFM scan strategy must enforce dual-direction tracing (trace/retrace) and automated tilt-correction algorithms (second-order polynomial surface subtraction) across the dense 180nm cell array to avoid conflating local dielectric field dishing with global wafer bow or scanner creep.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Aspect-Ratio AFM Tip Calibration and Target Array Navigation

### Context & Classification
* **Node & Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 3), 1T1C Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) architecture.
* **Process Flow:** W-Plug Overburden CMP $\rightarrow$ Post-CMP Plug Recess Profilometry $\rightarrow$ AFM Plug Recess & Dishing Metrology $\rightarrow$ High-Aspect-Ratio AFM Tip Calibration & Target Array Navigation.
* **Documentation Record:** Persisted to [docs/knowledge/har_afm_tip_calibration.md](./docs/knowledge/har_afm_tip_calibration.md).

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   High-Aspect-Ratio    │
│     AFM Tip Mount      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Tip Characterization  │
│        & Blind         │
│     Deconvolution      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Optical         │
│    Pre-Alignment &     │
│      Target Array      │
│       Navigation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Tapping / PeakForce   │
│  Contact Profilometry  │
│   across Array Pitch   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

```text
                      Metrology Scale Hierarchy (nm)    
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Array Recess Window┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                            │
   Bitline/WL Pitch┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                            │
  Cell Critical Dim┤▓▓▓▓                               │
                   │▓▓▓▓                               │
    Tip Apex Radius┤█                                  │
                   │█                                  │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0       500    1000     1500   2000 
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) Probe Loading & Laser Alignment**:
   * Mount a High-Aspect-Ratio silicon probe (shank length $\ge 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$, half-cone angle $\le 2.5^\circ$, nominal tip radius $R_{\text{tip}} \le 10\text{ nm}$, nominal spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$, resonance frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
   * Align the optical lever diode laser onto the cantilever apex to achieve a sum signal $\ge 4.5\text{ V}$ and zero differential photodiode deflection ($A-B < \pm 0.05\text{ V}$).

2. **Tip Apex Characterization & Blind Tip Estimation (BTE)**:
   * Navigate the stage to an on-chuck ultra-sharp silicon spike characterization grating (tip characterizer with apex radii $< 5\text{ nm}$).
   * Execute an automated $1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ tapping/PeakForce scan ($512 \times 512$ pixels, scan rate $0.5\text{ Hz}$).
   * Run the Blind Tip Estimation algorithm to extract the effective tip shape; verify apex radius $R_{\text{tip}} \le 12\text{ nm}$ and aspect ratio $\ge 10:1$ before engaging production wafers.

3. **Global Wafer Co-ordinate Registration & Optical Pre-Alignment**:
   * Load the post-CMP 180nm DRAM wafer onto the vacuum chuck (temperature controlled at $22.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
   * Use the high-magnification optical video microscope to capture wafer notch and global lithography alignment marks ($3$-point wafer coordinate transformation).
   * Program the motorized $XY$ translation stage to step directly to the target die array coordinates based on the PDK coordinate map.

4. **Target Memory Array Fine-Pitch Navigation**:
   * Position the optical crosshair over the dense $180\text{nm}$ 1T1C memory array field adjacent to the peripheral test pads.
   * Lower the AFM head under automated soft-engage ($Z$-drive piezo approach threshold $\Delta V_{\text{RMS}} = 5\%$ of free amplitude).
   * Perform an initial wide-field survey scan ($10.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 10.0\ \mu\text{m}$ at $1.0\text{ Hz}$) to identify memory array boundaries and bitline/wordline orientations.
   * Center the scan field over the active cell array with $2.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ scan range ($1024 \times 1024$ points) aligned orthogonally across the $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline pitch tracks for W-plug step-height extraction.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Value | Tolerance | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effective Tip Apex Radius ($R_{\text{eff}}$)** | $\le 10.0\text{ nm}$ | Max $12.0\text{ nm}$ | Blind Tip Estimation on reference spike standard |
| **Stage Navigation Repeatability ($3\sigma$)** | $\le 0.25\ \mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 0.05\ \mu\text{m}$ | Optical-to-Piezo closed-loop fiducial offset |
| **Array Pitch Metrology Fidelity** | $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ | 1D FFT Power Spectral Density along fast scan axis |
| **Pluggable Recess Aspect Ratio Access** | $\ge 5:1$ depth-to-width | Bottom contact confirmed | Zero non-linear sidewall convolution artifacts |

---

### Literature Citations & Physical Reference Basis

* **Cell Geometry & Contact Dimensions**: Transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and shared bitline contacts within $8F^2 / 6F^2$ stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench)*.
* **Array Pitch Specifications**: Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ *(Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering)*, directly setting the required spatial resolution, tip cone angle, and scan field dimensions.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated array navigation across 200mm/300mm wafer coordinates requires seamless handoff between low-magnification optical alignment (pattern recognition cross-correlation error < 0.2 um) and high-aspect-ratio (HAR) AFM tip engagement. Blind tip engagement inside narrow 180nm contact/via arrays poses extreme risk of lateral cantilever snap-in and premature tip fracture if closed-loop capacitive piezostage positioning drifts beyond 15 nm or if wafer thermal expansion gradients (> 0.05 C/min) are uncompensated.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm tungsten plug recess metrology with contact diameters of ~200-240 nm and recess depths of 15-40 nm, standard conical AFM tips exhibit tip-convolution artifacts that underestimate recess depth by failing to reach the plug bottom. Silicon HAR probes with aspect ratios >= 10:1 and tip apex radius <= 5 nm must undergo blind tip reconstruction (BTR) on certified titanium or silicon tip characterization gratings (e.g., NIST-traceable spiked structures) before and after array scanning to decouple true tungsten recess from tip wear and apex rounding.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal silicon HAR AFM probes with high-aspect-ratio FIB/DLC pillars (>= 10:1 AR, <= 5 nm apex radius, spring constant 40 N/m) have long lead times (> 12 weeks) from domestic/international vendors and a high unit cost. With tip lifetimes limited to ~25-40 site engagements before apex degradation exceeds the 8 nm limit, an inventory buffer of >= 150 packaged probes and qualified second-source suppliers (e.g., conductive diamond-coated or molded high-density carbon tips) must be secured prior to pilot CMP inline qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM throughput is intrinsically slow (~15-20 minutes per die site including optical target acquisition, cantilever resonant tuning, soft-tapping engage, 512x512 raster scan, and retract). A full 9-point or 49-point wafer map will stall inline CMP lot disposition. Metrology must implement a tiered sampling protocol: 5 critical macro sites per wafer for fast pass/fail gating, reserving dense target array profiling for baseline qualification runs and process excursion debug.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. HAR tip apex snap-off or mechanical fracture during high-speed rastering across sharp tungsten-plug/ILD oxide sidewall interfaces, causing invalid zero-depth recess readings and false-positive planarization reports.
1. Pattern recognition failure or stage translation skew exceeding 250 nm, causing AFM tip engagement onto dense field ILD rather than the target memory cell contact array, resulting in unrepresentative oxide erosion profiles.
1. Tip dilation/broadening due to airborne moisture capillary condensation or residual slurry contamination adhesion, resulting in severe step-height underestimation and artificial plug curvature.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-3-1-01` | **HAR AFM Tip Aspect Ratio and Apex Radius Blind Calibration** | Automated Fab In-line Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with acoustic enclosure, active vibration isolation table, and NIST-traceable Tip Characterization Grating (TGT1/HS-100MG sharp spike array) | 1. Perform auto-tuning of cantilever resonant frequency in tapping mode; lock amplitude setpoint at 75% free air amplitude. 2. Move stage to NIST-traceable tip characterization spike array using optical pattern recognition. 3. Engage tip with soft-approach profile (Z-drive step < 2 nm/step). 4. Execute non-destructive 1.0 um x 1.0 um scan at 0.5 Hz line rate with 512 x 512 pixel resolution over calibrated reference spikes. 5. Process topography map through automated blind tip reconstruction (BTR) algorithms to calculate apex tip radius and effective sidewall opening angle. 6. Repeat scan at 3 distinct reference sites to extract mean and 3-sigma variance. | `Reconstructed tip apex radius r_tip <= 5.0 nm; effective tip aspect ratio >= 10:1 (half-cone angle <= 5.0 degrees over the first 100 nm tip height); resonant frequency shift < 0.1% across 3 scans.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-3-1-02` | **Automated DRAM Cell Array Navigation and Contact Recess Profilometry** | In-line Industrial AFM with integrated high-resolution dual-magnification optical navigation camera (0.5 um optical resolution), closed-loop laser interferometer piezostage, and calibrated HAR probe | 1. Dispatch stage coordinates to DRAM memory array block (Mat B, Array Core 1) using CAD-to-stage coordinate mapping. 2. Execute optical pattern recognition on die-corner fiducial alignment marks; calculate and apply offset correction vector (residual error < 100 nm). 3. Switch to high-magnification optical view and center optical crosshairs on 200nm contact array test structure. 4. Engage HAR probe in tapping/peak-force tapping mode within designated 5.0 um x 5.0 um array ROI. 5. Acquire 3D height profile across 25 consecutive tungsten contact plugs at scan rate of 0.3 Hz, 512 x 512 pixels. 6. Perform automated tilt correction, background planarity leveling, and extract cross-sectional step height profile from ILD oxide plateau to tungsten plug meniscus center across 10 plugs. | `Array target navigation capture success rate = 100% (navigation positional error <= 50 nm relative to array center); tungsten plug recess depth measurement repeatability 1-sigma <= 0.35 nm across 10 repeat scans; tip wear degradation (radius delta) <= 1.0 nm post-measurement.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Bunny Suit with Hood and Booties, Static-dissipative Nitrile Gloves (Double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 UV/Laser Certified Safety Eyewear (filtered for AFM 670nm diode alignment laser), ESD-safe Conductive Wrist Strap for probe handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA eye contact: Immediately flush eyes at cleanroom emergency eyewash station with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open. In case of skin exposure: Remove contaminated gloves, wash skin thoroughly with soap and water. If inhaled: Move individual to fresh air outside the sub-fab/cleanroom; administer CPR or supplemental oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM acoustic/environmental chamber must be coupled to cleanroom downflow air filtration (Class 1 laminar airflow, < 0.2 m/s face velocity). Solvent cleaning operations for reference standard gratings must be performed strictly inside a dedicated wet bench with active local exhaust ventilation (face velocity >= 100 FPM / 0.51 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA wipes and swab materials must be collected in grounded, sealed solvent waste cans and disposed of as RCRA flammable solvent hazardous waste. DI rinse effluent must be routed to the fab industrial acid/solvent waste neutralization system (AWN) for automated pH balancing prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) / 2-Propanol** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DIW)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I Cleanroom Grade (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP brush scrubbed and Marangoni dried; hydrophilic ILD TEOS surface and bare metallic W-plug surface; free of residual colloidal silica slurry, slurry surfactant films, or organic drying watermarks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: AFM scanned and retracted; intact nanoscale topography without tip crash indentations, debris redeposition, or localized hydrocarbon contamination spots; ready for post-CMP clean inspection or metal-1 deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient cleanroom air promotes rapid native tungsten trioxide (WO3) galvanic growth and organic hydrocarbon airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption on the recess sidewalls, causing artificial recess depth reduction, false-positive roughness spikes, and downstream contact resistance shifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full engineering qualification and deployment of high-aspect-ratio AFM tip calibration routines, automated DRAM memory array navigation protocols, and high-precision tungsten plug recess profilometry capable of resolving sub-nanometer step heights in 180nm node memory cells.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `HAR_AFM_Tip_Calibration_BTR_Certificate.pdf`
- [ ] `DRAM_Array_W_Plug_Recess_Profilometry_Dataset.csv`
- [ ] `Calibrated_3D_Nanotopography_W_Array_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |

critics.systems_engineer: Automated array navigation across 200mm/300mm wafer coordinates requires seamless handoff between low-magnification optical alignment (pattern recognition cross-correlation error < 0.2 um) and high-aspect-ratio (HAR) AFM tip engagement. Blind tip engagement inside narrow 180nm contact/via arrays poses extreme risk of lateral cantilever snap-in and premature tip fracture if closed-loop capacitive piezostage positioning drifts beyond 15 nm or if wafer thermal expansion gradients (> 0.05 C/min) are uncompensated.
critics.domain_expert: For 180nm tungsten plug recess metrology with contact diameters of ~200-240 nm and recess depths of 15-40 nm, standard conical AFM tips exhibit tip-convolution artifacts that underestimate recess depth by failing to reach the plug bottom. Silicon HAR probes with aspect ratios >= 10:1 and tip apex radius <= 5 nm must undergo blind tip reconstruction (BTR) on certified titanium or silicon tip characterization gratings (e.g., NIST-traceable spiked structures) before and after array scanning to decouple true tungsten recess from tip wear and apex rounding.
critics.supply_chain: Single-crystal silicon HAR AFM probes with high-aspect-ratio FIB/DLC pillars (>= 10:1 AR, <= 5 nm apex radius, spring constant 40 N/m) have long lead times (> 12 weeks) from domestic/international vendors and a high unit cost. With tip lifetimes limited to ~25-40 site engagements before apex degradation exceeds the 8 nm limit, an inventory buffer of >= 150 packaged probes and qualified second-source suppliers (e.g., conductive diamond-coated or molded high-density carbon tips) must be secured prior to pilot CMP inline qualification.
critics.laya_pm: AFM throughput is intrinsically slow (~15-20 minutes per die site including optical target acquisition, cantilever resonant tuning, soft-tapping engage, 512x512 raster scan, and retract). A full 9-point or 49-point wafer map will stall inline CMP lot disposition. Metrology must implement a tiered sampling protocol: 5 critical macro sites per wafer for fast pass/fail gating, reserving dense target array profiling for baseline qualification runs and process excursion debug.
critical_failure_modes: HAR tip apex snap-off or mechanical fracture during high-speed rastering across sharp tungsten-plug/ILD oxide sidewall interfaces, causing invalid zero-depth recess readings and false-positive planarization reports.

Pattern recognition failure or stage translation skew exceeding 250 nm, causing AFM tip engagement onto dense field ILD rather than the target memory cell contact array, resulting in unrepresentative oxide erosion profiles.
Tip dilation/broadening due to airborne moisture capillary condensation or residual slurry contamination adhesion, resulting in severe step-height underestimation and artificial plug curvature.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Tapping-Mode AFM Scan Across W-Plug Dense Array and Peripheral Test Structures

### 1. Process Overview & Architecture Context
In the 180nm Open-Source DRAM process, tungsten (W) plugs provide critical electrical contact to the transistor drain/source regions beneath the stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture. Post-chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), precise quantitative step-height extraction of tungsten plug recess and inter-layer dielectric (ILD) dishing is essential. Excessive recess degrades plug contact resistance and crown capacitor bottom-electrode adhesion, whereas under-polishing leaves residual metallic tungsten short circuits.

```text
│  Load Wafer & Align   │

│                       │

│                       │
│   Tip Engagement &    │

│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Tapping Scan: Dense  │
│      Array Pitch      │
│       360-400nm       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Tapping Scan:     │
│    Peripheral Test    │
```

```text
                0        100      200       300     400 
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Cantilever Installation**:
   - Mount an ultra-sharp silicon tapping-mode probe (tip nominal radius $\le 10\text{ nm}$, nominal spring constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$, free air resonance frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
   - Load the post-W-CMP patterned 180nm DRAM wafer onto the automated AFM vacuum chuck.

2. **Optical Alignment & Resonance Auto-Tune**:
   - Align the 670 nm optical deflection laser onto the cantilever apex; maximize photodiode sum signal ($> 4.0\text{ V}$) and center lateral/vertical deflection to $0.00\text{ V} \pm 0.05\text{ V}$.
   - Sweep acoustic driving frequency to locate fundamental resonance peak; establish drive amplitude yielding $1.5\text{ V}$ to $2.0\text{ V}$ RMS free amplitude.
   - Set tapping amplitude setpoint ratio to $70\% - 80\%$ of free amplitude for stable tracking without tip rounding or surface alteration.

3. **In-Die Feature Pattern Recognition**:
   - Using the top-down optical navigation microscope, locate the target DRAM dies (center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zone $> 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Position navigation reticle over the **Dense Memory Array** corresponding to the 1T1C stacked capacitor contacts (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, array pitch $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Align secondary site to the **Peripheral Test Structure** macro containing isolated and semi-dense test lines.

4. **Dense Array AFM Acquisition**:
   - Set scan window to $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ orthogonal to bitline routing.
   - Scan parameters:
     - Resolution: $512 \times 512$ data points (pixel pitch $\approx 3.9\text{ nm}$).
     - Scan speed: $0.5\text{ Hz}$ to $0.8\text{ Hz}$ line rate.
     - Integral and proportional feedback gains optimized to suppress error signal $< 20\text{ mV}$.
   - Acquire trace and retrace channels: Height (Topography), Amplitude Error, and Phase.

5. **Peripheral Test Structure AFM Acquisition**:
   - Move stage to peripheral test macro; set scan size to $5.0\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 5.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ across isolated W-plug patterns and wide oxide areas.
   - Scan at $512 \times 512$ points at $0.5\text{ Hz}$ to extract planarization reference planes and wide-field oxide loss.

6. **Image Flattening & Step-Height Extraction**:
   - Apply 1st-order line-by-line planar leveling and 2nd-order polynomial background subtraction excluding plug contact holes.
   - Extract cross-sectional profiles across minimum 10 consecutive tungsten plugs in the dense array.
   - Quantify tungsten plug recess relative to the surrounding ILD oxide plateau using standard 2-point step-height histogram algorithms.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrology Limits

| Metrology Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Window & Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dense Array Pitch Verification** | $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ | Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) / auto-correlation across dense $2\times 2\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ array |
| **W-Plug Recess Depth** | $\le 20\text{ nm}$ (Nominal $5\text{ nm} - 15\text{ nm}$) | Extracted cross-sectional step height relative to planar ILD oxide |
| **Tungsten Overburden Residue** | $0.0\text{ nm}$ (Residual height on ILD $= 0\text{ nm}$) | Phase/topography channel over ILD spaces between bitline/plug contacts |
| **ILD Field Dishing / Erosion** | $\le 15\text{ nm}$ across $5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ peripheral spans | High-to-low profilometry baseline between dense array and peripheral field oxide |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Validates 180nm unit cell access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), folded bitline architecture, and tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnect routing to stacked capacitor contacts.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Validates array bitline and wordline contact pitch of approximately $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ in standard 180nm DRAM nodes, establishing the grid sizing and AFM scan window requirements.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: AFM tapping-mode cantilever dynamics must decouple plug recess topography from tip-sample phase convolution artifacts caused by elastic modulus mismatch between metallic Tungsten (E ~ 411 GPa) and TEOS/ILD oxide (E ~ 70 GPa). Systemic integration requires high-precision piezo-stage coordinate alignment with optical stepper fiducials to ensure that identical 5x5 um dense DRAM cell arrays (pitch 360 nm at 180nm node) and 20x20 um peripheral test pads are repeatedly scanned without thermal drift exceeding 0.2 nm/min.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm DRAM node, contact plug recess budget is tightly constrained between 15 nm and 35 nm. A recess exceeding 40 nm degrades subsequent Metal-1 Ti/TiN barrier step coverage leading to open-circuit or high contact resistance (Rc > 15 Ohm/plug), while under-polish or negative recess (plug protrusion) creates fatal lithographic depth-of-focus (DOF < 0.5 um) defocus and inter-metal bridge shorts. Tapping setpoint ratio (r_sp = A_sp / A_0) must be stabilized between 0.70 and 0.80 to avoid tip wear and cantilever ringing over high-aspect contact boundaries.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal silicon tapping cantilevers with diamond-like carbon (DLC) coating and nominal tip radius < 5 nm (nominal resonance ~300 kHz, spring constant ~40 N/m) face extended vendor lead times (12-16 weeks) from specialized suppliers like Bruker and NanoWorld. Standardizing on high-durability DLC probes prevents rapid tip apex blunting across abrasive tungsten surfaces and keeps tip-exchange overhead within fab operating budgets.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM metrology throughput is intrinsically slow (approximately 8-12 minutes per site for high-density 512x512 line tapping scans). Sampling plans must be strictly limited to a calibrated 9-point site map per wafer across 3 pilot wafers per CMP platen split, ensuring the metrology cycle does not exceed the 120-minute post-clean queue time prior to pre-metal degas and Ti/TiN barrier sputter deposition.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip apex fracture or catastrophic convolution dilation leading to artificial underestimation of plug recess depth by >15 nm due to tip geometry clipping contact hole sidewalls.
1. Acoustic or floor vibration resonance coupling into the cantilever deflection sensor, generating periodic z-banding noise (>2.0 nm RMS) that obscures true ILD erosion and tungsten micro-recess.
1. Post-CMP slurry nanoparticle residue (fumed silica or alumina) lodging in the contact plug recess, causing false positive height signals and probe tip contamination.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-3-2-01` | **Dense DRAM Array Tungsten Plug Recess and Step-Height Distribution Scan** | Automated Industrial Atomic Force Microscope (Bruker Dimension Icon or equivalent) equipped with DLC-coated silicon cantilevers (tip radius < 5 nm, resonance frequency 300 kHz, k = 42 N/m), acoustic enclosure (<35 dBA), and active vibration isolation table. | 1. Load 200mm pilot wafer into automated AFM chuck and engage vacuum hold-down (>75 kPa). 2. Pattern-recognize global alignment marks and navigate to dense memory array block (0.36 um pitch contact matrix). 3. Tune cantilever resonance: verify peak at 300 ± 15 kHz with Q-factor > 400. 4. Set scan parameters: scan area = 5.0 um x 5.0 um, resolution = 512 x 512 pixels, scan rate = 0.50 Hz, setpoint ratio = 0.75. 5. Acquire forward and reverse height, amplitude, and phase channels across 9 predetermined sites (center, mid-radius, wafer edge 3mm exclusion). 6. Apply 1st-order plane flattening using ILD oxide plateau as ground reference; execute automated step-height mask extraction across 100 individual W-plugs per site. | `Average W-plug recess depth across all 9 measured sites must fall strictly within 20.0 nm to 30.0 nm, with a 1-sigma intra-site uniformity <= 2.5 nm. Tip apex radius must check <= 8.0 nm upon post-scan blind reconstruction on standard titanium roughness specimen.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-1-3-2-02` | **Peripheral Large-Area Test Structure Oxide Dishing and Plug Array Erosion Profilometry** | Atomic Force Microscope in Tapping Mode with calibrated capacitive closed-loop XYZ scanner (100 um x 100 um scan range, z-noise floor < 0.03 nm RMS) and calibrated tip characterizer artifact. | 1. Position probe over 50 um x 50 um peripheral isolated contact test pad and adjacent 100 um x 100 um open field ILD field oxide. 2. Configure tapping scan area to 30.0 um x 30.0 um centered across the array-to-field dielectric boundary at 0.35 Hz line rate, 1024 x 256 aspect ratio. 3. Engage tip under soft-landing routine (damping threshold 90%). 4. Extract cross-sectional profile perpendicular to the boundary interface over a 25 um profile line. 5. Calculate total oxide dishing (distance from unpolished oxide baseline to center of array structure) and peripheral isolated plug step height. | `Maximum ILD field oxide dishing over peripheral structures must not exceed 25.0 nm. Isolated peripheral tungsten contact plug recess must measure between 15.0 nm and 32.0 nm with zero observed negative recess (protrusion > 0 nm is a critical fail).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom clean-sealed nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN ISO 374-1), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser-blocking impact safety glasses (OD > 4 at 670 nm for AFM laser diode), Full static-dissipative cleanroom smock, hood, and ESD conductive footwear, Particulate face mask (cleanroom compliant)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For IPA skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin thoroughly with deionized water for 15 minutes. For eye exposure from solvent splashing: Irrigate eyes immediately at the emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. For class 3R AFM diode laser accidental ocular exposure: Immediately remove subject from beam path, keep eyes shaded, and transport to occupational health clinic for retina evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM metrology tool enclosure must maintain laminar cleanroom downflow air (ISO Class 3 / Class 10 min, HEPA filtration velocity 0.45 m/s ± 20%). Solvent cleaning station for cantilever tweezers and sample fixtures must be situated in a dedicated chemical exhaust wet hood maintaining minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Wetted cleanroom wipes, spent IPA swabs, and discarded broken cantilevers must be collected in labeled, grounded, flame-resistant hazardous waste bins. Solvent waste drained into dedicated solvent carboy containers (flammable waste stream) for licensed third-party high-temperature incineration. No down-the-drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 5 (Ultra-pure) | `99.9%` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (residual trace from cleaning)** | `1336-21-6` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `<0.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP scrubbed and dried surface, free of colloidal silica slurry particulates, with trace native oxide on exposed tungsten surfaces (<1.5 nm WO3).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Particle-free, non-scratched, cleanroom-purged wafer topography; AFM scanned sites pristine without physical tip abrasion marks or localized organic tip-drop deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time causes thick, uncontrolled tungsten galvanic micro-corrosion and ambient airborne hydrocarbon adsorption (airborne molecular contamination, AMC), causing significant contact resistance spikes (>10x) and erratic barrier adhesion during subsequent Ti/TiN metal-1 PVD liner deposition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full tapping-mode AFM topographical quantification of 180nm DRAM dense cell W-plugs and peripheral test structures across 9 wafer sites, verifying tungsten recess within 20-30 nm and dielectric field dishing <= 25 nm without tip-induced scan damage.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_Plug_CMP_AFM_Topography_Dataset.csv`
- [ ] `Recess_and_Dishing_Profilometry_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Dense_Array_TappingMode_3D_Surface.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean contact plug recess depth in dense memory array** | `25.0 nm` | ±5.0 nm | Automated AFM bearing ratio and step-height algorithm across 900 individual plugs |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum dielectric oxide dishing over peripheral wide structures** | `15.0 nm` | <= 25.0 nm upper limit | Extracted horizontal line-profile step analysis relative to pristine ILD field datum |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Tapping cantilever tip blunting post-9-site wafer run** | `4.5 nm` | <= 8.0 nm final tip apex radius | Blind tip reconstruction algorithm utilizing calibration standard SPIP/Nanoscope |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal engineering signoff achieved when 100% of the 9 measured wafer locations satisfy ASSERT-01 and ASSERT-02, zero negative plug protrusion is detected across any scan site, cantilevers pass tip reconstruction qualification (ASSERT-03), and all deliverable CSV and PDF reports are archived into the fab manufacturing execution and metrology database.

critics.supply_chain: Single-crystal silicon tapping cantilevers with diamond-like carbon (DLC) coating and nominal tip radius < 5 nm (nominal resonance ~300 kHz, spring constant ~40 N/m) face extended vendor lead times (12-16 weeks) from specialized suppliers like Bruker and NanoWorld. Standardizing on high-durability DLC probes prevents rapid tip apex blunting across abrasive tungsten surfaces and keeps tip-exchange overhead within fab operating budgets.
critics.laya_pm: AFM metrology throughput is intrinsically slow (approximately 8-12 minutes per site for high-density 512x512 line tapping scans). Sampling plans must be strictly limited to a calibrated 9-point site map per wafer across 3 pilot wafers per CMP platen split, ensuring the metrology cycle does not exceed the 120-minute post-clean queue time prior to pre-metal degas and Ti/TiN barrier sputter deposition.
critical_failure_modes: Tip apex fracture or catastrophic convolution dilation leading to artificial underestimation of plug recess depth by >15 nm due to tip geometry clipping contact hole sidewalls.
Acoustic or floor vibration resonance coupling into the cantilever deflection sensor, generating periodic z-banding noise (>2.0 nm RMS) that obscures true ILD erosion and tungsten micro-recess.
Post-CMP slurry nanoparticle residue (fumed silica or alumina) lodging in the contact plug recess, causing false positive height signals and probe tip contamination.

testcases.title: Dense DRAM Array Tungsten Plug Recess and Step-Height Distribution Scan
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Industrial Atomic Force Microscope (Bruker Dimension Icon or equivalent) equipped with DLC-coated silicon cantilevers (tip radius < 5 nm, resonance frequency 300 kHz, k = 42 N/m), acoustic enclosure (<35 dBA), and active vibration isolation table.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer has completed W-CMP polish, post-CMP double-sided PVA brush scrub clean with dilute NH4OH/DIW, and isopropyl alcohol (IPA) Marangoni dry. Wafer surface inspected defect-free under darkfield optical inspection. Q-time elapsed in cleanroom air < 45 minutes.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load 200mm pilot wafer into automated AFM chuck and engage vacuum hold-down (>75 kPa). 2. Pattern-recognize global alignment marks and navigate to dense memory array block (0.36 um pitch contact matrix). 3. Tune cantilever resonance: verify peak at 300 ± 15 kHz with Q-factor > 400. 4. Set scan parameters: scan area = 5.0 um x 5.0 um, resolution = 512 x 512 pixels, scan rate = 0.50 Hz, setpoint ratio = 0.75. 5. Acquire forward and reverse height, amplitude, and phase channels across 9 predetermined sites (center, mid-radius, wafer edge 3mm exclusion). 6. Apply 1st-order plane flattening using ILD oxide plateau as ground reference; execute automated step-height mask extraction across 100 individual W-plugs per site.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Average W-plug recess depth across all 9 measured sites must fall strictly within 20.0 nm to 30.0 nm, with a 1-sigma intra-site uniformity <= 2.5 nm. Tip apex radius must check <= 8.0 nm upon post-scan blind reconstruction on standard titanium roughness specimen.

testcases.title: Peripheral Large-Area Test Structure Oxide Dishing and Plug Array Erosion Profilometry
testcases.instrumentation: Atomic Force Microscope in Tapping Mode with calibrated capacitive closed-loop XYZ scanner (100 um x 100 um scan range, z-noise floor < 0.03 nm RMS) and calibrated tip characterizer artifact.
testcases.pre_conditions: AFM optical deflection laser aligned to photodiode sum signal > 4.5 V; thermal drift stabilization protocol confirmed (< 0.15 nm/min drift rate). Wafer stage mapped to peripheral parametric test structures.
testcases.procedure: 1. Position probe over 50 um x 50 um peripheral isolated contact test pad and adjacent 100 um x 100 um open field ILD field oxide. 2. Configure tapping scan area to 30.0 um x 30.0 um centered across the array-to-field dielectric boundary at 0.35 Hz line rate, 1024 x 256 aspect ratio. 3. Engage tip under soft-landing routine (damping threshold 90%). 4. Extract cross-sectional profile perpendicular to the boundary interface over a 25 um profile line. 5. Calculate total oxide dishing (distance from unpolished oxide baseline to center of array structure) and peripheral isolated plug step height.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Maximum ILD field oxide dishing over peripheral structures must not exceed 25.0 nm. Isolated peripheral tungsten contact plug recess must measure between 15.0 nm and 32.0 nm with zero observed negative recess (protrusion > 0 nm is a critical fail).

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom clean-sealed nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN ISO 374-1)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser-blocking impact safety glasses (OD > 4 at 670 nm for AFM laser diode)
Full static-dissipative cleanroom smock, hood, and ESD conductive footwear
Particulate face mask (cleanroom compliant)
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For IPA skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin thoroughly with deionized water for 15 minutes. For eye exposure from solvent splashing: Irrigate eyes immediately at the emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. For class 3R AFM diode laser accidental ocular exposure: Immediately remove subject from beam path, keep eyes shaded, and transport to occupational health clinic for retina evaluation.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: AFM metrology tool enclosure must maintain laminar cleanroom downflow air (ISO Class 3 / Class 10 min, HEPA filtration velocity 0.45 m/s ± 20%). Solvent cleaning station for cantilever tweezers and sample fixtures must be situated in a dedicated chemical exhaust wet hood maintaining minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Wetted cleanroom wipes, spent IPA swabs, and discarded broken cantilevers must be collected in labeled, grounded, flame-resistant hazardous waste bins. Solvent waste drained into dedicated solvent carboy containers (flammable waste stream) for licensed third-party high-temperature incineration. No down-the-drain disposal permitted.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic post-CMP scrubbed and dried surface, free of colloidal silica slurry particulates, with trace native oxide on exposed tungsten surfaces (<1.5 nm WO3).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Particle-free, non-scratched, cleanroom-purged wafer topography; AFM scanned sites pristine without physical tip abrasion marks or localized organic tip-drop deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time causes thick, uncontrolled tungsten galvanic micro-corrosion and ambient airborne hydrocarbon adsorption (airborne molecular contamination, AMC), causing significant contact resistance spikes (>10x) and erratic barrier adhesion during subsequent Ti/TiN metal-1 PVD liner deposition.

expected_result.summary: Full tapping-mode AFM topographical quantification of 180nm DRAM dense cell W-plugs and peripheral test structures across 9 wafer sites, verifying tungsten recess within 20-30 nm and dielectric field dishing <= 25 nm without tip-induced scan damage.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean contact plug recess depth in dense memory array
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated AFM bearing ratio and step-height algorithm across 900 individual plugs

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum dielectric oxide dishing over peripheral wide structures
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Extracted horizontal line-profile step analysis relative to pristine ILD field datum

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Tapping cantilever tip blunting post-9-site wafer run
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Blind tip reconstruction algorithm utilizing calibration standard SPIP/Nanoscope

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Formal engineering signoff achieved when 100% of the 9 measured wafer locations satisfy ASSERT-01 and ASSERT-02, zero negative plug protrusion is detected across any scan site, cantilevers pass tip reconstruction qualification (ASSERT-03), and all deliverable CSV and PDF reports are archived into the fab manufacturing execution and metrology database.
