# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Focused $\text{Ga}^+$ Ion Beam Bulk Trench Milling & Coarse Cross-Sectioning

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-FIB-180NM-001`  
**Hierarchy Level:** Metrology Leaf Operation  
**Integration Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) / Planarization Post-CMP Metrology  
**Applicable Equipment:** Dual-Beam FIB/SEM System with Liquid Metal Ion Source ($\text{Ga}^+$ LMIS) and Pt/C Gas Injection System (GIS)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Start: Align ROI    │
│      W-Plug Array      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Pre-deposition     │
│    Protection Strip    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Stage Tilt to 52 deg  │
│      Coincidence       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Ga+ Bulk Rough     │
│  Trench Milling at 30  │
│       kV 5-7 nA        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Staircase Relief &   │
│   Sidewall Clearing    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  In-situ Inspection &  │
│   Metrology Hand-off   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the coarse ion-beam excavation procedure for preparing cross-sectional inspection cavities exposing post-CMP tungsten (W) contact plugs, stacked capacitor contact interfaces, and access transistor channel regions on 180nm DRAM wafers.

---

### 2. Physical Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chamber Loading & Vacuum Pumping:**
   - Mount coupon/wafer onto the 5-axis motorized stage.
   - Evacuate load-lock and transfer into the main chamber to a high vacuum pressure $\le 5.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ mbar}$ (ion column operating pressure $\le 1.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ mbar}$).

2. **Feature Registration & Coincidence Alignment:**
   - Navigate via electron beam (SEM: $5.0\text{ kV}$, $100\text{ pA}$) to the targeted tungsten plug contact array. Target geometries correspond to the $0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ contact plugs adjacent to access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Adjust stage $Z$ to system eucentric height ($WD \approx 5.0\text{ mm}$). Tilt stage to the ion beam normal angle ($\theta = 52.0^\circ$).

3. **In-situ Protective Cap Deposition:**
   - Insert GIS nozzle (Pt or C precursor) to $100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ standoff distance above the Region of Interest (ROI).
   - Deposit a protective strap over the plug array ($15\text{ }\mu\text{m} \text{ length} \times 2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m} \text{ width} \times 1.5\text{ }\mu\text{m} \text{ thickness}$) using electron-beam-induced deposition (EBID: $2.0\text{ kV}$, $1.6\text{ nA}$) followed by ion-beam-induced deposition (IBID: $30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{ pA}$) to suppress curtaining during milling.

4. **Coarse Bulk Trench Sputter Milling:**
   - Define a regular cross-section (staircase / regular trapezoid) bulk excavation box directly in front of the protected face:
     - **Trench Width:** $18.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ (spanning multiple $0.34\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ pitch pitches and contact columns).
     - **Trench Depth (Z-mill):** $3.5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to fully expose the W-plug base, gate poly level, and diffusion substrate.
     - **Trench Length (front-to-back clearance):** $10.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to allow line-of-sight view for low-kV CD-SEM and EDS detectors.
   - Set $\text{Ga}^+$ ion beam operating conditions:
     - **Accelerating Voltage:** $30.0\text{ kV}$
     - **Beam Current:** $5.0\text{ nA}$ to $7.0\text{ nA}$ (bulk high-rate removal).
     - **Dwell Time:** $1.0\text{ }\mu\text{s}$, with $50\%$ digital pixel overlap.
     - **Raster Strategy:** Multi-pass serpentine or regular cross-section mode directing sputtered material out of the trench cavity.

5. **Staircase Relief & Coarse Face Clearance:**
   - Switch beam current to $1.0\text{ nA}$ at $30.0\text{ kV}$.
   - Perform a stepped relief cut along the outer trench wall to prevent re-deposition of sputtered Si/W back onto the ROI face.
   - Stop coarse milling when the trench sidewall reaches within $200\text{ nm} - 300\text{ nm}$ offset from the targeted contact centerlines.
   - Retract GIS, tilt stage back to SEM inspection geometry ($\theta = 0^\circ$ or $38^\circ$), and perform in-situ electron-beam confirmation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Bulk Trench Cavity Depth** | $\ge 3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | In-situ SEM cross-section profilometry |
| **Front Clearance Angle / Viewing Line-of-Sight** | $\ge 45^\circ \pm 3^\circ$ | Degrees ($^\circ$) | In-situ tilt-corrected SEM angular measurement |
| **Distance from Milling Front to Target ROI Face** | $250 \pm 50$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM top-down measurement |
| **Protective Cap Retained Thickness over Target** | $\ge 1.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Cross-sectional SEM imaging at $52^\circ$ tilt |

---

### 4. Context References & Traceability
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:** Applied unit cell geometries ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, W-plug contact interfaces, and stacked capacitor over bitline structure) to establish milling depth boundaries and alignment ROI targets.
- **[SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid]:** Implemented physical ground rules for contact hole dimension ($0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\text{ }\mu\text{m}$), minimum metal pitch ($0.34\text{ }\mu\text{m}$), and grid resolution ($0.005\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) to size milling box dimensions and ROI spacing.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Bulk Ga+ ion beam milling for 180nm node tungsten plug cross-sectioning introduces heavy gallium ion implantation into surrounding SiO2/Si matrices and produces curtaining artifacts across high-sputter-rate dielectric versus refractory tungsten interfaces. Sputter yields differ by >3x between SiO2 (~2.5 atoms/ion) and W (~1.0 atoms/ion at 30 keV), which leads to non-planar floor topography, redeposited metallic conductive halos, and severe focal drift if eucentric alignment and automated drift correction are not synchronized with the high-current 30kV:30nA bulk beam raster pattern.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Coarse trenching requires a stepped staircase geometry (rough mill >5 nA, step-down to ~1-3 nA) placed strictly 1.0 to 1.5 um away from the targeted 170nm x 170nm contact plug array to preserve the region of interest from amorphization, Ga contamination, and knock-on displacement. Over-etching into the underlying silicon active diffusion or excessive redeposition of sputtered tungsten onto adjacent dielectric side walls during high-current excavation can mask real post-CMP dishing, oxide erosion, and keyhole seam formation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Liquid Gallium (LMIS) source lifetimes are critically shortened under prolonged high-emission currents (continuous 30-50 nA runs); average LMIS lifetime degrades to <1500 beam hours. Additionally, supply chains for GIS (gas injection system) organometallic precursors (Pt/C or W protective capping) must maintain unbroken cryogenic or inert seal logistics with single-supplier qualification risks across regional foundry metrology labs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-beam FIB/SEM tool allocations operate as primary yield metrology bottlenecks during in-line CMP excursion triage; bulk trenching cycle times exceeding 25 minutes per sample directly threaten the 4-hour lot turnaround time (TAT) committed for post-CMP W-plug review before subsequent ILD-1 deposition gates.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Curtaining and striated uneven trench faces induced by disparate sputtering rates between the dense Tungsten plug matrix and adjacent BPSG/TEOS dielectric.
1. Direct structural damage and amorphization of the 170nm contact plug region of interest caused by ion beam misalignment, beam tail exposure, or lack of sacrificial Pt/C electron-beam protective strapping.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-1-2-01` | **Dual-Beam FIB Bulk Staircase Trench Milling Dimension & Alignment Verification** | Dual-Beam FIB-SEM System (FEI/Thermo Fisher Helios or Zeiss Crossbeam) with Gallium LMIS source and calibrated Secondary Electron Detector | 1. Position target contact plug array at 52-degree stage tilt normal to Ga+ ion column. 2. Define regular trapezoidal/staircase bulk trench pattern: 15.0 um width, 10.0 um depth, 8.0 um distance back from final cross-section line. 3. Initiate coarse bulk excavation using 30 kV acceleration voltage and 30 nA beam current with serpentine scan. 4. Automatically step down current to 9.2 nA at 80% depth and terminate milling at prescribed z-depth. 5. Rotate to e-beam column (5 kV, 0.4 nA) and capture in-lens SE image to measure trench bottom clearance and cross-section offset. | `Milled trench depth >= 4.5 um; front face standoff distance from target plug center line is 1.2 um +/- 0.2 um; no unmitigated redeposition layer exceeding 50 nm along trench floor.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-1-2-02` | **Post-Bulk Milling Amorphization and Gallium Implantation Perimeter Assessment** | In-line Ultra-High Resolution In-Lens BSE/SE Detector coupled with Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) drift-corrected mapping | 1. Acquire high-contrast BSE cross-section profile of the remaining coarse buffer wall. 2. Execute 256x200 pixel point-dwell EDS spectrum scan across the buffer wall toward the protected W-plug interface. 3. Quantify Ga L-alpha emission intensity (1.098 keV) as a function of lateral distance from the milled face. 4. Measure thickness of damaged/amorphized dielectric boundary layer via high-resolution SE imaging. | `Ga ion intrusion depth into the 1.0 um buffer zone does not exceed 150 nm (Ga atomic concentration < 0.1 at% at distance >= 200 nm from milled edge); amorphization layer thickness <= 45 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile Gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified Laser and UV/Scatter Safety Glasses, Conductive ESD lab coat, Vapor respirator for GIS organometallic precursor exchange
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with organometallic precursor or LMIS components, flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. In case of inhalation from vacuum exhaust leaks, move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For eye contact, rinse eyes immediately with sterile saline or eyewash station for 15 minutes and seek emergency medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous tool chassis negative-pressure exhaust coupled to dedicated industrial scrubbed toxic gas exhaust (minimum flow rate 120 CFM); turbo-molecular pump backing lines vented to dedicated fab pyrophoric/scrubbed ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent Ga LMIS emitters and GIS precursor ampoules must be sealed in argon-purged hazardous canisters and returned to accredited refining vendor; cleaning wipes containing residual solvents and organometallics sealed in dedicated heavy-duty polyethylene hazardous waste bins.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gallium (Liquid Metal Ion Source)** | `7440-55-3` | 99.9999% (6N) | `100.0%` |
| **Trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV) (GIS Precursor)** | `94442-22-5` | Semiconductor Grade | `>= 99.0%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-W-CMP cleaned and dried wafer surface with residual tungsten slurry fully scrubbed; oxide recess <= 30 nm, clean bare tungsten plugs with no native oxide exceeding 1.5 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Coarse-milled trench cavity under ultra-high vacuum or dry nitrogen transport; cross-section face intact with 1.0-1.5 um sacrificial barrier protecting W-plug target.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and galvanic oxidation at the exposed W/SiO2 interface forming volatile tungsten oxide species (WO3/W2O5) and moisture-induced amorphization boundary degradation prior to fine polish.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful coarse bulk excavation of a staircase trench adjacent to targeted 180nm tungsten contact plugs using 30 kV Ga+ ion beam, establishing a precise 1.2 um buffer standoff for subsequent fine-beam polish without amorphizing or contaminating the target contact cross-section.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FIB_COARSE_TRENCH_INSPECTION_SEM.tiff`
- [ ] `BULK_MILLING_PROFILE_METRIC_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `GA_IMPLANTATION_EDS_PROFILE.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Milled trench depth clearance beneath W-plug bottom boundary** | `5.0 um` | +/- 0.5 um | Calibrated 52-degree stage-compensated SE-SEM vertical fiducial measurement |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Buffer distance from bulk milling cut face to 170nm contact plug edge** | `1200 nm` | +/- 100 nm | Top-down SEM secondary electron in-lens metrology |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum bulk milling induced sidewall curtaining striation amplitude** | `15 nm` | <= 25 nm peak-to-valley | High-magnification cross-sectional BSE contrast line profile analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Trench geometry conforms to 15 um x 10 um footprint with minimum 4.5 um depth; sacrificial Pt/C capping layer intact with >1.0 um buffer between coarse trench edge and target W-plug; Ga+ ion lateral implantation into plug region confirmed below 0.1 at% by in-line EDS; verified by Lead Metrology Researcher.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Low-kV Ion Beam Polish & In-Situ Secondary Electron Interface Metrology
**Document Code:** `SOP-FAB-MET-180-WPLUG-CS08`  
**Process Step:** Metrology (Cross-Sectional Interface Quality & CD Metrology)  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Parent Pipeline:** CMP Overburden & Plug Recess Analysis > Dual-Beam FIB Cross-Sectioning > Low-kV Ion Beam Polish & In-Situ Metrology  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Pre-Polish Trench   │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Low-kV Focused Ga+  │
│   Ion Beam Polish    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Electron Beam     │
│  In-Situ Secondary   │
│   Electron Imaging   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Interface CD     │
│  Metrology & Defect  │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Physical Process & Execution Steps

1. **Pre-Polish Alignment & Stage Tilt Setup**:
   - Transfer wafer/coupon into the Dual-Beam FIB-SEM high-vacuum specimen chamber ($P \le 5.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ mbar}$).
   - Set stage eucentric tilt to $52.0^\circ$ (matching the ion-to-electron column coincident angle).
   - Align the cross-section trench of the post-CMP Tungsten (W) plug contact via (drain contact leading to the stacked capacitor node over bitline) under the coincident point of electron and ion beams.

2. **Low-kV Ga$^+$ Ion Beam Final Polish**:
   - Switch liquid metal ion source ($\text{Ga}^+$) from coarse bulk-milling voltage down to low-kV cleaning mode: **$5.0\text{ kV}$ beam energy**, beam current **$40\text{ pA}$**.
   - Execute a fine sweeping cleaning cross-section pass across the face of the exposed tungsten plug and ILD dielectric boundary with an incidence angle glancing at $0.5^\circ - 1.5^\circ$ relative to the cross-section cut plane.
   - Restrict total polishing duration to $15 - 30\text{ seconds}$ to eliminate amorphous redeposition/curtaining without inducing curtaining artifacts or recessing the W-plug boundary.

3. **In-Situ Secondary Electron (SE) Immersion Field Imaging**:
   - De-energize the ion beam scanning; switch to high-resolution Field Emission SEM column.
   - Accelerating voltage: **$1.0\text{ kV} - 2.0\text{ kV}$** (low landing energy to maximize material contrast at the boundary and prevent charging of ILD and capacitor dielectrics); beam current: **$15\text{ pA} - 30\text{ pA}$**.
   - Detect secondary electrons using the In-Lens SE detector (Through-the-Lens Detector, TLD-SE) in high-resolution immersion mode at a working distance $\text{WD} = 3.5 - 4.0\text{ mm}$.

4. **In-Situ Interface Metrology & Defect Extraction**:
   - Calibrate magnification standards across horizontal and vertical axes at $\ge 150{,}000\times$.
   - Extract critical dimensions (CD): access transistor drain contact / W-plug interface width, bitline contact spacing, and surrounding dielectric sidewalls.
   - Screen for seam voids, delamination micro-cracks at the W-plug/liner boundary, and residual tungsten CMP smear or bridging.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180.0` | $\pm 9.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-situ calibrated CD-SEM line-scan |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220.0` | $\pm 11.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-situ calibrated CD-SEM line-scan |
| **Bitline / Wordline Pitch** | `360.0 - 400.0` | Nominal range | $\text{nm}$ | In-situ SE pitch profile measurement |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | `3.5` | $\pm 0.3$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-Lens SE edge contrast profile |

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Context Sources

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Confirms unit cell geometry: access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture connected to drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Confirms bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms thermally grown gate oxide dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Milling at high ion currents (>1 nA at 30 kV) leaves an amorphous damage layer and Ga+ implantation depth exceeding 20-30 nm in silicon and tungsten, which severely distorts true contact interface contrast. Stepping down sequentially to 5 kV and finally 2 kV (at 10-40 pA) is mandatory to reduce the surface amorphous layer thickness to <2 nm. Stage tilt and beam-sample geometry must be calibrated dynamically to prevent curtaining artifacts caused by the density differential between tungsten plugs (19.3 g/cm3) and SiO2 inter-layer dielectric (2.2 g/cm3).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Secondary electron (SE) image contrast across the W/Ti/TiN/SiO2 boundary relies heavily on work function disparities and surface cleanliness. In-situ low-kV polish eliminates redeposition and native oxide growth prior to high-resolution cross-sectional metrology. Beam deceleration mode (immersion lens with negative sample bias of -1 kV to -2 kV) should be engaged during 1 kV to 2 kV SEM observation to maintain sub-nanometer probe diameter, minimize charging on the ILD, and accurately resolve the 10 nm to 15 nm Ti/TiN adhesion/barrier liner profile.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Liquid Gallium ion sources (LMIS) for FIB columns are single-source consumables subject to supply lead times of 8 to 14 weeks and high replacement costs. Standardizing recipe parameters across Gen 3 wafer lots to avoid source arcing, maintaining chamber base vacuum better than 5e-7 mbar, and budgeting source operating hours per lamella are necessary to prevent unplanned tool downtime during defect review runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Low-kV polishing adds 12 to 20 minutes per cross-section site, creating a metrology cycle bottleneck for post-CMP Tungsten plug process control. Automated endpoint detection based on secondary electron flux monitoring must be established to terminate the 2 kV polish routine automatically once redeposited curtaining is cleared, preserving target throughput for tapeout validation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Over-polishing leading to differential milling recess (trenching) at the TiN/W interface, skewing cross-sectional plug width measurements by >15 nm.
1. High-kV gallium implantation induced amorphization concealing subtle voiding or seam defects at the core of the 180nm tungsten contact plug.
1. Hydrocarbon-induced electron beam carbon deposition on the polished cross-section face during extended low-kV in-situ imaging, obscuring secondary electron interface resolution.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-1-3-01` | **Low-kV Ion Beam Damage Layer & Curtaining Removal Verification** | Dual-Beam FIB-SEM (Focused Ion Beam / Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope) with Ga+ LMIS column and In-Lens SE Detector | 1. Tilt stage to grazing incidence angle (±1.5° offset from 30 kV milling angle). 2. Step FIB accelerating voltage down to 5 kV at 45 pA; perform sweep polish for 90 seconds across the 5 µm x 3 µm cross-section face. 3. Reduce FIB voltage to 2 kV at 15 pA; perform final surface clean polish for 120 seconds. 4. Switch to Electron Column at 1.5 kV, 50 pA beam current with Immersion Lens mode enabled. 5. Acquire 20,000x and 100,000x calibrated SEM micrographs across 5 consecutive tungsten plug interfaces. | `Amorphous Ga-damaged surface skin layer thickness must be <= 2.5 nm; residual vertical curtaining amplitude across W/SiO2 boundary must be < 1.0 nm; W/TiN interface delineation must show zero visible redeposition bridging.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-1-3-02` | **In-Situ SE Interface Contrast and Plug Recess Metrology** | High-Resolution Dual-Beam FE-SEM with calibrated secondary electron detector (ETD/TLD-SE) and automated line-scan CD metrology software | 1. Align cross-section face strictly perpendicular to SEM optical axis (stage tilt = 52° or equivalent e-beam normal alignment). 2. Set SEM conditions: HV = 1.0 kV, landing energy = 1.0 keV (stage bias 0 V), beam current = 25 pA, working distance = 4.0 mm. 3. Acquire 150,000x magnification secondary electron image with 2048x1784 resolution and 32-frame drift-compensated integration. 4. Perform secondary electron intensity profile line-scans across W plug center, TiN liner, and surrounding oxide ILD. 5. Measure plug recess relative to top oxide plane and barrier liner thickness. | `Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) of SE interface profile >= 15:1; distinct grayscale inflection corresponding to 10 nm nominal Ti/TiN liner resolved; Tungsten plug recess metrology repeatability 3-sigma <= 1.5 nm across 10 repeated scans.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving recommended during chamber access), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact safety glasses, Lint-free cleanroom bunny suit and hood, Conductive ESD wrist strap or heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with cleaning solvent (IPA), flush affected area immediately with clean deionized water for at least 15 minutes. In case of mechanical pinch or cold burn during liquid nitrogen anti-contaminator refill, warm injured tissue gently with lukewarm water and seek immediate medical evaluation. If Gallium contamination occurs on broken skin, wash thoroughly with soap and water, remove contaminated clothing, and consult cleanroom occupational health personnel.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom HVAC with minimum 60 air changes per hour; dedicated vacuum roughing pump exhaust lines connected directly to facility toxic/solvent scrubbed exhaust; dry nitrogen venting line for chamber purge.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent Ga ion source modules must be bagged in static-shielding hazardous material containers and returned to supplier for metal reclamation. IPA-soaked cleanroom wipers must be disposed of in dedicated hazardous solvent waste bins with self-closing lids.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gallium (Liquid Metal Ion Source)** | `7440-55-3` | 99.9999% (6N) | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (Chamber/Stage wipe down)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Chamber venting)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra High Purity (UHP 5.0) | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-bulk FIB trench cross-section cut completed at 30 kV Ga+; sample maintained under high vacuum (< 5e-6 mbar) or transferred via nitrogen-purged FOUP/shuttle box.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Low-damage (< 2 nm amorphous layer), polished cross-sectional face free of redeposited debris and Ga clustering, ready for TEM lamella lift-out or automated CD-SEM interface logging.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes native oxidation of the exposed tungsten plug and titanium barrier interfaces, altering secondary electron emission yield, distorting barrier dimension measurements by >3 nm, and inducing carbon contamination build-up during subsequent e-beam irradiation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful execution of low-kV (<= 2 kV) Ga+ ion beam fine polishing on tungsten contact plug cross-sections, achieving an ultra-smooth, damage-free interface that allows sub-nanometer secondary electron metrology of the W/Ti/TiN/SiO2 stack without curtaining artifacts.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_Plug_LowKV_Polish_Interface_Metrology_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `CrossSection_W_TiN_Liner_LineScan_Data.csv`
- [ ] `Calibrated_HighRes_SE_Interface_Micrographs.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual amorphous surface damage layer thickness post 2 kV Ga+ polish** | `1.8` | ±0.5 nm | High-resolution in-situ electron-beam contrast analysis / TEM cross-section verification |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Tungsten plug-to-oxide recess depth measurement repeatability** | `12.0` | ±1.5 nm (3-sigma) | Automated in-situ SE edge-detection profilometry line-scans across 10 sample plugs |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Ti/TiN barrier liner thickness measurement fidelity** | `12.5` | ±1.0 nm | Secondary electron peak-to-valley line profile inflection differentiation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five consecutive tungsten contact cross-sections demonstrate complete elimination of curtaining lines, amorphous damage layer verified <= 2.3 nm, SNR >= 15:1 across the TiN/W interface, and full alignment with post-CMP defect review metrology specifications documented and approved by the metrology lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## In-Line High-Resolution CD-SEM Profile & Plug Recess Metrology
**Module:** Metrology & Post-CMP Quality Assurance | **Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**File Created:** [`sop_cd_sem_plug_recess_metrology.md`](./docs/metrology/sop_cd_sem_plug_recess_metrology.md)

---

### 1. Operational Flowchart & Metrology Target Distribution

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Loading & Global Navigation:**
   - Transfer wafer from the post-CMP cleaning and dry module into the CD-SEM chamber under high vacuum ($P < 1.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).
   - Run optical pattern recognition on scribe-line fiducials for global die and coordinate grid alignment.
2. **Low-Voltage Beam Tuning & Charge Mitigation:**
   - Configure electron landing energy $V_{\text{acc}} = 500\text{ V} - 800\text{ V}$ with beam current $I_{\text{beam}} = 8\text{ pA} - 15\text{ pA}$ to eliminate electron-induced charging on surrounding ILD oxide.
   - Execute automated focus, astigmatism correction, and aperture centering at $200\text{k}\times$ magnification on a calibrated standard target.
3. **Top-Down In-Line CD Metrology:**
   - Acquire top-down secondary electron images across 9 dedicated array inspection sites (center, mid-radius, wafer edge).
   - Measure contact critical dimensions: length axis ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) and width axis ($W = 220\text{ nm}$) on bitline and drain storage node plugs.
   - Verify array line/space pitch against the cell specification grid ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
4. **Tilted-Beam Recess & Profile Metrology:**
   - Tilt the electron beam column / stage to $\theta = 15^\circ - 30^\circ$.
   - Extract W-plug recess depth relative to adjacent ILD oxide using backscattered electron (BSE) material contrast and secondary electron edge gradient derivatives.
5. **Voltage-Contrast (VC) Residual Metal Inspection & Lot Disposition:**
   - Perform bright-field voltage-contrast line scanning to identify residual tungsten bridging/stringers across array pitches or center-seam voids.
   - Upload measured profiles and lot statistics to the MES; auto-disposition lot to stacked capacitor deposition if acceptance limits are satisfied.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Nominal Target | Upper / Lower Specification Limit | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **W-Plug Critical Dimension (Length Axis $L$)** | **180** | $180 \pm 10$ | nm |
| **W-Plug Critical Dimension (Width Axis $W$)** | **220** | $220 \pm 12$ | nm |
| **Array Wordline / Bitline Pitch** | **360 – 400** | $[345, 415]$ | nm |
| **Post-CMP Plug Recess Depth** | **25** | $\le 35$ (max allowable recess) | nm |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
  - Access transistor channel geometry: length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells; stacked capacitor erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - Cell layout topology and array pitch specification: bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-2-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-2-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

# Standard Operating Procedure: Cross-Sectional EDS Microanalysis & Residual Metal Defect Mapping

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-3-01` | **Thermosonic Ball Wirebond Shear & Wire Pull Mechanical Strength Test** | Dage 4000 / Nordson Microtester Bond Pull & Ball Shear Test System | 1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-3-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with uncured epoxy: Wash with copious soap and warm water (do not use solvents like acetone which increase dermal absorption). Eye contact with silica dicing slurry: Flush at eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dicing saw fully enclosed with continuous high-volume DI water mist shroud. Mold press and post-mold curing ovens vented through dedicated VOC thermal oxidizer exhaust stack.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Silicon dicing slurry centrifuged and segregated into solid cake for non-hazardous landfill. Cured thermoset epoxy scrap disposed of as regulated solid waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Epoxy Novolac Resin (Mold Compound)** | `29690-82-2` | Semiconductor Packaging Grade | `Solid pellet / transfer mold compound` |
| **Amorphous Silica Filler** | `14808-60-7` | Sub-micron spherical particle | `75-88 wt% in epoxy mold compound` |
| **Silver-Filled Conductive Die Attach Adhesive** | `7440-22-4` | Electronic Grade Silver Flake | `70-80 wt% Ag in epoxy base` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Saw-diced wafer mounted on UV dicing tape, clean and dry with zero particulate or water residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Epoxy die-attached, cured, and thermosonically wirebonded to leadframe/substrate pads prior to molding.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation of exposed aluminum/copper bond pads degrades thermosonic ball bond adhesion, inducing high electrical contact resistance or catastrophic non-stick bond pad lifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Cross-Sectional EDS Microanalysis & Residual Metal Defect Mapping: BEOL metallization, electrical die sort (EDS), wafer backgrinding/dicing, and wirebond plastic encapsulation successfully yield JEDEC-qualified DRAM packaged units.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Electrical_Die_Sort_Wafer_Yield_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Wirebond_Ball_Shear_And_Pull_CPK_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `JEDEC_TSOP54_Final_ATE_SpeedBin_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wirebond ball shear strength** | `>= 18.0 gf` | Minimum failure load >= 15.0 gf across 30 samples | Dage 4000 micro-tester lateral ball shear per MIL-STD-883 |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) wafer array functional yield** | `>= 90.0%` | Minimum yield >= 85.0% on prime wafers | Automated wafer probe array test with March C- diagnostic patterns |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Packaged DRAM package coplanarity & lead pitch** | `<= 0.08 mm coplanarity` | JEDEC TSOP-54 mechanical envelope tolerance (+/- 0.05 mm) | Optical 3D coordinate measuring machine (CMM) metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% passing electrical continuity and JEDEC parametric DC checks; destructive wirebond shear CPK >= 1.67 with zero package voiding or delamination detected under scanning acoustic microscopy (C-SAM).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dual-Beam FIB Precision Cross-Section Lamella Preparation of W-Plug Array

- **Document ID:** `SOP-MET-FIB-180NM-001`
- **Module:** Metrology / Failure Analysis (FA) & Defect Metrology
- **Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 3)
- **Action Type:** Make / In-Situ Specimen Preparation

---

### 1. Process Flow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Surface Protection   │
│     GIS Deposition     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Bulk Rough Trench    │
│        Milling         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   U-Cut & OmniProbe    │
│   In-Situ Extraction   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    OmniProbe Needle    │
│  Weld to Cu Half-Grid  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Multi-Stage Thinning  │
│   & Low-kV Amorphous   │
│         Polish         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Chamber Setup and Coincident Point Alignment:**
   - Load post-CMP 180nm DRAM wafer coupon onto the stage; pump load-lock below $5.0 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{mbar}$.
   - Position stage at eucentric height ($WD = 5.0\,\text{mm}$); register coincidence point between electron beam ($SEM$: $5.0\,\text{kV}$, $0.10\,\text{nA}$) and Ga$^+$ focused ion beam ($FIB$: $30\,\text{kV}$).
   - Locate targeted tungsten plug (W-plug) contact array adjacent to access transistor channels ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$) and bitline/wordline interconnect grid.

2. **Protective Cap Deposition via Gas Injection System (GIS):**
   - Insert Pt GIS needle $100\,\mu\text{m}$ above ROI.
   - Deposit electron-beam-assisted protective Pt cap ($2.0\,\text{kV}$, $1.6\,\text{nA}$) to a thickness of $0.5\,\mu\text{m}$ across an area of $2.5\,\mu\text{m} \times 18\,\mu\text{m}$ to prevent curtaining and beam damage on post-CMP W-plug recesses.
   - Deposit subsequent ion-beam Pt cap ($30\,\text{kV}$, $80\,\text{pA}$) to an additional thickness of $1.5\,\mu\text{m}$ (total cap $\ge 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$).

3. **High-Current Bulk Trench Milling:**
   - Tilt stage to $52.0^\circ$ (normal to Ga$^+$ FIB column).
   - Mill front and rear bulk clearance trenches using $30\,\text{kV}$ Ga$^+$ beam at $7.0\,\text{nA}$ to $9.0\,\text{nA}$ down to a depth of $6.0\,\mu\text{m}$ and width of $12\,\mu\text{m}$, isolating a lamella chunk of approximately $1.5\,\mu\text{m}$ thickness centered along the array pitch ($360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$).

4. **Undercut (U-Cut) & In-Situ OmniProbe Lift-Out:**
   - Tilt stage to $0.0^\circ$ and mill lateral side cuts at $30\,\text{kV}$, $1.0\,\text{nA}$.
   - Tilt stage to $22.0^\circ$ and perform bottom undercut (U-cut) leaving a $1.0\,\mu\text{m}$ stabilizing tab.
   - Return stage to $0.0^\circ$; insert tungsten OmniProbe needle and dock micro-manipulator tip onto the top corner of the lamella.
   - Weld OmniProbe tip with GIS Pt patch ($30\,\text{kV}$, $50\,\text{pA}$, $1.5\,\mu\text{m} \times 1.5\,\mu\text{m}$). Sever remaining support tab at $30\,\text{kV}$, $0.3\,\text{nA}$, and retract probe with the extracted lamella.

5. **Mounting on Omniprobe Cu Half-Grid:**
   - Translate stage to align lamella against a post of a 3-post Copper (Cu) TEM half-grid.
   - Solder lamella to grid post using Pt deposition ($30\,\text{kV}$, $80\,\text{pA}$).
   - Mill off OmniProbe connection at $30\,\text{kV}$, $0.5\,\text{nA}$, and retract manipulator.

6. **Graded Thinning & Low-kV Amorphous Layer Cleaning:**
   - Coarse thinning: $30\,\text{kV}$ at $0.3\,\text{nA}$ rocking stage $\pm 1.5^\circ$ until lamella thickness reaches $300\,\text{nm}$.
   - Medium thinning: $16\,\text{kV}$ at $100\,\text{pA}$ until lamella thickness reaches $150\,\text{nm}$.
   - Fine thinning: $5.0\,\text{kV}$ at $40\,\text{pA}$ rocking stage $\pm 3.0^\circ$ until thickness reaches $60\,\text{nm} - 70\,\text{nm}$, revealing cross-sections of the W-plug array without missing the $180\,\text{nm}$ channel/contact interfaces.
   - Final surface polish: $2.0\,\text{kV}$ at $15\,\text{pA}$ to $20\,\text{pA}$ (or $1.0\,\text{kV}$ low-kV clean) at grazing incidence ($\pm 5.0^\circ$) to strip gallium implantation and reduce the surface amorphous damage layer to $< 2.0\,\text{nm}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░                                     │
Parallel Dev (deg)┤░                                     │
                  │▒                                     │
   Max Amorph (nm)┤▒                                     │
 W-Plug Pitch (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 Target Thick (nm)┤███████                               │
                  │███████                               │
                  └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                   0       95        190      285     380 
```

1. **Lamella Final Thickness:**
   - Target: **$65\,\text{nm} \pm 5\,\text{nm}$** across the entire active region (machine-measured via TEM/STEM low-loss EELS mean-free-path thickness map $t/\lambda$ and in-line HAADF-STEM).
2. **W-Plug Array Center-to-Center Pitch Alignment:**
   - Target: **$380\,\text{nm} \pm 20\,\text{nm}$** (matching the $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$ bitline/wordline contact pitch, verified via calibrated in-line CD-SEM / STEM measurement over at least 5 consecutive plugs without curtaining artifacts).
3. **Residual Amorphous Surface Damage Layer:**
   - Target: **$\le 2.0\,\text{nm}$** per sidewall (verified via high-resolution TEM [HRTEM] lattice fringe projection of single-crystal silicon substrate along the $\langle 110 \rangle$ zone axis).
4. **Lamella Sidewall Planarity & Parallelism Deviation:**
   - Target: **$\le 0.5^\circ$** wedge angle from top Pt capping down through W-plug / drain interface to substrate Si (measured by cross-sectional tilt tomography).

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

- **[1] 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Context:* Governs unit cell dimensions with access transistor channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, channel width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$, folded bitline layout ($8F^2 / 6F^2$), and the tungsten plug (W-plug) connection structure between drain contacts and stacked capacitor bottom electrodes.
- **[2] Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Context:* Establishes wordline and bitline pitch at approximately $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$, specifying physical integration constraints necessary for locating and cross-sectioning periodic W-plug rows without missing target plug cores.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-beam FIB milling of dense high-aspect-ratio 180nm W-plug arrays (channel L=180nm, contact pitch ~400-500nm) introduces severe differential milling rates (curtaining effects) between refractory tungsten (Z=74) and adjacent SiO2 inter-layer dielectric (ILD). A robust dual-layer capping scheme (in-situ electron-beam Pt followed by ion-beam Pt or C deposition) is mandatory to suppress curtaining and prevent Ga+ ion implantation and amorphization of the critical W/TiN/barrier interface.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, maintaining structural integrity across the shared drain contact W-plug requires precise lamella final thinning below 60 nm thickness for transmission EDS/TEM inspection. Final polishing must step down from 30 kV Ga+ coarse milling to 5 kV and finally 2 kV (10-20 pA) low-kV polishing to eliminate the amorphous Ga-damaged surface skin (<2 nm) while avoiding preferential over-etching of the softer oxide matrix surrounding the dense metal plugs.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-source vulnerability on FIB consumable components—specifically liquid metal ion sources (LMIS Ga sources with ~1500 hour operational lifetimes), organometallic precursor gas injection cartridges (MeCpPtMe3 for platinum deposition), and Cu/Mo TEM half-grids—can stall physical failure analysis turnaround times. Pre-emptive sourcing and stocking of alternative Omniprobe/Kleindiek tungsten extraction needles and multi-aperture strip assemblies are critical for continuous MPW lot profiling.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-beam lamella extraction requires an average FIB tool allocation of 2.5 to 3.5 hours per sample site. Uncalibrated GIS flux or drift during automated unattended overnight cuts will burn limited metrology budgets and destroy unrecoverable MPW die sites. Process boundaries must define explicit fiducial alignment checkpoints and automated beam-current interlocks before high-current bulk trenching begins.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Curtaining and striation artifacts propagating across the W-plug array due to insufficient or uneven protective Pt cap thickness and large sputter-yield mismatches between W and ILD oxide.
1. Mechanical collapse, redeposition bridging, or bending of the lamella during final 2 kV Ga+ thinning below 50 nm, rendering cross-sectional EDS line scans non-interpretable.
1. Omniprobe micromanipulator micro-welding failure or electrostatic discharge (ESD) spark during in-situ lift-out, resulting in catastrophic loss or fracture of the extracted specimen.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-3-1-01` | **Protective Cap Integrity and Lamella Uniformity Assessment** | Dual-Beam FIB/FE-SEM (e.g., Thermo Fisher Helios / FEI Strata 400S) with in-situ Secondary Electron & In-Lens Detectors | 1. Locate target 180nm W-plug array using 2 kV e-beam to avoid premature Ga contamination. 2. Deposit electron-beam-assisted protective Pt strap (15 um x 2 um) to a nominal thickness of 0.5 um using 2 kV / 1.6 nA. 3. Deposit ion-beam-assisted protective Pt strap (15 um x 2 um) to a thickness of 2.0 um using 30 kV / 80 pA. 4. Mill fiducial cross-markers adjacent to target window and perform dual bulk staircase trenching at 30 kV / 9.3 nA on both sides. 5. Measure cross-sectional Pt cap thickness uniformity across 10 equidistant points along the lamella length via in-situ tilt SEM imaging. | `Total protective Pt cap thickness must measure 2.5 um +/- 0.2 um with zero pinhole voids; thickness variation across the 15 um length must be <= 6.0%.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-2-3-3-3-1-02` | **Final Thinning Thickness and Amorphous Damage Layer Verification** | Dual-Beam FIB-SEM equipped with STEM detector (BF/DF) and Oxford Instruments EDS system | 1. Perform intermediate thinning steps at 30 kV / 0.28 nA down to 300 nm thickness. 2. Step down ion energy to 16 kV / 50 pA to thin the target window down to 150 nm. 3. Execute fine polishing at 5 kV / 20 pA at +/- 2 deg over-tilt until target window reaches <80 nm. 4. Perform final surface cleanup at 2 kV / 15 pA at +/- 5 deg over-tilt for 60 seconds per face to strip the Ga-damaged amorphous layer. 5. Acquire STEM Bright-Field images and EDS line profiles across the center W-plug to ILD interface to evaluate lamella thickness and residual Ga surface concentration. | `Final lamella thickness across the active W-plug array must measure between 45 nm and 65 nm; residual Ga contamination at the W/ILD barrier interface must be <= 1.5 at.% by EDS.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact splash safety goggles, ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive heel straps, Cleanroom face mask (filtering organic vapor and particulates)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with organometallic precursor or solvent: immediately flush affected skin with copious flowing water for minimum 15 minutes, remove contaminated PPE, and wash with mild non-abrasive soap. For eye contact: flush eyes immediately at eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmologist evaluation. For thermal burns from GIS cartridge heater: cool immediately with cold water pack; do not apply salves.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB roughing and turbo-molecular dry scroll pump exhaust lines must be plumbed directly into the cleanroom dedicated hazardous VOC/toxic house exhaust ducting operating under negative pressure (min 50 Pa static differential). Precursor cartridge exchange must occur under a certified local laminar exhaust snorkel (face velocity >= 0.5 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent GIS platinum precursor crucibles and used Ga ion source emitters must be sealed in airtight, antistatic hazardous waste containers labelled with CAS numbers and returned to specialized precious metal/toxic metal reclaimers. Solvent-soaked wipes must be sealed in airtight hazardous VOC bins for certified incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV) (GIS Pt precursor)** | `94442-22-5` | Sublimed Electronic Grade | `>= 99.0%` |
| **Gallium (Liquid Metal Ion Source)** | `7440-55-3` | High Purity Electronic 6N | `99.9999%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - Chamber and stub cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Grade | `>= 99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-W-CMP wafer coupon cleaned via megasonic DIW rinse and spin dried; tungsten plug recess <= 15 nm below ILD surface; zero slurry particle contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Final-polished ultra-thin lamella (<65 nm) mounted on Cu TEM grid, free of redeposited sputtered metal debris, preserved under vacuum or hermetic purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure limits causes native oxidation of the polished W-plug core (forming volatile/porous WO3) and rapid atmospheric moisture condensation on the ultra-thin (<65 nm) lamella membranes, causing membrane buckling, curtaining artifact amplification, and severe interfacial EDS quantification errors.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed preparation and extraction of a site-specific, ultra-thin cross-sectional TEM lamella centered across the 180nm DRAM memory cell tungsten plug array, demonstrating uniform thickness, absence of curtaining, and clean interfaces for high-resolution EDS and CD-SEM defect metrology.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FIB_WPLUG_LAMELLA_PREP_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `FIB_FINAL_POLISH_STEM_SE_IMAGERY.tiff`
- [ ] `W_PLUG_INTERFACE_EDS_LINEPROFILE.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **Final lamella uniform membrane thickness across target W-plug array** | `55.0 nm` | +/- 10.0 nm | In-situ low-kV STEM/SEM transmission imaging calibrated against cross-grating standard |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface amorphous Ga-implantation damage layer thickness per side** | `1.8 nm` | <= 2.5 nm | HR-STEM lattice fringe projection analysis at W-plug / SiO2 boundary |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum W-plug curtaining striation depth across active ILD trench** | `0.0 nm` | <= 3.0 nm | In-lens tilt SE profilometry across polished lamella cross-section |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: High-Resolution EDS Spectral Imaging and Elemental Line Scan Calibration
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology > Cross-Sectional EDS Microanalysis & Residual Metal Defect Mapping > High-Resolution EDS Spectral Imaging and Elemental Line Scan Calibration  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Purpose & Process Flow
This SOP details the calibration and execution of high-resolution Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) spectral imaging and elemental line scans across cross-sectioned post-CMP tungsten (W) contact plugs, bitline contacts, and stacked capacitor bottom contacts in a 180nm DRAM cell architecture.

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│          Cross-Section Lamella Prep          │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│        SEM Beam Calibration & Tuning         │
│          (Primary Energy: 5-15 keV)          │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│         EDS Gain & Energy Calibration        │
│          (Cu / Mn / C Zero & Gain)           │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│       Elemental Line Scan Acquisition        │
│          Across W-Plug / ILD Matrix          │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│       Spectral Imaging & Overburden /        │
│          Residue Deconvolution               │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Specimen Preparation & Vacuum Loading
1. Load the prepared FIB/cleaved cross-sectional DRAM wafer piece onto the SEM stage.
2. Evacuate the analysis chamber to a high vacuum pressure $\le 5.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$ ($\le 5 \times 10^{-6}\text{ mbar}$) to prevent hydrocarbon contamination during beam dwell.
3. Set the analytical working distance strictly to the EDS detector coplanar focal point (nominally $8.5\text{ mm}$ to $10.0\text{ mm}$, dependent on detector geometry).

#### Step 2: Electron Beam & Optics Alignment
1. Configure SEM beam accelerating voltage:
   - Use $15\text{ keV}$ for standard tungsten characteristic line excitation ($W\text{-L}\alpha$ at $8.396\text{ keV}$, $W\text{-M}\alpha$ at $1.774\text{ keV}$) and high-k metal lines ($Ta\text{-L}\alpha$).
   - Drop to $5\text{ keV}$ when resolving narrow interfacial regions across the gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) and high-k stack equivalent oxide thickness ($3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$) to minimize the electron beam interaction volume.
2. Adjust beam current to maintain an EDS detector dead time between $20\%$ and $35\%$.
3. Center condenser aperture, correct astigmatism at $\ge 100{,}000\times$ magnification over a standard reference landmark.

#### Step 3: EDS Spectral Calibration (Gain & Resolution)
1. Perform zero-peak and gain calibration using a known standard (e.g., standard Cu grid or Faraday cup reference):
   - Measure $Cu\text{-K}\alpha$ at $8.046\text{ keV}$ and $Cu\text{-L}\alpha$ at $0.930\text{ keV}$ or zero-strobe peak.
   - Verify detector energy resolution (FWHM at $Mn\text{-K}\alpha \le 130\text{ eV}$).
2. Confirm peak channel calibration drift is within $\pm 5\text{ eV}$ prior to production line scanning.

#### Step 4: High-Resolution Line Scan Setup & Execution
1. Navigate to the post-CMP contact array containing the access transistor drains and tungsten plugs connected to the stacked capacitor nodes.
2. Define a linear scan path of length $600\text{ nm}$ to $800\text{ nm}$ positioned perpendicular to the tungsten plug sidewall, encompassing:
   - Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD: $SiO_2 / Si_3N_4$)
   - Barrier layer (Ti/TiN, $10\text{--}15\text{ nm}$)
   - Tungsten plug core ($W$, access channel width footprint $W = 220\text{ nm}$, gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$)
   - Adjacent ILD matrix
3. Set scan sampling density: minimum 128 points per line scan (spatial resolution $\le 5\text{ nm/point}$), with pixel dwell time $\ge 100\text{ ms/point}$ or accumulate $\ge 100$ sweeps to achieve signal-to-noise ratio $\ge 15:1$ on the $W\text{-M}\alpha$ and $Si\text{-K}\alpha$ peaks.

#### Step 5: Spectral Deconvolution & 2D Elemental Mapping
1. Acquire a 2D HyperSpectral Map over an array area of $1.5\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.5\ \mu\text{m}$ covering the tungsten plug top recess and adjacent dielectric.
2. Run net count background subtraction using polynomial Bremsstrahlung modeling.
3. Deconvolve overlapping spectral lines (specifically $W\text{-M}\alpha$ at $1.774\text{ keV}$ and $Si\text{-K}\alpha$ at $1.740\text{ keV}$, $\Delta E \approx 34\text{ eV}$).
4. Check for residual tungsten streaks/overburden across the ILD field to evaluate CMP clear endpoint performance.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria

```text
                   DRAM 180nm Cell & Capacitance Metrics
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░                                   │
     Leakage Limit┤░                                   │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒                               │
Capacitance Target┤▒▒▒▒▒                               │
          Access W┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
          Access L┤██████████████████████████████      │
                  │██████████████████████████████      │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0       55       110     165     220 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target | Measurement Method | Verification Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **EDS Energy Calibration Accuracy** | Peak centroid drift $\le \pm 5\text{ eV}$ (relative to $Cu\text{-K}\alpha$ / $Cu\text{-L}\alpha$ or $Mn\text{-K}\alpha$) | Spectral reference calibration routine | $\text{eV}$ |
| **Spectral Spatial Step Resolution** | Point-to-point step size $\le 5.0\text{ nm}$ across the $180\text{ nm}$ gate length / $220\text{ nm}$ plug width | Calibrated Line Scan Profilometry | $\text{nm/pixel}$ |
| **$W\text{-M}\alpha$ / $Si\text{-K}\alpha$ Peak Deconvolution Residual** | Signal deconvolution overlap error $\le 3.0\%$ across the $W$/ILD interface | Non-linear least squares fit ($1.740\text{ keV}$ vs $1.774\text{ keV}$) | $\%$ |
| **Inter-Plug Surface Residual Tungsten Defect Density** | Residual $W$ net spectral peak intensity below background noise floor ($3\sigma$ threshold, $0\text{ counts/field}$ above baseline) | Post-CMP EDS 2D Spectral Area Scan | $\text{counts} / \text{defects per field}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
- **Access Transistor Dimensions**: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ connecting via W-plug to stacked capacitor over bitline (COB). *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench)*.
- **Dielectric & Interfacial Stack**: ONO or $Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ dielectric stacks with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$, requiring minimized beam interaction volume for interfacial profiling. Gate oxide physical thickness is $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$. *(Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering)*.
- **Cell Retention & Target Performance**: Storage capacitor capacitance target $\ge 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ (minimum $28\text{ fF}$), retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$. *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench & Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering)*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: High-resolution EDS spectral imaging and line scan calibration across 180nm tungsten (W) plug contact arrays must integrate directly into the defect classification feed without bottlenecking in-line CD-SEM wafer throughput. Spatial deconvolution algorithms must account for the electron interaction volume in SiO2 dielectric and W at 5-15 keV beam energies to prevent false positive residual metal bridging calls.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating EDS elemental line scans across sub-200nm contact plug boundaries requires strict discrimination between W M-alpha (1.775 keV) and Si K-alpha (1.740 keV) peaks due to severe energy overlap (delta E ~ 35 eV) which exceeds standard SDD energy resolution (~125-130 eV at Mn K-alpha). Deconvolution using calibrated standard reference spectra or W L-alpha (8.398 keV) line monitoring at accelerating voltages >= 10 keV is mandatory.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring a high-brightness FEG-SEM equipped with an ultra-thin window or windowless Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) with collection solid angle > 0.1 sr and pulse processor throughput > 1,000,000 cps carries a 16-24 week procurement lead time. Certified BAM or NIST certified magnification and W-Si calibration standards (e.g., NIST SRM 2060/2800) must be pre-cleared for cleanroom delivery.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tool commissioning, vendor FAT/SAT signoffs, and baseline line-scan recipes across post-W-CMP test dies must be completed within 14 operational days to avoid gatekeeping the post-CMP defect review signoff and subsequent inter-metal dielectric (IMD-1) deposition lot splits.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Spectral peak misidentification between W M-alpha (1.775 keV) and Si K-alpha (1.740 keV) causing phantom residual tungsten calls on clear dielectric inter-plug fields.
1. Hydrocarbon contamination cracking and beam-induced carbon deposition during dwell-intensive line scanning, degrading X-ray signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and pinning localized surface charge.
1. Interaction volume bloat at elevated accelerating voltages (>15 keV) expanding lateral electron diffusion beyond 250 nm, washing out boundary delineations across 180nm contact edges.

Load NIST SRM standard reference coupon with polished pure tungsten and high-resistivity silicon interfaces. 2. Acquire zero-peak and Mn K-alpha calibration spectrum to calibrate gain and zero offset. 3. Acquire spectral point acquisition at W-SiO2 junction for 60 seconds live time. 4. Run automated deconvolution routine across 1.60 keV to 1.90 keV band. 5. Navigate to 180nm contact plug dense array test pattern (pitch 360 nm). 2. Align a 1.0 um elemental line scan perpendicular across three adjacent W plugs and intervening oxide spaces. 3. Set pixel dwell time to 50 us with 256 sample points and 50 sweep integrations. 4. Extract net intensity profiles for W M-series and Si K-series. 5. Measure the 10%-90% signal edge transition width at the plug-dielectric boundary. | `Elemental boundary 10%-90% transition width <= 18.0 nm; signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) across plug core >= 25:1; zero false residual W counts (> 3 sigma background) detected across unpolished oxide field center.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Standard ESD-safe cleanroom gowning suit and hood
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For IPA skin contact: Wash thoroughly with DI water and mild soap for 15 minutes. For eye splash: Flush immediately at eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. For N2 asphyxiation risk: Evacuate personnel to fresh air immediately; administer CPR/oxygen if breathing ceases.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Cleanroom air recirculation with dedicated laminar flow HEPA units; roughing pump exhaust and loadlock dry pump purge directly ducted to facility solvent/general scrubbed exhaust header.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of IPA-soaked cleanroom lint-free wipes in sealed flammable solvent waste drums; liquid solvent residuals routed to closed carboy containers for hazardous organic waste treatment.

| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, Grade 5.0) | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP megasonic cleaned, IPA vapor dried, hydrophobic-to-native oxide surface with zero slurry particulate residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: High-vacuum inspected wafer surface with minimal carbon dwell contamination, ready for IMD-1 dielectric deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and hydrocarbon condensation forming adlayers that amplify carbon cracking under electron beam irradiation, masking EDS sensitivity and triggering localized dielectric pitting.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full calibration and validation of the high-resolution EDS spectral imaging and elemental line scan subsystem on 180nm W-plug contact arrays, confirming quantitative W/Si deconvolution, sub-20nm boundary sharpness, and zero phantom residual metal calls.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `W_Si_Deconvolution_Spectral_Data.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **Detector FWHM energy resolution at Mn K-alpha** | `126.0 eV` | +/- 2.0 eV | NIST calibration standard spectrum automated calibration routine |
