# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-CMP-049`
**Title:** ILD Oxide Thickness Extraction, Cauchy-Urbach Optical Model Fitting & Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Contour Generation  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > CMP of ILD & W-Plugs > Post-CMP Ellipsometry, AFM Topography Profilometry, and Defect Metrology > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Calibration and ILD Oxide Thickness Mapping > Post-CMP ILD Oxide 49-Point Thickness Mapping Recipe Execution > Automated 49-Point Post-CMP ILD Oxide Thickness Mapping Execution  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm (Gen 3)  
**Process Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Load Wafer & Align   │
│        Pattern         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Execute 49-Pt      │
│    Ellipsometry Map    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Measure Psi & Delta   │
│        Spectra         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Cauchy-Urbach      │
│   Optical Model Fit    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Extract ILD       │
│    Thickness & MSE     │
│       Evaluation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Generate WIWNU     │
│       Contour &        │
│  Statistical Analysis  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Loading & Notch Alignment:**
   - Load the post-CMP 200 mm wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the automated spectroscopic ellipsometer.
   - Run optical pattern recognition using fiducial alignment marks on the scribe lines (adhering to the 5 nm manufacturing grid resolution) to reference die coordinates.

2. **Automated 49-Point Polar Pattern Mapping:**
   - Initialize the automated 49-point polar coordinate metrology grid: 
     - 1 center point ($r = 0\text{ mm}$),
     - Concentric radial rings distributed across 5 concentric tracks up to an edge exclusion boundary of 3 mm ($r \le 97\text{ mm}$).
   - Set the optical beam spot size to $< 50\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ focused on dedicated scribe line test macro pads ($80\ \mu\text{m} \times 80\ \mu\text{m}$).

3. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Acquisition:**
   - Configure spectroscopic broadband source illumination covering DUV through visible spectrum ($\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$ to $800\text{ nm}$).
   - Set angle of incidence (AOI) to $\Phi = 70.0^\circ$ (near the Brewster angle for $\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}$).
   - Record the complex polarization reflectance ratio $\rho$ for each of the 49 sites:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients, and $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ are the ellipsometric angles.

4. **Cauchy-Urbach Optical Model Parameterization & Fitting:**
   - Layer stack configuration: Substrate ($\text{Si}$ single crystal) / Native/Interface Oxide / Inter-Layer Dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$ / ONO cap).
   - Parameterize the refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ via the Cauchy dispersion model with Urbach absorption tail:
     $$n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}$$
     $$k(\lambda) = \alpha \cdot \exp\left[\beta \cdot \left(\frac{1}{\lambda} - \frac{1}{\lambda_{\text{edge}}}\right)\right]$$
     - Seed starting parameters: $A_n \approx 1.457$, $B_n \approx 0.00354\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $C_n \approx 0$, and extinction coefficient $k \approx 0$ across transparent regime ($\lambda > 350\text{ nm}$).
   - Execute Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting to minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE) between modeled and experimental $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra across all 49 points.

5. **Thickness Extraction & WIWNU Contour Generation:**
   - Extract the physical oxide thickness $T_{\text{ILD}, i}$ at each point $i \in \{1, 2, \dots, 49\}$.
   - Calculate wafer-level statistics:
     $$\bar{T} = \frac{1}{49}\sum_{i=1}^{49} T_{\text{ILD}, i}, \quad \sigma = \sqrt{\frac{1}{48}\sum_{i=1}^{49} (T_{\text{ILD}, i} - \bar{T})^2}$$
     $$\text{WIWNU } (1\sigma\%) = \frac{\sigma}{\bar{T}} \times 100\% \quad \left(\text{or } 3\sigma\% = \frac{3\sigma}{\bar{T}} \times 100\%\right)$$
   - Construct a 2D interpolated radial thickness contour map to flag radial CMP polishing signatures (e.g., center-fast vs. edge-fast polishing).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Tolerance / Limits | Measurement Tool / Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Goodness-of-Fit / Regression Quality** | $\text{MSE} \le 1.50$ | Maximum $\text{MSE} < 2.50$ across all 49 sites | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Dimensionless) |
| **Model Measurement Repeatability / Precision** | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.10\text{ nm}$ ($1\sigma$ static repeatability) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer ($\text{nm}$) |
| **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU)** | $\text{WIWNU} (1\sigma) \le 2.5\%$ | $\le 4.0\%$ ($1\sigma$) / $\le 8.0\%$ ($3\sigma$) | Polar 49-point wafer mapping ($\%$) |
| **Target Post-CMP ILD Residual Thickness** | Nominal CMP target thickness | $\pm 15.0\text{ nm}$ from nominal center-target | Thin-film thickness extraction ($\text{nm}$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Context Citations

- **`Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology`**:
  - *Polarization principle and fundamental equation:* $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ utilizing complex Fresnel coefficients $r_p$ and $r_s$.
  - *Optical dispersion modeling:* Cauchy and Sellmeier formulations for parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Measurement precision & map density:* Sub-Angstrom precision target ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) on thin dielectrics and automated 49-point polar coordinate wafer mapping tracking radial film non-uniformity across process runs.
- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
  - *Topology & Dielectric Stack:* Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture with tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnects planarized under inter-layer dielectric and ONO/high-$\kappa$ film topologies.
- **`SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid`**:
  - *Grid & Metrology Site Resolution:* Physical placement grid resolution of $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) and lithographic DUV exposure criteria ($\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated 49-point polar coordinate stage translation must synchronize with broadband monochromator wavelength sweeps (240 nm - 800 nm) to keep total wafer cycle time under 180 seconds. A critical bottleneck is spectral fitting latency: the Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear regression on 49 spectra must run concurrently with wafer unclamp and FOUP load port transfer, ensuring the factory automation SEMI E10 MTBF/MTBA uptime metrics and SECS/GEM interface reporting buffers are not overwhelmed.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm CMP ILD planarization, using a standard 3-term Cauchy dispersion model n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4 is physically valid above 400 nm, but oxide absorption in the deep UV (<300 nm) requires coupling with an Urbach tail model alpha(E) = alpha_0 * exp((E - E_0)/E_u). Neglecting optical absorption in thick CMP dielectric stacks (>600 nm residual oxide) will cause mathematical correlation between film thickness d and Cauchy parameter A, inducing artificial WIWNU contour edge rolloff artifacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Spectroscopic ellipsometer xenon arc flash lamps suffer spectral output degradation and intensity drift past 1,000 operational hours, shifting DUV signal-to-noise ratios. Sourcing NIST-traceable calibrated thermal SiO2 on silicon reference wafer standards (100 nm, 500 nm, and 1000 nm calibrated sets) has lead times exceeding 14 weeks from specialized metrology suppliers; dual-source qualification and scheduled lamp replacement cycles must be strictly enforced.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput directly governs post-CMP defect and thickness containment. If the 49-point extraction loop fails to complete within the 30-minute post-scrubbing Q-time window, downstream VIA1 lithography track recipe dispatch is blocked. Milestone MS4 requires 99.5% recipe execution yield across 25-wafer lots with fully automated contour map rendering into the fab yield management database.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Cauchy parameter correlation divergence where parameter A trades off against thickness d, resulting in false bimodal thickness distribution and goodness-of-fit MSE > 2.5.
1. Optical back-side reflection interference from unpolished or non-absorbing double-side polished wafer substrates causing high-frequency harmonic ripple in Psi/Delta spectra.
1. Edge-exclusion zone violation (measuring within <3 mm of wafer bevel edge), leading to optical beam clipping, false edge-peel readings, and catastrophic stage Z-height autofocus collision.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-2-2-3-01` | **Automated 49-Point Cauchy-Urbach Optical Model Fit and MSE Convergence Verification** | Automated Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE / Rotating Compensator Ellipsometer, 240-800 nm, spot size 50 um x 100 um) with wafer vacuum chuck and automated pattern alignment system | 1. Load 200mm post-CMP wafer onto vacuum stage; enable optical pattern recognition to register notch at 0 degrees. 2. Set angle of incidence (AOI) to 70.00 degrees with spectral range 250 nm to 800 nm at 2.0 nm step intervals. 3. Execute automated 49-point polar coordinate measurement pattern across wafer surface with 3.0 mm edge exclusion. 4. At each point, acquire raw Tan(Psi) and Cos(Delta) spectra. 5. Fit dielectric stack using Cauchy dispersion formula (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4, with seed values A=1.457, B=0.0035 um^2, C=0) and Urbach extinction absorption tail. 6. Extract thickness d_ox (nm), optical parameters, and regression Mean Squared Error (MSE). | `Pass if all 49 points achieve Mean Squared Error MSE <= 1.50, extracted refractive index n at 632.8 nm is 1.4570 +/- 0.0050, and zero points exhibit parameter correlation divergence or autofocus aborts.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-2-2-3-02` | **49-Point Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Metric & Contour Map Generation Verification** | Metrology Data Analysis System integrated with automated polar-to-Cartesian Kriging contour interpolation engine and factory automation host interface | 1. Import 49 discrete thickness values {t_1, t_2, ..., t_49} and their corresponding polar coordinates (r_i, theta_i). 2. Compute mean thickness (t_mean), standard deviation (sigma), minimum thickness (t_min), and maximum thickness (t_max). 3. Calculate 1-sigma WIWNU percentage: WIWNU_1sigma = (sigma / t_mean) * 100%. 4. Calculate range WIWNU percentage: WIWNU_range = ((t_max - t_min) / (2 * t_mean)) * 100%. 5. Apply 2D Kriging spatial interpolation algorithm with 1.0 mm grid resolution across a 194 mm diameter active aperture (3.0 mm edge exclusion). 6. Render 2D color-gradient contour map with 10 nm isolines and export metrology dataset to standard fab automation formats. | `Pass if post-CMP residual ILD oxide target thickness is 700.0 nm +/- 35.0 nm, 1-sigma WIWNU <= 3.50%, range WIWNU <= 6.00%, and the generated contour map file successfully generates with no mathematical NaN or spatial disconnects.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 (ISO 5) cleanroom nitrile gloves (12-inch cuff, static dissipative), UV-absorbing laser/optical safety glasses rated for broadband xenon lamp exposure (OD 4+ at 200-400 nm), Full cleanroom bunny suit, hood, ESD-rated cleanroom boots, and conductive wrist grounding strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA cleaner: Immediately flush with cleanroom eyewash/DI water station for minimum 15 minutes. For UV lamp exposure flash: Seek immediate ophthalmological medical evaluation. In case of inert gas (N2) asphyxiation risk: Evacuate operator to fresh air, administer medical oxygen if breathing is labored, and summon emergency medical team.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology chamber equipped with dedicated Class 1 laminar flow exhaust hood maintaining 0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s face velocity; xenon arc lamp housing ducted directly to cleanroom heat/ozone exhaust (min 50 CFM) to vent generated ozone gas.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes sealed in hermetic antistatic solvent waste containers and routed to hazardous solvent waste stream. No chemical effluent drains directly from dry optical inspection tool.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Trace Surface Cleaner** | `67-63-0` | Electronic grade (VLSI / SEMI Grade 1) | `>99.8 wt%` |
| **Compressed Gaseous Nitrogen (Chuck/Optics Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 | `99.9999 vol%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, megasonic PVA brush scrubbed, residue-free, particle count < 20 at > 0.18 um, IPA Marangoni dried without watermarks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry, non-contact inspected, non-destructive optical measurement verified, organic contamination free, ready for VIA1 lithography spin-coating.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding 30 minutes in cleanroom ambient air leads to uncontrolled airborne molecular organic contamination (AMC/VOC) adsorption and native/capillary water uptake on ILD surface, shifting measured optical thickness by +1.5 nm to +3.0 nm and causing photoresist adhesion failure or popping during VIA1 lithography baking.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete non-destructive 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry measurement of post-CMP ILD oxide across 200mm wafers, robust optical fitting via coupled Cauchy-Urbach models achieving MSE <= 1.50, extraction of residual oxide thickness and refractive index, calculation of radial and within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU <= 3.5%), and generation of high-resolution 2D Kriging contour maps exported to factory YMS/MES.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ild_post_cmp_49pt_raw_spectra_wafer01.csv`
- [ ] `ild_post_cmp_cauchy_fit_thickness_table.csv`
- [ ] `ild_wiwnu_kriging_contour_map_wafer01.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical model fitting convergence across all 49 measured sites** | `1.00` | <= 1.50 MSE | Automated Levenberg-Marquardt chi-squared/MSE metric check across spectral band 250-800 nm |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual post-CMP ILD oxide mean thickness across active wafer area** | `700.0` | +/- 35.0 nm | Calculated arithmetic mean of all 49 Cauchy-fitted thickness points |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU 1-sigma)** | `2.50` | <= 3.50% | Statistical calculation (1-sigma / mean * 100%) on 49-point extraction dataset |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 wafer inspection points achieve optical fit MSE <= 1.50 with refractive index n(632.8 nm) = 1.457 +/- 0.005, residual mean thickness within [665 nm, 735 nm], 1-sigma WIWNU <= 3.50%, Kriging contour plot successfully compiled without spatial anomalies, and data logged to CIM/SECS-GEM database within the 30-minute queue time limit.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) & Dishing/Erosion Contour Analysis

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-2-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-2-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Raw 49-Point Ellipsometric Spectral Data Extraction & Dispersion Model Fitting

- **Module**: Metrology / CMP Thin-Film Quality Assurance
- **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN / SKY130-compatible 180nm Backend)
- **Document ID**: `SOP-MET-CMP-049`
- **Action Type**: Make

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the physical setup, spectral extraction protocol, optical dispersion modeling, and multi-point regression fitting for post-CMP Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) oxide films across a standard 49-point polar map on 200 mm production wafers.

---

## 2. Technical Protocol & Execution Steps

### Step 1: Optical Hardware Initialization & Wafer Alignment
1. Load the 200 mm post-CMP wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the spectroscopic ellipsometer.
2. Set the optical illumination source to broadband UV-Vis-NIR spanning $\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$ (KrF DUV baseline) through $800\text{ nm}$.
3. Fix the goniometer Angle of Incidence (AOI) to $\Phi = 70.0^\circ$ (near Brewster's angle for the $\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}$ material system).
4. Perform pattern recognition and wafer notch alignment using the foundry placement coordinate system ($0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ grid resolution).

### Step 2: 49-Point Polar Pattern Mapping Execution
1. Load the automated 49-point polar coordinate recipe:
   - Center site: 1 point at $(r=0\text{ mm})$.
   - Ring 1: 8 points at $r = 30\text{ mm}$ ($\Delta\theta = 45^\circ$).
   - Ring 2: 16 points at $r = 60\text{ mm}$ ($\Delta\theta = 22.5^\circ$).
   - Ring 3: 24 points at $r = 90\text{ mm}$ ($\Delta\theta = 15^\circ$, edge exclusion margin $= 5\text{ mm}$ on 100 mm radius).
2. Command the motorized stage to traverse each of the 49 measurement sites sequentially.
3. At each site, acquire reflected polarization states via the rotating analyzer/polarizer over the integration interval (500 ms per site).

### Step 3: Raw Spectral Polarization Extraction
1. Extract the raw spectroscopic reflectance ratio $\rho(\lambda)$ across all discrete wavelengths $\lambda \in [248\text{ nm}, 800\text{ nm}]$:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
   where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients for p- and s-polarized light.
2. Record and log raw experimental data arrays: $\tan(\Psi)_{i,\text{meas}}(\lambda)$ and $\cos(\Delta)_{i,\text{meas}}(\lambda)$ for site indices $i = 1, \dots, 49$.

### Step 4: Dispersion Model Parameterization & Regression Fitting
1. Define the nominal thin-film optical stack:
   - **Substrate**: Crystalline Silicon ($\text{c-Si}$, tabulated $n, k$ library).
   - **Film**: ILD Silicon Dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$), modeled via Cauchy dispersion:
     $$n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0 \quad (\text{for transparent dielectric ILD})$$
     - Seed starting parameters: $A_n = 1.4570$, $B_n = 3.56 \times 10^{-3}\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $C_n = 0$.
2. Execute Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear regression to minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE) metric across the $N$ spectral channels:
   $$\text{MSE} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{2N - M} \sum_{j=1}^{N} \left[ \left(\frac{\Psi_{\text{meas}}(\lambda_j) - \Psi_{\text{calc}}(\lambda_j)}{\sigma_{\Psi,j}}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\Delta_{\text{meas}}(\lambda_j) - \Delta_{\text{calc}}(\lambda_j)}{\sigma_{\Delta,j}}\right)^2 \right]}$$
   where $M$ is the number of variable fit parameters (thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$, Cauchy coefficient $A_n$).
3. Output the fitted oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}, i}$ and residual MSE for all 49 coordinates to generate the radial within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) profile.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Model Fit Goodness (Residual MSE)** | $\le 1.20$ | $\le 1.50$ maximum | Dimensionless | Levenberg-Marquardt regression report |
| **Measurement Precision (Oxide Thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\le \pm 0.10$ | $\text{nm}$ | Static 10-run repeatability on Center site |
| **Refractive Index ($n$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$)** | $1.457$ | $\pm 0.005$ ($1.452 - 1.462$) | Dimensionless | Cauchy dispersion parameter extract |
| **Spectral Acquisition Range** | $248 - 800$ | Exact wavelength bound | $\text{nm}$ | Spectrograph calibration verification |

---

## 4. Literature References & Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Fundamental Fresnel reflection ratio: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical modeling via Cauchy dispersion parameterization of refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
  - Measurement precision standard ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) and 49-point wafer mapping methodology for radial film non-uniformity tracking.
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Placement coordinate grid resolution ($0.005\ \mu\text{m} / 5\text{ nm}$).
  - DUV $248\text{ nm}$ baseline optical wavelength configuration.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated 49-point wafer mapping recipes must strictly synchronize polar (r, theta) stage positioning with spectral integration times to prevent stage vibration transients from corrupting Psi (tan Ψ) and Delta (cos Δ) measurements near edge dies (3 mm edge exclusion). Furthermore, the dispersion inversion engine must decouple film thickness (d_ILD) from refractive index drift (n_632.8) to eliminate non-physical mathematical covariance in thin residual oxide zones.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-CMP inter-layer dielectric (PETEOS/fluorosilicate glass) exhibits micro-roughness (0.3-0.8 nm RMS) and superficial moisture absorption that skews UV-band Delta angles below 300 nm. A 3-layer optical stack model (Si substrate / native interface / bulk ILD Cauchy layer / Bruggeman Effective Medium Approximation EMA surface roughness layer with 50% void) is mandatory; failing to fit roughness independently forces spurious extinction coefficients (k > 0) into nominally transparent SiO2.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Optical calibration standards (certified 100 nm and 1000 nm thermally grown SiO2 on Si with NIST-traceable ellipsometric calibration certificates) face single-source lead times exceeding 14 weeks. Optical alignment apertures and high-stability Xenon short-arc lamps must have tracked operating hours (<1200 hrs) to prevent spectral UV irradiance degradation.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The 49-point extraction and Marquardt-Levenberg regression fitting must execute under 90 seconds per wafer to avoid buffering wafers downstream of the post-CMP scrub and dry station, preventing queue-time violations prior to Via-1 photolithography.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Mathematical correlation between ILD thickness and Cauchy dispersion parameter A leading to false WIWNU profile estimation (>8 nm thickness variance artifact).
1. Surface hydration and post-CMP slurry residue forming a pseudo-film that artificially shifts measured Delta by >2.5 degrees in the 240-380 nm spectral band.
1. Optical beam clipping at the bevel edge on perimeter test sites (r > 97 mm on 200 mm wafer) inducing severe polarization depolarization and Chi-squared regression divergence.

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves, UV-400 rated laser/optical safety glasses during source alignment, Cleanroom antistatic bunny suit and ESD-safe protective footwear, Polycarbonate face shield during lamp housing replacement
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious DI water for at least 15 minutes. In case of high-pressure Xenon arc lamp rupture, immediately isolate the tool, evacuate personnel from UV ozone hazard zone, and seek medical attention for lacerations or thermal/UV burns.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool lamp housing requires dedicated cleanroom exhaust (minimum 50 CFM) to extract ozone generated by deep-UV (<240 nm) lamp emissions and maintain optical cavity cooling.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent-contaminated cleanroom wipes must be bagged in conductive antistatic bags and disposed of in designated flammables waste drums in accordance with SEMI S2/S8 standards.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): WIWNU Percentage Calculation & Radial Oxide Thickness Contour Mapping

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of Inter-Layer Dielectrics & Tungsten Plugs [Planarization] > Post-CMP Ellipsometry, AFM Topography Profilometry, and Defect Metrology [Metrology] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Calibration and ILD Oxide Thickness Mapping [Metrology] > Post-CMP ILD Oxide 49-Point Thickness Mapping Recipe Execution [Metrology] > Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) & Dishing/Erosion Contour Analysis [Metrology] > WIWNU Percentage Calculation & Radial Oxide Thickness Contour Mapping [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated calculation of Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU 1-sigma and (Max-Min)/(2*Mean)) across the 49-point polar/radial grid must couple deterministically with upstream CMP multi-zone carrier head backpressure recipes (zones 1 to 5). Inadequate spatial resolution or edge-exclusion misalignments (<3 mm vs. standard 5 mm) will propagate aliased radial polish profiles, leading to incorrect closed-loop feedback correction for ILD1/ILD2 oxide thinning.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Spectroscopic ellipsometry modeling must strictly enforce a robust Cauchy dispersion layer (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4, with A ~ 1.457 at 632.8 nm) stacked over the underlying poly-Si/nitride stopping stack to decouple physical thickness from optical refractive index variation. Neglecting residual CMP surface roughness (AFM Ra > 0.5 nm) or chemical slurry moisture absorption induces substantial fitting error (MSE > 2.5), which skews radial contour interpolation and artificially inflates computed edge roll-off WIWNU.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Ellipsometer optical source uptime (deuterium and quartz-tungsten-halogen dual lamps) and calibrated standard calibration reference wafers (NIST-traceable 100 nm and 1000 nm thermal SiO2 on Si) are primary single-point dependencies. Calibration drift beyond 90-day intervals or delayed vendor lamp replenishment directly compromises wafer lot disposition, holding up both wafer-level dielectric planarization and via photolithography release.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: WIWNU calculation and radial contour plotting must execute in <45 seconds per 200 mm wafer to maintain fab metrology line pacing. Delays or manual fitting parameter interventions will trigger WIP bottlenecking ahead of Contact/Via-1 lithography, threatening the overall MPW shuttle tapeout cycle time and queue-time ceilings.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Edge-exclusion boundary truncation error: Measuring within the 3 mm edge exclusion zone creates localized edge roll-off optical aberrations, causing extreme outlier readings that skew the WIWNU percentage by >4.5% and trigger false CMP tool alarms.
1. Dispersion model parameter cross-correlation: Floating refractive index 'n' and extinction coefficient 'k' simultaneously with physical thickness on rough post-CMP surfaces leads to mathematical divergence, yielding unphysical ILD thickness maps with MSE > 5.0.
1. Slurry residue and surface haze interference: Incomplete post-CMP megasonic clean leaves microscopic colloidal silica particles that scatter incident polarized beam spots, causing distorted tan(Psi) and cos(Delta) spectra and erroneous contour topology.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-2-3-2-01` | **Automated 49-Point Polar Ellipsometry WIWNU Percentage Verification** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (Dual Rotating Compensator, 190-850 nm, spot size 50 um x 100 um) with wafer stage R-theta mapping | 1. Load wafer onto vacuum chuck and align wafer notch to 0 degrees. 2. Execute 49-point polar coordinate recipe (radii at 0 mm, 25 mm, 50 mm, 70 mm, 85 mm, and 95 mm). 3. Acquire Psi and Delta spectra over 250-800 nm for each coordinate. 4. Apply validated Cauchy model for PECVD TEOS oxide over Si substrate with fixed n_633 = 1.458. 5. Extract thickness values (T_1 to T_49), calculate Mean, Standard Deviation (sigma), and WIWNU% = (sigma / Mean) * 100. 6. Compute range non-uniformity WIWNU_range% = ((T_max - T_min) / (2 * Mean)) * 100. | `Goodness of fit MSE <= 2.0 at all 49 points; Target Mean ILD Oxide Thickness = 650.0 nm +/- 25.0 nm; WIWNU (1-sigma) <= 3.0%; WIWNU_range <= 5.5%.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-2-3-2-02` | **Radial Oxide Thickness Contour Mapping and Multi-Zone Pressure Gradient Validation** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer Data Station with Automated Radial Spline Mapping & Metrology Host SECS/GEM Interface | 1. Import 49-point thickness dataset into radial contour generation algorithm. 2. Apply bicubic spline interpolation over 1 mm spatial grid across the 190 mm active diameter (5 mm edge exclusion). 3. Partition wafer into 5 concentric radial zones matching CMP head bladders: Zone 1 (0-30 mm), Zone 2 (30-55 mm), Zone 3 (55-75 mm), Zone 4 (75-88 mm), Zone 5 (88-95 mm). 4. Compute mean thickness for each zone and calculate inter-zone delta gradient: Delta_Z(n, n+1) = |Mean_Z(n) - Mean_Z(n+1)|. 5. Generate radial contour map plot and export SECS/GEM feed-forward vector to CMP controller. | `Radial contour interpolation must generate continuous gradient without localized artifacts or singularities; Inter-zone thickness delta Delta_Z between adjacent radial zones must be <= 18.0 nm across all boundaries.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), UV-filtering safety glasses (ANSI Z87.1 certified for optical metrology broadband/UV source scatter), Full cleanroom ESD gowning with hood, boot covers, and ESD wrist/heel strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes at cleanroom eye wash station. Inhalation of nitrogen in enclosed space (asphyxiation risk): Move victim to fresh air, administer CPR or supplemental oxygen if breathing is compromised. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with neutral soap and DI water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating air handling with localized lamp enclosure heat exhaust (exhaust duct airflow >= 50 CFM) to vent ozone generated by UV deuterium lamp arc.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-resistant solvent waste cans and disposed of through dedicated flammable solvent waste management; no liquid acid or hazardous chemical effluent generated during optical metrology.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) cleanroom wipes (for stage de-haze/maintenance)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 / Electronic Grade | `70% v/v in DI Water` |
| **Nitrogen Gas (Purge/Pneumatics)** | `7727-37-9` | VLSI Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP brush-scrubbed, megasonic-rinsed, and spin-dried ILD oxide surface, free of residual slurry abrasive nanoparticles (defect density < 0.05 defects/cm2) and organic residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Optically verified, mapped, and non-destructive post-CMP oxide surface maintained in pristine, moisture-free state, ready for Contact Photoresist Coating.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time causes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (organic amines and moisture chemisorption) on freshly polished hydrophilic SiO2, altering the surface refractive index n, inducing optical fit errors, and risking contact resist footing during subsequent 180nm photolithography.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful spectroscopic ellipsometric acquisition of a 49-point polar grid on post-CMP ILD oxide, deterministic calculation of 1-sigma and range WIWNU percentages, and generation of a 5-zone radial oxide thickness contour map validated against CMP polishing specifications for 180nm DRAM tapeout.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ILD_POST_CMP_49PT_WIWNU_REPORT_LOTXXXX.csv`
- [ ] `RADIAL_OXIDE_THICKNESS_CONTOUR_MAP_LOTXXXX.pdf`
- [ ] `CMP_MULTI_ZONE_FEEDFORWARD_PRESSURE_VECTOR_LOTXXXX.json`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (1-sigma) across 49 measurement points** | `2.2%` | <= 3.0% | Automated statistical analysis of 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry thickness array (formula: std_dev / mean * 100) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Mean Post-CMP ILD Oxide Remaining Thickness** | `650.0 nm` | +/- 25.0 nm | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Cauchy dispersion model fitting across 250-800 nm wavelength range (MSE <= 2.0) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum Inter-Zone Thickness Radial Delta between adjacent head pressure zones** | `12.0 nm` | <= 18.0 nm | Differential subtraction of zone-averaged thicknesses across concentric radial regions Z1 through Z5 |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 metrology sites successfully fitted with MSE <= 2.0; calculated WIWNU 1-sigma <= 3.0%; mean ILD thickness within 625.0 nm - 675.0 nm; radial contour map verified and signed off by Metrology Module Lead and CMP Process Engineer; automated feedforward CSV/JSON uploaded to MES.

Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid (SkyWater Technology / Google Open Source Silicon)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Pattern-Dependent Dishing & Dielectric Erosion Metrology Correlation Against CMP Targets

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Start: Post-CMP    │
│      200mm Wafer      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Ellipsometry      │
│      Calibration      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  49-Point Dielectric  │
│   Thickness Mapping   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Targeted AFM      │
│     Profilometry:     │
│   Dishing & Erosion   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      TLM Contact      │
│      Resistance       │
│      Correlation      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────◇───────────┐
│    CMP Acceptance     │
│       Criteria        │
└───────────◇───────────┘
            │
            ├─────────────────────────────╮Fail
        Pass│                             │
            ▼                             ▼
┌───────────────────────┐     ┌───────────────────────┐
│      Release to       │     │   CMP Polish Recipe   │
│    Metallization /    │     │   Feedback & Rework   │
│   Stacked Capacitor   │     │                       │
└───────────────────────┘     └───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Calibration & Optical Model Setup
1. Mount the 200 mm post-CMP production wafer onto the automated spectroscopic ellipsometer vacuum chuck.
2. Initialize optical measurement head across spectral band $\lambda = 240\text{ nm}$ to $800\text{ nm}$ at angle of incidence $\theta = 70^\circ$.
3. Acquire polarization angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$, measuring complex reflection ratio:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
4. Parameterize the ILD oxide ($SiO_2$) film using a calibrated Cauchy dispersion model ($n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}$, extinction coefficient $k(\lambda) = 0$). Verify sub-Angstrom fitting precision on reference gate oxide test dies ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).

#### Step 2: 49-Point Polar Thickness & WIWNU Contour Mapping
1. Execute the automated 49-point wafer mapping recipe across concentric radial zones (0 mm center out to 97 mm radius, 3 mm edge exclusion).
2. Record ILD thickness $T_{\text{ox}}(r, \theta)$ at all 49 points.
3. Compute Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU):
   $$\text{WIWNU (\%)} = \frac{T_{\text{max}} - T_{\text{min}}}{2 \times T_{\text{mean}}} \times 100\%$$
4. Generate 2D wafer contour maps to isolate radial polishing signatures (center-fast vs. edge-fast).

#### Step 3: Targeted AFM Micro-Topography Profilometry (Dishing & Erosion)
1. Transfer wafer to the in-line Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with high-aspect-ratio silicon tips.
2. Align scanning probe coordinates to selected dies (center, mid-radius, wafer edge) across two distinct pattern-density zones:
   - **Dense Memory Array (80–90% feature density)**: 8F²/6F² folded bitline cell array with access transistor channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, contacting stacked capacitor tungsten plugs (W-plugs). Scan area: $10\ \mu\text{m} \times 10\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - **Isolated Scribe-Line Test Area (<10% feature density)**: Large rectangular Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) test pads ($W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$). Scan profile line length: $120\ \mu\text{m}$.
3. Measure:
   - **Tungsten Plug Dishing ($D_{\text{plug}}$)**: Recess depth of the polished tungsten plug relative to adjacent oxide surface.
   - **Dielectric Oxide Erosion ($E_{\text{ox}}$)**: Step-height difference between field oxide and array oxide surface.

```text
               ILD Oxide Erosion vs Pattern Density (nm)
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░░                                  │
   TLM Pad (5%)┤░░░░░                                  │
Periphery (30%)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
    Array (90%)┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      11.2     22.5      33.8    45.0 
```

#### Step 4: Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) Electrical Resistance Correlation
1. Dock wafer on automated prober and measure total two-terminal resistance $R_T$ across pad spacings $d \in \{5, 10, 20, 40, 80\}\ \mu\text{m}$:
   $$R_T = 2 R_c + \left(\frac{R_s}{W}\right) \cdot d$$
2. Extract contact resistance $R_c$ (Y-intercept $/ 2$), sheet resistance $R_s$ ($\text{slope} \times W$), and transfer length $L_T$ ($|\text{X-intercept}| / 2$).
3. Calculate specific contact resistivity:
   $$\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2 \quad [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$$
4. Correlate variations in $R_c$ against AFM tungsten plug dishing and array ILD erosion to confirm plug height integrity prior to capacitor stack formation.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Measurement Method & Conditions | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **ILD Oxide WIWNU** | $\le 4.5\%$ (3.5 nm dry oxide baseline $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ repeatability) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (49-point wafer mapping, 3 mm edge exclusion) | $\%$ |
| **W-Plug Dishing ($D_{\text{plug}}$)** | $\le 25.0\text{ nm}$ across $180\text{ nm}$ node access transistor contacts | In-line Tapping AFM (Dense array: $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Array Oxide Erosion ($E_{\text{ox}}$)** | $\le 45.0\text{ nm}$ relative to low-density field oxide | High-resolution AFM step profiler ($10\ \mu\text{m} \times 10\ \mu\text{m}$ array scan) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **TLM Contact Resistivity ($\rho_c$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{-6}\ \Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2$ (Pad dimensions: $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}, L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$, spacings $5\text{--}80\ \mu\text{m}$) | 4-point electrical prober linear regression ($R_T \text{ vs. } d$) | $\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2$ |

---

### 3. Citations & Verified Local Literature Context
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Thin film Fresnel reflectance ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical modeling via Cauchy and Sellmeier dispersion parameterization for $n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$.
  - Sub-Angstrom dry oxide precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ on 3.5 nm oxide) and automated 49-point wafer non-uniformity mapping.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - $180\text{ nm}$ technology generation 8F² and 6F² folded bitline cell topology.
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) contacted via chemical mechanically planarized tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**:
  - Pad dimensions: $W = 100\ \mu\text{m}$, $L_{\text{pad}} = 50\ \mu\text{m}$, with progressive gaps $d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80\ \mu\text{m}$.
  - Extraction model $R_T = 2 R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$ and specific contact resistivity formula $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\ [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.

---
*Captured micro-knowledge record persisted at [`docs/knowledge/cmp_dishing_erosion_metrology.md`](./docs/knowledge/cmp_dishing_erosion_metrology.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical spectroscopic ellipsometry relies on an effective medium approximation or multilayer Fresnel model that breaks down across dense metal-dielectric arrays due to diffraction and lateral phase scattering. Relying solely on 49-point macro ellipsometry without co-registering micro-spot optical profilometry or AFM scan coordinates introduces spatial aliasing, obscuring pattern-dependent dielectric erosion in high-density DRAM cell arrays versus open peripheral logic areas.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In 180nm tungsten plug and ILD CMP, Prestonian polish dynamics cause severe pattern-density-driven overpolish in high-density contact arrays (>50% pattern density) compared to isolated peripheries. Dishing in tungsten features (>180nm) and oxide field erosion must be decoupled; failure to baseline pre-CMP deposition profile contours causes pre-existing PECVD topography to be falsely attributed to CMP erosion.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) cantilever tips (silicon nitride or diamond-like carbon, tip radius <10nm) suffer rapid blunting when scanning heterogeneous W-SiO2 interfaces, leading to tip convolution artifacts and severe consumable lead-time bottlenecks if cantilever consumption is not strictly rationed.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-tool metrology correlation across automated spectroscopic ellipsometry and offline high-resolution AFM creates an operational queue bottleneck. Without an automated recipe-driven coordinate handoff, post-CMP measurement cycle time exceeds the allowable 60-minute window, risking cross-lot hold queues and unplanned rework cycles.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Metrology aliasing where macroscopic ellipsometer beam spot size (50 um x 100 um) averages over high-density DRAM array lines and spaces, masking localized dielectric erosion exceeding 35 nm.
1. Post-CMP slurry residue or dried silica micro-abrasive contamination within dished plug recess regions, yielding false topography spikes and AFM tip breakage.
1. Failure to isolate tungsten dishing from adjacent ILD dielectric erosion, resulting in erroneous CMP down-force adjustments that punch through thin field oxides.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-2-3-3-01` | **Pattern-Dependent Dielectric Erosion Correlation across Array vs Periphery** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (micro-spot DUV-NIR 193-1000 nm, 30 um spot size) and Atomic Force Profiler (AFM tapping mode, tip radius <= 10 nm) | 1. Load wafer onto spectroscopic ellipsometer vacuum chuck and perform 3-point wafer notch/edge pattern alignment. 2. Measure remaining ILD oxide thickness across 49 standard wafer map sites, recording mean thickness and WIWNU. 3. Navigate micro-spot beam to 5 dedicated test pattern structures: DRAM core cell array (80% density), bitline contact pitch (50% density), peripheral logic (20% density), test pad isolation (0% density), and scribe line field oxide. 4. Transfer wafer to AFM profiler, align to identical 5 coordinate locations, and perform 20 um x 20 um high-resolution scans (512x512 lines at 0.5 Hz). 5. Extract step height from unpatterned field oxide baseline to array dielectric surface to determine dielectric erosion depth. 6. Cross-correlate optical film thickness reduction against AFM physical erosion depths across density variations. | `Dielectric oxide erosion between DRAM cell array (>=70% density) and peripheral field oxide must be <= 30.0 nm. Linear regression correlation coefficient (R^2) between optical thickness loss and AFM step-height erosion must satisfy R^2 >= 0.95 across all 5 test densities.` |

Align AFM tip over 180nm contact test structures at 9 designated die locations (center, inner ring, outer ring). 2. Execute 2 um x 2 um line scans across a 10x10 tungsten contact plug matrix at scan rate of 0.25 Hz with 1024 sampling points per line. 3. Apply second-order polynomial flatten to raw topography profile to remove wafer bow/tilt. 4. Extract cross-sectional profiles through plug centers and calculate tungsten dishing depth (vertical delta from surrounding oxide plane to lowest point of W plug meniscus). 5. Verify 1 site via cross-section cleavage and secondary electron microscopy inspection. | `Maximum tungsten contact plug dishing across all measured sites must be <= 15.0 nm. Total AFM probe tip wear after 9 site measurements must not degrade profile resolution by > 1.5 nm as validated by reference calibration grating step-height delta.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 10 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/laser radiation eye protection glasses for ellipsometry Class 3B laser/broadband light sources, Full static-dissipative cleanroom gowning including hood, face mask, and ESD booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For chemical splash to eyes: Flush immediately with cleanroom emergency eye wash for a minimum of 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. For skin contact with solvent cleaning agent: Remove contaminated clothing and wash skin thoroughly with water. For accidental optical beam exposure: De-energize tool light source immediately, report to cleanroom safety officer, and seek ophthalmological evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology equipment enclosure maintained under laminar HEPA downflow (0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s) with localized chemical solvent extract mini-exhaust (>50 CFM) active during manual stage/chuck wipe-down operations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent-soaked cleanroom wipers disposed into dedicated grounded, fire-rated, air-extracted flammable waste bins. AFM tips and sharp silicon fragments segregated into puncture-proof hazardous sharps containers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |

| **Deionized Water (Ultra-Pure)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM D5127 Type E-1 (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, cleanroom-dried post-CMP dielectric/tungsten surface free of colloidal slurry abrasives, with native oxide regrowth < 0.5 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, non-destructive post-metrology surface with zero mechanical tip scratches, no beam-induced organic carbon deposition, and ready for inter-metal dielectric cap deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended atmospheric exposure causes ambient organic contaminant adsorption and galvanic micro-corrosion at the tungsten-silicon dioxide interface, skewing AFM step-height profiling and degrading adhesion of subsequent barrier/dielectric deposition layers.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: ILD Planarization Non-Uniformity & Dielectric Thickness Contour Analysis

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-CMP ILD thickness variations directly compromise the parasitic capacitance budget and interconnect RC delay across critical DRAM wordline and bitline routing. If within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU) exceeds 5%, the downstream contact etch window will experience micro-trenching or under-etch punch-through across periphery sense amplifiers and array boundaries, severely narrowing photolithography focus budgets (DOF margin < 0.25 um).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Spectroscopic ellipsometry modeling of multi-layer post-CMP dielectric stacks (e.g., TEOS/SiN/BPSG over patterned topology) suffers from parameter correlation between layer thicknesses and optical dispersion indices. A robust Cauchy dispersion model (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4 with k = 0 in visible wavelengths) calibrated against baseline bare-Si monitor wafers must be strictly enforced, avoiding unphysical fitted values of refractive index n at 632.8 nm outside the 1.455–1.465 window.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology throughput can bottleneck 200mm pilot line turnaround. Reliance on proprietary optical calibration reference standards and deuterium/xenon lamp assemblies requires dual-sourced consumables with guaranteed MTBF > 2000 hours to avoid unplanned downtime during MPW validation cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dielectric thickness contour analysis must establish clear automated SPC trigger limits (UCL/LCL at 3-sigma) integrated directly into the factory MES. Any excursion in wafer edge exclusion (3 mm zone) must trigger an automated hold before releasing wafers to W-plug lithography to prevent scrap costs exceeding $18,000 per lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe edge roll-off (ERO) or center-to-edge thickness gradient exceeding ±15 nm due to uneven CMP retaining ring pressure and slurry starvation.
1. Pattern-dependent oxide dishing and dielectric erosion over dense memory array blocks compared to isolated periphery logic, resulting in contact open circuits after tungsten CMP.
1. Miscorrelation of spectroscopic ellipsometry fit parameters caused by unmodeled post-CMP surface micro-roughness (> 0.8 nm RMS), yielding false thickness drift readings.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-3-01` | **49-Point Full-Wafer ILD Thickness Mapping & WIWNU Calculation** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (xenon/deuterium broadband source 190–1000 nm, 30 um micro-spot optics, motorized theta-r stage) | 1. Load 200mm wafer onto vacuum chuck and initiate optical pattern recognition for wafer notch alignment. 2. Collect baseline reflectance and polarization angles Psi(lambda) and Delta(lambda) across 49 polar-grid measurement sites. 3. Execute automated regression fit utilizing the calibrated Cauchy oxide optical model (fixed k = 0, n_633 target = 1.458). 4. Record oxide thickness t_i at each site and compute mean thickness, standard deviation (sigma), and Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity using: WIWNU (%) = (sigma / mean) * 100. | `Pass if mean ILD thickness is 650 nm ± 20 nm, 1-sigma standard deviation <= 15 nm, and WIWNU <= 3.5% across all 49 measured sites.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-1-3-02` | **Within-Die Array-to-Periphery Dishing and Erosion Profilometry via Micro-Spot Ellipsometry** | High-Resolution Micro-Spot Spectroscopic Ellipsometer combined with in-situ Optical Surface Profilometer (spot size <= 25 um) | 1. Align wafer coordinates to DRAM cell array macro and adjacent wide periphery scribe-line test pads. 2. Measure residual ILD oxide thickness at 5 dedicated test sites inside dense memory cell array (50% pattern density). 3. Measure residual ILD oxide thickness at 5 corresponding open-field periphery scribe pads (0% pattern density). 4. Compute within-die dielectric erosion: Delta_T = Mean(T_periphery) - Mean(T_dense). 5. Generate high-resolution thickness contour line scan across the array-periphery transition boundary. | `Pass if maximum within-die dielectric erosion (Delta_T) <= 25 nm and absolute residual oxide over array poly-Si gate topography remains >= 250 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloved, 12 mil minimum), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses, Cleanroom ESD garment with full hood and face shield during lamp module maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with cleaning chemicals or IPA: rinse with Copious DI water for minimum 15 minutes at cleanroom safety shower. For eye exposure: flush eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Seek immediate occupational medical evaluation. For xenon arc lamp handling: in case of UV exposure, cover eyes with sterile dressing and report for ophthalmological evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Equipment enclosure must maintain continuous laminar downflow (0.45 m/s ± 20%) with dedicated cleanroom solvent mini-exhaust extracting at minimum 50 CFM for wafer load port and maintenance purge zones.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent wipes and IPA run-off collected in designated flammable waste carboys (DOT-approved, grounded stainless steel containers); aqueous residues routed to fab acid-base neutralization (AWN) system maintaining effluent pH 6.5–8.5.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Tier 3 / VLSI Grade | `99.8%` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (post-CMP clean residue monitoring)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade | `29.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, clean, dry post-CMP planarized oxide surface, free of residual slurry silica particles (> 0.16 um defect density < 0.05/cm^2).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, non-contaminated dielectric surface ready for tungsten contact plug photolithography and hardmask deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Extended cleanroom ambient air exposure causes airborne organic amine and hydrocarbon adsorption on active oxide surfaces, leading to photoresist adhesion failure, footing during contact lithography, and moisture-induced dielectric constant degradation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified 49-point full-wafer ILD oxide thickness distribution and array/periphery contour map for 180nm DRAM tapeout wafers demonstrating controlled polishing within nominal thickness targets, acceptable WIWNU, and minimal pattern-dependent dielectric erosion.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ILD_CMP_Wafer_Thickness_Contour_Map_Lot01.pdf`
- [ ] `ILD_49pt_Ellipsometry_Raw_Metrics.csv`
- [ ] `Array_Periphery_Dishing_Erosion_CrossSection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean post-CMP ILD oxide thickness matches target design rule specification** | `650 nm` | ± 20 nm | 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry average fit across 200mm wafer (excluding 3mm edge) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU 1-sigma relative)** | `2.8%` | <= 3.5% | Standard deviation divided by mean of 49 polar-grid optical measurement coordinates |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Array-to-periphery dielectric erosion delta** | `15 nm` | <= 25 nm | Micro-spot spectroscopic ellipsometry height step evaluation between dense memory cell array and peripheral test pads |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions validated on 3 consecutive qualifying production lots with zero SPC out-of-control signals, Goodness-of-Fit (GOF) >= 0.992 across all optical model fits, and formal endorsement by DRAM CMP Module Lead and Metrology Systems Engineer.
