# Standard Operating Procedure: Multi-Point Wafer-Level Profilometric Scan for W-Plug Dishing and ILD Erosion

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-W-CMP profilometry across 200mm wafers requires high-precision spatial synchronization between atomic force profiler (AFP) scan heads and stage coordinate fiducials to decouple mechanical chuck runout (typically 20-50 nm) from nanometer-scale ILD dielectric erosion and plug dishing. Failure to compensate for wafer bow and stage tilt creates systematic false-positive erosion signatures across edge-die rings.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm DRAM node contact plugs (target diameter 220 nm, dense array pitch 440-500 nm), tungsten dishing must not exceed 25 nm, and dense array ILD erosion must be constrained under 35 nm. Optical spectroscopic ellipsometry alone cannot resolve sub-micron dishing profiles due to spot-size limitations (~25-50 um) and dense metal scattering; therefore, high-aspect-ratio silicon AFM tips (tip radius <10 nm, cone angle <15 deg) combined with step-height profilometry are mandatory to resolve the true bottom profile of the recessed W-plug without tip sidewall convolution artifacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-crystal silicon high-aspect-ratio AFM probes coated with wear-resistant diamond-like carbon (DLC) suffer rapid tip blunting within 15-20 full-wafer 49-point scans when scanning abrasive post-CMP surfaces containing residual silica or alumina nanoparticles. Sourcing qualified cantilever lots with tight spring constant tolerances (k = 40 ± 5 N/m) and guaranteed tip radii represents an operational bottleneck with lead times exceeding 8 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: AFM-based 49-point multi-site wafer mapping imposes an operational bottleneck, requiring approximately 45-60 minutes per wafer in tapping/stepping mode. To maintain fab takt time, metrology sampling must implement a dual-tier gating structure: run 9-point rapid screening (center, mid-radius, edge exclusion 3 mm) on 100% of pilot lots, and escalate to full 49-point cross-wafer profilometric extraction only upon out-of-spec dishing/erosion triggering.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. AFM tip wear/fracture inducing scan dilation, yielding artificially flattened plug dishing values (<5 nm measured vs >30 nm actual recess) leading to subsequent Metal-1 open/high-resistance contacts.
1. Residual slurry abrasive bake-on during post-CMP queue delay creating surface micro-mounds that trigger tip crashes and invalid positive step-height offsets.
1. Excessive array oxide erosion (>45 nm) thinning the ILD0 layer beyond breakdown margins, causing M1-to-substrate capacitive leakage and bitline shorting.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-01` | **Automated 49-Point AFM Profilometric Extraction of Dense Array W-Plug Dishing** | Automated Fab Cleanroom Atomic Force Profilometer (AFP) with 200mm Wafer Stage, <10 nm Radius High-Aspect-Ratio DLC-Coated Tip, Optical Pattern Recognition Module | 1. Load wafer into AFP chuck and run 3-point wafer notch/edge alignment. 2. Engage optical pattern recognition to center scan box over test macro DRAM dense contact array (pitch 450 nm, nominal plug CD 220 nm) at 49 predefined polar coordinates. 3. Perform 2 um x 2 um tapping mode raster scan at 0.5 Hz line rate with 512x512 pixel resolution. 4. Apply 1st-order plane tilt correction across the surrounding reference field oxide. 5. Extract depth profile trace across 10 consecutive tungsten plugs per site and calculate mean recess depth relative to adjacent ILD oxide plane. 6. Compute cross-wafer mean, standard deviation, and range. | `Tungsten plug dishing depth: Mean across all 49 sites must be between 10.0 nm and 25.0 nm; maximum single-site dishing <= 28.0 nm; 3-sigma cross-wafer non-uniformity <= 15%.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-02` | **Multi-Site Profilometric Evaluation of Dense-to-Isolated Array ILD Oxide Erosion** | Dual-Beam High-Resolution Stylus Profilometer / Atomic Force Metrology Tool with 200mm Low-Vibration Vacuum Chuck and Interferometric Z-Sensor | 1. Position measurement head over macro-structures containing 100 um x 100 um dense array adjacent to 50 um unpatterned isolated ILD field at 9 standard radial sites (Center, 4x Half-Radius, 4x Edge at 3mm exclusion). 2. Execute 200 um long scan line traversing from unpatterned field oxide across the dense array boundary at 5 um/s. 3. Fit a least-squares baseline to the unpatterned field oxide elevation. 4. Measure the vertical step height difference between the baseline and the average ILD surface level inside the dense array matrix. 5. Record array oxide erosion height for all 9 measurement locations. | `Array ILD oxide erosion: Mean erosion across 9 sites <= 30.0 nm; maximum single-site erosion <= 35.0 nm; edge-to-center erosion delta <= 12.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (Double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 Approved UV/Laser Safety Eyewear (OD 4+ at AFM laser diode wavelength 670 nm), Full Anti-Static Cleanroom Bunny Suit with Hood, Face Mask, and ESD-Dissipative Booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with IPA: Flush immediately with copious amounts of water from cleanroom eyewash station for at least 15 minutes. For inhalation of solvent vapors: Relocate victim to fresh outdoor air immediately; seek medical evaluation if respiratory irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM metrology tool enclosure maintained under localized laminar HEPA filtration (0.12 um capture, Class 1 airflow) with tool exhaust venting connected to general solvent exhaust plenum (minimum static draw 0.25 kPa).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipes and contaminated AFM cantilevers collected in dedicated grounded hazardous solvent waste bins; volatile liquid waste routed to centralized fab solvent collection system for certified thermal oxidation or fuel blending.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) - Cleanroom Cleaning Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Tier C / Electronic Grade (>=99.8%) | `100%` |
| **Deionized Water** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type E-1.2 Ultra-pure Water (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-W-CMP brush scrubbed and dried wafer; hydrophilic oxide surface with native oxide thickness <= 1.0 nm on exposed W; free of particulate residue, slurry agglomerates, and drying watermarks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Scanned wafer with fully characterized topography; pristine unmarred contact plugs; surface contamination verified zero particle addition (>0.18 um count delta <= 5); ready for Pre-Metal-1 PVD Ti/TiN barrier deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure to ambient cleanroom humidity causes galvanic corrosion at the W-plug/dielectric interface, spontaneous oxidation of tungsten forming volatile WO3 hydrates, and particle precipitation that invalidates contact resistance (Rc) and causes subsequent M1 delamination.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: Post-W-CMP profilometry across 200mm wafers requires high-precision spatial synchronization between atomic force profiler (AFP) scan heads and stage coordinate fiducials to decouple mechanical chuck runout (typically 20-50 nm) from nanometer-scale ILD dielectric erosion and plug dishing. Failure to compensate for wafer bow and stage tilt creates systematic false-positive erosion signatures across edge-die rings.
critics.domain_expert: For 180nm DRAM node contact plugs (target diameter 220 nm, dense array pitch 440-500 nm), tungsten dishing must not exceed 25 nm, and dense array ILD erosion must be constrained under 35 nm. Optical spectroscopic ellipsometry alone cannot resolve sub-micron dishing profiles due to spot-size limitations (~25-50 um) and dense metal scattering; therefore, high-aspect-ratio silicon AFM tips (tip radius <10 nm, cone angle <15 deg) combined with step-height profilometry are mandatory to resolve the true bottom profile of the recessed W-plug without tip sidewall convolution artifacts.
critics.supply_chain: Single-crystal silicon high-aspect-ratio AFM probes coated with wear-resistant diamond-like carbon (DLC) suffer rapid tip blunting within 15-20 full-wafer 49-point scans when scanning abrasive post-CMP surfaces containing residual silica or alumina nanoparticles. Sourcing qualified cantilever lots with tight spring constant tolerances (k = 40 ± 5 N/m) and guaranteed tip radii represents an operational bottleneck with lead times exceeding 8 weeks.
critics.laya_pm: AFM-based 49-point multi-site wafer mapping imposes an operational bottleneck, requiring approximately 45-60 minutes per wafer in tapping/stepping mode. To maintain fab takt time, metrology sampling must implement a dual-tier gating structure: run 9-point rapid screening (center, mid-radius, edge exclusion 3 mm) on 100% of pilot lots, and escalate to full 49-point cross-wafer profilometric extraction only upon out-of-spec dishing/erosion triggering.
critical_failure_modes: AFM tip wear/fracture inducing scan dilation, yielding artificially flattened plug dishing values (<5 nm measured vs >30 nm actual recess) leading to subsequent Metal-1 open/high-resistance contacts.
Residual slurry abrasive bake-on during post-CMP queue delay creating surface micro-mounds that trigger tip crashes and invalid positive step-height offsets.
Excessive array oxide erosion (>45 nm) thinning the ILD0 layer beyond breakdown margins, causing M1-to-substrate capacitive leakage and bitline shorting.

testcases.pre_conditions: 200mm wafer post-W-CMP brush scrub clean and spin-rinse-dry (SRD); surface defect count verified <20 particles (>0.18 um) via darkfield inspection; room ambient 22±0.5 deg C, RH 45±3%.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer into AFP chuck and run 3-point wafer notch/edge alignment.
2. Engage optical pattern recognition to center scan box over test macro DRAM dense contact array (pitch 450 nm, nominal plug CD 220 nm) at 49 predefined polar coordinates.
3. Perform 2 um x 2 um tapping mode raster scan at 0.5 Hz line rate with 512x512 pixel resolution.
4. Apply 1st-order plane tilt correction across the surrounding reference field oxide.
5. Extract depth profile trace across 10 consecutive tungsten plugs per site and calculate mean recess depth relative to adjacent ILD oxide plane.
6. Compute cross-wafer mean, standard deviation, and range.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Tungsten plug dishing depth: Mean across all 49 sites must be between 10.0 nm and 25.0 nm; maximum single-site dishing <= 28.0 nm; 3-sigma cross-wafer non-uniformity <= 15%.

testcases.title: Multi-Site Profilometric Evaluation of Dense-to-Isolated Array ILD Oxide Erosion
testcases.instrumentation: Dual-Beam High-Resolution Stylus Profilometer / Atomic Force Metrology Tool with 200mm Low-Vibration Vacuum Chuck and Interferometric Z-Sensor
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer passed TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-01; no queue time violation (>30 min air ambient); reference isolated field oxide regions intact.
testcases.procedure:
1. Position measurement head over macro-structures containing 100 um x 100 um dense array adjacent to 50 um unpatterned isolated ILD field at 9 standard radial sites (Center, 4x Half-Radius, 4x Edge at 3mm exclusion).
2. Execute 200 um long scan line traversing from unpatterned field oxide across the dense array boundary at 5 um/s.
3. Fit a least-squares baseline to the unpatterned field oxide elevation.
4. Measure the vertical step height difference between the baseline and the average ILD surface level inside the dense array matrix.
5. Record array oxide erosion height for all 9 measurement locations.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Array ILD oxide erosion: Mean erosion across 9 sites <= 30.0 nm; maximum single-site erosion <= 35.0 nm; edge-to-center erosion delta <= 12.0 nm.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Multi-Site Coordinate Setup and Scan Route Programming for 49-Point Wafer Profilometry

### Document Metadata
- **SOP ID:** `SOP-MET-49PT-PROFILOMETRY-001`
- **Revision:** Rev 1.0 (Gen 3 nm DRAM Node / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip MPW)
- **Module:** Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) & Post-CMP Profilometry Metrology
- **Target Inspection:** Cross-Wafer W-Plug Dishing and ILD Oxide Erosion Profilometry

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Notch       │
│   Alignment & Origin   │
│     Initialization     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Coordinate       │
│  Transformation & Die  │
│     Pitch Snapping     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     49-Point Polar     │
│    Concentric Grid     │
│       Generation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Serpentine Scan     │
│   Route Optimization   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Vision Optical     │
│    Auto-Focus & AFM    │
│  Metrology Profiling   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Physical Placement Grid & Coordinate System Initialization
1. Initialize the automated metrology stage coordinate system $(X, Y) = (0.000\,\mu\text{m}, 0.000\,\mu\text{m})$ referenced to the center of the wafer.
2. Clamp all stage motion targets to the physical manufacturing placement grid resolution of **$0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$)** to avoid fractional grid off-axis displacement.
3. Perform mechanical wafer-notch optical orientation alignment to ensure rotational theta offset $\theta \le \pm 0.005^\circ$.

#### Step 2: 49-Point Polar Concentric Metrology Map Setup
Program the multi-site recipe utilizing a standard 49-point polar concentric distribution pattern across the wafer diameter to track radial CMP polishing non-uniformity:
1. **Center Site:** 1 point at $(r = 0\,\text{mm}, \theta = 0^\circ)$.
2. **Ring 1 (Inner core):** 8 points uniformly distributed at $45^\circ$ increments along radius $r_1$.
3. **Ring 2 (Mid-radius zone):** 16 points uniformly distributed at $22.5^\circ$ increments along radius $r_2$.
4. **Ring 3 (Outer edge-exclusion perimeter):** 24 points uniformly distributed at $15^\circ$ increments along radius $r_3$.
5. Snap each nominal polar coordinate $(X_i, Y_i)$ to the nearest identical DRAM test cell array target within the respective die layout, maintaining grid placement quantization in increments of **$0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$)**.

#### Step 3: Metrology Feature Targeting (W-Plug Contact Array)
1. Drive the optical pattern-recognition camera to the pre-programmed die coordinates containing the high-density tungsten contact array.
2. Align pattern matching against contact hole features specified with minimum dimensions of **$0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$**.
3. Verify that the pattern-recognition optical center lock satisfies an overlay placement tolerance within the maximum permissible overlay budget limit of **$\le 35\,\text{nm}$** relative to active diffusion and gate poly baselines.

#### Step 4: Serpentine Scan Route Path Optimization
1. Sort the 49 measurement site coordinates using a continuous serpentine (boustrophedon) routing algorithm across the wafer matrix (traversing positive-to-negative $X$ along alternating rows in $Y$).
2. Apply stage acceleration and deceleration curves that prevent mechanical overshoot beyond the **$5\,\text{nm}$** grid resolution.
3. Execute automated optical auto-focusing and engage AFM tip landing at each of the 49 sites to record surface topography, extracting W-plug dishing depth and surrounding ILD oxide erosion profiles.

---

### PDK & Metrology Metric Limits Reference Chart

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░                                 │
Gate Oxide Precision┤░                                 │
                    │▒▒                                │
     Grid Resolution┤▒▒                                │
 Gate Overlay Budget┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                          │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                          │
      Min Contact CD┤██████████████████████████████████│
                    │██████████████████████████████████│
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                    0.0    42.5     85.0    127.5 170.0 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

1. **Stage Coordinate Grid Placement Snapping:**  
   Every programmed scan site coordinate $(X, Y)$ must strictly align to integer multiples of **$0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$)**, with zero grid quantization error.
2. **Site Positioning & Target Overlay Accuracy:**  
   Optical pattern recognition and stage alignment offset at each contact array test site must remain within **$\le 35\,\text{nm}$** overlay error budget.
3. **Contact Feature Dimension Recognition:**  
   Pattern recognition feature dimensions must lock to the minimum drawn contact hole dimension of **$0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$** (with optical edge resolution tracking $\ge 150\,\text{nm}$ features).
4. **Metrology Site Map Completeness & Thickness Baseline:**  
   Successfully acquire AFM/ellipsometric profiles across all **49 measurement points** without optical autofocus timeout, matching gate oxide reference precision benchmarks of **$\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$**.

---

### Verified Literature Context Citations

- **[SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid]:**  
  Physical manufacturing placement grid resolution of **$0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$)**; minimum contact hole dimensions of **$0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$**; maximum permissible overlay error budget between gate poly and active diffusion of **$\le 35\,\text{nm}$**; minimum gate poly length of **$0.15\,\mu\text{m}$ ($150\,\text{nm}$)**.
- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]:**  
  Implementation of automated **49-point wafer mapping** to evaluate cross-wafer non-uniformity; sub-Angstrom dry gate oxide measurement precision baseline of **$\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$**.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated 49-point wafer profilometry routing must balance motion overhead and chuck thermal stabilization against measurement throughput. A serpentine raster trajectory across a 200mm wafer with a 3mm edge exclusion minimizes stage acceleration transients, but encoder position jitter must remain under 0.25 µm 3-sigma. Synchronization between the high-precision laser interferometer stage and the atomic force profilometer / stylus head is essential to prevent false topography step artifacts caused by stage settling hysteresis during multi-site stepping.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, tungsten plug CMP dishing in isolated contact structures and oxide erosion in dense memory array fields (0.28 µm contact pitch) demand nanometer-scale vertical resolution. Setting up 49 coordinate sites must capture concentric radial non-uniformity (center-to-edge profile) specifically targeting standard test die locations containing Kelvin arrays, dense contact matrices, and isolated test pads without landing on scribe line structures or non-planar alignment keys. Stylus tip profiling force must be kept <= 0.05 mN (or tapping mode AFM set to 15% amplitude setpoint attenuation) to eliminate plastic deformation of polished tungsten plugs.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Profilometry recipe maintenance relies on consumable AFM diamond-like carbon (DLC) coated probes or high-aspect-ratio silicon cantilevers with tip radius < 10 nm. Single-source diamond styli or specialized cantilevers exhibit 14-week lead times. The scan route program must incorporate an automated periodic tip-qualification artifact site (e.g., standard Si audit grating) every 10 wafers to detect tip bluntness (tip radius degradation > 20 nm) or tip contamination before running full production lots, ensuring predictable consumable replenishment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Cycle time budget allocates a maximum of 420 seconds per 200mm wafer for the entire 49-point profilometry sequence to maintain line balance upstream of M1 deposition. Stage move times must not exceed 2.2 seconds per site, and automated scan coordinates must interface directly via SEMI E5 (SECS-II) / E30 (GEM) recipe management to eliminate manual operator alignment delays. Recipe lock must be validated before wafer release to prevent uncalibrated coordinate offsets from corrupting lot-disposition databases.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Chuck optical alignment or wafer notch misorientation > 0.02 degrees causing automated coordinate offset where the profilometer scans field oxide instead of the designated tungsten plug / Kelvin array test structure.
1. Cantilever tip breakage or diamond stylus chipping during high-speed stage stepping due to improper Z-retract height clearance (< 500 µm) over wafer edge roll-off or particle anomalies.
1. Vibration coupling from cleanroom recirculating air units (FFUs) inducing low-frequency stage resonance (> 5 nm RMS noise floor), masking sub-15 nm tungsten plug dishing values.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-1-01` | **49-Point Profilometry Coordinate Stepping Accuracy and Stage Repeatability** | Automated Wafer-Scale AFM / Stylus Surface Profilometer equipped with dual-axis laser interferometer stage, pattern recognition system (PRS), and 200mm electrostatic vacuum chuck. | 1. Load qualification wafer onto chuck, initiate vacuum hold (>= 75 kPa), and perform automated notch detection and 2-point optical die alignment using high-magnification PRS camera. 2. Execute automated 49-point polar-radial scan route recipe across 5 concentric zones (Zone 1: Center 1 site; Zone 2: r=30mm 8 sites; Zone 3: r=60mm 12 sites; Zone 4: r=80mm 16 sites; Zone 5: r=97mm 12 sites, 3mm edge exclusion). 3. Drive stage to target coordinates and record stage optical encoder position vs target coordinate table. 4. Repeat 49-site sequence 5 consecutive times without unchucking to calculate positioning repeatability (3-sigma) and stage settling time at each site. | `Positioning accuracy across all 49 sites must be within |delta_X, delta_Y| <= 0.50 µm of layout design coordinates. Repeatability across 5 consecutive runs must achieve 3-sigma <= 0.15 µm. Stage settling time to reach < 0.2 nm RMS stage jitter must be <= 1.8 seconds per site.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-1-02` | **Automated Profilometric Extraction of Tungsten Plug Dishing and Array Erosion** | High-speed automated AFM / optical profilometer with high-aspect-ratio probe (tip radius <= 10 nm, cone half-angle <= 12 deg), acoustic isolation enclosure (< 35 dB cleanroom noise). | 1. Execute automated profile scanning across the 49 programmed coordinates, executing a 10 µm x 2 µm scan line (0.5 Hz line rate, 512 pixels/line) over 0.28 µm contact array test pads and adjacent field oxide. 2. Apply baseline tilt subtraction and extract tungsten plug dishing (vertical step from field ILD baseline to center of 0.28 µm contact plug) and ILD erosion (step height from isolated field oxide to dense array oxide). 3. Compute wafer-level dishing mean, standard deviation, and within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU % = (sigma / mean) * 100). 4. Perform automated tip verification scan on reference standard to ensure tip wear delta < 2.0 nm. | `Dishing measurement repeatability across 3 consecutive scans at any site must yield standard deviation sigma <= 0.8 nm. Wafer mean tungsten plug dishing must measure 12.0 nm ± 4.0 nm, array ILD erosion <= 18.0 nm, and WIWNU <= 6.5%. Total recipe run time for all 49 points must be <= 380 seconds.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Full cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood, conductive ESD booties, and electrostatic grounding wrist strap, Polypropylene cleanroom face mask (3-ply particulate filter)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye exposure to cleaning solvent (IPA): Immediately flush with copious cleanroom eye wash or tempered DI water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated gloves. For vapor inhalation dizziness: Move personnel immediately to fresh air outside cleanroom bay; administer medical oxygen if breathing is labored. For nitrogen displacement asphyxiation risk: Evacuate area immediately; administer CPR and artificial respiration if breathing ceases.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool installed in Class 100 / ISO 5 laminar cleanroom bay with vertical HEPA filtration air velocity 0.45 ± 0.05 m/s. Enclosure internal purge with positive pressure UHP nitrogen (exhaust port tied directly to cleanroom solvent exhaust duct maintaining negative pressure >= 50 Pa). Continuous ambient O2 deficiency sensors installed at tool base interlocked with audible alarms at < 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipes collected in dedicated, grounded, self-closing hazardous waste containers for flammables. No liquid effluent discharged to general drains; residual solvent waste directed to dedicated segregated volatile solvent collection drum for licensed off-site high-temperature incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade (SEMI Grade 4) | `>= 99.8% wt` |
| **Compressed Gaseous Nitrogen** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 | `>= 99.9999% vol` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP polished, DI water megasonic cleaned, and spin-rinse-dried (SRD) wafer with exposed tungsten plugs and TEOS/ILD oxide, free of slurry particulates (> 0.16 µm particle count < 20 per wafer), and zero residual polishing fluid.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Non-destructively profiled, contact-free verified surface; no tip-induced scratches or particle adders (delta particles <= 5 at >= 0.16 µm); tungsten plug surface native oxide <= 1.2 nm prior to barrier/seed metallization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient cleanroom air promotes galvanic corrosion and oxidation of exposed tungsten plugs in contact with ILD (forming non-conductive WO3), leading to contact resistance spikes (> 50 Ohm/via) and severe adhesion failure of subsequent Ti/TiN barrier metallization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full implementation and verification of an automated 49-point wafer profilometric coordinate map and optimized high-speed scan route recipe for 200mm wafers post-tungsten CMP. The deliverable guarantees precision alignment on designated 180nm DRAM test structures, extracting tungsten plug dishing and array oxide erosion with sub-nanometer repeatability within a 420-second operational window.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WP_MET_49PT_SCAN_COORDINATES_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `RECIPE_W_CMP_49PT_PROFILOMETRY_ROUTING.xml`
- [ ] `49PT_PROFILOMETRY_GAGE_RR_ANALYSIS_REPORT.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Stage navigation and pattern recognition alignment accuracy across all 49 wafer sites** | `<= 0.35 µm` | ±0.10 µm | Laser interferometer encoder cross-correlation against calibrated optical pattern recognition marks on NIST standard wafer. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Tungsten plug dishing measurement repeatability across 49 sites (Gauge R&R)** | `<= 0.75 nm 1-sigma` | +0.15 nm | 10-cycle automated repeatability test measuring 0.28 µm contact Kelvin test pads across 5 wafers without unchucking. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Total automated 49-site wafer profiling execution time per 200mm wafer** | `360.0 s` | +30.0 s / -40.0 s | SECS/GEM automated equipment event log timestamp delta between wafer load clamp and wafer unclamp transfer. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful execution of 5 consecutive 200mm qualification wafers completing the 49-point automated profilometry routine without stage timeout or pattern recognition failure, achieving Gauge R&R < 1.0% CV, mean dishing extraction within 12.0 ± 4.0 nm, and zero profilometer tip collision or surface scratch defects verified by post-metrology optical inspection.

testcases.instrumentation: Automated Wafer-Scale AFM / Stylus Surface Profilometer equipped with dual-axis laser interferometer stage, pattern recognition system (PRS), and 200mm electrostatic vacuum chuck.
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm CMP-polished 200mm qualification wafer with patterned tungsten test macros; stage calibrated against NIST-traceable lateral grid standard; ambient temperature stabilized at 21.0 ± 0.2 °C.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load qualification wafer onto chuck, initiate vacuum hold (>= 75 kPa), and perform automated notch detection and 2-point optical die alignment using high-magnification PRS camera.
2. Execute automated 49-point polar-radial scan route recipe across 5 concentric zones (Zone 1: Center 1 site; Zone 2: r=30mm 8 sites; Zone 3: r=60mm 12 sites; Zone 4: r=80mm 16 sites; Zone 5: r=97mm 12 sites, 3mm edge exclusion).
3. Drive stage to target coordinates and record stage optical encoder position vs target coordinate table.
4. Repeat 49-site sequence 5 consecutive times without unchucking to calculate positioning repeatability (3-sigma) and stage settling time at each site.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Positioning accuracy across all 49 sites must be within |delta_X, delta_Y| <= 0.50 µm of layout design coordinates. Repeatability across 5 consecutive runs must achieve 3-sigma <= 0.15 µm. Stage settling time to reach < 0.2 nm RMS stage jitter must be <= 1.8 seconds per site.

testcases.title: Automated Profilometric Extraction of Tungsten Plug Dishing and Array Erosion
testcases.instrumentation: High-speed automated AFM / optical profilometer with high-aspect-ratio probe (tip radius <= 10 nm, cone half-angle <= 12 deg), acoustic isolation enclosure (< 35 dB cleanroom noise).
testcases.pre_conditions: Stage alignment completed via TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-1-01; wafer surface rinsed with deionized water and spin-dried; tip resonance verified at 300 ± 15 kHz.
testcases.procedure:
1. Execute automated profile scanning across the 49 programmed coordinates, executing a 10 µm x 2 µm scan line (0.5 Hz line rate, 512 pixels/line) over 0.28 µm contact array test pads and adjacent field oxide.
2. Apply baseline tilt subtraction and extract tungsten plug dishing (vertical step from field ILD baseline to center of 0.28 µm contact plug) and ILD erosion (step height from isolated field oxide to dense array oxide).
3. Compute wafer-level dishing mean, standard deviation, and within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU % = (sigma / mean) * 100).
4. Perform automated tip verification scan on reference standard to ensure tip wear delta < 2.0 nm.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Dishing measurement repeatability across 3 consecutive scans at any site must yield standard deviation sigma <= 0.8 nm. Wafer mean tungsten plug dishing must measure 12.0 nm ± 4.0 nm, array ILD erosion <= 18.0 nm, and WIWNU <= 6.5%. Total recipe run time for all 49 points must be <= 380 seconds.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved)
ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields
Full cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood, conductive ESD booties, and electrostatic grounding wrist strap
Polypropylene cleanroom face mask (3-ply particulate filter)
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin or eye exposure to cleaning solvent (IPA): Immediately flush with copious cleanroom eye wash or tempered DI water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated gloves. For vapor inhalation dizziness: Move personnel immediately to fresh air outside cleanroom bay; administer medical oxygen if breathing is labored. For nitrogen displacement asphyxiation risk: Evacuate area immediately; administer CPR and artificial respiration if breathing ceases.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Tool installed in Class 100 / ISO 5 laminar cleanroom bay with vertical HEPA filtration air velocity 0.45 ± 0.05 m/s. Enclosure internal purge with positive pressure UHP nitrogen (exhaust port tied directly to cleanroom solvent exhaust duct maintaining negative pressure >= 50 Pa). Continuous ambient O2 deficiency sensors installed at tool base interlocked with audible alarms at < 19.5% O2.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent IPA lint-free wipes collected in dedicated, grounded, self-closing hazardous waste containers for flammables. No liquid effluent discharged to general drains; residual solvent waste directed to dedicated segregated volatile solvent collection drum for licensed off-site high-temperature incineration.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Post-CMP polished, DI water megasonic cleaned, and spin-rinse-dried (SRD) wafer with exposed tungsten plugs and TEOS/ILD oxide, free of slurry particulates (> 0.16 µm particle count < 20 per wafer), and zero residual polishing fluid.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-WPLUG-AFM-001`
**Title:** High-Resolution AFM/Stylus Profilometric Scan Execution across Dense Array and Isolated Contact Test Sites  
**Generation:** 180nm CMOS DRAM Node (Gen 3)  
**Process Step:** Post-CMP Metrology & Surface Topography Inspection  
**Equipment:** High-Resolution Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) / Stylus Nanoprofilometer with Automated Wafer Stage  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the precise execution of multi-site, high-resolution Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) and micro-stylus profilometry to measure tungsten plug ($W$-plug) dishing, inter-layer dielectric (ILD) array erosion, and surface micro-roughness ($R_a$ / $R_q$) following Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP). The inspection covers both dense memory cell array regions ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$ folded bitline stacked-capacitor-over-bitline contacts) and isolated peripheral contact pads on $200\,\text{mm}$ wafers.

---

### 2. Physical & Topographical Context
- **Transistor / Feature Node:** Minimum lithographic feature $F = 180\,\text{nm}$; access transistor gate length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, active width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
- **Cell Architecture:** Stacked Capacitor-over-Bitline (COB) utilizing tungsten ($W$) plug landing pads connecting bitline/storage nodes.
- **Topography Hazards:** CMP-induced selective over-polishing causes recessed metal centers ($W$-plug dishing) and thinned inter-layer oxide over high-density array fields (dielectric erosion), which degrade subsequent ONO/high-$\kappa$ capacitor bottom electrode lithography and deposition.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Stage Initialization & Automated Vacuum Chuck Calibration                      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Tip Qualification & Cantilever Resonance Tuning (Tapping Mode)                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Automated Alignment to Dense Memory Array & Isolated Test Sites                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. High-Resolution Scan Acquisition & Topographical Step Profiling                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 5. Automated Step Height Extraction (Dishing & Erosion) and Recipe Completion     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 3.1: Automated Wafer Loading & Chuck Alignment
1. Load the post-CMP wafer onto the automated electrostatic/vacuum stage.
2. Initialize optical global pattern alignment using scribe-line fiducial marks.
3. Establish a standard wafer map inspection grid across the wafer diameter to evaluate cross-wafer non-uniformity.

#### Step 3.2: Probe Selection & Cantilever Tuning
1. Load a high-aspect-ratio, wear-resistant single-crystal silicon AFM cantilever tip (nominal tip apex radius $\le 5\,\text{nm}$, cone angle $\le 15^\circ$) optimized for high-density contact plug profiling.
2. Engage in tapping/non-contact oscillation mode to prevent tip chipping against hardened tungsten plugs.
3. Tune cantilever resonance frequency (typically $300 \pm 50\,\text{kHz}$) and calibrate photodiode laser alignment to achieve maximum sum signal ($> 4.0\,\text{V}$).

#### Step 3.3: Dense Memory Cell Array Scan Execution
1. Step the stage to the designated memory array test site containing $180\,\text{nm}$ contact pitches ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$ layout with shared bitline/storage node contacts).
2. Set scan field window to $2.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ orthogonal to the bitline direction.
3. Set scan parameters:
   - **Data Resolution:** $512 \times 512$ points (minimum scan pixel size $\le 4\,\text{nm}/\text{pixel}$).
   - **Scan Rate:** $0.5\,\text{Hz}$ to $1.0\,\text{Hz}$ line rate to minimize tracking error across steep plug edges.
   - **Integral & Proportional Gains:** Adjusted to keep cantilever error signal within $\pm 0.1\,\text{nm}$.
4. Record 3D topography and extract line profiles perpendicular across consecutive dense $W$-plugs and adjacent ILD oxide fields.

#### Step 3.4: Isolated Contact Test Site Profilometric Execution
1. Step the stage to the isolated contact test site ($> 5\,\mu\text{m}$ pitch away from neighboring active regions).
2. Acquire a $5.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 5.0\,\mu\text{m}$ AFM scan at $512 \times 512$ resolution across the isolated $W$-plug.
3. Run a baseline micro-stylus profilometric sweep ($100\,\mu\text{m}$ line trace, stylus tip tracking force $\le 0.5\,\text{mg}$) over the array boundary interface to measure field oxide array erosion relative to the nominal surrounding bulk ILD field.

#### Step 3.5: Surface Micro-Roughness and Dishing Extraction
1. Apply 1st-order plane fit (tilt correction) and flatten filters to eliminate stage bow.
2. Calculate root-mean-square roughness ($R_q$) and mean roughness ($R_a$) over planar ILD oxide regions away from plug edges.
3. Extract maximum plug depression depth below the adjacent oxide plane ($W$-plug Dishing, $\Delta h_{\text{dish}}$).
4. Measure total field oxide recess in the array center relative to the unpolished scribe-line reference level (Array Erosion, $\Delta h_{\text{erosion}}$).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Plug Dishing ($\Delta h_{\text{dish}}$)** | $\le 15.0$ | Max $\le 20.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | High-Resolution AFM cross-sectional step profile |
| **Array Oxide Erosion ($\Delta h_{\text{erosion}}$)** | $\le 25.0$ | Max $\le 35.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | AFM / Stylus profilometry (array center vs. field ILD) |
| **Post-CMP Surface Micro-Roughness ($R_a$)** | $\le 0.20$ | Max $\le 0.35$ | $\text{nm}$ | $1.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 1.0\,\mu\text{m}$ AFM scan on polished field ILD |
| **AFM Lateral Measurement Resolution** | $\le 4.0$ | Limit $\le 4.0$ | $\text{nm}/\text{pixel}$ | $512 \times 512$ scan grid over $2.0\,\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}$ field |

---

### 5. Literature & Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Context applied:* Defines unit cell geometry featuring minimum feature size $F = 180\,\text{nm}$, access transistor channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, transistor width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$, stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture, and shared bitline contacts connected via tungsten plugs ($W$-plugs).
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
  - *Context applied:* Establishes baseline optical thin-film metrology, ILD dielectric thickness referencing, sub-Angstrom oxide tracking precision, and multi-point automated wafer mapping across wafer runs.
- **Four Point Probe Method:**
  - *Context applied:* Metrology standard for wafer-level electrical integrity and thin-film sheet resistance validation.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated cross-wafer profiling must balance high spatial resolution with metrology throughput; performing full 3D AFM scans across both isolated contact holes and ultra-dense memory array test structures across 49 wafer sites creates a severe bottleneck if scan areas (>10x10 um) and tip velocity (>1.0 Hz line rate) are not optimized with dual-stage piezo stages and pattern recognition auto-alignment.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm DRAM node, tungsten plug recess/dishing in isolated contacts (>0.25 um diameter) and array oxide erosion in dense contact areas (pitch ~360 nm) require tapping mode or non-contact AFM tips with tip radius <10 nm and aspect ratio >5:1 to avoid convolution artifacts, tip blunting on hard W surfaces, and artificial underestimation of plug dishing depths.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring ultra-sharp high-aspect-ratio silicon/diamond-like carbon AFM probes with consistent spring constant (k ~ 40 N/m) and resonant frequency (~300 kHz) requires dual-sourcing agreements with suppliers like Bruker or NanoWorld to mitigate lead-time spikes and lot-to-lot tip variation during pilot line qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Acquisition and qualification of an in-line cleanroom-grade atomic force profiler under a 'Buy' model requires strict adherence to fab tool acceptance milestones, tool footprint allocation inside Class 100 cleanroom space, and automated recipe transfer interfaces (SECS/GEM) matching the DRAM Foundation VN foundry schedule.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. AFM tip apex breakage or contamination from residual post-CMP slurry particles causing step-height distortion and false reporting of dishing profiles.
1. Pattern recognition failure on optical navigation camera due to low optical contrast on polished ILD oxide over dense array test sites.
1. Thermal drift and acoustic vibration coupling causing z-piezo measurement drift exceeding 2 nm across slow 512x512 line scans.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-2-01` | **Isolated Contact Tungsten Plug Dishing Measurement via Tapping-Mode AFM** | Automated In-Line Atomic Force Microscope (Bruker Dimension Icon / Park NX-Wafer) equipped with high-aspect-ratio DLC-coated silicon cantilever (nominal tip radius <10 nm, spring constant 42 N/m). | 1. Load wafer into AFM vacuum chuck and initiate SECS/GEM recipe 'W_CMP_ISO_DISH_49PT'. 2. Execute optical pattern recognition on die (0,0) isolated contact test structure (0.28 um contact diameter in 5x5 um field oxide). 3. Engage tip in tapping mode at 1.0 Hz scan rate, 512x512 resolution, over a 3.0 um x 3.0 um scan window. 4. Apply 1st order line-flattening algorithm to the acquired topography channel referencing the surrounding ILD oxide baseline. 5. Extract cross-sectional depth profile through the centroid of the W-plug and compute maximum step height delta. 6. Repeat across designated 49-point wafer map. | `Tungsten plug dishing depth delta <= 25.0 nm relative to adjacent planarized ILD field oxide across all 49 measured sites; tip wear verification scan shows tip radius <= 12.0 nm post-run.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-2-02` | **Dense Memory Cell Array ILD Oxide Erosion and Micro-Roughness Profilometry** | High-Resolution AFM/Stylus Profilometer with integrated anti-vibration active isolation platform and acoustic enclosure. | 1. Position probe over dense DRAM cell array test pad (10 um x 10 um matrix of contacts at 360 nm pitch). 2. Perform 10 um x 10 um area scan at 0.5 Hz line scan rate with scan angle 0 degrees (perpendicular to contact array orientation). 3. Extract average surface height profile across array boundaries to determine step down from bulk un-patterned field oxide to dense array oxide (erosion depth). 4. Calculate surface micro-roughness (Rq and Ra) on the inter-plug oxide regions using a high-pass Gaussian filter cut-off of 0.25 um. 5. Log metrics into wafer database. | `Array oxide erosion <= 35.0 nm relative to surrounding field oxide; residual ILD surface roughness Ra <= 0.35 nm; measurement repeatability 1-sigma < 0.8 nm across 5 consecutive repeat scans.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double gloving), UV-absorbing safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Full cleanroom bunny suit with ESD-dissipative booties and face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious DI water from cleanroom eyewash station for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, evacuate to fresh air area. Class 3R laser beam alignment safety protocol: avoid direct ocular exposure to AFM optical lever laser source.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool equipped with local mini-environment laminar flow HEPA unit maintaining ISO Class 3 downflow air velocity (0.45 m/s +/- 20%); internal solvent vapor extraction connection to fab general exhaust at minimum static pressure 0.5 in. w.g.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent wipes soaked with IPA collected in dedicated grounded, self-closing stainless steel flammable waste bins; exhausted to fab VOC abatement / thermal oxidizer system.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DI H2O)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type I (18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly rinsed and Marangoni-dried post-CMP oxide and tungsten surface, hydrophilic (water contact angle < 15 degrees), free from residual silica/alumina slurry abrasives.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Scanned, non-contact metrology surface free from tip-induced indentation scratches or particle recontamination; ready for pre-metal dielectric or contact-1 cap deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient exposure beyond Q-time promotes atmospheric moisture adsorption, galvanic corrosion at the W/TiN/oxide interface forming non-conductive tungsten trioxide (WO3) hillocks, and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) causing false topography readings.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery of comprehensive automated 49-point wafer topography map characterizing isolated tungsten plug dishing and dense DRAM cell array oxide erosion post-CMP, validating compliant step heights below 180nm process limits.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_CMP_Dishing_Erosion_49Pt_WaferMap.csv`
- [ ] `HighRes_AFM_Array_Topography_RawScans.tiff`
- [ ] `TC_CMP_Planarization_Metrology_Summary_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum isolated W-plug dishing depth across all qualified wafer sites** | `18.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Extracted 1D cross-sectional line profile from 512x512 tapping mode AFM scan calibrated against VLSI Standards step-height reference standard. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum dense memory cell array oxide erosion across 49 wafer points** | `24.0 nm` | +/- 6.0 nm | Differential step-height calculation between 10x10 um array mean plane and surrounding field oxide plane. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-CMP inter-layer dielectric (ILD) surface micro-roughness (Ra)** | `0.22 nm` | +/- 0.08 nm | Gaussian-filtered root-mean-square calculation over 1.0 um x 1.0 um oxide region between contact plugs. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal metrology signoff achieved when 100% of 49 wafer inspection sites satisfy dishing <= 25 nm and erosion <= 35 nm, 3 consecutive measurement loops confirm 1-sigma gauge R&R < 10% of tolerance, and summary PDF/CSV artifacts are committed to the DRAM Foundation VN quality vault.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Radial Dishing and Erosion Profile Extraction, Step-Height Analysis, and Wafer-Level Non-Uniformity Mapping

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM180-CMP-MET-007`  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) / SkyWater SKY130 Compatible  
**Level:** Industrial Leaf SOP  
**Metrology Stage:** Post-Tungsten (W) CMP & Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) Planarization  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Pre-Alignment and Coordinate Registration:**
   - Mount post-W CMP 200 mm production wafer onto automated vacuum chuck ($T = 22.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Perform optical notch/flat pre-alignment; reference Cartesian coordinates to the physical placement grid with a manufacturing step resolution of $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$).
   - Register active DRAM array coordinates ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$ cell pitch: channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$) and peripheral contact test structures ($0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ contact cutouts).

2. **Full-Wafer Optical Field Oxide Baseline Mapping (Spectroscopic Ellipsometry):**
   - Execute an automated 49-point polar/radial spectroscopic ellipsometry recipe across wafer radius ($r = 0$ to $97\,\text{mm}$, $3\,\text{mm}$ edge exclusion).
   - Acquire polarized reflection spectrum across wavelength $\lambda = 240\,\text{nm}$ to $800\,\text{nm}$; parameterize complex reflection ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$ using Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models for the ILD oxide ($n \approx 1.46$).
   - Determine nominal reference ILD thickness and global field oxide profile across center, mid-radius ($r = 45\text{--}50\,\text{mm}$), and outer periphery ($r = 90\text{--}95\,\text{mm}$).

3. **High-Resolution Multi-Point AFM Topography Profilometry:**
   - Position high-aspect-ratio diamond-like carbon (DLC) AFM probe tip (tip radius $R \le 5\,\text{nm}$) over 9 designated radial inspection dies (Center: $(0,0)$; Mid: 4 points at $r = 50\,\text{mm}$; Edge: 4 points at $r = 92\,\text{mm}$).
   - Run tapping-mode scanning profiles across:
     - **Array Core:** Dense W-plug capacitor contact array ($0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ contact size, minimum metal/contact pitch down to $0.34\,\mu\text{m}$). Scan box: $10\,\mu\text{m} \times 10\,\mu\text{m}$, line density 512 lines, scan speed $0.5\,\text{Hz}$.
     - **Array-to-Periphery Boundary:** Step-height transition boundary over a $50\,\mu\text{m} \times 5\,\mu\text{m}$ swath.

4. **Dishing, Erosion, and Step-Height Feature Extraction:**
   - **Tungsten Plug Dishing ($D_{\text{plug}}$):** Compute depth difference from planarized oxide plateau surrounding contact to the lowest nadir within the $0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ W-plug surface:
     $$D_{\text{plug}} = Z_{\text{oxide, ref}} - Z_{\text{W, min}}$$
   - **Array Oxide Erosion ($E_{\text{array}}$):** Extract height differential between unpatterned field oxide in peripheral logic and mean oxide line inside the dense stacked-capacitor array:
     $$E_{\text{array}} = \bar{Z}_{\text{field, logic}} - \bar{Z}_{\text{oxide, array}}$$
   - **Boundary Step Height ($\Delta h_{\text{step}}$):** Extract maximum step height across the dense memory mat edge transition to the open dummy/scribe-line field.

5. **Wafer-Level Non-Uniformity (NU) Surface Reconstruction:**
   - Compile radial dishing and erosion vectors across 9 radial coordinates.
   - Calculate Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity ($\text{WIWNU}\%$) using standard 1-$\sigma$ metric:
     $$\text{WIWNU} = \frac{\sigma_{D}}{\bar{D}} \times 100\%$$
   - Map 2D contour profile to identify radial polishing signatures (e.g., center-fast vs. edge-fast polishing) and generate CMP head zone back-pressure feedback offsets.

---

### 4. Context References & Traceability

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**
   - Transistor dimensions: Channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - W-plug interconnect foundation for stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture.
2. **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]:**
   - Optical modeling parameterization: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$ with Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion.
   - Spatial monitoring: 49-point automated wafer mapping tracking radial film thickness and non-uniformity.
3. **[SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid]:**
   - Minimum contact cutout: $0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Placement grid pitch resolution: $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$).
   - Interconnect spacing constraint: Metal 1 pitch $0.34\,\mu\text{m}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-CMP profilometry and AFM step-height scanning must interface directly with feed-forward lithography depth-of-focus (DoF) compensation models. In our 180nm DRAM process, severe array oxide erosion or localized tungsten plug dishing alters optical path reflections, skewing overlay aligner sensors and narrowing the usable DoF window down to less than 250 nm for the subsequent contact/metal-1 patterning passes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node DRAM contacts (contact diameter ~220nm, dense cell-array pitch ~360-400nm), radial pattern density variations create steep chemical-mechanical gradients. Tungsten dishing must not exceed 25 nm to prevent voiding and interface peeling during M1 barrier Ti/TiN sputtering, while array oxide erosion must remain below 35 nm across the entire 200mm wafer diameter to prevent substrate punch-through or poly-gate exposure.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: High-resolution AFM cantilevers (high aspect-ratio doped silicon or diamond-like carbon tips with tip radius <10 nm) have finite measurement lifetimes and high unit costs. Long scan times per wafer risk creating a metrology bottleneck in fab cycle time unless high-speed tapping/peak-force modes or automated multi-point step-height optical profilometer screening is used before high-resolution AFM sampling.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Execution requires strict alignment between post-CMP cleaning, DI water rinse spin-dryers, and cleanroom FOUP transfer. Profilometry mapping data across the 49-point matrix must be parsed and logged within 45 minutes of CMP completion to prevent queuing bottlenecks ahead of the inter-layer dielectric barrier cap deposition.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip convolution and scanning artifact degradation: blunt or chipped AFM tips underestimate tungsten plug dishing depth while overestimating plug sidewall widths across dense cell arrays.
1. Excessive wafer-level radial non-uniformity (>8% 1-sigma): leading to periphery under-polish (bridging tungsten residues) concurrently with center over-polish (severe oxide erosion and cell-transistor threshold voltage shift).
1. Galvanic corrosion pitting: delayed post-CMP drying or prolonged queue times prior to AFM inspection causing chemical corrosion pit formation at the W-plug/TiN/SiO2 tripartite boundary, mimicking mechanical dishing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

At each site, acquire a 5 um x 5 um tapping-mode topographical scan over dense DRAM cell contact plug arrays at 512 x 512 pixel resolution and 0.5 Hz scan rate. 4. Extract cross-sectional height profiles across 20 individual tungsten contact plugs per site. 5. Calculate dishing depth as the vertical distance between the surrounding ILD oxide baseline plane and the lowest point on the tungsten plug surface. | `Mean tungsten plug dishing depth across all sites must be <= 25.0 nm; maximum single-plug dishing depth must not exceed 35.0 nm; measurement repeatability 1-sigma across 5 consecutive static re-scans must be <= 0.8 nm.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-2-3-02` | **49-Point Optical Profilometry & Ellipsometric Wafer-Level Non-Uniformity (NU%) Mapping** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer & High-Accuracy Optical Surface Profiler with 200mm mapping stage (wavelength range 190 nm - 1000 nm) | 1. Compute wafer-level non-uniformity percentage: NU% = [(Max_thickness - Min_thickness) / (2 * Mean_thickness)] * 100. 5. Plot radial erosion profile from wafer center to wafer edge. | `Wafer-level oxide thickness non-uniformity NU% must be <= 5.5% (1-sigma <= 3.0%); array oxide erosion must be <= 30.0 nm across middle sites and <= 40.0 nm at outer edge sites (R=92mm); goodness of fit (GoF) for ellipsometric model must exceed 0.985.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Full cleanroom ESD-safe gowning (bunny suit, hood, booties, face mask), Laser safety goggles (Class 3B/Class 4 compliant for optical alignment lasers if housing interlock is bypassed during service)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with cleaning solvent (IPA), flush affected area immediately with clean deionized water or saline solution for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, remove victim to fresh air. If asphyxiation symptoms occur due to nitrogen displacement in enclosed tool service compartments, immediately move to an open, well-ventilated area and administer oxygen or CPR as trained.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM enclosure and spectroscopic stage must be operated under Class 10/ISO Class 4 laminar downflow clean air (airflow velocity 0.45 ± 0.05 m/s); tool maintenance wipe-down stations must be equipped with dedicated solvent exhaust ducting operating at >= 50 FPM face velocity.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent-soaked cleanroom wipes and contaminated tips must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-retardant hazardous waste bins designated for flammable solvent solids; liquid IPA effluent collected into dedicated solvent waste carboys for professional incineration. No drain disposal allowed.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-CMP scrubbed and spin-dried ILD SiO2 and W-plug surface; free of slurry abrasive nanoparticles (silica/alumina) and watermarks (drying spots).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Particulate-clean, non-damaged, mapped wafer surface with AFM measurement locations recorded, ready for dielectric cap barrier deposition (PECVD SiN or SiON).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding the queue time in cleanroom air leads to galvanic corrosion, micro-oxidation of exposed tungsten plugs, and airborne molecular contamination (AMC, organic amines and siloxanes) settling on dielectric surfaces, inducing voiding and severe adhesion failure during subsequent capping layer deposition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed wafer-scale non-uniformity mapping and nanoscale step-height profilometry across 49 coordinates, delivering high-resolution AFM profiles of tungsten plug dishing and array oxide erosion for 180nm DRAM tapeout verification.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Radial Topography Map Extraction and Planarization Uniformity Assessment

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Radial topography variations directly consume the photolithography Depth of Focus (DOF >= 0.5 um per Rayleigh criterion) during subsequent metal-1 exposure; without a tightly coupled feed-forward radial profile to scanner leveling systems, edge-die defocus yield fallout will exceed 14%.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Tungsten CMP exhibits severe center-to-edge non-uniformity (WIWNU) due to pad glazing, slurry starvation, and multi-zone carrier pressure gradients; AFM profilometry must differentiate true dense-array oxide erosion (pitch < 400 nm) from isolated plug dishing across all concentric radial annular zones (R0 to R98mm).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: High-aspect-ratio AFM metrology tips (radius < 10 nm, diamond-like carbon coated) suffer rapid wear and tip-breakage on abrasive W-CMP residues; reliance on single-vendor specialized cantilever arrays presents a critical procurement bottleneck for sustained 180nm inline production runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Radial AFM mapping across 49+ sites induces massive metrology queue times (exceeding 85 minutes per wafer); without automated multi-site recipe orchestration and hybrid ellipsometry-AFM correlation, metrology throughput will severely violate fab line takt time.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Edge-exclusion annular over-polishing (edge roll-off) exceeding 45 nm, stripping ILD dielectric down to the Ti/TiN barrier layer.
1. AFM cantilever tip dilation or chipping during dense W-plug scans, generating false erosion step-height readings and masking true dishing defects.
1. Post-CMP slurry abrasive particle crystallization in ambient air during queue-time delay, causing AFM scan head scratching and corrupted radial topography baselines.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-3-01` | **49-Point Radial AFM Profilometric Extraction of W-Plug Dishing and Array Erosion** | Automated 200mm Inline Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with DLC-coated ultra-sharp silicon tips (tip radius < 7 nm, spring constant 40 N/m) and acoustic isolation chamber. | 1. Load wafer into AFM staging chamber under ISO 3 laminar flow. 2. Execute automated 49-point polar coordinate scanning pattern across 5 concentric radial rings (0 mm, 25 mm, 50 mm, 75 mm, 95 mm). 3. At each target coordinate, perform a 10 um x 10 um tapping-mode scan across the dense DRAM cell array (180nm contact plug array, 50% pattern density) and an adjacent isolated 2.0 um test pad. 4. Apply first-order line leveling and baseline subtraction to the raw height profile. 5. Extract maximum isolated plug dishing (depth from oxide surface to plug center) and array oxide erosion (step height between surrounding field oxide and dense array field oxide). 6. Export 3D point cloud and compute radial within-wafer non-uniformity (WIWNU). | `Max isolated W-plug dishing across all radial points <= 28.0 nm; max dense array oxide erosion <= 35.0 nm; Radial WIWNU 1-sigma <= 4.8%.` |

Transfer wafer to stage chuck and verify automated optical pattern recognition on alignment fiducials. 2.
