# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated AFM/Profilometer Polar-to-Cartesian Coordinate Recipe Setup for Multi-Point Radial Wafer Scanning

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-AFM-180-POLAR-001`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm CMOS MPW / DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Classification:** Metrology / Planarization Characterization  
**Knowledge Base Entry:** [afm_polar_to_cartesian_recipe.md](./docs/knowledge/afm_polar_to_cartesian_recipe.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Wafer Loading &    │
│  Notch Pre-Alignment  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Configure Polar    │
│   Coordinates r_i,    │
│        theta_j        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│        Execute        │
│  Polar-to-Cartesian   │
│  Transformation X, Y  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Multi-Point AFM /   │
│     Profilometer      │
│       Profiling       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Radial Uniformity &  │
│    W-Plug Dishing     │
│      Extraction       │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Alignment & Zero Reference Initialization**:
   - Secure the processed 180nm post-CMP wafer onto the motorized vacuum chuck ($10^{-5}\text{ mbar}$ back-side vacuum hold).
   - Engage optical notch/flat detection to establish wafer orientation ($\theta = 0^\circ$ defined at the wafer notch axis).
   - Set stage physical origin $(X_0, Y_0) = (0.000\text{ mm}, 0.000\text{ mm})$ precisely at the physical wafer center.

2. **Polar Radial Recipe Grid Selection**:
   - Depending on statistical confidence requirements, select either a **9-point** or **49-point** wafer mapping grid.
   - Specify discrete radial concentric zones $r_i$ and azimuthal angles $\theta_j$:
     - For 9-point setup: Center ($r=0\text{ mm}$), inner ring ($r = R_1$), outer ring ($r = R_2$) sampled at orthogonal $\theta \in \{0^\circ, 90^\circ, 180^\circ, 270^\circ\}$.
     - For 49-point setup: Center point plus multi-tier radial rings tracking film non-uniformity across spin coating, polishing, and furnace runs.

3. **Automated Polar-to-Cartesian Coordinate Transformation**:
   - Execute coordinate calculation via stage controller firmware:
     $$X_k = r_i \cdot \cos(\theta_j) + X_{\text{offset}}$$
     $$Y_k = r_i \cdot \sin(\theta_j) + Y_{\text{offset}}$$
   - Apply die-level alignment offset $(X_{\text{offset}}, Y_{\text{offset}})$ to register the AFM tip directly over the memory array W-plug test pattern (targeting the access transistor drain contact via plug between channels of $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

4. **AFM / Profilometer Tip Engagement & Scanning**:
   - Navigate the stage to each mapped $(X_k, Y_k)$ site in serpentine order to minimize stage transit latency.
   - Engage high-aspect-ratio tip in non-contact/tapping mode or mechanical profilometer stylus over a scan window of $10\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 10\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.
   - Acquire high-resolution surface micro-topography data to quantify tungsten plug dishing and array oxide erosion.

5. **Topography Map Generation & Uniformity Analysis**:
   - Compile raw scan profiles across all 9 or 49 sites.
   - Correlate dielectric baseline erosion with pre-CMP/post-CMP dielectric values (referencing dry gate oxide baseline at $3.5\text{ nm}$ and photoresist profile at $1.3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
   - Export radial profile contours to verify planarization across concentric CMP slurry flow vectors.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                      Acceptance Criteria & Targets     
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░                                   │
 Junction Leakage┤░░                                   │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
 Cell Capacitance┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Photoresist Delta┤▓▓▓▓                                 │
                 │▓▓▓▓                                 │
 Gate Oxide Delta┤█                                    │
                 │█                                    │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0        7       14       21       28 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Value / Range | Exact Units | Target Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dielectric Gate Oxide Metrology Uncertainty** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Sub-angstrom precision tracking at $3.5\text{ nm}$ film baseline |
| **Thick Film / Photoresist Profile Uncertainty** | $\pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Profilometric resolution verified against $1.3\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ thick films |
| **Memory Cell Storage Node Capacitance** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Stacked capacitor integrity post-W-plug planarization |
| **Access Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage** | $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain target refresh interval |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
   - Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measurement precision requirement ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) and photoresist film thickness calibration ($1.3\text{ }\mu\text{m} \pm 2\text{ nm}$).
   - Polarization quantification via Fresnel reflection coefficients: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - 180nm unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) utilizing tungsten plug (W-plug) connection to stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
   - Electrical integrity boundary conditions requiring storage node capacitance $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ and leakage current $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Four Point Probe Method**:
   - Tungsten carbide tip contact methodology for electrical and mechanical surface characterization.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated conversion between polar (r, theta) stage positioning and Cartesian (x, y) scan vectors must account for chuck runout, theta encoder eccentricity, and optical notch-alignment offsets. A cumulative Abbe error exceeding 0.5 um during coordinate transformation will cause the AFM cantilever tip to land outside the 1.2 um scribe-line test pattern or dense DRAM tungsten plug arrays, resulting in false erosion readings or destructive cantilever tip crash against array edge topography.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm CMP node, radial topography maps require multi-point sampling across center, middle, and edge exclusion zones (down to 3 mm edge exclusion). The coordinate translation script must accurately sync polar rotation angles with orthogonal AFM fast/slow scan axes; otherwise, scan direction-dependent tip convolution artifacts will misrepresent tungsten plug dishing depths (nominal 15-25 nm) and inter-layer dielectric (ILD) oxide erosion steps across 200mm wafers.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying a COTS automated AFM/stylus profilometer dual-stage system with high-speed polar-to-Cartesian recipe translation requires securing calibrated diamond-like carbon (DLC) or high-aspect-ratio silicon cantilevers (nominal tip radius < 10 nm) with lead times exceeding 16 weeks. Second-sourcing diamond-coated probes is mandatory to prevent fab line stops during high-volume CMP post-polish qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Software tool qualification for polar-to-Cartesian recipe mapping is on the critical path for the 180nm commercial MPW tapeout. Failure to deliver automated recipe conversion within 10 days will delay post-W-CMP baseline metrology, impacting downstream contact/via metallization and pushing wafer lot release past scheduled foundry review milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Cantilever tip crash and catastrophic mechanical fracture during automated polar stage transit caused by Cartesian Z-clearance height calculation failure over wafer edge bevel roll-off.
1. Systematic azimuth angle theta skew leading to measurement target misregistration where the AFM scan area misses the 180nm W-plug test array and samples open-field planar oxide.
1. Coordinate rounding and non-linear Abbe error accumulation in the polar-to-Cartesian kinematic transformation matrix resulting in >5% radial dishing extraction distortion across 49-point wafer maps.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-3-1-01` | **Automated Polar-to-Cartesian Coordinate Transformation Accuracy & Target Acquisition Verification** | Automated 200mm Wafer Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with integrated high-resolution theta-R polar stage, pattern recognition optics (0.5 um resolution), and Cartesian scan head. | 1. Load automated recipe defining 49 radial inspection sites specified in polar coordinates (r in mm from 0 to 97 mm, theta from 0 to 359.9 degrees).\n2. Execute automated polar-to-Cartesian script to translate target coordinates into absolute stage (X, Y) commands.\n3. Drive stage sequentially across all 49 radial points, utilizing automated optical pattern recognition to register fiducial center offsets (Delta X, Delta Y).\n4. Record stage positioning error vector magnitude sqrt(Delta X^2 + Delta Y^2) at each site. | `Positioning error magnitude must be <= 0.8 um across all 49 radial inspection sites; zero instances of pattern recognition failure or stage out-of-travel bounds error.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-3-1-02` | **Radial Multi-Point W-Plug Dishing Measurement Repeatability (Gauge R&R)** | Automated AFM equipped with non-contact/tapping mode silicon cantilever (resonance frequency ~300 kHz, tip radius < 10 nm) and integrated step-height analysis software. | 1. Execute automated polar-to-Cartesian recipe to perform 10 um x 10 um AFM topography scans over dense tungsten plug test arrays at 9 radial sites.\n2. Measure peak-to-valley W-plug dishing depth and ILD oxide erosion profile automatically.\n3. Unload and reload wafer; repeat automated 9-site scan cycle for 10 consecutive runs.\n4. Calculate Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (R&R) and coefficient of variation (CV) for dishing depth across all sites. | `Measurement coefficient of variation (CV) must be < 1.0% across all 9 radial sites; maximum standard deviation for W-plug dishing depth must be <= 0.25 nm across 10 repeated runs.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/laser safety side-shield goggles, Full static-dissipative cleanroom gown and hood, Static-dissipative ESD safety shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of IPA skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin thoroughly with copious running water for at least 15 minutes. In case of eye contact: Irrigate exposed eyes with tepid isotonic saline or clean water for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open; seek immediate medical attention. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors: Evacuate person to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For Class 3R AFM laser diode exposure: Seek specialized ophthalmologic examination immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: AFM metrology tool enclosure must maintain constant laminar downward cleanroom air flow (0.45 m/s +/- 20%) with Class 1 HEPA filtration. Local chemical exhaust at solvent wipe station must maintain minimum face capture velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) with volatile organic vapor extraction.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and solvent swabs must be deposited into dedicated, grounded, self-closing hazardous flammables waste receptacles under continuous exhaust; disposed of as hazardous organic solvent waste in compliance with cleanroom environmental guidelines. Contaminated silica/cantilever sharps must be placed in rigid puncture-proof biohazard/sharps containers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade C-1 (MOS / Electronic Grade) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | High Purity Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly polished post-CMP 180nm tungsten plug and ILD oxide wafer surface, thoroughly scrubbed, megasonic-cleaned, and dried via Marangoni dryer; hydrophobic/hydrophilic stable surface with zero slurry residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Non-destructively profiled, particle-free wafer surface with verified absence of AFM tip-drag scratches or organic solvent stains, ready for post-CMP clean review or dielectric cap deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air queue time promotes galvanic corrosion between exposed tungsten plugs and titanium nitride adhesion liners, accelerated moisture-induced native oxide (WOx) growth, and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption that distorts sub-nanometer AFM topography extraction and degrades downstream inter-metal dielectric adhesion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Researchers obtain an automated, validated polar-to-Cartesian recipe translation module integrated with the wafer AFM/profilometer system, enabling unattended 49-point radial scans for sub-nanometer extraction of tungsten plug dishing and array oxide erosion on 200mm wafers.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `W_CMP_RADIAL_EROSION_DISHING_MAP_LOT01.csv`
- [ ] `AFM_METROLOGY_GAUGE_RR_QUALIFICATION_REPORT.pdf`

| `ASSERT-01` | **Polar-to-Cartesian stage positioning target alignment accuracy across 200mm wafer field** | `0.50` | +/- 0.30 um | Automated optical pattern recognition offset registration against certified 10 um pitch 2D calibration wafer grid. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Measurement repeatability coefficient of variation (CV) for tungsten plug dishing depth** | `0.65` | < 1.00 % | 10-run automated Gage R&R repeatability loop on 9 radial inspection coordinates spanning wafer center to 3mm edge exclusion. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **49-point full wafer radial topography scan sequence execution time** | `42.0` | +/- 3.0 minutes | Internal tool SECS/GEM timestamp logging of start, site-to-site transit, auto-focus, scan acquisition, and wafer park cycle. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

A cumulative Abbe error exceeding 0.5 um during coordinate transformation will cause the AFM cantilever tip to land outside the 1.2 um scribe-line test pattern or dense DRAM tungsten plug arrays, resulting in false erosion readings or destructive cantilever tip crash against array edge topography.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm CMP node, radial topography maps require multi-point sampling across center, middle, and edge exclusion zones (down to 3 mm edge exclusion). The coordinate translation script must accurately sync polar rotation angles with orthogonal AFM fast/slow scan axes; otherwise, scan direction-dependent tip convolution artifacts will misrepresent tungsten plug dishing depths (nominal 15-25 nm) and inter-layer dielectric (ILD) oxide erosion steps across 200mm wafers.
critics.supply_chain: Specifying a COTS automated AFM/stylus profilometer dual-stage system with high-speed polar-to-Cartesian recipe translation requires securing calibrated diamond-like carbon (DLC) or high-aspect-ratio silicon cantilevers (nominal tip radius < 10 nm) with lead times exceeding 16 weeks. Second-sourcing diamond-coated probes is mandatory to prevent fab line stops during high-volume CMP post-polish qualification.
critics.laya_pm: Software tool qualification for polar-to-Cartesian recipe mapping is on the critical path for the 180nm commercial MPW tapeout. Failure to deliver automated recipe conversion within 10 days will delay post-W-CMP baseline metrology, impacting downstream contact/via metallization and pushing wafer lot release past scheduled foundry review milestones.
critical_failure_modes: Cantilever tip crash and catastrophic mechanical fracture during automated polar stage transit caused by Cartesian Z-clearance height calculation failure over wafer edge bevel roll-off.
Systematic azimuth angle theta skew leading to measurement target misregistration where the AFM scan area misses the 180nm W-plug test array and samples open-field planar oxide.
Coordinate rounding and non-linear Abbe error accumulation in the polar-to-Cartesian kinematic transformation matrix resulting in >5% radial dishing extraction distortion across 49-point wafer maps.

testcases.title: Automated Polar-to-Cartesian Coordinate Transformation Accuracy & Target Acquisition Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated 200mm Wafer Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) with integrated high-resolution theta-R polar stage, pattern recognition optics (0.5 um resolution), and Cartesian scan head.
testcases.pre_conditions: 200mm calibration wafer with certified Cartesian grid pitch targets (10.000 um pitch, 100 nm step height) loaded on the vacuum chuck; optical notch aligned to 0.00 degrees; chuck theta runout calibrated to < 0.2 um.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load automated recipe defining 49 radial inspection sites specified in polar coordinates (r in mm from 0 to 97 mm, theta from 0 to 359.9 degrees).
2. Execute automated polar-to-Cartesian script to translate target coordinates into absolute stage (X, Y) commands.
3. Drive stage sequentially across all 49 radial points, utilizing automated optical pattern recognition to register fiducial center offsets (Delta X, Delta Y).
4. Record stage positioning error vector magnitude sqrt(Delta X^2 + Delta Y^2) at each site.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Positioning error magnitude must be <= 0.8 um across all 49 radial inspection sites; zero instances of pattern recognition failure or stage out-of-travel bounds error.

testcases.title: Radial Multi-Point W-Plug Dishing Measurement Repeatability (Gauge R&R)
testcases.instrumentation: Automated AFM equipped with non-contact/tapping mode silicon cantilever (resonance frequency ~300 kHz, tip radius < 10 nm) and integrated step-height analysis software.
testcases.pre_conditions: Post-W-CMP 180nm DRAM test wafer with completed DI-water clean and Marangoni dry; verified zero particulate defects > 0.18 um; AFM recipe calibrated on 9 radial test sites (r = 0, 25, 50, 75, 95 mm at 0 deg and 180 deg).
testcases.procedure:
1. Execute automated polar-to-Cartesian recipe to perform 10 um x 10 um AFM topography scans over dense tungsten plug test arrays at 9 radial sites.
2. Measure peak-to-valley W-plug dishing depth and ILD oxide erosion profile automatically.
3. Unload and reload wafer; repeat automated 9-site scan cycle for 10 consecutive runs.
4. Calculate Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (R&R) and coefficient of variation (CV) for dishing depth across all sites.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Measurement coefficient of variation (CV) must be < 1.0% across all 9 radial sites; maximum standard deviation for W-plug dishing depth must be <= 0.25 nm across 10 repeated runs.

ppe_required: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloving required)
ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/laser safety side-shield goggles
Full static-dissipative cleanroom gown and hood

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of IPA skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin thoroughly with copious running water for at least 15 minutes. In case of eye contact: Irrigate exposed eyes with tepid isotonic saline or clean water for at least 15 minutes, holding eyelids open; seek immediate medical attention. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors: Evacuate person to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For Class 3R AFM laser diode exposure: Seek specialized ophthalmologic examination immediately.

Local chemical exhaust at solvent wipe station must maintain minimum face capture velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) with volatile organic vapor extraction.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Used IPA wipes and solvent swabs must be deposited into dedicated, grounded, self-closing hazardous flammables waste receptacles under continuous exhaust; disposed of as hazardous organic solvent waste in compliance with cleanroom environmental guidelines. Contaminated silica/cantilever sharps must be placed in rigid puncture-proof biohazard/sharps containers.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly polished post-CMP 180nm tungsten plug and ILD oxide wafer surface, thoroughly scrubbed, megasonic-cleaned, and dried via Marangoni dryer; hydrophobic/hydrophilic stable surface with zero slurry residue.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Non-destructively profiled, particle-free wafer surface with verified absence of AFM tip-drag scratches or organic solvent stains, ready for post-CMP clean review or dielectric cap deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding cleanroom air queue time promotes galvanic corrosion between exposed tungsten plugs and titanium nitride adhesion liners, accelerated moisture-induced native oxide (WOx) growth, and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption that distorts sub-nanometer AFM topography extraction and degrades downstream inter-metal dielectric adhesion.

expected_result.summary: Researchers obtain an automated, validated polar-to-Cartesian recipe translation module integrated with the wafer AFM/profilometer system, enabling unattended 49-point radial scans for sub-nanometer extraction of tungsten plug dishing and array oxide erosion on 200mm wafers.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Measurement repeatability coefficient of variation (CV) for tungsten plug dishing depth

quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Internal tool SECS/GEM timestamp logging of start, site-to-site transit, auto-focus, scan acquisition, and wafer park cycle.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-CMP-049`
**Title:** 49-Point Radial Line-Scan Profilometry Execution Across Center-to-Edge DRAM Dense Cell & Periphery Plugs  
**Node:** 180nm CMOS DRAM Process (Gen 3 nm) — DRAM Foundation VN Open-Source Tapeout  
**Classification:** Metrology / Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Quality Assurance  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Visual Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Wafer Loading &     │
│    Notch Alignment     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    49-Point Radial     │
│  Sampling Grid Setup   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  AFM/Stylus Line-Scan  │
│      over W-Plugs      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Dishing & Array     │
│     Oxide Erosion      │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Radial Planarization  │
│       Uniformity       │
│       Assessment       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Physical & Architectural Constraints

- **Cell Topology:** Stacked Capacitor-over-Bitline (COB) architecture with 8$F^2$ / 6$F^2$ folded bitline layout ([`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`](./docs/)).
- **Access Transistor Dimensions:** Gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Interconnect & Pitch:** Wordline/Bitline pitch of approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$. Contact to bitline is shared between two adjacent memory cells and accessed via tungsten contact plug (W-plug).
- **Dielectric & Oxide Context:** Gate dielectric dry $\text{SiO}_2$ equivalent physical thickness $= 3.5\text{ nm}$ (monitored with sub-Angstrom precision $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$); Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) post-CMP requires radial mapping across 49 concentric points ([`Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology`](./docs/)).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Alignment & Recipe Selection:**
   - Load post-W-CMP cleaned and dried 200 mm wafer into the high-resolution automated AFM / high-precision surface profiler metrology chamber.
   - Perform notch alignment ($0^\circ$ orientation) and chuck vacuum lock ($\ge 80\text{ kPa}$).
   - Load recipe `W_CMP_RADIAL_49PT`.

2. **49-Point Radial Grid Generation:**
   - Establish a 49-point concentric polar inspection map extending from the wafer center ($r = 0\text{ mm}$) to near-edge ($r = 97\text{ mm}$, maintaining a $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion zone).
   - Divide sampling into 5 radial zones: Center (1 point), Inner Ring ($r \approx 25\text{ mm}$, 8 points), Middle Ring ($r \approx 50\text{ mm}$, 12 points), Outer Ring ($r \approx 75\text{ mm}$, 16 points), and Extreme Edge Ring ($r \approx 95\text{ mm}$, 12 points).

3. **Pattern Recognition & Site Alignment:**
   - At each of the 49 coordinates, perform optical pattern recognition (PR) targeting:
     - **Site A (Dense Cell Array):** Memory cell core with shared bitline W-plugs on a $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch grid.
     - **Site B (Periphery Circuitry):** Isolated peripheral transistor contact plugs ($W = 220\text{ nm}, L = 180\text{ nm}$ active transistor landing pads).

4. **Line-Scan Profilometry Execution:**
   - Set AFM cantilever scan mode to tapping / non-contact mode (high-aspect-ratio silicon tip, radius $< 10\text{ nm}$).
   - Execute transverse line scans perpendicular to the plug array:
     - **Dense Array Scan Length:** $20.0\ \mu\text{m}$ across at least 40 consecutive dense memory cells ($360 - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch).
     - **Periphery Scan Length:** $10.0\ \mu\text{m}$ covering isolated plugs and neighboring planar field oxide.
   - Scan speed: $\le 0.5\text{ Hz}$; sampling resolution: 1024 data points per scan line.

5. **Topography Profile Extraction:**
   - Extract raw surface elevation profile $Z(x)$. Perform baseline tilt leveling using adjacent unetched ILD field oxide references.
   - Calculate:
     - **W-Plug Dishing ($D_{\text{plug}}$):** Vertical recession depth from surrounding ILD plane to the plug center:
       $$D_{\text{plug}} = Z_{\text{ILD, local}} - Z_{\text{plug, min}}$$
     - **Dense Array Oxide Erosion ($E_{\text{array}}$):** Relative height loss between peripheral unpatterned field oxide and array oxide:
       $$E_{\text{array}} = Z_{\text{periph, ILD}} - Z_{\text{array, ILD}}$$

6. **Radial Uniformity Calculation & Disposition:**
   - Calculate within-wafer non-uniformity (NU%) across the 49 measured sites:
     $$\text{NU}\% = \frac{\sigma_{D_{\text{plug}}}}{\mu_{D_{\text{plug}}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Map profile signatures (center-fast vs. edge-fast polishing behavior) and export data to the factory APC (Advanced Process Control) database.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method & Units | Disposition / Action Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Plug Dishing ($D_{\text{plug}}$)** | $\le 25.0\text{ nm}$ (Periphery) / $\le 20.0\text{ nm}$ (Dense Cell) | High-Resolution AFM Line-Scan ($\text{nm}$) | Flag for CMP polish time trim if $> 30.0\text{ nm}$ |
| **Array Oxide Erosion ($E_{\text{array}}$)** | $\le 35.0\text{ nm}$ | Relative step height AFM ($\text{nm}$) | Adjust slurry abrasive loading / head pressure if $> 45.0\text{ nm}$ |
| **Within-Wafer Radial Non-Uniformity (NU%)** | $\le 7.5\%$ across 49 radial points | 49-point statistical standard deviation ($\%$) | Recalibrate CMP multi-zone carrier retaining ring pressures if $> 10.0\%$ |
| **Adjacent ILD Micro-Roughness ($R_a$)** | $\le 0.35\text{ nm}$ | Post-CMP AFM surface profile ($\text{nm}$) | Rework/Scrub cycle if micro-scratches induce $R_a > 0.60\text{ nm}$ |

```text
                 Representative W-Plug Dishing Across Radial Points (nm)
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
        Edge Plug┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
Mid-Radius Periph┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
 Mid-Radius Dense┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓      │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓      │
      Center Plug┤████████████████████████             │
                 │████████████████████████             │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0      5.6     11.2     16.8    22.4 
```

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

1. **[`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`](./docs/):**
   - Transistor geometries ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Shared bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) in $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline cell layouts.
2. **[`Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology`](./docs/):**
   - Automated 49-point wafer mapping methodology for tracking radial film non-uniformity across CMP and furnace processes.
   - Baseline dry gate oxide precision scale reference ($3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
3. **[`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`](./docs/):**
   - Bitline and wordline pitch specifications ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Thermal oxide thickness reference ($3.5\text{ nm}$) grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 49-point radial sampling scheme must reconcile spatial frequency mismatch between macro-scale CMP platen non-uniformity (wafer-scale Prestonian polishing pressure roll-off at edge exclusion zones) and local pattern density gradients between dense 8F^2 memory mat plugs (pattern density >45%) versus sparse periphery logic contacts (<10%). Profilometry line-scans must utilize dual-mode stylus/AFM tracking with synchronized de-skew algorithms to prevent high-aspect-ratio tip convolution from skewing height delta extractions across cell-to-periphery transitions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm COB architecture with 28 fF target cell capacitance, tungsten plug dishing exceeding 35 nm or oxide erosion exceeding 45 nm directly thins the bottom electrode contact pad interface, driving contact resistance variance R_c > 15 Ohm/via and causing bitline sensing margin asymmetry across folded bitline sense amplifiers. A radial scan pitch that skips critical transition boundary dice will fail to catch severe edge-die dielectric thinning caused by retaining-ring wear during tungsten buff CMP.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: High-density diamond-coated AFM cantilever tips and ultra-fine stylus probes (tip radius < 10 nm) exhibit accelerated wear rates when traversing abrasive silica/alumina post-CMP residues across 49 line-scans per wafer. Sourcing from certified single-crystal diamond tip vendors requires maintaining safety buffer stock of at least 60 tips per MPW run to avoid line-stoppage due to tip-breakage or tip-radius blunting beyond 20 nm.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing a 49-point radial scan with full sub-nanometer vertical resolution requires ~42 minutes per wafer, threatening the strict 120-minute Q-time window between post-CMP megasonic clean and post-CMP inter-metal dielectric (IMD) / bottom electrode contact (BEC) barrier deposition. Profilometry throughput must be balanced by using high-speed dual-head line scans or statistical 17-site screening with automated 49-point excursion escalation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Profilometer stylus or AFM tip blunting/chipping midway through the 49-point run causing artificial step-height smoothing, masking catastrophic 60 nm periphery plug dishing.
1. Edge-exclusion zone (R > 97 mm on 200 mm wafer) profile cliff-drop inducing mechanical tip skate and sample surface scratching across active gate periphery scribe structures.
1. Cross-die pattern density transition shock causing scan-stage micro-vibrations and false oxide erosion peaks in the outer radial zone.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-3-2-01` | **49-Point Radial Tungsten Plug Dishing Profilometry in Dense Cell Array vs. Periphery** | Atomic Force Profiler (AFP) / High-Resolution Stylus Profilometer with calibrated <10 nm diamond tip and laser heterodyne interferometer Z-sensor (KLA-Tencor HRP-350 or Park Systems FX40) | 1. Load wafer onto electrostatic chuck with notch oriented at 6 o'clock and execute automated 3-point pattern alignment on alignment die (0,0). 2. Program a 49-site polar coordinate map along 8 radial vectors (0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315 deg) from center (R=0 mm) to edge (R=97 mm, 3 mm edge exclusion). 3. At each site, execute a 50 um transverse line-scan at 2 um/s crossing both dense 8F^2 DRAM cell array plugs (0.22 um diameter, 0.40 um pitch) and isolated periphery circuit contact plugs (0.28 um diameter). 4. Apply 5th-order polynomial plane leveling to reference adjacent field oxide plateaus. 5. Compute peak-to-valley dishing depth for dense cell plugs and isolated periphery plugs. | `Dense array W-plug dishing depth <= 25.0 nm across all 49 sites; Periphery isolated W-plug dishing depth <= 35.0 nm; within-wafer dishing non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) <= 8.5%.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-3-2-02` | **Cross-Wafer Radial ILD Oxide Erosion Profilometric Assessment** | Automated Long-Trace Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak / Bruker DektakXT) with 2 um diamond stylus and low-force 1.0 mg head assembly | 1. Perform continuous radial diameter scans across X-axis (-97 mm to +97 mm) and Y-axis (-97 mm to +97 mm) intersecting dense cell array blocks and adjacent unpatterned scribe-line field oxide. 2. Extract step height delta between unpatterned field oxide baseline and dense array ILD plateau at each of the 49 defined radial inspection coordinates. 3. Filter micro-roughness using a Gaussian cutoff filter (lambda_c = 8 um). 4. Quantify dielectric erosion depth as Delta_H = H_field_oxide - H_array_oxide. | `Array oxide erosion <= 35.0 nm for all radial sites R <= 90 mm; Array oxide erosion <= 45.0 nm for edge sites 90 mm < R <= 97 mm; Total profile TIR (Total Indicated Runout) across array-to-periphery boundaries <= 40.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 1 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, accelerator-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical safety goggles, Static-dissipative ESD cleanroom coat and conductive footwear, Polypropylene lab apron for wet-clean handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA or trace chemical residues: flush affected area immediately with deionized water for at least 15 minutes. For suspect HF contact: wash immediately with water for 1 minute, continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel into the affected area, and seek immediate specialized medical treatment. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move subject to fresh air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Profilometer enclosure maintained under mini-environment laminar flow HEPA filtration with dedicated local solvent exhaust duct (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s or 100 fpm) and active static neutralization bar.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent wafer cleaning solvents (IPA) collected in dedicated stainless steel flammable solvent carboys. Aqueous rinse effluent routed to cleanroom acid-waste neutralization (AWN) system maintaining pH between 6.5 and 8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier C / VLSI Grade) | `> 99.8% v/v` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH - trace residue neutralizing rinse)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Grade 4) | `0.26% w/w aqueous` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (dilute post-metrology dip)** | `7664-39-3` | Ultra-Pure Microelectronics Grade | `0.5% w/w aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic post-megasonic-cleaned SiO2 surface with fully rinsed tungsten plug surfaces; free of residual slurry silica particles (>0.15 um particle count < 20 per 200mm wafer) and no active liquid meniscus.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Passivated, dry planarized dielectric and W-plug surface with native oxide growth < 1.2 nm, ready for immediate IMD/BEC barrier metallization (Ti/TiN PVD).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Galvanic corrosion of tungsten plugs driven by ambient humidity and atmospheric fluorine/chlorine trace contaminants, causing plug recess pitting, tungsten trioxide (WO3) bloom, and open contacts during bitline-to-plug contact landing.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified 49-point cross-wafer radial topography dataset validating tungsten plug dishing and array oxide erosion compliance with 180nm DRAM folded-bitline integration budgets (Cs = 28 fF, delta-Rc < 10%). Complete radial maps confirm uniform CMP removal rate across center, middle, and edge exclusion dies.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `W_CMP_Radial_49Pt_Dishing_Erosion_Profile.csv`
- [ ] `Wafer_Center_to_Edge_Topography_Contour_Map.pdf`
- [ ] `HighRes_DenseCell_Periphery_AFM_LineScan_Overlay.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum tungsten plug dishing in dense 8F^2 cell array across all 49 radial inspection sites** | `20.0 nm` | +5.0 nm / -10.0 nm | High-resolution AFM line-scan step height analysis across 50 um dense cell profile |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Center-to-edge dense array ILD oxide erosion delta (R=0 mm vs R=97 mm)** | `12.0 nm` | <= 8.0 nm differential | Stylus profilometry step height comparison of dense cell array plateau relative to adjacent scribe-line field oxide |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Within-wafer plug dishing non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean percentage across 49 points)** | `6.0%` | <= 8.5% | Statistical polar coordinate dispersion calculation across all 8 radial scanning vectors |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 radial inspection sites exhibit dense plug dishing <= 25 nm, periphery plug dishing <= 35 nm, and array oxide erosion <= 45 nm, with zero detected tip-induced scratch defects and complete metrology execution within the 60-minute cleanroom air Q-time boundary.

testcases.title: 49-Point Radial Tungsten Plug Dishing Profilometry in Dense Cell Array vs. Periphery
testcases.instrumentation: Atomic Force Profiler (AFP) / High-Resolution Stylus Profilometer with calibrated <10 nm diamond tip and laser heterodyne interferometer Z-sensor (KLA-Tencor HRP-350 or Park Systems FX40)
testcases.pre_conditions: 200mm wafer post-W-CMP and post-double-sided PVA brush scrub + megasonic clean; wafer dried with SRD (spin-rinse dry) under Class 1 cleanroom conditions; acoustic isolation table floating at 1.2 Hz resonance.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer onto electrostatic chuck with notch oriented at 6 o'clock and execute automated 3-point pattern alignment on alignment die (0,0).
2. Program a 49-site polar coordinate map along 8 radial vectors (0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315 deg) from center (R=0 mm) to edge (R=97 mm, 3 mm edge exclusion).
3. At each site, execute a 50 um transverse line-scan at 2 um/s crossing both dense 8F^2 DRAM cell array plugs (0.22 um diameter, 0.40 um pitch) and isolated periphery circuit contact plugs (0.28 um diameter).
4. Apply 5th-order polynomial plane leveling to reference adjacent field oxide plateaus.
5. Compute peak-to-valley dishing depth for dense cell plugs and isolated periphery plugs.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Dense array W-plug dishing depth <= 25.0 nm across all 49 sites; Periphery isolated W-plug dishing depth <= 35.0 nm; within-wafer dishing non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean) <= 8.5%.

testcases.title: Cross-Wafer Radial ILD Oxide Erosion Profilometric Assessment
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Long-Trace Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak / Bruker DektakXT) with 2 um diamond stylus and low-force 1.0 mg head assembly
testcases.pre_conditions: Profilometer calibrated with VLSI Standards 44.0 nm step height reference standard; ambient temperature stabilized at 21.0 +/- 0.2 deg C, RH 45 +/- 3%.
testcases.procedure:
1. Perform continuous radial diameter scans across X-axis (-97 mm to +97 mm) and Y-axis (-97 mm to +97 mm) intersecting dense cell array blocks and adjacent unpatterned scribe-line field oxide.
2. Extract step height delta between unpatterned field oxide baseline and dense array ILD plateau at each of the 49 defined radial inspection coordinates.
3. Filter micro-roughness using a Gaussian cutoff filter (lambda_c = 8 um).
4. Quantify dielectric erosion depth as Delta_H = H_field_oxide - H_array_oxide.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Array oxide erosion <= 35.0 nm for all radial sites R <= 90 mm; Array oxide erosion <= 45.0 nm for edge sites 90 mm < R <= 97 mm; Total profile TIR (Total Indicated Runout) across array-to-periphery boundaries <= 40.0 nm.

ppe_required: Class 1 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, accelerator-free)
ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical safety goggles
Static-dissipative ESD cleanroom coat and conductive footwear
Polypropylene lab apron for wet-clean handling

cas_chemicals.purity_grade: Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier C / VLSI Grade)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin contact with IPA or trace chemical residues: flush affected area immediately with deionized water for at least 15 minutes. For suspect HF contact: wash immediately with water for 1 minute, continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel into the affected area, and seek immediate specialized medical treatment. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move subject to fresh air immediately.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Profilometer enclosure maintained under mini-environment laminar flow HEPA filtration with dedicated local solvent exhaust duct (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s or 100 fpm) and active static neutralization bar.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent wafer cleaning solvents (IPA) collected in dedicated stainless steel flammable solvent carboys. Aqueous rinse effluent routed to cleanroom acid-waste neutralization (AWN) system maintaining pH between 6.5 and 8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophilic post-megasonic-cleaned SiO2 surface with fully rinsed tungsten plug surfaces; free of residual slurry silica particles (>0.15 um particle count < 20 per 200mm wafer) and no active liquid meniscus.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Passivated, dry planarized dielectric and W-plug surface with native oxide growth < 1.2 nm, ready for immediate IMD/BEC barrier metallization (Ti/TiN PVD).
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Galvanic corrosion of tungsten plugs driven by ambient humidity and atmospheric fluorine/chlorine trace contaminants, causing plug recess pitting, tungsten trioxide (WO3) bloom, and open contacts during bitline-to-plug contact landing.

expected_result.summary: Verified 49-point cross-wafer radial topography dataset validating tungsten plug dishing and array oxide erosion compliance with 180nm DRAM folded-bitline integration budgets (Cs = 28 fF, delta-Rc < 10%). Complete radial maps confirm uniform CMP removal rate across center, middle, and edge exclusion dies.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum tungsten plug dishing in dense 8F^2 cell array across all 49 radial inspection sites
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-resolution AFM line-scan step height analysis across 50 um dense cell profile

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Center-to-edge dense array ILD oxide erosion delta (R=0 mm vs R=97 mm)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Stylus profilometry step height comparison of dense cell array plateau relative to adjacent scribe-line field oxide

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Within-wafer plug dishing non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean percentage across 49 points)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Statistical polar coordinate dispersion calculation across all 8 radial scanning vectors

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 49 radial inspection sites exhibit dense plug dishing <= 25 nm, periphery plug dishing <= 35 nm, and array oxide erosion <= 45 nm, with zero detected tip-induced scratch defects and complete metrology execution within the 60-minute cleanroom air Q-time boundary.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title
**Radial Dishing/Erosion Topography Contour Reconstruction and CMP Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) Evaluation**

---

### 1. Document Control & Context
* **Module**: Post-CMP Ellipsometry, AFM Topography Profilometry, and Defect Metrology
* **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture / 180nm CMOS MPW Tapeout (SKY130-compatible back-end integration)
* **Target Structures**: Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) oxide fields and dense array Tungsten (W) contacts/plugs (Contact CD: $0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ on a $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ manufacturing grid) feeding stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) drain nodes.

---

### 2. Workflow & Process Architecture

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  1. Coordinate Grid Setup: 49-point polar mapping across wafer radius (R)      |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  2. Baseline Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Polarization Angles Ψ, Δ Modeling)    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  3. High-Resolution AFM Scans (W-Plug Dishing & Dense Array Oxide Erosion)     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                      |
                                      v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  4. Radial Topography Reconstruction & Mathematical WIWNU Extraction (%)       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Polar Measurement Coordinate Setup**:
   * Mount the post-W-CMP cleaned wafer onto the automated vacuum stage.
   * Establish an automated **49-point wafer mapping** routine distributed across radial tracks ($r = 0\,\text{mm}$ [center], $r = 0.33R$, $r = 0.66R$, and edge exclusion boundary $r \le R - 3\,\text{mm}$).
   * Align stage coordinates using the $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ physical manufacturing grid system to register dense cell-array test modules containing $0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ W-plug contacts.

2. **Full-Field Dielectric Baseline Acquisition (Spectroscopic Ellipsometry)**:
   * Measure unpatterned dielectric field reference sites at each of the 49 points.
   * Acquire complex Fresnel reflection ratios:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
   * Execute dispersion parameter fitting using the parameterized Cauchy/Sellmeier model to extract field oxide residual film thickness with baseline measurement precision $\le \pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$.

3. **Localized AFM Topography Profilometry**:
   * Position the atomic force microscope (AFM) probe above the selected memory cell array sites (dense $0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ contact plug arrays) and adjacent open oxide test structures.
   * Perform high-density tapping mode scans across a $10\,\mu\text{m} \times 10\,\mu\text{m}$ window over the cell array to capture:
     * **W-Plug Dishing**: Peak-to-valley profile depth between the adjacent field/inter-layer dielectric and the recessed center of the $0.17\,\mu\text{m}$ tungsten plug.
     * **Array Oxide Erosion**: Differential height baseline between isolated open-field oxide and dense bitline/cell-contact array oxide.

4. **Radial Contour Reconstruction & WIWNU Computation**:
   * Reconstruct the 2D radial surface contour map by superimposing absolute residual oxide heights from ellipsometry with localized AFM dishing/erosion step heights across all radial zones.
   * Compute Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity ($\text{WIWNU}_{\%}$) using the standard standard-deviation formula:
     $$\text{WIWNU}_{\%} = \frac{\sigma}{\mu} \times 100 = \frac{\sqrt{\frac{1}{N-1} \sum_{i=1}^{N} (T_i - \bar{T})^2}}{\bar{T}} \times 100$$
     where $N = 49$, $T_i$ represents the local total topography height (or net erosion/residual thickness) at point $i$, and $\bar{T}$ is the cross-wafer mean.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Identifier | Parameter Description | Nominal / Target Spec | Measurement Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-MET-01** | Wafer Mapping Sampling Density | **49 points** per radial run | Automated Wafer Handling Stage / Mapping Unit |
| **AC-MET-02** | Contact Plug Centerline Critical Dimension | **$0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$** (placement on $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ grid) | In-line CD-SEM / Calibrated AFM Profilometry |
| **AC-MET-03** | Baseline Dielectric Measurement Precision | $\mathbf{\le \pm 0.05\,\text{nm}}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Polarization $\Psi, \Delta$) |
| **AC-MET-04** | Post-CMP Global Radial WIWNU ($1\sigma / \text{mean}$) | $\mathbf{\le 4.5\%}$ across 49-point contour | Automated Data Synthesis System |

---

### 5. Context Sources & Literature Citations

* **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  * Physical model and ratio equation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ using Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion parameters.
  * Prescribed measurement precision of $\pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$ and radial tracking using **49-point wafer mapping**.
* **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  * Physical manufacturing grid resolution: $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$).
  * Contact hole minimum geometry dimension: $0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  * Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture using tungsten plugs (W-plugs) contacting drain and access transistor nodes ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-W-CMP radial topography reconstruction integrates 49-point automated spectroscopic ellipsometry with high-resolution atomic force microscopy (AFM) step scans. The primary architectural risk is cross-tool coordinate registration mismatch between optical macro-reflectometry coordinates and localized nanoscale AFM scanning sites across the 200mm wafer. If coordinate translation and stage skew exceed 5 um, localized dense DRAM contact array dishing/erosion will be misattributed to field oxide WIWNU, corrupting the feedback loop into the multi-zone CMP carrier retaining ring back-pressure controllers.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm technology node, depth of focus (DOF = k2 * lambda / NA^2 >= 0.5 um) imposes strict limits on cumulative topography variance prior to Metal 1 lithography. Tungsten plug dishing in 220nm diameter contacts must not exceed 25 nm, while localized dense array dielectric erosion must remain below 35 nm. A failure in zone-specific slurry distribution or pad conditioning downforce creates severe edge roll-off (ERO) within the outer 5mm exclusion zone, shifting optical Cauchy model fitting parameters (Psi and Delta) and inducing severe metal bridging or plug voiding during subsequent metallization.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-vendor dependency on ultra-sharp diamond-like carbon (DLC) coated AFM cantilever tips (tip radius < 10 nm) represents a critical line-stop bottleneck. Operating in high-throughput tapping mode across 49 dies per wafer rapidly induces tip wear and blunting, which artifically broadens contact profiles and degrades height resolution. Establishing qualified dual-sourcing for cantilevers and stocking a buffer of calibrated silicon step-height transfer standards is mandatory to avoid metrology downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Comprehensive 49-point full-die AFM raster scanning introduces unacceptable measurement latency (>180 minutes per wafer), colliding directly with the cleanroom post-CMP Q-time threshold. Metrology recipe partitioning must be enforced: execute high-speed 49-point spectroscopic ellipsometry for global inter-layer dielectric (ILD) WIWNU profiling within 8 minutes, followed by an optimized 9-point radial AFM sample plan (center, mid-radius, edge, extreme edge) to maintain cycle time below 28 minutes per production lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tip blunting and convolution artifact during high-aspect AFM plug scans leading to under-reporting of W-recess depth and subsequent M1 stringer shorts.
1. Cauchy/Sellmeier optical model inversion breakdown caused by anomalous surface micro-roughness (>1.5 nm Ra) on over-polished TEOS/BPSG dielectric arrays, generating false WIWNU film thickness maps.
1. Severe radial asymmetric erosion due to polishing pad glazing and multi-zone retaining ring pressure drift, driving focal plane excursions outside the 500 nm lithographic DOF margin.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-3-3-01` | **49-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Dielectric WIWNU Profiling** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (240-800 nm spectral range, micro-spot size <= 25x30 um) with 200mm high-precision vacuum chuck. | 1. Load wafer onto automated stage and perform optical pattern recognition alignment on primary wafer notch and global fiducials. 2. Execute automated 49-point polar coordinate map (polar angles 0°, 90°, 180°, 270° across radii r = 0, 30, 60, 85, 95 mm, with 3mm edge exclusion). 3. Acquire spectral Psi and Delta profiles from 240 nm to 800 nm at 70° angle of incidence at each site. 4. Regress data against a calibrated 3-layer optical model (ambient / residual TEOS oxide / Si substrate) utilizing the Cauchy dispersion parameterization. 5. Calculate global ILD thickness mean, standard deviation, and WIWNU percentage via [ (Thickness_max - Thickness_min) / (2 * Thickness_mean) ] * 100. | `Mean post-CMP remaining dielectric thickness within 480 nm to 520 nm; Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU) <= 4.5% (1-sigma <= 2.2 nm); Mean Square Error (MSE) of Cauchy fit <= 2.5 across all 49 measured sites.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-2-3-3-3-02` | **9-Point Radial AFM Dense Array Dishing and Erosion Metrology** | Automated Fab-Grade Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) operated in tapping/non-contact mode using DLC-coated tips (tip radius <= 8 nm, cantilever resonance ~300 kHz). | 1. Automatically transfer wafer to vibration-isolated AFM stage and calibrate scanner piezo linearity in X, Y, and Z. 2. Navigate sequentially to 9 designated radial DRAM test dies (Die (0,0), (±2,0), (0,±2), (±3,±3)). 3. Acquire 10 um x 10 um topography raster scans across the high-density tungsten contact array (50% pattern density, 220nm contact diameter) at 0.5 Hz line scan rate and 512 x 512 pixel resolution. 4. Extract cross-sectional height profiles orthogonal to array boundary to quantify array oxide erosion relative to adjacent field oxide. 5. Extract line profiles across isolated and dense W-plugs to evaluate central plug recess/dishing depth. | `W-plug dishing depth <= 20.0 nm (isolated) and <= 15.0 nm (dense array); Array oxide erosion <= 30.0 nm relative to isolated field oxide across all 9 radial sites; Tip wear broadening check showing measured contact diameter <= 235 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN 374 certified), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles and full face shield, DuPont Tyvek antistatic cleanroom gown with bound seams, Class 100 cleanroom shoe covers and ESD ground straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with acidic/basic cleaning residues: immediately flush with copious volumes of deionized water for at least 15 minutes. For HF exposure: rinse skin for 2 minutes, then liberally massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the affected area until medical personnel arrive. For eye contact: irrigate eyes with isotonic cleanroom eyewash solution for a minimum of 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Evacuate personnel immediately upon airborne vapor detection.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology load-locks and wafer staging modules must maintain positive-pressure laminar HEPA filtration (Class 1 cleanliness, ISO Class 3 environment). Chemical buffing and spin cleaning wet modules must operate under negative exhaust ventilation with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) connected to the dedicated cleanroom acidic/alkaline scrubber exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous post-CMP rinse effluents containing residual silica/alumina nanoparticles and ammonium hydroxide are routed to the central industrial wastewater treatment plant (IWTP). Automated pH neutralization occurs via sequential sulfuric acid (H2SO4) and sodium hydroxide (NaOH) titration maintaining effluent pH between 6.5 and 8.5 prior to municipal discharge. Solid wastes (spent AFM cantilevers, PVA brushes) are segregated into hazardous solid-waste bins.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (used in post-CMP megasonic clean)** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI Grade C-1 (Trace metal < 1 ppb) | `28.0-30.0 wt%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (slurry oxidizer trace residue)** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade C-1 | `30.0-32.0 wt%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (metrology strip and clean calibration)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic/VLSI Grade | `0.5 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, clean post-CMP surface following double-sided PVA scrub and spin rinse drying; residual particle count < 25 adders at >= 0.18 um; moisture-free with zero water marks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, non-destructive post-metrology surface with validated topography; zero AFM tip engagement indentations; passive surface native oxide thickness <= 1.2 nm; hermetically sealed in FOUP purged with 99.999% dry Nitrogen.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time causes ambient airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (volatile organic compounds and airborne boron/phosphorus dopants) along with uncontrolled galvanic micro-corrosion of tungsten plugs, generating catastrophic plug pull-out, voiding, and poor barrier adhesion during M1 Ti/TiN liner PVD deposition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full radial reconstruction of tungsten dishing, dense array dielectric erosion, and global oxide WIWNU across the 200mm wafer. Delivers high-density 49-point ellipsometric thickness contour maps and multi-point 3D AFM array profiles, validating that wafer topography variation is fully compliant with the 180nm lithographic depth of focus budget (DOF >= 500 nm).

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `REPORT_WIWNU_49PT_ELLIPSOMETRY_CONTOUR.pdf`
- [ ] `METROLOGY_ARRAY_DISHING_EROSION_AFM_RAW_PROFILES.csv`
- [ ] `RADIAL_TOPOGRAPHY_TOPOLOGICAL_RECONSTRUCTION_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Global Inter-Layer Dielectric (ILD) post-CMP Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity across 49 measurement sites** | `3.5%` | <= 4.5% (max single-site deviation <= 15 nm from wafer mean) | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Cauchy model fitting (240-800 nm, 70° incidence) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum Tungsten Contact Plug Dishing in dense DRAM memory array** | `12.0 nm` | <= 18.0 nm | High-resolution tapping-mode AFM 10x10 um line-scan extraction across center, mid-radius, and edge dies |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum Dense Array Oxide Erosion relative to adjacent unpatterned field dielectric** | `20.0 nm` | <= 30.0 nm | AFM step-height profilometry step-down analysis across DRAM array-to-periphery boundary |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal acceptance requires simultaneous verification that all 49 ellipsometry sites yield MSE <= 2.5 with global ILD WIWNU <= 4.5%, dense array tungsten plug dishing <= 18.0 nm, and array oxide erosion <= 30.0 nm across all 9 radial AFM test dies, signed off by the Metrology Lead and CMP Process Integration Engineer prior to FOUP dispatch to Pre-Metal 1 Degas and PVD Liner Deposition.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Automated Darkfield Laser Scatterometry and CMP Particle Defect Review

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-CMP darkfield laser scatterometry must operate on high-throughput optical coordinates linked dynamically to downstream defect review SEM via automated coordinate transformation and wafer alignment mark offset compensation (within sub-50nm coordinate registration error). Ensure recipe sensitivity maps (pixel binning, PMT gain, thresholding) are decoupled between bright reflective tungsten plug arrays and darker inter-layer dielectric (ILD) TEOS oxide fields to prevent detector saturation and false positive flare around dense memory array boundaries.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm DRAM node, darkfield inspection using deep-ultraviolet (DUV, e.g., 266nm or 355nm) oblique/normal laser illumination must resolve sub-90nm localized light scatterers (LLS) corresponding to slurry micro-scratches, residual colloidal silica nanoparticles, and unpolished tungsten puddling. Differentiating destructive gouges/chatter marks from benign surface micro-roughness requires polarization filtering (p-polarization suppression vs. s-polarization scatter collection) and spatial Fourier filtering to block periodic DRAM bitline and wordline array background diffractions.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Inspection throughput must achieve >= 25 wafers per hour (WPH) on 200mm wafers to avoid gating the entire pilot line CMP bay. Calibration standards, specifically NIST-traceable polystyrene latex (PSL) sphere reference wafers (60nm, 90nm, 120nm calibration bins) and ultra-clean quartz calibration artifacts, have lead times exceeding 16 weeks and require strict local stock rotation to ensure continuous tool qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Darkfield scatterometry serves as the primary inline go/no-go gate prior to ILD cap deposition and contact hole lithography. A high false-alarm rate (> 5%) stalls the review workflow by overburdening the automated defect review SEM (ADR-SEM); hence, classification thresholds and KLARF v1.2 defect partition pareto charts must be strictly validated during pilot lot runs to meet our 48-hour turn-around cycle.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Slurry nanoparticle agglomeration on hydrophobic post-brush-cleaned ILD oxide surfaces causing catastrophic dielectric breakdown and gate shorts if carried into subsequent furnace anneal.
1. High-angle micro-scratches induced by broken slurry alumina/silica abrasive aggregates cutting across adjacent 180nm metal bitline contacts, causing open circuits.
1. False-negative non-detection of residual tungsten thin film (scumming/puddling) in dished wide-field isolation oxide due to specular background haze and optical flare.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-3-01` | **Automated Darkfield Laser Particle & LLS Sensitivity Calibration on 200mm Oxide Test Wafers** | Automated DUV (355nm solid-state laser) Darkfield Wafer Defect Inspection System with multi-channel collectors (narrow, wide, and backscatter detectors) and automated stage mapping. | 1. Load 200mm post-CMP test wafer onto vacuum chuck and initiate automated 3-point wafer notch/edge alignment. 2. Configure darkfield inspection recipe: 355nm laser power 50mW, normal incidence illumination, multi-channel PMT collection with spatial Fourier filter enabled for periodic array suppression. 3. Execute full-wafer spiral scan at 3mm edge exclusion. 4. Extract total defect count, defect density (defects/cm^2), and coordinate binning (bins: 90-120nm, 120-180nm, >180nm). 5. Generate defect map and export KLARF results file. | `Total defect density for LLS >= 90nm must be <= 0.08 defects/cm^2 across the entire wafer active area (<= 25 total adders for a 200mm wafer with 3mm edge exclusion). Zero clusters of >= 5 adjacent defects.` |
| `TC-CMP-PLANARIZATION-3-3-02` | **CMP Micro-scratch and Tungsten Residue Classification via Defect Review SEM (ADR-SEM)** | Automated Defect Review Scanning Electron Microscope (ADR-SEM) with secondary and backscattered electron detectors, coupled with Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS). | 1. Load wafer into ADR-SEM loadlock and run automated global coordinate alignment using lithographic alignment targets. 2. Sample 100 randomly selected darkfield defect coordinates from bins > 90nm. 3. Auto-navigate to each target coordinate, perform autofocus, and capture high-resolution SEM images at 50,000x magnification. 4. Execute EDS spot analysis on defects suspected of metallic composition. 5. Classify defects into CMP Micro-scratch, Slurry Particle, Organic Flake, and Residual Tungsten. | `Coordinate relocation success rate >= 98%. Slurry particle redeposition count < 5% of sampled defects; killer micro-scratches (depth > 15nm or length > 2um bridging active features) = 0 defects found.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), EN 207 / ANSI Z136.1 certified DUV laser safety eyewear (optical density OD > 6+ at 266-355nm), Cleanroom gowning with conductive ESD boot covers, Chemical splash goggles during calibration standard handling and chemical cleaning
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Immediately flush eyes with clean emergency eyewash water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Remove contaminated apparel and wash skin thoroughly with non-abrasive soap and water. Laser exposure: Immediately power off interlock, seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation for suspected retinal or corneal exposure. Inhalation of solvent fumes: Move victim to fresh cleanroom air supply immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Tool enclosure maintained under negative static pressure with dedicated cleanroom solvent exhaust ducting operating at >= 150 CFM. Class 1 laminar HEPA/ULPA downflow over wafer loading stage.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent megasonic and post-CMP rinse effluents routed directly to the Central Acid-Base Waste Neutralization (AWN) system (monitored continuous pH titration to 6.5-8.5 before municipal release). Solvent vapors routed to dedicated VOC scrubber exhaust.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 5 (Electronic / VLSI Grade) | `99.9%` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (for megasonic cleaning brush chemistry)** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI Grade 4 | `28-30%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (post-CMP clean oxidizer)** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 4 | `30%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, clean-rinsed and Marangoni-dried post-CMP oxide/tungsten surface with zero visible slurry stains or dried droplet water marks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Inspected, defect-mapped, and dry surface packaged in vacuum/purged FOUP/SMIF pod, verified free of laser-induced optical heating damage.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes ambient airborne molecular contamination (AMC) organic condensation, moisture adsorption on fresh ILD surfaces, and irreversible slurry residue baking, permanently pinning colloidal particles to dielectric oxides.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full wafer automated darkfield laser scatterometry defect inspection and ADR-SEM review of post-CMP 180nm DRAM wafers, providing calibrated defect classification, KLARF maps, and quantitative defect density metrics validating post-polish cleanliness.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CMP_POST_POLISH_DEFECT_MAP.klarf`
- [ ] `DARKFIELD_INSPECTION_SUMMARY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `ADR_SEM_DEFECT_REVIEW_PARETO.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Full wafer defect density for particles and LLS >= 90nm** | `0.08` | <= 0.08 defects/cm^2 | Automated 355nm DUV darkfield scatterometry full-wafer scan with 3mm edge exclusion |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Optical-to-SEM defect coordinate re-detection accuracy** | `98.0` | >= 98.0% | Automated SEM field-of-view re-detection across 100 randomly sampled coordinate locations |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Critical micro-scratch occurrences bridging active array areas** | `0` | 0 (zero defect tolerance) | Automated Defect Review SEM classification at 50,000x magnification |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Darkfield inspection completed on 100% of pilot lot wafers with defect density <= 0.08 defects/cm^2, KLARF map validated with zero bridging micro-scratches on ADR-SEM review, and automated signoff approved by the Metrology Lead and DRAM Integration Engineer.
