# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB-MET-FIB-003`
**Title:** Dual-Beam FIB Precision Cross-Sectional Lamella Preparation & Pt Capping of 3D Crown Structures  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Location:** Metrology & Failure Analysis Cleanroom (Dual-Beam FIB/SEM Suite)  
**Related Spec Track:** [`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`](./docs/context.yaml) & [`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`](./docs/context2.yaml)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Visual Lifecycle

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       ROI Align       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     e-Beam Pt Cap     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Ga+ FIB Pt Strap    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Bulk Milling and    │
│       Undercut        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  In-Situ Lift-Out to  │
│         Grid          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Low-kV Thinning and  │
│        Polish         │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Region of Interest (ROI) Alignment & Surface Inspection
1. Load the 180nm DRAM coupon containing the stacked crown capacitor array into the Dual-Beam vacuum chamber; pump down to base pressure $\le 5.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ mbar}$.
2. Align stage to eucentric height ($Z \approx 5.0\text{ mm}$ working distance). Orient the array so that the bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$) or wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$) is aligned perpendicularly to the FIB cross-section slicing axis.
3. Perform low-dose SEM navigation at $2.0\text{ kV}$, $50\text{ pA}$ to identify the target 3D crown cell array above the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact.

#### Step 2: In-Situ Electron-Beam Protective Platinum Deposition
1. Insert the Pt gas injection system (GIS) needle to $100\,\mu\text{m}$ offset above the target ROI.
2. Deposit an initial sacrificial electron-beam induced Pt layer ($e$-Pt) directly onto the delicate high-$k$ crown tops:
   - **Beam Energy & Current:** $2.0\text{ kV}$, $1.6\text{ nA}$
   - **Dimensions:** $15.0\,\mu\text{m}\text{ (length)} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}\text{ (width)} \times 0.5\,\mu\text{m}\text{ (thickness)}$
   - *Rationale:* Protects the ultra-thin ($3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$ EOT) $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric crown rims from ion-beam implantation, curtaining, and sputtering distortion.

#### Step 3: Focused Ion Beam ($\text{Ga}^+$) Structural Platinum Strap Deposition
1. Retain Pt GIS needle insertion and tilt stage to FIB coincidence ($52.0^\circ$).
2. Deposit high-density ion-beam induced Pt ($i$-Pt) over the $e$-Pt cap:
   - **Ion Beam Energy & Current:** $30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{ pA} - 100\text{ pA}$
   - **Dimensions:** $15.0\,\mu\text{m}\text{ (length)} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}\text{ (width)} \times 2.0\,\mu\text{m}\text{ (thickness)}$

#### Step 4: Bulk Trench Milling & Lamella Undercut
1. Set $\text{Ga}^+$ ion beam to $30\text{ kV}$, $5.0\text{ nA} - 7.0\text{ nA}$ for coarse cross-section bulk trenching:
   - Mill front and rear relief trenches ($18\,\mu\text{m} \times 10\,\mu\text{m}$, depth $\approx 8\,\mu\text{m}$) leaving a central membrane of $\sim 1.5\,\mu\text{m}$ thickness.
2. Step current down to $30\text{ kV}$, $0.7\text{ nA} - 1.0\text{ nA}$ to mill side release cuts and perform bottom undercut milling at stage tilt $0^\circ - 7^\circ$, leaving a single structural micro-tab on one side.

#### Step 5: In-Situ Micro-Manipulator Lift-Out & Grid Mounting
1. Insert micro-manipulator probe (OmniProbe) and position probe tip at the free end of the lamella.
2. Secure probe tip using localized ion-beam Pt deposition ($30\text{ kV}$, $50\text{ pA}$).
3. Sever the remaining anchor tab at $30\text{ kV}$, $300\text{ pA}$, retract manipulator with free lamella, and translate to a Cu/Mo TEM half-grid.
4. Mount and weld the lamella onto a grid post using $i$-Pt ($30\text{ kV}$, $100\text{ pA}$), and mill the tungsten probe attachment free.

#### Step 6: Stepwise Lamella Thinning & Low-Damage Polish
1. **Intermediate Thinning:** Mill both faces of the lamella at $30\text{ kV}$, $300\text{ pA}$ down to $\sim 400\text{ nm}$ thickness at stage tilt $\pm 54.0^\circ$ ($\pm 2.0^\circ$ relative to glancing beam).
2. **Fine Thinning:** Reduce beam to $16\text{ kV}$, $50\text{ pA}$ at stage tilt $\pm 53.5^\circ$ down to $\sim 150\text{ nm}$ membrane thickness.
3. **Amorphous Layer Low-kV Polish:**
   - Polish at $5\text{ kV}$, $20\text{ pA}$ ($\pm 55.0^\circ$ tilt) down to final electron transparency ($< 60\text{ nm}$).
   - Final surface clean at $2\text{ kV}$, $10\text{ pA}$ ($\pm 57.0^\circ$ tilt) for $60\text{ s}$ per side to eliminate the $\text{Ga}^+$ amorphous damaged shell on the 3D crown sidewalls.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
 180nm Cell Context Verification Metrics
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │███████████████████████████████│
 Refresh Temp Threshold┤███████████████████████████████│
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
      Capacitance Floor┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
 Gate SiO2 Physical Thk┤▒▒                             │
                       │▒▒                             │
EOT (Ta2O5/Al2O3 Stack)┤░░                             │
                       │░░                             │
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                       0.0    21.2   42.5    63.8  85.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Measurement Instrument / Method | Target Value | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Protective Capping Thickness ($e$-Pt + $i$-Pt)** | In-Chamber HR-SEM ($2\text{ kV}$) | $\ge 2.50$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | $[2.20, 2.80]\,\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Final Lamella Inspection Thickness** | In-Chamber High-Voltage STEM / SEM | $\le 60.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | $[40.0, 60.0]\,\text{nm}$ |
| **Preserved Crown Structural Pitch** | HR-SEM / TEM Digital Metrology Caliper | $360.0 - 400.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 10.0\text{ nm}$ |
| **Amorphous Damage Boundary Layer** | High-Resolution TEM Lattice Fringe Imaging | $\le 2.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Max $< 2.5\text{ nm}$ per side |

---

### 4. Context References & Literature Citations

* **Source 1: `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**
  * *Unit Cell Geometry & Architecture:* 180nm node access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, folded bitline layout ($8F^2$ and $6F^2$).
  * *Capacitor Structure:* Stacked crown-shaped polysilicon / metal-insulator-metal (MIM) topology erected above the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  * *Dielectric & Electrical Target:* Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance budget, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$), leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Source 2: `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**
  * *Capacitor Dimensions & Pitches:* Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
  * *Dielectric Metrics:* Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$ with $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ layers; storage capacitance budget between $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to ensure retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$. Gate oxide physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-beam FIB lamella preparation on high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitors poses severe structural collapse risks under Ga+ ion beam momentum transfer. Initial protective encapsulation requires an electron-beam-induced Pt deposition (EBID) layer of at least 300 nm before switching to ion-beam-induced deposition (IBID) Pt; failure to decouple this will cause Ga+ implantation, curtaining artifacts, and sputter-amorphization of the thin Al2O3/Ta2O5 dielectric stack on crown vertical sidewalls.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor geometries, void filling inside the crown lumen during GIS Pt delivery is strictly diffusion-limited. If GIS nozzle pitch and precursor flux are not precisely tuned, hollow cavities beneath the IBID Pt cap lead to differential milling rates, generating curtaining across the high-k stack and obstructing HR-TEM lattice fringe and step-coverage measurement at the crown bottom.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursor GIS crucibles containing (trimethyl)methylcyclopentadienylplatinum(IV) (CAS 94442-19-0) and Liquid Metal Ion Source (LMIS) Gallium emitters exhibit lead times exceeding 8 to 12 weeks. Contracting third-party metrology services (Buy action) requires pre-qualified wafer coupon transfer containers and batching to minimize vendor tool setup fees and avoid standby delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: FIB lamella thinning and lift-out throughput is bounded to 2-3 lamellae per 8-hour shift per dual-beam tool. Outbound vendor turn-around time (TAT) must not exceed 72 hours to prevent dielectric aging/oxidation and to preserve critical project tapeout review milestones for the 180nm open-source DRAM foundation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Curtaining and selective over-milling across the crown oxide/dielectric interfaces due to incomplete void-fill during Pt capping
1. Ga+ ion implantation and surface amorphization of the Al2O3/Ta2O5 bilayer during high-voltage (>16 kV) final lamella polishing
1. Mechanical fracture or micro-cleaving of the suspended crown capacitor lamella during Omniprobe micromanipulator lift-out and Cu grid welding

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-1-3-2-1-01` | **Protective Dual-Stage Pt Cap Conformal Deposition & Void-Free Trench Infill Test** | Dual-Beam FIB/SEM (FEI Helios G4 / Thermo Scientific Scios II) with E-beam/I-beam GIS Pt injection system | 1. Position crown region of interest (ROI) under electron beam at 52-degree stage tilt. 2. Insert Pt GIS nozzle to 100 um working distance. 3. Deposit 400 nm e-beam Pt at 2 kV, 0.4 nA over a 15 um x 2 um box. 4. Verify infill of crown lumen without ion damage. 5. Deposit 2.0 um i-beam Pt cap at 30 kV, 0.1 nA. 6. Cross-section check via 5 kV secondary electron imaging. | `Total protective Pt cap thickness >= 2.2 um with zero voids > 10 nm inside the crown cavity; zero Ga+ induced sputtering of the top Al2O3/Ta2O5 dielectric interface prior to rough milling.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-1-3-2-1-02` | **Ultra-Low Voltage Final Lamella Thinning and Amorphous Damage Layer Qualification** | FIB/SEM dual-beam system equipped with 2 kV / 5 kV low-kV Ga+ or Ar+ polishing gun and Omniprobe micromanipulator, calibrated with 200 kV TEM inspection | 1. Tilt stage to ±1.5 degrees off FIB optical axis. 2. Perform step-down polish at 5 kV, 40 pA until membrane is semi-transparent to 5 kV SEM electrons. 3. Perform final cleaning polish at 2 kV, 15 pA for 120 seconds per side. 4. Measure final membrane thickness and verify absence of redeposited Ga. | `Final lamella membrane thickness across the 3D crown array is 30 nm to 50 nm; amorphous surface damage layer <= 1.5 nm per side as verified under HR-TEM; complete cross-sectional visibility of both inner and outer crown sidewalls.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser/impact eye protection glasses, Anti-static cleanroom ESD lab coat, Vapor respirator for organometallic precursor crucible replacement operations
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with organometallic Pt precursor, wash immediately with soap and copious running water for 15 minutes. In case of inhalation, relocate victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. Seek immediate medical attention. For physical wounds from fractured silicon coupons, flush wound with sterile saline and remove fragments.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB tool roughing vacuum pumps must be vented directly into dedicated toxic scrubbed exhaust (acid/organometallic scrubber duct) with continuous airflow interlocks (> 50 CFM) and vacuum gauge fail-safe shutoff valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent GIS precursor reservoirs, Ga LMIS disposal assemblies, and contaminated wipe materials must be packaged into hermetically sealed poly containers labeled as Hazardous Heavy Metal / Platinum Organometallic Waste and consigned to an accredited hazardous chemical recovery facility.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **(Trimethyl)methylcyclopentadienylplatinum(IV)** | `94442-19-0` | Semiconductor Grade (>= 99.9%) | `>= 99.5%` |
| **Gallium (LMIS source)** | `7440-55-3` | Ultra-High Purity 6N (99.9999%) | `100%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited Al2O3/Ta2O5 crown capacitor array post-ALD, stored in vacuum/dry N2 purge box, free of organic contamination or moisture adsorption.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Ultrathin (30-50 nm) lamella tack-welded to Cu TEM grid with protective Pt cap intact, stored under vacuum (< 1e-4 mbar) in dedicated TEM grid transfer carrier.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exposure to ambient moisture and air > 45 minutes induces moisture condensation in high-aspect-ratio crown crevices, causing outgassing in the FIB chamber, dielectric hydration/delamination, and severe oxidation of top conductive layers.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable completion of high-integrity, cross-sectional TEM lamellae extracted from 3D high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor modules, featuring void-free dual Pt encapsulation, minimal Ga+ amorphization, and clean preservation of Al2O3/Ta2O5 high-k dielectric interfaces suitable for atomic-resolution HR-TEM analysis.

| `ASSERT-01` | **Lamella membrane thickness across the crown capacitor active region** | `40 nm` | ± 10 nm | Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy (EELS) t/lambda measurement and high-tilt SEM secondary electron edge profiling |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Amorphous Ga+ beam damage layer thickness on high-k dielectric sidewalls** | `1.0 nm` | <= 1.5 nm | High-Resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy (HR-TEM) phase contrast lattice fringe analysis at 200 kV |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Protective Pt capping layer thickness over crown top crests** | `2.2 um` | ± 0.2 um | Calibrated dual-beam SEM cross-sectional measurement at 52-degree stage tilt |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

critics.systems_engineer: Dual-beam FIB lamella preparation on high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitors poses severe structural collapse risks under Ga+ ion beam momentum transfer. Initial protective encapsulation requires an electron-beam-induced Pt deposition (EBID) layer of at least 300 nm before switching to ion-beam-induced deposition (IBID) Pt; failure to decouple this will cause Ga+ implantation, curtaining artifacts, and sputter-amorphization of the thin Al2O3/Ta2O5 dielectric stack on crown vertical sidewalls.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm node high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor geometries, void filling inside the crown lumen during GIS Pt delivery is strictly diffusion-limited. If GIS nozzle pitch and precursor flux are not precisely tuned, hollow cavities beneath the IBID Pt cap lead to differential milling rates, generating curtaining across the high-k stack and obstructing HR-TEM lattice fringe and step-coverage measurement at the crown bottom.

Contracting third-party metrology services (Buy action) requires pre-qualified wafer coupon transfer containers and batching to minimize vendor tool setup fees and avoid standby delays.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## HR-SEM & Cross-Sectional Bright-Field TEM Imaging of High-k Crown Sidewall Step Coverage

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-DRAM180-009`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Node)  
**Classification:** Metrology / Analytical Transmission & Scanning Electron Microscopy  
**Reference Knowledge Capture:** [`docs/knowledge/hr_sem_tem_crown_step_coverage.md`](./docs/knowledge/hr_sem_tem_crown_step_coverage.md)

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Crown Capacitor     │
│       Wafer Prep       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Protective Pt C     │
│        Capping         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Ga FIB Milling     │
│     Lamella <50nm      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Low-kV In-Lens     │
│   HR-SEM Topography    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  BF-TEM 200kV Lattice  │
│       & Profile        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step Coverage & EOT   │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### 1. Site Localization & Protective Capping (DualBeam FIB/SEM)
1. Load coupon/cleaved wafer piece into the DualBeam chamber; pump to high vacuum ($< 1.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$).
2. Align along the DRAM memory array pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline direction) over the crown stacked capacitor field.
3. Deposit electron-beam assisted carbon/platinum protection pad ($1.5\text{ kV}$, $1.6\text{ nA}$, $200\text{ nm}$ thickness) directly over the crown tops to prevent beam-induced erosion of the $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3/\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-$k$ thin film.
4. Deposit ion-beam assisted Pt capping layer ($30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{ pA}$, $1.5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ thickness).

#### 2. Cross-Sectional Lamella Preparation & Lift-Out
1. Perform trench rough-milling using a focused $\text{Ga}^+$ ion beam ($30\text{ kV}$, $5.0\text{ nA}$ stepping down to $0.7\text{ nA}$) on both sides of the target crown capacitor row.
2. In-situ weld the micro-manipulator needle to the lamella top edge using Pt precursor deposition; undercut base and transfer onto a standard copper (Cu) or molybdenum (Mo) TEM half-grid.
3. Thin the lamella progressively:
   - Intermediate thinning at $16\text{ kV}$, $100\text{ pA}$.
   - Fine polishing at $5\text{ kV}$, $40\text{ pA}$.
   - Low-energy cleaning at $2\text{ kV}$, $10\text{ pA}$ to strip amorphous $\text{Ga}$-implanted damage layers until the physical lamella thickness is $< 50\text{ nm}$.

#### 3. High-Resolution In-Lens SEM (HR-SEM) Surface Screening
1. Switch to electron column in-lens Secondary Electron (In-Lens SE) mode.
2. Set beam acceleration voltage to $1.0\text{ kV} - 1.5\text{ kV}$ with a low probe current of $25\text{ pA} - 50\text{ pA}$ at a working distance ($WD$) of $2.0\text{ mm} - 3.0\text{ mm}$ to suppress charging on insulating oxides.
3. Screen overall crown structural integrity, checking for collapse, delamination at the W-plug contact, or non-uniform void formation across adjacent cell pitches ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).

#### 4. Bright-Field TEM (BF-TEM) High-k Sidewall Metrology
1. Transfer the grid to a Field-Emission Transmission Electron Microscope (FE-TEM).
2. Set accelerating voltage to $200\text{ kV}$ and orient the specimen to the on-axis zone axis along the capacitor array cleavage plane.
3. Acquire calibrated Bright-Field TEM (BF-TEM) images at magnifications between $200{,}000\times$ and $800{,}000\times$.
4. Position multi-point line scans across the dielectric stack profile at 4 critical points:
   - **Point A (Top Wall):** $50\text{ nm}$ below upper crown rim.
   - **Point B (Mid Wall):** Midpoint along the crown vertical height.
   - **Point C (Bottom Wall):** $50\text{ nm}$ above bottom corner.
   - **Point D (Crown Base):** Horizontal floor adjacent to the bottom electrode/plug contact.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter | Measurement Location / Method | Target Value | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | BF-TEM line scan calibrated against $k > 15$ dielectric stack | $3.0 - 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Crown Sidewall Step Coverage** | $(T_{\text{bottom}} / T_{\text{top}}) \times 100\%$ via calibrated BF-TEM profile | $\ge 90.0$ | $\%$ |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | C-V extraction on integrated 1T1C array | $25.0 - 30.0$ (min: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Cell Junction & Dielectric Leakage** | I-V probe measurement at $V_{\text{plate}} = V_{DD}/2$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Array Layout Critical Pitch** | In-lens HR-SEM bitline/wordline cross-section pitch | $360.0 - 400.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### Verified Literature Citations

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - High-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_3 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) providing effective $\kappa > 15$.
   - Capacitance budget target $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) erected above drain via tungsten plug (W-plug).
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - 1T1C architecture with $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell layout.
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ guaranteeing data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - High-$k$ equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) window: $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
   - Array bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) parameterizes planar witness monitor wafers with sub-Angstrom precision, but cannot resolve 3D geometric shading and precursor Knudsen diffusion starvation along the deep sidewalls of high-aspect-ratio (AR >= 10:1) crown capacitor cylinders. Cross-sectional HR-SEM and high-resolution bright-field TEM imaging are essential destructive ground-truth metrology gates to correlate optical Cauchy/Sellmeier models with actual physical step coverage across top, middle, and bottom crown coordinates.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate cross-sectional TEM of the Al2O3/Ta2O5 bilayer nanolaminate requires protective capping (in-situ e-beam Pt/C followed by ion-beam Pt) prior to Ga+ FIB milling to prevent curtaining artifacts, amorphization, and ion-beam sputtering of the ultra-thin high-k stack. Bright-field TEM at >= 200 kV must deliver lattice fringe phase contrast to resolve the crystalline/amorphous interface between bottom TiN/poly-Si electrode, Al2O3 interface seed (1.5-2.0 nm), and Ta2O5 bulk high-k dielectric (10-15 nm).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Because high-resolution analytical TEM and dual-beam FIB cross-sectioning represent external contracted metrology services ('Buy' action type) with high turnaround latency (72-120 hours) and steep per-sample hourly beam-time costs, coupon dicing plans must batch high-k ALD DOE splits (precursor pulse/purge ratios) into a single FIB coupon mount to minimize multi-run billing surcharges.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Destructive physical analysis (DPA) reduces pilot wafer inventory and imposes tight queue-time constraints between ALD chamber unloading and FIB vacuum loadlock pumping. Air exposure exceeding 45 minutes induces moisture adsorption, hydrocarbon condensation, and uncontrolled native oxidation of the bottom electrode, distorting quantitative TEM thickness measurements.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. FIB-induced thermal and ion-milling damage (Ga+ ion implantation or Pt precursor knock-on) causing artificial interfacial intermixing between Al2O3 seed and Ta2O5 layers.
1. Precursor depletion-induced sidewall pinch-off or severe bottom-wall thinning yielding step coverage < 90% at the bottom 10% depth of the 3D crown trench.
1. TEM lamella delamination or curtaining caused by mechanical stress mismatch between high-k oxide, TiN electrode, and thick sacrificial TEOS/BPSG hardmask.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-1-3-2-2-01` | **Cross-Sectional Dual-Beam FIB Sample Prep and HR-SEM Trench Profile Inspection** | Dual-Beam Ga+ FIB/FEG-SEM System (e.g., FEI Helios Nanolab 600 or equivalent) with in-situ Pt GIS and In-Lens SE/BSE detectors | 1. Load coupon into FIB chamber and pump down to <= 5e-6 mbar. 2. Deposit 200 nm electron-beam induced Pt protection layer at 2 kV, 1.6 nA followed by 1.5 um ion-beam induced Pt strap at 30 kV, 80 pA across crown trench ROI. 3. Perform rough cross-sectional trench milling using 30 kV, 9.3 nA Ga+ ion beam. 4. Progressively polish cross-section at 30 kV (0.28 nA) down to low-kV cleaning at 2 kV (40 pA) to eliminate amorphous damaged layer. 5. Tilt stage to 52 degrees and acquire in-lens HR-SEM images at 1.0 kV, 25 pA, WD 3.0 mm at 150,000x magnification across top, middle, and bottom trench zones. | `Physical step coverage (thickness_bottom / thickness_top) >= 92.0% measured across 5 adjacent crown cylinders; absence of gross voids, pinch-off, or micro-cracking along trench sidewalls.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-1-3-2-2-02` | **High-Resolution Bright-Field TEM Sidewall Thickness & Bilayer Interface Metrology** | 200 kV Field-Emission Transmission Electron Microscope (FE-TEM, e.g., JEOL JEM-2100F / Thermo Fisher Talos F200X) with calibrated high-resolution CCD/CMOS camera | 1. Insert TEM grid holder and achieve column vacuum <= 1e-7 Pa. 2. Align beam to zone axis along the TiN/Si crystal lattice interface. 3. Acquire zero-loss bright-field TEM micrographs at 500,000x and 1,000,000x direct magnification at three distinct depth locations: top lip (0-100 nm), mid-depth (800-900 nm), and bottom corner/floor (1700-1800 nm). 4. Extract calibrated line intensity profiles across the substrate/Al2O3 and Al2O3/Ta2O5 interfaces using digital micrograph analysis. 5. Measure absolute physical thicknesses of Al2O3 and Ta2O5 at 10 equidistant points along each sidewall zone. | `Al2O3 interface layer physical thickness = 1.80 nm ± 0.20 nm; Ta2O5 bulk high-k physical thickness = 12.0 nm ± 0.60 nm; bottom-to-top thickness conformity ratio >= 95.0%; Al2O3/Ta2O5 transition width <= 0.40 nm (sharp interface).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, Class 100 compatible), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact chemical splash goggles, ESD-safe dissipative lab coat, Full face shield and neoprene apron when handling liquid nitrogen cryo-traps or coupon cleaving solvents
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with gently flowing isotonic saline or clean water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin Exposure (cryogenic LN2): Immediately rewarm frostbitten tissue in lukewarm water bath (38-42 C); do not rub affected tissue. Organic Solvent Inhalation: Remove victim to fresh air; administer supplemental medical oxygen if breathing is labored; seek emergency medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB and TEM turbomolecular roughing foreline pumps must be piped to dedicated toxic vacuum exhaust ducted to fab central acid/scrubber systems. Sample prep wet chemical clearing must occur in an ASHRAE-110 certified chemical fume hood with minimum 100 FPM face velocity.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent FIB Ga LMIS sources and Pt metal-organic precursor ampoules must be sealed in airtight hazardous solid chemical containers for licensed pyrophoric/heavy metal reclamation. Contaminated solvent wipes and cleaved silicon fragments must be disposed of in labeled solid hazardous waste bins.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gallium (Ga+ FIB Ion Source)** | `7440-55-3` | 99.9999% (6N) | `100%` |
| **Trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV) (Pt GIS Precursor)** | `94442-22-5` | 99.9% | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - Coupon Cleaning & Substrate Prep)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI / MOS | `99.9%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (Cryogenic Anti-Contamination Trap)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: As-deposited ALD Al2O3/Ta2O5 dielectric stack on patterned bottom TiN/poly-Si crown cylinders, pristine vacuum-unsealed, free of organic haze or moisture condensation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Cross-sectioned, Pt-capped, low-kV Ga+ cleaned TEM lamella (< 40 nm thickness) mounted on grid, stored under ultra-high vacuum (< 1e-6 Torr) or continuous dry nitrogen purge cabinet.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes moisture absorption and surface hydrolysis of Ta2O5, promoting uncontrolled interfacial sub-oxide (SiOx/TiOxN) growth and surface carbon contamination that distorts TEM boundary measurement by > 0.5 nm.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: Optical spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) parameterizes planar witness monitor wafers with sub-Angstrom precision, but cannot resolve 3D geometric shading and precursor Knudsen diffusion starvation along the deep sidewalls of high-aspect-ratio (AR >= 10:1) crown capacitor cylinders. Cross-sectional HR-SEM and high-resolution bright-field TEM imaging are essential destructive ground-truth metrology gates to correlate optical Cauchy/Sellmeier models with actual physical step coverage across top, middle, and bottom crown coordinates.
critics.domain_expert: Accurate cross-sectional TEM of the Al2O3/Ta2O5 bilayer nanolaminate requires protective capping (in-situ e-beam Pt/C followed by ion-beam Pt) prior to Ga+ FIB milling to prevent curtaining artifacts, amorphization, and ion-beam sputtering of the ultra-thin high-k stack. Bright-field TEM at >= 200 kV must deliver lattice fringe phase contrast to resolve the crystalline/amorphous interface between bottom TiN/poly-Si electrode, Al2O3 interface seed (1.5-2.0 nm), and Ta2O5 bulk high-k dielectric (10-15 nm).
critics.supply_chain: Because high-resolution analytical TEM and dual-beam FIB cross-sectioning represent external contracted metrology services ('Buy' action type) with high turnaround latency (72-120 hours) and steep per-sample hourly beam-time costs, coupon dicing plans must batch high-k ALD DOE splits (precursor pulse/purge ratios) into a single FIB coupon mount to minimize multi-run billing surcharges.
critics.laya_pm: Destructive physical analysis (DPA) reduces pilot wafer inventory and imposes tight queue-time constraints between ALD chamber unloading and FIB vacuum loadlock pumping. Air exposure exceeding 45 minutes induces moisture adsorption, hydrocarbon condensation, and uncontrolled native oxidation of the bottom electrode, distorting quantitative TEM thickness measurements.
critical_failure_modes: FIB-induced thermal and ion-milling damage (Ga+ ion implantation or Pt precursor knock-on) causing artificial interfacial intermixing between Al2O3 seed and Ta2O5 layers.
Precursor depletion-induced sidewall pinch-off or severe bottom-wall thinning yielding step coverage < 90% at the bottom 10% depth of the 3D crown trench.
TEM lamella delamination or curtaining caused by mechanical stress mismatch between high-k oxide, TiN electrode, and thick sacrificial TEOS/BPSG hardmask.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## STEM-EDS/EELS Nanoscale Conformal Profile Mapping & Top-to-Bottom Thickness Ratio Extraction

- **Domain Council Node**: `Architecture & Integration` > `Foundry Tapeout & PDK` > `Nanofabrication` > `Thin Film Deposition` > `Metrology`
- **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make
- **Document Path**: [`sop_stem_eds_eels_conformal_mapping.md`](./docs/knowledge/sop_stem_eds_eels_conformal_mapping.md)

---

### Metrology Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   FIB Lamella Prep &   │
│     Pt Deposition      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    STEM Alignment &    │
│   HAADF-STEM Imaging   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   STEM-EDS Spectrum    │
│  Imaging & Line Scans  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Low-loss/Core-loss   │
│  EELS Fine Profiling   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step Coverage &     │
│    Thickness Ratio     │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Dual-Beam FIB Lamella Preparation**:
   - Deposit in-situ electron-beam Pt ($1.0\text{ kV}$, $0.5\text{ nA}$, $\sim 200\text{ nm}$) over target 180nm crown capacitor cell (array pitch: $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$), followed by ion-beam Pt deposition ($30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{ pA} \to 0.23\text{ nA}$, $1.5 - 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Perform bulk trenching ($30\text{ kV}$, $7 - 15\text{ nA}$ $\text{Ga}^+$ beam) and Omniprobe lift-out to a Cu/Mo TEM half-grid.
   - Execute progressive thinning ($30\text{ kV}$, $0.43\text{ nA} \to 40\text{ pA}$), followed by low-kV damage clean ($5\text{ kV}$, $20\text{ pA}$; final flash polish at $2\text{ kV}$, $15\text{ pA}$, $\pm 7^\circ$) until specimen thickness $t \le 40 - 50\text{ nm}$ at the bottom cup and W-plug interface.
2. **STEM Alignment & HAADF-STEM Reference Imaging**:
   - Accelerating voltage: $200\text{ kV}$ (cold FEG); convergence semi-angle $\alpha = 15 - 21\text{ mrad}$; probe size $\le 0.15\text{ nm}$.
   - HAADF collection semi-angle $\beta = 50 - 200\text{ mrad}$ ($Z^2$ contrast).
   - Record calibrated micrographs at three specific locations: **Top** (crown lip), **Mid** (sidewall midpoint), and **Bottom** (cup corner above the W-plug).
3. **STEM-EDS Spectrum Imaging & Line Scans**:
   - Quad-SDD detector ($\ge 0.9\text{ sr}$ solid angle); probe current $150 - 300\text{ pA}$; dwell time $20 - 50\ \mu\text{s/pixel}$ with spatial drift correction every 15 frames.
   - Acquire transverse line scans across the dielectric stack extracting $\text{Ta-M}\alpha$ ($1.71\text{ keV}$), $\text{Al-K}\alpha$ ($1.48\text{ keV}$), $\text{O-K}\alpha$ ($0.525\text{ keV}$), $\text{Ti-K}\alpha$ ($4.51\text{ keV}$), and $\text{W-M}\alpha$ ($1.77\text{ keV}$).
   - Measure full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) physical layer thicknesses: $T_{\text{top}}$, $T_{\text{mid}}$, and $T_{\text{bottom}}$.
4. **Low-Loss & Core-Loss STEM-EELS Nanoscale Profiling**:
   - Calibrate dispersion to $0.1 - 0.25\text{ eV/channel}$ (ZLP energy resolution $\le 0.8\text{ eV}$).
   - Check local inelastic scattering relative thickness ($t/\lambda \le 0.8$).
   - Profile core-loss edges ($\text{Ta-N}_{4,5}$ at $33\text{ eV}$, $\text{Al-L}_{2,3}$ at $73\text{ eV}$, $\text{Si-L}_{2,3}$ at $99\text{ eV}$, and $\text{O-K}$ at $532\text{ eV}$) to resolve interfacial intermixing without beam damage artifacts.
5. **Top-to-Bottom Thickness Ratio Extraction**:
   - Compute Step Coverage:
     $$\text{Conformality Ratio} = \frac{T_{\text{bottom}}}{T_{\text{top}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Export profiles into foundry Statistical Process Control (SPC).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                                                        
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░                                     │
     I_leak (fA)┤░                                     │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
StepCoverage (%)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
 EOT_target (nm)┤▓▓                                    │
                │▓▓                                    │
      C_min (fF)┤████████████                          │
                │████████████                          │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     23.8      47.5     71.2    95.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Acceptable Limits | Units | Measurement Tool | Context Constraint |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Top-to-Bottom Thickness Ratio** | **$\ge 95.0$** | Min $90.0$ | **%** | STEM-EDS / EELS FWHM line scan | High-aspect-ratio crown sidewall step coverage |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | **$3.5$** | $3.0 - 4.0$ | **nm** | Extracted from physical thickness with $\kappa > 15$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture* ($3 - 4\text{ nm}$ EOT) |
| **Storage Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | **$\ge 28.0$** | Min $25.0$ | **fF/cell** | In-line $C-V$ on array correlated with STEM geometry | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$) |
| **Dielectric Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at 85°C)** | **$< 1.0$** | Max $1.0$ | **fA/cell** | In-line wafer probe $I-V$ qualification | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$) |

---

### 3. Citations of Verified Local Literature

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor channel geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with shared bitline contact in $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline cell architectures.
   - Stacked capacitor crown topology over bitline (COB) erected above drain via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - High-k dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) providing effective $\kappa > 15$.
   - Target electrical budget: minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance for alpha-particle noise immunity; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - 1T1C stacked capacitor architecture requiring minimum capacitance $25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C.
   - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) target of $3 - 4\text{ nm}$ utilizing $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-k dielectric.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch constrained between $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.

---
*Captured in knowledge base:* [`sop_stem_eds_eels_conformal_mapping.md`](./docs/knowledge/sop_stem_eds_eels_conformal_mapping.md)

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting conformal profile metrics along high-aspect-ratio (HAR ~10:1 to 15:1) crown cylinder sidewalls requires strict fiducial co-registration between HAADF-STEM imaging frames and spectral EELS/EDS line scans. Drift distortion exceeding 0.1 nm/min during long spectral dwell times will invalidate the extracted top-to-bottom step-coverage ratio.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm DRAM node with Al2O3/Ta2O5 laminate stacks (nominal thickness ~8-12 nm), quantifying the bottom-corner thinning via EELS (Al-L2,3 at 73 eV and Ta-M4,5 at 1780 eV) or EDS requires deconvolving beam-broadening artifacts and delocalization errors within a lamella that must be thinned uniformly to <= 30 nm without selective Ga+ ion-beam milling damage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dual-beam FIB-SEM for site-specific lamella lift-out and 200kV FEG-STEM with high solid-angle windowless EDS detectors (Super-X/ChemiSTEM) represent heavy capital bottlenecks with outsourced metrology turnaround times typically exceeding 72 hours per lot wafer, threatening cycle-time commitments.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology budget and queue constraints mandate that FIB lamella preparation and TEM beam time must deliver actionable step-coverage feedback within 24 hours of ALD batch completion to avoid holding subsequent TiN plate-electrode runs in the cleanroom.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Electron-beam induced reduction, sample mass loss, or localized carbon contamination during extended EELS/EDS acquisition at deep bottom trench corners, distorting calculated film thickness.
1. Preferential Ga+ implantation and curtaining artifacts during FIB cross-section preparation obscuring the true physical interface of the amorphous Al2O3/Ta2O5 dielectric stack.
1. Spatial drift (>0.5 nm) during long spectral integration distorting the stoichiometric Al:Ta ratio profiles along crown cylinder sidewalls.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

Align 200 kV FEG-STEM probe with 0.16 nm probe size and ~150 pA beam current. 2. Acquire calibrated HAADF-STEM overview of full crown cylinder (depth ~1.2 um to 1.8 um). 3. Position nanoscale EDS line scans / spectral map boxes across 3 critical locations: Top sidewall (upper 50 nm), Mid sidewall (depth 50%), and Bottom inner radius/corner (lower 50 nm). 4. Perform live drift-corrected EDS spectrum imaging tracking Ta-Lalpha (8.14 keV) and Al-Kalpha (1.486 keV) lines. 5. Extract calibrated FWHM physical thickness profiles across dielectric stack at each of the 3 zones. | `Top-to-bottom physical thickness ratio (T_bottom / T_top) must be >= 0.90 (>=90% conformality) with no localized dielectric thinning below 7.5 nm at bottom corners, and EDS quantification drift error <= 0.2 nm across 3 consecutive scans.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-1-3-2-3-02` | **Low-Loss / Core-Loss STEM-EELS Nanoscale Chemical Interface and Interdiffusion Profile Mapping** | 200 kV Analytical STEM with Gatan Continuum High-Resolution EELS spectrometer, energy resolution <= 0.8 eV FWHM at Zero Loss Peak (ZLP). | 1. Set spectrometer dispersion to 0.25 eV/channel covering Al-L2,3 (73 eV), Ta-N6,7 (25 eV), and O-K (532 eV). 2. Acquire dual-EELS profile perpendicular to the TiN/Al2O3/Ta2O5/TiN interface at bottom trench with 0.1 nm step pitch. 3. Apply background subtraction using power-law fitting before ionization edges. 4. Deconvolve plural scattering using Fourier-ratio deconvolution. 5. Plot 1D elemental concentration gradients across the multi-layer interfaces. | `Interfacial mixing layer between Al2O3 and Ta2O5 must be <= 0.8 nm; residual Ga contamination from FIB preparation within dielectric film must be <= 0.5 at.%; zero pinhole discontinuities detected over a 50 nm lateral sidewall run.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving required during chemical/plasma handling), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, ESD wrist strap / conductive footwear for electron microscope console operation, Cryogenic safety face shield and insulated cryogenic gloves during TEM liquid nitrogen dewar cold-trap filling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For cryogenic liquid nitrogen splash/frostbite: Immediately flush affected body parts with copious tepid water (40-42°C); never rub frozen tissue. Seek immediate medical attention. For oxygen deficiency alarm in TEM room: Immediately evacuate personnel to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: TEM and FIB preparation laboratories must maintain active continuous HVAC with minimum 10 air changes per hour (ACH). Plasma cleaner vacuum pump exhaust must be hard-ducted directly to the facility acid/general exhaust line. Room ambient O2 monitoring system with low-level alarm set to 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent chemical wipes and solvent swabs containing IPA must be disposed of in dedicated hazardous organic waste satellite accumulation containers with self-closing lids. Depleted FIB gallium sources and contaminated grid components must be collected as RCRA hazardous heavy metal waste.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly completed post-ALD Al2O3/Ta2O5 crown capacitor wafer prior to upper electrode deposition, stored under dry N2 purge or vacuum transfer box.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Completed dual-beam FIB lamella mounted on TEM grid, plasma cleaned, and loaded into ultra-high vacuum (<= 5e-7 Pa) STEM specimen chamber.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air Q-time causes atmospheric moisture adsorption and surface hydrocarbon contamination, resulting in rapid electron-beam carbon graphitization under STEM probe and oxidation artifacts that invalidate stoichiometric O:Al:Ta ratios.

| `ASSERT-02` | **Bottom corner high-k stack total physical thickness** | `9.5 nm` | ± 0.5 nm | FWHM intensity profiling of normalized STEM-EDS line scans across the dielectric bilayer |

critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm DRAM node with Al2O3/Ta2O5 laminate stacks (nominal thickness ~8-12 nm), quantifying the bottom-corner thinning via EELS (Al-L2,3 at 73 eV and Ta-M4,5 at 1780 eV) or EDS requires deconvolving beam-broadening artifacts and delocalization errors within a lamella that must be thinned uniformly to <= 30 nm without selective Ga+ ion-beam milling damage.
critics.supply_chain: Dual-beam FIB-SEM for site-specific lamella lift-out and 200kV FEG-STEM with high solid-angle windowless EDS detectors (Super-X/ChemiSTEM) represent heavy capital bottlenecks with outsourced metrology turnaround times typically exceeding 72 hours per lot wafer, threatening cycle-time commitments.
critics.laya_pm: Metrology budget and queue constraints mandate that FIB lamella preparation and TEM beam time must deliver actionable step-coverage feedback within 24 hours of ALD batch completion to avoid holding subsequent TiN plate-electrode runs in the cleanroom.
critical_failure_modes: Electron-beam induced reduction, sample mass loss, or localized carbon contamination during extended EELS/EDS acquisition at deep bottom trench corners, distorting calculated film thickness.
Preferential Ga+ implantation and curtaining artifacts during FIB cross-section preparation obscuring the true physical interface of the amorphous Al2O3/Ta2O5 dielectric stack.
Spatial drift (>0.5 nm) during long spectral integration distorting the stoichiometric Al:Ta ratio profiles along crown cylinder sidewalls.

testcases.title: STEM-HAADF and High-Solid-Angle EDS Crown Sidewall Conformal Step Coverage & Top-to-Bottom Ratio Extraction
testcases.instrumentation: FEI/Thermo Fisher Titan or Talos F200X G2 S/TEM operated at 200 kV, equipped with 4-quadrant Super-X windowless SDD EDS detectors and automated drift-corrected spectrum imaging (DCFI).
testcases.pre_conditions: FIB-prepared cross-sectional lamella from active crown array thinned to <=30 nm (measured by low-loss EELS t/lambda <= 0.35), loaded on a Mo/Be low-background grid, plasma-cleaned in 25% O2 / 75% Ar for 60 seconds to eliminate hydrocarbon contamination.
testcases.procedure: 1. Align 200 kV FEG-STEM probe with 0.16 nm probe size and ~150 pA beam current. 2. Acquire calibrated HAADF-STEM overview of full crown cylinder (depth ~1.2 um to 1.8 um). 3. Position nanoscale EDS line scans / spectral map boxes across 3 critical locations: Top sidewall (upper 50 nm), Mid sidewall (depth 50%), and Bottom inner radius/corner (lower 50 nm). 4. Perform live drift-corrected EDS spectrum imaging tracking Ta-Lalpha (8.14 keV) and Al-Kalpha (1.486 keV) lines. 5. Extract calibrated FWHM physical thickness profiles across dielectric stack at each of the 3 zones.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Top-to-bottom physical thickness ratio (T_bottom / T_top) must be >= 0.90 (>=90% conformality) with no localized dielectric thinning below 7.5 nm at bottom corners, and EDS quantification drift error <= 0.2 nm across 3 consecutive scans.

testcases.title: Low-Loss / Core-Loss STEM-EELS Nanoscale Chemical Interface and Interdiffusion Profile Mapping
testcases.instrumentation: 200 kV Analytical STEM with Gatan Continuum High-Resolution EELS spectrometer, energy resolution <= 0.8 eV FWHM at Zero Loss Peak (ZLP).
testcases.pre_conditions: FIB lamella thickness validated via EELS ZLP log-ratio method (t/lambda between 0.25 and 0.40); sample oriented exactly along [110] zone axis to avoid projection tilt distortion across vertical sidewalls.
testcases.procedure: 1. Set spectrometer dispersion to 0.25 eV/channel covering Al-L2,3 (73 eV), Ta-N6,7 (25 eV), and O-K (532 eV). 2. Acquire dual-EELS profile perpendicular to the TiN/Al2O3/Ta2O5/TiN interface at bottom trench with 0.1 nm step pitch. 3. Apply background subtraction using power-law fitting before ionization edges. 4. Deconvolve plural scattering using Fourier-ratio deconvolution. 5. Plot 1D elemental concentration gradients across the multi-layer interfaces.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Interfacial mixing layer between Al2O3 and Ta2O5 must be <= 0.8 nm; residual Ga contamination from FIB preparation within dielectric film must be <= 0.5 at.%; zero pinhole discontinuities detected over a 50 nm lateral sidewall run.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving required during chemical/plasma handling)
ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/impact-resistant safety glasses
ESD wrist strap / conductive footwear for electron microscope console operation
Cryogenic safety face shield and insulated cryogenic gloves during TEM liquid nitrogen dewar cold-trap filling
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For cryogenic liquid nitrogen splash/frostbite: Immediately flush affected body parts with copious tepid water (40-42°C); never rub frozen tissue. Seek immediate medical attention. For oxygen deficiency alarm in TEM room: Immediately evacuate personnel to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: TEM and FIB preparation laboratories must maintain active continuous HVAC with minimum 10 air changes per hour (ACH). Plasma cleaner vacuum pump exhaust must be hard-ducted directly to the facility acid/general exhaust line. Room ambient O2 monitoring system with low-level alarm set to 19.5% O2.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent chemical wipes and solvent swabs containing IPA must be disposed of in dedicated hazardous organic waste satellite accumulation containers with self-closing lids. Depleted FIB gallium sources and contaminated grid components must be collected as RCRA hazardous heavy metal waste.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly completed post-ALD Al2O3/Ta2O5 crown capacitor wafer prior to upper electrode deposition, stored under dry N2 purge or vacuum transfer box.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Completed dual-beam FIB lamella mounted on TEM grid, plasma cleaned, and loaded into ultra-high vacuum (<= 5e-7 Pa) STEM specimen chamber.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding ambient air Q-time causes atmospheric moisture adsorption and surface hydrocarbon contamination, resulting in rapid electron-beam carbon graphitization under STEM probe and oxidation artifacts that invalidate stoichiometric O:Al:Ta ratios.

expected_result.summary: Verifiable nanoscale profile and thickness quantification report demonstrating high conformality of the ALD Al2O3/Ta2O5 high-k dielectric stack along 3D crown capacitor sidewalls with top-to-bottom step coverage exceeding 90%.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Capacitor crown dielectric top-to-bottom physical thickness step coverage ratio (T_bottom / T_top)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Calibrated HAADF-STEM cross-sectional line profile calibrated against Si lattice fringe standard (0.3135 nm)

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Bottom corner high-k stack total physical thickness
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: FWHM intensity profiling of normalized STEM-EDS line scans across the dielectric bilayer

quantitative_assertions.assertion: ALD stack interdiffusion interfacial zone width between Al2O3 and Ta2O5 sublayers
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 10%-to-90% elemental transition width measured via 0.1 nm pitch EELS core-loss line profiling

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All quantitative assertions validated on at least 3 distinct crown capacitor cells per die across center and edge wafer locations, with T_bottom/T_top >= 90%, zero structural delamination or pinhole voids, and sign-off approved by Lead Metrology Engineer and Process Integration Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Cryogenic/Thermal Probe C-V Dispersion and I-V Dielectric Leakage Qualification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The integration of high-k Al2O3/Ta2O5 nanolaminates into 180nm crown capacitor topologies requires strict correlation between cryogenic flatband voltage shift and room-to-elevated temperature interface trap density (Dit). The system-level parasitic resistance and inductance from long cryogenic triaxial probe cabling introduce phase angle distortions in high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V measurements, necessitating rigorous open/short/load de-embedding at 77K and 358K (85°C) to prevent false-positive capacitance budget degradation under 28 fF/cell.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dispersion in C-V across 1 kHz to 1 MHz frequencies directly indicates borderline border traps and oxygen vacancy states in the ALD Ta2O5 sub-layers. At cryogenic temperatures (77K), carrier freeze-out suppresses bulk Poole-Frenkel emission, exposing pure Fowler-Nordheim tunneling and defect-assisted hopping. If frequency dispersion exceeds 3.5% across 10 kHz to 1 MHz or dielectric leakage exceeds 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V operating bias at 85°C, the DRAM cell retention time cannot guarantee the JEDEC-standard 64 ms refresh interval.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Liquid nitrogen (LN2) supply lines and vacuum-rated cryogenic probe station tips (BeCu or tungsten with sub-micron tip radius) exhibit high lead-time volatility and operational cost overheads. Furthermore, the specialized ultra-dry N2 purge gas (grade 6.0, 99.9999% purity) must remain uninterrupted to avoid condensation and frost formation on delicate 180nm test structures during cryo-to-ambient temperature ramp-up cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal cycling between 77K and 398K (125°C stress) demands significant thermal stabilization dwell times (minimum 25 minutes per temperature setpoint), creating severe throughput bottlenecks in the testbay schedule. Metrology lots must be batched with automated multiplexed probe matrices to maintain cycle-time targets without risking Q-time expiry prior to post-dielectric passivation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal expansion mismatch induced delamination or micro-cracking of the crown sidewall Al2O3/Ta2O5 nanolaminate stack during rapid 77K to 358K temperature swings.
1. Cryogenic surface moisture condensation during chamber warmup causing localized dielectric dissolution, leakage paths, and erratic C-V flatband hysteretic shifts.
1. Probe-tip scrubbing damage through top metal TiN crown electrodes resulting in artificial dielectric punch-through and erroneous I-V soft-breakdown reporting.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-1-3-3-01` | **Cryogenic to Elevated Temperature C-V Dispersion and Interface Trap Density Extraction** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter Module, Lake Shore CRX-VF Cryogenic Vacuum Probe Station, calibrated Triaxial Kelvin Probes | 1. Pump probe chamber down to 5e-6 Torr and flood thermal stage with LN2 to reach 77K ± 0.5K. 2. Land triaxial probes on top TiN crown plate and bottom W-plug test pad. 3. Execute bidirectional voltage sweep from -1.5V to +1.5V with AC oscillation amplitude of 25 mV across discrete frequencies: 1 kHz, 10 kHz, 100 kHz, and 1 MHz. 4. Ramp chuck temperature using resistive heater at 5 K/min to 300K (ambient) and repeat C-V sweeps. 5. Ramp chuck temperature to 358K (85°C), stabilize for 15 minutes, and repeat C-V sweeps. 6. Extract frequency dispersion delta-C/C_1MHz at zero-bias and calculate interface trap density (Dit) via high-low frequency conductance method. | `Capacitance at 1 MHz, 0V bias must be >= 28.0 fF per unit cell equivalent area across all temperatures; frequency dispersion (C_10kHz - C_1MHz)/C_1MHz must be <= 3.5%; Dit at mid-gap must remain <= 2.5e11 eV^-1 cm^-2 at 300K and 358K.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-1-3-3-02` | **Temperature-Dependent I-V Dielectric Leakage and Conduction Mechanism Qualification** | Keysight B1500A with B1517A High Resolution SMU (fA resolution), Lake Shore Cryogenic Probe Station, Faraday Shielded Dark Enclosure | 1. Lower guarded triaxial probe tip gently onto isolated 1000-cell crown capacitor array test key. 2. Apply stepped staircase DC voltage from 0.0V to 1.8V with 20 mV step increment and 1.0 second hold/delay time to eliminate capacitive charging currents. 3. Measure leakage current at each step, continuously logging I-V profile up to operating Vdd (1.0V) and dielectric soft-breakdown onset. 4. Cool down stage to 77K under continuous vacuum, stabilize, and repeat identical staircase DC voltage sweep to decouple Poole-Frenkel emission from tunneling. 5. Extract leakage current density at V_cell = 1.0V and plot ln(J/E) vs 1/T (Arrhenius plot) to confirm activation energy of trap levels. | `Dielectric leakage current at 1.0V bias and 358K (85°C) must be <= 1.0 fA/cell (<= 1.0 pA for 1000-cell array); soft breakdown voltage V_bd must exceed 2.2V; leakage at 77K must be <= 0.05 fA/cell.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cryogenic safety gloves with extended cuffs (EN 511 compliant), ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face safety shield and splash goggles, Thermal insulating apron, Anti-static ESD cleanroom lab coat, Cleanroom nitrile under-gloves
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For cryogenic liquid contact/frostbite: Immediately flush affected tissue with tepid water (38-42°C); never rub frozen tissue or apply direct dry heat; summon emergency medical assistance immediately. For nitrogen asphyxiation: Promptly remove victim to fresh air; administer oxygen or artificial respiration if breathing has stopped; notify on-site cleanroom emergency response team.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom HVAC with minimum 60 air changes per hour; ambient oxygen depletion sensor modules with audible/visual strobe alarms calibrated to trigger at < 19.5% O2; cryogenic chamber vent line plumbed directly into facility scrubbed inert exhaust duct.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent cryogenic nitrogen boil-off gas must be routed through vacuum pump exhaust directly to the cleanroom non-toxic facility roof stack; contaminated isopropanol cleaning wipes collected in sealed, fireproof hazardous organic waste bins for solvent reclamation.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Liquid Nitrogen** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Cryogenic Grade (99.999%) | `100%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas (Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 6.0 Semiconductor Pure | `99.9999%` |
| **Isopropanol (Probe Tip Cleaning Solvent)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited top TiN crown metal capping layer over ALD Al2O3/Ta2O5 dielectric stack, hydrophobic, clean, free of organic hydrocarbons and moisture condensation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pristine, room-temperature stabilized, vacuum-desorbed top electrode surface ready for immediate inter-layer dielectric (ILD-1) oxide deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture chemisorption and airborne organic amine adsorption onto exposed electrode/dielectric boundaries inducing parasitic surface leakage, abnormal C-V hysteresis loops (> 80 mV shift), and irreversible electrode oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full electrical and thermal qualification report establishing that the 180nm crown capacitor Al2O3/Ta2O5 ALD stack achieves >= 28 fF/cell storage capacitance with < 3.5% frequency dispersion, and maintains leakage current <= 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C (1.0V) across 77K-358K temperature domains.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `CRYO_THERMAL_CV_DISPERSION_MATRIX_LOT03.csv`
- [ ] `IV_DIELECTRIC_LEAKAGE_QUALIFICATION_REPORT_GEN3.pdf`
- [ ] `CROWN_CAPACITOR_KAPLAN_MEIER_BREAKDOWN_PLOT.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage capacitance per single 180nm DRAM crown unit cell at 1 MHz, 0V bias at 300K** | `29.5 fF` | +/- 1.5 fF (minimum 28.0 fF) | Multi-frequency C-V extraction on calibrated Keysight B1500A LCR module with triaxial open/short fixture compensation |
| `ASSERT-02` | **C-V frequency dispersion between 10 kHz and 1 MHz at zero-bias across 77K to 358K** | `2.1 %` | <= 3.5 % maximum | Automated normalized capacitance ratio calculation: (C_10kHz - C_1MHz) / C_1MHz * 100 |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dielectric leakage current per 180nm crown capacitor cell at 1.0V bias and 358K (85°C)** | `0.65 fA/cell` | <= 1.00 fA/cell maximum | Keysight B1517A High-Resolution SMU low-current staircase DC I-V sweep on 1000-cell parallel array structure |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions verified across minimum 5 sample sites per wafer over 3 qualifying lots; capacitance exceeds 28.0 fF/cell at 85°C; leakage current remains strictly <= 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V; zero freeze-out cracking detected upon chamber return to 300K; formal sign-off by Metrology Lead and Process Integration Manager.
