# Standard Operating Procedure: Dilute HF/Ozone Crown Cavity Pre-Clean and Interfacial Native Oxide Stripping

**Category**: Wet Chemistry | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 3D high-aspect-ratio (HAR ~15:1 to 20:1) crown cylinder architecture for 180nm open-source DRAM, surface tension forces during liquid chemical exchange and drying pose severe capillary collapse risks. The use of megasonic agitation in SC-1 and standard cascade dump rinse must be strictly tuned to avoid acoustic cavitation damage to fragile polysilicon or TiN crown cylinders, while Marangoni or IPA vapor drying is required post-dHF to avoid micro-stiction between adjacent crown walls.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Complete native oxide stripping inside deep crown cavities (>1.2 µm depth, ~200 nm diameter) is limited by Knudsen diffusion and depletion of HF ions at the cavity bottom. If HF concentration is too low (e.g., <0.5%) or immersion duration insufficient (<20 s), incomplete interfacial oxide removal occurs, generating a series dielectric parasitics (low-k SiO2) that degrades capacitance equivalent thickness (CET) by >1.5 nm; conversely, over-etching etches the underlying TiN/poly plug contact or ILD oxide spacer.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade hydrofluoric acid (SEMI Tier 3/4 or Grade 5) and semiconductor-grade ozone generators capable of 50-80 ppm dissolved ozone (DIO3) in UPW have strict lead times and require specialized PVDF/PTFE wetted parts. Contamination of dHF baths with trace Fe or Cu (>10 ppt) will plate onto the bare silicon/TiN interface via electrochemical reduction during oxide stripping, permanently pinning interfacial traps.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Wet bench scheduling must be rigidly coordinated with the downstream ALD TiN module. A strict Q-time window of <= 60 minutes in air is enforceable before uncontrolled native SiO2 regrows to >0.3 nm, which directly risks scrap of high-value patterned 180nm DRAM wafer lots prior to dielectric deposition.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Capillary force-induced mechanical collapse and pattern stiction of neighboring 3D crown capacitor walls during spin-rinse-drying.
1. Incomplete interfacial native oxide stripping at the crown cavity bottom due to diffusion-limited mass transfer, yielding high contact resistance and degraded effective dielectric constant.
1. Electrochemical displacement plating of metallic contaminants (Cu/Fe) onto bare silicon/TiN surfaces from recirculated dHF bath.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-1-01` | **Interfacial Native Oxide Removal and Contact Angle Dewetting Verification** | Automated Angle-Resolved X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (AR-XPS) and Automated Contact Angle Goniometer | 1. Immerse wafer in 0.5% (1:100) dHF:UPW bath at 22.0°C +/- 0.5°C for 30 seconds with continuous megasonic flow (0.8 MHz, 0.2 W/cm2). 2. Transfer immediately to quick-dump rinse (QDR) with 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW until bath resistivity > 16 MOhm-cm. 3. Perform IPA vapor dry. 4. Measure sessile drop water contact angle across 9 points on unpatterned monitoring pads. 5. Quantify Si 2p oxide-to-elemental peak ratio via AR-XPS at 45° take-off angle. | `Water contact angle >= 75.0 degrees (indicating hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated surface) across all 9 points, and residual Si-O peak on AR-XPS showing equivalent SiO2 thickness <= 0.15 nm.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-1-02` | **Post-Clean Crown Cylinder Structural Integrity and Particle Inspection** | In-line Top-Down and Cross-Sectional Field Emission SEM (FE-SEM) and Laser Scattering Defect Inspection Tool (KLA/SP2 equivalent) | 1. Load wafer into laser scattering surface inspection system to detect localized particle adders (>= 0.18 µm). 2. Transfer to FE-SEM and inspect high-density 180nm crown array at center, middle, and edge dice (50,000x magnification). 3. Measure cylinder wall tilt angle and inter-cylinder gap spacing across 30 cavities per die. | `Total particle defect adders (>= 180nm) <= 15 defects per 200mm wafer; zero observed crown cylinder micro-collapse, tilt, or bridging stiction (wall tilt deviation < 1.0 degree from 90° normal).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full-face splash shield with ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses underneath, Heavy-duty double-layered butyl/neoprene chemical-resistant gloves (minimum 15 mil thickness), Acid-resistant fluoropolymer/rubber apron with integrated sleeves, Steel-toe chemical-resistant neoprene safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Immediately flush skin exposure with continuous cold water for exactly 5 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. Massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected area until medical arrival. For eye exposure, irrigate immediately with 1% Calcium Gluconate solution or sterile saline for 15 minutes. Call emergency hazmat response; HF absorbs deep into tissues and causes lethal hypocalcemia and cardiac arrest.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet bench dedicated acid laminar exhaust maintained at face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with real-time continuous photoacoustic/electrochemical HF toxic gas sensor (< 0.1 ppm alarm setpoint) and ozone off-gas thermal destruction catalyst unit (< 0.05 ppm ambient exhaust).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluorinated acid drain routed to automated calcium fluoride (CaF2) precipitation neutralization unit. Dosed with calcium hydroxide/chloride slurry to bring effluent fluoride ion concentration < 10 ppm and pH neutralized between 6.5 and 8.5 prior to municipal industrial release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier 4 (Trace metal < 10 ppt) | `0.5% - 1.0% w/w in UPW` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Electronic Grade (in-situ dissolved in UPW) | `20 - 50 ppm (dissolved DIO3)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH)** | `1336-21-6` | SEMI Tier 3 | `29% w/w` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Tier 3 | `30% w/w` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, organic-contaminated post-RIE ash surface with 0.8 - 1.5 nm non-stoichiometric native SiO2 and residual fluorocarbon polymers.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated (Si-H) or clean oxide-free metallic interface with < 0.15 nm equivalent SiO2 and zero organic residue.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Regrowth of interfacial SiO2 exceeding 0.3 nm under cleanroom ambient exposure, resulting in parasitic low-k series capacitance, high leakage current, and severe TiN electrode work function shift.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful complete stripping of native and chemical interfacial oxides from high-aspect-ratio 180nm crown capacitor cavities using dilute HF/DIO3 wet sequence, yielding clean, hydrogen-passivated surfaces with zero pattern collapse ready for conformal ALD TiN deposition.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dHF_ozone_clean_run_metrology.csv`
- [ ] `crown_cavity_ar_xps_interfacial_report.pdf`
- [ ] `post_clean_fe_sem_cross_section.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual interfacial oxide thickness inside crown cavity bottom** | `0.10 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm | High-Resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy (HR-TEM) combined with EELS on FIB lamella cross-section |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Static deionized water contact angle on monitor test pads** | `80.0 degrees` | +/- 5.0 degrees | Automated Optical Goniometer Sessile Drop Analysis (9-point wafer mapping) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-clean 180nm crown capacitor wall collapse / defect density** | `0 defects/cm2` | + 0.05 defects/cm2 | Brightfield Optical / Laser Defect Inspection and In-line Top-Down Review SEM |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer lot passes AR-XPS residual oxide qualification (<= 0.15 nm equivalent SiO2), exhibits sessile contact angle >= 75.0 degrees, demonstrates zero structural collapse on cross-sectional SEM, and is transferred into the ALD TiN load lock within the 30-minute air Q-time limit.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-180-CAP-004`  
**Process Step:** Dilute HF and Ozonated UPW Chemical Bath Formulation and Megasonic Wet Bench Setup  
**Integration Node:** 180nm Commercial Open-Source DRAM (Gen 3) — Crown Capacitor ALD Pre-Clean & Interfacial Native Oxide Stripping  

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Stage 1: Dilute HF   │
│   Bath Formulation    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Stage 2: Megasonic   │
│  Bath Setup at 1 MHz  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Stage 3: Crown     │
│  Cavity Native Oxide  │
│         Strip         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Stage 4: Dewetting   │
│  Endpoint Detection   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Stage 5: Quick Dump  │
│  Rinse to 16 MOhm-cm  │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Safety Pre-Check & PPE
> [!CAUTION]
> Hydrofluoric acid (HF) penetrates skin rapidly and irreversibly binds calcium ions. **Calcium gluconate gel must be present and inspected at the wet bench at all times** before initiating chemical formulation.

### Step 1: Chemical Bath Formulation (Dilute HF)
1. Verify feed ultra-pure water (UPW) baseline resistivity is **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.
2. Formulate dilute hydrofluoric acid (dHF) in the fluoropolymer (PTFE) wet bench immersion tank:
   - Mix at a volumetric ratio of **$1:50$ to $1:100\text{ HF}:\text{UPW}$** (yielding **$0.5\%$ to $1.0\%\text{ HF}$** concentration).
   - If utilizing buffered chemistry with micro-trench wetting, incorporate wetting agent ($0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad) to eliminate bubble entrapment in high-aspect-ratio crown cavities.
3. Stabilize bath temperature at **$22^\circ\text{C}$** (ambient room temperature control).

### Step 2: Megasonic Wet Bench Setup
1. Fill the quartz or PTFE immersion bath equipped with bottom/side-mounted megasonic piezoelectric transducers.
2. Initialize transducer power and lock carrier frequency at **$1\text{ MHz}$**.
3. Degas the formulated chemical bath under continuous recirculation and megasonic acoustic streaming for 5 minutes prior to wafer lot immersion to remove entrapped microbubbles in high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor cavities.

### Step 3: Wafer Immersion & Native Oxide Strip
1. Transfer wafer boat into the megasonic dHF immersion tank.
2. Maintain immersion for **$15\text{ to }30\text{ seconds}$** at **$22^\circ\text{C}$** with continuous $1\text{ MHz}$ megasonic acoustic agitation to dissolve interfacial native silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$).
3. Monitor surface transition: observe the hydrophobic dewetting transition endpoint (clean chemical sheeting off the silicon substrate surface).

### Step 4: Cascade Dump Rinse & Nitrogen Dry
1. Immediately transfer wafer boat to the Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) / Cascade Dump Rinse tank supplied with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** UPW.
2. Execute **$5\text{ dump rinse cycles}$** (minimum 3 minutes) until dump tank effluent resistivity reaches **$> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.
3. Transfer wafers to spin rinse dryer (SRD) or dry station; blow dry with filtered high-purity nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$).

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                                        ┌──────────────────┐
                                        │░░                │
    Megasonic Transducer Frequency (MHz)┤░░                │
                                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
     Native Oxide Strip Time (sec (max))┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
 UPW Feed Baseline Resistivity (MOhm-cm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓       │
                                        │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓       │
Cascade Dump Rinse Resistivity (MOhm-cm)┤██████████        │
                                        │██████████        │
                                        └┬───┬────┬───┬────┘
                                        0.0 7.5 15.0 22.5   
```

| Metric # | Target Parameter | Exact Specification / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Dilute HF Bath Concentration | **$0.5\% \text{ to } 1.0\%$** ($1:50 \text{ to } 1:100\text{ HF}:\text{UPW}$) | Volumetric ratio / $\%$ wt | Wet bench titration / flow dosing meter |
| **AC-02** | Interfacial Native Oxide Strip Duration | **$15 \text{ to } 30$** (at $22^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{seconds}$ | Wet bench calibrated recipe timer |
| **AC-03** | Cascade Dump Rinse Resistivity Endpoint | **$> 16.0$** (after $5\text{ cycles}$ with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ feed) | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity cell sensor |
| **AC-04** | Megasonic Transducer Agitation Frequency | **$1.0$** | $\text{MHz}$ | RF generator diagnostic readout |

---

## 4. Context Source Citations
- **Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**:
  - *Native Oxide Strip*: $1:50$ or $1:100\text{ HF}:\text{UPW}$ ($0.5\%\text{ to }1.0\%\text{ HF}$), $15\text{ to }30\text{ seconds}$ at $22^\circ\text{C}$; hydrophobic dewetting endpoint.
  - *Agitation & Rinse*: Quartz/PTFE immersion bath with megasonic agitation at $1\text{ MHz}$; cascade dump rinse $5\text{ cycles}$ with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW until effluent resistivity $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - Intermediate/dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for 3 minutes; $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dip for $15\text{--}30\text{ seconds}$; high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - Wetting agent ($0.1\%$ Triton X-100 or Fluorad) micro-trench bubble entrapment mitigation; mandatory calcium gluconate safety protocol for HF handling.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Integration of megasonic transducers (950 kHz to 1.0 MHz) into dilute HF (dHF 100:1 or 200:1) and ozonated UPW (DIO3, 20 ppm) baths requires stringent acoustic power density profiling. Excessive localized acoustic streaming risks mechanical cavitation collapse that can topple high-aspect-ratio (HAR > 15:1) 180nm crown capacitor SiO2/SiN structural molds, while insufficient megasonic propagation results in boundary layer stagnation and incomplete removal of native oxide inside the 1.2 um deep cylindrical crown cavities.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct exposure of silicon/polysilicon crown bottom electrodes to ozonated UPW without precise redox potential monitoring causes uncontrolled chemical oxidation, which dHF then continuously strips, altering target crown cylinder wall thicknesses. A strict cyclical or balanced chemistry is mandatory: controlled native oxide stripping down to an H-terminated or controlled sub-nanometer chemical oxide surface must preserve dielectric interface integrity prior to ALD TiN deposition, keeping surface roughness RMS below 0.2 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring ultra-high-purity (UPW/SEMI Grade 5) hydrofluoric acid (49% bulk) with trace metallic impurities < 10 ppt and compatible fluoropolymer PVDF/PFA megasonic chemical bath components has an 8-to-12 week lead time. Furthermore, inline ozone contactor membranes with Teflon AF components must be dual-sourced to mitigate single-supplier downtime during the 180nm DRAM tapeout pilot run.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tool qualification schedule for the wet bench setup allocates only 10 working days prior to ALD TiN baseline deposition. Any delays in exhaust interlock validation, bath recirculation leak testing, or EHS hydrofluoric acid sensor sign-off will directly push back the milestone for Crown Capacitor Dielectric stack processing.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Megasonic acoustic cavitation micro-jetting induces mechanical collapse, shearing, or pattern stiction of high-aspect-ratio DRAM crown capacitor micro-pillars.
1. Ozone off-gassing and rapid decomposition in warm UPW degrades dissolved O3 concentration below critical passivation threshold (< 10 ppm), resulting in non-uniform carbon contaminant clearance and pinhole defects in subsequent ALD TiN.
1. Fluoride salt crystallization or localized HF depletion inside high-aspect-ratio cavities causing incomplete native SiO2 stripping and degraded contact resistance (Rc > 50 Ohm per contact).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-1-1-01` | **Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch Rate and Uniformity Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE) with automated 49-point wafer mapping and inline four-point probe sheet resistance meter | 1. Immerse monitor wafer into 100:1 dHF wet bath with megasonic agitation at 0.8 W/cm2 for 60 seconds. 2. Transfer immediately to quick-dump rinse (QDR) bath with 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW for 3 cycles. 3. Spin-rinse dry (SRD) with high-purity filtered N2 at 2500 RPM for 180 seconds. 4. Measure remaining SiO2 thickness across 49 points via Spectroscopic Ellipsometry. | `Thermal SiO2 etch rate must be 2.3 nm/min +/- 0.2 nm/min; within-wafer etch uniformity (1-sigma) must be <= 1.5%; zero visual haze or drying spots under bright-field inspection.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full-face splash shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Heavy-duty butyl or neoprene chemical apron, Cal-OSHA compliant heavy-gauge Neoprene/Nitrile outer gloves over inner thin nitrile exam gloves, Closed-toe chemical-resistant neoprene boots, Continuous optical air HF gas badge/clip-on detector
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Hydrofluoric acid readily penetrates dermal layers causing hypocalcemia and severe cardiac arrest. In case of skin exposure: immediately rinse affected area under dedicated emergency safety shower for exactly 5 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. Immediately massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into skin until emergency medical services arrive. In case of eye contact: flush with sterile 1% Calcium Gluconate ophthalmic solution or eyewash for 15 minutes. Ensure fresh Calcium Gluconate gel tubes (within valid expiration dates) are mounted directly at wet bench front-panel.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid-exhaust ducting manufactured from polypropylene/ECTFE (Halar) maintaining negative static pressure of -1.5 in. w.g. across the lip-slot exhausted wet bench perimeter; minimum face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with differential pressure interlocks connected to automated chemical drain dump; continuous inline ozone ambient destruct unit (catalytic MnO2 carusite bed) venting below 0.05 ppm OSHA ceiling limit.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Hydrofluoric waste must be diverted exclusively into designated fluoride chemical drain (F-Drain), segregated from general acid/base systems. Automatic neutralization requires two-stage precipitation using Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry or Calcium Chloride (CaCl2) to convert soluble fluorides into insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) precipitate, maintaining pH between 7.5 and 8.5 before settling and filter-press dewatering.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-RIE high-aspect-ratio cylinder etch and ash residue; native SiO2 layer thickness ~1.2 nm with organic halocarbon etch byproduct contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Completely stripped native oxide, atomically clean H-terminated or controlled sub-monolayer chemical oxide (< 0.3 nm), hydrophobic crown cylinder sidewalls (contact angle > 70 deg if H-terminated).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (> 0.5 nm SiO2) in ambient cleanroom air with airborne moisture and trace organics, leading to excessive series resistance (Rc) and parasitic interfacial capacitance drop across the ALD TiN bottom electrode interface.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

Excessive localized acoustic streaming risks mechanical cavitation collapse that can topple high-aspect-ratio (HAR > 15:1) 180nm crown capacitor SiO2/SiN structural molds, while insufficient megasonic propagation results in boundary layer stagnation and incomplete removal of native oxide inside the 1.2 um deep cylindrical crown cavities.
critics.domain_expert: Direct exposure of silicon/polysilicon crown bottom electrodes to ozonated UPW without precise redox potential monitoring causes uncontrolled chemical oxidation, which dHF then continuously strips, altering target crown cylinder wall thicknesses. A strict cyclical or balanced chemistry is mandatory: controlled native oxide stripping down to an H-terminated or controlled sub-nanometer chemical oxide surface must preserve dielectric interface integrity prior to ALD TiN deposition, keeping surface roughness RMS below 0.2 nm.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Crown Cavity Ozone Organic Removal and 1:50 DHF Interfacial Oxide Strip Recipe Execution  
**Module:** 3D High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor ALD Dielectric & Metal Electrode Deposition / Wet Chemistry  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 1: Load Wafer   │
│        Cassette        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 2: Ozone/SC-1   │
│        Organic         │
│     Solubilization     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 3: Intermediate  │
│       Dump Rinse       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 4: 1:50 DHF    │
│   Interfacial Strip    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 5: Quick Dump   │
│     Rinse & Dewet      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 6: High-Purity   │
│         N2 Dry         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Preparation**:
   - Verify safety controls prior to opening HF chemistry enclosures. Confirm **Calcium Gluconate Gel** is present at the wet bench station.
   - Ensure the immersion tanks (PTFE/quartz) and megasonic transducers (1 MHz) are active and calibrated.
2. **Organic Contaminant Solubilization & Surface Oxidation (SC-1 / Ozone Bath)**:
   - Prepare/verify the alkaline oxidation bath: **5 parts UPW : 1 part 29% NH₄OH : 1 part 30% H₂O₂**.
   - Heat the bath to **70°C – 80°C** (target: **70°C – 75°C**).
   - Immerse the wafer cassette in the bath for **10 to 15 minutes** (nominal: **10 minutes**) under **1 MHz megasonic agitation** to solubilize organic surface films and dislodge sub-micron particulates via zeta potential repulsion.
3. **Intermediate Cascade Dump Rinse**:
   - Transfer wafer cassette immediately to the cascade dump rinse tank using 18.2 MΩ·cm Ultra-Pure Water (UPW).
   - Execute **5 dump cycles** or rinse for **3 minutes** until the effluent bath resistivity exceeds **16 MΩ·cm**.
4. **Interfacial Native Oxide Strip (Dilute HF Bath)**:
   - Transfer the cassette into the dilute hydrofluoric acid bath containing **1:50 HF : UPW** (approx. 1% HF concentration) maintained at **22°C**.
   - Immerse for **15 to 30 seconds** to strip the interfacial native oxide layer inside the crown cavities.
   - Endpoint: Verify the hydrophobic surface dewetting transition (water sheets and beads off upon pull).
5. **Final Cascade Dump Rinse**:
   - Transfer into the final dump rinse tank with 18.2 MΩ·cm UPW.
   - Execute cascade dump rinsing until resistivity stabilizes at **> 16 MΩ·cm** (nominal: 5 cycles, 3 minutes).
6. **Drying**:
   - Transfer wafer lot to the spin-rinse-dry (SRD) or Marangoni dry module.
   - Perform drying using **high-purity N₂ blow-dry** to eliminate residue and water spots prior to conformal CVD/ALD TiN bottom/top electrode deposition.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 / Oxidation Bath Temperature** | `72.5` | `70.0 - 80.0` | `°C` | In-situ Bath RTD / Thermocouple Sensor |
| **Dilute HF (1:50) Immersion Duration** | `22.5` | `15.0 - 30.0` | `s` | Automated Wet Bench Robot Recipe Timer |
| **DHF Process Bath Temperature** | `22.0` | `21.0 - 23.0` | `°C` | In-situ Bath Temperature Controller |
| **Post-Strip Cascade Rinse Resistivity**| `16.0` (min) | `16.0 - 18.2` | `MΩ·cm` | In-line Effluent Resistivity Meter |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **[Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure]**:
  - *Parameters referenced*: SC-1 chemistry ratio (`5 parts DI H2O : 1 part 29% NH4OH : 1 part 30% H2O2`), bath temperature `70°C - 80°C`, duration `10 - 15 minutes`, dump rinse resistivity benchmark `18.2 MΩ·cm` for `3 minutes`, dilute HF dip ratio `1:50 HF:H2O` for `15 - 30 seconds`, hydrophobic transition, and final `high-purity N2 blow-dry`.
- **[RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering]**:
  - *Parameters referenced*: Megasonic agitation at `1 MHz`, base oxide etching (~`0.5 nm`), cascade dump rinse `5 cycles` until bath resistivity `> 16 MΩ·cm`, and dilute HF immersion temperature of `22°C` for `15 to 30 seconds`.
- **[Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)]**:
  - *Parameters referenced*: Hydrofluoric chemical burn safety protocol requiring `Calcium Gluconate Gel` to be present at all times at the operating station.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitor structures (depth-to-width > 12:1 at 180nm node), aqueous surface tension during standard bath immersion creates liquid entrapment and incomplete cavity wetting. Dissolved ozone (DIO3) mass-transport into deep cavities must be bubble-free to avoid micro-masking, and downstream 1:50 DHF oxide etching requires verified diffusion modeling to prevent bottom oxide undercut while top cavity oxide is stripped.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Ozone-DIW exposure creates an atomically thin, chemically grown passivating oxide while stripping fluorocarbon polymer and organic etch residues. The subsequent 1:50 DHF dip (0.5 wt% HF) must execute an isotropic etch of this chemical oxide and residual native oxide down to the bottom TiN/poly-Si storage node electrode interface. Over-etching will attack supporting inter-dielectric layer (IDL) oxides such as USG or BPSG, leading to crown mechanical collapse or pattern peeling, whereas under-etching leaves high-contact-resistance SiO2/organic interfaces prior to ALD TiN deposition.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Ultra-pure hydrofluoric acid (HF 49% semiconductor grade VLSI/SEMI Grade 4) and semiconductor-grade liquid/gas oxygen for corona discharge ozone generation require uninterrupted closed-loop delivery. Supply bottlenecks in ultrapure water (UPW) TOC (< 1 ppb) and dissolved O2/O3 saturation consistency directly degrade batch-to-batch interface resistance on open-source fab line pilot runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Strict queue-time (Q-Time) tracking between the final Marangoni/IPA vapor dry step of the DHF strip and vacuum loadlock pumping for ALD TiN deposition is critical. Any idle time exceeding 30 minutes in cleanroom ambient re-grows native oxide (> 0.4 nm), causing capacitor threshold shifts and invalidating MPW electrical signoff.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interlayer Dielectric (BPSG/USG) Over-Etch & Crown Collapse: Capillary forces and excessive DHF dwell time dissolve mechanical anchor oxides, resulting in crown capacitor leaning, structural collapse, and shorting.
1. Incomplete Cavity Wetting & Micro-bubble Stagnation: Sub-micron cavity entrapment of gas bubbles during ozone sparging prevents interfacial oxide strip, leading to localized native oxide retention (> 1.2 nm) and severe capacitor contact open/high ESR.
1. Fluorine Surface Contamination & Galvanic Corrosion: Insufficient rinse cascading after 1:50 DHF leaves residual HF trapped inside cavity bottoms, corroding bottom electrode TiN seeds and forming non-conductive titanium fluorides (TiFx).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-1-2-01` | **Crown Cavity Bottom Interfacial Native Oxide Thickness Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE) on open-frame scribe pads, cross-checked with High-Resolution Cross-Sectional TEM (HR-TEM) with EELS chemical mapping inside crown bottoms | 1. Position wafer on spectroscopic ellipsometer stage under N2 purge. 2. Measure residual oxide thickness across 49-point wafer map on dedicated crown array test macro. 3. Cleave wafer sample under cleanroom conditions and prepare lamella via FIB at center and edge crown cavities. 4. Perform HR-TEM imaging and EELS linescan across the silicon/metal interface at bottom crown cavity. | `Residual interfacial SiO2 thickness must be <= 0.25 nm (below detection limit of continuous native film) across 100% of tested cavity bottom locations with 3-sigma uniformity < 0.05 nm.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-1-2-02` | **Crown Lateral Support Oxide Undercut and Structural Deflection Inspection** | In-line In-Lens Critical Dimension SEM (CD-SEM) and Tilt-Angle Field Emission SEM (FESEM at 45° tilt) | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM vacuum chamber. 2. Measure top inner diameter (CD_top) and bottom diameter (CD_bottom) of crown cavity. 3. Transition to 45° tilt FESEM. 4. Inspect crown pillar structural verticality, lateral inter-crown spacing, and undercut depth into surrounding USG/BPSG dielectric layer at 20 representative sites. | `USG/BPSG lateral etch undercut <= 3.5 nm; crown capacitor structure leaning or tilt angle deviation < 1.0° from vertical; 0% observed crown-to-crown bridging, stiction, or collapse across entire inspection field.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full-face chemical splash shield (polycarbonate/ANSI Z87.1 certified), Viton or heavy neoprene gauntlet gloves over double nitrile inner gloves, Acid-resistant PTFE/Neoprene chemical apron and full-body acid suit, Steel-toe chemical resistant boots with PVC shoe covers, Personal portable ambient ozone (O3) and hydrofluoric acid (HF) gas detectors
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF dermal contact: Immediately flush area with UPW/safety shower for 60 seconds. Immediately apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel repeatedly to affected area with gloved hand, massaging continuously until emergency medical personnel arrive. For eye contact: Rinse continuously with isotonic saline or neutral water for minimum 15 minutes and seek ophthalmologic care. For Ozone inhalation: Remove victim immediately to fresh air, administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is difficult, and keep calm.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench must operate under continuous laminar air exhaust dedicated to acid/toxic fumes with face velocity maintained between 0.5 m/s and 0.7 m/s (100-140 fpm). Continuous photoacoustic toxic gas monitors for HF (threshold alarm 1.0 ppm) and electrochemical monitors for O3 (threshold alarm 0.1 ppm) tied to automatic interlock shotoff valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent dilute HF effluent is routed exclusively to dedicated fluoride waste neutralization piping (Fluoride Waste Drainage - FWD). Chemical precipitation with calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) forming insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge, followed by secondary neutralization with caustic to maintain discharge pH between 6.5 and 8.5 with total fluoride discharge < 10 mg/L. Residual ozone stream routed to thermal/catalytic MnO2 carusite destruct unit.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 4 / VLSI (Pico-pure, ultra-low trace metals < 100 ppt) | `0.5 wt% to 1.0 wt% (1:50 volumetric dilution from 49% stock)` |
| **Ozone (Dissolved O3 in UPW)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from 99.999% purity cryogenic liquid oxygen source | `15 to 25 ppm dissolved O3 in ultra-pure water (DIO3)` |
| **Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)** | `7732-18-5` | Electronic Grade 1 (Resistivity 18.2 MOhm-cm @ 25°C, TOC < 1 ppb) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic, covered with fluorocarbon etch polymer, surface particulate, and native oxide layer (thickness 1.2 nm - 1.8 nm)
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Atomically clean, fully hydrogen-terminated, hydrophobic silicon/TiN interface (contact angle > 75°), native oxide < 0.2 nm
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time causes spontaneous atmospheric re-oxidation forming non-stoichiometric SiOx/TiOx interfacial oxide (> 0.4 nm) and airborne organic hydrocarbon contamination, causing high contact resistance, capacitance degradation (> 15% dielectric capacitance reduction), and high ALD TiN leakage current.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful complete removal of organic cavity residues via DIO3 oxidation and complete interfacial oxide stripping down to bare conductive substrate inside high-aspect-ratio crown cavities using 1:50 DHF, producing a pristine hydrogen-terminated hydrophobic surface ready for ALD TiN seed layer deposition with structural crown integrity intact.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WET_CLEAN_RUN_REPORT_RECIPE_DHF_O3_LOT_LOG.csv`
- [ ] `CROWN_CAVITY_CROSS_SECTION_HRTEM_EELS_MAP.pdf`

critics.systems_engineer: In high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitor structures (depth-to-width > 12:1 at 180nm node), aqueous surface tension during standard bath immersion creates liquid entrapment and incomplete cavity wetting. Dissolved ozone (DIO3) mass-transport into deep cavities must be bubble-free to avoid micro-masking, and downstream 1:50 DHF oxide etching requires verified diffusion modeling to prevent bottom oxide undercut while top cavity oxide is stripped.
critics.domain_expert: Ozone-DIW exposure creates an atomically thin, chemically grown passivating oxide while stripping fluorocarbon polymer and organic etch residues. The subsequent 1:50 DHF dip (0.5 wt% HF) must execute an isotropic etch of this chemical oxide and residual native oxide down to the bottom TiN/poly-Si storage node electrode interface. Over-etching will attack supporting inter-dielectric layer (IDL) oxides such as USG or BPSG, leading to crown mechanical collapse or pattern peeling, whereas under-etching leaves high-contact-resistance SiO2/organic interfaces prior to ALD TiN deposition.
critics.supply_chain: Ultra-pure hydrofluoric acid (HF 49% semiconductor grade VLSI/SEMI Grade 4) and semiconductor-grade liquid/gas oxygen for corona discharge ozone generation require uninterrupted closed-loop delivery. Supply bottlenecks in ultrapure water (UPW) TOC (< 1 ppb) and dissolved O2/O3 saturation consistency directly degrade batch-to-batch interface resistance on open-source fab line pilot runs.
critics.laya_pm: Strict queue-time (Q-Time) tracking between the final Marangoni/IPA vapor dry step of the DHF strip and vacuum loadlock pumping for ALD TiN deposition is critical. Any idle time exceeding 30 minutes in cleanroom ambient re-grows native oxide (> 0.4 nm), causing capacitor threshold shifts and invalidating MPW electrical signoff.
critical_failure_modes: Interlayer Dielectric (BPSG/USG) Over-Etch & Crown Collapse: Capillary forces and excessive DHF dwell time dissolve mechanical anchor oxides, resulting in crown capacitor leaning, structural collapse, and shorting.

Incomplete Cavity Wetting & Micro-bubble Stagnation: Sub-micron cavity entrapment of gas bubbles during ozone sparging prevents interfacial oxide strip, leading to localized native oxide retention (> 1.2 nm) and severe capacitor contact open/high ESR.

Fluorine Surface Contamination & Galvanic Corrosion: Insufficient rinse cascading after 1:50 DHF leaves residual HF trapped inside cavity bottoms, corroding bottom electrode TiN seeds and forming non-conductive titanium fluorides (TiFx).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Clean Contact Angle Dewetting Verification and Ellipsometric Interfacial Oxide Metrology
**Node Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, 1T1C Stacked Crown Capacitor Topology)  
**Process Step ID**: `MET-CLN-180-004`  
**Classification**: Metrology Quality Gate (Action Type: Buy / In-Line Metrology Tool Qualification)

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

│  Post-DHF/Ozone Wafer  │

         Pass│

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Metrology Transport & Automated Wafer Handling
1. Transfer post-dilute HF/ozone cleaned 200 mm wafers from clean bench dry-station to the automated metrology FOUP under continuous clean dry air (CDA) / high-purity $N_2$ purge (purity $\ge 99.9999\%$).
2. Start the physical queue-time ($Q$-time) clock: wafers must complete metrology and enter the ALD TiN degas/loadlock within $\le 120\text{ min}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth ($> 0.2\text{ nm}$).

#### Step 2: Contact Angle Dewetting Verification (Sessile Droplet Goniometry)
1. Mount the wafer onto the vacuum chuck of an automated optical goniometer.
2. Dispense a calibrated sessile micro-droplet of ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) with a target volume of $1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$ onto 5 dedicated planar monitor test pads situated along the wafer scribe lines (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right).
3. Image the droplet profile with high-speed digital imaging within $3.0\text{ s}$ of droplet contact to prevent evaporation drift.
4. Extract the water contact angle ($\theta$) using a circle/tangent fitting algorithm.
   - Fully stripped, hydrogen-terminated silicon ($\text{Si-H}$) yields a hydrophobic dewetting response ($\theta \ge 70^\circ$, nominally $75^\circ - 85^\circ$).
   - Incompletely stripped hydrophilic surfaces exhibiting residual oxide ($\text{Si-OH}$ or $SiO_2$) yield $\theta < 45^\circ$, triggering an automatic clean rework alarm.

```text
Water Contact Angle Target Spectrum (Degrees)
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │░░░░░                          │
Hydrophilic Native SiO2┤░░░░░                          │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │

                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓    │
    Bare Hydrophobic Si┤███████████████████████████████│
                       │███████████████████████████████│
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                        0      20     40      60     80 
```

#### Step 3: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Interfacial Oxide Profiling
1. Transport wafer onto the optical stage of a Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE).
2. Configure broadband spectral scanning across the wavelength range $\lambda = 250\text{ nm}$ to $850\text{ nm}$ at variable angles of incidence ($\Phi = 65^\circ, 70^\circ, 75^\circ$).
3. Execute a standard 9-site or 13-site diameter map targeting planar MOSCAP diagnostic scribe-line test pads (co-located with MOSCAP test structures of diameter $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, or $1000\ \mu\text{m}$).
4. Fit acquired ellipsometric angles $(\Psi, \Delta)$ against a two-layer optical dispersion model: $\text{Si (substrate)} / SiO_2\ (\text{Cauchy dielectric layer})$.
5. Quantify the physical residual interfacial oxide thickness ($t_{ox}$) with an extraction resolution of $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 4: Lot Disposition & ALD Loadlock Release
1. Verify all 5 contact angle sites and 9/13 ellipsometry sites meet Acceptance Criteria.
2. Transfer compliant lots directly into the ALD TiN deposition cluster module loadlock pumped down to base vacuum ($< 1 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Control / Rejection Limit | Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DIW Contact Angle ($\theta$)** | $\ge 75^\circ$ | Reject if $\theta < 70.0^\circ$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Automated Sessile Droplet Goniometer ($1.0\ \mu\text{L}$ DIW) |
| **Residual Interfacial $SiO_2$ Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $\le 0.10$ | Reject if $t_{ox} > 0.20$ | nanometers ($\text{nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\lambda = 250 - 850\text{ nm}$) |
| **Oxide Film Thickness Precision / Uniformity** | $\pm 0.1$ | Reject if $3\sigma > 0.15$ | nanometers ($\text{nm}$) | Multi-site (9-point) SE Wafer Map |
| **Clean-to-Vacuum Loadlock Queue Time ($Q\text{-time}$)** | $\le 60$ | Strict Expiry at $> 120$ | minutes ($\text{min}$) | Automated MES Fab Tracking Timer |

---

### Literature Context & Citations

1. **Capacitance Budget & High-$\kappa$ Stack Preservation**:
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
   - Specifies a minimum cell storage capacitance budget of **$28\text{ fF/cell}$** with an effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ ($Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ or ONO stack) over crown-shaped polysilicon/MIM topologies. Eliminating parasitic series native oxide ($t_{ox} \le 0.2\text{ nm}$) is required to prevent capacitance degradation below the $28\text{ fF}$ threshold.
2. **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) Targets**:
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
   - Directs stacked crown/cylinder capacitors to maintain an EOT of **$3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$** and minimum capacitance of **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$** (ensuring $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention time at $85^\circ\text{C}$). Uncontrolled native oxide consumes $1.0 - 1.5\text{ nm}$ of this stringent budget if not verified stripped.
3. **Oxide Thickness Metrology Baseline Precision**:
   - *Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction*  
   - Validates that high-frequency accumulation capacitance and ellipsometric/C-V modeling yields physical oxide thickness $t_{ox}$ with **$\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision** on planar diagnostic test pads ($200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter pads).

---

*The extracted micro-knowledge and architectural record have been persisted to [`docs/knowledge/post_clean_contact_angle_ellipsometry_sop.md`](./docs/knowledge/post_clean_contact_angle_ellipsometry_sop.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Optical metrology on high-aspect-ratio 3D crown structures encounters significant polarization depolarization and effective medium approximation (EMA) limitations. Standard spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) light spot sizes (typically ~50-100 µm) average over millions of micro-cavities, convoluting sidewall oxide, bottom cavity interface, and planar top-surface reflections. To ensure systems-level integration, SE measurements must be constrained to planar monitor pads embedded in the scribe line or wafer edge specifically calibrated to reflect the chemical etch kinetics of the 3D cell array.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Following dilute HF (dHF)/ozone stripping, an ideal silicon/poly-Si surface terminates in Si-H bonds, exhibiting hydrophobicity with a deionized water contact angle (WCA) > 70-75 degrees. Any residual native oxide (Si-OH termination) immediately reduces WCA (< 20 degrees) and increases the interfacial sub-oxide thickness (SiO_x) measurable by SE phase shift Delta (Δ). Ellipsometric fitting must apply an anisotropic Cauchy or B-Spline model incorporating an interfacial roughness layer; otherwise, sub-nanometer native oxide regrowth (< 0.5 nm) will be falsely attributed to surface micro-roughness.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated spectroscopic ellipsometers and high-precision optical goniometers with cleanroom nitrogen-purged loadlocks represent significant capital equipment bottlenecks. Calibration standards (traceable SiO2/Si standard wafers certified by NIST/VLSI Standards) must be procured with dual source verification to avoid tool downtime during multi-project wafer (MPW) runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology execution adds inline cycle time that directly threatens the strict 45-minute Q-time window between wet clean oxide stripping and ALD TiN deposition. Standard 49-point wafer mapping must be streamlined to an automated 9-point radial sampling scheme during routine fabrication, with full 49-point maps reserved strictly for daily qualification lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interfacial Native Oxide Regrowth Exceeding Budget (> 0.4 nm), causing series capacitance reduction and dielectric leakage degradation across the crown capacitor node.
1. Incomplete dHF Dewetting (Hydrophilic Pockets, WCA < 65°), indicating localized chemical stagnancy or capillary pinning inside 3D high-aspect-ratio crown cavities.
1. Capillary Contamination from Metrology Droplet Residue, introducing airborne hydrocarbons or organic surfactant residues onto the cleanroom-primed Si-H interface prior to vacuum ALD entry.

Dispense 0.5 µL ultra-pure degassed UPW (18.2 MOhm·cm) droplet at 0.1 µL/s rate. 4. Capture high-speed baseline profile at 30 fps for 5 seconds using Young-Laplace fitting algorithm. 5. Record contact angle theta for left and right flanks and compute arithmetic mean. | `Static deionized water contact angle (WCA) >= 72.0° across all 5 monitoring points. Standard deviation across wafer < 2.5°. Zero droplet pinning or hysteresis.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-1-3-02` | **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Point Interfacial Oxide Thickness Metrology** | Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE) equipped with micro-spot optics (30 µm spot size, spectral range 190 nm to 1000 nm, 70° incident angle). | 1. Transfer wafer to SE measurement chamber with N2 purge active to prevent air oxidation. 2. Execute 9-point radial automated wafer map focusing on scribe-line planar monitor pads. 3. Acquire raw spectroscopic polarization parameters Psi (Ψ) and Delta (Δ) from 193 nm to 800 nm. 4. Fit acquired spectra using a dual-layer optical model: Substrate (c-Si) / Interfacial Native Oxide (SiO2, Cauchy model n=1.46 at 632.8 nm) / Ambient (N2). 5. Extract interfacial oxide thickness (T_ox) and Mean Squared Error (MSE). | `Interfacial native oxide thickness T_ox <= 0.35 nm across all 9 measured points. Thickness uniformity 3-sigma <= 0.08 nm. Optical model goodness-of-fit MSE <= 2.0.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), Chemical-resistant neoprene overgloves for chemical prep/rinsing, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles and full-face shield, Acid-resistant Tyvek protective lab apron, Cleanroom antistatic safety shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with HF-contaminated surfaces: immediately flush with eyewash/drench shower for 2 minutes, then aggressively massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel onto affected area for >= 15 minutes or until medical arrival. For eye contact: flush with sterile isotonic eyewash solution for >= 15 minutes. Inhalation: remove victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Metrology loadlock and goniometer station must be installed inside dedicated laminar flow hoods connected to the cleanroom acid exhaust ducting with continuous face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) and automated differential pressure alarm.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent sessile drop liquids and rinse wastes routed directly to Dedicated Fluoride/Acid Waste Neutralization (AWN) collection system. Waste stream neutralized with calcium hydroxide Ca(OH)2 to precipitate non-hazardous CaF2 cake (pH maintained between 6.5 and 8.5) prior to municipal release.

| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA dry residual)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 | `< 0.05%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic Si-H passivated crystalline silicon / polysilicon surface, freshly etched via dHF/Ozone and Marangoni dried; target native oxide thickness < 0.2 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Clean, verified hydrophobic (WCA >= 72°) substrate with pristine interfacial native oxide <= 0.35 nm, prepped for immediate vacuum loadlock transfer into the ALD TiN deposition cluster tool.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces spontaneous atmospheric re-oxidation and airborne organic moisture adsorption, forming an uncontrolled 0.5-1.2 nm amorphous SiO_x dielectric barrier layer that degrades high-k capacitance-equivalent thickness (CET) by > 15% and spikes capacitor contact resistance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full metrology verification confirming complete interfacial native oxide removal and persistent Si-H hydrophobic passivation across the wafer post-dHF clean. Both automated sessile drop contact angle goniometry and spectroscopic ellipsometry demonstrate a sub-0.35 nm native oxide layer and uniform surface dewetting within the permissible 30-minute cleanroom air Q-time.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

| `ASSERT-02` | **Mean interfacial native oxide thickness (T_ox) extracted via Cauchy optical model** | `<= 0.35 nm` | +0.05 nm / -0.15 nm | Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry across 190-1000 nm spectra |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Wafer-level 9-point radial interfacial oxide thickness non-uniformity (1-sigma)** | `<= 0.05 nm` | +0.02 nm | Radial 9-point wafer mapping standard deviation calculation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer passes signoff if all 5 contact angle monitor sites exhibit WCA >= 72.0°, 9-point SE oxide thickness map confirms mean T_ox <= 0.35 nm with MSE <= 2.0, and elapsed metrology time is <= 20 minutes from post-clean cassette unload, enabling immediate ALD cluster loadlock pump-down.

critics.systems_engineer: Optical metrology on high-aspect-ratio 3D crown structures encounters significant polarization depolarization and effective medium approximation (EMA) limitations. Standard spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) light spot sizes (typically ~50-100 µm) average over millions of micro-cavities, convoluting sidewall oxide, bottom cavity interface, and planar top-surface reflections. To ensure systems-level integration, SE measurements must be constrained to planar monitor pads embedded in the scribe line or wafer edge specifically calibrated to reflect the chemical etch kinetics of the 3D cell array.
critics.domain_expert: Following dilute HF (dHF)/ozone stripping, an ideal silicon/poly-Si surface terminates in Si-H bonds, exhibiting hydrophobicity with a deionized water contact angle (WCA) > 70-75 degrees. Any residual native oxide (Si-OH termination) immediately reduces WCA (< 20 degrees) and increases the interfacial sub-oxide thickness (SiO_x) measurable by SE phase shift Delta (Δ). Ellipsometric fitting must apply an anisotropic Cauchy or B-Spline model incorporating an interfacial roughness layer; otherwise, sub-nanometer native oxide regrowth (< 0.5 nm) will be falsely attributed to surface micro-roughness.
critics.domain_expert_context: Contact angle verification must utilize static sessile drop with ultra-pure degassed DI water (< 0.5 µL droplet) to prevent droplet-induced capillary collapse or pinhole wetting in high-aspect-ratio patterns.
critics.supply_chain: Automated spectroscopic ellipsometers and high-precision optical goniometers with cleanroom nitrogen-purged loadlocks represent significant capital equipment bottlenecks. Calibration standards (traceable SiO2/Si standard wafers certified by NIST/VLSI Standards) must be procured with dual source verification to avoid tool downtime during multi-project wafer (MPW) runs.
critics.laya_pm: Metrology execution adds inline cycle time that directly threatens the strict 45-minute Q-time window between wet clean oxide stripping and ALD TiN deposition. Standard 49-point wafer mapping must be streamlined to an automated 9-point radial sampling scheme during routine fabrication, with full 49-point maps reserved strictly for daily qualification lots.
critical_failure_modes: Interfacial Native Oxide Regrowth Exceeding Budget (> 0.4 nm), causing series capacitance reduction and dielectric leakage degradation across the crown capacitor node.
Incomplete dHF Dewetting (Hydrophilic Pockets, WCA < 65°), indicating localized chemical stagnancy or capillary pinning inside 3D high-aspect-ratio crown cavities.
Capillary Contamination from Metrology Droplet Residue, introducing airborne hydrocarbons or organic surfactant residues onto the cleanroom-primed Si-H interface prior to vacuum ALD entry.

testcases.title: Automated Sessile Drop Static Contact Angle Dewetting Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Optical Goniometer / Drop Shape Analyzer with Class 1 cleanroom environmental enclosure and motorized sub-microliter syringe dispenser.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer has completed dHF/Ozone strip, ultrapure water megasonic rinse, and Marangoni/IPA vapor dry within <= 10 minutes. Instrument stage calibrated at 22.0 ± 0.5 °C and 45 ± 2% RH under laminar N2 flow.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load wafer onto goniometer vacuum chuck under class-1 laminar flow. 2. Align automated optical dispenser over designated planar scribe-line test pads (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right). 3. Dispense 0.5 µL ultra-pure degassed UPW (18.2 MOhm·cm) droplet at 0.1 µL/s rate. 4. Capture high-speed baseline profile at 30 fps for 5 seconds using Young-Laplace fitting algorithm. 5. Record contact angle theta for left and right flanks and compute arithmetic mean.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Static deionized water contact angle (WCA) >= 72.0° across all 5 monitoring points. Standard deviation across wafer < 2.5°. Zero droplet pinning or hysteresis.

testcases.title: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Point Interfacial Oxide Thickness Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (VASE) equipped with micro-spot optics (30 µm spot size, spectral range 190 nm to 1000 nm, 70° incident angle).
testcases.pre_conditions: Tool baseline auto-calibrated against NIST-traceable 100 nm thermal SiO2 standard wafer with residual goodness-of-fit MSE < 1.2. Wafer loaded under dry N2 purge.
testcases.procedure: 1. Transfer wafer to SE measurement chamber with N2 purge active to prevent air oxidation. 2. Execute 9-point radial automated wafer map focusing on scribe-line planar monitor pads. 3. Acquire raw spectroscopic polarization parameters Psi (Ψ) and Delta (Δ) from 193 nm to 800 nm. 4. Fit acquired spectra using a dual-layer optical model: Substrate (c-Si) / Interfacial Native Oxide (SiO2, Cauchy model n=1.46 at 632.8 nm) / Ambient (N2). 5. Extract interfacial oxide thickness (T_ox) and Mean Squared Error (MSE).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Interfacial native oxide thickness T_ox <= 0.35 nm across all 9 measured points. Thickness uniformity 3-sigma <= 0.08 nm. Optical model goodness-of-fit MSE <= 2.0.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving)
Chemical-resistant neoprene overgloves for chemical prep/rinsing
ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles and full-face shield
Acid-resistant Tyvek protective lab apron
Cleanroom antistatic safety shoes
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin contact with HF-contaminated surfaces: immediately flush with eyewash/drench shower for 2 minutes, then aggressively massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel onto affected area for >= 15 minutes or until medical arrival. For eye contact: flush with sterile isotonic eyewash solution for >= 15 minutes. Inhalation: remove victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Metrology loadlock and goniometer station must be installed inside dedicated laminar flow hoods connected to the cleanroom acid exhaust ducting with continuous face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) and automated differential pressure alarm.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent sessile drop liquids and rinse wastes routed directly to Dedicated Fluoride/Acid Waste Neutralization (AWN) collection system. Waste stream neutralized with calcium hydroxide Ca(OH)2 to precipitate non-hazardous CaF2 cake (pH maintained between 6.5 and 8.5) prior to municipal release.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Hydrophobic Si-H passivated crystalline silicon / polysilicon surface, freshly etched via dHF/Ozone and Marangoni dried; target native oxide thickness < 0.2 nm.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Clean, verified hydrophobic (WCA >= 72°) substrate with pristine interfacial native oxide <= 0.35 nm, prepped for immediate vacuum loadlock transfer into the ALD TiN deposition cluster tool.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding Q-time induces spontaneous atmospheric re-oxidation and airborne organic moisture adsorption, forming an uncontrolled 0.5-1.2 nm amorphous SiO_x dielectric barrier layer that degrades high-k capacitance-equivalent thickness (CET) by > 15% and spikes capacitor contact resistance.

expected_result.summary: Full metrology verification confirming complete interfacial native oxide removal and persistent Si-H hydrophobic passivation across the wafer post-dHF clean. Both automated sessile drop contact angle goniometry and spectroscopic ellipsometry demonstrate a sub-0.35 nm native oxide layer and uniform surface dewetting within the permissible 30-minute cleanroom air Q-time.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean static deionized water contact angle across planar scribe-line monitor points
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated Young-Laplace drop shape analysis via Optical Goniometer

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean interfacial native oxide thickness (T_ox) extracted via Cauchy optical model
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry across 190-1000 nm spectra

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Wafer-level 9-point radial interfacial oxide thickness non-uniformity (1-sigma)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Radial 9-point wafer mapping standard deviation calculation

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Wafer passes signoff if all 5 contact angle monitor sites exhibit WCA >= 72.0°, 9-point SE oxide thickness map confirms mean T_ox <= 0.35 nm with MSE <= 2.0, and elapsed metrology time is <= 20 minutes from post-clean cassette unload, enabling immediate ALD cluster loadlock pump-down.

# Standard Operating Procedure: In-Situ Ultra-High Vacuum Degas and TiCl4/NH3 ALD Precursor Saturation Optimization

**Category**: Thin Film Deposition | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-2-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-2-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of In-Situ Ultra-High Vacuum Degas and TiCl4/NH3 ALD Precursor Saturation Optimization: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## In-Situ UHV Thermal Degas and Chamber Moisture Desorption Profiling

**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM Cell Architecture)  
**Process Module:** Thin Film Deposition / Pre-ALD Surface Conditioning  
**Document Link:** [in_situ_uhv_thermal_degas.md](./docs/knowledge/in_situ_uhv_thermal_degas.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Loadlock Insertion &  │
│     Cryo Pumpdown      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   RGA Pre-Scan: Base   │
│        Baseline        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   UHV Thermal Degas    │
│      Ramp & Bake       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Quadrupole RGA     │
│  Desorption Profiling  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Base Recovery &     │
│  Transfer Gate to ALD  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Loadlock Insertion & Rough Pumping**:
   - Transfer wafer batch with 3D crown capacitor stacks ($L=180\text{ nm}, W=220\text{ nm}$ access transistor, tungsten W-plug contacts) into the cassette loadlock.
   - Evacuate loadlock to rough vacuum $< 50\text{ mTorr}$ before opening slit valve to the central transfer/degas module.

2. **Chamber Base Pumpdown**:
   - Engage high-vacuum turbomolecular and cryopump train.
   - Pump down degas station until the chamber base pressure reaches **$< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$** to suppress background oxygen and ambient humidity incorporation.

3. **In-Situ Residual Gas Analysis (RGA) Baseline Initialization**:
   - Power on the Quadrupole RGA mass spectrometer in Faraday cup / electron multiplier mode.
   - Calibrate baseline partial pressure scans across amu 1 to amu 50, establishing background levels for amu 18 ($H_2O$), amu 17 ($OH^+$), amu 28 ($N_2/CO$), and amu 32 ($O_2$).

4. **UHV Thermal Degas Recipe**:
   - Place wafer onto the heated substrate pedestal with radiative backside heating.
   - Ramp pedestal temperature at $15^\circ\text{C}/\text{min}$ to **$350^\circ\text{C} - 400^\circ\text{C}$** under ultra-high vacuum conditions (staying within the thermal budget of the tungsten contact and high-$\kappa$ dielectric stack).
   - Maintain isothermal plateau for **30 minutes** to desorb chemisorbed and physisorbed water molecules trapped inside the high-aspect-ratio 3D crown cavities.

5. **Moisture Desorption Dynamic Profiling & Chamber Recovery**:
   - Continuously record mass amu 18 ($H_2O$) ion current. Monitor the desorption peak during thermal ramp-up and confirm signal decay back toward baseline.
   - Once the desorption curve drops and chamber total pressure recovers to **$< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$**, deactivate heating elements.
   - Cool wafer under UHV to $< 150^\circ\text{C}$, then actuate UHV transfer robot to route wafer directly into the ALD TiN deposition chamber without atmospheric break.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                      Degas & In-Situ Baseline Metrics  
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Bitline Strapping Rs┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
  Capacitance Target┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
    Chamber Pumpdown┤▓▓                                │
                    │▓▓                                │
 H2O Desorption Peak┤████████                          │
                    │████████                          │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0      20       40      60      80 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Bayard-Alpert ion gauge / Cryopump controller |
| **Moisture Outgassing Equilibrium** | amu 18 partial pressure $< 5 \times 10^{-9}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Quadrupole RGA continuous scan |
| **Degas Thermal Soak Temperature** | $350 - 400$ ($\pm 5$) | ${^\circ}\text{C}$ | Multi-point substrate thermocouple / Pyrometry |
| **Storage Cell Target Capacitance** | $25 \text{ to } 30$ (Nominal: $\ge 28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | In-line C-V prober post-TiN ALD & metal anneal |
| **Cell Leakage Current (at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parameter analyzer (to guarantee data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
  - *Chamber Base Vacuum*: Must pump down below **$2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$** using turbomolecular or cryopump to prevent oxygen and contaminant incorporation.
  - *Thermal Process Profile*: Anneal and degas conditions set at **$400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes** ensure metallurgical and interfacial integrity.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Cell Capacitance Baseline*: Storage capacitor must maintain **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$** per cell to guarantee data retention time **$> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$**.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Geometry & Stack Budget*: Stacked crown capacitor erected over drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) with access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - *Capacitance & Leakage Limits*: Minimum **$28\text{ fF}$** per cell capacitance budget and leakage current target **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$**.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In-situ UHV thermal degas must maintain strict baseline decoupling between the loadlock, transfer chamber, and ALD TiN deposition module. Pumping down to < 5.0e-8 Torr via turbomolecular pump (TMP) backed by dry roots pumps requires continuous baseline residual gas analyzer (RGA) tracking to avoid opening slit valves while high partial pressures of desorbed H2O and hydrocarbons remain present, which would cross-contaminate downstream TiCl4/NH3 chambers and degrade baseline vacuum conductance.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Deep 3D high-aspect-ratio (HAR 15:1 to 25:1) crown capacitor cylinders act as molecular traps for physisorbed atmospheric moisture and hydroxyl terminations (-OH). Thermal degas at 250°C to 350°C under UHV is mandatory to drive out trapped water vapor prior to TiCl4 exposure; incomplete moisture desorption will trigger parasitic gas-phase reactions with TiCl4 to form TiO2 particulates and corrosive HCl, causing severe dielectric interface traps, leakage current, and electrode peeling.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specialized UHV instrumentation—specifically quadrupole mass spectrometers (RGA up to 100 amu) with open ion sources, UHV-compatible ceramic substrate heater platens, and dry scrubbed pumping sets—suffer from extended lead times (16-24 weeks). Standardization on common CF flange seals, UHV thermocouple feedthroughs, and off-the-shelf halogen heating lamps is essential to keep the open-source 180nm MPW schedule viable.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal degas cycle times directly bottleneck cluster tool throughput. A prolonged 45-minute degas sequence limits wafer output to < 6 WPH per degas station. Profiling must rigorously define the minimum thermal budget and dwell time required to achieve the critical H2O desorption knee without violating cluster tool cycle-time budgets and line yields.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal shock induced crown micro-collapse or mechanical buckling due to excessive ramp rates (> 20°C/s) across high-aspect-ratio cylindrical capacitor oxide scaffolds.
1. Precursor condensation and gas-phase nucleated TiO2 particle shower occurring in subsequent ALD steps caused by residual water vapor outgassing (m/z 18 > 1.0e-9 Torr).
1. Re-adsorption of backstreaming pump hydrocarbons and moisture during wafer transfer due to loadlock-to-transfer chamber pressure inversion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)
