Initiate data logging on RGA tracking m/z 18 (H2O), m/z 17 (OH), m/z 28 (N2/CO), and m/z 44 (CO2) at 100 ms dwell. 2. Ramp substrate temperature from 25°C to 300°C at 5°C/s using closed-loop PID control. 3. Hold thermal soak at 300°C for 10 minutes. 4. Record peak desorption temperature and track water partial pressure decay curve until equilibrium. 5. Cooldown to < 100°C under UHV prior to transfer valve interlock release. | `Peak H2O desorption (m/z 18) must drop below 5.0e-9 Torr partial pressure before 8 minutes of thermal soak at 300°C; chamber total base pressure must achieve <= 1.0e-7 Torr at end of dwell.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-2-1-02` | **Post-Degas Crown Capacitor Structural Integrity and Particle Inspection** | In-line Laser Surface Particle Defect Scanner (0.12 um threshold), High-Resolution In-Lens Field Emission SEM (FE-SEM) | 1. Transfer wafer via robotic handler directly to in-line laser particle inspection module. 2. Measure added particle count across full 200mm wafer area for particle sizes >= 0.18 um. 3. Load wafer into CD/FE-SEM to inspect 9 die locations (center, edges, mid-radius) across the high-aspect-ratio crown arrays. 4. Verify vertical sidewall perpendicularity, absence of mechanical crown buckling, top-rim bridging, or thermal collapse. | `Added surface particle count >= 0.18 um must be <= 5 particles/wafer; FE-SEM inspection must show 0% crown tilt, bending, or physical collapse across all 9 inspected sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving with heat-resistant outer layer for maintenance), UV/IR protective eye safety glasses (ANSI Z87.1 rated for thermal inspection), Full cleanroom ESD gowning with face shield during hot-zone maintenance, Thermal insulating heat-resistant gloves (rated up to 400°C for hot chamber intervention)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burn emergency: Flush affected skin immediately with copious cold sterile water for at least 15 minutes; do not apply unapproved ointments; cover with sterile dry gauze and seek immediate medical attention. Inert gas asphyxiation (N2): Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen or CPR if unconscious; call emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Chamber roughing and TMP backing lines must vent to a dedicated acid/toxic fab exhaust duct with continuous differential pressure monitoring (minimum 1.5 in-w.g. negative draft). Purge and vent gas lines must have excess flow check valves and oxygen depletion sensors installed in the tool bay.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Vacuum pump effluent must pass through an integrated point-of-use wet/thermal scrubber system equipped with automated caustic neutralization dosing (pH maintained between 6.5 and 8.5) before municipal water/air discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nitrogen (Ultra-High Purity 99.9999% purge gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 6.0 UHP | `>= 99.9999%` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (trace desorbed byproduct / scrubbed off-gas)** | `7647-01-0` | Trace Exhaust | `< 10 ppm at scrubber intake` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched/cleaned high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor silicon oxide/nitride surfaces after RCA-2/SC-2 wet clean and Marangoni drying, possessing labile hydroxyl (-OH) termination and physisorbed atmospheric moisture.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dehydroxylated, moisture-free pristine crown dielectric surface stabilized under UHV (< 1.0e-7 Torr), ready for immediate atomic layer TiCl4 chemisorption without parasitic gas-phase hydrolysis.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time causes catastrophic moisture re-absorption and native oxide regrowth within the high-aspect-ratio cylinder bottoms, causing severe TiCl4 gas-phase nucleation, haze, localized peeling of the TiN top electrode, and 100x increase in crown capacitor dielectric leakage current.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Demonstrate complete in-situ UHV thermal desorption of trapped moisture from 180nm high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor arrays, achieving partial pressure of H2O below 5.0e-9 Torr at 300°C without introducing thermal deformation or particulate contamination prior to ALD TiN deposition.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TC_CROWN_UHV_DEGAS_RGA_DESORPTION_PROFILE.csv`
- [ ] `TC_CROWN_THERMAL_STRESS_SEM_INSPECTION_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `TC_CROWN_PRE_POST_DEGAS_PARTICLE_MAP.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Residual chamber moisture partial pressure at completion of 300°C degas hold** | `3.5e-9 Torr` | <= 5.0e-9 Torr maximum limit | In-situ Quadrupole Mass Spectrometer (RGA) tracking m/z 18 signal |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Chamber baseline total pressure prior to slit-valve opening to ALD module** | `8.0e-8 Torr` | <= 1.0e-7 Torr maximum limit | Bayard-Alpert Hot Cathode Ionization Vacuum Gauge |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-degas added particle contamination (size >= 0.18 um)** | `1 particle/wafer` | <= 5 particles/wafer maximum | Automated Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanner |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit condition is satisfied when three consecutive 200mm pilot test wafers achieve H2O partial pressure <= 5.0e-9 Torr within 8 minutes of thermal soak at 300°C, zero physical crown capacitor buckling confirmed via 9-point cross-sectional FE-SEM, and added particle counts stay <= 5 particles per wafer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## TiCl4/NH3 ALD Pulse-Purge Saturation Recipe Parameter Optimization

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-ALD-TIN-180NM-001`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm CMOS DRAM)  
**Process Step:** 3D High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor ALD Metal Electrode Deposition (`TiN` Top/Plate Electrode)  
**Classification:** Leaf Industrial Standard Operating Procedure  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Load & Degas   │
│        at 400C         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

┌────────────────────────┐
│  Pulse TiCl4: 0.25 s   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼

│   Ar Purge 1: 4.0 s    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Pulse NH3: 0.40 s    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Ar Purge 2: 5.0 s    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐

             │

```

```text

 Ar Purge 1┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒        │

```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Conditioning & In-Situ Thermal Degas
1. Transfer patterned 180nm crown capacitor wafer through the vacuum load lock into the single-wafer ALD reaction chamber.
2. Pump down the reaction chamber to a base pressure $< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ via turbomolecular pump to eliminate background $O_2$ and residual atmospheric moisture.
3. Stabilize substrate stage heater to $400^\circ\text{C} \pm 5^\circ\text{C}$ under high-purity $N_2/H_2$ ($95\%/5\%$) forming gas flow at $1.0\text{ Torr}$ for $30\text{ minutes}$ to thoroughly outgas residual moisture and hydroxyl groups from the high-k crown capacitor dielectric ($Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ or $ONO$).

#### Step 2: Reaction Line & Bubbler Delivery Calibration
1. Maintain liquid $TiCl_4$ precursor canister at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ (vapor pressure $\approx 10\text{ Torr}$).
2. Heat precursor delivery lines to $120^\circ\text{C}$ to prevent precursor condensation and valve clogging.
3. Establish continuous ultra-high-purity Argon carrier gas flow ($Ar\ge 99.999\%$) through reaction manifold at $300\text{ sccm}$, maintaining chamber working process pressure between $1.0\text{ Torr}$ and $2.0\text{ Torr}$.

#### Step 3: ALD Pulse-Purge Cycle Execution (Self-Limiting Surface Saturation)
Execute automated recipe loop for each individual ALD cycle:
- **Sub-step 3A ($TiCl_4$ Precursor Pulse):** Open fast-response pneumatic injection valve for $0.25\text{ s}$ ($250\text{ ms}$) to deliver saturated chemisorbed monolayer across the high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor structures ($L=180\text{ nm}$, $W=220\text{ nm}$, pitch $360\text{--}400\text{ nm}$).
- **Sub-step 3B (Purge 1):** Sweep chamber with $Ar$ ($99.999\%$) for $4.0\text{ s}$ at $500\text{ sccm}$ to purge physisorbed excess $TiCl_4$ and desorbed $HCl$ reaction by-products.
- **Sub-step 3C ($NH_3$ Reactant Pulse):** Open $NH_3$ ($99.999\%$) gas injection valve for $0.40\text{ s}$ ($400\text{ ms}$) at $150\text{ sccm}$ to react with chemisorbed $-TiCl^*$ species, completing the nitridation to $TiN$.
- **Sub-step 3D (Purge 2):** Sweep chamber with $Ar$ ($99.999\%$) for $5.0\text{ s}$ at $500\text{ sccm}$ to exhaust residual $NH_3$ and $HCl$ / $NH_4Cl$ volatile species.

#### Step 4: Growth Rate Tracking & Thickness Termination
1. Loop Steps 3A through 3D for calibrated cycles (steady-state growth per cycle $\approx 0.22\text{ \AA/cycle}$) to achieve targeted top electrode thickness of $15.0\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ ($150\text{ \AA}$).
2. Perform post-deposition chamber evacuation to $< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ before moving wafer to cooldown station.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}$ | Max $2.0 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Bayard-Alpert Ionization Gauge |
| **High-AR Step Coverage & Conformality** | $100$ | $\ge 95$ | $\%$ | Cross-sectional STEM / HR-TEM at bottom of crown |
| **Cell Capacitance (MIM Stack)** | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0$ to $30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated Wafer Prober $C\text{--}V$ testing at $1\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Automated DC Parametric Tester |

---

### 4. Sources Cited

1. **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
   - Base pressure limit: $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ using turbomolecular or cryopump.
   - High-purity gas standard: $Ar\ 99.999\%$.
   - Thermal budget constraints: Annealing and degas regime ($N_2/H_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ minutes}$).
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - 1T1C storage capacitor target: Minimum capacitance $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ (ensuring data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
   - Crown capacitor dielectric stack: $Ta_2O_5$ / $Si_3N_4$ with $EOT \approx 3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Transistor geometry constraints: Access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Capacitance noise immunity budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$.
   - Dielectric leakage current ceiling: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In high-aspect-ratio (HAR 12:1 to 15:1) 180nm crown capacitor geometries, Knudsen diffusion governs precursor transport into the deep cylinder pores. Relying on baseline planar ALD pulse/purge timings leads to precursor starvation at the capacitor bottom or, conversely, excessive parasitic CVD re-deposition and ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) particulate generation if purge duration is insufficient to clear unreacted TiCl4 and NH3 boundary layers. The thermal budget must be strictly capped between 350°C and 400°C to prevent dielectric crystallization and interface degradation while ensuring low chlorine contamination (<1.5 at.%).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: TiCl4/NH3 surface chemisorption transitions between self-limiting ALD and decomposition regimes based on substrate temperature and exposure dosage. At 380°C, self-saturation requires an exposure dosage exceeding 1.2 x 10^5 Langmuirs at the cylinder bottom. If the NH3 purge time is truncated, residual amine groups react with incoming TiCl4 in the gas phase, forming granular, high-resistivity TiN (>200 uOhm-cm) with severe pinhole density and micro-voids, compromising the top electrode leakage current and dielectric breakdown.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade TiCl4 (CAS 7550-45-0, 5N purity) requires temperature-controlled stainless steel bubblers (maintained at 25-30°C) with heated delivery manifolds (120-140°C) to prevent line condensation and valve clogging. Ultra-high purity NH3 (CAS 7664-41-7, 6N) requires specialized point-of-use scrubbers and gas cabinets with toxic gas monitoring. Supply chain lead times for high-cycle ALD diaphragm valves (rated for >50 million cycles at 150°C) currently stand at 14-18 weeks; dual-source qualification of delivery solenoids is mandatory.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Module delivery requires freezing the recipe window within a 2-week testing sprint across a 25-wafer DOE lot. The primary risk to schedule is tool down-time resulting from exhaust foreline clogging by solid NH4Cl adducts, which requires automated heated forelines (150°C) and downstream cold-trap maintenance routines. Any process re-qualification extending beyond 15 business days directly impacts the metal-1 deposition handoff milestone.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Gas-phase parasitic CVD reaction generating solid NH4Cl salt particles and particulate contamination across the wafer (>50 particles at >0.18 um).
1. Incomplete precursor penetration into the high-aspect-ratio crown bottom, causing step coverage collapse (<85%) and capacitor leakage failure.
1. High chlorine incorporation (>2.0 at.%) in the TiN film due to low deposition temperature or incomplete NH3 surface saturation, leading to severe sheet resistance drift and aluminum metallization corrosion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-2-2-01` | **High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor TiN ALD Step Coverage and Bottom Conformal Saturation Test** | Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM, Hitachi S-4800 or equivalent) with in-situ high-resolution cross-sectional measurement; Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS/EDX). | 1. Load wafer into ALD reactor under N2 loadlock and transfer to reactor stage at 380°C. 2. Perform 5-minute pre-soak in UHP N2 flow (300 sccm). 3. Execute 350 ALD cycles with optimized pulse-purge sequence: TiCl4 pulse (0.8 s, Ar carrier 80 sccm) -> N2 purge (6.0 s, 400 sccm) -> NH3 pulse (1.2 s, 150 sccm) -> N2 purge (8.0 s, 400 sccm). 4. Measure TiN film thickness at top surface, middle sidewall, and bottom cup surface using cross-sectional FE-SEM at 100kX magnification at 9 points across the wafer. | `Target nominal TiN thickness = 15.0 nm +/- 1.0 nm. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Full face shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved) paired with chemical splash goggles, Heavyweight butyl rubber gloves (>15 mil) over nitrile inner gloves for chemical handling; cleanroom ESD nitrile for standard loading, Acid/corrosive-resistant Tychem chemical apron and full sleeve covers, Supplied-air respirator (SCBA) or NIOSH-approved combination acid gas/ammonia particulate respirator available for maintenance/line breaks
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TiCl4 reacts violently with water/moisture to form dense titanium dioxide smoke and hydrochloric acid vapor. Skin contact: Immediately drench affected area with copious amounts of running water under an emergency safety shower for at least 20 minutes; remove contaminated clothing while under the shower. Eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with gentle eyewash stream for at least 30 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate emergency ophthalmological care. Inhalation of TiCl4 hydrolysate (HCl) or NH3: Remove victim to fresh air immediately; administer oxygen if breathing is difficult; keep patient warm and resting; call 911 / emergency cleanroom response immediately. Do not apply neutralizing chemical agents to skin burns.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Chamber vacuum foreline must feature active gas abatement. Dedicated acid exhaust ducting with continuous negative pressure monitoring (>1.2 in. w.g.) interlocked to ALD gas delivery valves. Tool foreline must be heated to 150°C up to the point-of-use thermal/wet scrubber to prevent NH4Cl deposition. Room toxic gas monitoring system (TGMS) with electrochemical sensors for NH3 (alarm threshold: 25 ppm OSHA PEL, 15 ppm TLV) and optical/electrochemical detection for HCl/TiCl4 (alarm threshold: 1 ppm). Automatic emergency shutoff valves (E-stop) trigger on exhaust pressure loss or toxic gas detection.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Vacuum exhaust gases pass through a high-temperature burn/wet scrubber. Acidic effluent (HCl) is collected in an acid waste neutralization (AWN) unit where it is dosed with 20% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution to maintain discharge pH between 6.5 and 8.5. Solid NH4Cl salt captured in preventive maintenance cold-traps must be dissolved in DI water under a certified chemical fume hood, neutralized via AWN, and disposed of as regulated industrial wastewater.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride** | `7550-45-0` | Optoelectronic / Electronic Grade (5N, 99.999% metals basis) | `100%` |
| **Ammonia (Anhydrous)** | `7664-41-7` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100%` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (reaction byproduct / hydrolysate)** | `7647-01-0` | Technical / Waste effluent | `Variable (<37%)` |
| **Ammonium Chloride (sublimation solid byproduct)** | `12125-02-9` | Reaction residue / particulate | `Solid salt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pristine, degassed high-k capacitor dielectric surface (ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 nanolaminate) with zero organic residues, post-clean moisture desorbed (<1.0x10^11 atoms/cm2 hydroxyl/fluorine contamination), and pre-annealed under high vacuum.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hermetically sealed 15nm ALD TiN top electrode, uniform golden-brown metallic finish, surface chlorine passivation bonded, free of NH4Cl salt crystallites and particulate defects, ready for Top Plate CVD polysilicon or PVD Al strapping metallization.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air causes moisture chemisorption and native oxidation of the high-k dielectric, producing high interfacial trap density (Dit), uncontrolled interfacial TiO2/Zr-OH bonding, severe EOT increase (>0.3 nm), and premature dielectric breakdown under capacitor operating voltage (1.5V).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full parameter optimization and process qualification of the in-situ TiCl4/NH3 ALD pulse-purge sequence for 180nm DRAM 3D crown capacitor top metal electrode deposition. The recipe achieves complete self-limiting surface saturation at 380°C, ensuring >=92% step coverage inside 12:1 aspect ratio crown structures, low chlorine incorporation (<1.2 at.%), excellent resistivity (<=120 uOhm-cm), and zero parasitic CVD NH4Cl hazing.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TiN_ALD_Crown_StepCoverage_SEM_Analysis.pdf`
- [ ] `TiCl4_NH3_Saturation_DOE_RawData.csv`
- [ ] `TiN_Crown_Capacitor_FIB_CrossSection_100kX.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Conformal TiN bottom-to-top step coverage inside HAR (12:1) crown cylinder** | `92.0` | >= 90.0% | High-resolution cross-sectional FE-SEM at 100,000x magnification across 9 wafer points |
| `ASSERT-02` | **ALD TiN film specific electrical resistivity on thermal oxide monitor** | `115.0` | <= 120.0 uOhm-cm | 4-point probe sheet resistance measurement combined with spectroscopic ellipsometry thickness mapping |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Residual chlorine concentration in bulk ALD TiN film** | `0.95` | <= 1.20 at.% | Calibrated X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) depth profile analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Attainment of all quantitative assertions across 3 consecutive 25-wafer demonstration lots with Cpk >= 1.33 for film thickness uniformity (<1.5% 1-sigma across 200mm wafer) and step coverage >= 90%, zero toxic gas alarm events during continuous production, and full approval by Thin Film Deposition Lead and Module Systems Engineer.

critics.systems_engineer: In high-aspect-ratio (HAR 12:1 to 15:1) 180nm crown capacitor geometries, Knudsen diffusion governs precursor transport into the deep cylinder pores. Relying on baseline planar ALD pulse/purge timings leads to precursor starvation at the capacitor bottom or, conversely, excessive parasitic CVD re-deposition and ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) particulate generation if purge duration is insufficient to clear unreacted TiCl4 and NH3 boundary layers. The thermal budget must be strictly capped between 350°C and 400°C to prevent dielectric crystallization and interface degradation while ensuring low chlorine contamination (<1.5 at.%).
critics.domain_expert: TiCl4/NH3 surface chemisorption transitions between self-limiting ALD and decomposition regimes based on substrate temperature and exposure dosage. At 380°C, self-saturation requires an exposure dosage exceeding 1.2 x 10^5 Langmuirs at the cylinder bottom. If the NH3 purge time is truncated, residual amine groups react with incoming TiCl4 in the gas phase, forming granular, high-resistivity TiN (>200 uOhm-cm) with severe pinhole density and micro-voids, compromising the top electrode leakage current and dielectric breakdown.
critics.supply_chain: Electronic-grade TiCl4 (CAS 7550-45-0, 5N purity) requires temperature-controlled stainless steel bubblers (maintained at 25-30°C) with heated delivery manifolds (120-140°C) to prevent line condensation and valve clogging. Ultra-high purity NH3 (CAS 7664-41-7, 6N) requires specialized point-of-use scrubbers and gas cabinets with toxic gas monitoring. Supply chain lead times for high-cycle ALD diaphragm valves (rated for >50 million cycles at 150°C) currently stand at 14-18 weeks; dual-source qualification of delivery solenoids is mandatory.
critics.laya_pm: Module delivery requires freezing the recipe window within a 2-week testing sprint across a 25-wafer DOE lot. The primary risk to schedule is tool down-time resulting from exhaust foreline clogging by solid NH4Cl adducts, which requires automated heated forelines (150°C) and downstream cold-trap maintenance routines. Any process re-qualification extending beyond 15 business days directly impacts the metal-1 deposition handoff milestone.
critical_failure_modes: Gas-phase parasitic CVD reaction generating solid NH4Cl salt particles and particulate contamination across the wafer (>50 particles at >0.18 um).
Incomplete precursor penetration into the high-aspect-ratio crown bottom, causing step coverage collapse (<85%) and capacitor leakage failure.

High chlorine incorporation (>2.0 at.%) in the TiN film due to low deposition temperature or incomplete NH3 surface saturation, leading to severe sheet resistance drift and aluminum metallization corrosion.

testcases.title: High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor TiN ALD Step Coverage and Bottom Conformal Saturation Test
testcases.instrumentation: Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM, Hitachi S-4800 or equivalent) with in-situ high-resolution cross-sectional measurement; Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS/EDX).
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm patterned crown capacitor test wafers (aspect ratio 12:1, depth 1.2 um, diameter 100 nm) with intact ALD Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack; ALD chamber pre-conditioned with 50 dummy cycles; baseline vacuum < 1x10^-6 Torr; chuck temperature stabilized at 380°C +/- 1.0°C; bubbler temperature at 30°C.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer into ALD reactor under N2 loadlock and transfer to reactor stage at 380°C.
2. Perform 5-minute pre-soak in UHP N2 flow (300 sccm).
3. Execute 350 ALD cycles with optimized pulse-purge sequence: TiCl4 pulse (0.8 s, Ar carrier 80 sccm) -> N2 purge (6.0 s, 400 sccm) -> NH3 pulse (1.2 s, 150 sccm) -> N2 purge (8.0 s, 400 sccm).
4. Unload wafer to cooling station under N2 flow.
5. Cleave wafer across center and edge dies; prepare cross-sections via focused ion beam (FIB).
6. Measure TiN film thickness at top surface, middle sidewall, and bottom cup surface using cross-sectional FE-SEM at 100kX magnification at 9 points across the wafer.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Target nominal TiN thickness = 15.0 nm +/- 1.0 nm. Step coverage (Bottom Thickness / Top Thickness) >= 92% across all 9 measurement dies. Bottom thickness must be >= 13.8 nm. No peeling, delamination, or void formation visible under SEM.

testcases.title: TiN Film Resistivity, Chlorine Content, and Precursor Saturation Plateau Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Four-Point Probe (4PP, KLA Tencor OmniMap or CDE ResMap 178); X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS, Physical Electronics VersaProbe III) with depth profiling.
testcases.pre_conditions: Blanket monitor wafers (200mm Si with 100nm thermal oxide); ALD reactor stabilized at 380°C; precursor delivery lines heated to 135°C; reactor base pressure verified at < 5x10^-7 Torr.
testcases.procedure:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Aspect-Ratio Crown TiN Conformality Metrology & Resistance Inspection
**Node**: Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM) | **Architecture**: 8F²/6F² Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) | **Action Type**: Buy / Quality Buyoff

---

### Process Workflow
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│        Pre-Scan        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Cross-Section      │
│       TEM/SEM &        │
│      Ellipsometry      │
│      Conformality      │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  4-Point Probe Kelvin  │
│   Sheet Resistance &   │
│   Contact Resistance   │
│       Inspection       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Statistical Process   │
│  Control & Lot Buyoff  │
│          Gate          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Baseline Reference Metrics
```text
                       Capacitor Baseline Targets       
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░                                   │
        EOT (nm)┤░░░                                   │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                            │
    Dielectric k┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                            │
  Retention (ms)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Capacitance (fF)┤█████████████████                     │
                │█████████████████                     │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       16        32       48       64 
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Alignment & Non-Destructive Planar Metrology**:
   - Transfer production and witness test wafers from FOUP to the spectroscopic ellipsometry/reflectometry stage under cleanroom class 1 conditions.
   - Measure planar TiN film thickness across a 49-point wafer map on dedicated flat scribe-line test pads. Confirm uniform target baseline thickness within ±5%.

2. **High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Cross-Sectional TEM/SEM Sampling**:
   - Prepare focused ion beam (FIB) cross-section lamellae cut across the bitline and wordline pitch (360 nm to 400 nm) exposing crown capacitor structures erected above the tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Perform High-Resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy (HR-TEM) or high-voltage CD-SEM imaging at three critical crown capacitor locations:
     - Top lip ($t_{\text{top}}$)
     - Middle sidewall ($t_{\text{mid}}$)
     - Bottom crown base / corner adjacent to the W-plug interface ($t_{\text{bottom}}$)
   - Calculate film step coverage:
     $$\text{Conformality} = \frac{t_{\text{bottom}}}{t_{\text{top}}} \times 100\%$$

3. **In-Line Electrical Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) & Contact Resistance ($R_c$) Measurement**:
   - Transfer wafer to an automated four-point Kelvin probe test station.
   - Measure sheet resistance ($R_s$) across Kelvin cross-bridge structures on test dies.
   - Measure contact chain resistance across W-plug/TiN interfaces over access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) to verify absence of excessive interfacial oxide or unreacted precursor residues.

4. **Dielectric Stack & Capacitance Integration Confirmation**:
   - Verify post-electrode dielectric stack integrity with high-$k$ layer ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or ONO) to ensure physical EOT remains within 3 to 4 nm with effective $\kappa > 15$.
   - Route wafer to C-V prober and test cell array test structures at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to ensure retention and noise-immunity targets are met before releasing to metallization interconnect steps.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Crown Sidewall & Bottom Step Coverage (Conformality)** | $\ge 95\%$ ($t_{\text{bottom}} / t_{\text{top}} \ge 0.95$) | $\%$ | Cross-Section HR-TEM / FIB-SEM |
| **Crown Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (Window: $25\text{ -- }30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated LCR / C-V Prober @ $1\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ (Retention $> 64$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ ($\text{ms}$) | Sub-pA Parametric Analyzer @ $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ -- }4.0$ ($\kappa > 15$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & C-V Profiling |

---

### Literature Citations & Physical Context
- **[Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Mandates minimum storage capacitance of **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$** to guarantee retention time **$> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$**, with stacked crown dielectric EOT maintained at **$3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$**, and bitline/wordline pitch at **$360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$**.
- **[Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Specifies access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), crown stacked capacitor erected above drain contact via W-plug, dielectric stack with effective **$\kappa > 15$**, target minimum capacitance of **$28\text{ fF/cell}$**, and junction/cell leakage ceiling of **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$**.
- **[Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects]**: Establishes downstream metallization boundary parameters and reference sheet resistance guidelines for interconnect integration.

---
*Micro-knowledge entry persisted in [docs/knowledge/tin_conformality_metrology.md](./docs/knowledge/tin_conformality_metrology.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Measuring TiN film conformality inside high-aspect-ratio (HAR 12:1 to 15:1) 180nm crown structures purely via top-down spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) is physically impossible due to optical shadowing, non-specular scattering, and effective medium approximation breakdowns within 3D cylinders. Inline non-destructive metrology must combine planar monitor SE dispersion calibration (Drude-Lorentz optical model for metallic TiN) with cross-sectional high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) or focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy (FIB-SEM) alongside dedicated 4-terminal Kelvin resistance test structures (crown bottom-to-top continuity).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: ALD TiN deposited via TiCl4 and NH3 at 350-400°C exhibits chlorine incorporation (typically 1.5-3.0 at.%) and density gradients down deep crown sidewalls if precursor purging and exposure times are marginal. A step coverage / conformality metric below 95% at the crown bottom results in localized sheet resistance spiking (>120 Ohm/sq) and vulnerability to contact over-etch punchthrough during downstream tungsten plug integration. Metrology must verify that bottom-to-top thickness ratio (t_bottom / t_top) exceeds 0.95 and resistivity stays below 180 uOhm-cm across the entire 3D node cavity.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Destructive cross-sectional TEM preparation (FIB lamella lift-out) incurs extreme cycle-time overhead ($450-$700/sample and >8 hours turnaround) which threatens the MPW fast-prototyping cadence. The metrology flow must qualify non-destructive X-ray fluorescence (micro-XRF) with capillary optics or automated picosecond ultrasonic laser acoustics as reliable inline proxies for TiN mass thickness, reserving destructive TEM sampling strictly for lot-level qualification and baseline calibration.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Failure to bound inspection turnaround within a strict 60-minute window will violate the downstream inter-metal dielectric / plate contact ALD queue-time. TiN oxidizes rapidly into non-stoichiometric TiO_xN_y in ambient air, shifting sheet resistance and invalidating Kelvin electrical measurements. Metrology automation must execute within 45 minutes of chamber unload or mandate nitrogen-purged FOUP transit.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Keyhole pinch-off at crown neck causing incomplete TiCl4 precursor diffusion and severe bottom sidewall thickness thinning (<70% conformality)
1. Uncontrolled ambient air oxidation of fresh ALD TiN resulting in native TiO2 surface formation and false-positive sheet resistance failure (>250 Ohm/sq)
1. FIB beam-induced damage or curtaining during cross-sectional lamella prep leading to artificial geometric distortion and inaccurate TEM thickness readings

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-2-3-01` | **Cross-Sectional HR-TEM 3D Crown TiN Thickness and Conformality Step-Coverage Verification** | DualBeam FIB-SEM (FEI Helios NanoLab 650) for in-situ Ga+ lamella lift-out, followed by 200kV Field Emission HR-TEM (FEI Talos F200X) equipped with Super-X EDS detector. | 1. Locate target 180nm crown capacitor test matrix using FIB electron beam imaging at 2kV/50pA to prevent resist/film charging. 2. Deposition of 200nm in-situ electron-beam Pt followed by 2.0um ion-beam Pt protective strap across crown array. 3. Perform trench milling using Ga+ beam at 30kV, 9nA down to crown bottom level; step down current to 0.79nA for undercut and lift-out needle extraction. 4. Mount lamella onto standard Cu Omniprobe grid; perform precision thinning with 5kV/40pA Ga+ and final polish at 2kV/16pA to achieve uniform ~40nm membrane thickness. 5. Load grid into HR-TEM at 200kV; calibrate magnification against Si lattice fringe spacing (0.314 nm). 6. - **Hazard Classification**: `High`

Metrology must verify that bottom-to-top thickness ratio (t_bottom / t_top) exceeds 0.95 and resistivity stays below 180 uOhm-cm across the entire 3D node cavity.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Crown Sidewall Conformal TiN Coverage Metrology and Interfacial Carbon/Chlorine X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) Inspection

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Measuring thin TiN films inside high-aspect-ratio (HAR) 180nm crown capacitor cylinders (aspect ratio ~15:1 to 20:1) with standard optical reflectometry or spectroscopic ellipsometry hits fundamental diffraction and beam-spot limits (>25 um beam spot averaging over dense arrays). Angle-resolved or small-spot micro-ellipsometry on dedicated witness test pads combined with calibrated inline cross-sectional HR-SEM/TEM step coverage calibration is required to decouple sidewall attenuation from top-planar film thickness.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: ALD TiN from TiCl4 and NH3 precursors at 400-450C inherently risks trapping residual chlorine (<1.5 at.%) and carbon contaminants at the TiN/high-k interface, directly inducing dielectric leakage and Vth shift. Destructive Angle-Resolved X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (AR-XPS) or depth-profiling XPS must be performed on coupon witness dice within an ultra-high vacuum transfer module or immediately post-cleave to avoid environmental oxidation (TiO2 conversion) masking genuine interfacial stoichiometry.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Monochromatic Al Ka XPS analytical equipment time and automated wafer-scale metrology slots represent severe queue bottlenecks for an open-source MPW run. Dual-sourcing analytical runs between primary domestic lab facilities and regional commercial analytical services requires standardized UHV sample packaging protocols and sealed N2 purge transit canisters to preserve unoxidized TiN interfaces.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Balancing research budget and tapeout milestones dictates that XPS chemical profiling cannot be run on every full production wafer. Process qualification must leverage a 1-in-25 wafer sampling plan on sacrificial coupon scribe lines, while using non-destructive 4-point probe sheet resistance (Rs) wafer mapping and spectroscopic reflectometry as daily line-yield gating monitors.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete ALD precursor purge leading to localized TiCl4 gas condensation and severe chlorine contamination (>2.5 at.% Cl) at the bottom crown corner, causing catastrophic capacitor leakage and electrode delamination.
1. Atmospheric post-deposition queue-time excursion exceeding limit, causing uncontrolled surface oxidation of TiN to TiO2/TiOxNy and distorting XPS core-level spectra (Ti 2p, O 1s) interpretations.
1. Severe sidewall conformality pinch-off at crown rim leading to sub-50% thickness coverage at the bottom cylinder floor, causing open-circuit node contact and capacitance degradation below target specification.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-01` | **Crown Bottom/Top Sidewall TiN Step Coverage and Conformality Metrology** | Focused Ion Beam High-Resolution Scanning Electron Microscope (FIB-HRSEM, 30kV Ga+ liquid metal ion source, in-lens SE detector) and Multi-Angle Micro-Spot Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE, 190-1000 nm, 30 um spot size) | 1. Load wafer into automated micro-spot spectroscopic ellipsometer; align beam to 100 um x 100 um planar witness pad and acquire Psi/Delta spectra from 250 nm to 850 nm to extract baseline planar thickness (t_top). 2. Transfer coupon/witness wafer to dual-beam FIB-SEM chamber; pump down to < 5e-6 mbar. 3. Deposit protective Pt/C strap (1 um thick) over three selected crown capacitor array cells (wafer center, middle radius, wafer edge). 4. Mill cross-sectional trench across crown capacitor structures using 30 kV / 300 pA Ga+ ion beam; perform fine polish cut at 5 kV / 48 pA. 5. Acquire high-magnification (200,000x) in-lens secondary electron micrographs of the crown rim (t_rim), center sidewall (t_mid), and bottom corner/floor (t_bot). 6. Measure physical thickness across 5 equidistant points along the vertical sidewall profile and calculate conformality ratio: (t_bot / t_top) * 100%. | `Planar TiN thickness must be 15.0 nm +/- 1.0 nm. Crown bottom-to-top sidewall conformality ratio (t_bot / t_top) must be >= 85.0% across all measured sites with zero visible pinch-off voids or structural delamination.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-02` | **Interfacial Chlorine and Carbon Quantification via High-Resolution Depth-Profiling XPS** | Monochromatic Al Ka X-Ray Photoelectron Spectrometer (XPS, hv = 1486.6 eV, hemispherical analyzer, 200 um analysis spot, Mono-atomic Ar+ ion sputter gun) | 1. Align sample under Al Ka X-ray beam spot (100 W, 15 kV) on planar TiN/dielectric stack witness region. 2. Acquire survey spectrum (0-1200 eV pass energy 160 eV, step size 1.0 eV) to confirm elemental presence of Ti, N, O, C, Cl, and underlying substrate elements. 3. Initiate gentle Ar+ ion beam depth profiling (beam energy 1 keV, raster 2 mm x 2 mm) calibrated against standard Ta2O5 / SiO2 etch rates (target ~1.2 nm/min). 4. After each 15-second sputter cycle, acquire high-resolution core-level scans for Ti 2p (450-470 eV), N 1s (392-404 eV), C 1s (280-292 eV), Cl 2p (194-206 eV), and O 1s (526-538 eV) at 20 eV pass energy, 0.05 eV step size. 5. Sputter through the full TiN layer and across the interfacial transition zone into the underlying crown dielectric layer. 6. Integrate peak areas using Shirley background subtraction and apply calibrated Scofield relative sensitivity factors to extract atomic concentration profiles as a function of depth. | `Bulk and interfacial Chlorine (Cl 2p) concentration must be <= 1.2 at.%; bulk Carbon (C 1s) concentration must be <= 1.0 at.%; Ti:N stoichiometric ratio in bulk film must remain between 0.98 and 1.05.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol), Chemical-resistant neoprene outer gloves for wet maintenance/coupon prep, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact splash safety goggles, Full cleanroom bunny suit with integrated face shield, Class 100 cleanroom particulate mask or half-face respirator with acid gas/organic vapor cartridge during precursor/vent scrubber handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with residual acidic byproducts or TiCl4 hydrolyzed residues: flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes, then apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel if fluoride/acid cross-exposure is suspected. For inhalation: remove victim to fresh air immediately, administer oxygen if breathing is labored, and obtain immediate medical assistance. For eye contact: flush eyes using emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: XPS loadlock degas line, FIB vacuum chamber roughing exhaust, and ALD transfer module forelines must be hard-ducted directly to dedicated house acid-gas scrubbers with continuous differential pressure monitoring (>1.5 in. w.g. negative draw). Continuous toxic gas detection system (TGDS) interlocked to auto-shutoff valves required for Cl2, HCl, and NH3.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhaust condensate traps and solvent wipe waste must be collected in designated sealed HDPE hazmat drums. Acidic wastewater from scrubbers neutralized with 10% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) or sodium bicarbonate slurry to reach pH 6.8-8.2 prior to licensed hazardous industrial wastewater effluent discharge.

| **Argon (sputter / loadlock gas)** | `7440-37-1` | Research Grade 99.9999% | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN metal electrode on crown high-k dielectric, pristine, unpassivated, kept at <100C in inert vacuum or N2 transfer pod.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: FIB-inspected coupon diced; XPS characterized surface verified; sample returned to hermetic N2-purged desiccant cabinet or released to post-metal dielectric cap deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture hydrolyzes residual surface Ti-Cl bonds creating volatile HCl micro-pitting, while ambient oxygen rapidly forms a 1.5-2.5 nm native TiOxNy/TiO2 passivating layer that irreversibly skews XPS chemical shift deconvolution and degrades contact resistance (Rc) by >300%.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **ALD TiN film bottom-to-top sidewall conformality ratio across 180nm crown cylinder** | `90.0%` | >= 85.0% | FIB-HRSEM calibrated cross-sectional image analysis across 3 array test sites |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum residual interfacial chlorine (Cl 2p) atomic concentration** | `0.8 at.%` | <= 1.2 at.% | Monochromatic Al Ka XPS depth-profiling integrated peak analysis |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Ti:N stoichiometric bulk elemental ratio** | `1.01` | +/- 0.04 | High-resolution core-level XPS Ti 2p and N 1s spectral deconvolution |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Simultaneous validation of >=85% sidewall conformality on FIB cross-sections, interfacial Cl <1.2 at.%, C <1.0 at.%, and baseline planar sheet resistance within 120-160 ohm/sq, formally signed off by Nanofabrication Metrology Lead and DRAM Systems Engineer.

critics.systems_engineer: Measuring thin TiN films inside high-aspect-ratio (HAR) 180nm crown capacitor cylinders (aspect ratio ~15:1 to 20:1) with standard optical reflectometry or spectroscopic ellipsometry hits fundamental diffraction and beam-spot limits (>25 um beam spot averaging over dense arrays). Angle-resolved or small-spot micro-ellipsometry on dedicated witness test pads combined with calibrated inline cross-sectional HR-SEM/TEM step coverage calibration is required to decouple sidewall attenuation from top-planar film thickness.
critics.domain_expert: ALD TiN from TiCl4 and NH3 precursors at 400-450C inherently risks trapping residual chlorine (<1.5 at.%) and carbon contaminants at the TiN/high-k interface, directly inducing dielectric leakage and Vth shift. Destructive Angle-Resolved X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (AR-XPS) or depth-profiling XPS must be performed on coupon witness dice within an ultra-high vacuum transfer module or immediately post-cleave to avoid environmental oxidation (TiO2 conversion) masking genuine interfacial stoichiometry.
critics.supply_chain: Monochromatic Al Ka XPS analytical equipment time and automated wafer-scale metrology slots represent severe queue bottlenecks for an open-source MPW run. Dual-sourcing analytical runs between primary domestic lab facilities and regional commercial analytical services requires standardized UHV sample packaging protocols and sealed N2 purge transit canisters to preserve unoxidized TiN interfaces.
critics.laya_pm: Balancing research budget and tapeout milestones dictates that XPS chemical profiling cannot be run on every full production wafer. Process qualification must leverage a 1-in-25 wafer sampling plan on sacrificial coupon scribe lines, while using non-destructive 4-point probe sheet resistance (Rs) wafer mapping and spectroscopic reflectometry as daily line-yield gating monitors.
critical_failure_modes: Incomplete ALD precursor purge leading to localized TiCl4 gas condensation and severe chlorine contamination (>2.5 at.% Cl) at the bottom crown corner, causing catastrophic capacitor leakage and electrode delamination.
Atmospheric post-deposition queue-time excursion exceeding limit, causing uncontrolled surface oxidation of TiN to TiO2/TiOxNy and distorting XPS core-level spectra (Ti 2p, O 1s) interpretations.

Severe sidewall conformality pinch-off at crown rim leading to sub-50% thickness coverage at the bottom cylinder floor, causing open-circuit node contact and capacitance degradation below target specification.

testcases.title: Crown Bottom/Top Sidewall TiN Step Coverage and Conformality Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Focused Ion Beam High-Resolution Scanning Electron Microscope (FIB-HRSEM, 30kV Ga+ liquid metal ion source, in-lens SE detector) and Multi-Angle Micro-Spot Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE, 190-1000 nm, 30 um spot size)
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer has completed ALD TiN deposition (target 15 nm nominal planar), cooled to room temperature under N2 purge, and inspected for macro defectivity; dedicated crown test macro array (50 um x 50 um) verified intact.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer into automated micro-spot spectroscopic ellipsometer; align beam to 100 um x 100 um planar witness pad and acquire Psi/Delta spectra from 250 nm to 850 nm to extract baseline planar thickness (t_top).
2. Transfer coupon/witness wafer to dual-beam FIB-SEM chamber; pump down to < 5e-6 mbar.
3. Deposit protective Pt/C strap (1 um thick) over three selected crown capacitor array cells (wafer center, middle radius, wafer edge).
4. Mill cross-sectional trench across crown capacitor structures using 30 kV / 300 pA Ga+ ion beam; perform fine polish cut at 5 kV / 48 pA.
5. Acquire high-magnification (200,000x) in-lens secondary electron micrographs of the crown rim (t_rim), center sidewall (t_mid), and bottom corner/floor (t_bot).
6. Measure physical thickness across 5 equidistant points along the vertical sidewall profile and calculate conformality ratio: (t_bot / t_top) * 100%.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Planar TiN thickness must be 15.0 nm +/- 1.0 nm. Crown bottom-to-top sidewall conformality ratio (t_bot / t_top) must be >= 85.0% across all measured sites with zero visible pinch-off voids or structural delamination.

testcases.title: Interfacial Chlorine and Carbon Quantification via High-Resolution Depth-Profiling XPS
testcases.instrumentation: Monochromatic Al Ka X-Ray Photoelectron Spectrometer (XPS, hv = 1486.6 eV, hemispherical analyzer, 200 um analysis spot, Mono-atomic Ar+ ion sputter gun)
testcases.pre_conditions: Sample diced from designated witness site; loaded into XPS loadlock within 30 minutes of N2 transport seal break; chamber vacuum base pressure < 2e-9 mbar; flood gun charge neutralizer calibrated.
testcases.procedure:
1. Align sample under Al Ka X-ray beam spot (100 W, 15 kV) on planar TiN/dielectric stack witness region.
2. Acquire survey spectrum (0-1200 eV pass energy 160 eV, step size 1.0 eV) to confirm elemental presence of Ti, N, O, C, Cl, and underlying substrate elements.
3. Initiate gentle Ar+ ion beam depth profiling (beam energy 1 keV, raster 2 mm x 2 mm) calibrated against standard Ta2O5 / SiO2 etch rates (target ~1.2 nm/min).
4. After each 15-second sputter cycle, acquire high-resolution core-level scans for Ti 2p (450-470 eV), N 1s (392-404 eV), C 1s (280-292 eV), Cl 2p (194-206 eV), and O 1s (526-538 eV) at 20 eV pass energy, 0.05 eV step size.
5. Sputter through the full TiN layer and across the interfacial transition zone into the underlying crown dielectric layer.
6. Integrate peak areas using Shirley background subtraction and apply calibrated Scofield relative sensitivity factors to extract atomic concentration profiles as a function of depth.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Bulk and interfacial Chlorine (Cl 2p) concentration must be <= 1.2 at.%; bulk Carbon (C 1s) concentration must be <= 1.0 at.%; Ti:N stoichiometric ratio in bulk film must remain between 0.98 and 1.05.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol)
Chemical-resistant neoprene outer gloves for wet maintenance/coupon prep
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact splash safety goggles
Full cleanroom bunny suit with integrated face shield
Class 100 cleanroom particulate mask or half-face respirator with acid gas/organic vapor cartridge during precursor/vent scrubber handling
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of skin contact with residual acidic byproducts or TiCl4 hydrolyzed residues: flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes, then apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel if fluoride/acid cross-exposure is suspected. For inhalation: remove victim to fresh air immediately, administer oxygen if breathing is labored, and obtain immediate medical assistance. For eye contact: flush eyes using emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: XPS loadlock degas line, FIB vacuum chamber roughing exhaust, and ALD transfer module forelines must be hard-ducted directly to dedicated house acid-gas scrubbers with continuous differential pressure monitoring (>1.5 in. w.g. negative draw). Continuous toxic gas detection system (TGDS) interlocked to auto-shutoff valves required for Cl2, HCl, and NH3.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Exhaust condensate traps and solvent wipe waste must be collected in designated sealed HDPE hazmat drums. Acidic wastewater from scrubbers neutralized with 10% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) or sodium bicarbonate slurry to reach pH 6.8-8.2 prior to licensed hazardous industrial wastewater effluent discharge.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly deposited ALD TiN metal electrode on crown high-k dielectric, pristine, unpassivated, kept at <100C in inert vacuum or N2 transfer pod.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: FIB-inspected coupon diced; XPS characterized surface verified; sample returned to hermetic N2-purged desiccant cabinet or released to post-metal dielectric cap deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Atmospheric moisture hydrolyzes residual surface Ti-Cl bonds creating volatile HCl micro-pitting, while ambient oxygen rapidly forms a 1.5-2.5 nm native TiOxNy/TiO2 passivating layer that irreversibly skews XPS chemical shift deconvolution and degrades contact resistance (Rc) by >300%.

expected_result.summary: Complete metrology qualification of ALD TiN top electrode inside 180nm crown capacitor cylinders, establishing cross-sectional sidewall step coverage >=85% and confirming sub-1.2 at.% chlorine and sub-1.0 at.% carbon interfacial chemical purity via calibrated AR-XPS/depth profiling.

quantitative_assertions.verification_method: FIB-HRSEM calibrated cross-sectional image analysis across 3 array test sites

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum residual interfacial chlorine (Cl 2p) atomic concentration

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Ti:N stoichiometric bulk elemental ratio

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Cross-Sectional FIB Sample Preparation

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-FIB-180NM-003`  
**Process Step:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Metrology > High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Cross-Sectional FIB Sample Preparation  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Technology Node:** Gen 3 (180nm CMOS / Stacked Crown 1T1C Memory Array)  
**Knowledge Record:** [sop_fib_crown_sample_prep.md](./docs/sop_fib_crown_sample_prep.md)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

The dual-beam (Ga⁺ FIB / Field-Emission SEM) cross-sectional lamella preparation workflow for High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) 180nm crown capacitor memory arrays:

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wafer Inspection &   │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Protective e-Beam &   │
│   Ga+ Pt Deposition    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Bulk Trenching &    │
│    Lamella Cut-out     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Omniprobe Lift-Out &  │
│     Grid Mounting      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Multi-Stage Ga+     │
│    Low-kV Polish &     │
│         Clean          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Chamber Vacuum & Array Target Alignment
1. Load the 180nm DRAM coupon or wafer piece into the dual-beam FIB-SEM chamber. Pump down to base chamber vacuum $\le 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$.
2. Align the array orientation using the FE-SEM: locate the dense $8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline capacitor array with bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$. Tilt the stage to eucentric height at $52.0^\circ$ relative to the ion optical column.

#### Step 2: Protective Cap Deposition (Anti-Curtaining Buffer)
1. **e-Beam Protective Buffer:** Insert the organometallic Platinum (Pt) Gas Injection System (GIS) needle ($100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ stand-off). Perform electron-beam-induced deposition (EBID) at $2.0\text{ kV}$, $0.4\text{ nA}$ over a $15\text{ }\mu\text{m} \times 2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ area to deposit an initial non-damaging $300\text{ nm}$ Pt seed layer directly over the crown tips and ALD TiN top electrode.
2. **Ion-Beam Protective Cap:** Switch to Ga⁺ ion-beam-induced deposition (IBID) at $30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{ pA}$ to build a robust protective cap reaching a total thickness of $2.5\text{ }\mu\text{m} \pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.

#### Step 3: Bulk Milling & Undercut
1. **Front and Back Bulk Trenching:** Mill bulk relief trenches on both sides of the capped strap using regular cross-section (Si sputter rates) at $30\text{ kV}$, $7.0\text{ nA}$ stepping down to $1.0\text{ nA}$, cutting down past the crown bottom, tungsten contact plug (W-plug), and access transistor channel ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
2. **Side and Bottom Relief Cut:** Tilt stage to $0.0^\circ$ (perpendicular to FIB at $52^\circ$ tilt angle). Perform bottom undercut at $30\text{ kV}$, $0.5\text{ nA}$, leaving a $1.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ structural support tab on one side.

#### Step 4: In-Situ Micro-Manipulator Lift-Out & Post Mount
1. Insert the Omniprobe micro-manipulator needle and contact the lamella edge. Tack-weld needle to lamella using ion-beam Pt deposition ($30\text{ kV}$, $30\text{ pA}$, $30\text{ s}$).
2. Cut the remaining holding tab at $30\text{ kV}$, $0.3\text{ nA}$. Retract the needle with lamella and translate to the multi-finger Cu/Mo TEM half-grid.
3. Position the lamella against a grid finger post. Weld both ends to the post using Ga⁺ Pt ($30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{ pA}$). Sputter-cut the needle tip at $30\text{ kV}$, $0.5\text{ nA}$ and retract the Omniprobe.

#### Step 5: Multi-Step Progressive Thinning & Low-kV Polish
1. **Coarse Thinning:** Mill both faces at stage tilts of $\pm 54.0^\circ$ ($\pm 2.0^\circ$ glancing over-tilt) at $30\text{ kV}$, $300\text{ pA}$ down to lamella thickness $\approx 350\text{ nm}$.
2. **Medium Thinning:** Adjust tilt to $\pm 53.5^\circ$ ($\pm 1.5^\circ$ over-tilt) at $16\text{ kV}$, $100\text{ pA}$ down to lamella thickness $\approx 150\text{ nm}$.
3. **Fine Thinning:** Adjust tilt to $\pm 53.0^\circ$ ($\pm 1.0^\circ$ over-tilt) at $5\text{ kV}$, $40\text{ pA}$ down to lamella thickness $\approx 70\text{ nm}$.
4. **Final Low-Damage Polish:** Mill at $2\text{ kV}$, $20\text{ pA}$ glancing beam ($\pm 55.0^\circ$, $\pm 3.0^\circ$ over-tilt) for $60\text{ s}$ per side to strip Ga⁺ ion implantation amorphization layers from the TiN electrode and dielectric sidewalls.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                                                        
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░                                  │
Grid Tilt Err (deg)┤░                                  │
                   │▒▒                                 │
 Amorph Damage (nm)┤▒▒                                 │
  Pt Cap Thick (um)┤▓▓▓                                │
                   │▓▓▓                                │
 Lamella Thick (nm)┤███████████████████████████████████│
                   │███████████████████████████████████│
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0     12.5    25.0     37.5   50.0 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Bound | Physical Units | Verification Tool & Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Electron-Transparent Lamella Thickness** | $45.0$ | $\le 50.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-situ low-kV STEM detector / EELS zero-loss peak ratio ($t/\lambda \le 0.5$) |
| **Protective Pt Cap Thickness** | $2.5$ | $\pm 0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Calibrated FE-SEM cross-sectional measurement |
| **Sidewall Ga⁺ Amorphization Layer Damage** | $1.8$ | $\le 2.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | High-Resolution TEM (HRTEM) lattice fringe imaging at Si/SiO₂ interface |
| **Crown Specimen Pitch Alignment Tilt Error** | $0.2$ | $\le 0.5$ | $\text{deg}$ | Cross-beam eucentric stage angle encoder relative to array normal ($360\text{ - }400\text{ nm}$ pitch) |

---

### 4. Context Source Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Validates the target stacked capacitor topology over tungsten drain contact plug (W-plug), access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), high-k dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$, e.g., $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or $\text{ONO}$), and minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ requiring intact physical height and sidewall profile preservation during milling.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Corroborates the $1\text{T}1\text{C}$ architecture with $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell layout, array bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$, high-k equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3 - 4\text{ nm}$, and gate physical oxide thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ used for setting beam alignment tolerances and avoiding lamella bend deformation.
- **Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
  - Grounds vacuum operational thresholds (base chamber pressure $\le 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$) to inhibit surface oxidation or contaminant redeposition during ion beam milling and gas injection capping.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-beam FIB/SEM preparation of 180nm Gen 3 high-aspect-ratio (HAR ~15:1 to 20:1) crown capacitors requires strict structural preservation during cross-sectioning. Primary systemic vulnerability is beam-induced curtaining across alternating material interfaces (Pt/C strap, ALD TiN, high-k dielectric, and polysilicon bottom electrode) due to differential sputter rates. An electron-beam-assisted protective cap must precede high-current Ga+ deposition to prevent top crown distortion and surface sputtering artifact propagation into downstream metrology planes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct Ga+ focused ion beam milling of ultra-thin ALD TiN electrodes (~10-15 nm) causes severe ion beam amorphization, Ga+ implantation (forming unwanted Ga-Ti-N intermetallic damage layers up to 8 nm thick), and void smearing inside deep capacitor hollows. Final thinning must drop to low acceleration voltages (5 kV down to 1-2 kV) with glancing incidence (<2°) to preserve TiN crystal lattice fringes and enable valid HR-TEM/STEM sidewall coverage and XPS correlative analysis.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-source reliance on organometallic precursor gas injection cartridges (e.g., GIS (CH3)3Pt(CpCH3) trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum and W(CO)6) and liquid metal ion sources (LMIS Ga alloy tips) introduces lead-time risks exceeding 16 weeks in open-hardware fab setups. Standardized GIS cartridge rebuilds and dual-source Ga/Xe-plasma FIB compatibility matrices must be budgeted to prevent line stoppages.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: FIB sample preparation sits on the critical path between ALD chamber qualification and TEM/XPS physical parameter signoff. Lamella prep yield is historically sub-65% for unautomated HAR capacitor targets, creating throughput bottlenecks. Implementation of automated fiducial-guided drift-compensated trench milling and standardized lift-out milestones is mandatory to ensure turnaround times stay under 4 hours per specimen.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Curtaining effect during Ga+ ion milling causing false-positive crown sidewall thickness variations and step-coverage measurement distortions.
1. Mechanical rupture and collapse of unsupported 15:1 HAR hollow cylindrical crown walls during lamella thinning below 50 nm.
1. Heavy Ga+ ion implantation and surface oxidation artifacts masking true ALD interfacial chlorine and carbon contaminant concentrations during downstream XPS/EDX inspections.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-1-01` | **Dual-Beam Cap Deposition & Trench Milling Fiducial Accuracy Test** | Dual-Beam FIB/SEM System (Ga+ LMIS & FE-SEM) equipped with GIS Platinum precursor and high-precision 5-axis piezo stage | 1. Locate target crown array using SEM at 2 kV. 2. Deposit electron-beam-assisted Pt cap (1 kV, 400 pA) to 200 nm thickness. 3. Deposit ion-beam-assisted Pt strap (30 kV, 80 pA) to 1.5 µm thickness over 15 µm x 2 µm window. 4. Mill cross-sectional rough trenches on front and back using 30 kV, 7 nA Ga+ beam down to 6 µm depth. 5. Measure trench fiducial alignment drift and surface curtaining via in-situ SEM. | `E-beam/I-beam Pt protective strap total thickness >= 1.7 µm with zero voiding over crown apex; fiducial drift <= 15 nm over 20-minute mill duration; surface curtaining amplitude <= 3.0 nm across active ALD TiN crown.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-1-02` | **Low-kV Final Lamella Polish & Amorphous Damage Layer Verification** | Dual-Beam FIB/SEM with Omniprobe micromanipulator, Omniprobe copper TEM grid, and low-kV Ga+ deceleration optics | 1. Perform intermediate thinning at 16 kV, 50 pA at ±1.5° until lamella reaches 150 nm. 2. Fine-mill at 5 kV, 30 pA at ±2.0° down to 70 nm thickness. 3. Perform final cleaning polish at 2 kV, 15 pA at ±3.5° for 60 seconds per side. 4. Acquire SEM transmission-mode or high-resolution backscattered electron (BSE) cross-sectional image across the top 100 nm of the crown cylinder. | `Total lamella target thickness = 45 nm ± 5 nm measured at crown mid-depth; Ga+ amorphization damage layer thickness <= 1.8 nm on ALD TiN sidewall; zero structural delamination or bending along capacitor high-aspect-ratio axis.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 374 Type B cleanroom nitrile gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness, dual-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/impact safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom class 100 antistatic garment and conductive ESD-safe footwear, Half-face HEPA/organic vapor respirator during GIS precursor cylinder exchange
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin exposure to organometallic Pt compound: Wash immediately with copious amounts of water and non-abrasive soap for at least 15 minutes; seek immediate medical consultation for heavy metal contact. Eye exposure: Flush eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Gallium contact: Mechanically wipe off prior to copious water wash. Inhalation of organic vapors during maintenance: Evacuate personnel to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB/SEM roughing and turbomolecular pump exhausts must be hard-piped to dedicated hazardous toxic gas fab exhaust (HTG/VOC scrubber) with negative differential pressure (> 0.25 in. w.g.) and minimum continuous flow rate of 30 SCFM.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent GIS precursor crucibles, contaminated cleavage shards, and contaminated glove waste must be sealed in airtight UN-certified hazardous waste drums for dedicated pyrolytic metals recovery. Isopropanol wipe waste must be segregated in grounded flammables containers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV) [Pt GIS Precursor]** | `94442-19-0` | Sublimed Electronic Grade (99.99%-Pt) | `>= 99.0%` |
| **Gallium Metal (Liquid Metal Ion Source Charge)** | `7440-55-3` | Ultra-High Purity 6N | `99.9999%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - Chamber and Coupon Clean)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `>= 99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN crown capacitor array coupon, unpassivated, post-degas/pre-clean with surface native oxide < 0.3 nm and zero particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Finished ultra-thin cross-sectional lamella (<50 nm) mounted on Cu TEM half-grid, sealed in vacuum transfer pod or continuous dry-N2 desiccator box ready for HR-TEM/XPS.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure to atmospheric moisture and oxygen causes rapid oxidation of 10nm ALD TiN to TiO2/TiON and uptake of adventitious carbon, permanently corrupting interfacial Cl/C XPS metrology and rendering TEM sidewall contrast invalid.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable completion of high-aspect-ratio 180nm crown capacitor cross-sectional lamella preparation via dual-beam FIB with preserved TiN thin-film integrity, minimal Ga-induced amorphization, and complete encapsulation for atomic-scale metrology.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FIB_Crown_CrossSection_Rough_and_Final_SEM.tiff`
- [ ] `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-1_Thinning_Process_Log.csv`
- [ ] `Lamella_Integrity_and_Damaged_Layer_Inspection_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Lamella thickness across crown capacitor active dielectric region** | `45 nm` | ± 5 nm | In-situ low-kV SEM Transmission detector (STEM-in-SEM) and electron energy-loss low-loss plasmon ratio |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Amorphous Ga+ implantation damaged zone on TiN crown sidewall** | `1.5 nm` | <= 1.8 nm maximum | High-resolution transmission electron cross-section lattice fringe edge metrology |
| `ASSERT-03` | **High-aspect-ratio crown cylinder sidewall vertical taper deviation** | `89.5 deg` | ± 0.5 deg | Calibrated dual-beam SEM tilt-corrected cross-sectional profile line measurement |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit requires unanimous Metrology Council verification that the lamella exhibits zero crown structural collapse across >= 5 contiguous cells, Pt protective capping exhibits zero voids, sidewall amorphization is confirmed <= 1.8 nm, and the specimen is transferred to high-vacuum storage within the 20-minute atmospheric Q-time limit.

An electron-beam-assisted protective cap must precede high-current Ga+ deposition to prevent top crown distortion and surface sputtering artifact propagation into downstream metrology planes.
critics.domain_expert: Direct Ga+ focused ion beam milling of ultra-thin ALD TiN electrodes (~10-15 nm) causes severe ion beam amorphization, Ga+ implantation (forming unwanted Ga-Ti-N intermetallic damage layers up to 8 nm thick), and void smearing inside deep capacitor hollows. Final thinning must drop to low acceleration voltages (5 kV down to 1-2 kV) with glancing incidence (<2°) to preserve TiN crystal lattice fringes and enable valid HR-TEM/STEM sidewall coverage and XPS correlative analysis.
critics.domain_expert_failure_risk: Sample charging and delamination at the high-aspect-ratio crown neck during lift-out micromanipulation caused by mechanical shear stresses and excessive redeposition inside 3D cylindrical cavities.
critics.supply_chain: Single-source reliance on organometallic precursor gas injection cartridges (e.g., GIS (CH3)3Pt(CpCH3) trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum and W(CO)6) and liquid metal ion sources (LMIS Ga alloy tips) introduces lead-time risks exceeding 16 weeks in open-hardware fab setups. Standardized GIS cartridge rebuilds and dual-source Ga/Xe-plasma FIB compatibility matrices must be budgeted to prevent line stoppages.
critics.laya_pm: FIB sample preparation sits on the critical path between ALD chamber qualification and TEM/XPS physical parameter signoff. Lamella prep yield is historically sub-65% for unautomated HAR capacitor targets, creating throughput bottlenecks. Implementation of automated fiducial-guided drift-compensated trench milling and standardized lift-out milestones is mandatory to ensure turnaround times stay under 4 hours per specimen.
critical_failure_modes: Curtaining effect during Ga+ ion milling causing false-positive crown sidewall thickness variations and step-coverage measurement distortions.
Mechanical rupture and collapse of unsupported 15:1 HAR hollow cylindrical crown walls during lamella thinning below 50 nm.
Heavy Ga+ ion implantation and surface oxidation artifacts masking true ALD interfacial chlorine and carbon contaminant concentrations during downstream XPS/EDX inspections.
