# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Crown Sidewall ALD TiN Conformal Step Coverage TEM/EDX Metrology

### Metrology Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Sample Prep:      │
│     Dual-Beam FIB      │
│        Lift-Out        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   TEM Bright-Field /   │
│   HAADF-STEM Imaging   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Crown Profile      │
│  Thickness Metrology:  │
│  Top/Sidewall/Bottom   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   STEM-EDX Nanoprobe   │
│  Spectral Line-Scan &  │
│     Quantification     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Pass/Fail  │
│     Determination      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### 1. Sample Preparation & Focused Ion Beam (FIB) Lift-Out
1. **Protective Capping**: Load the coupon/die containing the 180nm memory array (crown capacitor over W-plug contacts with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and bitline pitch $\approx 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) into a Dual-Beam FIB system.
2. **Deposition**: In-situ deposit an electron-beam protective Pt/C layer ($0.5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ at $2\text{ kV}$, $0.2\text{ nA}$) followed by a high-energy ion-beam Pt protective strap ($1.5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ at $30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{ pA}$) over the targeted crown cell region.
3. **Cross-Sectional Milling & Thinning**: Trench out the cross-section along the bitline/wordline pitch using a $30\text{ kV}$ $\text{Ga}^+$ ion beam. Perform lift-out and attach the lamella to a standard Cu or Mo TEM half-grid.
4. **Final Polishing**: Thin the region of interest down to an electron-transparent thickness of $\le 50\text{ nm}$ physical thickness using progressive ion beam de-tuning ($5\text{ kV}$, followed by a $1\text{ to }2\text{ kV}$ low-energy polish) to eliminate amorphous damaged surface layers.

#### 2. Cross-Sectional TEM/STEM High-Resolution Imaging
1. **Beam Alignment & Acceleration**: Transfer the lamella grid to a FEG (Field Emission Gun) TEM/STEM operated at an accelerating voltage of $200\text{ kV}$ with probe current calibrated at $0.5\text{ to }1.0\text{ nA}$.
2. **Tilt Alignment**: Align the sample along the low-index zone axis using high-precision double-tilt goniometer stage to ensure edge-on profile alignment across the vertical crown sidewall and bottom cup.
3. **High-Angle Annular Dark-Field (HAADF) STEM Acquisition**: Acquire $Z$-contrast HAADF-STEM and Bright-Field (BF) images of the 3D crown structure (outer/inner crown walls, underlying W-plug contact, and high-$k$ dielectric interface).
4. **Thickness Metrology Measurement**: Perform calibrated spatial measurements (calibrated against Si lattice fringe spacing $d_{111} = 0.3135\text{ nm}$):
   - $T_{\text{top}}$: TiN physical thickness at the top horizontal crown surface.
   - $T_{\text{sidewall}}$: TiN physical thickness along the vertical mid-sidewall profile.
   - $T_{\text{bottom}}$: TiN physical thickness at the bottom interior crown corner adjacent to the W-plug.
   - Calculate conformal step coverage:
     $$\text{Conformal Step Coverage (\%)} = \left(\frac{T_{\text{bottom}}}{T_{\text{top}}}\right) \times 100\%$$

#### 3. STEM-EDX Spectral Line-Scan & Stoichiometry Quantification
1. **EDX Nanoprobe Setup**: Focus the electron probe to a spot size $\le 0.5\text{ nm}$. Set the dwell time to $50\text{ ms/point}$ to prevent localized thermal/beam-induced drift.
2. **Nanoprobe Line Profiling**: Traverse an EDX line-scan across the high-aspect-ratio crown sidewall crossing the multilayer stack: High-$k$ dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) $\rightarrow$ ALD TiN electrode $\rightarrow$ Top encapsulation.
3. **Elemental Quantification**:
   - Extract primary characteristic X-ray lines: $\text{Ti } \text{K}_\alpha$ ($4.51\text{ keV}$), $\text{Ti } \text{L}_\alpha$ ($0.45\text{ keV}$), $\text{N } \text{K}_\alpha$ ($0.39\text{ keV}$), and precursor impurity lines $\text{Cl } \text{K}_\alpha$ ($2.62\text{ keV}$) / $\text{C } \text{K}_\alpha$ ($0.28\text{ keV}$).
   - Quantify the atomic ratio $[\text{Ti}]:[\text{N}]$ and residual halogen/contaminant atomic concentration using standard Cliff-Lorimer thin-foil $k$-factor analysis.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  Crown Capacitor ALD TiN Conformal Step Coverage (%)
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒  │
 Bottom Corner TiN┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒  │
Sidewall (Mid) TiN┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓  │
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓  │
   Top Surface TiN┤████████████████████████████████████│
                  │████████████████████████████████████│
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0       25       50      75      100 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method & Tooling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **ALD TiN Conformal Step Coverage Ratio** | $\ge 90.0\%$ (Bottom-to-Top ratio: $\frac{T_{\text{bottom}}}{T_{\text{top}}} \times 100\%$) | $\%$ | Calibrated Cross-Sectional HAADF-STEM Profile Measurement |
| **Crown Sidewall Ti:N Stoichiometry** | $1.00 \pm 0.05$ (Atomic Ratio $[\text{Ti}]/[\text{N}]$) | atomic ratio | STEM-EDX Cliff-Lorimer $k$-factor quantification |
| **Precursor Impurity Residue ($\text{Cl}$ / $\text{C}$)** | $\le 1.5\text{ at}\%$ (Chlorine and Carbon content) | $\text{at}\%$ | STEM-EDX Nanoprobe Line Integration |
| **Cell Capacitance & Leakage Integrity Impact** | Cell Capacitance $\ge 25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$; Leakage Current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fF/cell}$, $\text{fA/cell}$ | Post-Deposition Electrical C-V & I-V Parametric Test |

---

### Citations of Local Literature Context

1. **Cell Layout, Access Transistor & Capacitance Budget**:
   - Access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) erected above drain via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Minimum cell storage capacitance budget of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell (min $28\text{ fF}$ per cell) to guarantee noise immunity against soft errors and bitline coupling with retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Leakage target: sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   *(Cited from: `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench` and `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`)*.
2. **Dielectric Stack**:
   - ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric stack with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ and effective $\kappa > 15$.
   *(Cited from: `180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench` and `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`)*.
3. **Pitch & Structural Geometry**:
   - Bitline and wordline pitch approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ across $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell configurations.
   *(Cited from: `Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`)*.

---

*Documented micro-knowledge entry persisted at [sop_crown_ald_tin_tem_edx_metrology.md](./docs/sop_crown_ald_tin_tem_edx_metrology.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In the 180nm DRAM integration flow, non-destructive optical spectroscopic ellipsometry is physically unable to resolve sidewall conformality inside high-aspect-ratio (AR > 15:1) cylindrical crown capacitors. High-resolution cross-sectional TEM coupled with STEM-EDX line scanning is mandatory. However, lamella preparation via DualBeam FIB/SEM induces significant Ga+ ion curtaining and localized mechanical shear along the TiN/ZrO2/TiN dielectric interfaces, risking artificial delamination or thickness measurement distortion if protective e-beam Pt/C capping is inadequately tuned.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: ALD TiN deposition using TiCl4 and NH3 precursors typically exhibits low-temperature kinetic limitations inside deep crown structures, leading to precursor depletion at the bottom electrode. Measuring top-to-bottom step coverage via HAADF-STEM requires nanometer-scale spatial resolution to differentiate physical TiN thickness (target 10 nm) from residual chlorine segregation and interfacial TiO_xN_y oxidation layers, which must be cross-validated by atomic percentage EDX line profiles across the inner and outer cylinder sidewalls.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: FIB lamella preparation and high-brightness Schottky FEG-TEM/EDX metrology represent an ultra-high-cost, destructive operational bottleneck. Outsourcing advanced TEM sample prep or beamline access across regional commercial foundries introduces turnaround latencies exceeding 72 hours, which directly jeopardizes lot-holding schedules and baseline feedback cycles for ALD cycle recipe optimization.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Destructive sampling of sacrificial production wafers directly degrades wafer yield and inflates development burn rate. Standardized metrology coupons must be co-integrated into the scribe lines/kerf regions of the 180nm MPW reticle, and lamella extraction procedures must be locked into standardized SOPs to ensure repeatability across metrology shifts without holding downstream metallization lots past tight Q-time limits.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe bottom-to-top TiN pinch-off and step coverage starvation (< 85% coverage at the crown cylinder base), creating high series resistance and dielectric leakage.
1. Ga+ ion beam implantation and re-deposition damage during 30 kV FIB milling causing artificial amorphization and elemental boundary blurring between TiN and high-k dielectric.
1. Interfacial delamination of the ALD TiN film under FIB capping layer induced by excessive mechanical stress and thermal mismatch during in-situ Pt deposition.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-2-01` | **Crown Capacitor Sidewall ALD TiN Step Coverage & Thickness Uniformity Metrology** | FEI/ThermoFisher DualBeam FIB/SEM (Helios G4) with In-Situ Pt Gas Injection System (GIS) and 200kV High-Resolution Analytical S/TEM (Titan Themis / Talos F200X). | 1. Load cleaved 15mm x 15mm wafer coupon into DualBeam FIB/SEM chamber at vacuum < 5e-6 mbar. 2. Deposit 200 nm electron-beam induced Pt protection layer at 2 kV, 1.6 nA followed by 2.0 um ion-beam induced Pt strap at 30 kV, 0.23 nA over target crown capacitor array. 3. Perform automated trench milling with 30 kV Ga+ ion beam, lift out lamella using Omniprobe micromanipulator, and weld onto Cu Omniprobe TEM grid. 4. Thin lamella progressively down to ~50 nm at 30 kV and 5 kV, followed by final low-energy polish at 2 kV, 27 pA to remove amorphous Ga-damaged surface layers. 5. Transfer to 200 kV HR-STEM and acquire calibrated High-Angle Annular Dark-Field (HAADF) images at 1,000,000x magnification at three dedicated positions: crown top rim, 50% depth sidewall, and crown cylinder bottom corner. 6. Calibrate pixel scale against Si lattice fringe (0.3135 nm) and measure physical TiN layer thickness at 10 equidistant points for each zone. | `TiN physical thickness at crown top rim must be 10.0 nm +/- 1.0 nm; step coverage ratio (Sidewall Bottom Thickness / Top Rim Thickness) >= 90.0% across all measured crown structures.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-2-02` | **Interfacial Cl Impurity & Ti/N Stoichiometry Quantification via STEM-EDX Line Scan** | 200kV Analytical STEM equipped with Super-X 4-quadrant Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) Energy-Dispersive X-Ray Spectrometer (EDX) and Velox analytical software. | 1. Align 200 kV electron probe in STEM mode with probe current set to 0.5 nA, probe diameter < 0.2 nm. 2. Select a vertical line profile of 30 nm length traversing the dielectric/TiN interface at the crown cylinder bottom (95% depth). 3. Acquire STEM-EDX spectral line profile with 0.2 nm step size, 1.0 s dwell time per pixel, collecting Ti-Kalpha (4.51 keV), N-Kalpha (0.392 keV), Cl-Kalpha (2.62 keV), and O-Kalpha (0.525 keV) fluorescence lines. 4. Apply Cliff-Lorimer k-factor quantification with standard absorption correction in Velox software. 5. Extract atomic concentration profiles across the bulk TiN and boundary interfaces. | `Bulk Ti:N stoichiometric ratio must be between 0.95 and 1.05; residual chlorine (Cl) atomic impurity concentration within the bottom sidewall TiN must not exceed 1.5 at.%; interfacial oxygen contamination must be <= 3.0 at.%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/impact safety glasses, ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive footwear, Laser safety glasses (Class 3B/4 alignment compliant for FIB/TEM chamber positioning lasers)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with precursor residue or IPA: Flush immediately with copious tepid water for 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. Eye contact: Rinse thoroughly at eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Liquid nitrogen cryogenic exposure: Treat frostbite immediately with warm water bath (38-42 C); do not rub affected tissue; seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: DualBeam FIB and TEM roughing vacuum pumps must be vented directly into dedicated semiconductor toxic/flammable sub-fab scrubbed exhaust lines. Continuous ambient oxygen deficit monitoring (ODS) required in TEM microscope enclosure room.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent precursor GIS ampoules must be sealed and disposed of via licensed hazardous chemical metal-organic waste disposal. IPA-soaked cleanroom wipes collected in closed, fire-resistant, self-closing hazardous waste drums.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV) (FIB Pt Precursor)** | `94442-19-0` | Electronic Grade (99.9%) | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA - Specimen & Chamber Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (Cryo-trapping and cooling)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN top electrode, hydrophobic, chlorine-passivated, unexposed to uncontrolled moisture or ambient air particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: FIB-lamella mounted on Omniprobe grid under high-vacuum transfer pod or N2 storage, ready for transmission electron beam bombardment.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time causes ambient moisture adsorption (H2O) and atmospheric oxidation of the thin ALD TiN surface, producing uncontrolled TiO2/Ti(OH)x scale that falsifies EDX stoichiometry and induces delamination during FIB Pt deposition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified cross-sectional TEM/EDX metrology report establishing quantitative baseline for 180nm high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor ALD TiN step coverage, confirming conformal step coverage >= 90% and residual Cl impurity content <= 1.5 at.% across the deep sidewalls.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-2-HAADF-TEM-Images.tiff`
- [ ] `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-2-StepCoverage-Data.csv`
- [ ] `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-2-STEM-EDX-Spectra-Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **ALD TiN Bottom-to-Top Step Coverage Ratio inside Crown Capacitor** | `92.5%` | +/- 2.5% (minimum acceptable threshold: 90.0%) | Calibrated HR-STEM HAADF thickness measurements at 1,000,000x magnification at 5% vs 95% crown depth |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual Chlorine Atomic Fraction in Crown Sidewall ALD TiN Bulk** | `1.1 at.%` | <= 1.5 at.% | 200 kV STEM Super-X EDX line-scan integration across 30 nm sidewall profile with Cliff-Lorimer quantification |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Nominal TiN Electrode Top Rim Thickness** | `10.0 nm` | +/- 1.0 nm | Lattice-calibrated high-resolution cross-sectional HAADF-STEM image analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Unambiguous approval signed off by Integration Lead and Principal Metrology Scientist certifying that FIB lamella shows zero Ga-induced delamination artifacts, ALD TiN step coverage strictly exceeds 90.0%, and chlorine contamination remains within the <= 1.5 at.% envelope across three distinct crown capacitor cells.

Ga+ ion beam implantation and re-deposition damage during 30 kV FIB milling causing artificial amorphization and elemental boundary blurring between TiN and high-k dielectric.
Interfacial delamination of the ALD TiN film under FIB capping layer induced by excessive mechanical stress and thermal mismatch during in-situ Pt deposition.

testcases.title: Crown Capacitor Sidewall ALD TiN Step Coverage & Thickness Uniformity Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: FEI/ThermoFisher DualBeam FIB/SEM (Helios G4) with In-Situ Pt Gas Injection System (GIS) and 200kV High-Resolution Analytical S/TEM (Titan Themis / Talos F200X).
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer coupon cleaved from crown array module post-ALD TiN top electrode deposition; vacuum desiccator storage maintained; pre-deposition optical defect inspection completed.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load cleaved 15mm x 15mm wafer coupon into DualBeam FIB/SEM chamber at vacuum < 5e-6 mbar. 2. Deposit 200 nm electron-beam induced Pt protection layer at 2 kV, 1.6 nA followed by 2.0 um ion-beam induced Pt strap at 30 kV, 0.23 nA over target crown capacitor array. 3. Perform automated trench milling with 30 kV Ga+ ion beam, lift out lamella using Omniprobe micromanipulator, and weld onto Cu Omniprobe TEM grid. 4. Thin lamella progressively down to ~50 nm at 30 kV and 5 kV, followed by final low-energy polish at 2 kV, 27 pA to remove amorphous Ga-damaged surface layers. 5. Transfer to 200 kV HR-STEM and acquire calibrated High-Angle Annular Dark-Field (HAADF) images at 1,000,000x magnification at three dedicated positions: crown top rim, 50% depth sidewall, and crown cylinder bottom corner. 6. Calibrate pixel scale against Si lattice fringe (0.3135 nm) and measure physical TiN layer thickness at 10 equidistant points for each zone.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: TiN physical thickness at crown top rim must be 10.0 nm +/- 1.0 nm; step coverage ratio (Sidewall Bottom Thickness / Top Rim Thickness) >= 90.0% across all measured crown structures.

testcases.title: Interfacial Cl Impurity & Ti/N Stoichiometry Quantification via STEM-EDX Line Scan
testcases.instrumentation: 200kV Analytical STEM equipped with Super-X 4-quadrant Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) Energy-Dispersive X-Ray Spectrometer (EDX) and Velox analytical software.
testcases.pre_conditions: FIB-prepared lamella thickness verified < 50 nm via EELS zero-loss peak log-ratio method; TEM chamber vacuum < 2e-7 mbar; detector liquid nitrogen or Peltier cooling stabilized.
testcases.procedure: 1. Align 200 kV electron probe in STEM mode with probe current set to 0.5 nA, probe diameter < 0.2 nm. 2. Select a vertical line profile of 30 nm length traversing the dielectric/TiN interface at the crown cylinder bottom (95% depth). 3. Acquire STEM-EDX spectral line profile with 0.2 nm step size, 1.0 s dwell time per pixel, collecting Ti-Kalpha (4.51 keV), N-Kalpha (0.392 keV), Cl-Kalpha (2.62 keV), and O-Kalpha (0.525 keV) fluorescence lines. 4. Apply Cliff-Lorimer k-factor quantification with standard absorption correction in Velox software. 5. Extract atomic concentration profiles across the bulk TiN and boundary interfaces.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Bulk Ti:N stoichiometric ratio must be between 0.95 and 1.05; residual chlorine (Cl) atomic impurity concentration within the bottom sidewall TiN must not exceed 1.5 at.%; interfacial oxygen contamination must be <= 3.0 at.%.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving)
ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/impact safety glasses
ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive footwear
Laser safety glasses (Class 3B/4 alignment compliant for FIB/TEM chamber positioning lasers)
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Skin contact with precursor residue or IPA: Flush immediately with copious tepid water for 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. Eye contact: Rinse thoroughly at eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Liquid nitrogen cryogenic exposure: Treat frostbite immediately with warm water bath (38-42 C); do not rub affected tissue; seek immediate medical attention.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: DualBeam FIB and TEM roughing vacuum pumps must be vented directly into dedicated semiconductor toxic/flammable sub-fab scrubbed exhaust lines. Continuous ambient oxygen deficit monitoring (ODS) required in TEM microscope enclosure room.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent precursor GIS ampoules must be sealed and disposed of via licensed hazardous chemical metal-organic waste disposal. IPA-soaked cleanroom wipes collected in closed, fire-resistant, self-closing hazardous waste drums.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly deposited ALD TiN top electrode, hydrophobic, chlorine-passivated, unexposed to uncontrolled moisture or ambient air particulates.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: FIB-lamella mounted on Omniprobe grid under high-vacuum transfer pod or N2 storage, ready for transmission electron beam bombardment.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time causes ambient moisture adsorption (H2O) and atmospheric oxidation of the thin ALD TiN surface, producing uncontrolled TiO2/Ti(OH)x scale that falsifies EDX stoichiometry and induces delamination during FIB Pt deposition.

expected_result.summary: Verified cross-sectional TEM/EDX metrology report establishing quantitative baseline for 180nm high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor ALD TiN step coverage, confirming conformal step coverage >= 90% and residual Cl impurity content <= 1.5 at.% across the deep sidewalls.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: ALD TiN Bottom-to-Top Step Coverage Ratio inside Crown Capacitor
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Calibrated HR-STEM HAADF thickness measurements at 1,000,000x magnification at 5% vs 95% crown depth

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Residual Chlorine Atomic Fraction in Crown Sidewall ALD TiN Bulk
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 200 kV STEM Super-X EDX line-scan integration across 30 nm sidewall profile with Cliff-Lorimer quantification

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Nominal TiN Electrode Top Rim Thickness
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Lattice-calibrated high-resolution cross-sectional HAADF-STEM image analysis

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Unambiguous approval signed off by Integration Lead and Principal Metrology Scientist certifying that FIB lamella shows zero Ga-induced delamination artifacts, ALD TiN step coverage strictly exceeds 90.0%, and chlorine contamination remains within the <= 1.5 at.% envelope across three distinct crown capacitor cells.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Angle-Resolved XPS & Sputter Depth Profile Cl/C Contamination Inspection

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-180-044`  
**Node Path:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > 3D High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor ALD Dielectric & Metal Electrode Deposition > Conformal CVD/ALD TiN Top Metal Electrode Deposition > Crown Capacitor Pre-Clean and ALD TiN Surface Degas/Precursor Balancing > Crown Sidewall Conformal TiN Coverage Metrology and Interfacial Carbon/Chlorine X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) Inspection > Angle-Resolved XPS and Depth Profile Cl/C Contamination Inspection`  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm Node)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Classification:** Metrology / Surface & Interface Physics  

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Wafer Load & UHV    │
│   Pumpdown to 5e-10    │
│          mbar          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  AR-XPS Surface Tilt   │
│  Scan at 15 to 75 deg  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Mono Ar+ Sputter    │
│   Depth Profiling at   │
│         500 eV         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Photoelectron      │
│  Spectrum Acquisition  │
│  Ti2p, N1s, Cl2p, C1s  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Quantification &    │
│   Boundary Interface   │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Load Lock Ingress & Ultra-High Vacuum (UHV) Transfer**
   - Transfer the 180nm patterned crown capacitor wafer into the load-lock chamber.
   - Cryopump load lock down to $< 5.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ mbar}$; transfer via robotic arm to the analytical chamber at base vacuum pressure $P_{\text{base}} \le 5.0 \times 10^{-10}\text{ mbar}$.
   - Activate dual electron/low-energy ion flood gun to neutralize surface charging on exposed crown dielectric domains.

2. **Angle-Resolved XPS (AR-XPS) Surface Analysis**
   - Align the monochromatic $\text{Al } K_\alpha$ X-ray source ($h\nu = 1486.6\text{ eV}$, $15\text{ kV}$, $150\text{ W}$, spot size $\le 100\ \mu\text{m}$) over the crown capacitor test array.
   - Vary the photoelectron emission take-off angle relative to the sample normal: $\theta = [15^\circ, 30^\circ, 45^\circ, 60^\circ, 75^\circ]$.
   - Collect core-level survey and high-resolution multiplex spectra at analyzer pass energy $E_p = 20\text{ eV}$ for:
     - $\text{Ti } 2p$ ($450\text{ eV} - 470\text{ eV}$)
     - $\text{N } 1s$ ($392\text{ eV} - 404\text{ eV}$)
     - $\text{C } 1s$ ($280\text{ eV} - 292\text{ eV}$)
     - $\text{Cl } 2p$ ($194\text{ eV} - 206\text{ eV}$)
     - $\text{O } 1s$ ($526\text{ eV} - 536\text{ eV}$)
   - Quantify near-surface native adventitious carbon vs. intrinsic organic residual groups originating from the metalorganic/halide ALD precursors.

3. **Low-Damage Monoenergetic $\text{Ar}^+$ Depth Profiling**
   - Configure monoatomic $\text{Ar}^+$ ion gun at beam landing energy $E_{\text{ion}} = 500\text{ eV}$, raster area $2.0\text{ mm} \times 2.0\text{ mm}$, and incident beam angle $45^\circ$ to suppress preferential sputtering and atomic knock-in intermixing.
   - Execute alternating etch cycles ($t_{\text{sputter}} = 15\text{ s/cycle}$, calibrated etch rate $\sim 0.25\text{ nm/min}$ relative to $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$) followed by spectral acquisition ($E_p = 40\text{ eV}$).
   - Continuously record concentration profiles across the TiN top electrode, the TiN/dielectric ($\text{ONO}$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ / $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, $\kappa > 15$) interface, down into the underlying tungsten plug (W-plug) contact interface.

4. **Spectral Deconvolution & Interface Demarcation**
   - Align peak positions using adventitious carbon $\text{C } 1s$ ($284.8\text{ eV}$) or bulk metallic $\text{TiN } \text{Ti } 2p_{3/2}$ ($454.9\text{ eV}$) as reference.
   - Deconvolute $\text{Cl } 2p$ doublet ($\text{Cl } 2p_{3/2}$ at $198.5\text{ eV}$, split by $1.6\text{ eV}$) to determine whether chlorine resides as bounded metal chlorides ($\text{Ti-Cl}$) from unreacted $\text{TiCl}_4$ precursor or trapped volatile residues.
   - Demarcate the dielectric interface boundary at the $50\%$ intensity crossing of the dielectric core peak ($\text{Ta } 4f$, $\text{Al } 2p$, or $\text{Si } 2p$) and extract the peak contamination levels at that transition coordinate.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics  
                 ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                 │███████████████████████████████████│
  Ret Temp (degC)┤███████████████████████████████████│
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
Cap Min (fF/cell)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
   Interf C (at%)┤▒                                  │
                 │▒                                  │
    Bulk Cl (at%)┤░                                  │
                 │░                                  │
                 └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                 0.0     21.2    42.5     63.8   85.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Measurement Technique | Target Spec | Critical Limit | Engineering Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Chlorine in TiN Film ($\text{Cl}_{\text{bulk}}$)** | Mono $\text{Ar}^+$ XPS Depth Profile ($\text{Cl } 2p$) | $\le 0.5$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{at.\%}$ |
| **Interfacial Carbon Concentration ($\text{C}_{\text{interf}}$)** | AR-XPS & Sputter Profile ($\text{C } 1s$) at TiN/Dielectric boundary | $\le 1.2$ | $\le 2.0$ | $\text{at.\%}$ |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | High-Frequency Quasi-Static $C$-$V$ Array Metrology | $\ge 28.0$ | $\ge 25.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Data Retention Operating Temperature ($T_{\text{ret}}$)** | Electrical Cell Retention Stress Testing ($t_{\text{ret}} > 64\text{ ms}$, $I_{\text{leak}} < 1\text{ fA/cell}$) | $85.0$ | $85.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources Cited

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Dielectric system: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ ensures alpha-particle soft-error immunity.
   - Leakage requirement: Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - 1T1C storage capacitor retains $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to maintain data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Stacked crown capacitors deploy $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ high-$\kappa$ dielectrics with equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$.
3. **Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**
   - High-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static $C$-$V$ extraction protocols for physical thickness extraction and interface-state verification connecting gate/dielectric stack integration to working devices.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Angle-resolved XPS (ARXPS) and Ar+ depth profiling on 3D high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor structures introduce severe geometric shadowing and preferential sputtering artifacts. Sputtering TiN with standard monoatomic Ar+ beams causes preferential removal of N and severe chemical state reduction of Ti (Ti4+ to Ti3+/Ti2+), which distorts the quantification of interfacial Cl and adventitious versus carbidic C. The systems integration scheme must cross-correlate ARXPS findings with coupon-level low-energy Ar gas cluster ion beam (Ar-GCIB) profiling or high-resolution cross-sectional STEM-EELS to prevent erroneous process window definition for the TiCl4/NH3 ALD sequence.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Interfacial chlorine residue exceeding 1.5 at.% at the high-k (e.g., ZrO2/Al2O3) to TiN top electrode interface drives elevated trap-assisted tunneling, shifts the effective work function by >120 meV due to dipole modification, and catalyzes galvanic/electromigration voiding under subsequent metallization thermal budgets (380-400 °C). Angle-resolved emission angles must span from shallow takeoff (15° for top surface adventitious contamination decoupling) to bulk/sidewall grazing angles (75°) to separate baseline air exposure contamination from intrinsic residual Cl originating from incomplete surface ligand exchange during sub-400 °C ALD cycles.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Monochromatic Al K-alpha micro-focused X-ray sources (spot size < 20 um) and low-energy dual-mode electron/ion charge neutralizers represent critical metrology bottlenecks in regional open-source fabs. The ultra-high vacuum (UHV) inspection chamber consumables, particularly replacement filament arrays, multi-channel plate (MCP) detectors, and high-purity (99.9999%) Argon gas supplies for depth profiling, require long procurement lead times (16-24 weeks); a secondary offline cross-check protocol via TOF-SIMS must be maintained to prevent tool-down deadlocks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: XPS vacuum pump-down cycles to achieve < 5e-9 mbar for multi-point crown wafer profiling consume excessive line time (4-6 hours per wafer lot). Failure to enforce rigorous Q-time gates between the ALD degas/deposition cluster and the metrology loadlock will lead to unavoidable adventitious carbon saturation, generating false out-of-spec triggers that delay fab lot progression and waste analytical instrument time on non-conforming wafers.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Differential sputter knock-in and forward recoil implantation of surface adventitious carbon into the bulk TiN/dielectric interface during Ar+ depth profiling, masking true interfacial chemistry.
1. Geometric shadowing along the high-aspect-ratio (AR > 10:1) crown sidewalls preventing photoelectrons from reaching the hemispherical analyzer, yielding insufficient signal-to-noise ratio for Cl 2p core-level deconvolution.
1. Charge-up induced spectral broadening and binding energy shifts over thick dielectric regions, causing incorrect chemical phase identification for Ti-C, Ti-N-O, and Ti-Cl species.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-3-01` | **Angle-Resolved XPS Surface and Interfacial Chlorine/Carbon Deconvolution** | Monochromatic Al K-alpha (1486.6 eV) Angle-Resolved X-ray Photoelectron Spectrometer with multi-axis automated tilt-rotate stage and low-energy electron flood neutralizer | 1. Align beam spot (20 um diameter) onto the crown capacitor array test pattern. 2. Collect survey spectra (0-1200 eV pass energy 160 eV, step 1.0 eV). 3. Acquire high-resolution core spectra for C 1s (280-295 eV), N 1s (390-410 eV), Ti 2p (450-475 eV), O 1s (525-545 eV), and Cl 2p (194-206 eV) at pass energy 20 eV, step 0.05 eV. 4. Vary emission takeoff angle theta through 15°, 45°, and 75° relative to the surface normal. 5. Perform Shirley background subtraction and deconvolute C 1s (adventitious C-C at 284.8 eV vs. carbide Ti-C at 281.8 eV) and Cl 2p doublet (Cl 2p3/2 at 198.5 eV for metal chloride). 6. Quantify atomic concentrations using relative sensitivity factors (RSF). | `Pass: Bulk/interfacial chlorine concentration at theta = 45° and 75° is <= 1.2 at.%; adventitious carbon at top surface (theta = 15°) is documented, while carbidic C (281.8 eV) in bulk TiN is <= 0.8 at.%. Fail if Cl 2p atomic percentage exceeds 1.5 at.% at any angle.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-3-02` | **Low-Energy Ar-Ion Depth Profile of TiN/Dielectric Crown Interface** | XPS system integrated with Monoatomic/Gas Cluster Ion Beam (GCIB) Ar+ sputter source and multichannel hemispherical analyzer | 1. Initialize continuous depth profile mode alternating between 15 seconds sputter etch and high-resolution core spectrum acquisition (Ti 2p, Cl 2p, C 1s, O 1s, Zr 3d / Al 2p). 2. Monitor Ti 2p and Zr 3d signals to identify the TiN/high-k dielectric transition zone (defined as 10% to 90% normalized peak intensity). 3. Track Cl 2p and C 1s intensities throughout the bulk TiN layer and at the dielectric interface. 4. Convert sputter time to depth based on pre-calibrated TiN etch rate (nm/min) verified by spectroscopic ellipsometry. 5. Calculate integrated atomic fraction across the 5 nm interface region. | `Pass: Cl concentration profile displays no interfacial accumulation peak exceeding 1.0 at.%; steady-state bulk TiN chlorine is <= 0.8 at.%; depth profile shows clear stoichiometry transition with interface width <= 1.5 nm. Fail if Cl interfacial pile-up exceeds 1.5 at.% or interface smearing exceeds 2.5 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required during UHV sample loading), ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/laser-blocking safety glasses, Anti-static ESD lab coat, Cryogenic gloves and face shield for liquid nitrogen cold trap refills on UHV sorption/cryopumps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation of Argon/Nitrogen boil-off causing asphyxiation: Evacuate exposed personnel to fresh air immediately; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; seek emergency medical response. Skin contact with cryogenic liquid nitrogen: Flush affected area with lukewarm water (not hot); do not rub frozen tissue; apply sterile dressing and treat as thermal burn. Eye contact with IPA: Irrigate with sterile eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom airflow maintaining ISO Class 5 laminar environment; vacuum pump exhaust lines must be permanently plumbed to dedicated scrubbed toxic/inert fab house exhaust ducting to prevent asphyxiant gas accumulation in the metrology bay.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA cleanroom wipes must be sealed in airtight flammable waste bins and disposed of via certified hazardous solvent incineration; dry vacuum scroll pump exhaust purged through dedicated facility abatement; contaminated sputter target or coupon fragments managed as solid electronic hazardous waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Argon (compressed / cryogenic UHV grade for sputter profiling)** | `7440-37-1` | Research Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, for sample degrease/holder preparation)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (cryopump regeneration and cold traps)** | `7727-37-9` | Industrial Cryogenic Grade | `>= 99.99%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN top metal electrode on crown capacitor; pristine metallic luster; unoxidized top layer with zero ambient moisture exposure.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Analyzed surface containing localized Ar+ sputter craters in sacrificial test pads; surface passivated under UHV and transferred directly to cassette/FOUP under nitrogen purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes ambient moisture (H2O) and hydrocarbon chemisorption, hydrolyzing surface-active Ti-Cl bonds into volatile HCl and titanium oxides (TiO2), thereby irrecoverably falsifying baseline chlorine concentration and skewing ARXPS surface/bulk contamination ratios.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Angle-resolved XPS and depth profile metrology verified conformal ALD TiN top electrode purity over 3D crown capacitors, confirming interfacial Cl concentration is suppressed below 1.2 at.% and carbidic C is below 0.8 at.%, validating the sub-400 °C ALD TiCl4/NH3 purge efficiency without degrading the underlying high-k dielectric stack.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ARXPS_Core_Level_Deconvolution_Report_TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-1-3-3.pdf`
- [ ] `Depth_Profile_Quantification_TiN_Interface_Raw_Data.csv`
- [ ] `High_Resolution_Survey_and_Narrow_Scan_Spectra_Mapping.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Interfacial chlorine (Cl 2p) atomic percentage in conformal TiN top electrode** | `0.8 at.%` | +/- 0.4 at.% (absolute upper bound <= 1.2 at.%) | High-resolution XPS narrow scan deconvolution of Cl 2p doublet calibrated using empirical relative sensitivity factors (RSF) at 45° takeoff angle |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Carbidic carbon (C 1s Ti-C sub-peak at 281.8 eV) bulk concentration** | `0.4 at.%` | <= 0.8 at.% max | Peak fitting and deconvolution of C 1s envelope after low-energy 500 eV Ar+ sputter removal of adventitious surface hydrocarbon layer |
| `ASSERT-03` | **TiN to High-k dielectric chemical transition interface width** | `1.1 nm` | +/- 0.3 nm (absolute upper bound <= 1.5 nm) | 10% to 90% atomic concentration crossover depth between Ti 2p and Zr 3d (or Al 2p) during calibrated Ar-GCIB profiling |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires full multi-angle (15°, 45°, 75°) spectral convergence, all quantitative assertions meeting target specifications within stated tolerances, automated baseline Shirley background fits achieving chi-squared <= 1.25, and signed EHS verification of closed Q-time logging from ALD deposition to XPS pump-down.

Charge-up induced spectral broadening and binding energy shifts over thick dielectric regions, causing incorrect chemical phase identification for Ti-C, Ti-N-O, and Ti-Cl species.

testcases.title: Angle-Resolved XPS Surface and Interfacial Chlorine/Carbon Deconvolution
testcases.instrumentation: Monochromatic Al K-alpha (1486.6 eV) Angle-Resolved X-ray Photoelectron Spectrometer with multi-axis automated tilt-rotate stage and low-energy electron flood neutralizer
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer cleaved coupon or 200mm full wafer mounted in UHV analysis chamber at base pressure <= 5.0e-9 mbar; dual flood gun active; energy scale calibrated against Au 4f7/2 (84.00 eV) and Cu 2p3/2 (932.67 eV).
testcases.procedure: 1. Align beam spot (20 um diameter) onto the crown capacitor array test pattern. 2. Collect survey spectra (0-1200 eV pass energy 160 eV, step 1.0 eV). 3. Acquire high-resolution core spectra for C 1s (280-295 eV), N 1s (390-410 eV), Ti 2p (450-475 eV), O 1s (525-545 eV), and Cl 2p (194-206 eV) at pass energy 20 eV, step 0.05 eV. 4. Vary emission takeoff angle theta through 15°, 45°, and 75° relative to the surface normal. 5. Perform Shirley background subtraction and deconvolute C 1s (adventitious C-C at 284.8 eV vs. carbide Ti-C at 281.8 eV) and Cl 2p doublet (Cl 2p3/2 at 198.5 eV for metal chloride). 6. Quantify atomic concentrations using relative sensitivity factors (RSF).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass: Bulk/interfacial chlorine concentration at theta = 45° and 75° is <= 1.2 at.%; adventitious carbon at top surface (theta = 15°) is documented, while carbidic C (281.8 eV) in bulk TiN is <= 0.8 at.%. Fail if Cl 2p atomic percentage exceeds 1.5 at.% at any angle.

testcases.title: Low-Energy Ar-Ion Depth Profile of TiN/Dielectric Crown Interface
testcases.instrumentation: XPS system integrated with Monoatomic/Gas Cluster Ion Beam (GCIB) Ar+ sputter source and multichannel hemispherical analyzer
testcases.pre_conditions: Chamber pressure maintained <= 2.0e-8 mbar during Ar gas bleeding; sputter raster area set to 2.0 mm x 2.0 mm centered on analysis spot; beam energy calibrated to 500 eV monoatomic Ar+ (or 5 keV Ar2000+ cluster) to minimize knock-in.
testcases.procedure: 1. Initialize continuous depth profile mode alternating between 15 seconds sputter etch and high-resolution core spectrum acquisition (Ti 2p, Cl 2p, C 1s, O 1s, Zr 3d / Al 2p). 2. Monitor Ti 2p and Zr 3d signals to identify the TiN/high-k dielectric transition zone (defined as 10% to 90% normalized peak intensity). 3. Track Cl 2p and C 1s intensities throughout the bulk TiN layer and at the dielectric interface. 4. Convert sputter time to depth based on pre-calibrated TiN etch rate (nm/min) verified by spectroscopic ellipsometry. 5. Calculate integrated atomic fraction across the 5 nm interface region.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass: Cl concentration profile displays no interfacial accumulation peak exceeding 1.0 at.%; steady-state bulk TiN chlorine is <= 0.8 at.%; depth profile shows clear stoichiometry transition with interface width <= 1.5 nm. Fail if Cl interfacial pile-up exceeds 1.5 at.% or interface smearing exceeds 2.5 nm.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required during UHV sample loading)
ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/laser-blocking safety glasses
Anti-static ESD lab coat
Cryogenic gloves and face shield for liquid nitrogen cold trap refills on UHV sorption/cryopumps

cas_chemicals.name: Argon (compressed / cryogenic UHV grade for sputter profiling)
Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA, for sample degrease/holder preparation)
Liquid Nitrogen (cryopump regeneration and cold traps)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Inhalation of Argon/Nitrogen boil-off causing asphyxiation: Evacuate exposed personnel to fresh air immediately; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; seek emergency medical response. Skin contact with cryogenic liquid nitrogen: Flush affected area with lukewarm water (not hot); do not rub frozen tissue; apply sterile dressing and treat as thermal burn. Eye contact with IPA: Irrigate with sterile eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Continuous cleanroom airflow maintaining ISO Class 5 laminar environment; vacuum pump exhaust lines must be permanently plumbed to dedicated scrubbed toxic/inert fab house exhaust ducting to prevent asphyxiant gas accumulation in the metrology bay.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent IPA cleanroom wipes must be sealed in airtight flammable waste bins and disposed of via certified hazardous solvent incineration; dry vacuum scroll pump exhaust purged through dedicated facility abatement; contaminated sputter target or coupon fragments managed as solid electronic hazardous waste.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly deposited ALD TiN top metal electrode on crown capacitor; pristine metallic luster; unoxidized top layer with zero ambient moisture exposure.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Analyzed surface containing localized Ar+ sputter craters in sacrificial test pads; surface passivated under UHV and transferred directly to cassette/FOUP under nitrogen purge.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding air queue time causes ambient moisture (H2O) and hydrocarbon chemisorption, hydrolyzing surface-active Ti-Cl bonds into volatile HCl and titanium oxides (TiO2), thereby irrecoverably falsifying baseline chlorine concentration and skewing ARXPS surface/bulk contamination ratios.

expected_result.summary: Angle-resolved XPS and depth profile metrology verified conformal ALD TiN top electrode purity over 3D crown capacitors, confirming interfacial Cl concentration is suppressed below 1.2 at.% and carbidic C is below 0.8 at.%, validating the sub-400 °C ALD TiCl4/NH3 purge efficiency without degrading the underlying high-k dielectric stack.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Interfacial chlorine (Cl 2p) atomic percentage in conformal TiN top electrode
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-resolution XPS narrow scan deconvolution of Cl 2p doublet calibrated using empirical relative sensitivity factors (RSF) at 45° takeoff angle

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Carbidic carbon (C 1s Ti-C sub-peak at 281.8 eV) bulk concentration
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Peak fitting and deconvolution of C 1s envelope after low-energy 500 eV Ar+ sputter removal of adventitious surface hydrocarbon layer

quantitative_assertions.assertion: TiN to High-k dielectric chemical transition interface width
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 10% to 90% atomic concentration crossover depth between Ti 2p and Zr 3d (or Al 2p) during calibrated Ar-GCIB profiling

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Researcher exit signoff requires full multi-angle (15°, 45°, 75°) spectral convergence, all quantitative assertions meeting target specifications within stated tolerances, automated baseline Shirley background fits achieving chi-squared <= 1.25, and signed EHS verification of closed Q-time logging from ALD deposition to XPS pump-down.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Thermal ALD Ti4Cl/NH3 Conformal Top Electrode Recipe Execution

**Category**: Thin Film Deposition | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal ALD of TiN using TiCl4 and NH3 requires substrate temperatures strictly maintained between 380°C and 420°C to achieve acceptable film resistivity (<150 uOhm-cm) and low residual chlorine (<1.5 at%). However, at aspect ratios exceeding 15:1 within 180nm crown capacitor cylinders, purge cycles must be extended beyond 8 seconds to prevent precursor mixing, vapor-phase CVD nucleation, and ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) condensation in forelines, which rapidly clogs roots blower exhaust lines and drifts reactor base pressure above 5x10^-4 Torr.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The high surface area of 3D cylinder crown capacitors demands complete saturation dosing (exposure > 1.2x10^5 Langmuirs) of both TiCl4 and NH3. Chlorine contamination from incomplete ligand exchange at lower thermal budgets creates sub-stoichiometric TiN_xCl_y films, severely degrading the work function (>4.6 eV target) and inducing corrosion/peeling at the high-k ZrO2/Al2O3 dielectric interface due to trace HCl outgassing during subsequent 400°C metallization anneals.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade TiCl4 (CAS 7550-45-0, 99.999% trace metals basis) and anhydrous ultra-high purity NH3 (CAS 7664-41-7, 99.9995%) require heated bubbler canisters and stainless steel 316L VCR distribution manifold lines traced at 60°C to prevent cold spots. Lead times for quartz reactor liners and heated bellows valves rated for corrosive HCl/NH4Cl byproducts currently exceed 16 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Module delivery must synchronize tightly with pre-ALD high-k dielectric post-deposition anneal (PDA) and post-top-electrode PVD Al strapping. Exceeding queue time (>45 minutes in ambient air) results in moisture condensation on high-k surfaces, triggering uncontrolled TiCl4 hydrolysis into particulate TiO2 and void formation that invalidates the wafer lot before electrical probe.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. NH4Cl solid salt precipitation in reactor exhaust throttle valve and foreline causing base pressure fluctuation and particle backstreaming into the process chamber.
1. Incomplete TiCl4 purge leading to parasitic parasitic CVD mode growth, causing severe top-opening pinch-off (step coverage dropping below 85% inside the crown cavity).
1. Corrosive chlorine leaching (>2.0 at% Cl incorporation) attacking the underlying ZrO2-Al2O3-ZrO2 (ZAZ) dielectric, resulting in high capacitor leakage current (I_leak > 1 fA/cell at 1.0V).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-01` | **Cross-Sectional Step Coverage and Conformal Thickness Verification via HR-XSEM** | Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM) / Focused Ion Beam (FIB) DualBeam System | 1. Cleave or FIB-cut cross-sectional lamella across high-density 180nm crown capacitor array. 2. Mount specimen in FE-SEM vacuum chamber (<1x10^-5 Pa). 3. Image top surface, middle sidewall, and bottom cup corners at 100,000x magnification with 5.0 kV accelerating voltage. 4. Measure physical TiN film thickness at top horizontal surface (T_top), 50% depth sidewall (T_mid), and bottom cup floor (T_bot) across 5 dies. | `T_top target = 20.0 nm ± 1.5 nm; Step coverage defined as (T_bot / T_top) * 100% >= 95.0%; Sidewall conformality (T_mid / T_top) * 100% >= 92.0%; zero pinch-off or voiding observed.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-02` | **Residual Chlorine Contamination and Film Resistivity Characterization** | X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) / 4-Point Probe Sheet Resistance Mapper | 1. Measure sheet resistance (R_s) across 49-point polar map using calibrated 4-point probe. 2. Calculate film resistivity rho = R_s * t_phys (using SE/XRR measured thickness). 3. Load wafer into ultra-high vacuum XPS chamber (<5x10^-9 Torr). 4. Perform Ar+ ion cluster surface sputter etch (15 nm depth etch). 5. Acquire core-level spectra for Ti 2p, N 1s, O 1s, and Cl 2p peaks. 6. Quantify atomic concentration percentage of Cl incorporation. | `Film resistivity rho <= 140 uOhm-cm with within-wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma) < 2.5%; residual chlorine atomic concentration [Cl] < 1.2 at%; oxygen contamination [O] < 2.0 at%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B / Acid-gas resistant full-face respirator with multi-gas/P100 cartridge (3M 60926) during maintenance, Double-layer nitrile gloves with outer heavy-duty butyl rubber gloves (15 mil), Chemical splash apron and face shield, Flame-resistant and anti-static cleanroom coverall (Tyvek/Nomex)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TiCl4/HCl skin contact: Immediately drench affected area with copious amounts of water for at least 20 minutes under emergency safety shower; remove contaminated clothing. Do not apply dry cloths (TiCl4 hydrolyzes exothermically with moisture). For NH3 eye exposure: Flush continuously with sterile isotonic saline eyewash for minimum 30 minutes; seek immediate ophthalmologist intervention. Inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air, administer 100% medical oxygen via non-rebreather mask; keep warm and strictly rest to mitigate delayed pulmonary edema.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated point-of-use (POU) thermal-wet burn-wet scrubber with continuous water recirculation. Scrubbed effluent connected to acid exhaust plenum (static negative pressure > -1.5 in. w.g.). Heated forelines maintained at 150°C from chamber to scrubber inlet to eliminate NH4Cl deposition. Continuous real-time electrochemical toxic gas monitoring for NH3 (TLV-TWA 25 ppm, alarm at 10 ppm) and Cl2/HCl (TLV-Ceiling 2 ppm, alarm at 0.5 ppm) interlocked with automatic pneumatic shutoff valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous effluent from wet scrubber passes through cleanroom automated Acid-Base Neutralization (AWN) system. Injected with 20% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution to neutralize dissolved HCl and ammonium ions to achieve strictly compliant discharge pH between 6.5 and 8.5 before municipal drainage.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride** | `7550-45-0` | Optoelectronic Grade 99.999% | `> 99.9%` |
| **Anhydrous Ammonia** | `7664-41-7` | Electronic Grade 5.5 | `> 99.9995%` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (reaction byproduct)** | `7647-01-0` | Technical byproduct | `Variable in exhaust stream` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly post-annealed (450°C N2/O2 PDA) crystalline high-k dielectric (ZAZ) surface, free of organic hydrocarbons, water adsorption, and fluorine residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Continuous, stoichiometric TiN passivated conductive metal electrode; surface protected under vacuum transfer or sealed N2 FOUP/pod to prevent oxidation into TiO2.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive moisture adsorption on high-k dielectric causes uncontrolled rapid TiCl4 hydrolysis during initial ALD pulses, forming localized particulate clusters, non-uniform nucleation incubation delays, and interface trap density increase (D_it > 1x10^12 eV^-1 cm^-2).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Execution of a verified thermal ALD TiCl4/NH3 conformal deposition yielding a 20.0 nm continuous TiN top electrode inside high-aspect-ratio (15:1) 180nm crown capacitor structures with >95% step coverage, <1.2 at% Cl content, and resistivity <140 uOhm-cm, satisfying baseline requirements for 180nm open-source DRAM storage cell electrodes.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `RECIPE_ALD_TIN_CROWN_TOP_EXECUTION_LOG.csv`
- [ ] `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-01_HR_XSEM_STEP_COVERAGE.tiff`
- [ ] `XPS_DEPTH_PROFILE_RESIDUAL_CHLORINE_REPORT.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Bottom-to-top capacitor cylinder physical step coverage ratio** | `95.0%` | +5.0% / -2.0% | High-Resolution Cross-Sectional FE-SEM image analysis (calibrated FIB lamella) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual chlorine atomic concentration in bulk TiN layer** | `0.9 at%` | ± 0.3 at% (strict ceiling 1.2 at%) | X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) depth profile calibrated against RBS standards |
| `ASSERT-03` | **As-deposited TiN bulk film resistivity on monitor wafer** | `120 uOhm-cm` | ± 20 uOhm-cm | 4-point probe sheet resistance measurement combined with XRR film thickness |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Physical step coverage verified >= 95% without cylinder pinch-off or voiding on FIB-SEM lamella, bulk chlorine concentration confirmed < 1.2 at% by XPS, and reactor exhaust pressure delta across 250 cycles remaining < 5% with zero NH4Cl clogging alarms, formally signed off by Thin Film Deposition Lead and Fab Integration Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure: ALD Chamber Conditioning and TiCl4/NH3 Precursor Line Saturation Prep

**Category**: Thin Film Deposition | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal ALD precursor delivery requires strict manifold thermal budgeting: the TiCl4 delivery line must maintain 60°C ± 2°C to prevent condensation, while the delivery line pneumatic ALD valves (fast-switching <20 ms) must prevent micro-leakage backstreaming. Intermixing TiCl4 and NH3 in delivery forelines prior to the reaction chamber leads to immediate solid ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) particulate fouling, necessitating dedicated isolated precursor manifolds with continuous high-purity N2 ballast curtains.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Chamber wall passivation is paramount; under-conditioned chamber walls act as huge parasitic precursor sinks that cause severe cycle-to-cycle non-uniformity and TiCl4 starvation within high-aspect-ratio (HAR 25:1) 3D crown capacitor cylinders. A minimum of 150 dummy ALD cycles at 400°C on clean dummy silicon substrates is required to saturate stainless steel/aluminum chamber adsorption sites and reach steady-state self-limiting growth rate (0.22 Å/cycle) with chlorine impurity levels < 1.5 at.%.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade TiCl4 (purity >= 99.999% trace metal basis) and semiconductor-grade anhydrous NH3 (grade 6.0, 99.9999%) have stringent container turnover cycles. Ampoule bubbler dip tubes and fast-pulse valves (Swagelok ALD3/ALD6 series) experience seat degradation and seal swelling due to corrosive anhydrous HCl/Cl2 generation, requiring scheduled rebuilds every 250,000 pulses and dedicated local buffer stock of perfluoroelastomer (FFKM / Kalrez 9100) O-rings.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Precursor saturation prep and chamber conditioning consume up to 4 hours of non-productive tool time per preventive maintenance or ampoule changeover cycle. To hit commercial 180nm MPW tapeout cost and cycle-time targets, conditioning verification must execute via automated in-situ pressure-rise and QCM/ellipsometric monitor wafer screening without breaking vacuum, locking wafer handoff into the ALD run within the designated 60-minute process window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Premature gas-phase co-reaction producing solid NH4Cl particulates that clog gas distribution showerheads and inject killer defects into 3D crown trench bottoms.
1. Precursor line cold-spots causing TiCl4 condensation, leading to erratic pressure bursts, non-saturating CVD-like runaway deposition, and extreme film thickness gradient across the wafer.
1. Incomplete wall passivating causing TiCl4 depletion and under-saturated deposition on high-aspect-ratio crown sidewalls, yielding discontinuous bottom electrode coverage and catastrophic capacitor leakage.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-01` | **TiCl4 & NH3 Precursor Vapor Pressure and Pulse-Dose Line Saturation Verification** | In-situ Capacitance Manometer (MKS Baratron 627D, 0.1 Torr full-scale), High-Speed Fast Response ALD Pneumatic Pulse Manifold, In-situ Residual Gas Analyzer (SRS RGA200) | 1. Isolate the reaction chamber vacuum pump and establish 50 sccm high-purity N2 carrier flow. 2. Fire 50 consecutive test pulses of TiCl4 (pulse width: 100 ms) with 3000 ms N2 purge into the conditioned ballast line, logging the peak chamber pressure rise per pulse via high-speed Baratron. 3. Fire 50 consecutive test pulses of NH3 (pulse width: 150 ms) with 3000 ms purge, recording transient delta pressure. 4. Calculate pulse-to-pulse pressure repeatability across pulses 20 to 50 for both precursors. | `TiCl4 transient pulse pressure spike must measure 120 ± 15 mTorr above baseline with pulse-to-pulse standard deviation < 2.5%; NH3 transient pulse pressure spike must measure 250 ± 20 mTorr with standard deviation < 2.0%; zero detectable precursor cross-talk peak on RGA during alternate purge intervals.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-02` | **Conditioned Chamber Steady-State TiN Deposition Rate and Non-Uniformity Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (J.A. Woollam M-2000), 49-Point Automated Wafer Mapping Stage, In-situ Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) | 1. - **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B Chemical Hazard Suit with sealed butyl rubber over-gloves, Full-face respiratory protection equipped with multi-gas / acid gas / ammonia combination cartridge (NIOSH approved), Chemical splash apron and face shield during cylinder connection/disconnection, Continuous personal electrochemical toxic gas monitor for Cl2/HCl and NH3
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TiCl4 contact: Do NOT immediately flood with water if pure liquid puddles on clothing; brush off excess, strip clothing immediately under safety shower and flush skin with copiously running water for minimum 20 minutes (TiCl4 reacts violently with moisture releasing corrosive HCl gas and heat). For NH3 inhalation/eye exposure: Remove to fresh air, administer humidified medical oxygen, irrigate eyes immediately with sterile saline for 30 minutes, and seek immediate specialized medical treatment for severe chemical pulmonary edema.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative pressure exhaust dedicated to toxic acid and pyrophoric/corrosive streams (minimum duct face velocity 100 FPM); integrated gas cabinets with automatic emergency shut-off valves (ESV) interlocked to cleanroom gas detection system (toxic thresholds: HCl > 2 ppm, NH3 > 25 ppm).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Vacuum pump effluent must pass through point-of-use thermal decomposition scrubber (electrically heated decomposition chamber > 800°C) followed by a wet acid-alkaline counter-current packed bed scrubber to scrub dissolved ammonium salts and hydrolyze volatile chlorides into neutral brine prior to industrial wastewater discharge.

| **Ultra-High Purity Nitrogen (N2)** | `7727-37-9` | UHP Grade (6N5, <10 ppb H2O/O2) | `>= 99.99995%` |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: High-k dielectric surface (ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 laminate) freshly annealed with sub-nanometer root-mean-square roughness (<0.2 nm RMS), native oxide free, hydroxyl-terminated (-OH) without moisture clustering.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully conditioned, continuous 2-3nm conformal TiN nucleation seed layer exhibiting stoichiometric cubic rock-salt crystallite phase, hermetically sealing high-k dielectric without micro-voids.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes ambient moisture chemisorption and hydrocarbon contamination on the crown capacitor high-k dielectric, causing TiCl4 hydrolytic micro-explosions during the initial pulses, generating particulate defects, and causing interface traps (Dit > 1x10^12 cm^-2 eV^-1) that destroy DRAM retention time.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful conditioning of the ALD reaction chamber and saturation of TiCl4/NH3 delivery manifolds, achieving repeatable self-limiting ALD growth regime (0.22 Å/cycle) with uniform passivated reactor walls, zero precursor condensation, and clean baseline monitor verification ready for 3D crown capacitor top electrode deposition.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

| `ASSERT-02` | **TiN steady-state growth rate per cycle (GPC) across 49-point wafer map** | `0.22 Å/cycle` | ± 0.02 Å/cycle | Spectroscopic ellipsometry film thickness extraction across 49 points on 200mm monitor wafer |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Film sheet resistance of 10nm conditioned TiN test film** | `180 uOhm-cm` | ± 20 uOhm-cm | Four-point probe resistivity mapping system (49-point polar map) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Chamber leak-up rate < 1.0 mTorr/min, precursor pulse repeatability standard deviation < 2.5%, monitor wafer TiN thickness non-uniformity <= 1.5% (1-sigma), zero NH4Cl precipitation detected in foreline cold trap, and formal EHS gas sensor validation signed off.
