# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title
**DRC/LVS Verification & PDK Parameter Extraction for ALD Chamber Conditioning and TiCl4/NH3 Precursor Line Saturation Prep**

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the physical verification (Design Rule Checking - DRC, Layout Versus Schematic - LVS) and parasitic/geometrical parameter extraction protocol required prior to executing the conformal ALD TiN crown top electrode deposition process. It validates that the drawn 180nm 1T1C stacked capacitor array geometry, contact plugs, bitline pitches, and metallization layers conform strictly to the foundry PDK physical rules and baseline electrical targets.

---

### 2. Physical Workflow Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["GDSII / OASIS Layout Stream-In"] --> B["Rule Deck Compilation (180nm DRC Deck)"]
    B --> C["Cell Geometry & Crown Area Verification"]
    C --> D["LVS Connectivity Extraction (1T1C Node Matching)"]
    D --> E["PDK Parameter Extraction (C_cell, EOT, R_s, Leakage)"]
    E --> F{"Acceptance Criteria Met?"}
    F -- "Pass" --> G["Sign-Off for ALD TiCl4/NH3 Chamber Conditioning"]
    F -- "Fail" --> H["Layout ECO / Parameter Recalibration"]
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream-In & Layer Mapping**:
   - Stream in the 180nm DRAM crown capacitor over bitline (COB) layout into the physical verification engine.
   - Map layers for access transistor gate (poly), active diffusion, tungsten contact plugs (`W-plug`), crown cylinder capacitor electrodes, and Metal-1 routing.

2. **Access Transistor DRC Check**:
   - Verify access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure bitline contact sharing rules between adjacent cells in $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ topologies satisfy layout spacing constraints.
   - Verify bitline and wordline pitch does not violate the minimum $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ specification.

3. **Storage Node & Crown Capacitor DRC/LVS Verification**:
   - Validate 3D crown capacitor boundary placement directly erected over the drain contact via tungsten plug (`W-plug`).
   - Run LVS extraction on the 1T1C cell network to ensure 100% pin/node matching between schematic netlist and physical layout across the array.
   - Verify gate dielectric physical thickness equivalent modeled at $3.5\text{ nm}$ (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$).

4. **PDK Parameter Extraction & Boundary Setup for ALD TiN Top Electrode**:
   - Extract effective storage node capacitance model using high-$\kappa$ dielectric parameters ($\kappa > 15$ for $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO stack, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$).
   - Set up chamber preparation boundaries: confirm substrate stage heater and chamber base pressure targets ($< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$) and pre-deposition baseline tolerances.
   - Extract interconnect parameters for downstream Metal-1 Al-0.5% Cu interconnects (target thickness $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$, target sheet resistance $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$ after forming gas anneal $\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$).

5. **Sign-off Reporting**:
   - Generate automated verification report indicating clean DRC (0 violations), LVS clean (nets matched), and extracted storage capacitance within acceptable bounds before releasing the chamber run.

---

### 4. PDK Extracted Parameter Distribution

```text
                                                        
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
     Metal-1 Thickness┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
                      │▒                               │
     Gate Ox Thickness┤▒                               │
Bitline/Wordline Pitch┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                      │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
    Capacitance Target┤███                             │
                      │███                             │
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                       0      90      180    270    360 
```

---

### 5. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement / Extraction Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Access Transistor Geometry** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Optical / DRC Extraction |
| **Bitline / Wordline Pitch** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Layout Pitch Rule Verification |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ (min $\ge 28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Field Solver / PDK Parameter Extraction |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE Corner Simulation on Extracted Netlist |
| **Downstream Metal-1 Target Thickness** | $350 \pm 5\%$ | $\text{nm}$ | PDK Interconnect Deck Extraction |

---

### 6. Verified Literature Sources Cited
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$, shared bitline contact in $8F^2/6F^2$ COB; crown capacitor over W-plug; high-$\kappa$ $\kappa > 15$; minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor architecture; capacitance target $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$; $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide thickness $3.5\text{ nm}$ ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).
- **Source 3**: *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*
  - Base pressure $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$; Metal-1 thickness target $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$; post-metal anneal $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$ ($\text{N}_2/\text{H}_2\ 95/5$ at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for $30\text{ min}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Bridging physical verification (DRC/LVS) with ALD chamber pre-conditioning and TiCl4/NH3 line saturation requires tightly binding extracted parasitic interconnect RC models with real-world ALD step coverage. Chamber wall passivation shifts baseline thermal emissivity and parasitic wall deposition load, altering effective gas-phase partial pressure delivered to high-aspect-ratio crown arrays. If extraction decks assume a perfectly conformal 15 nm TiN plate without modeling the chamber saturation curve and precursor depletion across 200mm wafers, extracted top-electrode plate resistance will underestimate actual Bitline-to-Capacitor RC delay mismatch by over 18%.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: TiCl4 and NH3 chemisorption during chamber seasoning produces solid NH4Cl adducts if cold spots (<150°C) exist in downstream forelines or delivery manifolds. Incomplete line saturation yields non-stoichiometric TiNxCyOz films during initial wafer exposure, creating variable work functions that skew dielectric flatband voltage (Vfb) and cause LVS parameter extraction mismatches. Precursor delivery lines must be seasoned to steady-state vapor pressure equilibrium (TiCl4 bubbler maintained strictly at 30°C ± 0.5°C with heated line jackets at 60°C to 80°C) prior to qualifying PDK layout ground-rules.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade anhydrous NH3 (6N / 99.9999%) and ultra-high-purity TiCl4 (5N5 / 99.9995%) carry stringent lead times and regional hazmat transport controls. Premature seasoning and excessive purge cycles during chamber conditioning deplete high-purity precursor reserves, leading to high scrap rates. Dual-source qualification for precursor canisters and integrated point-of-use residual gas analyzers (RGA) are mandatory to monitor line saturation without burning production-grade raw materials.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The physical verification schedule hinges on completing PDK rule deck parameter extraction within the assigned 3-week MPW tapeout sprint. Interdependencies between ALD hardware line saturation sign-off and DRC density/enclosure validation create a project critical path bottleneck. Running test dummy conditioning wafers in parallel with automated DRC/LVS deck regression ensures that physical parasitic extraction rules accurately reflect validated film resistivity and step coverage profiles without delaying tapeout milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. NH4Cl solid adduct accumulation in vacuum pump forelines causing exhaust throttling, back-streaming particulate contamination, and severe crown pinhole shorts.
1. Incomplete precursor delivery line saturation causing transient GPC (growth per cycle) gradients across the 3D crown array, yielding top-electrode thickness tapering below minimum DRC conformal limits (<10 nm).
1. Corrosive chlorine ligand (Cl-) retention (>2.0 at%) in seasoned TiN films leading to post-deposition Al-interconnect corrosion and parasitic sheet resistance drift.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-1-01` | **TiCl4/NH3 Precursor Line Saturation and Partial Pressure Stability Quantification via In-Situ RGA** | Extorr XT300M In-Situ Residual Gas Analyzer (RGA) mounted downstream of ALD throttle valve, MKS Baratron Capacitance Manometer (0.1 to 10 Torr range), and calibrated He-leak detector. | 1. Isolate reaction chamber and execute 50 sequential pulses of TiCl4 (150 ms pulse / 2.0 s Ar purge) into conditioning dump bypass line while tracking m/z = 190 (TiCl4+) and m/z = 155 (TiCl3+). 2. Switch delivery lines to main chamber and execute 100 alternating cycles of TiCl4 (150 ms) / Ar purge (3.0 s) / NH3 (200 ms) / Ar purge (3.0 s) on blanket conditioning dummy wafers. 3. Monitor ion current intensities for baseline cracking fragments (m/z 17, 36, 155, 190) across cycles 80 to 100 to determine precursor line saturation plateaus. 4. Record chamber transient peak pressure on Baratron manometer per cycle. | `TiCl4 cracking fragment peak intensity (m/z 155) must achieve pulse-to-pulse reproducibility of <= +/- 2.5% variation across 20 consecutive pulses; chamber transient peak pressure must stabilize at 1.85 Torr +/- 0.05 Torr; baseline residual Cl2/HCl background during Ar purge must remain below 1.0e-8 A ion current.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-1-02` | **Conditioned TiN Conformal Film Sheet Resistance and PDK Parasitic Rs Extraction Verification** | KLA-Tencor OmniMap RS-100 4-Point Probe, Woollam M-2000 Spectroscopic Ellipsometer, and FEI Helios G4 DualBeam FIB-SEM for cross-sectional profile verification. | 1. Execute 250 cycles of thermal ALD TiN deposition targeting 15.0 nm nominal thickness at 380°C. 2. Unload wafer to dry N2 purge loadlock and transfer under inert atmosphere to 4-Point Probe. 3. Measure sheet resistance (Rs) across 49-point polar map with 3 mm edge exclusion. 4. Measure film thickness via spectroscopic ellipsometry at identical coordinates. 5. Perform FIB-SEM high-resolution cross-section at center, middle, and edge crown structures to measure 3D step coverage conformality. 6. Extract parasitic resistance parameters and back-annotate into PDK LVS verification rule decks. | `Average film thickness = 15.0 nm +/- 0.75 nm (<= 5% 1-sigma non-uniformity across 200mm wafer); Sheet resistance Rs <= 120.0 Ohm/sq with uniformity <= 4.0%; 3D crown sidewall-to-top step coverage >= 95.0% confirmed via SEM; extracted PDK sheet resistance delta from design rule baseline <= 3.5%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B Chemically Resistant Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Suit with sealed seams, Full-face NIOSH-certified CBRN/Acid-Gas canister respirator (or supplied air BA during cylinder swaps), Double-layered heavy-duty Butyl rubber outer gloves over nitrile inner exam gloves, Impact-resistant dielectric safety boots with neoprene overshoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye exposure: Flush immediately with sterile saline or water for minimum 30 minutes; do not apply neutralizing agents. Inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air, establish airway, administer 100% humidified oxygen; monitor for delayed pulmonary edema (up to 48 hours). Skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing under emergency drench shower; wash skin thoroughly with copious water and apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel if secondary acid burns occur; seek immediate emergency critical care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative pressure dedicated hazardous gas cabinet ventilation maintaining face velocity >= 120 FPM (0.61 m/s); tool exhaust ducted directly to dedicated corrosive scrubbers with dual point-of-use (POU) thermal burn-wet scrubbers. Real-time toxic gas optical monitoring (MDA Scientific/Honeywell SPM Flex) interlocked to auto-shutoff pneumatic pneumatic precursor valves at 0.5 ppm TiCl4 or 25 ppm NH3.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Effluent gases routed through high-temperature thermal decomposition chamber (>850°C) followed by multi-stage counter-current packed wet scrubber circulating 10-15% NaOH solution to neutralize HCl byproducts into NaCl and water. Solid NH4Cl trap residues dissolved in water, pH-adjusted to 7.0-8.5, and routed to heavy-metal/industrial fluoride effluent treatment facility.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (TiCl4)** | `7550-45-0` | Ultra-High Purity (5N5 Electronic Grade) | `99.9995 wt%` |
| **Anhydrous Ammonia (NH3)** | `7664-41-7` | VLSI Grade (6N) | `99.9999 vol%` |
| **Hydrogen Chloride (HCl gas byproduct)** | `7647-01-0` | Process Byproduct | `< 5.0 vol% in effluent stream` |
| **Ammonium Chloride (NH4Cl solid particulate)** | `12125-02-9` | Reaction Condensate Adduct | `Variable solid particulate` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited and post-annealed 3D high-k crown dielectric stack (Al2O3/ZrO2) with clean, OH-terminated hydrophilic surface, zero organic residue, and metallic contamination < 1.0e10 atoms/cm2.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal 15 nm conductive TiN film with clean stoichiometric surface (Ti:N = 1:1.02), Cl- residue < 1.5 at%, ready for immediate aluminum bitline metallization or inter-metal barrier capping.

critics.systems_engineer: Bridging physical verification (DRC/LVS) with ALD chamber pre-conditioning and TiCl4/NH3 line saturation requires tightly binding extracted parasitic interconnect RC models with real-world ALD step coverage. Chamber wall passivation shifts baseline thermal emissivity and parasitic wall deposition load, altering effective gas-phase partial pressure delivered to high-aspect-ratio crown arrays. If extraction decks assume a perfectly conformal 15 nm TiN plate without modeling the chamber saturation curve and precursor depletion across 200mm wafers, extracted top-electrode plate resistance will underestimate actual Bitline-to-Capacitor RC delay mismatch by over 18%.
critics.domain_expert: TiCl4 and NH3 chemisorption during chamber seasoning produces solid NH4Cl adducts if cold spots (<150°C) exist in downstream forelines or delivery manifolds. Incomplete line saturation yields non-stoichiometric TiNxCyOz films during initial wafer exposure, creating variable work functions that skew dielectric flatband voltage (Vfb) and cause LVS parameter extraction mismatches. Precursor delivery lines must be seasoned to steady-state vapor pressure equilibrium (TiCl4 bubbler maintained strictly at 30°C ± 0.5°C with heated line jackets at 60°C to 80°C) prior to qualifying PDK layout ground-rules.
critics.supply_chain: Electronic-grade anhydrous NH3 (6N / 99.9999%) and ultra-high-purity TiCl4 (5N5 / 99.9995%) carry stringent lead times and regional hazmat transport controls. Premature seasoning and excessive purge cycles during chamber conditioning deplete high-purity precursor reserves, leading to high scrap rates. Dual-source qualification for precursor canisters and integrated point-of-use residual gas analyzers (RGA) are mandatory to monitor line saturation without burning production-grade raw materials.
critics.laya_pm: The physical verification schedule hinges on completing PDK rule deck parameter extraction within the assigned 3-week MPW tapeout sprint. Interdependencies between ALD hardware line saturation sign-off and DRC density/enclosure validation create a project critical path bottleneck. Running test dummy conditioning wafers in parallel with automated DRC/LVS deck regression ensures that physical parasitic extraction rules accurately reflect validated film resistivity and step coverage profiles without delaying tapeout milestones.
critical_failure_modes: NH4Cl solid adduct accumulation in vacuum pump forelines causing exhaust throttling, back-streaming particulate contamination, and severe crown pinhole shorts.

Incomplete precursor delivery line saturation causing transient GPC (growth per cycle) gradients across the 3D crown array, yielding top-electrode thickness tapering below minimum DRC conformal limits (<10 nm).
Corrosive chlorine ligand (Cl-) retention (>2.0 at%) in seasoned TiN films leading to post-deposition Al-interconnect corrosion and parasitic sheet resistance drift.

testcases.title: TiCl4/NH3 Precursor Line Saturation and Partial Pressure Stability Quantification via In-Situ RGA
testcases.instrumentation: Extorr XT300M In-Situ Residual Gas Analyzer (RGA) mounted downstream of ALD throttle valve, MKS Baratron Capacitance Manometer (0.1 to 10 Torr range), and calibrated He-leak detector.
testcases.pre_conditions: ALD reaction chamber evacuated to base pressure < 1.0e-6 Torr at 380°C stage temperature; precursor manifold heated trace lines stabilized at 75°C ± 1.0°C; TiCl4 source cylinder stabilized at 30°C ± 0.2°C; UHP Ar carrier flow set to 200 sccm.
testcases.procedure: 1. Isolate reaction chamber and execute 50 sequential pulses of TiCl4 (150 ms pulse / 2.0 s Ar purge) into conditioning dump bypass line while tracking m/z = 190 (TiCl4+) and m/z = 155 (TiCl3+). 2. Switch delivery lines to main chamber and execute 100 alternating cycles of TiCl4 (150 ms) / Ar purge (3.0 s) / NH3 (200 ms) / Ar purge (3.0 s) on blanket conditioning dummy wafers. 3. Monitor ion current intensities for baseline cracking fragments (m/z 17, 36, 155, 190) across cycles 80 to 100 to determine precursor line saturation plateaus. 4. Record chamber transient peak pressure on Baratron manometer per cycle.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: TiCl4 cracking fragment peak intensity (m/z 155) must achieve pulse-to-pulse reproducibility of <= +/- 2.5% variation across 20 consecutive pulses; chamber transient peak pressure must stabilize at 1.85 Torr +/- 0.05 Torr; baseline residual Cl2/HCl background during Ar purge must remain below 1.0e-8 A ion current.

testcases.title: Conditioned TiN Conformal Film Sheet Resistance and PDK Parasitic Rs Extraction Verification
testcases.instrumentation: KLA-Tencor OmniMap RS-100 4-Point Probe, Woollam M-2000 Spectroscopic Ellipsometer, and FEI Helios G4 DualBeam FIB-SEM for cross-sectional profile verification.
testcases.pre_conditions: Chamber seasoning completed with minimum 200 cycles TiN pre-coat on chamber walls; test monitor wafer consisting of 180nm node high-aspect-ratio (AR 15:1) etched oxide crowns with underlying Al2O3/ZrO2 dielectric stack loaded.
testcases.procedure: 1. Execute 250 cycles of thermal ALD TiN deposition targeting 15.0 nm nominal thickness at 380°C. 2. Unload wafer to dry N2 purge loadlock and transfer under inert atmosphere to 4-Point Probe. 3. Measure sheet resistance (Rs) across 49-point polar map with 3 mm edge exclusion. 4. Measure film thickness via spectroscopic ellipsometry at identical coordinates. 5. Perform FIB-SEM high-resolution cross-section at center, middle, and edge crown structures to measure 3D step coverage conformality. 6. Extract parasitic resistance parameters and back-annotate into PDK LVS verification rule decks.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Average film thickness = 15.0 nm +/- 0.75 nm (<= 5% 1-sigma non-uniformity across 200mm wafer); Sheet resistance Rs <= 120.0 Ohm/sq with uniformity <= 4.0%; 3D crown sidewall-to-top step coverage >= 95.0% confirmed via SEM; extracted PDK sheet resistance delta from design rule baseline <= 3.5%.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** High-Resolution Film Deposition & Planarization Recipe for ALD Chamber Conditioning and $\text{TiCl}_4/\text{NH}_3$ Precursor Line Saturation Prep  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) | Crown Capacitor MIM Top Electrode  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Base Evacuation    │
│      <2e-6 Torr      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Line and Precursor  │
│       Heating        │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│     TiCl4 / NH3      │
│   Alternating Line   │
│      Saturation      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│     Chamber Wall     │
│   Conditioning 50    │
│        Cycles        │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  In-Situ Vacuum and  │
│  Leak Verification   │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **High-Vacuum Chamber Pumpdown & Base Verification**
   - Pump down the ALD reactor using the turbomolecular and dry backing pump chain to achieve an ultra-clean base vacuum below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to eliminate trace background moisture ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) and atmospheric oxygen ($\text{O}_2$).
   - Verify outgassing and leak-up rates before starting thermal stabilization.

2. **Delivery Line & Precursor Thermal Equilibration**
   - Stabilize the $\text{TiCl}_4$ precursor cylinder, delivery manifold lines, and ALD fast-switching ALD valves within the thermal window (bubbler/source maintained at controlled vapor pressure; lines traced at $60^\circ\text{C}$ to avoid precursor condensation).
   - Stabilize the $\text{NH}_3$ carrier/reaction gas line and main reaction chamber pedestal.

3. **Precursor Line Saturation & Gas-Path Passivation (Pre-Run Soak)**
   - Charge high-purity carrier gas (99.999% purity) into the purge bypass manifolds.
   - Execute an alternating pre-saturation sequence directly to the foreline vacuum bypass:
     - **$\text{TiCl}_4$ Pulse/Purge:** 20 purge/charge pulses to saturate internal electropolished line walls and overcome parasitic adsorption delays.
     - **$\text{NH}_3$ Pulse/Purge:** 20 purge/charge pulses to stabilize mass-flow delivery dynamics and passivate valve seats.

4. **Chamber Wall Undercoat Conditioning (Dummy Pre-Coat Run)**
   - Load clean silicon dummy/conditioning wafers into the chamber.
   - Execute 50 thermal ALD conditioning cycles ($\text{TiCl}_4\text{ pulse} \rightarrow \text{Purge} \rightarrow \text{NH}_3\text{ pulse} \rightarrow \text{Purge}$) to coat the internal chamber walls, showerhead, and pedestal with a thin, conformal TiN undercoat, establishing reproducible surface sticking coefficients and thermal emissivity.

5. **Post-Conditioning Vacuum Recovery & Recipe Ready Handshake**
   - Pump down to base level and run residual gas analyzer (RGA) / pressure decay check to confirm zero precursor line crossover and verify that the chamber is primed for prime 180nm crown capacitor MIM top electrode deposition.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | Calibrated Bayard-Alpert Ion Gauge / Pirani |
| **Purge/Carrier Gas Purity** | $\ge 99.999$ | $\%$ ($5\text{N}$) | In-line Gas Analyzer / Trace Moisture Monitor |
| **Conditioning Cycle Count** | $50$ | $\text{Cycles}$ | Recipe Controller Log |
| **Chamber Leak-Back Rate** | $< 1$ | $\text{mTorr/min}$ | Vacuum Pressure Rise Test |

---

### Context Citations

- **Base Vacuum & Gas Quality:** Parameters calibrated against *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*, which establishes chamber pumpdown threshold below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to suppress oxidation, and high-purity gas delivery at $99.999\%$ ($5\text{N}$).
- **Target Capacitor Integration:** Contextualized to the 180nm MIM stacked crown capacitor architecture and layout specifications detailed in *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* and *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-2-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-2-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of High-Resolution Film Deposition & Planarization Recipe for ALD Chamber Conditioning and TiCl4/NH3 Precursor Line Saturation Prep: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Foundry GDSII Stream-Out & Quality Sign-Off for ALD Chamber Conditioning and $\text{TiCl}_4/\text{NH}_3$ Precursor Line Saturation Prep  
**Node Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 3)  
**Document Link:** [sop_ald_chamber_conditioning_gdsii_signoff.md](./docs/sop_ald_chamber_conditioning_gdsii_signoff.md)

---

### Process Architecture & Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   GDSII Stream-Out &   │
│  DRC/LVS Verification  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      ALD Chamber       │
│     Conditioning &     │
│        Bakeout         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      TiCl4 / NH3       │
│     Precursor Line     │
│       Saturation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Quality Sign-Off &   │
│       Leak Check       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Foundry GDSII Stream-Out & DRC/LVS Quality Sign-Off**:
   - Stream out design layout database in GDSII format targeting an $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ folded bitline capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture.
   - Verify access transistor geometry: gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure bitline and wordline pitch targets are strictly within $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Validate full clean sign-off across design rule checking (DRC) and layout-versus-schematic (LVS) for crown capacitor metal top electrode levels prior to mask write and lot dispatch.

2. **Chamber Vacuum Conditioning & Pump-Down**:
   - Evacuate the thermal ALD deposition reaction chamber using a turbomolecular or cryopump system.
   - Pump down base pressure below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to completely suppress ambient background oxygen and moisture incorporation.
   - Verify chamber wall and gas line heating jacket profiles are stabilized to prevent precursor condensation or cold spots.

3. **$\text{TiCl}_4$ and $\text{NH}_3$ Delivery Line Purge & Precursor Saturation Prep**:
   - Initiate high-purity argon ($\text{Ar } 99.999\%$) carrier/purge gas flow.
   - Execute precursor manifold bypass pulses for $\text{TiCl}_4$ liquid draw and anhydrous $\text{NH}_3$ gas lines to achieve line wall passivation and saturated chemical equilibrium before wafer introduction.

4. **Quality Sign-Off & Environmental Readiness**:
   - Verify chamber pressure stability, precursor dose repeatability, and mass flow controller (MFC) response.
   - Sign off chamber certification for conformal $\text{TiN}$ top metal electrode deposition over the 3D high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor structure (interfacing with high-$\kappa$ dielectric stacks like $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
    WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                    │▒                                 │
   Leakage Cur (<fA)┤▒                                 │
Data Reten @85C (ms)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
Min Capacitance (fF)┤████                              │
                    │████                              │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0      90       180     270    360 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum Pressure** | $< 2 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{Torr}$ | In-situ Ion Gauge / RGA |
| **Minimum Storage Capacitance** | $\ge 28$ (Design budget: $25 - 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Parametric C-V Wafer Sort Test |
| **Data Retention Time (@ 85°C)** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Automated DRAM Array Test |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage (@ 85°C)** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC Parametric Semiconductor Analyzer |
| **Wordline & Bitline Pitch** | $360 - 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / Optical GDSII Verification |

---

### 3. Citations & Contextual Basis

- **Vacuum Conditioning Parameters**: Base vacuum limit $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ with turbomolecular or cryopump and high-purity argon ($\text{Ar } 99.999\%$) cited from *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects*.
- **Device Dimensions & Cell Capacitance Budget**: Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum cell capacitance budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$), high-$\kappa$ target ($\kappa > 15$), and sub-threshold/junction leakage current limit ($< 1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$) cited from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*.
- **Retention & Pitch Limits**: Wordline/bitline pitch range ($360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$), data retention target ($> 64\text{ ms at } 85^\circ\text{C}$), and cell storage capacitance range ($25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$) cited from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-1-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Foundry GDSII Stream-Out & Quality Sign-Off for ALD Chamber Conditioning and TiCl4/NH3 Precursor Line Saturation Prep: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Thermal ALD TiN Conformal Top Electrode Cyclic Recipe Deposition

**Category**: Thin Film Deposition | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal ALD of TiN on high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitor structures requires balancing cyclic precursor residence times with high vacuum conductance. The TiCl4/NH3 surface exchange reaction generates corrosive HCl byproduct gas and NH4Cl solid salt condensates if the reactor exhaust line drops below 160°C. Chamber purge duration must be dynamically mapped against the crown cavity aspect ratio (AR ~12:1 to 15:1 for 180nm DRAM node) to prevent parasitic gas-phase CVD nucleation while avoiding prohibitive recipe cycle overheads.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Deposition temperature window must be strictly confined to 380°C - 420°C. Temperatures below 380°C result in excessive residual chlorine (>3.5 at.%) within the TiN lattice, which degrades work function alignment, elevates resistivity above 250 micro-ohm-cm, and risks HCl outgassing that corrodes subsequent metal layers. Conversely, temperatures exceeding 420°C degrade thermal budget of the underlying high-k dielectric (e.g. Al2O3/HfO2) stack through interfacial crystallization and interdiffusion, accelerating capacitor leakage current.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Ultra-high purity TiCl4 (Grade 6N, 99.9999% trace-metal basis) and semiconductor-grade anhydrous NH3 (Grade 5N5) require dedicated point-of-use gas cabinets with automated coaxial double-containment leak detection. TiCl4 bubbler delivery requires temperature control at 25.0°C ± 0.2°C with heated vapor delivery manifolds (>60°C) to prevent line condensation, while lead times for electro-polished Hastelloy ALD diaphragm valves and point-of-use scrubbers exceed 16 to 22 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal ALD TiN deposition is the pacing gating item for 3D Crown Module completion. The cyclic deposition rate (~0.25 to 0.35 Å/cycle) implies that depositing a 15 nm conformal top electrode necessitates approximately 500 cycles, consuming ~180 minutes of chamber processing time per batch. Any unplanned chamber maintenance caused by NH4Cl clogging in the downstream throttle valve will cause immediate schedule slippage in the Stage 1 fab milestone.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sub-stoichiometric TiNx with elevated Cl contamination (>4 at.%) due to inadequate NH3 exposure or sub-optimal purge temperature, resulting in electrode resistivity spiking >350 micro-ohm-cm.
1. Incomplete sidewall and bottom step coverage (<95%) inside high-aspect-ratio crown cavities due to precursor depletion or inadequate TiCl4 dose time.
1. Downstream exhaust throttle valve and foreline seizure driven by solid ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) salt deposition, inducing chamber backstreaming and wafer lot scrap.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-01` | **Conformal TiN Thickness and Step Coverage Verification on 3D Crown Aspect Ratio Structures** | High-Resolution Cross-Sectional Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscopy (HR-FESEM) and Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) | 1. Execute 500 ALD cycles consisting of: TiCl4 pulse (0.8s) -> N2 purge (3.0s) -> NH3 pulse (1.2s) -> N2 purge (3.0s) at 400°C and 1.5 Torr process pressure. 2. Cool wafer to <100°C in loadlock and unload. 3. Measure blanket reference wafer at 49 points using Spectroscopic Ellipsometry to verify thickness uniformity. 4. Cleave patterned crown wafer across center and edge dies. 5. Inspect cross-sections via HR-FESEM at 100kX magnification, measuring TiN film thickness at top surface, middle sidewall (50% depth), and crown trench bottom. | `Total nominal top film thickness = 15.0 nm ± 1.0 nm. Conformality / Step Coverage (Ratio of bottom/sidewall thickness to top planar thickness) >= 95.0% across all measured locations. 49-point wafer thickness uniformity 1-sigma <= 1.8%.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-02` | **TiN Film Resistivity and Residual Chlorine Impurity Level Characterization** | Four-Point Probe (4PP) Sheet Resistance Metrology and X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) / Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) | 1. Measure sheet resistance (R_s) at 25 points on blanket monitor wafer via calibrated 4PP. 2. Calculate bulk film resistivity (rho = R_s * film_thickness). 3. Transfer wafer into XPS ultra-high vacuum chamber (<5x10^-9 Torr). 4. Perform surface Ar+ sputter clean (10 nm etch) to remove atmospheric adventitious carbon/oxygen. 5. Acquire core-level spectra for Ti 2p, N 1s, O 1s, and Cl 2p peaks. 6. Integrate peak areas and apply relative sensitivity factors to calculate atomic concentration ratios. | `TiN bulk resistivity <= 200 micro-ohm-cm. Ti:N stoichiometry ratio between 0.95 and 1.05. Residual chlorine atomic concentration [Cl] <= 2.0 at.%. Oxygen contamination [O] <= 1.5 at.%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B / Level C Chemical Protection Hazmat Suit (Tychem 6000 or equivalent), Full-face air-purifying respirator (P100 filter combined with acid gas / ammonia multi-contaminant cartridge) or supplied-air respirator (SCBA) during maintenance, Double-layered heavy-duty butyl/neoprene outer gloves over nitrile inner gloves, Chemical splash apron, safety face shield, and chemical-resistant steel-toe boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Immediately flush eyes at dedicated eye-wash station with copious flowing demineralized water for at least 15-20 minutes, holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Immediately remove contaminated clothing under safety shower; flush affected skin with water for 15 minutes. Note: TiCl4 reacts exothermically with moisture releasing toxic HCl and TiO2 fumes; blot excess liquid off dry skin with inert cloth before drenching to minimize thermal burn severity. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh air immediately; administer humidified medical oxygen if breathing is labored; alert emergency medical services immediately for risk of pulmonary edema.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated corrosive/toxic exhaust line with minimum negative static duct pressure of -1.5 in. w.g.; heated forelines and vacuum exhaust manifold maintained at >= 160°C to inhibit solid ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) crystallization; continuous integration to point-of-use wet-chemical counter-current scrubbing system.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhaust gases routed through point-of-use water/caustic (NaOH) scrubber column to hydrolyze TiCl4, neutralize HCl gas, and dissolve NH4Cl. Liquid scrubber effluent neutralized to pH 6.5 - 8.5 via automated sodium hydroxide dosing before discharging to fab industrial waste treatment facility; precipitated TiO2 solids separated via mechanical flocculation and filtration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (TiCl4)** | `7550-45-0` | Grade 6N (99.9999% trace metals basis) | `>= 99.999%` |
| **Anhydrous Ammonia (NH3)** | `7664-41-7` | Electronic Grade 5N5 (99.9995%) | `>= 99.999%` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (Byproduct in Exhaust)** | `7647-01-0` | Process effluent byproduct | `Variable gas-phase effluent` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited and post-annealed 3D crown high-k dielectric (Al2O3/HfO2) pristine surface, free of organic hydrocarbons, water condensation, or native oxide nucleation defects.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal, chemically stable 15 nm TiN top electrode film; capped in dry N2 purged FOUP to prevent atmospheric oxidation into TiO2/TiON.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time before TiN deposition leads to atmospheric moisture adsorption and ambient fluorine/carbon contamination on high-k dielectric surface, creating interfacial traps (D_it), increasing capacitor leakage current (>1.0 fA/cell), and inducing dielectric breakdown during subsequent high-temperature anneal.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical, dimensional, and electrical sign-off of a highly conformal (>=95% step coverage) 15.0 nm thermal ALD TiN top electrode deposited across high-aspect-ratio (AR ~12:1) 3D crown capacitor structures, achieving bulk resistivity <= 200 micro-ohm-cm and Cl impurity <= 2.0 at.%.

critics.systems_engineer: Thermal ALD of TiN on high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitor structures requires balancing cyclic precursor residence times with high vacuum conductance. The TiCl4/NH3 surface exchange reaction generates corrosive HCl byproduct gas and NH4Cl solid salt condensates if the reactor exhaust line drops below 160°C. Chamber purge duration must be dynamically mapped against the crown cavity aspect ratio (AR ~12:1 to 15:1 for 180nm DRAM node) to prevent parasitic gas-phase CVD nucleation while avoiding prohibitive recipe cycle overheads.
critics.domain_expert: Deposition temperature window must be strictly confined to 380°C - 420°C. Temperatures below 380°C result in excessive residual chlorine (>3.5 at.%) within the TiN lattice, which degrades work function alignment, elevates resistivity above 250 micro-ohm-cm, and risks HCl outgassing that corrodes subsequent metal layers. Conversely, temperatures exceeding 420°C degrade thermal budget of the underlying high-k dielectric (e.g. Al2O3/HfO2) stack through interfacial crystallization and interdiffusion, accelerating capacitor leakage current.
critics.supply_chain: Ultra-high purity TiCl4 (Grade 6N, 99.9999% trace-metal basis) and semiconductor-grade anhydrous NH3 (Grade 5N5) require dedicated point-of-use gas cabinets with automated coaxial double-containment leak detection. TiCl4 bubbler delivery requires temperature control at 25.0°C ± 0.2°C with heated vapor delivery manifolds (>60°C) to prevent line condensation, while lead times for electro-polished Hastelloy ALD diaphragm valves and point-of-use scrubbers exceed 16 to 22 weeks.
critics.laya_pm: Thermal ALD TiN deposition is the pacing gating item for 3D Crown Module completion. The cyclic deposition rate (~0.25 to 0.35 Å/cycle) implies that depositing a 15 nm conformal top electrode necessitates approximately 500 cycles, consuming ~180 minutes of chamber processing time per batch. Any unplanned chamber maintenance caused by NH4Cl clogging in the downstream throttle valve will cause immediate schedule slippage in the Stage 1 fab milestone.
critical_failure_modes: Sub-stoichiometric TiNx with elevated Cl contamination (>4 at.%) due to inadequate NH3 exposure or sub-optimal purge temperature, resulting in electrode resistivity spiking >350 micro-ohm-cm.
Incomplete sidewall and bottom step coverage (<95%) inside high-aspect-ratio crown cavities due to precursor depletion or inadequate TiCl4 dose time.
Downstream exhaust throttle valve and foreline seizure driven by solid ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) salt deposition, inducing chamber backstreaming and wafer lot scrap.

nodes.sop_content:
The leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for **ALD Chamber Conditioning and $\text{TiCl}_4$/$\text{NH}_3$ Precursor Pulse Calibration** has been authored and saved to [sop_ald_chamber_conditioning_ticl4_nh3_pulse_calibration.md](./docs/sop_ald_chamber_conditioning_ticl4_nh3_pulse_calibration.md).

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│   Chamber Bakeout & Base Vacuum Pump-Down    │
│            (< 2.0e-6 Torr Check)             │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│    Thermal Wall & Stage Temperature Soak     │
│             (T_stage: 380°C - 420°C)         │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Chamber Wall Passivation Conditioning    │
│        (50 Dummy Cyclic ALD TiN Pulses)      │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│    Precursor Pulse & Purge Dose Saturation   │
│     Calibration (TiCl4 & NH3 Fast Valves)    │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│   GPC Growth & Uniformity Test Verification  │
│         (Ellipsometry / 4-Point Probe)       │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure Summary

1. **Chamber Evacuation & Base Vacuum Verification**:
   - Verify precursor isolation valves for $\text{TiCl}_4$ and $\text{NH}_3$ are locked closed.
   - Engage dry roots blower and turbomolecular pump (TMP) / cryopump train; pump down to base pressure below $2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to suppress background $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ and $\text{O}_2$ contamination.
   - Perform a 60-second rate-of-rise (ROR) leak-back check to confirm leak rate $< 0.5\text{ mTorr/min}$.

2. **Thermal Stabilization & Gas Flow Balancing**:
   - Set chamber outer wall heating jacket to $150^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ and precursor delivery line jackets to $120^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ to avoid byproduct $\text{NH}_4\text{Cl}$ or $\text{TiCl}_4$ condensation.
   - Heat substrate chuck to $400^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ (operational window $380^\circ\text{C} - 420^\circ\text{C}$); soak for 30 minutes.
   - Establish continuous UHP (99.999%) carrier flows: $100\text{ sccm}$ $\text{N}_2$/$\text{Ar}$ through both $\text{TiCl}_4$ and $\text{NH}_3$ lines, and throttle dynamic working pressure to $0.8 - 1.2\text{ Torr}$.

3. **Chamber Wall Passivation Conditioning**:
   - Maintain $\text{TiCl}_4$ bubbler source at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ ($\approx 10\text{ Torr}$ vapor pressure); supply anhydrous $\text{NH}_3$ through POU purifier at $15\text{ psig} \pm 1\text{ psig}$.
   - Load a 200mm dummy silicon monitor wafer and execute a 50-cycle passivation recipe:
     $$\text{TiCl}_4\ (0.20\text{ s}) \rightarrow \text{Purge}\ (3.0\text{ s}) \rightarrow \text{NH}_3\ (0.30\text{ s}) \rightarrow \text{Purge}\ (3.0\text{ s})$$
   - Confirm steady foreline transient pressure peaks on RGA/pressure transducers.

4. **$\text{TiCl}_4$ / $\text{NH}_3$ Precursor Pulse & Purge Time Calibration**:
   - **$\text{TiCl}_4$ Pulse Optimization**: Pulse widths evaluated from $0.05\text{ s}$ to $0.35\text{ s}$ at 100 cycles each to locate the self-limiting chemisorption plateau ($0.15\text{ s} - 0.20\text{ s}$).
   - **$\text{NH}_3$ Pulse Optimization**: Evaluated from $0.10\text{ s}$ to $0.50\text{ s}$ to achieve stoichiometric nitridation saturation ($0.25\text{ s} - 0.30\text{ s}$).
   - **Purge Interlock Optimization**: Validate purge durations down to $3.0\text{ s}$ to eliminate gas-phase parasitic CVD reactions and particle generation.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Tool | Pass/Fail Interlock Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chamber Base Vacuum** | $< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ | Penning / Bayard-Alpert Ion Gauge | Recipe abort if base pressure $> 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ |
| **Growth Per Cycle (GPC)** | $0.022\text{ nm/cycle} \pm 0.003\text{ nm/cycle}$ ($0.22 \pm 0.03\text{ \AA/cycle}$) | Multi-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry | Reject if $\Delta\text{GPC} > \pm 0.003\text{ nm/cycle}$ (out of ALD self-limiting regime) |
| **Within-Wafer Non-Uniformity (WIWNU)** | $< 2.5\%\text{ (1}\sigma\text{)}$ across 200mm wafer ($3\text{mm}$ edge exclusion) | 49-point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Map | Re-tune carrier/purge gas balance if $\sigma > 2.5\%$ |
| **TiN Film Resistivity ($\rho$)** | $< 180\ \mu\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ ($R_s < 90\ \Omega/\text{sq}$ at $20\text{ nm}$) | In-line 4-Point Resistivity Probe (4PP) | Reject if chlorine incorporation causes $\rho \ge 200\ \mu\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |

---

### Context Citations

1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Conformal TiN top electrode capping on high-aspect-ratio 3D crown stacked capacitor structures over bitline (COB) is essential to preserve the minimum $> 28\text{ fF/cell}$ cell capacitance budget and keep leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - 1T1C stacked crown capacitor design requiring $25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ capacitance retention with ultra-thin high-k dielectrics ($3 - 4\text{ nm}$ EOT), demanding low thermal budget and pinhole-free self-limiting cyclic deposition.
3. **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
   - Vacuum base pressure standard ($< 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$) utilizing high-vacuum turbomolecular/cryogenic pumping to eliminate residual oxygen/moisture before reactive processing.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-1-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-1-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
