# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Thermal ALD Multi-Cycle TiN Top Electrode Deposition Run

**Module:** Thin Film Deposition / Nanofabrication  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 3, Stacked Crown Capacitor Architecture)  
**Process Equipment:** Thermal Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) Hot-Wall Reactor  
**Precursors:** Titanium Tetrachloride ($\text{TiCl}_4$) + Anhydrous Ammonia ($\text{NH}_3$)  

---

### 1. Process Flow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│        Pumpdown        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pre-Dep Thermal Soak  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    ALD Super-Cycle     │
│      TiCl4 / NH3       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-Dep Purge &    │
│          Vent          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   In-Line Metrology    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Load Lock & Chamber Pumpdown**
   - Transfer pattern-inspected 180nm DRAM wafer with high-k dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or ONO stack over W-plug contacts) from load lock to ALD reaction chamber.
   - Evacuate reaction chamber using turbomolecular vacuum pump to a base pressure $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to remove residual moisture and atmospheric oxygen.
   - Stabilize continuous carrier gas: High-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$ 99.999%) / Argon ($\text{Ar}$) purge flow at working pressure $0.5 - 2.0\text{ Torr}$.

2. **Substrate Thermal Equalization**
   - Heat substrate stage to $400^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring thermal budget remains compatible with underlying access transistor: gate oxide dry $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ and back-end metallization stability limit).
   - Soak wafer under inert $\text{N}_2$ flow for $10\text{ minutes}$ to ensure uniform wafer temperature across the 3D crown capacitor array.

3. **Multi-Cycle Thermal ALD Sequence ($\text{TiCl}_4 / \text{NH}_3$)**
   - **Step A ($\text{TiCl}_4$ Pulse):** Dose $\text{TiCl}_4$ vapor for $0.2 - 0.5\text{ s}$ using carrier gas into the reaction zone; complete self-terminating surface chlorination of the dielectric interface.
   - **Step B ($\text{N}_2$ Purge):** Purge chamber with inert $\text{N}_2$ for $2.0 - 5.0\text{ s}$ to evacuate unreacted $\text{TiCl}_4$ molecules and byproducts.
   - **Step C ($\text{NH}_3$ Pulse):** Pulse anhydrous $\text{NH}_3$ for $0.5 - 1.0\text{ s}$ to nitridize surface complexes into TiN with volatile $\text{HCl}$ byproduct formation.
   - **Step D ($\text{N}_2$ Purge):** Purge chamber with inert $\text{N}_2$ for $2.0 - 5.0\text{ s}$ to sweep out residual $\text{NH}_3$ and $\text{HCl}$.
   - **Loop Execution:** Repeat Steps A through D for target cyclic count ($\sim 300 - 500\text{ cycles}$ at typical growth rate of $0.03 - 0.05\text{ nm/cycle}$) to achieve physical TiN top electrode thickness of $15 - 25\text{ nm}$ conformal coverage inside high-aspect-ratio 3D crown structures.

4. **Chamber Evacuation & Unload**
   - Stop precursor manifold valving; run dynamic pump-and-purge cycle with $\text{N}_2$ ($5\text{ cycles}$).
   - Vent load lock with dry $\text{N}_2$ and transfer wafer to wafer cassette under cleanroom Class 1 laminar flow.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                            ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                            │░░                                │
Leakage Limit @85C (fA/cell)┤░░                                │
   Dielectric Stack EOT (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒                             │
                            │▒▒▒▒▒                             │
Capacitance Target (fF/cell)┤██████████████████████████████████│
                            │██████████████████████████████████│
                            └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                             0       7       14      21      28 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Method / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance** | $\mathbf{28\text{ fF/cell}}$ | $\ge 25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ | Quasi-static C-V / LCR probe at $10\text{ kHz}$ across crown array |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $\mathbf{3.5\text{ nm}}$ | $3.0 - 4.0\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / extracted from C-V accumulation |
| **Storage Cell Leakage Current** | $<\mathbf{1.0\text{ fA/cell}}$ | $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | Parameter analyzer probe measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($t_{\text{retention}} > 64\text{ ms}$) |
| **Deposition Base Vacuum** | $< \mathbf{2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}}$ | Max $2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ | In-situ cold cathode / ion vacuum gauge prior to precursor flow |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Capacitance & Leakage Targets:** Sourced from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity; leakage current kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; crown-shaped MIM structure erected above drain contact via W-plug).
- **Retention & Dielectric EOT Limits:** Sourced from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Storage capacitor maintains $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; stacked crown dielectric EOT around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ with $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$; gate dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Vacuum Deposition & Thermal Envelope:** Sourced from *Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects* (Chamber base pressure criteria below $2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$; thermal processing constraints for metal lines and post-metal anneal at $400^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-2-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-2-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Thermal ALD Multi-Cycle TiN Top Electrode Deposition Run: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-TIN-001`
**Title:** Crown Capacitor TiN Top Metal Electrode Step Coverage & Sheet Resistance Metrology  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > 3D High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor ALD Dielectric & Metal Electrode Deposition > Conformal CVD/ALD TiN Top Metal Electrode Deposition > Thermal ALD Ti4Cl/NH3 Conformal Top Electrode Recipe Execution > Thermal ALD TiN Conformal Top Electrode Cyclic Recipe Deposition > Crown Capacitor TiN Step Coverage and Sheet Resistance Metrology  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm)  
**Action Type:** Buy / Foundry Execution & In-line Metrology  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the quantitative verification protocol for assessing the physical conformality (step coverage) and electrical conductivity (sheet resistance, $R_s$) of thermal ALD titanium nitride ($\text{TiN}$) deposited as the top metal electrode over 3D high-aspect-ratio (HAR) crown capacitor structures in an 8F²/6F² 180nm DRAM cell architecture.

---

### 2. Required Metrology Equipment & Tools
1. **In-Line Dual-Beam FIB-SEM (Focused Ion Beam / High-Resolution Scanning Electron Microscope):**
   - Gallium ($Ga^+$) liquid metal ion source for cross-sectional trench milling.
   - Field Emission SEM (FE-SEM) equipped with in-lens secondary electron detector, operating at $1.0\text{--}2.0\text{ kV}$ beam voltage and working distance $\le 4.0\text{ mm}$ for non-charging sub-nanometer crown profile inspection.
2. **Automated 4-Point Probe (4PP) Resistivity Metrology System:**
   - Dual-configuration automated mapping tool with tungsten carbide tips (tip radius $100\ \mu\text{m}$, probe spacing $1.0\text{ mm}$, loading force $50\text{--}100\text{ g}$).
3. **Dedicated In-Die Test Vehicle Structures:**
   - 4-point Kelvin cross-bridge sheet resistance structures ($100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ test pads compatible with standard probe tips) located in the scribe-line / kerf region.
   - Array-edge crown capacitor test matrices over bitline contacts and tungsten plugs (W-plugs).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                            PROCEDURE FLOW OVERVIEW                                |
|                                                                                   |
|  [Step 1] Wafer Inspection & In-Die Macro Registration                            |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [Step 2] Sheet Resistance (Rs) 4PP & Kelvin Cross-Bridge Metrology               |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [Step 3] FIB Precision Cross-Section Preparation                                 |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [Step 4] High-Resolution In-Lens FE-SEM Step Coverage Measurement               |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [Step 5] Quantitative Calculation, Lot Acceptance & Hold Criteria                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Wafer Inspection & Macro Alignment
1. Load the 200 mm post-ALD TiN top electrode wafer onto the automated metrology stage under class-1 cleanroom laminar flow.
2. Align the wafer notch to $0^\circ$ and register the coordinate frame using the active array fiducials defined by the 180nm cell pitch (bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).

#### Step 2: Sheet Resistance ($R_s$) Measurement
1. **Planar Monitor / Kerf Kelvin Bridge Verification:**
   - Move probe head to scribe-line test pads ($100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ area).
   - Apply a constant current $I = 1.00\text{ mA}$ through force terminals; measure voltage drop $V$ across sense terminals at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Calculate sheet resistance: $R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln(2)} \cdot \frac{V}{I} \cdot f_{\text{corr}} \approx 4.532 \cdot \frac{V}{I}$.
2. **Radial Multi-Point Mapping:**
   - Execute 49-point automated radial contour scan across the wafer to ensure within-wafer (WIW) sheet resistance non-uniformity is $< 3.0\%$ ($1\sigma$).

#### Step 3: Dual-Beam FIB Precision Cross-Section Milling
1. Drive stage to the target 3D crown capacitor array site directly adjacent to the drain contact W-plug.
2. Deposit an in-situ electron-beam protective platinum ($\text{Pt}$) strap ($1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ thick, $2\ \mu\text{m} \times 10\ \mu\text{m}$ area) at $2.0\text{ kV}$, followed by ion-beam $\text{Pt}$ deposition at $30\text{ kV}, 80\text{ pA}$ to shield crown top corners from ion milling artifacts.
3. Rough-mill a trapezoidal trench at $30\text{ kV}, 0.79\text{ nA}$ beam current to expose the crown sidewalls.
4. Clean-mill/polish the cross-sectional viewing face at low ion energy ($5\text{ kV}, 48\text{ pA}$, followed by $2\text{ kV}$ polish) to remove amorphized silicon/gallium contamination.

#### Step 4: High-Resolution FE-SEM Step Coverage Measurement
1. Tilt stage to $52^\circ$ (orthogonal to electron optical axis) and focus FE-SEM at $1.5\text{ kV}, 50\text{ pA}$ in immersion/in-lens mode.
2. Measure TiN physical film thickness at three distinct locations along the crown capacitor profile:
   - **$T_{\text{top}}$**: TiN thickness on the horizontal field/top surface of the crown rim.
   - **$T_{\text{side\_mid}}$**: TiN thickness along the vertical inner sidewall at 50% cavity depth.
   - **$T_{\text{bottom}}$**: TiN thickness at the lowest interior re-entrant base of the crown cavity directly over the ONO/$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric.
3. Calculate physical step coverage metrics:
   $$\text{Bottom Step Coverage (\%)} = \left(\frac{T_{\text{bottom}}}{T_{\text{top}}}\right) \times 100$$
   $$\text{Sidewall Step Coverage (\%)} = \left(\frac{T_{\text{side\_mid}}}{T_{\text{top}}}\right) \times 100$$

#### Step 5: Data Recording & Quality Discard Logic
1. Validate that electrode uniformity does not pinch off the cylindrical aperture required for backfill integration.
2. Upload metrology log (thickness, $R_s$, coordinates) into the DRAM Manufacturing Execution System (MES).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Metrology Method | Action on Excursion |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TiN Bottom Step Coverage** | $\ge 90.0\%$ | $\%$ ($\frac{T_{\text{bottom}}}{T_{\text{top}}} \times 100$) | In-Line FE-SEM / FIB Cross-section | Hold lot; recalibrate $\text{TiCl}_4 / \text{NH}_3$ ALD purge & precursor exposure times |
| **TiN Sidewall Step Coverage** | $\ge 92.0\%$ | $\%$ ($\frac{T_{\text{side\_mid}}}{T_{\text{top}}} \times 100$) | In-Line FE-SEM / FIB Cross-section | Hold lot; inspect thermal chamber temperature gradient |
| **Planar TiN Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $80.0 \le R_s \le 150.0$ | $\Omega/\text{sq}$ ($\Omega/\square$) | 4-Point Probe / Kelvin Cross-Bridge ($100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ pad) | Scrape sample if $R_s > 180\ \Omega/\text{sq}$ (under-chlorinated or oxidized film) |
| **Crown Dielectric Leakage In-Line Baseline** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Automated Parametric Analyzer (W-Plug to Top TiN) | Engineering disposition for dielectric pinhole or TiN punch-through |

---

### 5. Context Sources & Literature References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Layout architectures ($8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline, stacked capacitor over bitline/COB).
  - Geometry and structures: Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$), drain contact tungsten plug (W-plug), crown-shaped metal-insulator-metal (MIM) stack, ONO and $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectrics ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Target cell capacitance ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$) and leakage current ceiling ($\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor (Crown/Cylinder) storage capacitance budget ($25\text{--}30\text{ fF/cell}$), cell retention target ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
  - Dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT: $3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$); bitline/wordline array pitch ($360\text{--}400\text{ nm}$).
- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging:**
  - In-die probe/bonding pad standard envelope ($100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm 1T1C stacked crown architecture with an aspect ratio exceeding 10:1 to achieve 25-30 fF per cell, non-conformal TiN top electrode deposition drastically increases series parasitic resistance (Rs) and induces RC delay penalties on cell access times. Furthermore, micro-loading across the crown cylinder sidewalls modifies effective work function and creates asymmetrical electric field gradients across the Si3N4/Ta2O5 dielectric stack, jeopardizing 64 ms retention budgets at 85°C.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Thermal ALD TiN utilizing TiCl4 and NH3 precursors inherently risks residual chlorine incorporation (>1.5 at%) if reaction temperatures fall below 400°C or if purge cycles are insufficient. In deep 3D crown recesses, Knudsen diffusion bottlenecks can lead to starved NH3 delivery at the capacitor bottom, degrading step coverage below the critical 90% threshold and accelerating dielectric degradation via Cl migration during post-metal anneal (PMA). Cross-sectional HR-SEM/TEM coupled with four-point probe monitoring on monitor coupons is mandatory.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Ultra-high-purity TiCl4 (99.999%) and anhydrous semiconductor-grade NH3 supply chains face periodic lead-time volatility and stringent canister qualification hurdles. Reliance on specialized inline high-resolution cross-sectional SEM/FIB and ultra-shallow automated 4-point probe equipment requires multi-vendor servicing agreements and contingency calibration wafers to prevent fab-wide pilot line halts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology turnaround time for cross-sectional FIB-SEM preparation and sheet resistance mapping currently risks exceeding our pilot cycle-time target of 4 hours per qualification lot. Destructive physical analysis (DPA) must be restricted to coupon cutouts or dedicated scribe-line test macro arrays to prevent wafer scrapping and minimize overall MPW wafer loss.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bottom-to-top sidewall TiN thickness pinch-off resulting in <85% step coverage and localized capacitor electrode voids
1. Chlorine outgassing (residual Cl > 2.0 at%) causing TiN peeling, film delamination, and dielectric leakage degradation
1. Excessive TiN sheet resistance (>120 Ohm/sq on 20 nm nominal film) driving cell RC time constant beyond retention refresh timing limits

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-3-01` | **Crown Capacitor TiN High-Aspect-Ratio Step Coverage Cross-Sectional SEM/TEM Verification** | Dual-Beam Focused Ion Beam and High-Resolution Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FIB-SEM / HR-TEM) | 1. Transfer wafer to Dual-Beam FIB-SEM chamber. 2. Deposit protective Pt cap layer (1.5 um) over target crown cell test macro. 3. Mill high-precision cross-sectional trench perpendicular to the crown capacitor array using Ga+ ion beam at 30 kV followed by low-kV (2-5 kV) polish. 4. Acquire HR-SEM micrographs at 100,000x to 250,000x magnification at 5 distinct vertical locations: top horizontal surface, upper sidewall (90% height), mid sidewall (50% height), lower sidewall (10% height), and bottom center. 5. Measure physical film thickness at each location using calibrated line-profile cursors across 10 adjacent crown cells. | `Bottom-to-top step coverage ratio (t_bottom / t_top * 100%) >= 90.0% and sidewall step coverage ratio (t_min_sidewall / t_top * 100%) >= 88.0% across all 10 measured cells; zero visual voids, pinch-offs, or delamination.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-2-3-02` | **ALD TiN Top Electrode Sheet Resistance and Specific Contact Resistivity Metrology via TLM and 4PP** | Automated 4-Point Probe (4PP) Mapping System and Semi-Automated Micro-Probe Station with Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Measure sheet resistance (Rs) across 49-point polar map on planar monitor wafer using calibrated automated four-point probe. 2. Calculate mean sheet resistance and across-wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma %). 3. Move production wafer to probe station and establish 4-terminal Kelvin contact to TLM test pads. 4. Sweep DC current from -5 mA to +5 mA and record voltage drop across each gap distance (5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um). 5. Extract total resistance R_T vs gap spacing d, performing least-squares linear regression to determine slope (Rs/W), y-intercept (2*Rc), and transfer length L_T. 6. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = Rc * W * L_T. | `Planar 4PP TiN sheet resistance Rs <= 80.0 Ohm/sq with 1-sigma non-uniformity < 3.0%; TLM-extracted specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), Chemical splash goggles with ANSI Z87.1 side shields, Flame-resistant anti-static cleanroom gowning, Acid gas / vapor half-face respirator (available for coupon FIB prep with HF post-etch)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TiCl4/acid gas inhalation, evacuate immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For skin contact with acidic reaction byproducts or HF deprocess reagents, immediately drench under emergency shower for 15 minutes and apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously while seeking immediate emergency medical treatment. For eye exposure, irrigate with sterile saline or isotonic eyewash for >= 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous toxic gas monitoring for NH3 (TLV: 25 ppm, ceiling alarm at 15 ppm) and Cl2/HCl (ceiling alarm at 1 ppm); chemical wet scrubber exhaust with dedicated laminar extraction hoods operating at minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); emergency power backup for all exhaust blowers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhausted process effluents routed through centralized wet acid-base scrubbers using circulating caustic NaOH solution for HCl/TiCl4 neutralization, followed by dedicated ammonia bio-scrubber or thermal oxidizer. Liquid analytical waste collected in heavy-duty polyethylene carboys, pH neutralized to 6.5-8.5 prior to certified fab wastewater handling.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4)** | `7550-45-0` | Optoelectronic / Electronic Grade (5N) | `99.999%` |
| **Anhydrous Ammonia (NH3)** | `7664-41-7` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP 5N5) | `99.9995%` |
| **Hydrofluoric acid (HF - used in optional coupon DPA bevel deprocessing)** | `7664-39-3` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `0.5% - 49%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN top electrode, pristine metallic gold-brown film free of native TiO2 passivation and moisture condensation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized, passivated/cleared wafer under high-purity N2 purge, ready for pre-metal dielectric (PMD) CVD oxide deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Ambient atmospheric exposure past 60 minutes drives spontaneous surface oxidation of TiN into high-resistivity oxynitride (TiOxNy) and moisture-induced hydrolytic corrosion from trace Cl residues, increasing sheet resistance >25% and degrading inter-layer contact resistance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical and electrical validation of the ALD TiN top electrode within 180nm crown capacitor matrices, verifying >=90% step coverage across AR 10:1 cylindrical features, sheet resistance <= 80 Ohm/sq on 20 nm nominal film, and specific contact resistivity <= 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2 with zero adhesion failures or pinhole defects.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `MET_CROWN_TIN_STEP_COVERAGE_HRTEM_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `MET_CROWN_TIN_4PP_SHEET_RESISTANCE_49PTS_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `MET_CROWN_TIN_TLM_CONTACT_RESISTIVITY_EXTRACT.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Bottom-to-top TiN physical step coverage inside crown capacitor cylinder** | `92.0%` | +/- 2.0% (Lower specification limit >= 90.0%) | Calibrated cross-sectional FIB/HR-SEM line scan at bottom center vs top horizontal baseline |
| `ASSERT-02` | **ALD TiN planar sheet resistance (Rs)** | `75.0 Ohm/sq` | +/- 5.0 Ohm/sq (Upper specification limit <= 80.0 Ohm/sq) | Automated 49-point dual-configuration four-point probe mapping |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Specific contact resistivity (rho_c) to top plate metallization via TLM** | `7.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2` | +/- 2.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2 (Upper specification limit <= 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2) | 4-wire Kelvin DC sweep on scribe-line TLM test array (gaps 5-80 um) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Engineering sign-off requires meeting all 3 quantitative assertions across 3 consecutive pilot wafer runs, verification of zero interfacial peeling/delamination under cross-sectional TEM, residual Cl content <= 1.5 at% confirmed by EDX/XPS, and complete metrology archival within the fab MES before Q-time expiration.

# Standard Operating Procedure: TiN Top Electrode Step-Coverage Cross-Sectional SEM and Sheet Resistance Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-ALD TiN characterization must isolate bottom/sidewall step-coverage inside 180nm crown capacitor trenches (aspect ratio 15:1 to 20:1) without destroying adjacent cell plate continuity. Standard top-down sheet resistance via four-point probe (4PP) averages planar film thickness and is blind to bottom-trench thinning or voiding; cross-sectional DualBeam FIB-SEM cleaving and STEM lamella sampling are mandatory to establish true step-coverage metrics across wafer edge and center.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Thermal ALD TiN from TiCl4/NH3 typically suffers from chlorine incorporation (0.5-3.0 at.%) if deposition temperature is held below 400°C to protect peripheral CMOS metal gates. This residual chlorine directly degrades resistivity (>150 µΩ·cm) and accelerates TiOxNy oxidation upon ambient exposure. Step coverage must achieve ≥90% at the trench bottom, and resistivity extracted from planar 4PP and test-bench TLM structures must correlate to TEM-calibrated physical thickness to prevent false under-thickness calls.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: DualBeam FIB gallium ion liquid metal ion sources (LMIS) and specialized cross-section diamond scribe wheels have extended import lead times (>12 weeks). Calibration standards for four-point probe sheet resistance (NIST-traceable VLSI standards) and high-purity SEM aperture consumables must be pre-staged at VN fab facilities to avoid metrology tool downtime during inline run qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Inline Metrology WPs represent gating milestones for Crown Capacitor Module signoff. Cleave-and-measure SEM destroys monitor dies; we must mandate sacrificial coupon scribe lines and dedicated kerf test structures rather than active DRAM array cracking. Automated image-analysis recipes for SEM step-coverage thickness extraction must be locked within 4 hours of pump-down to maintain lot transit velocity.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. FIB gallium ion beam amorphization/swelling and curtaining artifacts during cross-section preparation distorting TiN sidewall and bottom thickness measurements by >15%.
1. Atmospheric oxidation of non-passivated ALD TiN into TiO2 during air transit prior to 4PP measurement, yielding artificially inflated sheet resistance (Rs > 250 Ω/sq).
1. Trench pinch-off at top collar due to insufficient precursor purge/diffusion causing re-entrant step-coverage and catastrophic bottom-electrode open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-3-01` | **DualBeam FIB-SEM Crown Trench TiN Step-Coverage and Conformal Ratio Verification** | FEI/ThermoFisher Helios G4 DualBeam FIB-SEM with in-situ carbon/Pt protective gas injection system (GIS) and calibrated digital edge-detection measurement engine | 1. Load coupon into FIB-SEM chamber and pump to < 5e-6 mbar. 2. Deposit 1.5 µm protective Pt strap across 5 consecutive crown capacitor cells using 30 kV 0.23 nA Ga+ ion beam. 3. Perform rough cross-sectional trench milling with 30 kV 2.5 nA beam, followed by fine polishing at 30 kV 50 pA and final clean at 2 kV 23 pA. 4. Switch to Immersion SEM mode at 3.0 kV, 50 pA, working distance 4.0 mm, utilizing In-lens backscattered detector (ICD). 5. Measure TiN physical thickness at top planar surface (T_top), upper sidewall at 90% depth (T_side_up), midpoint sidewall at 50% depth (T_mid), and trench bottom center (T_bottom). 6. Calculate step coverage ratio: (T_bottom / T_top) * 100%. | `T_bottom must be >= 18.0 nm (for nominal 20.0 nm top deposition); step-coverage conformality ratio (T_bottom / T_top) >= 90.0%; sidewall thickness uniformity (T_mid / T_side_up) >= 88.0% with zero visible pinch-off voids across all 5 inspected cells.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-3-02` | **Four-Point Probe (4PP) Planar Sheet Resistance and Resistivity Uniformity Metrology** | KLA-Tencor ResMap 178 Four-Point Probe with 40-mil tungsten carbide probe head, compliant spring load (100g), and automated 49-point wafer mapping capability | 1. Calibrate 4PP tool using certified 10.0 Ω/sq NIST-traceable standard wafer. 2. Load 180nm blanket TiN monitor wafer on vacuum chuck. 3. Execute 49-point polar contour map scan with 3 mm edge exclusion. 4. Record DC voltage drop across inner pins with 1.00 mA current injection through outer pins. 5. Extract mean sheet resistance (Rs_mean), standard deviation (1-sigma), and diameter scan profile. 6. Multiply Rs_mean by nominal TEM-calibrated thickness (20.0 nm) to compute specific film bulk resistivity. | `Mean sheet resistance Rs_mean must be <= 75.0 Ω/sq (corresponding to bulk resistivity <= 150 µΩ·cm for 20 nm film); 49-point sheet resistance wafer non-uniformity (1-sigma / Rs_mean) must be <= 2.5%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-layered, 6 mil), Safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1 certified), Face shield (during wafer cleaving and liquid nitrogen handling), Cut-resistant Dyneema inner glove liners for mechanical wafer scribing
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Silicon or diamond scribe skin laceration: Irrigate immediately with sterile saline for 15 minutes, apply direct pressure with sterile gauze, report to occupational health for micro-particulate decontamination. Chemical splash (IPA): Rinse eyes at emergency station for >= 15 min. No specific physiological antidote for metallic TiN or Ga; maintain symptom-directed medical protocol.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Mechanical scribe station must operate under minimum 100 FPM laminar flow with HEPA/exhaust vacuum capture shroud to prevent airborne silicon/TiN shards. DualBeam FIB roughing pump exhaust must be hard-ducted into facility toxic exhaust (SCRUBBED_EXHAUST) line.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of cleaved silicon/TiN contaminated glass/wafers in labeled sharps containers. Solvent wipes saturated with IPA must be collected in dedicated flammable waste drums and purged under nitrogen before hazardous waste contractor pickup.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Titanium Nitride (solid film / particulate dust from cleaving)** | `25583-20-4` | Analytical Standard / Thin Film | `99.99%` |
| **Gallium (FIB ion source)** | `7440-55-3` | Semiconductor Grade 7N | `99.99999%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (sample cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited thermal ALD TiN film in vacuum load-lock chamber, unexposed to cleanroom ambient, surface terminated with residual Ti-Cl and Ti-NHx ligands.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Characterized coupon/wafer with Pt/C-capped inspection pads, sealed under dry nitrogen purge or transferred immediately to cluster load-lock for interlayer dielectric (ILD) cap deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding 30 minutes cleanroom air exposure causes moisture-induced hydrolysis of residual Ti-Cl bonds, releasing trace gaseous HCl that corrodes adjacent metal lines, accompanied by spontaneous atmospheric oxidation of TiN into high-resistance TiOxNy/TiO2, shifting sheet resistance by >40% and corrupting metrology baseline.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: Post-ALD TiN characterization must isolate bottom/sidewall step-coverage inside 180nm crown capacitor trenches (aspect ratio 15:1 to 20:1) without destroying adjacent cell plate continuity. Standard top-down sheet resistance via four-point probe (4PP) averages planar film thickness and is blind to bottom-trench thinning or voiding; cross-sectional DualBeam FIB-SEM cleaving and STEM lamella sampling are mandatory to establish true step-coverage metrics across wafer edge and center.
critics.domain_expert: Thermal ALD TiN from TiCl4/NH3 typically suffers from chlorine incorporation (0.5-3.0 at.%) if deposition temperature is held below 400°C to protect peripheral CMOS metal gates. This residual chlorine directly degrades resistivity (>150 µΩ·cm) and accelerates TiOxNy oxidation upon ambient exposure. Step coverage must achieve ≥90% at the trench bottom, and resistivity extracted from planar 4PP and test-bench TLM structures must correlate to TEM-calibrated physical thickness to prevent false under-thickness calls.

Calibration standards for four-point probe sheet resistance (NIST-traceable VLSI standards) and high-purity SEM aperture consumables must be pre-staged at VN fab facilities to avoid metrology tool downtime during inline run qualification.
critics.laya_pm: Inline Metrology WPs represent gating milestones for Crown Capacitor Module signoff. Cleave-and-measure SEM destroys monitor dies; we must mandate sacrificial coupon scribe lines and dedicated kerf test structures rather than active DRAM array cracking. critical_failure_modes: FIB gallium ion beam amorphization/swelling and curtaining artifacts during cross-section preparation distorting TiN sidewall and bottom thickness measurements by >15%.

testcases.title: DualBeam FIB-SEM Crown Trench TiN Step-Coverage and Conformal Ratio Verification
testcases.instrumentation: FEI/ThermoFisher Helios G4 DualBeam FIB-SEM with in-situ carbon/Pt protective gas injection system (GIS) and calibrated digital edge-detection measurement engine
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer monitor piece cleaved from center and edge zones of lot; wafer vacuum transfer box depressurized; in-situ E-beam assisted Pt capping layer (150 nm) deposited over TiN crown tops prior to Ga+ FIB trench milling to prevent curtaining.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load coupon into FIB-SEM chamber and pump to < 5e-6 mbar. 2. Deposit 1.5 µm protective Pt strap across 5 consecutive crown capacitor cells using 30 kV 0.23 nA Ga+ ion beam. 3. Perform rough cross-sectional trench milling with 30 kV 2.5 nA beam, followed by fine polishing at 30 kV 50 pA and final clean at 2 kV 23 pA. 4. Switch to Immersion SEM mode at 3.0 kV, 50 pA, working distance 4.0 mm, utilizing In-lens backscattered detector (ICD). 5. Measure TiN physical thickness at top planar surface (T_top), upper sidewall at 90% depth (T_side_up), midpoint sidewall at 50% depth (T_mid), and trench bottom center (T_bottom). 6. Calculate step coverage ratio: (T_bottom / T_top) * 100%.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: T_bottom must be >= 18.0 nm (for nominal 20.0 nm top deposition); step-coverage conformality ratio (T_bottom / T_top) >= 90.0%; sidewall thickness uniformity (T_mid / T_side_up) >= 88.0% with zero visible pinch-off voids across all 5 inspected cells.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Four-Point Probe Calibration & TiN Planar Monitor Sheet Resistance Metrology

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-4PP-TIN-180NM`  
**Process Layer:** Conformal CVD/ALD TiN Top Metal Electrode Deposition  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Crown MIM Capacitor Architecture)  
**Persisted Knowledge File:** [four_point_probe_tin_sop.md](./docs/knowledge/four_point_probe_tin_sop.md)

---

### Metrology Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     NIST Standard      │
│      Calibration       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Probe Head Pin     │
│      Conditioning      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Planar Monitor     │
│        Loading         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  49-Point Contour Map  │
│          Scan          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     Tolerance Met?     │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├──────────────╮No
          Yes│              │
             ▼              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐ ┌────────────────────────┐
│     Lot Release to     │ │       Hold Lot &       │
│     Metrology Gate     │ │      Recalibrate       │
└────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### 1. Environmental Stabilization & Tool Initialization
- Confirm cleanroom temperature is $21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and relative humidity is $\le 45\%$.
- Power on the collinear four-point probe (4PP) station equipped with tungsten carbide tips (spacing $s = 1.0\,\text{mm}$, pin radius $100\,\mu\text{m}$, regulated down-force $50 \pm 10\,\text{g}$).
- Allow electrometer and constant-current source pre-amps to warm up for $\ge 30\,\text{minutes}$.

#### 2. Probe Head Inspection & Baseline NIST Calibration
- Visually inspect probe tips at $50\times$ optical magnification for bent pins, physical wear, or particle accumulation.
- Load the certified NIST-traceable calibration reference wafer (nominal $R_s = 10.00\,\Omega/\text{sq}$).
- Source $I = 1.0\,\text{mA}$ across outer pins (1 & 4), measure potential drop $V$ across inner pins (2 & 3), and execute dual-configuration switching ($R_A, R_B$) to eliminate geometric boundary effects:
  $$R_s = \frac{\pi}{\ln 2} \left(\frac{V}{I}\right) \cdot F_{\text{geom}}$$
- Repeat measurement 5 times at center. Verify instrument calibration deviation $\le \pm 0.50\%$.

#### 3. TiN Planar Monitor Loading & Recipe Setup
- Load the unpatterned monitor companion wafer accompanying the thermal ALD $\text{TiCl}_4 / \text{NH}_3$ top-electrode lot onto the vacuum chuck (vacuum pressure $\ge 70\,\text{kPa}$).
- Set coordinate alignment using wafer notch/flat at $0^\circ$.
- Set automated measurement profile:
  - **Pattern:** 49-point standard concentric polar/Cartesian grid.
  - **Edge Exclusion:** $3.0\,\text{mm}$ from wafer boundary.
  - **Current Sourcing:** Dual-polarity sweep at $I = 10.0\,\text{mA}$ ($+I$ and $-I$) to eliminate parasitic Seebeck/thermoelectric EMF.

#### 4. Automated Acquisition & Non-Uniformity Calculation
- Execute map scan across all 49 sites; register individual site sheet resistance $R_{s,i}$.
- Calculate lot summary metrics:
  - Mean Sheet Resistance: $\bar{R}_s = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N} R_{s,i}$
  - Wafer Non-Uniformity:
    $$\text{NU}\,(1\sigma) = \left(\frac{\sigma}{\bar{R}_s}\right) \times 100\%$$
- Log metrics to MES. If all acceptance criteria pass, disposition lot to subsequent lithography/interconnect gate. If out of spec, hold lot under OCAP.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Boundary | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tool Calibration Bias** | `0.00` | `%` | $\le \pm 0.50\%$ | NIST Transfer Standard ($10.00\,\Omega/\text{sq}$) |
| **TiN Monitor Sheet Resistance ($\bar{R}_s$)** | `25.0` | $\Omega/\text{sq}$ | $\pm 2.5\,\Omega/\text{sq}$ ($22.5 - 27.5$) | 49-point dual-configuration 4PP scan |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity ($1\sigma / \bar{R}_s$)** | `< 2.0` | `%` | $\le 2.0\%$ max | 49-point radial contour map ($3\,\text{mm}$ EE) |
| **Contact & Polarity Drift ($\Delta R_s$)** | `< 0.15` | `%` | $\le 0.15\%$ | Forward vs. reverse polarity current sweep |

---

### Context Citations
- **[Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects]**: Establishes baseline metal layer sheet resistance limits ($R_s < 0.08\,\Omega/\text{sq}$) and vacuum/anneal processing protocols used for interconnect comparison.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Defines cell dimensioning ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$), crown-shaped MIM storage capacitor requirements, and leakage thresholds ($< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$).
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Defines 1T1C target storage capacitance budget ($25 \text{ to } 30\,\text{fF/cell}$) and dielectric/electrode step requirements governing capacitor top-electrode conductivity.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated collinear four-point probe (4PP) tooling requires rigorous geometric boundary condition correction factors (Smits and Haldor Topsøe models) for finite circular wafer geometries (200mm diameter) and finite edge proximity, especially when interpreting 49-point planar monitor maps; failing to couple automated probe tip pitch (1.0 mm or 1.59 mm spacing) with localized thickness extracted via spectroscopic ellipsometry introduces systematic bulk resistivity calculation drift exceeding ±8%.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Thermal ALD TiN deposited via TiCl4 and NH3 precursors yields nanocrystalline rock-salt structure with residual Cl- impurities and native surface oxynitride (TiOxNy) formation upon ambient exposure; probe loading force must be strictly tuned between 40 g and 100 g per pin to reliably penetrate native TiO2 passivation without puncturing ultra-thin 15-30 nm TiN into the underlying sacrificial dielectric or causing micro-cracking and tungsten carbide contact spalling.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten carbide (WC) or osmium-alloy probe heads suffer accelerated micro-radius wear and tip contamination after ~5,000 touchdowns on abrasive ALD metal nitrides; second-source qualification for certified NIST-traceable standard calibration wafers (VLSI Standards silicon-doped or implanted reference wafers) faces a 14-week lead time with high import sensitivity.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Planar monitor sheet resistance qualification gates the release of the 3D crown capacitor top-plate node in the 180nm DRAM lot; establishing a rigid 30-minute post-ALD queue time for 4PP inspection is critical to prevent ambient oxidation from artificially shifting baseline electrical acceptance parameters before physical cross-sectional validation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Probe-induced mechanical film perforation: Excessive needle spring force or worn probe tips punching through thin (20 nm) ALD TiN into the underlying oxide, causing direct electrical shorting or erroneous multi-layer conduction paths.
1. Native oxynitride surface passivation error: Uncontrolled ambient cleanroom exposure leading to rapid TiOxNy growth that increases contact resistance (Rc) past the compliance voltage limit of the current source, yielding apparent sheet resistance drift.
1. Electromigration or localized Joule heating degradation: Excessive drive current applied during 4PP I-V sweeps causing localized resistive thermal breakdown and premature electromigration at probe-to-thin-film contact interfaces.

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with IPA solvent, flush affected area with copious amounts of DI water for a minimum of 15 minutes; remove contaminated garments. In case of ocular contact, immediately flush eyes at safety eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. If inhaled in high concentrations, relocate victim to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation performed within cleanroom recirculating laminar flow hood with HEPA filtration (ISO Class 4/5); local solvent wipe station must have dedicated chemical exhaust bench maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and solvent swabs must be deposited into closed, airtight, grounded stainless-steel flammable waste bins; disposed of in designated hazardous organic solvent stream in compliance with environmental cleanroom waste regulations.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited thermal ALD TiN thin film (20nm nominal on 100nm SiO2 on Si), pristine metallic appearance, purged with N2 during chamber pump-down to atmospheric transfer.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: 4PP-characterized TiN monitor surface with microscopic mechanical probe witness marks (<2 um diameter, non-perforating), preserved inside hermetic purge-capable FOUP under continuous N2 trickle.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom ambient queue time triggers chemisorption of atmospheric moisture and uncontrolled oxidation of TiN into insulating TiOxNy, introducing artificial positive sheet resistance drift (>15%) and inaccurate baseline calibration for the ALD deposition run.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful electrical sheet resistance baseline metrology and spatial uniformity qualification of the planar ALD TiN top electrode monitor wafer via calibrated automated 4PP, confirming chemical deposition process stability and baseline resistivity within specification prior to 3D high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor metallization.

| `ASSERT-02` | **Within-wafer sheet resistance non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean)** | `1.8%` | ≤ 2.5% | Statistical calculation derived from 49-point polar coordinate automated probe dataset excluding 3 mm wafer edge. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Probe-to-film contact repeatability on reference standard** | `0.15%` | ≤ 0.50% | Relative standard deviation across 5 consecutive center-point probe touchdown cycles on NIST-traceable standard. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

testcases.title: NIST-Traceable Reference Wafer 4PP Calibration and Contact Resistance Linearity Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Collinear Four-Point Probe Station with 1.0 mm spaced Tungsten Carbide tips (50 um tip radius), Keithley 2450 SMU / 2182A Nanovoltmeter, NIST-traceable Rs reference wafer (nominal 100.0 Ohm/sq).
testcases.pre_conditions: Probe head cleaned with anhydrous isopropyl alcohol wipe; ambient temperature stabilized at 21.0 ± 0.5 °C, RH 45 ± 5%; NIST reference wafer loaded with vacuum chuck at -75 kPa.
testcases.procedure:
1. Lower probe assembly onto reference standard wafer center using 60 g probe loading force.
2. Apply dual-polarity current sweep from +100 uA to +10 mA and -100 uA to -10 mA across outer pins 1 and 4 in 10 logarithmic steps.
3. Measure differential voltage across inner pins 2 and 3.
4. Calculate forward and reverse sheet resistance Rs = (pi / ln(2)) * (V / I) * F_geom.
5. Repeat measurement across 5 repeated touchdowns to evaluate contact repeatability and probe tip linearity (I-V ohmic fit R^2).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: I-V linearity regression coefficient R^2 >= 0.9999; calculated mean Rs across 5 touchdowns within 100.0 ± 0.5 Ohm/sq (relative error <= 0.5%); pin-to-pin contact resistance <= 10.0 Ohm.

testcases.title: 49-Point Full-Wafer Sheet Resistance and Radial Non-Uniformity Metrology on Planar ALD TiN Monitor
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Mapping Four-Point Probe Station (49-point polar/concentric map, 3 mm edge exclusion) integrated with low-noise current reversal source, Cleanroom Class 100 environmental enclosure.
testcases.pre_conditions: 200mm Si monitor wafer with 100nm thermal oxide and 20nm as-deposited thermal ALD TiN loaded within 20 minutes of chamber vent; calibration test TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-3-1-01 verified valid.
testcases.procedure:
1. Align wafer notch to 0 degrees on the motorized theta-r stage.
2. Execute automated 49-point concentric grid mapping routine applying 1.0 mA forward and reverse current at 60 g force.
3. Record V_f and V_r at each point, compute geometric edge correction factors F(d/s) for points near the 3 mm perimeter.
4. Extract wafer-level mean sheet resistance (Rs_mean), standard deviation (sigma), and percentage non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean * 100% and (Rs_max - Rs_min)/(2 * Rs_mean) * 100%).
5. Inspect touchdown sites under 100x optical microscope to ensure absence of film tearing or peeling.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Rs_mean between 120.0 Ohm/sq and 180.0 Ohm/sq for 20nm nominal TiN; full-wafer 1-sigma non-uniformity <= 2.5%; zero structural film punch-through or delamination defects under optical inspection.

ppe_required: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double gloving required)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields
Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive ESD footwear

cas_chemicals.name: Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)
cas_chemicals.purity_grade: Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C12, Trace Metal < 1 ppb)

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of skin contact with IPA solvent, flush affected area with copious amounts of DI water for a minimum of 15 minutes; remove contaminated garments. In case of ocular contact, immediately flush eyes at safety eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. If inhaled in high concentrations, relocate victim to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Operation performed within cleanroom recirculating laminar flow hood with HEPA filtration (ISO Class 4/5); local solvent wipe station must have dedicated chemical exhaust bench maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm).
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Used IPA wipes and solvent swabs must be deposited into closed, airtight, grounded stainless-steel flammable waste bins; disposed of in designated hazardous organic solvent stream in compliance with environmental cleanroom waste regulations.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly deposited thermal ALD TiN thin film (20nm nominal on 100nm SiO2 on Si), pristine metallic appearance, purged with N2 during chamber pump-down to atmospheric transfer.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: 4PP-characterized TiN monitor surface with microscopic mechanical probe witness marks (<2 um diameter, non-perforating), preserved inside hermetic purge-capable FOUP under continuous N2 trickle.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding cleanroom ambient queue time triggers chemisorption of atmospheric moisture and uncontrolled oxidation of TiN into insulating TiOxNy, introducing artificial positive sheet resistance drift (>15%) and inaccurate baseline calibration for the ALD deposition run.

expected_result.summary: Successful electrical sheet resistance baseline metrology and spatial uniformity qualification of the planar ALD TiN top electrode monitor wafer via calibrated automated 4PP, confirming chemical deposition process stability and baseline resistivity within specification prior to 3D high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor metallization.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Mean sheet resistance (Rs_mean) of 20nm planar ALD TiN monitor across 49-point wafer map
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Dual-polarity 49-point automated collinear 4PP electrical mapping with geometric edge correction.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Within-wafer sheet resistance non-uniformity (1-sigma / mean)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Statistical calculation derived from 49-point polar coordinate automated probe dataset excluding 3 mm wafer edge.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Probe-to-film contact repeatability on reference standard
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Relative standard deviation across 5 consecutive center-point probe touchdown cycles on NIST-traceable standard.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Completion of 49-point 4PP wafer map with mean Rs within 135.0-165.0 Ohm/sq, 1-sigma non-uniformity <= 2.5%, valid NIST calibration certificate logged within the same shift, and visual optical confirmation of zero mechanical punch-through on all probe touchdown sites signed off by Lead Metrology Engineer.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): FIB Precision Cross-Sectional Specimen Preparation of Crown Cell Arrays

**Module**: Metrology & Nanofabrication Inspection  
**Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm Node DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type**: Make  
**Target Structure**: 3D High-Aspect-Ratio Crown Capacitor Array with Conformal ALD TiN Top Electrode, High-$k$ Stack, and Contact Plugs.

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Sample Prep & Pt    │
│       Deposition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  High-Current Trench   │
│     Rough Milling      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Low-Current Fine    │
│         Polish         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Cross-Sectional     │
│  Metrology Inspection  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Chamber Evacuation & Sample Grounding**
   - Mount cleaved die onto an angled FIB/SEM specimen stub using ultra-clean conductive carbon/copper tape to prevent charging across the high-aspect-ratio crown arrays.
   - Load stub into Dual-Beam FIB/SEM chamber and pump down vacuum until chamber base pressure reaches $\le 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ (identical to baseline high-vacuum metallization criteria).

2. **Region of Interest (ROI) Alignment & Protective Cap Deposition**
   - Align to the target Crown Capacitor array along the active bitline/wordline array grid using electron beam navigation at $E_{\text{beam}} = 5\text{ kV}$, $I_{\text{beam}} = 100\text{ pA}$.
   - Insert Gas Injection System (GIS) needle for Organometallic Platinum (Pt) precursor.
   - **Step 2.1 (Electron Beam-Induced Deposition - EBID)**: Deposit initial conformal protective Pt cap ($t \approx 200\text{ nm}$) using 2–5 kV electron beam to prevent Ga+ ion implantation damage to the fragile upper rim of the conformal TiN electrode.
   - **Step 2.2 (Ion Beam-Induced Deposition - FIBID)**: Deposit bulk sacrificial Pt strap ($t \approx 1.5 - 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$, footprint $15\ \mu\text{m} \times 2.5\ \mu\text{m}$) using $30\text{ kV}\ \text{Ga}^+$ beam at $100 - 300\text{ pA}$ to eliminate beam curtaining across deep 3D crowns.

3. **High-Current Bulk Trench Rough Milling**
   - Tilt sample stage to $52.0^\circ$ (perpendicular to $\text{Ga}^+$ column).
   - Define bulk cross-sectional relief trench in front of the crown array ROI (milling depth $\ge 3.0\ \mu\text{m}$, width $18\ \mu\text{m}$, length $12\ \mu\text{m}$) and side relief cuts.
   - Mill trench using coarse focused $\text{Ga}^+$ ion beam at $30\text{ kV}$ acceleration voltage and $1.0\text{ nA} - 3.0\text{ nA}$ beam current, stopping ~300 nm before the active target crown cut-plane.

4. **Intermediate Polish**
   - Step down $\text{Ga}^+$ beam current to $30\text{ kV}$, $150\text{ pA} - 300\text{ pA}$.
   - Advance cross-sectional plane through the sacrificial strap until the cut plane intercepts the center of the crown cylinder array and underlying W-plug contact vias.

5. **Low-kV / Low-pA Precision Final Polish**
   - Step down ion beam to $30\text{ kV}$ at $30 - 50\text{ pA}$ to remove redeposited material.
   - Perform final glancing angle surface cleaning at $2\text{ kV} - 5\text{ kV}$, $10 - 30\text{ pA}$ to eliminate the amorphous Ga-damaged surface layer down to $< 2\text{ nm}$.
   - Inspect cross-section in in-lens SE/BSE detector mode at $1.5 - 3.0\text{ kV}$ SEM voltage to verify continuous TiN step coverage, dielectric integrity, and contact interfaces.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                    180nm DRAM Physical Parameters      
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░░░░                                │
  Ret Time (ms)┤░░░░░░░                                │
               │▒▒▒▒                                   │
Cap Target (fF)┤▒▒▒▒                                   │
  Al Met-1 (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓   │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓   │
     Pitch (nm)┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                0        95       190       285     380 
```

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Pattern Pitch Alignment** | **$360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$** | $\text{nm}$ | In-situ High-Resolution SEM line pitch metrology across adjacent cross-sectioned crown cell centers |
| **Underlying Access Gate Length ($L$)** | **$180\text{ nm}$** | $\text{nm}$ | Cross-sectional SEM calibrator along transistor channel below storage node contact |
| **Metal Interconnect Layer Thickness** | **$350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$** | $\text{nm}$ | Cross-sectional SEM vertical cursor caliper across Metal-1 interconnect layers |
| **Storage Cell Retained Capacitance Budget** | **$\ge 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$** ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$ nominal) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Correlated electrical C-V parameter extraction ensuring data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Citations of Literature Context
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Stacked crown/cylinder capacitor target minimum capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell; retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; array bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; crown MIM/polysilicon topology above drain contact via tungsten (W) plug; minimum $28\text{ fF}$ capacitance budget; leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**: Vacuum baseline base pressure $< 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$; Metal-1 interconnect thickness $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$; post-anneal sheet resistance $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$.

*Documentation note has been captured in [docs/fib_specimen_prep_crown_cell_arrays.md](./docs/fib_specimen_prep_crown_cell_arrays.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-beam FIB/SEM preparation of 3D high-aspect-ratio (HAR ~15:1 to 20:1) crown cell arrays risks electrostatic discharge and local electron/ion beam heating that delaminates unannealed thermal ALD TiN from the underlying dielectric. The milling trench geometry must incorporate wide relief angles (>45 deg) to prevent re-deposition of sputtered silicon/TiN onto the crown sidewalls during the final polish.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At Gen 3 (180nm node dimensions with sub-50nm ALD TiN layers), curtaining artifacts from the porous or corrugated top topography of crown structures will severely corrupt step-coverage measurement. An initial low-energy, highly conformal electron-beam induced Pt/C capping layer (500nm at 2-5kV) followed by ion-beam induced Pt deposition (1.5-2.0 um at 30kV) is strictly mandatory before rough milling to preserve the top rim profile.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Gallium liquid metal ion sources (LMIS) and organometallic Pt/C Gas Injection System (GIS) precursor vials have volatile lead times (>12 weeks) and high cost per deposition cycle. For open-source pilot runs in VN, optimizing beam currents during bulk excavation and limiting Pt precursor depletion per sample coupon is critical for tool uptime and operational budget.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: FIB sample throughput is the primary bottleneck for the TiN step-coverage metrology feedback loop. A standard trenching and lamella thinning workflow takes 90 to 120 minutes per site; automated slice-and-view or standardized coupon-cleave fiducial milling must be scheduled to prevent exceeding the 60-minute Q-time window between TiN deposition and TEM/HR-SEM inspection.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Curtaining artifact across high-aspect-ratio crown arrays obscuring the ALD TiN bottom-to-top thickness interface during SEM inspection.
1. Gallium ion implantation damage and amorphization layer exceeding 5 nm on the TiN sidewall during final milling at 30 kV without low-kV (2-5 kV) cleanup.
1. Protective Pt capping layer delamination caused by inadequate pre-clean or excessive initial ion beam flux, leading to physical collapse of the crown upper edges.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-3-2-01` | **Dual-Beam FIB Protective Cap Deposition and Curtaining Mitigation Test** | FEI/Thermo Fisher Helios NanoLab DualBeam FIB/SEM with Gallium LMIS, trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum GIS precursor, and in-chamber SE/BSE detectors | 1. Locate target 5x5 crown cell array under 2 kV, 50 pA SEM electron beam. 2. Deposit electron-beam induced Pt protection layer: 2 kV, 1.6 nA, 500 nm nominal thickness. 3. Insert Pt GIS needle and deposit ion-beam induced Pt cap: 30 kV, 80 pA, 1.5 um thickness across a 15 um x 3 um footprint. 4. Perform cross-sectional line profile SEM measurement to evaluate cap uniformity and surface voiding. | `Total protective Pt cap thickness >= 2.0 um (e-beam Pt >= 450 nm, i-beam Pt >= 1400 nm) with 0 voiding/delamination at the TiN crown interface and surface curtaining striation roughness Ra < 2.0 nm across the 15 um width.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-3-2-02` | **Precision Cross-Sectional Rough Milling and Low-kV Amorphization Polish** | DualBeam FIB/SEM system equipped with multi-channel Gas Injection System, retractable STEM/SE detector, and continuous beam current selector (30 kV down to 2 kV) | 1. Perform bulk excavation trench on front and back sides using Ga+ beam at 30 kV, 9.3 nA down to 4 um depth. 2. Step down beam current to 30 kV, 0.79 nA for intermediate fine milling to reach 200 nm lamella thickness. 3. Tilt stage +/- 1.5 degrees and polish using 5 kV, 48 pA beam to remove coarse Ga+ damage. 4. Execute final low-energy polish at 2 kV, 24 pA for 120 seconds. 5. Measure Ga+ damaged/amorphized boundary thickness on TiN lattice fringes under high-resolution SEM/STEM mode. | `Final cross-section face exhibits planar perpendicularity within 90.0 +/- 0.5 degrees, thickness <= 80 nm for high-resolution imaging, and Ga+ induced amorphous surface damage layer thickness <= 3.0 nm verified by high-contrast lattice imaging.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving required during precursor swap), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and laser/radiation impact safety glasses, ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive heel straps, Full face shield and butyl rubber apron when handling GIS organometallic canister maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with organometallic Pt precursor or liquid Ga: Immediately flush with copious amounts of water for 15 minutes, remove contaminated clothing, and wash area thoroughly with mild soap. For ocular exposure: Flush eyes at eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmologist evaluation. For inhalation of precursor vapors during GIS seal failure: Evacuate person to fresh air; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; seek immediate emergency medical care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB turbomolecular vacuum pump exhaust must be continuously ducted into dedicated acid/solvent building scrubber line. Precursor vial exchange must be conducted inside a certified Class 100 laminar flow exhausted chemical fume hood with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent precursor ampoules and wipes containing organometallic Pt residues must be sealed in airtight polypropylene hazardous waste containers labeled 'Toxic Heavy Metal Contaminated Waste'. Spent Ga LMIS crucibles must be segregated for manufacturer recycling and heavy-metal reclamation.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV)** | `94442-22-5` | Sublimed Metrology Grade (>= 99.0%) | `99.5 wt%` |
| **Liquid Gallium (LMIS Source)** | `7440-55-3` | Ultra-High Purity 6N Grade | `99.9999 wt%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, Chamber Cleaning & Substrate Prep)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI-C1) | `>= 99.8 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited thermal ALD TiN top electrode, passivated in N2 purge box, showing no native oxidation or moisture condensation rings.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Cross-sectioned, low-kV polished coupon under ultra-high vacuum (< 1e-6 mbar) or sealed in vacuum transfer desiccator ready for immediate high-resolution SEM/TEM step-coverage measurement.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exposure to ambient air beyond 45 minutes induces atmospheric oxidation of exposed TiN to TiO2 along microscopic grain boundaries, shifting measured sidewall thickness by 1.5-3.0 nm and distorting secondary electron contrast during step-coverage evaluation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable delivery of a defect-free, un-curtained, and low-damage FIB cross-sectional specimen of the 180nm crown capacitor cell array, enabling sub-nanometer SEM metrology of conformal ALD TiN bottom, sidewall, and top thickness profiles.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FIB_Crown_CrossSection_Tilt52deg_Raw.tiff`
- [ ] `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-2-3-2_Metrology_Log.csv`
- [ ] `FIB_Specimen_Preparation_Quality_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Protective Pt Cap Total Thickness over Crown Array** | `2.0 um` | +/- 0.15 um | In-situ calibrated dual-beam SEM cross-sectional line profile metrology at 52-degree coincidence |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Ga+ Ion Milling Surface Amorphous Damage Layer Thickness** | `2.5 nm` | <= 3.0 nm max | High-resolution transmission-mode STEM detector contrast analysis on the final 2 kV polished TiN edge |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Cross-Section Face Verticality Across 15:1 Aspect Ratio Crown** | `90.0 degrees` | +/- 0.5 degrees | In-chamber electron-beam orthogonal tilt measurement against the baseline silicon substrate plane |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Cross-sectional lamella/trench face is fully prepared across at least 5 consecutive 180nm crown capacitor cells without curtaining striations or crown rim collapse, amorphous Ga damage layer is verified <= 3.0 nm, and high-contrast SEM images clearly delineate the ALD TiN-to-dielectric boundary across 100% of the capacitor sidewall.
