### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Inspection Method | Lower Spec Limit (LSL) | Nominal Target | Upper Spec Limit (USL) | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TiN Bottom Step Coverage Ratio** ($\frac{t_{\text{bot}}}{t_{\text{top}}}$) | In-Lens FE-SEM Micrograph Line Analysis | $85.0$ | $90.0$ | $100.0$ | $\%$ |
| **TiN Sidewall Step Coverage Ratio** ($\frac{t_{\text{mid}}}{t_{\text{top}}}$) | In-Lens FE-SEM Micrograph Line Analysis | $90.0$ | $95.0$ | $100.0$ | $\%$ |
| **Array Cell Pitch Verification** | Cross-Section SEM Pitch Metrology | $360.0$ | $380.0$ | $400.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Gate Oxide Reference Thickness Benchmark** | High-Resolution Calibrated Edge / Ellipsometry Correlation | $3.45$ | $3.50$ | $3.55$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**  
  Confirms the 180nm node unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked crown capacitor MIM/polysilicon topology over tungsten plug (W-plug), high-k dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$, minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ budget), and sub-1 fA/cell leakage target.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**  
  Confirms the 1T1C stacked capacitor architecture ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$ cell layout), capacitor storage budget ($25 - 30\text{ fF}$ per cell for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), equivalent oxide thickness (EOT $3 - 4\text{ nm}$), bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$, and gate dielectric thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**  
  Confirms optical dispersion calibration and gate oxide thickness reference baseline ($3.5\text{ nm}$ measured within $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Low-kV (≤1.0 kV) in-lens immersion FE-SEM provides the sub-nanometer secondary electron (SE) resolution necessary to discern sub-10 nm TiN top electrode morphology without destructive beam charging or excessive interaction volume blooming into the underlying high-k dielectric stack. However, the electron optical working distance is strictly restricted (<2 mm immersion mode), posing severe stage-tilt collision hazards against FIB-cleaved stub geolocations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At high aspect ratios (AR ≥ 15:1 to 20:1 for Gen 3 180nm crown capacitor trench architectures), measuring conformal TiN step coverage requires discriminating between ALD deposition thickness along trench sidewalls and bottom pinch-off profiles. Hydrocarbon contamination deposition under stationary beam dwell causes apparent film thickness overestimation; beam deceleration with low-kV in-lens energy filtering (EsB/In-Lens SE) is critical to isolate pure material compositional boundaries without edge blooming.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring dedicated high-resolution field emission SEM metrology inspection hours or analytical laboratory outsourcing services requires strict SLA guarantees on high-vacuum chamber turnaround and calibration standards (e.g., NIST-traceable magnification grid standards SRM 2060). Outsource batch queues must accommodate quick-turn coupons before post-cleave ambient oxidation degrades sidewall TiN/dielectric interfaces.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Low-kV in-lens FE-SEM represents the decisive go/no-go gate before proceeding to wafer-level automated C-V electrical test structures and metallization routing. Turnaround inspection deliverables must complete within the shift window to feed back into ALD TiCl4/TDMAT cycle adjustments, avoiding idling of downstream cassette lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Electron beam-induced deposition (EBID) of carbonaceous contamination during high-magnification sidewall inspection creating artificial film thickness expansion >1.5 nm.
1. Immersion objective lens pole piece collision during high-tilt angle sample positioning of FIB-cleaved high-aspect-ratio trench specimens.
1. Delamination or artifact edge rounding of thin TiN liners caused by specimen charging and inadequate low-kV substrate ground referencing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-1-3-01` | **Low-kV In-Lens Sidewall TiN Step Coverage Metrology** | FE-SEM with In-Lens Secondary Electron Detector, Beam Deceleration stage bias, and calibrated pixel measurement package (NIST-traceable) | 1. Load cleaved trench sample into high-vacuum chamber and align electron beam column to trench center. 2. Activate in-lens SE detector and engage beam deceleration mode (500V landing energy). 3. Focus on top planar surface TiN, midpoint sidewall, and bottom corner trench at 200,000x magnification. 4. Acquire calibrated micrographs using line-averaging mode (N=64 scans) to suppress signal-to-noise ratio without stationary beam dwell. 5. Measure top surface film thickness (T_top), 50% trench depth sidewall thickness (T_side), and bottom trench center thickness (T_bottom) using full-width-half-maximum (FWHM) edge detection across 5 distinct crowns. | `TiN step coverage ratio (T_side / T_top) >= 85.0% and (T_bottom / T_top) >= 80.0% across all 5 measured trench crowns with continuous, void-free film boundary.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-1-3-02` | **Beam-Induced Hydrocarbon Contamination Rate Verification** | Analytical In-Lens FE-SEM equipped with Plasma Clean chamber decon accessory and calibrated image analysis software | 1. Position beam on sacrificial test site outside device array at 100,000x magnification. 2. Capture initial reference frame at t=0 s. 3. Continuous raster scan the 1 um x 1 um field of view for 120 s dwell time. 4. Shift to 50,000x magnification and capture the contamination spot micrograph. 5. Quantify dark carbon contrast deposition thickness profile via grayscale intensity step height analysis. | `Carbonaceous deposition edge growth thickness <= 0.3 nm after 120 seconds continuous beam rastering; no visible dark halo blooming impeding TiN interface delineation.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom class 100 nitrile gloves (double gloving), UV-blocking ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses, Grounded ESD wrist strap and conductive heel grounders, Lint-free cleanroom smock and hairnet
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA/conductive paste: wash immediately with copious deionized water and soap for 15 minutes. Eye exposure: rinse at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. High-voltage interlock exposure: de-energize main supply breakers before rendering first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Sample preparation, stub degreasing, and carbon mounting must be conducted under a dedicated laminar flow exhaust hood with minimum 100 FPM face velocity. FE-SEM roughing pump exhaust must be plumbed to fab house toxic/solvent exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent swabs and carbon paint applicators sealed in dedicated solvent-rated hazardous waste bins. Liquid solvent residue collected in clearly labeled flammable hazardous waste carboys for commercial incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Electronic Grade VLSI | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Colloidal Graphite (Carbon Paint)** | `7782-42-5` | Microscopy High Purity Suspension | `20% in isopropanol carrier` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly FIB-milled or micro-cleaved cross-section with exposed TiN top electrode, dielectric stack, and substrate interfaces under vacuum seal or N2 blanket.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: High-vacuum inspected cross-section sample with beam-cleared field, stored in desiccant dry-pack cabinet or transferred to TEM grid archive.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure causes native oxidation of TiN into oxynitride (TiOxNy) and hydrolysis of moisture-sensitive interfaces, skewing optical/electron contrast boundaries and falsely indicating sidewall roughness or non-conformal ALD coverage.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified low-kV in-lens FE-SEM cross-sectional micrography showing ultra-thin, continuous, conformal TiN top electrode deposition on 180nm high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor trenches with quantitative step coverage validation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TIN_STEP_COVERAGE_METROLOGY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `FESEM_HIGH_RES_INLENS_MICROGRAPHS.tiff`
- [ ] `TRENCH_THICKNESS_PROFILE_EXTRACTION.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **TiN Sidewall to Top Planar Step Coverage Ratio** | `88.0%` | +-3.0% | Calibrated in-lens FE-SEM edge detection image analysis at 50% trench depth |
| `ASSERT-02` | **TiN Trench Bottom Center to Top Planar Step Coverage Ratio** | `82.5%` | +-3.5% | Calibrated in-lens FE-SEM bottom trench apex cross-sectional pixel profiling |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Top Planar Electrode Baseline Thickness** | `12.0 nm` | +-0.8 nm | Low-kV In-Lens FE-SEM calibrated measurement against NIST magnification reference standard |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Complete multi-point metrology dataset demonstrating >= 85% sidewall step coverage across 5 consecutively inspected high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor trenches with zero observed pinch-off voids and formally approved engineering sign-off report.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: High-Resolution STEM/TEM TiN Sidewall and Bottom Step Coverage Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: STEM/TEM cross-sectional metrology provides definitive physical nanoscale truth for 3D crown capacitor TiN step coverage, but it is inherently destructive, localized, and has low throughput. The core challenge is bridging cross-sectional TEM slice data with non-destructive in-line spectroscopic ellipsometry and sheet resistance measurements across 200mm wafers to ensure radial uniformity across all high-aspect-ratio cylinder arrays without sacrificing sample yield.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At aspect ratios exceeding 15:1 to 20:1 for 180nm-node DRAM crown cells, precursor transport depletion (TiCl4/NH3 or TDMAT) severely degrades bottom and sidewall step coverage. Focused Ion Beam (FIB) specimen preparation introduces Ga+ ion beam damage, curtaining artifacts, and amorphous redeposition. High-resolution HAADF-STEM with sub-0.2 nm spatial resolution and low-kV final polish (<2 kV Ga+ or Ar+ nanomill) is mandatory to accurately resolve the 10-15 nm TiN continuous barrier without artificial delamination or thickness distortion.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dual-beam FIB/SEM and 200/300kV aberration-corrected STEM tools represent significant capital equipment bottlenecks and cost-per-sample drivers. Outsourcing sample preparation or relying on shared metrology centers risks queue-time escalation, oxidation of freshly cleaved TiN interfaces, and critical data turnaround latency for ALD process recipe optimization cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: TEM turnaround time (TAT) per wafer coupon directly dictates the iteration pace of ALD reactor tuning runs. A standardized coupon cleavage protocol, fiducial alignment marks on scribe lines, and an automated lamella pick-and-place routine must be enforced to keep preparation and measurement cycles strictly under 8 hours per lot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Lamella curtaining and preferential redeposition during FIB milling masking the real TiN-to-dielectric interface at the bottom of the crown trench.
1. Post-deposition ambient oxidation of ultrathin TiN sidewalls prior to vacuum transfer, generating TiOxNy artifacts and skewing physical thickness measurements by >1.5 nm.
1. Structural collapse or bowing of high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor cylinder walls induced by mechanical stress relaxation during thin lamella thinning down to <50 nm.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-2-01` | **HAADF-STEM Quantitative Sidewall and Bottom TiN Step Coverage Verification** | FEI/ThermoFisher Helios DualBeam FIB/SEM for site-specific lift-out with Fischione 1040 Nanomill, paired with a 200kV Field Emission Analytical STEM (FEI Tecnai/Talos or JEOL ARM200F) equipped with HAADF detector and calibrated sub-nanometer magnification standards. | 1. Navigate DualBeam FIB to crown capacitor test array scribe structure. 2. Deposit 300 nm electron-beam Pt followed by 2.0 um ion-beam Pt strap. 3. Perform bulk trenching at 30 kV, 9 nA to release 15x2 um lamella; lift out and mount on Cu Omniprobe TEM grid. 4. Thin lamella progressively to 100 nm at 16 kV (0.15 nA) and 5 kV (40 pA). 5. Final low-energy polish at 2 kV (15 pA) or Ar+ nanomill to achieve <40 nm lamella thickness without amorphous Ga damage. 6. Transfer in inert vacuum capsule to 200 kV STEM. 7. Acquire calibrated HAADF-STEM micrographs at 500kX-1.2MX magnification at five designated locations: field top, cylinder neck, upper sidewall (80% height), lower sidewall (20% height), and trench bottom center. 8. Extract calibrated intensity profile lines across TiN interfaces to determine physical thickness. | `Physical TiN thickness must be >= 10.0 nm at field top. Sidewall step coverage (thickness at 20% height divided by top field thickness) must be >= 90.0%. Bottom step coverage (thickness at bottom trench center divided by top field thickness) must be >= 85.0%. TiN layer must be continuous with zero pinholes or voids.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-2-02` | **High-Resolution STEM-EDS Compositional Uniformity and Oxidation Depth Profiling** | 200 kV Analytical STEM equipped with Large Solid-Angle Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) system and automated drift correction. | 1. Align electron probe in STEM mode with probe size <0.5 nm and beam current ~300 pA. 2. Define EDS linescan vectors across the crown bottom corner and lower sidewall (normal to TiN/ZrO2-Al2O3-ZrO2 interface) with 0.2 nm spatial step pitch and 500 ms dwell time per point. 3. Quantify atomic percentages of Ti, N, O, Cl (if TiCl4 precursor) or C (if TDMAT precursor) across the film profile. 4. Extract stoichiometry ratio (Ti:N) and quantify oxygen contamination concentration at the inner bulk versus outer interfaces. | `Stoichiometric Ti:N ratio must be within 1.00 +/- 0.05 across sidewall and bottom films. Bulk oxygen concentration within the TiN core must be < 2.0 at.%. Halogen (Cl) or Carbon (C) impurity concentration must remain <= 1.5 at.%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving for chemical handling), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses, Liquid nitrogen cryogenic handling gloves and full-face cryogenic shield, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown and ESD-safe safety footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For cryogenic liquid nitrogen splash/frostbite: Flush affected tissue immediately with copious tepid water (40-42 C); do not apply dry heat or rub frostbitten skin; seek immediate medical attention. For isopropanol skin/eye contact: Irrigate exposed eyes or dermal areas with isotonic eyewash or deluge shower for 15 minutes. For Ga/Pt precursor contamination: Wash with mild soap and water; evacuate inhalation area.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB GIS (Gas Injection System) exhaust and vacuum turbo roughing pump forelines must vent through active abatement scrubbers. Cryogenic LN2 filling stations require ambient oxygen level deficiency sensors (<19.5% O2 alarm triggers continuous mechanical exhaust purge at >= 30 air changes per hour).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent Ga ion source reservoirs must be segregated in hazardous heavy-metal containment bins. Cleanroom solvent-wetted wipes (IPA) must be collected in self-closing, grounded flammable solvent waste cans. Spent copper and molybdenum TEM aperture grids must be disposed of according to hazardous electronic metal waste guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gallium (FIB liquid metal ion source)** | `7440-55-3` | 99.9999% (6N Electronic Grade) | `100%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (TEM anticontaminator cryo-trap)** | `7727-37-9` | Industrial Cryogenic Grade | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (Solvent for coupon degreasing & ultrasonic cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Platinum Precursor ((CH3)3Pt(CpCH3) for in-situ protective strap deposition)** | `94442-22-5` | High Purity Organometallic Precursor | `99%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN top electrode, vacuum unloaded into dry N2 FOUP/carrier, showing zero native TiO2 passivation under optical inspection.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: FIB-prepared lamella mounted on Cu grid, stored in high-vacuum desiccator or cryo-transfer holder with passivated carbon cap, ready for STEM column insertion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time causes ambient moisture and oxygen diffusion down the HAR crown capacitor pores, leading to spontaneous formation of a 1.0-2.5 nm amorphous TiOxNy interfacial skin that invalidates TEM step coverage metrology, distorts HAADF contrast, and skews sheet resistance correlation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable STEM/TEM metrology signoff confirming that ALD TiN top electrode achieves >=90% sidewall and >=85% bottom step coverage inside 180nm DRAM high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitor cylinders with stoichiometric Ti:N ratio (1.00 +/- 0.05) and core oxygen contamination < 2.0 at.%.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TEM_TiN_Step_Coverage_Analysis_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `HAADF_STEM_Calibrated_Thickness_Profiles.csv`
- [ ] `HighRes_STEM_HAADF_EDS_Mapping_Data.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **TiN sidewall step coverage at 20% cylinder depth relative to top field thickness** | `90.0` | +/- 3.0% | Calibrated HAADF-STEM intensity line profile across 5 distinct crown structures per die. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **TiN bottom step coverage at cylinder center floor relative to top field thickness** | `85.0` | +/- 4.0% | Calibrated HAADF-STEM line profile measurement across the horizontal bottom interface. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **TiN core stoichiometric Ti:N atomic concentration ratio** | `1.00` | +/- 0.05 | STEM-EDS quantitative elemental spectral area integration across 3 test points on sidewall and bottom. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful delivery of TEM_TiN_Step_Coverage_Analysis_Report.pdf displaying fully continuous, void-free TiN film with verified >=90% sidewall step coverage, >=85% bottom step coverage, and verified absence of FIB curtaining or delamination across all 5 measured test dies, approved by DRAM Foundation VN Metrology Lead.

critics.systems_engineer: STEM/TEM cross-sectional metrology provides definitive physical nanoscale truth for 3D crown capacitor TiN step coverage, but it is inherently destructive, localized, and has low throughput. The core challenge is bridging cross-sectional TEM slice data with non-destructive in-line spectroscopic ellipsometry and sheet resistance measurements across 200mm wafers to ensure radial uniformity across all high-aspect-ratio cylinder arrays without sacrificing sample yield.
critics.domain_expert: At aspect ratios exceeding 15:1 to 20:1 for 180nm-node DRAM crown cells, precursor transport depletion (TiCl4/NH3 or TDMAT) severely degrades bottom and sidewall step coverage. Focused Ion Beam (FIB) specimen preparation introduces Ga+ ion beam damage, curtaining artifacts, and amorphous redeposition. High-resolution HAADF-STEM with sub-0.2 nm spatial resolution and low-kV final polish (<2 kV Ga+ or Ar+ nanomill) is mandatory to accurately resolve the 10-15 nm TiN continuous barrier without artificial delamination or thickness distortion.
critics.supply_chain: Dual-beam FIB/SEM and 200/300kV aberration-corrected STEM tools represent significant capital equipment bottlenecks and cost-per-sample drivers. Outsourcing sample preparation or relying on shared metrology centers risks queue-time escalation, oxidation of freshly cleaved TiN interfaces, and critical data turnaround latency for ALD process recipe optimization cycles.
critics.laya_pm: TEM turnaround time (TAT) per wafer coupon directly dictates the iteration pace of ALD reactor tuning runs. A standardized coupon cleavage protocol, fiducial alignment marks on scribe lines, and an automated lamella pick-and-place routine must be enforced to keep preparation and measurement cycles strictly under 8 hours per lot.
critical_failure_modes: Lamella curtaining and preferential redeposition during FIB milling masking the real TiN-to-dielectric interface at the bottom of the crown trench.
Post-deposition ambient oxidation of ultrathin TiN sidewalls prior to vacuum transfer, generating TiOxNy artifacts and skewing physical thickness measurements by >1.5 nm.
Structural collapse or bowing of high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor cylinder walls induced by mechanical stress relaxation during thin lamella thinning down to <50 nm.

testcases.title: HAADF-STEM Quantitative Sidewall and Bottom TiN Step Coverage Verification
testcases.instrumentation: FEI/ThermoFisher Helios DualBeam FIB/SEM for site-specific lift-out with Fischione 1040 Nanomill, paired with a 200kV Field Emission Analytical STEM (FEI Tecnai/Talos or JEOL ARM200F) equipped with HAADF detector and calibrated sub-nanometer magnification standards.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer coupon cleaved from center, middle, and edge test macro dies containing 180nm crown capacitor test structures post-TiN ALD. Protective in-situ electron-beam and ion-beam Pt/C cap (>1.5 um thickness) deposited over target trench array prior to 30 kV Ga+ trenching.
testcases.procedure: 1. Navigate DualBeam FIB to crown capacitor test array scribe structure. 2. Deposit 300 nm electron-beam Pt followed by 2.0 um ion-beam Pt strap. 3. Perform bulk trenching at 30 kV, 9 nA to release 15x2 um lamella; lift out and mount on Cu Omniprobe TEM grid. 4. Thin lamella progressively to 100 nm at 16 kV (0.15 nA) and 5 kV (40 pA). 5. Final low-energy polish at 2 kV (15 pA) or Ar+ nanomill to achieve <40 nm lamella thickness without amorphous Ga damage. 6. Transfer in inert vacuum capsule to 200 kV STEM. 7. Acquire calibrated HAADF-STEM micrographs at 500kX-1.2MX magnification at five designated locations: field top, cylinder neck, upper sidewall (80% height), lower sidewall (20% height), and trench bottom center. 8. Extract calibrated intensity profile lines across TiN interfaces to determine physical thickness.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Physical TiN thickness must be >= 10.0 nm at field top. Sidewall step coverage (thickness at 20% height divided by top field thickness) must be >= 90.0%. Bottom step coverage (thickness at bottom trench center divided by top field thickness) must be >= 85.0%. TiN layer must be continuous with zero pinholes or voids.

testcases.title: High-Resolution STEM-EDS Compositional Uniformity and Oxidation Depth Profiling
testcases.instrumentation: 200 kV Analytical STEM equipped with Large Solid-Angle Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) system and automated drift correction.
testcases.pre_conditions: FIB lamella prepared according to TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-2-01 with thickness verified <= 40 nm via electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) low-loss mean free path ratio (t/lambda <= 0.4).
testcases.procedure: 1. Align electron probe in STEM mode with probe size <0.5 nm and beam current ~300 pA. 2. Define EDS linescan vectors across the crown bottom corner and lower sidewall (normal to TiN/ZrO2-Al2O3-ZrO2 interface) with 0.2 nm spatial step pitch and 500 ms dwell time per point. 3. Quantify atomic percentages of Ti, N, O, Cl (if TiCl4 precursor) or C (if TDMAT precursor) across the film profile. 4. Extract stoichiometry ratio (Ti:N) and quantify oxygen contamination concentration at the inner bulk versus outer interfaces.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Stoichiometric Ti:N ratio must be within 1.00 +/- 0.05 across sidewall and bottom films. Bulk oxygen concentration within the TiN core must be < 2.0 at.%. Halogen (Cl) or Carbon (C) impurity concentration must remain <= 1.5 at.%.

For isopropanol skin/eye contact: Irrigate exposed eyes or dermal areas with isotonic eyewash or deluge shower for 15 minutes. Cleanroom solvent-wetted wipes (IPA) must be collected in self-closing, grounded flammable solvent waste cans. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-FIB-180NM-003`
**Title:** Dual-Beam FIB Precision Lamella Cross-Section Preparation of High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) TiN Crown Storage Capacitor  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > 3D HAR Crown Capacitor ALD Dielectric & Metal Electrode Deposition > Conformal CVD/ALD TiN Top Metal Electrode Deposition > High-Aspect-Ratio TiN Step Coverage Metrology and Sheet Resistance Verification > High-Resolution STEM/TEM TiN Sidewall and Bottom Step Coverage Metrology > FIB Precision Lamella Cross-Section Preparation of HAR TiN Crown Capacitor  
**Generation:** 180nm (Gen 3)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the protocol for dual-beam Focused Ion Beam / Scanning Electron Microscope (FIB-SEM, $\text{Ga}^+$ liquid metal ion source) precision cross-sectional lift-out and lamella preparation. The objective is to extract an intact, artifact-free, electron-transparent lamella across the array pitch of 180nm stacked crown capacitors (erected over drain contacts and tungsten plugs / W-plugs with cell layout pitch of 360 nm to 400 nm) to enable high-resolution STEM/TEM inspection of conformal TiN electrode step coverage.

---

### 2. Process Flow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Pre-Inspection & Protective Deposition             |
|   • E-beam Pt/C capping: 2 kV, 1.6 nA (thickness ~300 nm)    |
|   • I-beam Pt strapping: 30 kV, 80-100 pA (thickness ~1.5 µm)|
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Trench Milling & Cross-Section Bulk Trenching       |
|   • Coarse staircase cuts: 30 kV @ 7-15 nA                  |
|   • Intermediate framing: 30 kV @ 1-3 nA                    |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: In-Situ Micro-Manipulator Lift-Out & Grid Mounting  |
|   • Bottom/side cuts: 30 kV @ 300 pA                        |
|   • Needle welding & post attachment: Cu / Mo Omniprobe grid |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Multi-Stage Thinning & Low-kV Amorphous Cleanup     |
|   • Progressive thinning: 30 kV -> 16 kV -> 5 kV            |
|   • Final flash polish: 1-2 kV @ 20-30 pA (amorphous < 2 nm)|
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Target Registration and Dual Protective Cap Deposition
1. Load the 180nm DRAM test die into the dual-beam FIB-SEM chamber; pump system to high-vacuum base pressure $\le 5.0 \times 10^{-6}\text{ mbar}$.
2. Align the electron beam (SEM) to the targeted $8F^2 / 6F^2$ array block exhibiting stacked crown capacitors over bitline contacts (bitline/wordline pitch: 360 nm to 400 nm).
3. **Electron-Beam Protective Capping:** Deposit an in-situ electron-beam induced deposition (EBID) Pt or C strap directly over the region of interest ($20\ \mu\text{m} \times 2\ \mu\text{m}$) at $2\text{ kV}$, $1.6\text{ nA}$ beam current to a physical thickness of $\sim 300\text{ nm}$ to avoid $\text{Ga}^+$ ion implantation into the upper TiN crown rim.
4. **Ion-Beam Protective Strapping:** Deposit an in-situ ion-beam induced deposition (IBID) Pt strap ($20\ \mu\text{m} \times 2.5\ \mu\text{m}$) using $\text{Ga}^+$ beam at $30\text{ kV}$, $80\text{–}100\text{ pA}$, ramping up to $300\text{ pA}$ until total protective cap thickness reaches $1.5\text{–}2.0\ \mu\text{m}$.

#### Step 2: Coarse Trenching & Cantilever Undercut
1. Position bulk trench milling patterns anterior and posterior to the lamella strip ($18\ \mu\text{m} \times 12\ \mu\text{m}$ area on each side).
2. Execute coarse staircase milling using $\text{Ga}^+$ at $30\text{ kV}$, $7\text{–}15\text{ nA}$ down to a depth of $\sim 6\ \mu\text{m}$, clearing silicon substrate below the W-plug and access transistor baseline ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
3. Reduce ion current to $30\text{ kV}$, $1\text{–}3\text{ nA}$ for intermediate sidewall clean cuts, thinning the lamella membrane slab to a width of $\sim 800\text{ nm}$.
4. Tilt the stage to $45^\circ\text{–}52^\circ$ relative to the ion column, verify clearance, and mill side release cuts and bottom undercut at $30\text{ kV}$, $300\text{–}500\text{ pA}$, leaving a small tether tab ($\sim 1\ \mu\text{m}$) on one lateral edge.

#### Step 3: In-Situ Omniprobe Lift-Out and Half-Grid Attachment
1. Insert the in-situ tungsten micro-manipulator (Omniprobe/EasyLift) needle and align within $500\text{ nm}$ of the free edge of the lamella.
2. Weld the needle tip to the lamella top corner using local Pt deposition ($30\text{ kV}$, $50\text{–}80\text{ pA}$, $1\ \mu\text{m} \times 1\ \mu\text{m}$ patch).
3. Mill through the remaining tether tab at $30\text{ kV}$, $300\text{ pA}$.
4. Retract the needle along the z-axis smoothly; translate stage to the transmission electron microscopy (TEM) Omniprobe Cu or Mo half-grid.
5. Mount the lamella onto a grid post, weld contact edges with Pt deposition ($30\text{ kV}$, $100\text{ pA}$), and detach the tungsten needle using a line cut at $30\text{ kV}$, $500\text{ pA}$.

#### Step 4: Precision Multi-Stage Thinning and Low-kV Amorphous Cleanup
1. **Rough Thinning:** Angle beam at $\pm 2.0^\circ$ off parallel to accommodate beam divergence. Mill both sides using $30\text{ kV}$ at $300\text{ pA}$ until membrane thickness reaches $\sim 300\text{ nm}$.
2. **Intermediate Thinning:** Tilt stage to $\pm 1.2^\circ$; mill with $16\text{ kV}$ at $100\text{ pA}$ down to a membrane thickness of $\sim 120\text{ nm}$.
3. **Fine Polish:** Tilt stage to $\pm 0.5^\circ$; mill with $5\text{ kV}$ at $40\text{ pA}$ until target thickness of $40\text{–}60\text{ nm}$ is achieved across the 360 nm–400 nm periodic array of crowns and W-plugs.
4. **Low-Energy Amorphous Removal:** Perform final broad-beam sweep on both faces at $1\text{–}2\text{ kV}$, $20\text{–}30\text{ pA}$ at glancing incidence ($\pm 5^\circ\text{–}7^\circ$) for $45\text{ s}$ per side to strip off $\text{Ga}^+$ implantation and amorphous surface damage layers.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Final Lamella Thickness** | $50\text{ nm} \pm 10\text{ nm}$ across the active crown region | High-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) / STEM EELS low-loss log-ratio mean free path ($t/\lambda$) |
| **Amorphous Damage Layer Thickness** | $\le 2.0\text{ nm}$ per exposed sidewall surface | HR-TEM lattice fringe edge imaging (measuring crystalline fringe termination of Si/W/TiN) |
| **Structural Integrity & Curtain Defect Amplitude** | $\Delta z \le 3\text{ nm}$ surface roughness / zero crown voiding or bend distortion | STEM bright-field cross-sectional imaging along the 360 nm–400 nm cell pitch |
| **Field-of-View Array Uniformity** | $\ge 5$ continuous intact 1T1C cells preserved on lamella | STEM / TEM montaged low-magnification overview (showing contiguous crowns over W-plugs) |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
* **Cell Architecture & Array Pitch:** 180nm DRAM cells adopt $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) topologies, with bitline/wordline pitch of approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$. *(Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering; 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench)*
* **Sub-Capacitor Interconnect Topology:** Crown-shaped capacitor structure erected above the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug) connected to access transistors with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. *(Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench)*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dual-beam FIB/SEM (Ga+ LMIS) milling across 180nm node high-aspect-ratio (HAR > 12:1) 3D crown cylinder structures induces differential sputter rates between the porous/empty crown dielectric cavities, the dense ALD TiN shell (ρ ≈ 5.2 g/cm³), and the surrounding ILD/SiO₂ matrix. If protective strap deposition lacks an in-situ electron-beam-assisted Pt/C cap before Ga+ ion-beam deposition, curtaining artifacts will completely distort sidewall profile angle and apparent film thickness in downstream STEM annular dark-field imaging.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: High-energy 30 kV Ga+ ion milling creates severe surface amorphous damage layers (up to 20-30 nm thick) and significant Ga+ implantation into the ultra-thin (15-20 nm) conformal ALD TiN bottom electrode. To resolve sub-nanometer grain boundaries and true conformal step coverage along deep re-entrant bottom corners, low-kV final polish polishing (5 kV down to 1-2 kV @ 15-30 pA) is mandatory to thin the lamella to <40 nm while restricting the amorphous sidewall layer to <1.5 nm per side.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: N/A
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: FIB lamella preparation represents a high-cost destructive metrology bottleneck with throughput rarely exceeding 2-3 site-specific lamellae per 8-hour shift. Metrology sampling plans must enforce stringent coordinate-mapping fiducials aligned to the 180nm DRAM test array to prevent costly lift-out misregistration and re-milling iterations.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Curtaining and striation artifacts across deep crown cylinders caused by voids or inadequate electron-beam Pt capping, preventing accurate sidewall TiN thickness measurements.
1. Mechanical rupture or thermal-stress bowing of high-aspect-ratio 3D crown cylindrical shells during final 2 kV Ga+ thinning to sub-40 nm electron transparency.
1. Excessive Ga+ ion beam mixing and amorphous damage zone (>3 nm) obscuring the TiN/high-k dielectric interface.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-2-1-01` | **Site-Specific Electron/Ion Beam Pt Capping and Lift-Out Extraction Verification** | Dual-beam FIB-SEM system (e.g. Thermo Scientific Helios / FEI Scios) equipped with multi-channel Gas Injection System (GIS) and in-situ piezo micromanipulator. | 1. Navigate to target 180nm crown capacitor array; deposit e-beam Pt strap (2 kV, 1.6 nA, dimensions 15 μm x 2 μm x 0.5 μm). 2. Deposit ion-beam Ga+ Pt strap (30 kV, 0.23 nA, thickness 2.0 μm). 3. Mill bulk trenches on front and back sides using 30 kV 9 nA Ga+ beam down to 6 μm depth. 4. Perform bottom and side undercut cuts at 30 kV 0.79 nA. 5. Attach micromanipulator tungsten needle via Pt spot weld (30 kV, 40 pA) and excise lamella from bulk substrate. 6. Transfer lamella to TEM copper Omniprobe grid and weld with Pt tacking. | `Lift-out transfer success rate = 100%; Pt capping protection layer thickness >= 2.0 μm with zero curtaining defect or ion-beam voiding in the crown array region under 5 kV SEM inspection.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-2-1-02` | **Multi-Stage Low-kV Thinning and Amorphous Layer Thickness Validation** | Dual-beam FIB-SEM with low-kV Ga+ deceleration mode, integrated STEM detector (HAADF/BF), and calibrated TEM grid stage. | 1. Perform intermediate thinning using 30 kV Ga+ beam at 240 pA down to 300 nm thickness. 2. Tilt stage ±1.5° and thin to 120 nm using 16 kV Ga+ beam at 50 pA. 3. Fine-thin at ±2.0° using 5 kV Ga+ beam at 30 pA down to ~60 nm. 4. Perform final surface clean/polish using 2 kV Ga+ beam at 15 pA at ±3.0° glancing angle to reach final target thickness. 5. Inspect lamella on-axis using integrated 30 kV STEM detector to measure uniform optical density and thickness. | `Total lamella thickness within target window of 35 nm to 45 nm across entire 1.8 μm depth of the crown capacitor; Ga+ induced amorphous surface layer <= 1.5 nm per side determined by high-resolution STEM boundary contrast.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom clean-suit (Tyvek), Double nitrile gloves (chemical and vacuum clean), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser impact safety glasses, Liquid nitrogen cryogenic handling gloves and face shield (for cold-trap fills)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with organometallic Pt GIS precursor or Ga metal residue: Immediately brush off loose residue, flush exposed skin thoroughly with copious water for at least 15 minutes, remove contaminated clothing, and seek medical evaluation. For liquid nitrogen cryogenic cold contact: Immerse frostbitten tissue in warm water bath (38-42°C); do not rub affected tissue.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous vacuum turbo-molecular pump exhaust manifold vented to certified toxic scrubbed cleanroom exhaust; GIS delivery lines fitted with automated pneumatic isolation interlocks; ambient O2 deficiency monitor installed near FIB cryo-cold-trap refilling stations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent GIS organometallic platinum ampoules and Ga-contaminated chamber aperture strips must be sealed in argon-purged hazardous material containers and routed to certified precious metal reclaim and hazardous organometallic disposal facilities.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV)** | `94442-22-5` | Sublimed Electronic Grade | `>= 99.0%` |
| **Gallium (Liquid Metal Ion Source)** | `7440-55-3` | 6N Ultra-Pure | `99.9999%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (Cryo-baffle / cold trap)** | `7727-37-9` | Cryogenic Industrial | `>= 99.99%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN crown wafer coupon stored in sealed purge container; surface free of moisture, chemical adsorbates, or native TiO2 overgrowth (effective TiOx thickness < 0.5 nm).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Completed electron-transparent (<45 nm) lamella mounted on Cu Omniprobe grid, sealed under continuous dry N2 purge or high-vacuum transfer pod (<1e-4 mbar).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation converting ultra-thin (15-20 nm) ALD TiN sidewall layers into native TiOxNy, introducing artificial dielectric boundary artifacts and lattice swelling that invalidate precision step coverage TEM metrology.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Fabrication of an ultra-thin (<45 nm), defect-free, site-specific TEM cross-section lamella through the exact axial center of high-aspect-ratio 180nm DRAM TiN crown capacitors, fully prepared and mounted on a Cu Omniprobe TEM grid ready for atomic-resolution STEM/HAADF metrology.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FIB_TEM_Lamella_Final_SEM_Inspection_10kV.tiff`
- [ ] `Lamella_Thickness_EELS_LowLoss_Log.csv`
- [ ] `FIB_Crown_CrossSection_Preparation_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Final lamella uniform thickness across entire crown height** | `40 nm` | +/- 5 nm | In-situ low-loss EELS mean-free-path (t/λ) mapping and HAADF-STEM calibrated cross-section intensity profile. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Ga+ beam-induced amorphous damage layer thickness on TiN sidewall** | `1.2 nm` | <= 1.5 nm | High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) lattice fringe analysis at 200 kV. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Lamella pitch/roll axial tilt misalignment relative to crown cylinder centerline** | `0.0 deg` | <= 0.5 deg | High-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) on-axis diffraction contrast alignment. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires 100% intact lamella securely tack-welded to Cu Omniprobe grid with target crown capacitor clearly centered, zero curtaining artifacts in the active 3D cylinder region, uniform thickness between 35-45 nm verified by EELS, and amorphous surface damage confirmed <= 1.5 nm.

testcases.procedure: 1. Navigate to target 180nm crown capacitor array; deposit e-beam Pt strap (2 kV, 1.6 nA, dimensions 15 μm x 2 μm x 0.5 μm). 2. Deposit ion-beam Ga+ Pt strap (30 kV, 0.23 nA, thickness 2.0 μm). 3. Mill bulk trenches on front and back sides using 30 kV 9 nA Ga+ beam down to 6 μm depth. 4. Perform bottom and side undercut cuts at 30 kV 0.79 nA. 5. Attach micromanipulator tungsten needle via Pt spot weld (30 kV, 40 pA) and excise lamella from bulk substrate. 6. Transfer lamella to TEM copper Omniprobe grid and weld with Pt tacking.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Lift-out transfer success rate = 100%; Pt capping protection layer thickness >= 2.0 μm with zero curtaining defect or ion-beam voiding in the crown array region under 5 kV SEM inspection.

testcases.title: Multi-Stage Low-kV Thinning and Amorphous Layer Thickness Validation
testcases.instrumentation: Dual-beam FIB-SEM with low-kV Ga+ deceleration mode, integrated STEM detector (HAADF/BF), and calibrated TEM grid stage.
testcases.pre_conditions: Excised lamella securely mounted on Cu half-grid post, initial lamella thickness <= 1.5 μm.
testcases.procedure: 1. Perform intermediate thinning using 30 kV Ga+ beam at 240 pA down to 300 nm thickness. 2. Tilt stage ±1.5° and thin to 120 nm using 16 kV Ga+ beam at 50 pA. 3. Fine-thin at ±2.0° using 5 kV Ga+ beam at 30 pA down to ~60 nm. 4. Perform final surface clean/polish using 2 kV Ga+ beam at 15 pA at ±3.0° glancing angle to reach final target thickness. 5. Inspect lamella on-axis using integrated 30 kV STEM detector to measure uniform optical density and thickness.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total lamella thickness within target window of 35 nm to 45 nm across entire 1.8 μm depth of the crown capacitor; Ga+ induced amorphous surface layer <= 1.5 nm per side determined by high-resolution STEM boundary contrast.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom clean-suit (Tyvek)
Double nitrile gloves (chemical and vacuum clean)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser impact safety glasses
Liquid nitrogen cryogenic handling gloves and face shield (for cold-trap fills)
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of skin contact with organometallic Pt GIS precursor or Ga metal residue: Immediately brush off loose residue, flush exposed skin thoroughly with copious water for at least 15 minutes, remove contaminated clothing, and seek medical evaluation. For liquid nitrogen cryogenic cold contact: Immerse frostbitten tissue in warm water bath (38-42°C); do not rub affected tissue.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Continuous vacuum turbo-molecular pump exhaust manifold vented to certified toxic scrubbed cleanroom exhaust; GIS delivery lines fitted with automated pneumatic isolation interlocks; ambient O2 deficiency monitor installed near FIB cryo-cold-trap refilling stations.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent GIS organometallic platinum ampoules and Ga-contaminated chamber aperture strips must be sealed in argon-purged hazardous material containers and routed to certified precious metal reclaim and hazardous organometallic disposal facilities.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly deposited ALD TiN crown wafer coupon stored in sealed purge container; surface free of moisture, chemical adsorbates, or native TiO2 overgrowth (effective TiOx thickness < 0.5 nm).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Completed electron-transparent (<45 nm) lamella mounted on Cu Omniprobe grid, sealed under continuous dry N2 purge or high-vacuum transfer pod (<1e-4 mbar).
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Atmospheric oxidation converting ultra-thin (15-20 nm) ALD TiN sidewall layers into native TiOxNy, introducing artificial dielectric boundary artifacts and lattice swelling that invalidate precision step coverage TEM metrology.

expected_result.summary: Fabrication of an ultra-thin (<45 nm), defect-free, site-specific TEM cross-section lamella through the exact axial center of high-aspect-ratio 180nm DRAM TiN crown capacitors, fully prepared and mounted on a Cu Omniprobe TEM grid ready for atomic-resolution STEM/HAADF metrology.

quantitative_assertions.verification_method: In-situ low-loss EELS mean-free-path (t/λ) mapping and HAADF-STEM calibrated cross-section intensity profile.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Ga+ beam-induced amorphous damage layer thickness on TiN sidewall
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) lattice fringe analysis at 200 kV.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Lamella pitch/roll axial tilt misalignment relative to crown cylinder centerline
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) on-axis diffraction contrast alignment.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Researcher exit signoff requires 100% intact lamella securely tack-welded to Cu Omniprobe grid with target crown capacitor clearly centered, zero curtaining artifacts in the active 3D cylinder region, uniform thickness between 35-45 nm verified by EELS, and amorphous surface damage confirmed <= 1.5 nm.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Resolution STEM HAADF Imaging for TiN Sidewall and Bottom Step Coverage

**Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip / DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Level:** Crown MIM Capacitor Electrode Metrology  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology  

---

### 1. Metrology Workflow Architecture

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  FIB Lamella Prep &  │
│      Pt Capping      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   STEM Alignment &   │
│     HAADF Setup      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Crown Capacitor    │
│  Z-Contrast Imaging  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  TiN Step Coverage   │
│      Extraction      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Acceptance      │
│    Verification &    │
│      Pass/Fail       │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Specimen Extraction & FIB Lamella Preparation:**
   - Deposit an in-situ electron-beam/ion-beam protective Pt capping layer over the 3D crown capacitor array to preserve the top TiN electrode morphology.
   - Using a DualBeam FIB (Gallium ion source at 30 kV down to 2–5 kV for final low-damage polish), mill a cross-sectional lamella across the stacked capacitor bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Polish lamella to a final uniform electron transparency thickness $t \le 40\text{ nm}$ across the crown capacitor cavity (aspect ratio $\sim 8:1$ to $10:1$, targeting $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ active node alignment).

2. **Instrument Setup & STEM Alignment:**
   - Load lamella into a field-emission Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (FEG-STEM).
   - Accelerating voltage: Set to $200\text{ kV}$ with probe convergence semi-angle $\alpha = 18 - 25\text{ mrad}$.
   - Align High-Angle Annular Dark-Field (HAADF) detector with an inner collection semi-angle $\beta_{\text{in}} \ge 50 - 70\text{ mrad}$ to ensure pure Rutherford-like $Z$-contrast imaging ($I \propto Z^{1.7-2.0}$), clearly isolating high-$Z$ Ta/W/Ti from lower-$Z$ Si/O/N layers (dielectric stack: $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or ONO).

3. **High-Resolution HAADF Acquisition:**
   - Orient the sample to the silicon $[110]$ zone axis or along the crown sidewall tangent to eliminate projection overlap.
   - Acquire cross-sectional STEM HAADF micrographs at nominal magnification $\ge 500,000\times$ (calibrated pixel size $\le 0.1\text{ nm/pixel}$, verified against the physical placement grid resolution $\le 5\text{ nm}$).
   - Capture three critical spatial regions per crown cell:
     - **Region A (Top):** Horizontal top surface of the crown rim.
     - **Region B (Sidewall):** Mid-depth vertical interior sidewall profile.
     - **Region C (Bottom):** Bottom horizontal floor and corner fillet adjacent to the underlying contact/W-plug.

4. **Digital Image Processing & Thickness Extraction:**
   - Extract intensity line profiles perpendicular to the interface across Regions A, B, and C.
   - Determine physical film thickness ($T_{\text{top}}$, $T_{\text{side}}$, $T_{\text{bottom}}$) using full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) of the TiN intensity profile.
   - Calculate step coverage ratios:
     $$\text{Bottom Step Coverage (\%)} = \left(\frac{T_{\text{bottom}}}{T_{\text{top}}}\right) \times 100\%$$
     $$\text{Sidewall Step Coverage (\%)} = \left(\frac{T_{\text{side}}}{T_{\text{top}}}\right) \times 100\%$$

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                   TiN Step Coverage Target Distribution
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░                            │
  Bot TiN Thk (nm)┤░░░░░░░░                            │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
  Top TiN Thk (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
Side/Top Ratio (%)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 Bot/Top Ratio (%)┤███████████████████████████████████ │
                  │███████████████████████████████████ │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0       23       46      69       92 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TiN Bottom Step Coverage** | $\ge 90.0$ | Min $85.0$ | $\%$ | FWHM HAADF Line Profile ($T_{\text{bottom}}/T_{\text{top}}$) |
| **TiN Sidewall Step Coverage** | $\ge 90.0$ | Min $85.0$ | $\%$ | FWHM HAADF Line Profile ($T_{\text{side}}/T_{\text{top}}$) |
| **Nominal Top TiN Thickness** | $20.0$ | $\pm 2.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Calibrated STEM HAADF Profile ($T_{\text{top}}$) |
| **Corner Fillet Continuity** | $100$ (No micro-voids or pinch-off) | Zero voiding $> 1.0\text{ nm}$ | boolean / count | High-resolution HAADF corner inspection |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture with crown topology.
  - Access transistor channel dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Crown capacitor contact established above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric layer ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO stack) requiring conformal metal electrode capping to satisfy storage capacitance budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor requiring cell capacitance of $25 - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to maintain retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch is $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$, defining the lamella target pitch.
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
  - Physical placement grid resolution is $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - Contact hole dimension: $0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$ ($170\text{ nm} \times 170\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum active diffusion width: $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: STEM HAADF imaging of deep 3D crown capacitor TiN liners requires site-specific DualBeam FIB lamella preparation with sub-30 nm thickness without curtaining or preferential Ga+ knock-on amorphization. Systems integration must ensure that the measured 2D cross-sectional TiN step coverage directly calibrates the full-wafer crown capacitance-voltage (C-V) modeling without introducing sample-prep spatial distortion artifacts across high-aspect-ratio cylinder arrays.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: HAADF detector inner semi-angle must be calibrated strictly above 50 mrad at 200 kV to guarantee pure Rutherford-dominated Z-contrast (intensity proportional to ~Z^1.7-2.0), clearly distinguishing the ALD TiN electrode (Z_Ti=22, Z_N=7) from the underlying high-k dielectric (e.g., ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2) and bottom metal node. Failure to optimize beam probe convergence angle (alpha ~ 15-25 mrad) will lead to probe broadening within high-aspect-ratio sidewall grooves and erroneous thickness underestimation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: DualBeam Ga+ FIB and high-brightness Schottky FEG-STEM tool time represents a severe operational bottleneck with costs exceeding $350/hour; relying on third-party analytical service bureaus introduces a 5 to 7 day cycle-time delay that disrupts real-time feedback loops to the ALD TiN deposition furnace.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Because TEM sample preparation is destructive and low-throughput (2 to 3 lamellae per 8-hour shift), sample coupon selection must strictly follow statistically representative wafer coordinates (center, middle, edge) to validate ALD precursor diffusion kinetics across the 200mm wafer plane prior to committing to whole-lot metallization signoff.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Lamella bend contour or curtaining along the high-aspect-ratio crown capacitor sidewalls causing artificial contrast variation and inaccurate TiN physical thickness measurement by >1.5 nm.
1. Ga+ ion beam damage during 30 kV trenching forming an amorphous intermetallic Ga-Ti-Si alloy layer, masking genuine ALD TiN interface roughness and oxidation.
1. Hydrocarbon electron-beam-induced contamination (EBIC) deposition during high-magnification HAADF dwell, obscuring sub-nanometer bottom corner step coverage.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-2-2-01` | **Quantitative HAADF-STEM TiN Sidewall and Bottom Step Coverage Ratio Verification** | 200 kV FEG Analytical Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (STEM) with High-Angle Annular Dark-Field (HAADF) Detector and Fischione Plasma Cleaner | 1. Insert specimen holder into STEM goniometer and evacuate column to <= 1.5e-5 Pa. 2. Align zone axis of substrate silicon to [110] using Kikuchi diffraction patterns. 3. Acquire low-magnification STEM survey image to verify crown cylinder aspect ratio and orientation. 4. Acquire calibrated HAADF-STEM micrographs (2048x2048 pixels, 15 us dwell time) at 5 key positions: top planar field, top cylinder rim, mid-sidewall (depth = 50%), bottom sidewall (depth = 90%), and center bottom cup. 5. Extract calibrated line intensity profiles across TiN interfaces at 10 equispaced points per zone using DigitalMicrograph or ImageJ, measuring full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) thickness. | `TiN step coverage ratio (Bottom Thickness / Top Planar Thickness) must be >= 92.0%; Mid-sidewall step coverage ratio (Mid-Sidewall Thickness / Top Planar Thickness) must be >= 95.0%; absolute bottom corner TiN thickness must be >= 9.2 nm for nominal 10.0 nm target deposition.` |
| `TC-CROWN-ALD-MODULE-2-3-2-2-02` | **High-Resolution STEM-EDS Interface Compositional Abruptness and Delamination Screen** | 200 kV Analytical STEM equipped with 4-quadrant windowless Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) array | 1. Position high-brightness electron probe (0.2 nm probe diameter, 250 pA probe current) across the TiN/high-k dielectric bottom interface. 2. Perform 2D hyper-spectral EDS map across bottom and sidewall interfaces (50 nm x 50 nm scan box, 0.5 nm pixel spacing). 3. Extract 1D atomic concentration profile for Ti-K_alpha (4.51 keV), N-K_alpha (0.392 keV), and adjacent dielectric elements across the interface. 4. Measure 10%-90% transition width across the TiN/dielectric boundary. | `TiN/dielectric interface transition width must be <= 1.2 nm indicating no interdiffusion or voiding; no physical delamination gap observed (>0.2 nm) along entire bottom perimeter; atomic Ti:N stoichiometric ratio must remain between 0.95 and 1.05.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved when handling vacuum components), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown and ESD footwear, Cryogenic insulated gloves and face shield for liquid nitrogen replenishment on EDS/vacuum traps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For cryogenic liquid nitrogen splash/frostbite: Flush affected tissue with lukewarm water (not hot) immediately; do not rub; seek medical assistance. For IPA inhalation or eye contact: Irrigate eyes at plumbed emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes; remove to fresh air in case of vapor inhalation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Laboratory equipped with continuous oxygen depletion monitoring sensors (ODS) with audible and visual alarms calibrated to trip at <19.5% O2; local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on chemical preparation benches and roughing pump oil mist exhausts routed to certified facility scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent (IPA) collected in dedicated, grounded flammable waste containers for solvent incineration; expired or contaminated TEM grids disposed of in solid heavy-metal hazardous waste streams.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for specimen grid cleaning** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `>= 99.9%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (for STEM cold-trap and EDS detector cooling)** | `7727-37-9` | Industrial Cryogenic Grade | `100.0%` |
| **Argon gas (carrier/milling gas for ion mill)** | `7440-37-1` | Grade 5.0 (Ultra-High Purity) | `>= 99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly FIB-thinned and low-kV Ar-polished lamella on Mo/Cu TEM grid, protected from ambient hydrocarbon condensation and atmospheric moisture.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Post-STEM examined lamella with verified absence of beam-induced carbon deposition, stored in dry N2 purged vacuum desiccator box (relative humidity < 5%).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exposure to ambient air beyond 60 minutes causes atmospheric moisture absorption and ambient hydrocarbon deposition on the lamella, resulting in severe beam-induced contamination during HAADF dwell, surface TiN oxidation (forming native TiO2/TiOxNy), and artificial expansion of measured physical boundary layers.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified sub-Angstrom precision High-Resolution STEM HAADF imaging and step coverage metrology of ALD TiN top electrode within high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitor structures, proving conformality >= 92% across all capacitor topologies.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `HAADF_STEM_TiN_Coverage_Report_W03_Lot04.pdf`
- [ ] `TiN_Sidewall_Bottom_Thickness_Data_Log.csv`
- [ ] `Calibrated_200kV_HAADF_STEM_Micrographs_Raw_DataSet.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Bottom-to-Top ALD TiN physical step coverage ratio in 3D crown capacitor cavity** | `95.0%` | +-3.0% | Calibrated 200 kV HAADF-STEM micrograph line-intensity integration across 10 distinct vertical crown cup cross-sections |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Mid-depth sidewall TiN thickness continuity and absence of pinch-off thinning** | `9.6 nm` | +-0.5 nm | High-magnification HAADF intensity profile measurement calibrated against Si [110] crystal lattice spacing (0.192 nm) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Hydrocarbon beam-induced contamination ring thickness post-imaging** | `< 0.3 nm` | +0.1 nm | Differential dark-field contrast subtraction before and after 60-second high-magnification acquisition dwell |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Unambiguous approval signed off by Metrology Module Lead and Thin Films Deposition Lead confirming: (1) measured bottom step coverage >= 92.0% across center, middle, and edge wafer coupon lamellae, (2) zero delamination or void defects at bottom dielectric corners, and (3) all artifacts, raw TIFF datasets, and CSV line profiles successfully cataloged in the DRAM Foundation VN database.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Metrology: TEM-EDX Line-Scan Profile Extraction and Step Coverage Conformality Quantification

**Module / Sub-system:** Metrology > High-Resolution STEM/TEM TiN Sidewall and Bottom Step Coverage Metrology  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN), Gen 3 (nm), 1T1C Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Execution  

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   TEM Lamella Prep -   │
│   FIB Lift-out Under   │
│          50nm          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   STEM-HAADF Imaging   │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  EDX Drift-Corrected   │
│       Line-Scan        │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Ti-Ka and N-K Net    │
│  Intensity Extraction  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     FWHM Physical      │
│   Thickness Fitting    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Conformality Ratio   │
│     Quantification     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Specimen Preparation (FIB Site-Specific Lift-Out):**
   - Identify memory array crown capacitor test cells in the 180nm array (bitline pitch: 360 nm to 400 nm; transistor footprint $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Deposit in-situ protective Pt/C capping layer via dual-beam FIB.
   - Thin lamella to uniform final electron-transparency thickness $\le 45\text{ nm}$ using a final low-energy Ga⁺ Polish beam at $2\text{ kV}, 28\text{ pA}$ to eliminate surface amorphization.

2. **STEM-HAADF Imaging Setup:**
   - Load sample into Analytical FEG-TEM/STEM operated at $200\text{ kV}$ accelerating voltage.
   - Align High-Angle Annular Dark-Field (HAADF) detector: camera length $100\text{ mm}$, probe convergence semi-angle $\alpha = 18.5\text{ mrad}$, probe current $I_p \approx 0.5\text{ nA}$ with sub-nanometer spot size ($\le 0.2\text{ nm}$).
   - Tilt sample to the exact zone axis perpendicular to the capacitor trench sidewall to eliminate artificial projection blurring.

3. **EDX Line-Scan Profile Extraction:**
   - Activate Drift-Correction System (cross-correlation tracking on gold/platinum reference marker every $10\text{ s}$).
   - Position high-density EDX line-scan vectors perpendicular to the TiN film at 5 critical locations:
     1. **Top Flat Surface** ($t_{\text{top}}$)
     2. **Upper Sidewall** ($z = 80\%$ crown trench height)
     3. **Mid Sidewall** ($z = 50\%$ crown trench height)
     4. **Lower Sidewall** ($z = 20\%$ crown trench height)
     5. **Crown Trench Bottom** ($t_{\text{bottom}}$)
   - Set scan profile step size to $0.25\text{ nm/step}$ with a dwell time of $250\text{ ms/pixel}$ across an energy dispersion range of $0 - 20\text{ keV}$ capturing $\text{Ti-K}\alpha$ ($4.51\text{ keV}$), $\text{Ti-L}\alpha$ ($0.45\text{ keV}$), $\text{N-K}\alpha$ ($0.39\text{ keV}$), and oxygen/tantalum/aluminum dielectric edge signals.

4. **Background Subtraction & Full-Width Half-Maximum (FWHM) Extraction:**
   - Fit and subtract bremsstrahlung background using a polynomial model.
   - Extract Gaussian-fitted Net Peak Areas for $\text{Ti-K}\alpha$ and calculate the physical layer thickness ($t$) at each location using the 50% relative intensity threshold / FWHM of the elemental line-profile.

5. **Step Coverage Conformality & Stoichiometry Quantification:**
   - Calculate step coverage ratios:
     $$\text{Conformality}_{\text{bottom}} = \frac{t_{\text{bottom}}}{t_{\text{top}}} \times 100\%$$
     $$\text{Conformality}_{\text{mid-sidewall}} = \frac{t_{\text{mid-sidewall}}}{t_{\text{top}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Calculate atomic ratio ($\text{Ti}:\text{N}$) via Cliff-Lorimer thin-foil quantification with experimentally determined $k_{\text{TiN}}$ factors.

---


| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Technique / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TiN Bottom Step Coverage Conformality** | $\ge 90.0\%$ ($t_{\text{bottom}} / t_{\text{top}}$) | 200 kV STEM-EDX $\text{Ti-K}\alpha$ FWHM line profile |
| **TiN Mid-Sidewall Step Coverage Conformality** | $\ge 92.0\%$ ($t_{\text{mid}} / t_{\text{top}}$) | 200 kV STEM-EDX $\text{Ti-K}\alpha$ FWHM line profile |
| **TiN Stoichiometric Atomic Ratio ($\text{Ti}:\text{N}$)** | $1.00 \pm 0.05$ (at/at) | Cliff-Lorimer EDX quantification across sidewalls |
| **FIB Lamella Metrology Window Thickness** | $\le 45\text{ nm}$ | Low-loss EELS mean free path / STEM HAADF contrast |

---

### 4. Context References & Micro-Knowledge Persistence
- **Integration Context:** Verified against *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (8F² / 6F² folded bitline, cell footprint with access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked crown capacitor over bitline on W-plug, dielectric stack $\kappa > 15$, $C_{\text{cell}} \ge 28\text{ fF}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Capacitor & Physical Limits Context:** Aligned with *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, equivalent oxide thickness EOT $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$, retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Documented Artifact:** Persisted to [tem_edx_tin_conformality_sop.md](./docs/knowledge/tem_edx_tin_conformality_sop.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: STEM-EDX characterization of the high-aspect-ratio (AR >= 12:1, depth ~1.5-1.8 um) TiN/ZrO2-Al2O3-ZrO2 crown capacitor requires strict correlation between lamella tilt alignment (< 0.5 deg off zone axis) and actual physical film thickness. Beam broadening through a 50-80 nm thick lamella can induce artificial Ti-K/N-K peak smearing across the 10 nm nominal TiN electrode, leading to an overestimation of sidewall conformality if deconvolution algorithms fail to account for electron scattering physics.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At Gen 3 (180nm node open-source DRAM 3D crown), the top TiN electrode is deposited via ALD utilizing TiCl4 and NH3 precursors. Ti-Kalpha and N-K EDX line scans across the capacitor crown top, sidewall (top, middle, bottom 10%), and bottom trench must resolve both physical step coverage and stoichiometric uniformity. A major artifact risk is TiCl4 residual chlorine segregation (Cl-Kalpha peak at 2.62 keV) at the TiN/high-k interface, which causes parasitic work function drift and leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Dual-beam FIB-SEM (Ga+ ion source) lift-out consumables (Pt precursor GIS gas, Omniprobe W tips, Cu/Mo TEM half-grids) and STEM-EDX operational time exceed $450/hour. High sample prep turnaround time (4 to 6 hours per lamella) throttles inline fab feedback; standardizing grid transfer in inert nitrogen cryo-shuttles is essential to prevent re-milling iterations.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Destructive physical analysis must be gated precisely at the post-TiN top electrode deposition step. To avoid blocking wafer lot progress, physical verification must deliver calibrated step coverage metrics and stoichiometry line profiles within an 8-hour shift window, aligning with downstream ILD-1 oxide deposition scheduling.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Lamella curtaining or differential Ga+ ion milling damage at the metal-dielectric interface obscuring bottom 10% crown trench sidewall thickness measurement.
1. Delamination of the TiN top metal layer during protective carbon/Pt electron/ion-beam deposition inside the Dual-Beam FIB chamber due to excessive ion beam current.
1. EDX peak overlap and beam spreading obscuring chlorine impurity detection (> 1.5 at.%) and artificially broadening the TiN physical profile.

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, ASTM D6319), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/impact safety glasses with side shields, Static-dissipative cleanroom gowning and ESD-safe heel straps, Cryogenic gloves and full face shield for liquid nitrogen dewar handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with organic platinum GIS condensate or IPA, flush affected area with copious clean water for >= 15 minutes. For cryogenic liquid nitrogen contact/frostbite, immediately immerse tissue in warm water (38-42 deg C); do not rub affected tissue; seek immediate medical attention. In case of inhalation of precursor vapors, remove victim to fresh air and provide supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB-SEM chamber backing roughing pump exhaust must be hard-piped directly to the certified fab acid/toxic house exhaust scrubbing line (minimum negative pressure -250 Pa). Cleaving and grid mounting stations must operate inside Class 100 laminar flow benches with localized chemical fume extraction.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent Ga liquid-metal ion sources, contaminated Omniprobe tips, and fractured TEM copper grids must be segregated into dedicated solid heavy-metal waste containers. Solvents from coupon cleaning collected in labeled halogen-free organic solvent drums for hazardous waste treatment.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| **Isopropanol (Coupon Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/MOS Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (Cryo-Trap & Cold Stage)** | `7727-37-9` | Industrial Cryogenic (99.999%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN top electrode, surface passivated by vacuum unload from ALD cluster, free of atmospheric oxidation or moisture condensation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Completed TEM specimen on Cu grid sealed in ultra-high purity N2 desiccator capsule or transferred into STEM high-vacuum loadlock (< 1e-6 mbar).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure limits causes native TiO2/TiON formation (> 1.5 nm) on outer and sidewall surfaces, skewing EDX nitrogen-to-oxygen quantification and causing delamination during FIB carbon capping.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical and chemical cross-sectional validation of the high-aspect-ratio 3D crown capacitor TiN top electrode, establishing calibrated physical step coverage conformality and EDX elemental stoichiometry line profiles.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TEM_EDX_TIN_STEPMET_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `STEM_HAADF_CALIBRATED_CROSS_SECTION.tiff`
- [ ] `TIN_ELEMENTAL_LINESCAN_CONCENTRATIONS.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Bottom-to-top TiN electrode physical step coverage ratio (t_bot / t_top)** | `88.0%` | >= 85.0% | Calibrated HAADF-STEM digital caliper line profiles averaged across 10 crown capacitor cells |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Stoichiometric Ti-to-N atomic ratio along crown trench bottom sidewall** | `1.01` | ±0.04 (0.97 - 1.05) | High-collection STEM-EDX Cliff-Lorimer quantified net peak line-scan integration |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Residual chlorine concentration at bottom 10% crown capacitor sidewall** | `0.8 at.%` | <= 1.2 at.% | STEM-EDX Cl-Kalpha (2.62 keV) spectral peak deconvolution |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 3 quantitative assertions pass verification; minimum 3 lamellae from center, middle, and edge wafer die demonstrate bottom step coverage >= 85.0% and Ti:N ratio within 0.97-1.05 without interfacial voiding; formal review signed off by Lead Thin Film Metrology Engineer and DRAM Integration PI.
