# Standard Operating Procedure: Critical Layer Extraction & Dissection Rule Deck Configuration

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting critical layers (active diffusion, poly gate, contact, and metal 1) into an automated OPC dissection rule deck requires strict adherence to the 5 nm manufacturing placement grid. The primary architectural risk is polygon grid snap rounding error during fragmentation, which can artificially create off-grid non-orthogonal edge segments and corrupt lithography simulation aerial images across KrF 248nm stepper exposures.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm/130nm hybrid pitch with Rayleigh k1 = 0.40 and NA = 0.65, dissection segment lengths for critical poly gate lines (150 nm CD) and dense DRAM cell storage-node contacts (170 nm CD) must not exceed 40 nm near concave/convex corners. Inadequate edge dissection spacing induces severe optical proximity error, leading to line-end pull-back exceeding the 35 nm overlay margin and causing DRAM wordline-to-diffusion shorts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle write time on 5x optical quartz masks scales linearly with dissection segment count and fracturing complexity (MEBES/OASIS format). Over-dissecting non-critical perimeter circuits will inflate electron-beam reticle write times beyond 28 hours per mask, driving prototype tooling costs and tapeout cycle-time past commercial MPW schedule bounds.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dissection rule decks must integrate seamlessly with open-source and commercial physical verification pipelines without licensing bottlenecks. Milestones require automated layer decomposition signoff 14 business days ahead of MPW reticle data preparation freeze to allow full model-calibrated aerial image re-simulation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe gate poly line-end pull-back (>35 nm) resulting in incomplete active diffusion channel coverage and open pass-transistor failure in DRAM bitcells.
1. Off-grid vertex fracturing during dissection rule execution causing mask data preparation (MDP) syntax rejection and optical reticle inspection grid-snap violations.
1. Corner rounding and bridging at dense 0.17 um contact holes due to insufficient corner dissection segment allocation under 248nm KrF DUV illumination.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-01` | **Critical Poly Gate Edge Dissection and Grid Compliance Verification** | KLayout / OpenROAD Calibre-compatible SVRF/TCL DRC-OPC rule execution engine and OASIS fractured geometry checker | 1. Execute dissection rule deck script on 150 nm poly gate channel areas and line ends. 2. Measure generated dissection segment lengths along straight edges, convex corners, and concave corners. 3. Query coordinates of all newly created dissection vertices against the 0.005 um placement grid. 4. Check segment length distributions across dense 1T1C DRAM bitcell arrays. | `All dissection vertices must align strictly to integer multiples of 5 nm (0 off-grid errors). Line-end dissection segment pitch must be 35 nm +/- 5 nm; straight channel edge segments must be 60 nm +/- 5 nm with zero segments < 25 nm.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-02` | **Contact Layer Enclosure and Aerial Image Intensity Margin Test** | Optical Lithography Aerial Image Simulator (KrF 248nm, NA=0.65, annular illumination sigma_out=0.75, sigma_in=0.45) and CD-SEM contour analyzer | 1. Run simulated KrF DUV exposure on post-dissection OPC reticle layout at nominal dose (25 mJ/cm2) and +/-0.25 um defocus. 2. Extract simulated wafer resist threshold contours at 0.30 intensity level. 3. Measure printed contact CD and calculate enclosure margin over active diffusion. | `Simulated contact CD must remain 170 nm +/- 8.5 nm (within 5% of target) across +/-0.25 um DOF window. Overlay/enclosure margin over diffusion must be >= 35 nm under worst-case corner rounding.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), UV-filtering safety spectacles (ANSI Z87.1 certified for 248nm/365nm stray emissions), Cleanroom chemical splash apron and anti-static ESD-safe lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with TMAH or solvent splashes: flush immediately with copious cleanroom DI water for minimum 15 minutes at emergency drench station. For eye exposure: rinse at eye-wash station holding eyelids open for 15 minutes; seek immediate medical evaluation. No specific chemical antidote; provide symptomatic dermal decontamination.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated lithography bay chemical wet bench exhaust maintaining negative static pressure of >= 0.2 inches water column with laminar face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) and HEPA/chemical carbon filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate spent TMAH aqueous developer waste into dedicated alkaline holding containers for neutralization to pH 6.0-9.0 prior to regulated disposal; collect solvent waste in closed-loop grounded stainless steel drums.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `99.8%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor Grade | `2.38%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-cleaved, dehydration-baked quartz reticle blank / wafer surface free of organic particulates and chemical airborne amine contaminants.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dissected OPC-ready GDSII/OASIS fractured reticle data verified clean of snapping anomalies, ready for mask writer data ingestion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive delay in ambient cleanroom air exposes resist/blank substrates to airborne basic amines causing severe T-topping, line-width broadening, and uncorrectable optical pattern distortion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed and validated Critical Layer Extraction & Dissection Rule Deck Configuration for 180nm KrF DUV lithography tapeout, providing automated extraction of active diffusion, gate poly, contact, and metal 1 layers with 5 nm grid-snapped edge fragmentation and line-end serifs meeting 35 nm overlay budgets.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_critical_dissection_rules.tcl`
- [ ] `dissection_verification_metrics_report.csv`
- [ ] `opc_aerial_contour_simulation_summary.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum grid deviation across all dissected edge vertices** | `0.0 nm` | +0.0 nm (strict 5 nm grid alignment) | Automated geometry vertex database audit script on post-dissection OASIS file |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Minimum edge segment length on dense poly gate features** | `35.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | DRC polygon edge measurement check verifying no dissection segment < 25 nm |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Simulated poly gate-to-diffusion overlay pull-back margin** | `35.0 nm` | >= 35.0 nm minimum margin | Optical aerial image threshold contour extraction under nominal KrF 248nm stepper focus window |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All four critical layers extract cleanly from top-level DRAM GDSII/OASIS without syntax or grid errors; automated dissection script executes with 100% pass on ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03; and formal approval is logged by domain expert and systems engineer for mask data preparation release.

# Standard Operating Procedure: GDSII Layer Filtering & Boundary Dissection Grid Setup

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Grid snapping mismatches between the GDSII boundary dissection engine and the mask writer e-beam raster grid will induce cumulative phase shifts and edge placement error (EPE) offsets. With a 5 nm manufacturing grid and a 5x reticle magnification, the reticle domain grid corresponds to 25 nm; dissection nodes must strictly snap to integer multiples of 1 nm on the mask write grid to avoid fractional-grid truncation errors across cell-to-periphery abutment seams.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In 180nm DRAM cell arrays (6F2/8F2 topologies), pass-gate wordline poly and active area bitline diffusions present high-aspect-ratio 1D-to-2D transitions. Setting the boundary dissection grid too coarse (>40 nm segment length) fails to resolve optical line-end pullback and gate-to-contact bridge margins; conversely, an overly aggressive dissection pitch (<10 nm) causes fragmentation explosion, exceeding the maximum allowed polygon vertex count per reticle fracturing domain and generating acute mask rule check (MRC) sliver violations.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial mask shops and photomask writer platforms (e.g., NuFlare EBM series or JEOL 50 keV variable-shaped beam systems) levy steep price premiums and reject data decks exceeding 8 billion fracture figures. Layer filtering must cleanly purge auxiliary non-lithographic metadata (e.g., text labels, pin identifiers, PR boundary constructs) prior to fracturing, ensuring shot-count density and write times remain strictly within contracted commercial MPW budget envelopes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Reticle generation schedule contingency depends on zero-defect handoff to mask fracturing. Iterative layer-filtering re-runs due to unmapped GDSII layer/datatype pairs or non-orthogonal boundary polygon self-intersections directly introduce 3 to 5 business day delays in the photomask data preparation (MDP) signoff timeline, threatening the fixed quarterly foundry shuttle freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Polygon edge fragmentation slivers (<20 nm edge length) causing fatal e-beam shot dose blurring and subsequent reticle chrome bridging
1. Off-grid vertex truncation resulting in systematic CD bias of +/-5 nm and catastrophic DRAM pass-gate threshold voltage shifts
1. Unfiltered drawing layer annotations mistakenly written into chrome opaque areas, causing fatal array shorts on critical active/poly levels

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-1-01` | **Automated GDSII Layer Filtering & Boundary Orthogonality Verification** | KLayout Batch Mode (Python/Ruby OpenAccess API) / Calibre DESIGNrev CLI Engine | 1. Execute stream-in layer filtering script isolating target critical mask layers (Poly and Diffusion). 2. Run boolean XOR operation against the unfiltered raw master database to verify zero geometric deletion or distortion of active layout features. 3. Execute polygon vertex traversal across all filtered geometries to detect non-manhattan or skew boundaries. 4. Measure all filtered boundary edge lengths against minimum polygon perimeter constraints. | `Total number of unmapped or orphan polygons = 0; non-manhattan edge deviation <= 0.000 um; geometric XOR discrepancy area = 0.000 um^2; zero missing shapes in 100% of analyzed cell coordinate spaces.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-1-02` | **Boundary Dissection Grid Snap & Minimum Segment Pitch Profiling** | Calibre nmOPC Engine / Synopsys Proteus OPC Dissection Log Parser | 1. Compile and apply the boundary dissection rule deck to the extracted Poly wordline boundary perimeter. 2. Extract Cartesian (X, Y) coordinates of every generated dissection vertex. 3. Compute modulo of vertex coordinates against the 5.0 nm manufacturing grid resolution. 4. Calculate inter-nodal distances along straight edges, concave corners, and convex corner transitions. | `All dissection vertices satisfy coordinate % 5.0 nm == 0 (zero off-grid vertices); segment length >= 20.0 nm (no sub-resolution sliver segments); corner vertex snapping tolerance <= 0.5 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 antistatic nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-blocking safety glasses, Antistatic ESD-safe polyester cleanroom frock and conductive cleanroom booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of eye contact with IPA/cleaning solvents, flush eyes immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes at the emergency eyewash station. In case of vapor inhalation causing dizziness, immediately move personnel to fresh air outside the cleanroom gowning area; seek medical evaluation if respiratory irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Local chemical exhaust hood dedicated to solvent cleaning of reticle cassettes and tapeout media inspection terminals with continuous laminar air capture velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); room air circulation under continuous HEPA/ULPA positive pressure filtration.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-soaked wipers and liquid waste in closed, grounded, flame-proof stainless steel flammables containers; dispose via certified hazardous solvent incineration pathway; no drain disposal allowed.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Ethanol Technical Grade** | `64-17-5` | SEMI Grade 2 | `96.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly stripped, organic-free chrome-on-quartz (Cr/Qz) blank mask surface or post-OPC fractured OASIS/GDSII database verified free from syntax anomalies.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dissected boundary layout frozen and verified against manufacturing grid rules, sealed in cleanroom dry-nitrogen purged reticle pod (RSP200).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding airborne queue time induces moisture condensation and airborne molecular contamination (AMC, sulfates/amines) on reticle inspection media, inducing optical haze, crystal growth defects, and localized transmission loss under 248nm KrF DUV illumination.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical signoff and structural verification of GDSII filtered critical DRAM layers (Poly Gate and Active Diffusion) with model-aligned boundary dissection segments snapping cleanly to the 5 nm manufacturing grid, completely prepped for model-based optical proximity correction and 5x DUV reticle fracturing.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_filtered_poly_diff_layers.gds`
- [ ] `boundary_dissection_grid_verification_report.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): GDSII Critical Layer Parsing and Stream Filtering Deck Setup

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > DUV Stepper 5x Optical Reticle Generation & Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) [Photolithography] > GDSII Layer Decomposition & Rule-Based Model-Calibrated OPC Simulation [Circuit Design] > Critical Layer Extraction & Dissection Rule Deck Configuration [Circuit Design] > GDSII Layer Filtering & Boundary Dissection Grid Setup [Circuit Design] > GDSII Critical Layer Parsing and Stream Filtering Deck Setup [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Feature CD: 180 nm, Overlay: ±35 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Parsing and stream filtering 180nm DRAM full-chip GDSII stream decks must account for hierarchical cell instantiations (SRAM/DRAM array macro repetition) without flattening the entire database in memory. A failure to enforce boundary-preserving stream filtering will cause memory exhaustion (>64GB RAM footprint) during KLayout/Calibre hierarchical parsing of repeating 360nm-pitch bitline arrays.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm DUV (248nm KrF, NA=0.65, k1=0.40), the manufacturing placement grid is strictly 5nm. The GDSII stream filtering deck must isolate layer/datatype mappings (e.g., active diffusion 65:20, poly gate 68:20, contact 70:20) and flag non-orthogonal segment dissections or off-grid coordinates (<5nm snap violations) prior to model-based optical proximity correction (OPC) reticle fracturing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW tapeout reticle mask shops enforce strict layer-map conformance. Discrepancies between open-source GDSII stream layer-datatype numbers and the commercial 180nm mask tooling specifications will lead to rejected photomask data submission, incurring multi-week MPW shuttle cycle delays and secondary fracturing NRE charges.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The stream filtering deck execution must complete in under 15 minutes per full-chip regression run on standard 16-core CI runners. Downstream reticle optical inspection and dissecting scripts rely directly on these filtered GDSII stream layers; late delivery blocks the DUV mask-data preparation milestone.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Off-grid vertex rounding during stream filtering leading to sub-5nm grid snapping errors and false DRC/OPC dissection fractures.
1. Misassignment or dropping of critical layer-datatype pairs (e.g., poly dummy fill vs. functional wordline gates) causing missing features on the 5x reticle plate.
1. Database explosion due to unintentional tree-flattening of dense 360nm pitch memory array cells during stream conversion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-1-1-01` | **GDSII Stream Deck Critical Layer Isolation and Grid Snap Verification** | Automated KLayout Python Engine (klayout.db) with Stream Validation Module and 64-bit Linux Workstation | 1. Execute stream filtering script on top-level GDSII file extracting only designated critical litho layers. 2. Traverse all polygon vertices in the filtered output stream database. 3. Calculate modulo remainder against the 5nm manufacturing grid (coord % 5000 in DBU with 1 DBU = 0.001 um). 4. Enumerate isolated polygon counts per layer and compare against baseline golden deck database. | `Off-grid vertex count must be exactly 0 (0% tolerance). Extracted polygon count on layer 68:20 must match golden array gate extraction with 100% layer containment.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-1-1-02` | **Hierarchical Cell Boundary Preservation and Memory Footprint Audit** | GNU Time profiler, KLayout CLI stream analyzer, and Valgrind Massif memory analyzer | 1. Run the stream filtering deck with memory logging enabled. 2. Verify instance preservation by querying cell hierarchy depth and reference counts for memory cell core sub-cells. 3. Check bounding box coordinates of top cell before and after layer filtering. 4. Record peak RSS memory consumption during parsing. | `Memory cell hierarchy reference count must match input layout within 0% discrepancy (no unprompted cell flattening). Peak memory consumption must not exceed 16.0 GB for full-chip GDSII stream execution.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom antistatic nitrile gloves (Class 100), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses, ESD-safe cleanroom coat and footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin/eye contact with console sanitation reagents (IPA), flush affected area with copious amounts of clean deionized water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation in enclosed computer server rooms, remove personnel to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA/ULPA laminar airflow environment with 20-30 air changes per hour (ACH); dedicated local exhaust on chemical storage cabinets.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect solvent-soaked wipes in closed, flammables-rated hazardous waste bins. Dispose of through certified microelectronics hazardous waste reclamation contractors according to RCRA guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for cleanroom tapeout media console sanitation** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI Purified) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Digital tapeout GDSII data stream generated and MD5 checksum verified against Git LFS repository.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Filtered critical layer stream files serialized, schema-validated, and prepared for optical proximity correction (OPC) reticle simulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Data cache corruption, unsynchronized branch versioning between PDK rules and reticle mask-prep deck, or stale coordinate snapping tables resulting in mismatched 5x reticle fractures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified GDSII stream filtering deck successfully parses, isolates, and validates critical photolithography layers (Diffusion, Poly Gate, Contact, Metal 1) on a 5nm manufacturing grid without hierarchy flattening for 180nm open-source DRAM.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `filtered_critical_layers_deck_report.pdf`
- [ ] `layer_extraction_grid_metrics.csv`
- [ ] `dram_180nm_stream_filtered_top.gds`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum allowable manufacturing placement grid snap deviation across all extracted critical layer polygons** | `0 nm` | 0 nm | Automated polygon coordinate modulo check via KLayout DB Python script verifying integer alignment to 5nm resolution grid. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Critical gate layer extraction boundary area discrepancy relative to input GDSII layout database** | `0.00%` | +/-0.001% | Geometric XOR boolean comparison between input raw GDSII gate layer and stream-filtered output layer. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Full-chip stream filtering execution time on reference 16-core workstation** | `480 s` | <= 900 s | POSIX wall-clock time recording from script invocation to final clean exit and file serialization. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero off-grid coordinate faults detected, clean 0-error XOR boolean comparison against golden layer definitions, and signed approval from Domain Expert and Systems Engineer on filtered_critical_layers_deck_report.pdf.

## Document Details
- **Title**: Polygon Boundary Fragmentation and Dissection Grid Pitch Configuration
- **Node**: 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy Level**: Circuit Design / OPC Rule Deck Configuration / Critical Layer Extraction
- **Laser / Reticle Exposure**: DUV 248 nm KrF Excimer Laser Stepper (5x Reduction)

---

## 1. Process Flowchart

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    GDSII Poly and     │
│     Active Input      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘

┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Snapping to 5nm Mfg  │
│         Grid          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Edge Classification  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Variable Dissection  │
│      Pitch Setup      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │

└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Dimensional Metrics & Layout Parameter Ranges

```text
             OPC Dissection Grid & Feature Metrics (nm) 
            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆           │
Half-Pitch R┤◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆           │
            │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■│
Poly Spacing┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■│
```

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Ingestion & Manufacturing Grid Snapping
1. Ingest drawn GDSII polygons for critical layers: Gate Polysilicon (`poly`) and Active Diffusion (`diff`).
2. Verify all incoming polygon vertices strictly snap to the foundry physical placement manufacturing grid resolution of **0.005 µm (5 nm)**. Reject or enforce snapping on off-grid vertices prior to dissection.

### Step 2: Optical Resolution Verification & Pitch Setup
1. Validate pattern features against DUV KrF lithography constraints:
   - Exposure wavelength: $\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$
   - Stepper numerical aperture: $\text{NA} = 0.65$
   - Process factor: $k_1 = 0.40$
   - Minimum resolvable half-pitch: $R = k_1 \times \frac{\lambda}{\text{NA}} = 0.40 \times \frac{248\text{ nm}}{0.65} = 152\text{ nm}$.
2. In the DRAM cell core (wordline / bitline array pitch: **360 nm to 400 nm**), verify minimum drawn poly gate length is **150 nm** (with access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$), and minimum gate poly-to-poly spacing is **0.21 µm (210 nm)**.

### Step 3: Topological Edge Classification & Dissection Breakpoint Placement
1. Tag polygon perimeter segments based on topological context:
   - **Corner Edges (Convex & Concave):** Insert fixed dissection vertices at a distance of **40 nm** from vertex corners to properly handle 2D optical corner-rounding and line-end pullback.
   - **Line-Ends:** Tag line-ends facing active diffusion or adjacent wordlines; allocate fragment lengths of **40 nm to 50 nm**.
   - **Gate Over Active (1D Channel Runs):** Break straight edges spanning the active transistor region ($W = 220\text{ nm}$) into uniform segments with a dissection grid pitch between **60 nm and 100 nm**.
   - **Field Poly Routing:** For non-critical field interconnects outside active diffusion, relax the dissection pitch to a maximum segment length of **120 nm** to avoid mask rule check (MRC) shot count explosion.

### Step 4: Dissection Grid Pitch Snapping & Reticle Scaling
1. Quantize all segment dissection boundaries to integer multiples of the **5 nm** manufacturing grid.
2. Ensure fragment coordinates map accurately to the **5x optical reticle domain** (wafer $1\times$ dimension $\times 5$ magnification), preventing grid snapping rounding errors on the mask write tool.

### Step 5: Simulation & Iterative Edge Placement Error (EPE) Verification
1. Run model-calibrated aerial image simulation under KrF illumination.
2. Measure Edge Placement Error (EPE) gauge deviations across all dissected fragments. Ensure shifts do not exceed overlay margins.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Placement Manufacturing Grid** | `5.0` | Exact snap ($\Delta = 0.0$) | `nm` |
| **Minimum Drawn Gate Length ($L_{min}$)** | `150.0` | $\pm 0.0$ (Drawn) / $\le 35.0$ overlay error | `nm` |
| **Minimum Poly Spacing** | `210.0` | $\ge 210.0$ | `nm` |
| **Rayleigh Minimum Half-Pitch ($R$)** | `152.0` | Theoretical lower bound | `nm` |
| **DRAM Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | `180.0` | Target drawn CD | `nm` |
| **Permissible Poly-to-Active Overlay Error** | `35.0` | $\le 35.0$ | `nm` |

---

## 5. Context Citations
- **[SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid]**: Manufacturing placement grid of 0.005 µm (5 nm); minimum poly gate length of 0.15 µm (150 nm); minimum active diffusion width of 0.15 µm; minimum poly spacing of 0.21 µm; maximum permissible overlay error between gate poly and active diffusion $\le 35\text{ nm}$; DUV 248 nm KrF excimer laser exposure with $\text{NA} = 0.65, k_1 = 0.40$ yielding minimum resolvable half-pitch of 152 nm.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; 8F² / 6F² folded bitline architectures.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Bitline and wordline pitch of 360 nm to 400 nm; 1T1C stacked capacitor cell layout.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dissection grid pitch configuration must balance computational runtime and optical simulation fidelity across the 180nm DRAM cell matrix. Establishing a fragmentation pitch that is too fine (<15 nm) leads to polygon explosion (>50 million edge segments for full-chip poly layer), causing memory blowouts and mask data preparation (MDP) fracturing errors. Conversely, an excessively coarse fragmentation pitch (>80 nm) violates the Nyquist sampling limit of the optical kernel (KrF 248nm, NA=0.65, sigma=0.75, optical diameter ~380 nm), creating EPE (Edge Placement Error) oscillations and line-end pullback across dense 8F^2 wordline passes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node (poly CD=150nm, min pitch=360nm, overlay <=35nm), boundary fragmentation must explicitly decouple convex/concave corner dissection from 1D gate line edge segments. Dissection vertices placed directly on active-poly intersections induce artificial rippling during model-based OPC iterations. We require multi-tier fragmentation: 25 nm to 40 nm dissection steps near line ends and T-junctions, transitioning to 60 nm to 80 nm along regular long 1D gate channels, strictly locked to the 5 nm manufacturing placement grid to prevent off-grid snapping during 5x reticle e-beam writing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle write times and mask inspection costs on 6-inch quartz blanks scale directly with MEBES/OASIS figure count generated by polygon boundary fragmentation. Over-dissecting the 180nm DRAM capacitor-over-bitline (COB) landing pads increases mask write duration beyond 18 hours per reticle plate, dramatically inflating MPW mask costs and elevating risk of mask defect printability. Dissection pitch rules must be co-optimized with the commercial mask shop's e-beam fracturing engine capabilities.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: From a project execution timeline perspective, fragmentation and boundary dissection deck qualification must close within Sprint 3 to enable freeze of the 5x reticle tapeout deck. Any unconstrained fragmentation rule that triggers Calibre/KLayout DRC/OPC engine crashes during full-chip hierarchical processing risks delaying our multi-project wafer (MPW) submission window by up to 6 months.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Off-grid vertex snapping during MEBES/OASIS fracturing caused by dissection pitch not aligning to the 5nm manufacturing grid, yielding catastrophic reticle CD dispersion (+/-18nm variation).
1. Corner rounding and line-end pullback exceeding 45nm on active diffusion-to-poly contact regions due to coarse dissection grid pitch (>75nm), inducing open circuits or high contact resistance (>250 Ohm).
1. Edge-placement oscillation and non-convergent OPC simulation loops caused by excessive fragmentation segment density (<15nm) violating optical kernel Nyquist stability limits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-1-2-01` | **Polygon Boundary Fragmentation Pitch and Grid Alignment Verification** | Automated EDA DRC/OPC Rule Deck Verification Engine (Siemens Calibre nmOPC / KLayout DRC engine) with OASIS/GDSII geometry inspection tool | 1. Execute the polygon boundary dissection deck on test vehicle array containing dense 8F^2 wordline lines/spaces (180nm/180nm) and isolated peripheral logic gates. 2. Measure edge fragment length distribution across convex corners, concave corners, line-ends, and 1D channel edges. 3. Check all fragment vertex coordinates against modulo-5nm placement grid constraint. 4. Run 12-iteration model-based OPC simulation and evaluate convergence stability across all dissected edges. | `Pass: 100% of fragment vertices reside exactly on the 5.0 nm physical manufacturing grid (0 off-grid points); corner fragment lengths are within 30 nm +/- 5 nm; 1D channel segment pitch is 60 nm +/- 5 nm; OPC simulation converges within <= 10 iterations without oscillation.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-1-2-02` | **Simulated Contour Edge Placement Error (EPE) and Reticle Fracturing Figure Count Evaluation** | Calibre ORC (Optical Rule Checking) / Synopsys Sentaurus Lithography Post-OPC Contour Simulator coupled with Mask Data Preparation (MDP) OASIS fracturing analyzer | 1. Subject post-dissection OPC layout to full-chip contour aerial image simulation at nominal KrF exposure (248nm, NA=0.65). 2. Measure Edge Placement Error (EPE) gauges placed at 20nm intervals across memory cell access transistor gate regions and line-end overlaps. 3. Fracture the layout into 5x reticle format and extract total trapezoid/primitive figure count per reticle unit area. | `Pass: Maximum absolute EPE across DRAM cell access transistor channels <= 4.0 nm; gate-to-active line-end pullback <= 12.0 nm under nominal exposure; total fractured mask figure count <= 1.2 x 10^7 figures/cm^2 on reticle scale.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A cleanroom chemical apron with full sleeves, Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene composite gloves over nitrile inner gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles and full-face polycarbonate shield, Cleanroom positive-pressure respirator hood (when handling wet lithography/mask etching solvents)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH skin/eye exposure: Immediately drench affected area at safety shower for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. TMAH is a potent neuromuscular toxin; administer continuous CPR if breathing ceases and arrange emergency ALS transport with calcium gluconate/atropine availability. For acid exposure: Rinse with copious water, apply calcium gluconate gel if HF-containing blends were present.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated dedicated laminar exhaust fume hood maintaining face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); continuous volatile organic compound (VOC) and toxic acid vapor extraction scrubbers with real-time differential pressure telemetry.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate organic solvent rinses (PGMEA) into dedicated flammable solvent carboys. Acidic waste must be routed through automated pH neutralization system (neutralized to pH 6.8-7.5 using 10% NaOH) prior to wastewater discharge. TMAH developer waste collected in dedicated alkaline containment drums for certified hazardous disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-cleaned quartz reticle substrate or silicon wafer with pristine hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) vapor-primed surface, free of organic residues (contact angle > 70 deg, particulate count < 5 defects @ >0.15um).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Exposed and post-exposure baked (PEB) chemical-amplified resist film on 5x reticle blank/wafer, stable latent image without airborne amine contamination or CD line-slumping.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes airborne molecular amine (NH3/N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone) chemisorption into the DUV chemically amplified resist surface, leading to insoluble T-topping, fatal bridging of 150nm poly lines, and severe reticle line-edge roughness (>8nm 3-sigma).

**Exit Objective Summary**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Dissection Grid Alignment Metrology and Edge Placement Error (EPE) Inspection

- **Node ID**: `node-metrology-epe-inspection-gen3`
- **Hierarchical Context**: `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > DUV Stepper 5x Optical Reticle Generation & Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) > GDSII Layer Decomposition & Rule-Based Model-Calibrated OPC Simulation > Critical Layer Extraction & Dissection Rule Deck Configuration > GDSII Layer Filtering & Boundary Dissection Grid Setup > Dissection Grid Alignment Metrology and Edge Placement Error Inspection`
- **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Role**: Domain Expert AI (DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     GDSII Polygon      │
│       Ingestion        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Grid Snapping to 5nm  │
│       Resolution       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Boundary Dissection   │
│     Node Placement     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     248nm KrF DUV      │
│   Optical Simulation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  EPE Metrology Gauge   │
│       Evaluation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Verification and    │
│   Gate Overlay Audit   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **GDSII Polygon Ingestion & Physical Grid Snapping**:
   - Import the decomposed GDSII layout stream corresponding to the DRAM access transistor array (`L = 180 nm`, `W = 220 nm`), active diffusion (`diff`), poly gate, and contact layers.
   - Enforce snapping of all polygon vertices and dissection segment coordinates to the foundry physical placement manufacturing grid resolution of **0.005 µm (5 nm)**. Off-grid coordinates must be rounded to the nearest 5 nm node prior to rule evaluation.

2. **Boundary Dissection Grid Configuration & Node Placement**:
   - Segment all active diffusion boundaries (minimum width `0.15 µm`) and polysilicon gate runs (minimum gate length `0.15 µm / 150 nm`; minimum gate spacing `0.21 µm / 210 nm`).
   - Place evaluation dissection nodes along edges and corners with edge-segment lengths snapped strictly to multiples of the **5 nm** grid. Set high-density corner dissection around line ends and corners to capture 2D optical proximity degradation.

3. **DUV Optical Model-Calibrated Forward Simulation**:
   - Execute model-based forward optical aerial image and resist threshold simulation under deep ultraviolet conditions: exposure wavelength **$\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$ (KrF excimer laser)** and numerical aperture **$\text{NA} = 0.65$**.
   - Ensure the simulation kernel captures the Rayleigh resolution limit:
     $$R = k_1 \cdot \frac{\lambda}{\text{NA}} = 0.40 \cdot \frac{248\text{ nm}}{0.65} \approx 152.6\text{ nm}$$
   - Verify optical performance across the nominal focus range ensuring a minimum Depth of Focus:
     $$\text{DOF} = k_2 \cdot \frac{\lambda}{\text{NA}^2} \ge 0.5\text{ µm (500 nm)}$$

4. **Edge Placement Error (EPE) Metrology Gauge Extraction**:
   - Instantiate perpendicular measurement cut-lines (gauges) at each dissection segment across gate poly, active diffusion, and contact borders (`0.17 µm x 0.17 µm`).
   - Quantify EPE as the signed scalar displacement vector between drawn target polygon boundaries and simulated resist contour edges:
     $$\text{EPE} = x_{\text{simulated}} - x_{\text{target}}$$

5. **Poly-to-Active Overlay Error Metrology & Design Rule Sign-Off**:
   - Evaluate composite overlay displacement between simulated poly gate edges and underlying active diffusion edges across the access transistor channel.
   - Flag any gauge exceeding the maximum permissible overlay error budget ($\le 35\text{ nm}$) or violating the minimum half-pitch limit ($152\text{ nm}$). Output clean sign-off report or route feedback coordinates back to the OPC segmentation optimization loop.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                Critical Dimensions and Tolerances (nm) 
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Min DOF Window┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                       │
Min Poly Space┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                       │
   Max Overlay┤▓▓▓▓                                    │
              │▓▓▓▓                                    │
  Mfg Grid Res┤█                                       │
              │█                                       │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0        125       250      375      500 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Manufacturing Grid Alignment** | **5.0** | nm | Exact (0.000 nm off-grid delta) | Automated DRC/GDSII vertex snap verifier |
| **Gate Poly-to-Diffusion Overlay Error** | **$\le$ 35.0** | nm | Maximum upper bound ($\le 35\text{ nm}$) | Model-calibrated optical overlay gauge analysis |
| **Minimum Resolvable Half-Pitch ($R$)** | **152.6** | nm | Lower limit ($\ge 152\text{ nm}$) | Rayleigh equation validation ($\lambda=248\text{ nm}, \text{NA}=0.65, k_1=0.40$) |
| **Lithography Depth of Focus (DOF)** | **$\ge$ 0.5** | µm (500 nm) | Process window lower bound | Focus-Exposure Matrix (FEM) aerial image window check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
   - *Physical Manufacturing Grid Resolution*: 0.005 µm (5 nm).
   - *Critical Dimensions*: Minimum active diffusion width = 0.15 µm; minimum poly gate length = 0.15 µm (150 nm); minimum poly gate spacing = 0.21 µm (210 nm); minimum contact dimension = 0.17 µm $\times$ 0.17 µm.
   - *DUV Lithography & Overlay*: $\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$ (KrF), $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$, Rayleigh half-pitch $R \approx 152\text{ nm}$; $\text{DOF} \ge 0.5\text{ µm}$; maximum gate poly to active diffusion overlay error $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - *Cell Architecture & Device Dimensions*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; folded bitline layout with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).

---

> [!NOTE]
> Architectural context and execution rules referenced from [docs/context.yaml](./docs/context.yaml). This SOP enforces zero off-grid vertices and maintains physical design compatibility for the DRAM Foundation VN tapeout cycle.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dissection grid granularity must strictly align with the 5 nm manufacturing grid of the 180nm/130nm hybrid lithography deck. Sub-resolution dissection segments below 10 nm create explosive fractured vertex counts and intolerable OPC runtime inflation without improving edge placement error (EPE). The metrology framework must decouple optical diffraction models (lambda=248nm, NA=0.65) from mask-e-beam grid discretization errors to avoid false EPE alarm spikes at 45-degree corner fillets.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At minimum drawn poly gate length of 150 nm and a tight overlay budget of <= 35 nm against active diffusion, unconstrained dissection node placement along critical gate-to-contact proximity margins causes severe contour rippling. EPE evaluation gauges must be placed orthogonal to calibrated dissection cuts with an edge placement error tolerance <= 5.0 nm. Failure to enforce curvature-dependent segmentation at line ends will induce uncalibrated optical pinch necking and destructive gate leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle mask inspection cycle time and defect printability verification depend on standard OASIS/GDSII fracturing formats acceptable to local merchant mask shops. Using proprietary dissection geometry formats or non-standard e-beam writer grid step sizes (outside integer multiples of 5 nm) introduces mask write errors, 5x reticle generation delays, and escalates multi-project wafer (MPW) qualification costs by exceeding standard MEB inspection limits.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Automated dissection alignment and EPE metrology sign-off must execute within a 4-hour batch turnaround limit across all critical layers (Diff, Poly, Contact, Metal 1) to support our tapeout milestone timeline. GDSII layer extraction and EPE rule-deck validation gates must be strictly checked before authorizing write-head fracturing to avoid re-spin penalty costs on 5x optical quartz reticles.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Grid aliasing error inducing asymmetric polygon vertex rounding where dissection boundaries snap off the 5 nm physical manufacturing grid, driving EPE exceeding 12 nm on 150 nm poly gates.
1. Line-end pullback under-dissection yielding extreme EPE (>25 nm) at storage node contact landing pads, causing catastrophic open contacts or overlay margin breach.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Edge Segment Dissection & Fragment Tagging Rule Deck Synthesis

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dissection granularity across the 360nm pitch memory array (180nm line/space bitline grid) must maintain an integer-multiple relationship with the 5x reticle write-grid (typically 5nm on reticle, corresponding to 1nm on wafer). Over-dissection generates an exponential explosion of edge fragments (exceeding 25 million fragments per reticle field), degrading Calibre/OpenOPC runtimes past acceptable cluster throughput limits without yielding EPE improvements. The rule deck must strictly differentiate between dense 1D periodic array line-ends and random 2D periphery logic to throttle evaluation node counts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the boundary where the periodic 360nm bitline array transitions to the folded sense amplifier readout (cross-coupled latch pairs and isolation transistors), optical proximity effects shift sharply from 1D Bessel/dipole interference to asymmetric 2D wave diffraction. The edge fragmentation rule deck must enforce adaptive fragmentation: 40nm sub-segments at line-ends and concave/convex corner jogs, tapering out to 120nm along straight non-critical runs. Failure to tag corner-adjacent fragments separately will result in severe line-end pullback (>35nm) and catastrophic bridging between adjacent bitlines at the sense amp pitch-matching interface.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle write times at commercial photomask shops using 50keV variable shaped beam (VSB) mask writers scale non-linearly with total shot count. Excessively fragmented edge segments translate directly into fractured trapezoids and micro-slivers on the 5x Cr-on-quartz reticle, driving up mask costs by 40-60% and risking mask-house rejection due to minimum printable feature size (MPFS) violations on sub-resolution reticle assist features (SRAFs).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rule deck calibration must remain tightly coupled with our 180nm commercial MPW schedule. We cannot allow an open-ended rule deck optimization loop to derail tapeout milestones. The deck must establish deterministic fragment tagging classes within a fixed 3-iteration calibration budget, ensuring bitline DRC clean sign-off within OpenROAD-to-GDSII export workflows prior to mask data preparation (MDP) freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Fragment Length Undershoot (<25nm on wafer / <125nm on reticle) causing VSB mask writer shot fracturing errors, e-beam dose sliver defects, and mask inspection false alarms.
1. Asymmetric Tagging at Array-Sense Amplifier Boundary leading to uncompensated bitline line-end pullback exceeding 30nm, causing open contacts at the bitline-to-sense-amp transfer nodes.
1. Dissection Node Divergence in Closed OPC Simulation Loops where high fragment density causes neighboring edge displacement oscillations, leading to simulation non-convergence and bridging violations.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |

Execute edge dissection rule deck on critical layer (Metal1/Active) across memory core and sense amplifier periphery. 2. Extract all dissected segment lengths into an SQL spatial geometry database. 3. Filter segments categorized by tag: 'line_end', 'corner_convex', 'corner_concave', 'run_straight'. 4. Quantify segment length distribution and flag any fragment length falling below 30nm (wafer-scale). 5. Verify that corner-adjacent fragments are tagged with high-priority weighting tags. | `Zero edge fragments under 30.0 nm wafer scale (150.0 nm 5x reticle scale); 100% of line-end vertices tagged as 'line_end_critical' with target fragment length of 40.0 nm ± 2.0 nm; total fragment count within core array ≤ 1.25x theoretical minimum.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-2-02` | **Optical Proximity Edge Placement Error (EPE) Convergence Post-Tagging** | Calibrated 248nm DUV Stepper Optical Model Simulator (Numerical Aperture NA=0.68, Annular Illumination sigma_out=0.75, sigma_in=0.50) | 1. Run nominal 10-iteration OPC simulation on dissected layout using tagged fragment movement rules. 2. Measure Edge Placement Error (EPE) across 500 cutline evaluation points placed on dense 360nm pitch array bitlines and sense amplifier coupling gates. 3. Extract maximum positive EPE (bridging risk) and maximum negative EPE (pinching/pullback risk). 4. Evaluate convergence rate across iterations 6 through 10 to check for displacement damping. | `EPE on all critical 360nm pitch bitline runs must fall within ±3.5 nm of nominal target; line-end pullback EPE ≤ 5.0 nm; displacement damping oscillation between iterations 8-10 must be < 0.8 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100/ISO 5 Nitrile Gloves (double-gloved), UV-Blocking Safety Glasses (ANSI Z87.1 certified), Antistatic ESD-Safe Cleanroom Frock and Hood, Dedicated ESD Conductive Footwear with Heel Straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with IPA: Flush thoroughly with tempered water for 15 minutes. Inhalation of solvent fumes: Evacuate personnel to fresh air immediately; administer oxygen if respiratory distress occurs. Eye exposure: Irrigate eyes at emergency eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Consult medical staff immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous localized recirculating laminar airflow unit (HEPA/ULPA filtered, downflow face velocity 0.45 m/s ± 0.05 m/s) with dedicated exhaust for solvent vapor extraction at 150 CFM, interlocked to ambient volatile organic compound (VOC) detectors.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent-soaked cleanroom wipes and contaminated nitrile consumables must be segregated in grounded, fire-rated stainless steel solvent waste bins with self-closing foot pedals. Spent liquid IPA collected in closed HDPE waste carboys labeled hazardous organic waste for certified off-site thermal incineration.

| **Nitrogen Gas (Purified for SMIF Pod Purge)** | `7727-37-9` | UHP Grade 5.5 | `99.9995%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry post-strip hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) primed substrate or clean quartz reticle blank free from organic haze, particulate defect count < 0.02 defects/cm2 at >0.15um.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Synthesized reticle tapeout database locked; physical wafer pilot pre-exposure DUV photoresist film baked (PAB 110°C, 60s) and stabilized under dry inert atmosphere.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric airborne molecular contamination (AMC) causing amine-induced photoresist T-topping and insoluble resist skins, resulting in severe scumming, bridging on 360nm pitch memory lines, and uncorrectable pattern distortion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Synthesized, validated edge segment dissection and fragment tagging rule deck tailored for 180nm open-source DRAM 360nm bitline pitch and folded sense amplifier transition geometries, preventing mask sliver defects and ensuring optical proximity convergence.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Dissection Parameter Specification & Edge Geometry Classification Definition

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     GDSII Critical     │
│     Layers: Poly,      │
│    Active, Contact     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Dissection Parameter  │
│     Specification      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Edge Geometry      │
│    Classification &    │
│        Tagging         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Physical Grid & CD   │
│    Compliance Check    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  OPC Dissection Rule   │
│     Deck Synthesis     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **GDSII Critical Layer Filtering & Extraction**:
   - Extract critical front-end device layers: Poly gate (`poly`), Active diffusion (`diff`), and Contact (`contact`).
   - Align all vertex coordinates and layout geometries strictly to the manufacturing grid of $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).

2. **Edge Dissection Parameter Specification**:
   - **Baseline Grid Dissection**: Segment all polygon boundaries using an integer multiple of the $5\text{ nm}$ grid.
   - **Access Transistor Channel Dissection**:
     - Constrain gate length edge dissection to $L = 180\text{ nm}$ across the active channel (width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
     - Set the minimum allowable dissection fragment length for poly gate runs to $150\text{ nm}$ (process minimum drawn gate length).
     - Maintain poly-to-poly space dissection checks against the minimum spacing threshold of $0.21\ \mu\text{m}$ ($210\text{ nm}$).
   - **Contact Hole Dissection**:
     - Enforce perimeter dissection on standard square contacts with edge length $0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$ ($170\text{ nm} \times 170\text{ nm}$) to preserve shape symmetry under DUV $248\text{ nm}$ KrF exposure.

3. **Edge Geometry Classification & Tagging**:
   - **Gate Edge (Gate Poly over Diffusion)**: Tag segments where `poly` overlaps `diff` with $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Apply tight OPC control points with dissection segment lengths between $35\text{ nm}$ and $75\text{ nm}$ to avoid CD degradation within the $\le 35\text{ nm}$ overlay error budget.
   - **Field Poly Edge**: Tag non-active poly runs with minimum width $150\text{ nm}$ and space $\ge 210\text{ nm}$.
   - **Line-End & Corner Geometries**: Tag convex and concave corners. Place corner-adjacent dissection cuts at $50\text{ nm}$ offsets to enable line-end pull-back compensation and optical corner rounding correction.
   - **Bitline Contact Shared Interface**: Tag contact boundaries flanking adjacent $8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline access pairs.

4. **Rule Deck Synthesis & DRC Compliance Gate**:
   - Compile edge tags and dissection intervals into the OPC rule deck.
   - Verify that all generated dissection breakpoints evaluate to zero grid-snapping error ($0\text{ nm}$ deviation from the $5\text{ nm}$ manufacturing grid) and resolve within Rayleigh resolution limits ($R = 152\text{ nm}$ with $\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$).

---

### 2. Physical Metrics & Process Specification

```text
Critical Dimension & Lithography Specs (nm)

    Overlay Limit┤■■■■■■■                              │
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░       │

                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Active Diff W Min┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
      Gate CD Min┤███████████████████████████          │

                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0     52.5     105.0    157.5  210.0 
```

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

1. **Manufacturing Grid Alignment**:
   - **Target**: Deviation $= 0.000\ \mu\text{m}$ ($0\text{ nm}$ off-grid points). Every dissection fragment boundary must snap exactly to the $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) physical placement grid.
2. **Access Transistor Dimension Adherence**:
   - **Target**: Channel length segment $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (lower hard bound $\ge 150\text{ nm}$ minimum poly gate length) and channel active width segment $W = 220\text{ nm}$ (lower hard bound $\ge 150\text{ nm}$ minimum active diffusion width).
3. **Contact Geometry Uniformity**:
   - **Target**: Uncorrected perimeter dimension $= 0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$ ($170\text{ nm} \pm 0\text{ nm}$ drawn length per side).
4. **Gate-to-Diffusion Overlay Dissection Tolerance**:
   - **Target**: Maximum dissection placement delta $\le 35\text{ nm}$ relative to the active-poly boundary.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources

- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Manufacturing placement grid: $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum active diffusion width: $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum poly gate length: $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$); minimum poly spacing: $0.21\ \mu\text{m}$ ($210\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum contact hole dimension: $0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$ ($170\text{ nm} \times 170\text{ nm}$).
  - Overlay error budget between gate poly and active diffusion: $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
  - Rayleigh resolution limit: $R = 152\text{ nm}$ ($\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - DRAM access transistor unit cell dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Layout topology: $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline layout with shared bitline contacts.
- **OpenROAD Physical Design & Synthesis Toolflow**:
  - Floorplan, detailed placement grid legalization, and DRC signoff verification integration.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Fragment dissection granularity represents a direct trade-off between optical proximity simulation fidelity and computational runtimes across full-chip DRAM reticle databases. Over-dissection generates an unmanageable explosion in polygon edge counts, causing OPC matrix solving bottlenecks and fracturing artifacts in post-tapeout mask data preparation (MEBES/OASIS.MASK format). Conversely, coarse dissection leads to edge placement error (EPE) ripple, causing severe line-end pullback and optical bridging across dense wordline/bitline array peripheries. Edge geometry tagging must dynamically classify fragments into convex corners, concave corners, line-ends, and 1D nested edges with context-aware sizing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm lithographic node using KrF 248nm DUV steppers (NA = 0.60 to 0.65), k1 factor sits around 0.45 to 0.50, necessitating rigorous model-based OPC rather than simple rule-based bias. For DRAM cell array structures, active area (diffusion) and poly wordline pitches approach the optical diffraction limit. Dissection rule decks must enforce maximum fragment length constraints on 1D nested runs (typically 120nm to 180nm on wafer scale) and specialized sub-segmentation around line-ends (<60nm on wafer, corresponding to <300nm on 5x reticle) to capture 2D optical intensity curvature without violating e-beam mask writer minimum shot size constraints (10nm on mask).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle write time at commercial merchant mask shops scales non-linearly with total shot count during 50keV variable shaped e-beam (VSB) reticle patterning. Sub-optimal dissection parameterization that produces extraneous fragment tags and jagged jogs adds thousands of fractured trapezoids per DRAM die field, driving mask write times past 18 hours per plate and exponentially inflating mask set NRE costs while increasing defect vulnerability from multi-pass e-beam heating and CD drift.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The edge geometry classification deck must freeze its parameter boundaries before initiating optical proximity calibration loops. Uncontrolled dissection rule revisions invalidate pre-existing EPE measurement gauge decks and optical test-pattern calibrations, creating cascade rework cycles across physical verification (KLayout DRC/OPC decks) and risking delay of the scheduled commercial 180nm MPW tapeout delivery slot.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Fragment Length Undersizing (<40nm wafer scale): Produces polygon vertex snapping errors on the lithography grid and generates ultra-narrow mask fracture figures that exceed e-beam writer minimum shot dimensions, inducing reticle-level CD errors.
1. Misclassification of Dense Array Line-Ends as 1D Nested Edges: Inhibits adequate corner-rounding and line-end pullback correction, leading to wordline-to-contact bridging or complete gate-to-source/drain overlay failure under nominal defocus.
1. Dissection Jog Oscillation / Ripple: Divergent adjacent segment shifts during iterative matrix convergence, causing sawtooth line edge roughness (LER) on active gate channels and degrading DRAM retention characteristics.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-2-1-01` | **Edge Dissection Segmentation and Vertex Placement Compliance Verification** | KLayout DRC/OPC Batch Engine (v0.28+) with Python PyData/GDSII Parser and Calibre-compatible SVRF/Tcl rule verification parser | 1. Ingest testclip GDSII containing standard DRAM 6F2/8F2 unit cell arrays, periphery sense amplifier logic, and isolated pitch structures into the layout analysis engine. 2. Execute the Edge Segment Dissection Rule Deck with classification routines assigning tag attributes (CONVEX_CORNER, CONCAVE_CORNER, LINE_END, NESTED_1D). 3. Extract resulting dissected segment coordinates and compute all segment lengths across every classified tag. 4. Scan entire polygon database for illegal fragment lengths below minimum threshold (L_frag < 40nm wafer) or exceeding maximum un-dissected span (L_frag > 250nm wafer). 5. Measure vertex-to-grid snapping variance against the 1.0nm primary design grid. | `Zero (0) occurrences of fragmented segments < 40.0nm on wafer scale; zero (0) occurrences of 1D edge segments > 250.0nm without dissection; 100% of all generated fragment vertices strictly co-located on the 1.0nm design grid with 0.0nm snapping residual.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-1-2-1-02` | **Geometry Classification Tagging Accuracy and Line-End Boundary Identification** | Automated Computational Lithography Verification Suite (Calibre OPCverify / KLayout DRC-LVS script runner) with Optical Gauge Inspection Matrix | 1. Run the edge geometry classification deck across the synthetic layout containing 10,000 reference geometric inspection tags. 2. Query the geometry classification attribution database for all line-end structures with width <= 220nm. 3. Verify whether line-end corner segments are assigned dedicated corner-adjacency tags with dissection step lengths configured between 50nm and 70nm. 4. Compare automated tag assignments against the ground-truth geometric test pattern classification map. 5. Log false-positive classifications (e.g., 1D edge tagged as line-end) and false-negative omissions. | `Classification accuracy must be exactly 100.0% with zero (0) false-positive or false-negative tags across all 10,000 designated verification test sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloved, minimum 6 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-absorbing side-shield safety glasses, Electrostatic dissipative (ESD) cleanroom garment with integrated conductive carbon threading, Full cleanroom face mask and chemical-resistant polypropylene sleeves
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Remove victim to fresh cleanroom air supply; administer CPR if breathing ceases. Eye Contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious clean water or sterile isotonic saline for >= 15 minutes at cleanroom eyewash station. Skin Contact: Wash exposed dermal surface with mild non-abrasive soap and water, discard contaminated PPE. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without explicit medical guidance; seek immediate emergency clinical assistance.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Process execution and solvent-wipe stations must operate under certified laminar cleanroom downflow hoods (Class 100 / ISO 5) with recirculated HEPA/ULPA air and dedicated VOC local exhaust ventilation (LEV) maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Liquid IPA solvent rinses and cleaning wipes must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-arrested stainless-steel flammable liquid disposal drums; segregating strictly from halogenated acids and oxidizers; disposed via certified hazardous chemical reclamation streams.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) / 2-Propanol** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade (SEMI Class 1) | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DI Water)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM D5127 Type E-1.2 Ultra-Pure Grade | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-OPC input GDSII/OASIS design database verified DRC clean (zero design rule violations) and logically decomposed into critical active, poly, and contact mask layers.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tagged, dissected layer geometry synthesized and serialized into annotated layout database ready for model-based optical proximity correction solver iteration.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding layout data shelf life without freeze synchronization introduces design-to-mask database skew; in cleanroom plate handling, queue expiry between litho cleaning and e-beam write results in airborne organic contamination, reticle haze growth, and permanent transmission degradation on the 5x quartz plate.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Synthesized and validated dissection parameter rule deck and geometric edge classification specification configured for 180nm DUV KrF lithography on DRAM array and periphery critical layers. The delivery confirms clean, grid-legal edge fragmentation with verified elimination of short-edge slivers and 100% boundary tagging accuracy across high-density array geometries.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_edge_dissection_rules.drc`
- [ ] `edge_classification_tagging_report.csv`
- [ ] `dissection_epe_verification_summary.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Minimum allowable wafer-scale fragment dissection length on critical wordline/bitline layers** | `45.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Automated KLayout geometry property extraction script scanning all generated polygon edges across full DRAM chip array. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum allowable waver-scale fragment dissection length on nested 1D gate channels** | `150.0 nm` | +/- 10.0 nm | SVRF rule check measuring inter-vertex distance along unperturbed continuous 1D gate edges. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Corner-to-corner adjacency dissection step length on 2D line-end geometries** | `60.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Geometric gauge coordinate extraction against Calibre/KLayout OPC tagging markers. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Execution of full chip layer extraction and dissection verification script showing zero (<40nm) fragment violations, 100% grid compliance on the 1nm manufacturing grid, zero unclassified edge segments, and formal multi-agent council approval by the Physical Verification Systems Engineer and Domain Expert.

testcases.title: Edge Dissection Segmentation and Vertex Placement Compliance Verification
testcases.instrumentation: KLayout DRC/OPC Batch Engine (v0.28+) with Python PyData/GDSII Parser and Calibre-compatible SVRF/Tcl rule verification parser
testcases.pre_conditions: Target layer GDSII (DRAM Wordline Poly and Active Diffusion layers) flattened and snapped to the standard 1nm manufacturing design grid; baseline geometric dissection rule deck compiled and linked.
testcases.procedure:
1. Ingest testclip GDSII containing standard DRAM 6F2/8F2 unit cell arrays, periphery sense amplifier logic, and isolated pitch structures into the layout analysis engine.
2. Execute the Edge Segment Dissection Rule Deck with classification routines assigning tag attributes (CONVEX_CORNER, CONCAVE_CORNER, LINE_END, NESTED_1D).
3. Extract resulting dissected segment coordinates and compute all segment lengths across every classified tag.
4. Scan entire polygon database for illegal fragment lengths below minimum threshold (L_frag < 40nm wafer) or exceeding maximum un-dissected span (L_frag > 250nm wafer).
5. Measure vertex-to-grid snapping variance against the 1.0nm primary design grid.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Zero (0) occurrences of fragmented segments < 40.0nm on wafer scale; zero (0) occurrences of 1D edge segments > 250.0nm without dissection; 100% of all generated fragment vertices strictly co-located on the 1.0nm design grid with 0.0nm snapping residual.

testcases.pre_conditions: Synthetic optical test pattern layout comprising 180nm nominal DRAM cell bitline/wordline features with known orthogonal jogs, U-bends, T-junctions, and isolated line-ends.

1. Run the edge geometry classification deck across the synthetic layout containing 10,000 reference geometric inspection tags.
2. Query the geometry classification attribution database for all line-end structures with width <= 220nm.
3. Verify whether line-end corner segments are assigned dedicated corner-adjacency tags with dissection step lengths configured between 50nm and 70nm.
4. Compare automated tag assignments against the ground-truth geometric test pattern classification map.
5. Log false-positive classifications (e.g., 1D edge tagged as line-end) and false-negative omissions.
