# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Metrology-Calibrated OPC Model Discrepancy & EPE Defect Analysis

### 1. Document Context & Traceability
- **Node & Path:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > DUV Stepper 5x Optical Reticle Generation & Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) > GDSII Layer Decomposition & Rule-Based Model-Calibrated OPC Simulation > Model-Calibrated DUV 248nm Aerial Image & Forward OPC Simulation > CD-SEM Metrology Benchmark & Post-OPC Mask Verification > **Metrology-Calibrated OPC Model Discrepancy & EPE Defect Analysis**
- **Process Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm DRAM / CMOS MPW, drawn $L_g = 150\,\text{nm}$)
- **Action Type:** Make / Metrology Verification

---

### 2. Workflow Architecture

```text
+------------------------+
|                        |
|    CD-SEM Metrology    |
|       Benchmarks       |
|                        |
+------------------------+
             |
             v
+------------------------+
|     Wafer Contour      |
|       Extraction       |
+------------------------+
             |
             v
+------------------------+
|   OPC Forward Aerial   |
|          Sim           |
+------------------------+
             |
             v
+------------------------+
|  EPE Gauge Comparison  |
+------------------------+
             |
             v
+------------------------+
|     Defect Hotspot     |
|       Filtering        |
+------------------------+
             |
             v
+------------------------+
|    OPC Calibration     |
|        Sign-Off        |
+------------------------+
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: CD-SEM Calibration Pattern Measurement & Contour Extraction
1. Load test wafers exposed with the calibrated KrF DUV 248nm lithography step ($\lambda = 248\,\text{nm}$, stepper numerical aperture $\text{NA} = 0.65$, illumination factor $k_1 = 0.40$, yielding a Rayleigh half-pitch resolution $R = k_1 \cdot \frac{\lambda}{\text{NA}} = 152.6\,\text{nm}$).
2. Perform automated top-down CD-SEM inspection across dedicated calibration structures:
   - Minimum poly gate lines ($L_g = 0.15\,\mu\text{m} = 150\,\text{nm}$, spacing $0.21\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Active diffusion patterns (width $0.15\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Discrete transistor test benches: long-channel reference ($W/L = 20\,\mu\text{m}/5\,\mu\text{m}$), intermediate ($W/L = 10\,\mu\text{m}/1.0\,\mu\text{m}$), and sub-micron target ($W/L = 2.0\,\mu\text{m}/0.18\,\mu\text{m}$).
3. Extract high-resolution SEM edge contours mapped on a manufacturing placement sub-grid of $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\nm$).

#### Step 2: Forward OPC Simulated Contour Overlay
1. Import target layout GDSII decomposed layers (Active Diffusion, Poly Gate, Contact Holes of $0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$).
2. Execute the forward optical proximity correction (OPC) model simulation incorporating:
   - DUV KrF ($\lambda = 248\,\text{nm}$) aerial image kernel and resist diffusion models calibrated with spectroscopic ellipsometry resist thickness metrics ($1.3\,\mu\text{m} \pm 2\,\text{nm}$).
   - Substrate gate dielectric interface parameters ($3.5\,\text{nm}$ dry oxide baseline, monitored with $\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) e^{i\Delta}$ Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion).
3. Overlay the simulated post-OPC resist contours directly onto the digitized CD-SEM edge contours.

#### Step 3: Edge Placement Error (EPE) Gauge Analysis
1. Place 1D and 2D cutline inspection gauges orthogonal to all critical feature edges at $20\,\text{nm}$ intervals.
2. For each gauge $i$, calculate the local signed Edge Placement Error:
   $$\text{EPE}_i = x_{\text{SEM}, i} - x_{\text{Simulated}, i}$$
3. Compute the maximum deviation and distribution statistics ($\mu, 3\sigma$) across 1D dense lines, isolated lines, line-ends, and 2D corner rounding regions.

#### Step 4: Discrepancy Classification & Hotspot Flagging
1. Filter EPE values against manufacturing defect thresholds:
   - **Pinching Risk:** Minimum feature width reduction $> 10\,\text{nm}$ (violating the $150\,\text{nm}$ minimum poly limit).
   - **Bridging Risk:** Space narrowing reducing spacing below the $210\,\text{nm}$ poly space limit.
   - **Line-End Pullback:** Excessive pullback threatening contact-to-poly enclosure or gate-to-active overlay budget ($\le 35\,\text{nm}$).
2. Export flagged hotspots to the OPC calibration team for model parameter re-tuning (optical kernel weights and resist threshold calibration).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Physical Target Metrics

```text
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
 Overlay Budget┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
Active Diff Tol┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                           │
   Poly CD Disp┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
  EPE Gauge Tol┤█████████████████                      │
               │█████████████████                      │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0       8.8     17.5      26.2    35.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Pass/Fail Criterion |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Critical Poly CD Discrepancy** | $150.0$ | $\le \pm 10.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Mandatory: Measured CD-SEM vs. OPC Model |
| **Active Diffusion CD Discrepancy** | $150.0$ | $\le \pm 10.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Mandatory: Minimum active width verification |
| **Max EPE (Dense & Isolated 1D Lines)** | $0.0$ | $\le \pm 15.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Hard Gate: Max allowable model-to-SEM gauge error |
| **Gate Poly-to-Active Overlay Margin** | $\le 35.0$ | $\le 35.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Mandatory: Maximum permissible overlay error budget |
| **Manufacturing Grid Compliance** | $5.0$ ($0.005\,\mu\text{m}$) | $0$ snapped | $\text{nm}$ | Mandatory: Snapped to physical placement grid |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
1. **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
   - DUV KrF $\lambda = 248\,\text{nm}$, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$ yielding $R = 152.6\,\text{nm}$ Rayleigh half-pitch resolution.
   - Minimum poly gate length: $150\,\text{nm}$ ($0.15\,\mu\text{m}$); minimum poly spacing: $210\,\text{nm}$ ($0.21\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Minimum active diffusion width: $150\,\text{nm}$ ($0.15\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Contact hole dimension: $0.17\,\mu\text{m} \times 0.17\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Manufacturing grid: $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\,\text{nm}$).
   - Overlay error budget between gate poly and active diffusion: $\le 35\,\text{nm}$.
2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Photoresist thickness monitoring: $1.3\,\mu\text{m} \pm 2\,\text{nm}$.
   - Gate oxide metrology: $3.5\,\text{nm} \pm 0.05\,\text{nm}$ using $\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) e^{i\Delta}$ with Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling.
3. **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**:
   - Test transistor geometries for model validation: $W/L = 20\,\mu\text{m}/5\,\mu\text{m}$, $10\,\mu\text{m}/1.0\,\mu\text{m}$, and $2.0\,\mu\text{m}/0.18\,\mu\text{m}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The OPC model discrepancy extraction pipeline fails to establish a closed-loop coupling between CD-SEM line-edge roughness (LER) measurement noise and simulated aerial image intensity contours. Without deconvolving the electron-beam shrinkage artifacts from actual 248nm photoresist profiles, calibrated edge placement error (EPE) residuals will propagate systematic offsets into subsequent GDSII reticle bias calculations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm critical feature nodes (especially active area and bitline contacts), 2D optical proximity effects introduce severe line-end pullback and corner rounding that 1D CD benchmarks miss. The calibrated model must incorporate spectroscopic ellipsometry dispersion parameters (n, k at 248nm) for underlying BARC and poly-Si layers to prevent optical phase mismatch and EPE flare under ±0.5 um depth-of-focus (DOF) excursions.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW fabs enforce strict reticle inspection specs and CD tolerances. Over-constraining EPE tolerances below 5nm will cause excessive multi-quadrant mask write times on 5x reticles or false-positive reticle rejections, driving up mask costs and delaying multi-project wafer tapeout schedules.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The delivery milestones must decouple physical CD-SEM automated wafer inspection runs from OPC kernel regression scripts to maintain pipeline throughput. If automated recipe alignment fails on 49-point wafer maps, the entire mask tapeout validation risks schedule slip without a verified fall-back rule-based deck.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Catastrophic bridge defect or dielectric line pinching at bitline-to-storage-node contact due to unmodeled 2D aerial image optical proximity flare exceeding process window margin.
1. Severe gate oxide CD variation caused by calibration against resist shrinkage induced by repeated CD-SEM electron-beam exposure during multi-point contour extraction.
1. Mask rule check (MRC) violation on 5x reticle generation arising from aggressive sub-resolution assist feature (SRAF) insertion driven by uncalibrated high-frequency EPE discrepancies.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-2-3-3-01` | **Automated CD-SEM to OPC Model Residual EPE Gauge Extraction Across 49-Point Wafer Map** | Automated High-Resolution In-line CD-SEM (500V to 800V landing energy, 5-8 pA beam current) synchronized with GDSII pattern matching engine and Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (248nm polarization Psi/Delta validation). | 1. Align wafer coordinates to global fiducials and measure BARC thickness at 9 control points via spectroscopic ellipsometry (confirming 82.0 ± 1.5 nm). 2. Execute automated CD-SEM recipe to capture 50 distinct 1D isolated/dense line/space pitches and 50 2D line-end cut gauge locations across a 49-point wafer map. 3. De-embed resist shrinkage using single-scan beam exposure algorithms. 4. Overlay physical CD-SEM edge contours with simulated aerial image OPC target contours in metrology software. 5. Compute mean EPE and 3-sigma gauge residual distribution for each feature class. | `EPE residuals across all 1D line/space gauges must satisfy |Mean EPE| <= 3.5 nm with 3-sigma <= 6.0 nm; 2D line-end pullback residual must not exceed 8.0 nm across all 49 exposure fields.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-2-3-3-02` | **Focus-Exposure Matrix (FEM) Bossung Contour and DOF EPE Defect Verification** | DUV 248nm Stepper, Automated CD-SEM with integrated defect inspection contour analyzer, and Cauchy/Sellmeier optical film metrology suite. | 1. Measure underlying gate stack dielectric indices via spectroscopic reflectometry. 2. Capture SEM micrographs across all focus-exposure coordinates for the dense 180nm DRAM cell array pattern. 3. Extract physical contours at threshold intensity I_th = 0.30. 4. Compare physical FEM contours to OPC model variable threshold resist (VTR) predictions. 5. Flag any locations exhibiting bridging, pinching, or EPE > 15 nm as defect pinch/bridge violations. | `OPC model must maintain EPE defect-free contour envelope across a verified Depth of Focus (DOF) >= 0.5 um and exposure latitude (EL) >= 10% with zero simulated-vs-silicon bridging/pinching discrepancies.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloved), UV-blocking ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses / cleanroom face shield, Antistatic ESD cleanroom smock and hood, Closed-toe cleanroom safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH exposure: Immediately flush skin/eyes with copious water for >= 15 min; TMAH is a systemic neurotoxin and dermal hazard—administer oxygen if inhaled and transport to emergency medical facility immediately. For PGMEA/IPA contact: Remove contaminated clothing, wash skin thoroughly with soap and water, flush eyes with saline solution.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom laminar air flow with dedicated localized scrubbed chemical exhaust at track develop cups (min face velocity 0.5 m/s); non-vented chamber vacuum exhaust routed to dedicated VOC scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous TMAH developer effluent routed directly to dedicated alkaline organic industrial wastewater neutralization system with continuous pH balancing (target pH 6.5 - 8.5) prior to municipal discharge; solvent rinses collected in sealed flammables carboys.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH developer)** | `75-59-2` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `2.38% aqueous solution` |
| **Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate (PGMEA)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI Grade | `> 99.5%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade | `> 99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-develop inspection (ADI) clean, dry positive resist pattern over cured 82nm BARC, free from airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and moisture.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: CD-SEM scanned and metrology-cleared patterned resist surface with minimal charge accumulation and carbonaceous deposition, ready for reactive-ion etch (AEI).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient cleanroom air causes airborne amine absorption into photoresist, precipitating T-topping, footing, uncontrolled critical dimension drift (> 4nm), and surface oxidation leading to erratic EPE modeling.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Metrology-calibrated 248nm DUV optical proximity correction model finalized for 180nm DRAM critical layers. All 1D and 2D test patterns exhibit closed-loop EPE residual convergence against silicon CD-SEM benchmarks within process window tolerances, ensuring zero reticle-induced bridging or pinching defects.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `opc_model_epe_discrepancy_report.csv`
- [ ] `sem_contour_overlay_verification.tiff`
- [ ] `opc_calibration_signoff_dram180.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **RMS Edge Placement Error (EPE) residual between calibrated OPC aerial model and CD-SEM contour gauges** | `2.8 nm` | <= 3.5 nm max RMS | Automated regression analysis of 500+ CD-SEM metrology gauge sites across 180nm pitch structures using OPC verification engine |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Minimum Depth of Focus (DOF) window without EPE-induced bridging or pinching defect alerts** | `0.60 um` | >= 0.50 um | Focus-exposure matrix (FEM) automated wafer CD-SEM inspection and Bossung curve fit |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Underlying BARC/resist film thickness uniformity variance across 49-point wafer mapping** | `82.0 nm` | ± 1.2 nm (3-sigma) | Spectroscopic ellipsometry 49-point automated polarimetric wafer mapping (rho = tan(Psi)*exp(i*Delta)) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All gauge residual RMS figures must register below 3.5 nm, with 0 defect flags on critical bitline and storage cell contact geometries under ±0.25 um stepper focus excursion, verified and signed off by the Lead Metrology Engineer and Chief Tapeout Architect.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Post-OPC Edge Placement Error (EPE) & Litho Rule Check (ORC) Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-OPC EPE verification must co-optimize across both optical diffraction limits and 3D resist development effects. At the 180nm node (DUV 248nm KrF stepper, NA ~ 0.60–0.68), DRAM array critical dimensions (CD ~ 180nm, pitch ~ 360nm) operate at a k1 factor of ~0.44–0.50, placing line ends and contact-to-active overlaps directly into severe 2D optical proximity degradation regimes. Litho Rule Check (ORC) must verify that process window variations (defocus +/-0.25 um, dose variation +/-5%) do not result in bridging, pinching, or EPE excursions exceeding the PDK budget (+/-15nm), while ensuring that simulation runtimes scale linearly with mask decomposition tiles without edge stitching discontinuities across memory bank boundaries.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In DRAM cell architectures (e.g. 6F2 or 8F2 layouts), edge placement error on the storage node contact (SNC) to active area (AA) and bitline contact (BLC) to wordline/poly layers dictates device leakage and retention time. Standard 1D rule-based OPC fails at dense staggered array terminations and line-end pullbacks. Calibrated model-based OPC (MBOPC) combined with full-chip ORC must enforce rigorous 2D contour-to-drawn checks across nominal, best-case, and worst-case aerial image thresholds. Optical dispersion and resist modeling parameters calibrated from spectroscopic reflectometry/ellipsometry (monitoring the 180nm-compatible DUV photoresist thickness of 480nm +/-2nm and bottom anti-reflective coating BARC at 60nm +/-1nm) must be explicitly fed into the litho simulator kernel.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle fabrication for 5x reduction DUV reticles requires high-density Cr-on-quartz (COQ) or attenuated Phase Shift Masks (att-PSM, 6% MoSi transmission). Over-aggressive OPC features such as sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) narrower than 80nm at wafer scale (400nm on 5x reticle) will trigger reticle inspection false defects, dramatically increasing e-beam mask writing times (>18 hours/plate) and driving reticle manufacturing yields down. The ORC deck must enforce minimum reticle manufacturing grid rules (e.g., 1nm grid, minimum assist feature width 400nm mask scale) to ensure commercial merchant photomask shops can fabricate plates within standard inspection tolerances.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off criteria for the Post-OPC ORC metrology milestone cannot be held up by endless computational refinement cycles. The physical tapeout schedule requires that full-chip GDSII decomposition, MBOPC simulation, and ORC violation classification finish within a contiguous 48-hour compute envelope on a 64-core compute cluster. Any critical violation flags (pinching <130nm, bridging space <135nm, or contact EPE > 18nm) must be automatically categorized into systematic vs. false-positive categories with automated geometric waiver logging before physical reticle data preparation (MDP) release.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node contact (SNC) to active area line-end pullback causing contact landing area loss >35%, leading to high contact resistance (>5 kOhm) or open circuit failures in memory cells.
1. Dense bitline (BL) line-end bridging or pinching under extreme through-focus excursions (+/-0.30 um DOF boundary), causing inter-column bitline shorts or open-circuit read failures.
1. Excessive reticle assist feature (SRAF) optical printability under low dose/overexposure, generating rogue resist defects and unwanted patterning on wafer silicon.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-01` | **Full-Chip Post-OPC Model-Based ORC EPE Gauge Metrology & Process Window Analysis** | Calibrated Full-Chip Computational Lithography & ORC Metrology Suite (Mentor Calibre nmDRC/nmOPC/ORC or Synopsys Proteus engine calibrated to 248nm KrF Stepper NA=0.65, sigma_outer=0.75, sigma_inner=0.45 annular illumination). | 1. Import post-OPC GDSII database into the ORC simulation metrology pipeline. 2. Place 2D measurement gauges across all critical DRAM array locations: Wordline line ends, Bitline pitch array, and Storage Node Contact landing pads (minimum 50,000 gauge sites across full chip). 3. Execute nominal optical-resist contour extraction at nominal condition (Focus = 0.00 um, Exposure Dose = 1.00x). 4. Run process window excursion corner simulations at four extreme corners: (+0.25um focus, +5% dose), (+0.25um focus, -5% dose), (-0.25um focus, +5% dose), (-0.25um focus, -5% dose). 5. Compute EPE defined as the Euclidean distance between simulated resist contour and target design intent across all gauge locations. 6. Filter and log all pinching violations (CD < 135nm) and bridging violations (Space < 135nm). | `Nominal condition maximum absolute EPE across all gauges must be <= 12.0 nm. Through-process-window worst-case corner EPE must be <= 18.0 nm with zero bridging (space < 130 nm) and zero pinching (width < 130 nm) violations reported across the entire 180nm DRAM core memory array.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-02` | **Critical Dimension & Film Stack Calibration Metrology for Optical Litho Simulation Inputs** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer & Reflectometer (J.A. Woollam M-2000 or KLA ASET-F5x) with spectral range 190 nm - 1000 nm; Automated Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM, Hitachi S-9380). | 1. Load wafer into Spectroscopic Ellipsometer stage under class 1 cleanroom yellow light. 2. Execute 49-point polar wafer mapping measuring Psi and Delta angles from 193nm to 800nm. 3. Fit measured spectra using Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion model to extract film thickness and refractive index (n, k) values at 248nm for both BARC and photoresist layers. 4. Transfer wafer to 248nm KrF stepper, expose litho calibration focus-exposure matrix (FEM) test reticle, perform post-exposure bake (PEB) and TMAH development. 5. Load wafer into CD-SEM and measure 1D/2D calibration test structures (dense lines, isolated spaces, line ends) across 25 FEM fields. 6. Cross-correlate empirical CD-SEM contours with optical simulation predictions to extract residual model error. | `Photoresist film thickness across 49-point wafer map must be 480.0 nm +/- 3.0 nm (3-sigma < 2.5 nm); BARC thickness must be 60.0 nm +/- 1.5 nm. Extracted optical constants at 248nm must meet: Photoresist n = 1.78 +/- 0.02, k = 0.015 +/- 0.003; BARC n = 1.50 +/- 0.03, k = 0.42 +/- 0.03. CD-SEM vs. simulation root-mean-square error (RMSE) must be <= 3.5 nm across all calibration features.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 chemical-resistant nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol), UV-absorbing safety spectacles (ANSI Z87.1 certified for 190nm-400nm radiation), ESD-safe cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood and conductive booties, Half-face respirator with multi-gas/organic vapor/P100 particulate cartridge (when handling solvent bottles)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH skin or eye contact: Immediately flush affected area with copious amounts of flowing water at emergency eyewash/drench shower station for a minimum of 15-20 minutes while removing contaminated apparel; TMAH acts as a potent neuromuscular toxin—seek urgent emergency medical attention even if skin burns are not visually obvious. For PGMEA/IPA inhalation: Remove victim immediately to fresh uncontaminated air; support breathing with supplemental oxygen if respiratory distress occurs. For solvent eye contact: Irrigate eyes with isotonic saline or temperate water for 15 minutes, holding eyelids retracted.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All chemical dispensing, spin coating, and developer operations must be conducted within dedicated laminar flow wet chemical hoods with dedicated exhaust maintaining face velocity between 0.45 m/s and 0.55 m/s (90-110 FPM). Continuous toxic organic vapor monitoring and exhaust failure interlocks connected to cleanroom SCADA system.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous alkaline developer waste containing 2.38% TMAH must be routed exclusively to a dedicated segregated TMAH/basic wastewater neutralization line, neutralized with dilute sulfuric acid to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to industrial wastewater treatment; never cross-mix TMAH with concentrated acids or organic solvent lines. Spent PGMEA and IPA waste solvents must be collected in closed, grounded stainless-steel/flammable-approved waste carboys for hazardous organic waste incineration disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Propylene Glycol Monomethyl Ether Acetate (PGMEA / Photoresist/BARC Solvent)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI Electronic Grade (SEMICHEM 99.9%) | `>= 99.5 wt%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH Developer)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor Grade (Ultra-Pure) | `2.38 wt% in aqueous solution` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (EG) | `>= 99.8 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Vapor-HMDS primed, BARC and 248nm chemically amplified photoresist freshly coated, soft-baked at 110 deg C, specular, particulate-free (<10 particles at >0.15 um), optical reflection verified.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Developed, hard-baked resist pattern with fully cleared inspection gauges, hydrophobically stable surface, zero chemical scum or residual developer residue in active spaces.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom ambient air queue time causes airborne amine (e.g. NH3, N-methylpyrrolidone) contamination, neutralizing photoacid generators (PAG) at the resist surface, triggering severe 'T-topping' resist profile distortion, catastrophic EPE gauge shifts (>25nm), and micro-bridging across dense 180nm DRAM pitch lines.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified Post-OPC GDSII database, comprehensive full-chip Litho Rule Check (ORC) metrology sign-off report, and empirical optical metrology calibration dataset demonstrating compliant Edge Placement Error within +/-15nm across nominal and process window boundaries for 180nm DRAM tapeout.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_POST_OPC_ORC_METROLOGY_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `DRAM180_FULLCHIP_EPE_GAUGE_ANALYSIS.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM180_PROCESS_WINDOW_CONTOUR_OVERLAY.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum full-chip post-OPC nominal edge placement error (EPE) across all calibrated critical DRAM array gauges** | `9.5 nm` | <= 12.0 nm | Automated Model-Based ORC Gauge Extraction across 50,000 inspection sites in Calibre ORC / Proteus |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Minimum through-process-window space (bridging threshold) under +/-0.25um defocus and +/-5% dose excursion** | `148.0 nm` | >= 135.0 nm | Full-chip process window contour intersection scanning and 2D spacing check |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Spectroscopic ellipsometry measured 248nm KrF photoresist thickness uniform mapping (49 points)** | `480.0 nm` | +/- 3.0 nm (3-sigma < 2.5 nm) | 49-point automated polar spectroscopic reflectometry/ellipsometry wafer mapping |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero fatal lithographic violations (no bridging <135nm, pinching <135nm, or contact EPE >18nm at +/-0.25um DOF / +/-5% exposure corners) across all critical layers (Active, Poly, Contact, Metal1); all deliverable files archived and cryptographic SHA256 checksums signed off by Lithography Lead, PDK Tapeout Lead, and Quality Assurance Manager.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## EPE Gauge Placement & Process Window Corner Setup for Poly/Contact Layers

**Document ID:** `SOP-LITHO-OPC-180NM-003`  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) / Gen 3  
**Target Layers:** Poly Gate (`poly`) & Bitline/Drain Contact Hole (`contact`)  
**Context Citing:** [SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid](./docs/knowledge/epe_gauge_placement_poly_contact.md) & [180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology](./docs/knowledge/epe_gauge_placement_poly_contact.md)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────┐
│                   │
│  GDSII Ingestion  │
│                   │
└─────────┬─────────┘
          │
          │

│   Gauge Seeding   │
│                   │

          │
          │
          ▼

          │

          ▼
```

---

### 2. Physical Metrics & Dimensional Boundaries

```text

                     │■■■■■■■                          │
  Overlay Budget (nm)┤■■■■■■■                          │
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Input Ingestion & Manufacturing Grid Snapping
1. Ingest post-OPC GDSII / OASIS databases for `poly` (Layer 68:20) and `contact` (Layer 71:20) layers along with active diffusion (`diff`, Layer 65:20).
2. Validate and snap all vertex coordinates to the physical manufacturing grid resolution of **`0.005 µm (5 nm)`**.
3. Verify that the minimum drawn poly gate length is **`0.15 µm (150 nm)`** and access transistor gate channel length is **`L = 180 nm`** (width **`W = 220 nm`**).

#### Step 2: Poly Layer EPE Gauge Seeding
1. **Channel Center Gauges:** Seed 1D orthogonal EPE measurement gauges across poly gate channels intersecting active diffusion at the exact midpoint:
   - Target drawn dimension: **`180 nm`** for array access transistors; **`150 nm`** for peripheral gates.
   - Gauge length: **`0.30 µm (300 nm)`** spanning **`0.005 µm (5 nm)`** step intervals.
2. **Line-End & Tip-to-Tip Gauges:** Seed longitudinal gauges on all poly gate line-ends facing adjacent bitline diffusion or neighbor gates:
   - Monitor minimum poly gate spacing target of **`0.21 µm (210 nm)`**.
3. **Corner Rounding Gauges:** Place bidirectional diagonal gauges at 45° across outer gate corners to detect corner pull-back and bridging.

#### Step 3: Contact Hole Layer EPE Gauge Seeding
1. **Orthogonal Dual-Axis Gauges:** Place crosshair X-axis and Y-axis EPE gauges across every 2D contact aperture:
   - Target nominal drawn dimension: **`0.17 µm x 0.17 µm (170 nm x 170 nm)`**.
2. **Poly-to-Contact Enclosure Gauges:** Place relational edge-to-edge gauges measuring the contact boundary to the underlying gate poly edge and active diffusion edge.
   - Apply boundary overlay limit: ensure enclosing margin accommodates the maximum permissible overlay error budget of **`<= 35 nm`**.

#### Step 4: Optical & Process Window (PW) Corner Matrix Configuration
Configure KrF DUV optical lithography parameters:
- **Optical Source:** Deep Ultraviolet KrF excimer laser, wavelength **`λ = 248 nm`**, numerical aperture **`NA = 0.65`**, process factor **`k1 = 0.40`** (minimum resolvable half-pitch **`R = 152 nm`**).
- **Process Window Simulation Corners:**
  - **Corner 1 (Nominal):** Best Focus ($0.0\text{ µm}$), Nominal Dose ($E_0$).
  - **Corner 2 (Max Dose / +Defocus):** Dose $+5.0\%$, Defocus $+0.15\text{ µm}$.
  - **Corner 3 (Min Dose / -Defocus):** Dose $-5.0\%$, Defocus $-0.15\text{ µm}$.
  - **Corner 4 (Max Dose / -Defocus):** Dose $+5.0\%$, Defocus $-0.15\text{ µm}$.
  - **Corner 5 (Min Dose / +Defocus):** Dose $-5.0\%$, Defocus $+0.15\text{ µm}$.

#### Step 5: Post-OPC Litho Rule Check (ORC) Metrology Execution
1. Run full-chip contour simulation at all 5 process window corners.
2. Calculate Edge Placement Error across all gauges:
   $$\text{EPE} = \text{Edge}_{\text{simulated}} - \text{Edge}_{\text{drawn}}$$
3. Flag any location violating the critical dimension tolerances, line-end pullback limits, or bridging thresholds.

---

| **AC-MET-01** | DRAM Access Gate Poly CD ($L$) across Channel Midpoint | `180.0` | `± 9.0` ($\le 5.0\%$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-MET-02** | Contact Hole Critical Dimension ($CD_x$, $CD_y$) | `170.0` | `± 10.0` ($\le 5.8\%$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-MET-03** | Max Gate-to-Active Overlay Edge Placement Deviation | $\le 35.0$ | $\le 35.0$ (Hard Ceiling) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-MET-04** | Grid Placement Snapping Residual Error | `0.0` | `< 0.005` (Snapping Step Grid) | $\text{µm}$ |

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Full-Chip Optical Rule Check (ORC) Aerial & Resist Simulation Across Dose-Focus Matrix

**Category**: Photolithography | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Full-chip simulation across a multi-condition Dose-Focus Matrix (Bossung condition grid) on dense 180nm DRAM cell arrays requires massive compute grids and fine mesh resolution (<1nm grid pitch). Without strict hierarchical tiling and optical cluster binning, runtime will explode exponentially, while boundary stitching artifacts between tiles could mask localized optical pinching or bridging along dense wordlines and bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrated resist 3D profiles must incorporate acid diffusion length and post-exposure bake (PEB) thermal dynamics beyond simple aerial threshold models (CTR). In 180nm DRAM capacitor-contact and isolation active-area corners, aerial-only simulation overpredicts process windows due to high optical diffraction non-linearities and flare from 5x reduction reticle chrome degradation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle write turn-around time (TAT) and e-beam direct-write mask shop qualifications are throttled if OPC/ORC clean decks cannot export standardized OASIS/MEBES formats verified against commercial MPW mask house acceptance rule decks. Any respin caused by undetected post-OPC EPE violations imposes a 6-to-8 week tapeout slip and tens of thousands in MPW mask tooling overhead.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Simulation milestones must strictly gate physical reticle fabrication signoff. If full-chip ORC pass/fail flags rely on manual contour inspection rather than automated numeric GDS/OASIS EPE error marker generation across +/-10% dose and +/-0.35um focus variation windows, the verification schedule will slip past foundry tapeout freezes.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sub-resolution assist feature (SRAF) sidelobe printing and resist bridging under over-exposure/negative-defocus conditions in dense DRAM cell matrix array periphery.
1. Line-end pullback and catastrophic contact-hole pinch-off (EPE > 15nm) causing open bitline contact plugs under underexposure/positive-defocus extreme process corners.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-2-01` | **Full-Chip Bossung Dose-Focus Matrix Aerial & Diffused Resist EPE Verification** | Calibrated Lithography Simulator Engine (PROLITH/Calibre OPCverify) with 248nm KrF / 365nm i-line Optical Vector Kernel and 3D Resist PEB Diffusion Solver | 1. Ingest full-chip post-OPC layout and partition into 50um x 50um tiles with 2um halo overlaps. 2. Define Dose-Focus Matrix spanning Dose: -10%, nominal (135 mJ/cm^2), +10% in 2.5% steps; Focus: -0.35 um, 0.0 um, +0.35 um in 0.07 um steps (DOF >= 0.70 um window). 3. Execute aerial image intensity field computation and compute diffused threshold resist contours. 4. Measure Edge Placement Error (EPE) across 10,000 automated 1D/2D cutlines placed orthogonally along gate edges, line ends, and contact margins. | `Maximum absolute EPE <= 12.0 nm across all DRAM storage node, wordline, and bitline features under nominal condition; maximum absolute EPE <= 18.0 nm at extreme process window corners (+/-8% dose, +/-0.25 um focus); zero pinching/bridging violations detected across full chip.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-2-02` | **SRAF Sidelobe Printing & Minimum Mask Feature Inspectability Check** | Automated Lithography Rule Check (ORC) Engine with Intensity Threshold Extrema Detector and High-Resolution Aerial Image Profiler | 1. Run intensity extrema scan across all non-printing assist feature regions at +12% exposure dose and -0.30 um defocus. 2. Calculate peak normalized aerial image intensity (I_max / I_clear) over all SRAF geometries. 3. Evaluate resist loss margin against the critical resist development threshold (I_th = 0.30). | `Peak intensity on all non-printing assist features must remain strictly below 0.22 (I/I_clear) across the full dose-focus window; resist residual thickness loss over SRAFs must be 0.0 nm (no spurious resist pattern formation).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, minimum 6 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-absorbing safety glasses / face shield, Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood and ESD booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with developer/TMAH or resist solvent: Immediately flush with copious deionized water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent fumes: Move victim to fresh uncontaminated air; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing is labored. For eye contact: Rinse open eyes under emergency eye wash for 15 minutes and seek immediate medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Lithography simulation server racks require dedicated HVAC cooling (minimum 20 ACH, relative humidity 40-45% +/-2%, 21 deg C). Experimental resist calibration track must be equipped with dedicated laminar exhaust ducts maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s with solvent vapor scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent developer solution containing TMAH must be segregated into designated alkaline waste streams and neutralized with dilute hydrochloric/sulfuric acid to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to hazardous waste pickup. Organic solvent rinses containing PGMEA must be collected in closed UN-rated flammable waste drums.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Propylene Glycol Monomethyl Ether Acetate (PGMEA / resist solvent)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `>99.5 wt%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH developer)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade | `2.38 wt%` |
| **1-Methoxy-2-propanol** | `107-98-2` | Spectrophotometric Grade | `>=99.0 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: HMDS vapor-primed and dry ultra-flat 150mm/200mm test substrate with native oxide < 1.2 nm or freshly etched hardmask surface.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Spin-coated photoresist film (1.3 um nominal thickness) post-softbaked at 95 deg C with zero airborne amine contamination.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive environmental cleanroom air exposure causes airborne basic amine (NH3/N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone) chemisorption on resist surface, causing severe T-topping, insoluble skin layer formation, and catastrophic line-edge CD widening in subsequent ORC physical calibration prints.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified full-chip ORC aerial and 3D resist simulation deck report confirming 180nm open-source DRAM layouts maintain common depth of focus (DOF) >= 0.50 um at >= 10% exposure latitude (EL) with zero unresolved EPE, bridging, pinching, or SRAF sidelobe printability errors.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_fullchip_orc_epe_distribution_report.csv`
- [ ] `bossung_process_window_contour_analysis.pdf`
- [ ] `fullchip_orc_error_markers_overlay.gds`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Common Depth of Focus (DOF) across dense DRAM cell array and critical periphery transistors** | `0.60 um` | +/-0.10 um (minimum acceptable >= 0.50 um) | Automated Process Window Analysis (ED-window overlap curve generated from Bossung matrix simulation) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Full-chip maximum 3-sigma Edge Placement Error (EPE) under nominal exposure dose and focus** | `8.5 nm` | <= 12.0 nm maximum limit | Automated cutline-based contour vs. drawn design geometry EPE distribution extraction in ORC software |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum assist feature (SRAF) peak intensity ratio under 1.10x dose over-exposure corner** | `0.18` | <= 0.22 maximum threshold | Full-chip intensity scan threshold parser over non-printing assist feature coordinates |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All full-chip critical cutline locations achieve zero fatal ORC error flags (no pinching < 130nm, no bridging < 140nm, no line-end pullback > 20nm) across a certified common process window of +/-8% dose and +/-0.25um focus, and signoff approval log signed by both Lithography Domain Expert and Systems Engineer.

Measure Edge Placement Error (EPE) across 10,000 automated 1D/2D cutlines placed orthogonally along gate edges, line ends, and contact margins.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Process Window Matrix Definition & DUV Illumination Condition Setup

### 1. Document Control & Metadata
- **Module**: Photolithography & Metrology
- **Target Technology**: 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW / Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Toolset**: 5x Reduction DUV KrF Stepper/Scanner, Spectroscopic Ellipsometer, CD-SEM
- **Action Type**: Make

---

### 2. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Substrate        │
│  Preparation & Resist  │
│       Spin-Coat        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Ellipsometric Film   │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    DUV Illumination    │
│         Setup          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Focus-Exposure     │
│    Matrix Exposure     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   CD-SEM Metrology &   │
│      FEM Analysis      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Common Process     │
│  Window Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Preparation & Resist Thickness Qualification**
   - Apply DUV positive photoresist onto prime bare/test wafers using automated track spin-coating targeted to a nominal film thickness of **$1.3\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Perform spectroscopic ellipsometry metrology using polarized reflectance ($\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$) parameterized with Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models.
   - Execute automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to verify resist uniformity within **$\pm 2\text{ nm}$**.

2. **DUV Stepper Illumination & Optical Setup**
   - Configure KrF excimer laser source to wavelength **$\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$**.
   - Set projection lens numerical aperture to **$\text{NA} = 0.65$**.
   - Load the 5x optical reticle aligned to the foundry physical placement manufacturing grid of **$0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ (5 nm)**.
   - Calculate theoretical resolution limit via Rayleigh criterion:
     $$R = k_1 \cdot \frac{\lambda}{\text{NA}} = 0.40 \cdot \frac{248\text{ nm}}{0.65} \approx 152\text{ nm}$$

3. **Process Window Matrix (FEM) Execution**
   - Define a Focus-Exposure Matrix (FEM) array across the wafer with stepped nominal exposure doses (e.g., center nominal $\pm 15\%$ in $1\text{ mJ/cm}^2$ increments) and nominal focus offsets (stepped in $0.05\ \mu\text{m}$ increments across $\pm 0.4\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Expose critical gate poly patterns (drawn target gate length: **$0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ / 150 nm**) and contact hole arrays (drawn target: **$0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$**).

4. **CD-SEM Metrology & Process Window Analysis**
   - Measure critical dimensions (CD) across all FEM field locations using automated CD-SEM.
   - Extract Bossung curves (CD vs. Focus across Dose) for:
     - Poly gate length: target **$150\text{ nm}$**.
     - Active diffusion width: target **$0.15\ \mu\text{m}$**.
     - Contact hole CD: target **$0.17\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Verify that the depth of focus satisfies:
     $$\text{DOF} = k_2 \cdot \frac{\lambda}{\text{NA}^2} \ge 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$$
   - Confirm gate poly to active diffusion overlay error vector does not exceed the budget of **$\le 35\text{ nm}$**.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                       Critical Dimension Targets (nm)  
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    │
       Min Diff Width┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
         Contact Hole┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Resolvable Half-Pitch┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓   │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓   │
      Drawn Gate Poly┤█████████████████████████████    │
                     │█████████████████████████████    │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    42.5    85.0    127.5 170.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target / Limit | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Metrology |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Resist Film Thickness & Uniformity** | $1.3\ \mu\text{m} \pm 2\text{ nm}$ | $\mu\text{m}$, $\text{nm}$ | 49-point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Minimum Resolvable Half-Pitch ($R$)** | $\le 152\text{ nm}$ ($\lambda=248\text{ nm}, \text{NA}=0.65, k_1=0.40$) | $\text{nm}$ | CD-SEM Cross-Section / Top-Down |
| **Depth of Focus (DOF)** | $\ge 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ ($\text{DOF} = k_2 \cdot \frac{\lambda}{\text{NA}^2}$) | $\mu\text{m}$ | Bossung Plot Metric Fitting |
| **Poly-to-Active Overlay Error** | $\le 35\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Optical/SEM Overlay Tool |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**: Verified parameters for $\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$ KrF laser, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$ yielding minimum resolvable half-pitch $152\text{ nm}$, gate poly length $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$), active diff width $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$, contact dimension $0.17\ \mu\text{m} \times 0.17\ \mu\text{m}$, physical grid resolution $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$), $\text{DOF} \ge 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$, and maximum permissible overlay error $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Polarization metrology ($\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$) with Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling, automated 9-point/49-point wafer mapping, and photoresist measurement precision ($1.3\ \mu\text{m} \pm 2\text{ nm}$).

*Knowledge captured to [docs/knowledge/duv_fem_process_window_setup.md](./docs/knowledge/duv_fem_process_window_setup.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Illumination source pupil condition (NA=0.65, KrF 248nm excimer laser) must be matched across optical proximity correction (OPC) aerial engine kernels and physical scanner tool lens aberrations (Zernike polynomials Z5-Z16 <= 15mlambda). Operating at Rayleigh k1 = 0.40 leaves zero margin for pupil fill asymmetry or telecentricity tilt, which induces non-correctable systematic intra-field Edge Placement Errors (EPE) across 150nm poly wordlines and 170nm contact arrays.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm dense DRAM wordline arrays (150nm poly lines at 360nm pitch) paired with 170nm isolated contact pads, a standard conventional circular pupil fails to sustain the mandatory >=0.5um Depth of Focus (DOF). An annular off-axis illumination (OAI) aperture (sigma_outer=0.75, sigma_inner=0.45) or quasar configuration must be tuned alongside thin organic bottom anti-reflective coating (BARC) thickness optimization (reflectivity R < 0.5% at 248nm) to prevent standing wave CD necking and line-end pullback.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: KrF 248nm excimer laser operating mix relies on high-purity neon and krypton gas mixes; excimer gas degradation limits pulse energy stability to +/-1.5%, which rapidly deteriorates effective dose accuracy. Chemically amplified photoresist (CAR) lots and bottom anti-reflective coating (BARC) supplies must be qualified with certified ambient amine-filtration packaging to prevent T-topping bridging defects on production lines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Focus-Exposure Matrix (FEM) lot validation and OPC aerial model calibration consume scarce pilot-line capacity and high-cost baseline CD-SEM hours. Clear gating rules must enforce automated FEM contour extraction and Bossung curve parameterization within a 48-hour cycle to avoid bottlenecking downstream reticle tapeout and reticle inspection signoff milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Wordline CD necking and bridging across wafer topography steps driven by DOF collapse (<0.40 um) under non-optimized conventional illumination.
1. Line-end pullback and gate-to-active overlay shift exceeding the 35 nm budget caused by non-telecentric lens pupil aberrations and uncompensated off-axis illumination phase error.
1. T-topping and resist scumming at 170nm contact hole bottoms resulting from airborne base contamination (amine poisoning) during excessive post-exposure queue delays.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-2-1-01` | **Full Process Window Qualification via Focus-Exposure Matrix (FEM) Bossung Metrology** | KrF 248nm Step-and-Scan DUV Lithography System (0.65 NA, annular sigma 0.75/0.45), Automated Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM, 1.0 keV e-beam, 5nm pixel pitch), Thin-Film Spectroscopic Ellipsometer | 1. Program step-and-scan DUV stepper with 11x11 Focus-Exposure Matrix: focus offsets from -0.50 um to +0.50 um in 0.10 um increments; exposure dose from 18.0 mJ/cm2 to 26.0 mJ/cm2 in 0.8 mJ/cm2 steps. 2. Expose FEM test reticle containing 150nm dense DRAM wordline arrays (1:1.4 pitch) and 170nm contact hole patterns. 3. Perform post-exposure bake (PEB) at 115 deg C for 90 seconds within 10 minutes of exposure. 4. Develop wafer using 2.38% TMAH puddle process for 60 seconds, followed by DI water rinse and spin dry. 5. Load wafer into automated CD-SEM and measure 150nm poly CD across 121 matrix fields (9 intra-field sites per die). 6. Extract Bossung curves to compute common usable Depth of Focus (EDOF) at +/-10% CD specification tolerance. | `Pass if common usable Process Window yields Exposure Latitude (EL) >= 10.0% at a minimum Depth of Focus (DOF) >= 0.50 um across both dense 150nm wordline and 170nm contact features; fail if common DOF < 0.50 um or CD 3-sigma across intra-field points exceeds 7.5 nm.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-2-1-02` | **DUV Illumination Pupil Telecentricity and Wavefront Aberration Optical Rule Check (ORC)** | In-situ DUV Stepper Transmission Image Sensor (TIS), Wavefront Interferometer / Shack-Hartmann Lens Aberration Sensor, Metrology CD-SEM | 1. Run automated lens wavefront aberration measurement using in-situ Shack-Hartmann sensor to extract Zernike polynomial coefficients Z5 through Z16. 2. Execute transmission image sensor (TIS) scan at 25 intra-field coordinates across the 26mm x 33mm exposure field to quantify telecentricity error (centroid shift vs. focus delta). 3. Expose 150nm isolated and dense poly test structures across focus steps (-0.3 um, 0 um, +0.3 um). 4. Measure asymmetry and pattern pitch shift via CD-SEM metrology across field corners and field center. | `Pass if total Zernike wavefront error RMS <= 0.025 lambda (<= 6.2 nm), field telecentricity error <= 1.5 mrad across all 25 field locations, and dense-to-isolated line bias shift across +/-0.30 um focus range is <= 4.0 nm; fail if telecentricity > 1.5 mrad or RMS wavefront error > 6.2 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom suit with conductive ESD booties, Chemical-resistant butyl rubber outer gloves over nitrile inner gloves, Certified 248nm KrF DUV laser safety eyewear (optical density OD >= 7.0 at 248 nm), Full-face splash shield during liquid chemical canister exchange and developer bath maintenance, Vapor-tight organic vapor respirator cartridge (NIOSH OV/P100) for chemical dispensing bay intervention
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH skin or eye contact: Immediately flush affected areas with continuous running water for at least 15 minutes; TMAH acts as a potent neurotoxin and caustic base; administer immediate medical treatment and cardiac monitoring. For toxic excimer fluorine gas inhalation: Evacuate area immediately to fresh air, administer 100% humidified medical oxygen, and keep victim warm and at rest; treat for pulmonary edema. For organic solvent splash: Wash with copious soap and water; remove contaminated garments immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Lithography coat/track and developer modules must be tied to dedicated dedicated corrosive base scrubbed exhaust with continuous face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) and differential pressure interlock (-50 Pa). Laser bay gas cabinets require toxic gas exhaust with automatic shutoff valves linked to electrochemical ambient fluorine sensors (alarm threshold 0.1 ppm).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent developer solution containing 2.38% TMAH must be segregated into dedicated alkaline chemical drain lines routed to an automated biological/electrochemical oxidation treatment station; direct acid mixing prohibited to avoid exothermic toxic mist generation. Solvent waste (PGMEA/EBR) routed to dedicated solvent carboys for certified hazardous high-temperature incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH Developer)** | `75-59-2` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `2.38 wt% aqueous solution` |
| **Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate (PGMEA / Resist Solvent)** | `108-65-6` | Semiconductor Electronic Grade | `>= 99.5%` |
| **Krypton / Neon / Fluorine Gas Mixture (KrF Excimer Laser Source)** | `7782-41-4 (Fluorine), 7439-90-9 (Krypton), 7440-01-9 (Neon)` | Research / Laser Grade 5.0 | `0.1% F2, 1.5% Kr, balance Ne (98.4%)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry, clean, organo-metallic residue-free Si substrate coated with cured 60 nm bottom anti-reflective coating (BARC) and soft-baked 420 nm KrF photoresist with water contact angle 68-74 degrees, free of micro-bubbles or pinhole streaks.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Exposed, post-exposure baked (115 deg C) and developed pattern exhibiting vertical sidewall profiles (88 to 90 degrees), free of unexposed resist residue, scumming, bridging, or T-topping.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding 30 minutes in cleanroom ambient air prior to post-exposure bake exposes chemically amplified resist to trace airborne amine bases (NH3, N-methylpyrrolidone), neutralizing photo-generated acids and triggering severe resist T-topping, line-end bridging, and complete footing closure of 170nm contact holes.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified DUV 248nm stepper illumination condition and calibrated Focus-Exposure Matrix baseline for 180nm DRAM tapeout, delivering a validated process window (DOF >= 0.55 um at 10% EL) for 150nm poly wordlines and 170nm contact arrays with overlay budget <= 35nm.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PW_DUV180_FEM_Bossung_Analysis_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Process_Window_Matrix_Dose_Focus_Metrology.csv`
- [ ] `DUV_Lens_Telecentricity_Aberration_Zernike_Map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Common Depth of Focus (DOF) across 150nm poly lines and 170nm contact patterns at >= 10% Exposure Latitude** | `0.58 um` | +/- 0.05 um (minimum allowable >= 0.50 um) | Bossung curve intersection analysis from 11x11 Focus-Exposure Matrix CD-SEM measurements |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Critical Dimension (CD) Mean for minimum drawn poly gate line at nominal dose/focus** | `150.0 nm` | +/- 7.5 nm (+/- 5% of drawn feature size) | Top-down automated CD-SEM multi-site sampling across 25 intra-field die positions |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Stepper Lens Pupil Telecentricity Error across full 26mm x 33mm exposure field** | `0.8 mrad` | <= 1.5 mrad maximum | In-situ Transmission Image Sensor (TIS) intra-field focal-plane displacement metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Engineering council signoff requires automated extraction of common DOF >= 0.50 um at 10% EL across poly and contact layers, CD 3-sigma across field <= 7.5 nm, lens aberration RMS <= 0.025 lambda, and verified queue-time tracking log confirming PEB completed within 30 minutes of exposure with zero T-topping.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Full-Chip Aerial Image & Variable Threshold Resist (CTR/VTR) Contour Simulation

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > DUV Stepper 5x Optical Reticle Generation & Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) [Photolithography] > GDSII Layer Decomposition & Rule-Based Model-Calibrated OPC Simulation [Circuit Design] > Post-OPC Edge Placement Error (EPE) & Litho Rule Check (ORC) Metrology [Metrology] > Full-Chip Optical Rule Check (ORC) Aerial & Resist Simulation Across Dose-Focus Matrix [Photolithography] > Full-Chip Aerial Image & Variable Threshold Resist (CTR/VTR) Contour Simulation [Photolithography]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Feature CD: 180 nm, Overlay: ±35 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Full-chip aerial image and variable threshold resist (CTR/VTR) simulation requires decomposing complex DRAM dense cell arrays (pitch 360nm) alongside wide peripheral logic. The optical convolution kernels (Hopkins transmission cross-coefficients) and empirical resist diffusion equations must be vectorized across HPC cluster nodes without tiling boundary artifacts, ensuring that 2D edge placement error (EPE) extraction does not diverge at sub-window boundaries.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm DUV (248nm KrF, NA 0.65-0.70), relying on a simple constant threshold resist (CTR) model severely underestimates line-end shortening and corner rounding in dense storage node and bitline contact layers. A variable threshold resist (VTR) model calibrated against empirical CD-SEM gauge data (capturing local optical intensity slope, max intensity I_max, and minimum intensity I_min) is non-negotiable to prevent bridging and pinch-off under nominal focus/dose conditions.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Model calibration relies strictly on experimental CD-SEM calibration wafers printed on commercial 180nm foundry tracks. Discrepancies in batch-to-batch resist chemistry (e.g., photoacid generator loading and quencher efficiency) or delays in reticle fab delivery directly bottleneck the simulation model parameter fitting and subsequent tapeout freeze.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Simulation runtime for full-chip DRAM array and peripheral circuitry must stay within the allocated 12-hour turn-around window per design iteration. Clear sign-off criteria and automated gauge reporting are critical to avoid blocking downstream mask data preparation (MDP) and 5x reticle tapeout milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe line-end pullback and contact necking on dense capacitor storage nodes due to uncalibrated VTR threshold degradation in low-contrast optical regimes.
1. Tiling boundary stitching artifacts in distributed optical kernels resulting in false ORC pinching violations across 50um boundary overlaps.
1. Over-prediction of process window margin caused by unmodeled acid blur and post-exposure bake (PEB) thermal gradient variations across the 200mm wafer field.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-2-2-01` | **Full-Chip VTR Model Contour Calibration vs CD-SEM Anchor Gauges** | Calibrated Optical Rule Check / OPC Simulation Engine (Hopkins Abbe formulation, 248nm KrF optical model) with CD-SEM Gauge Importer | 1. Ingest calibrated optical TCC kernels and VTR resist parameters into simulation engine. 2. Execute 2D contour simulation across all 128 target gauge sites at nominal dose (E0) and best focus (F0). 3. Extract simulated resist contour cutline values at designated gauge coordinates. 4. Calculate residuals between simulated contours and physical CD-SEM gauge values across dense lines, isolated spaces, and 2D SRAM/DRAM line-ends. | `Root-mean-square error (RMSE) between simulated contour and CD-SEM gauge measurements <= 1.8 nm, and maximum absolute EPE gauge error <= 3.5 nm across all 128 anchor sites.` |
| `TC-DUV-STEPPER-RETICLE-1-3-2-2-02` | **Process Window Aerial Image Contrast and NILS Verification across Focus-Dose Matrix** | Full-Chip Aerial Image Metrology Engine with automated Normalized Image Log-Slope (NILS) extraction script | 1. Run full-chip aerial image intensity matrix across nominal, under-dose (-10%), over-dose (+10%), and defocus (+/- 200nm) states. 2. Evaluate optical intensity profile across critical DRAM bitline pitches (180nm line / 180nm space). 3. Compute image contrast ((I_max - I_min) / (I_max + I_min)) and NILS = w * d(ln I)/dx at the nominal resist edge threshold for all critical feature cross-sections. 4. Flag any spatial location where NILS drops below process window threshold. | `Minimum NILS >= 1.60 and aerial image contrast >= 0.45 across full-chip critical array features over the entire +/- 150 nm focus and +/- 5% exposure dose envelope.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), UV-absorbing safety goggles (ANSI Z87.1 approved for 248nm/365nm stray radiation), Antistatic ESD cleanroom lab coat and ESD heel straps, Half-mask respirator with organic vapor cartridge (during solvent wipe/developer handling)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with TMAH or solvents: Flush immediately with copiously flowing clean deionized water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated attire. Seek immediate medical attention; TMAH acts as a severe neurotoxin and caustic base. For inhalation: Move subject to fresh air immediately and supply supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated yellow-room chemical laminar flow wet-bench exhaust operating at >= 100 FPM face velocity; continuous VOC air monitoring duct linked to facility scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate organic solvent wastes (PGMEA, ethyl lactate) into dedicated grounded flammables drums. Aqueous basic developer (TMAH) must be collected separately in carboys and neutralized to pH 6-9 prior to hazardous chemical treatment.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Propylene Glycol Monomethyl Ether Acetate (PGMEA / Resist Solvent)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `>= 99.5%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH 2.38% developer)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade | `2.38%` |
| **Ethyl Lactate (Safe solvent stripper/edge bead remover)** | `97-64-3` | Reagent Grade | `>= 99.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: HMDS vapor-primed, defect-free substrate with organic bottom anti-reflective coating (BARC) cured at 205°C and stable contact angle of 65° ± 5°.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Simulated resist contour boundary database matched against target mask layout, ready for downstream Litho Rule Check (LRC) DRC-violation filtering.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient cleanroom air causes airborne molecular amine contamination (base poisoning), resulting in severe T-topping, foot formation, and unrecoverable EPE offset drift in chemically amplified DUV resists.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full-chip aerial image intensity maps and calibrated Variable Threshold Resist (VTR) contour datasets successfully generated for all DRAM cell array and peripheral logic layers, demonstrating robust lithographic fidelity and zero catastrophic bridging/necking violations across the entire specified process window.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `fullchip_vtr_contour_report.pdf`
- [ ] `epe_gauge_residual_metrics.csv`
- [ ] `aerial_image_nils_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Root-mean-square error between simulated VTR contours and empirical CD-SEM calibration gauges across dense bitline and storage nodes** | `1.5 nm` | +/- 0.3 nm | Automated cutline-to-gauge regression analysis using epe_gauge_residual_metrics.csv |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum Edge Placement Error (EPE) on full-chip 2D corner rounding and line-ends across +/- 100nm defocus** | `3.8 nm` | <= 5.0 nm maximum | Full-chip ORC polygon extraction and automated DRC EPE violation classification |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero critical lithographic bridging or pinching violations flagged across nominal and +/- 5% dose / +/- 100nm focus process window, with model calibration RMSE <= 1.8 nm verified and certified by Lithography and Tapeout Lead.
