# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): CD-SEM Metrology & Process Window Characterization for 180nm Gate Poly Patterning

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > Electron Beam Direct Write (EBDW) Lithography for 180nm Critical Dimension Gates [Photolithography] > EBDW Exposure Recipe Execution for 180nm Poly Gate Patterning [Photolithography] > E-Beam Proximity Effect Correction and Dose Matrix Calibration for 180nm Poly Gates [Photolithography] > EBDW Focus-Exposure Dose Matrix Calibration Array Patterning on Test Wafers [Photolithography] > CD-SEM Metrology & Process Window Characterization for 180nm Gate Poly Patterning [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Feature CD: 180 nm, Overlay: ±35 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Split-Field Dual CMOS Vision / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: EBDW patterning coupled with automated CD-SEM requires stringent fiducial alignment and charging mitigation. For 180nm poly gates patterned over 3.5nm thermal gate oxide and underlying active areas, negative e-beam resist (such as HSQ or chemically amplified negative resists) or positive resists (ZEP520A/PMMA) exhibit severe electron-beam-induced shrinkage during SEM inspection. The inspection recipe must specify ultra-low landing energy (<=300 eV to 500 eV) and frame integration caps to avoid false CD shrinkage reporting that corrupts the Dose-Focus Matrix (EDM/FEM) feedback loop.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm gate poly node, proximity effect correction (PEC) accuracy dictates the iso-dense bias between isolated gate lines and dense 180nm DRAM cell pass-gate arrays. CD-SEM line-edge roughness (LER) and line-width roughness (LWR) extraction algorithms must apply standardized threshold detection (e.g., 50% normalized threshold edge-detection) to isolate resist footing from true physical CD. Failure to calibrate the beam scan linearity against a calibrated pitch standard (e.g., NIST-traceable 100nm/200nm pitch standard) will directly skew the extraction of the overlapping process window.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-wafer EBDW and inline CD-SEM tools (such as Hitachi CG-series or Applied Materials VeritySEM) suffer from severe throughput bottlenecks compared to standard DUV lithography. With typical CD-SEM measurement times running at 1.5 to 2.5 seconds per site and EBDW exposure speeds limited by shot-pitch constraints, wafer-scale FEM sampling must be strategically decimated to a 25-point or 49-point matrix per die to preserve tool availability and prevent wafer queue-time violations.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology data turnaround time directly gates the downstream reactive ion etching (RIE) polysilicon gate etch recipe lock. Delaying CD-SEM signoff beyond the 120-minute post-develop queue window risks atmospheric airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption and resist oxidation, invalidating the Bossung curve process window analysis and delaying lot release to RIE.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Electron beam resist slimming and carbonaceous charging deposition during repeated CD-SEM measurement passes, causing artificial CD degradation > 5 nm across FEM matrix points.
1. Inaccurate edge detection thresholding due to resist sidewall footing/scumming in dense DRAM poly gate arrays, producing false process window closure.
1. Misalignment of CD-SEM automated pattern recognition (APR) on e-beam fiducials, leading to measurement placement off-target into adjacent uncorrected proximity zones.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-2-3-01` | **Automated CD-SEM Dose-Focus Array Verification and CD Uniformity Mapping** | High-Resolution In-line CD-SEM (Hitachi CG5000 or equivalent) calibrated to NIST-traceable pitch standard; Landing Energy: 400 eV, Beam Current: 8.0 pA. | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM loadlock under high vacuum (P < 1e-5 Pa). 2. Execute automated global wafer alignment using peripheral alignment targets. 3. Engage automated pattern recognition (APR) on the central 180nm isolated and dense gate poly test structures across the 9x9 focus-exposure matrix. 4. Collect top-down secondary electron line profiles at 150kX magnification using 16-frame averaging with multi-point edge detection at 50% threshold height. 5. Measure gate poly CD, Line Edge Roughness (LER, 3-sigma), and Line Width Roughness (LWR, 3-sigma) for each matrix point. 6. Export tabular metrology data and Bossung curve datasets. | `Target critical dimension for isolated and dense lines is 180 nm +/- 9 nm (within +/- 5% tolerance) at nominal e-beam dose; Line Width Roughness (LWR 3-sigma) <= 6.5 nm; measurement repeatability 3-sigma <= 1.2 nm across 5 consecutive non-destructive runs.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-2-3-02` | **EBDW Process Window and Exposure Latitude (EL) / Depth of Focus (DOF) Extraction** | Metrology Data Analysis Suite (KLA Klarity ProDATA or equivalent offline analysis engine) linked with CD-SEM output database. | 1. Import multi-die FEM CD measurements across focus offsets (-300 nm to +300 nm) and dose variations. 2. Fit raw CD data to second-order polynomial Bossung curves for both isolated gate and dense DRAM cell gate structures. 3. Construct the overlapping Exposure-Defocus (E-D) window considering a +/- 10% CD specification (162 nm to 198 nm). 4. Calculate maximum Exposure Latitude (EL %) at zero defocus and Depth of Focus (DOF um) at 10% EL. 5. Extract iso-dense bias across the operational window. | `Depth of Focus (DOF) >= 250 nm at >= 10% Exposure Latitude (EL) for both isolated and dense 180nm features; Overlapping process window area >= 15% across the full array; Iso-dense bias <= 8.0 nm across nominal operating envelope.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-static safety glasses with side shields, Full static-dissipative cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood and ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For chemical contact from solvent wipes: Flush eyes or skin immediately with copious cleanroom DI water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, relocate victim to fresh air. For high-voltage interlock exposure or electrical shock from SEM column components: Disconnect main power breaker immediately, administer CPR if pulse is absent, and call emergency response.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom laminar air flow (recirculated HEPA/ULPA, 0.45 m/s face velocity). CD-SEM vacuum chamber roughing pumps must be vented directly to dedicated industrial solvent/acid scrubber exhaust lines outside the fab envelope.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent-contaminated wipes used in loadlock maintenance must be segregated in dedicated sealed, flame-resistant hazardous solvent bins. Effluent pump oils and cleaning solvents must be collected for disposal as hazardous organic waste under RCRA guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI/SEMI-C1) | `99.9%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH, residual)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade | `<= 2.38%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-development, post-bake (hardbake 110 deg C) patterned e-beam resist on 180nm polysilicon / 3.5nm gate oxide stack; clean, dry, residue-free surface.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: SEM-inspected patterned resist surface with minimal electron radiation damage; ready for pre-etch ash descum or polysilicon gate RIE etch chamber load.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding atmospheric queue time causes absorption of airborne basic amines and moisture, resulting in resist line-edge T-topping, foot swelling, and post-develop oxidation of the polysilicon surface leading to micromasking during subsequent poly RIE.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full CD-SEM dimensional qualification and focus-exposure process window characterization of the 180nm polysilicon gate level patterned via electron beam direct write. Establishes the verified baseline dose and focus envelope meeting open-source DRAM cell pitch and isolated transistor gate requirements prior to reactive ion etch transfer.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `EBDW_180nm_Gate_Poly_CDSEM_Matrix_RawData.csv`
- [ ] `EBDW_Gate_Process_Window_Bossung_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `HighRes_Representative_Gate_Poly_Profiles.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Nominal isolated gate critical dimension at center dose/focus** | `180.0 nm` | +/- 9.0 nm | In-line CD-SEM 50% threshold algorithm across 9 central die locations |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Overlapping Depth of Focus (DOF) at 10% Exposure Latitude** | `>= 300 nm` | -50 nm lower bound limit | Bossung curve fitting and process window extraction via metrology analysis software |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Line Width Roughness (LWR, 3-sigma) for dense 180nm poly lines** | `<= 6.0 nm` | +0.5 nm upper bound limit | Automated high-magnification CD-SEM multi-segment contour analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> CD-SEM measurement data successfully exported with 100% target pattern recognition, showing an overlapping process window >= 250 nm DOF at >= 10% EL with isolated and dense 180nm gate lines within +/- 5% CD tolerance, signed off by Metrology Lead and Lithography Process Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure: CD-SEM Automated Metrology and Line-Edge Roughness Evaluation for 180nm Poly Gates

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated CD-SEM recipe execution across the 200mm wafer array must decouple e-beam electrostatic wafer charging and hydrocarbon beam-induced contamination from true poly gate critical dimension bias. The measurement integration algorithm must utilize a standardized derivative-based threshold (50% or maximum derivative) on secondary electron (SE) intensity profiles, ensuring that post-EBDW develop resist profiles and etched polysilicon gate profiles do not drift due to electron dose shrinkage during repeated multi-site autofocus routines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Line-Edge Roughness (LER) and Line-Width Roughness (LWR) extraction at 180nm drawn gate lengths (target 180nm / 150nm minimum gate length) requires spatial frequency analysis using power spectral density (PSD). The CD-SEM algorithm must sample edge points along gate segments with an inspection length L >= 2 um at a pixel pitch <= 1.0 nm to separate high-frequency white noise from low-frequency roughness (correlation length xi ~ 15-30 nm), ensuring unbiasing of the 3-sigma LER/LWR values against gate oxide breakdown and off-state transistor leakage variability.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-source dependency on specialized critical dimension calibration standards (such as NIST-traceable single-crystal silicon pitch standards STS/MRS-4) and ultra-high-resolution ZrO/W Schottky field-emission electron sources introduces substantial lead-time exposure (16-24 weeks). A secondary qualified supplier for certified magnification standards and wafer-level SEM pitch reference targets must be maintained to avoid stalling DRAM pilot-line wafer qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Automated metrology execution cannot become a cycle-time bottleneck for EBDW dose matrix iterations. Wafer-level inspection schemes must balance sampling density (minimum 9-die cross-wafer map, 5 DRAM cell poly gate targets per die) with throughput constraints (< 45 minutes per wafer including pattern recognition, global alignment, autofocus, and LER unbiasing) to satisfy the downstream Q-time gating into reactive ion etching.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Electron-beam charging-induced pattern distortion causing artificial edge displacement and false CD shift exceeding +/- 8 nm during automated edge detection.
1. Hydrocarbon deposition (carbon contamination) and resist line shrinkage during repetitive beam exposure on HSQ/ZEP520A/chemically amplified resist (CAR) leading to unrecoverable critical dimension measurement skew.
1. Loss of pattern recognition fiducial lock due to low contrast between undeveloped/developed poly layers and underlying 3.5 nm gate dielectric, triggering automated aborts or measurement on wrong dummy array lines.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-01` | **Automated Poly Gate Critical Dimension (CD) Mean and Uniformity Verification** | Automated Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) equipped with Schottky FE source, 500V landing energy, 8.0 pA beam current, laser-interferometric wafer stage, and certified pitch calibration standard. | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM vacuum loadlock and transfer to the electrostatic chuck chamber. 2. Execute global 2-point optical/SE wafer alignment using dedicated kerf alignment marks. 3. Run automated navigation across a 9-die wafer distribution map (center, top, bottom, left, right, and 4 corner coordinates). 4. At each die location, engage automated autofocus and pattern recognition to lock onto the isolated and dense 180nm DRAM access transistor poly gate test structures. 5. Acquire 512x512 secondary electron line scan images at 150kX magnification using 16-frame averaging with scan line rotation orthogonal to gate line. 6. Extract bottom CD width using standardized 50% threshold algorithm across an inspection box window of 1.0 um length. 7. Log mean CD, 3-sigma across-wafer variation, and export raw SEM line profiles. | `Mean Critical Dimension (CD) across all 9 dies must be 180.0 nm +/- 5.0 nm (175.0 nm to 185.0 nm); 3-sigma across-wafer CD variation must be <= 5.4 nm (<= 3.0% of nominal CD); automated pattern recognition success rate >= 98%.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-02` | **Line-Edge Roughness (LER) and Line-Width Roughness (LWR) Unbiased PSD Evaluation** | High-Resolution CD-SEM offline image processing terminal running unbiased Power Spectral Density (PSD) edge-detection software with pixel size <= 0.8 nm/pixel. | 1. Import raw calibrated 16-bit uncompressed CD-SEM image data from 5 dedicated DRAM cell test fields per wafer. 2. Define left and right line edge regions of interest (ROI) along a continuous 2.0 um gate length segment. 3. Execute multi-threshold edge localization algorithm to determine left edge coordinates x_L(y) and right edge coordinates x_R(y) at 1.0 nm vertical sampling intervals. 4. Calculate local linewidth w(y) = x_R(y) - x_L(y). 5. Compute spatial autocorrelation function and one-dimensional Power Spectral Density (PSD) via fast Fourier transform (FFT) for x_L(y), x_R(y), and w(y). 6. Apply high-frequency noise subtraction to decouple SEM instrument image noise floor from intrinsic line roughness. 7. Extract unbiased 3-sigma LER, unbiased 3-sigma LWR, and correlation length (xi). | `Unbiased 3-sigma Line-Edge Roughness (LER) must be <= 4.5 nm; unbiased 3-sigma Line-Width Roughness (LWR) must be <= 6.0 nm; correlation length xi must be between 15 nm and 35 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom bunny suit with hood and boot covers, Isopropanol-resistant chemical apron during chamber maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with clean water at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open; seek ophthalmic medical evaluation. Skin Contact: Remove contaminated cleanroom garments, wash skin thoroughly with non-abrasive soap and water. Inhalation (VOC/Asphyxiant): Move victim to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing is labored; call emergency medical dispatch. High-Voltage/X-ray Electrical Shock: De-energize high-voltage interlocks (500V-30kV column supplies) before touching victim; perform CPR if pulse is absent.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom Class 100 vertical laminar flow (> 0.45 m/s face velocity); tool dry scroll/turbomolecular pump foreline exhaust ducted directly to acid/solvent scrubber exhaust header (> 50 Pa negative draft); ambient oxygen depletion monitoring sensors set with alarm threshold at 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipe materials collected in FM-approved, self-closing dedicated solvent waste containers with flame arrestors; liquid solvent effluent stored in dedicated flammable carboys labeled according to RCRA hazardous solvent waste regulations; zero drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, semiconductor grade for chamber/stage wipe)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 (VLSI/Electronic grade > 99.9%) | `100.0%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (purge/vent gas)** | `7727-37-9` | UHP Grade 5.5 (99.9995%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly developed post-EBDW photoresist on polysilicon/gate dielectric stack, thoroughly DI-rinsed, spin-dried, and hard-baked (110°C, 60s) with zero liquid or organic puddle residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: SEM-inspected wafer free of electrostatic surface charge and hydrocarbon contamination spots; ready for immediate loadlock pumpdown into poly reactive ion etching (RIE) cluster tool.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient cleanroom air queue time causes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (amines and organic volatiles) onto resist sidewalls, atmospheric moisture condensation, and resist profile deformation/footing, leading to critical dimension shift > 10 nm and catastrophic gate line collapse or bridging during poly etch.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full wafer-level automated CD-SEM inspection and line-edge roughness characterization completed across a 9-die sampling grid for 180nm DRAM polysilicon access gates. Complete extraction of mean gate length, 3-sigma across-wafer CD variation, unbiased 3-sigma LER, and unbiased 3-sigma LWR validating the EBDW proximity effect correction and dose matrix calibration.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `WP213_Calibrated_PolyGate_Micrographs_150kX.tiff`

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean Critical Dimension of 180nm Poly Gate** | `180.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Automated 50% threshold secondary electron intensity profile extraction across 9 dies (45 sites total) on calibrated CD-SEM. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Across-Wafer 3-Sigma Critical Dimension Uniformity (CDU)** | `4.8 nm` | <= 5.4 nm | Statistical 3-sigma standard deviation calculation across all 45 automated measurement sites per wafer. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Unbiased Line-Edge Roughness (LER 3-sigma)** | `3.8 nm` | <= 4.5 nm | High-frequency noise-subtracted Power Spectral Density (PSD) analysis along 2.0 um gate evaluation length. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit approval requires 100% automated measurement completion across all 9 wafer map dies with pattern recognition success >= 98%, mean poly gate CD within 175.0-185.0 nm, CDU 3-sigma <= 5.4 nm, unbiased 3-sigma LER <= 4.5 nm, and formal delivery of signed CSV wafer map data and PDF PSD analysis report to the downstream Poly Gate RIE working group prior to Q-time expiration.

critics.systems_engineer: Automated CD-SEM recipe execution across the 200mm wafer array must decouple e-beam electrostatic wafer charging and hydrocarbon beam-induced contamination from true poly gate critical dimension bias. The measurement integration algorithm must utilize a standardized derivative-based threshold (50% or maximum derivative) on secondary electron (SE) intensity profiles, ensuring that post-EBDW develop resist profiles and etched polysilicon gate profiles do not drift due to electron dose shrinkage during repeated multi-site autofocus routines.
critics.domain_expert: Line-Edge Roughness (LER) and Line-Width Roughness (LWR) extraction at 180nm drawn gate lengths (target 180nm / 150nm minimum gate length) requires spatial frequency analysis using power spectral density (PSD). The CD-SEM algorithm must sample edge points along gate segments with an inspection length L >= 2 um at a pixel pitch <= 1.0 nm to separate high-frequency white noise from low-frequency roughness (correlation length xi ~ 15-30 nm), ensuring unbiasing of the 3-sigma LER/LWR values against gate oxide breakdown and off-state transistor leakage variability.
critics.supply_chain: Single-source dependency on specialized critical dimension calibration standards (such as NIST-traceable single-crystal silicon pitch standards STS/MRS-4) and ultra-high-resolution ZrO/W Schottky field-emission electron sources introduces substantial lead-time exposure (16-24 weeks). A secondary qualified supplier for certified magnification standards and wafer-level SEM pitch reference targets must be maintained to avoid stalling DRAM pilot-line wafer qualification.
critics.laya_pm: Automated metrology execution cannot become a cycle-time bottleneck for EBDW dose matrix iterations. Wafer-level inspection schemes must balance sampling density (minimum 9-die cross-wafer map, 5 DRAM cell poly gate targets per die) with throughput constraints (< 45 minutes per wafer including pattern recognition, global alignment, autofocus, and LER unbiasing) to satisfy the downstream Q-time gating into reactive ion etching.
critical_failure_modes: Electron-beam charging-induced pattern distortion causing artificial edge displacement and false CD shift exceeding +/- 8 nm during automated edge detection.

Hydrocarbon deposition (carbon contamination) and resist line shrinkage during repetitive beam exposure on HSQ/ZEP520A/chemically amplified resist (CAR) leading to unrecoverable critical dimension measurement skew.

Loss of pattern recognition fiducial lock due to low contrast between undeveloped/developed poly layers and underlying 3.5 nm gate dielectric, triggering automated aborts or measurement on wrong dummy array lines.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## CD-SEM Automated Measurement Recipe Programming and Pattern Recognition Setup

- **Document ID**: `SOP-MET-CDSEM-180NM-001`
- **Revision**: 1.0 (Gen 3 / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Node)
- **Module**: Metrology & Defect Inspection / Photolithography Gate Verification
- **Captured Knowledge Document**: [`cd_sem_recipe_setup.md`](./docs/knowledge/cd_sem_recipe_setup.md)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Recipe Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Wafer Loading &     │
│    Global Alignment    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Die Navigation &    │
│  Template PR Training  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  AF Autofocus & Beam   │
│    Stig Calibration    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  ROI Setup for 180nm   │
│      Gate & Pitch      │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Multi-Site Automated  │
│    Run & Screening     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Wafer Loading & Coordinate System Initialization
1. Load the 180nm post-exposure / post-etch polysilicon patterned wafer into the loadlock; pump chamber to high vacuum ($< 1 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).
2. Perform macro optical flat/notch global alignment to calibrate wafer center offset ($X_0, Y_0$) and rotation angle ($\theta$).
3. Set the coordinate placement grid resolution to **$0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$)** matching the physical manufacturing grid.

#### Step 2: Electron Optical Column & Beam Condition Setup
1. Set beam acceleration voltage ($V_{\text{acc}}$) to **$500\text{--}800\text{ V}$** (low landing energy) with probe current $I_p \le 8\text{ pA}$ to eliminate photoresist charging and gate pattern shrinkage.
2. Select working distance (WD) at **$3.0\text{ mm} \pm 0.2\text{ mm}$**.
3. Perform dynamic stigmate calibration and automated laser height-sensing autofocus (AF) on dedicated sacrificial off-array alignment marks.

#### Step 3: Hierarchical Pattern Recognition (PR) Template Programming
1. **Coarse PR (Low Magnification, $2,000\times\text{--}5,000\times$):** Register the outer edge of the DRAM memory array boundary block. Set template matching window to $\pm 10\ \mu\text{m}$ with a normalized cross-correlation (NCC) acceptance score threshold $\ge 0.85$.
2. **Fine PR (High Magnification, $50,000\times\text{--}100,000\times$):** Register the unique unit cell topology around the access transistor active diffusion ($W = 220\text{ nm}$) and poly gate junction. Configure search capture window to $\pm 100\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 4: Region of Interest (ROI) & Edge Detection Algorithm Configuration
1. Position the measurement box (ROI) across the DRAM access transistor poly gate line over active diffusion:
   - Line width evaluation length: along the access transistor active channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Nominal target length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (or $150\text{ nm}$ minimum gate length limit).
2. Set adjacent poly gate line-to-line spacing measurement cursor to measure pitch with minimum spacing of **$0.21\ \mu\text{m}$ ($210\text{ nm}$)**.
3. Configure the edge detection algorithm using **Threshold Maximum Slope (50% secondary electron peak intensity)** across 32 integrated horizontal scan lines.
4. Enable Line-Edge Roughness (LER) / Line-Width Roughness (LWR) filtering over the gate line segment.

#### Step 5: Multi-Site Execution & Automated Screening
1. Program wafer sampling map: 9 standard sites per wafer (center, 4 mid-radius, 4 edge die) across array cells and peripheral test macros.
2. Activate auto-abort threshold: Flag and skip measurement site if correlation score drops below $0.80$ or if gate-to-diffusion overlay exceeds permissible tolerance.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                    180nm DRAM Metrology Targets (nm)   
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░                                   │
Max LER (3-sigma)┤░░                                   │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                              │
Overlay Gate/Diff┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                              │
 CD Spacing Pitch┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     Gate CD Mean┤████████████████████████████████     │
                 │████████████████████████████████     │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0.0     52.5     105.0    157.5  210.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition / Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate CD Mean** | **$180.0 \pm 10.0$** (Min drawn limit: $\ge 150.0$) | $\text{nm}$ | Measured over active diffusion width ($W = 220\text{ nm}$) |
| **Minimum Poly Gate Spacing (Pitch)** | **$\ge 210.0$** ($0.21\ \mu\text{m}$) | $\text{nm}$ | Edge-to-edge space between adjacent wordlines/gates |
| **Gate Poly to Active Overlay Error** | **$\le 35.0$** | $\text{nm}$ | Maximum permissible displacement budget |
| **Grid Placement Fidelity & Repeatability** | **$\le 5.0$** ($0.005\ \mu\text{m}$) | $\text{nm}$ | $3\sigma$ measurement repeatability across physical grid |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Folded bitline architecture with shared bitline contacts between adjacent memory cells.
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Manufacturing physical grid resolution: $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum drawn poly gate length: $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum poly gate spacing: $0.21\ \mu\text{m}$ ($210\text{ nm}$).
  - Overlay error budget between gate poly and active diffusion: $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - Macro-alignment, spin-coat resist baseline, and optical alignment tolerance evolution (Gen 1 $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ down to Gen 2 $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pattern recognition (PR) template stability across multiple dies depends critically on macroscopic wafer global coordinate registration vs local SEM field-of-view (FOV) distortion. The hierarchy specifies EBDW written poly gates where stitching boundaries and proximity effect dose gradients create subtle contrast shifts; optical alignment marks must tie seamlessly into secondary electron yield contrast targets without charging-induced FOV drift (>2 nm/min beam deflection).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm polysilicon gate metrology, electron beam landing energy must be restricted to 500 eV to 800 eV with beam currents below 10 pA to prevent gate dielectric breakdown and resist shrinkage during autofocus/PR sweeps. Line-edge roughness (LER) algorithm setups must use 16-frame averaging with sub-pixel edge thresholding (50% maximum slope) to distinguish true physical gate topography from carbonaceous beam-induced contamination artifacts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: CD-SEM calibration pitch standards (e.g., MRS-4 or calibrated VLSI 100nm/200nm silicon pitch standards with NIST-traceable certificates) face long lead times and high vendor-lock costs. Automated wafer exchange handler cassettes must maintain compatibility with both full 200mm wafers and diced coupon holders without requiring proprietary vacuum load-lock retrofits.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Recipe creation throughput must be tightly scheduled: manual FOV hunting and pattern recognition failure handling during unattended 25-point wafer mapping could blow out queue-time windows prior to poly etch. Metrology gate sign-off must yield verifiable line-width results within a strict 6-hour cycle time per lot to prevent bottlenecks in the MPW tapeout loop.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Pattern Recognition Failure (PRF) caused by surface charging and contrast inversion on ungrounded isolated poly gate test structures, resulting in tool abort or false site measurements.
1. Electron-beam-induced carbon contamination and resist shrinkage on critical 180nm features during repeated recipe autofocus and measurement iterations, permanently distorting line profiles prior to subsequent RIE processing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-1-01` | **Automated Low-Dose Multi-Die Pattern Recognition Success Rate and Target Alignment Validation** | Automated Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) equipped with 500V-800V landing energy capability, laser interferometer stage, and dual-level hierarchical template matching algorithm. | 1. Load automated metrology recipe containing hierarchical global-to-local search vectors (50 µm optical-equivalent FOV down to 1.5 µm CD-SEM FOV). 2. Execute automated navigation and pattern recognition across 25 predetermined die sites across the wafer without operator intervention. 3. Record pattern match correlation scores, stage settling times, and beam placement center offsets across all 25 sites. | `Pattern recognition success rate >= 98% (>= 24/25 sites locked without human intervention); pattern match correlation score >= 0.85; automated beam FOV center displacement <= 15 nm from nominal coordinate center.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-1-02` | **180nm Poly Gate Critical Dimension Measurement Repeatability and Line Shrinkage Limit Test** | CD-SEM automated metrology station with line-scan profile analysis software, integrated Faraday cup for beam current verification, and calibrated NIST-traceable pitch standard. | 1. Execute automated single-point CD measurement recipe on target 180nm nominal poly gate line. 2. Repeat automated measurement sequence 10 consecutive times on the identical physical feature without stage movement. 3. Extract 10-run mean CD, 3-sigma measurement variation, and delta CD between Run 1 and Run 10 to quantify e-beam induced resist shrinkage/contamination. | `Dynamic measurement precision 3-sigma <= 1.5 nm; e-beam induced dimensional shrinkage/growth (Delta CD = |Run 10 - Run 1|) <= 1.8 nm over 10 repeated exposures.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Full static-dissipative ESD cleanroom gown, hood, and conductive shoe covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For isopropanol inhalation: Move subject to fresh air immediately. For skin contact: Flush skin thoroughly with DI water for 15 minutes. For eye splash: Irrigate eyes at eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Seek medical attention if irritation persists. High-voltage interlock emergency shut-off must be triggered immediately if vacuum chamber enclosure breaches during operation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom ISO 5 recirculating laminar air flow; CD-SEM load-lock roughing pump and dry scroll exhaust tied directly to dedicated scrubbed VOC/acid fab exhaust duct (> 50 CFM negative pressure exhaust).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes sealed in dedicated fire-rated flammable solvent waste bins with airtight spring-loaded lids; empty solvent canisters grounded and disposed of via hazardous solvent treatment stream.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (cleanroom chamber/load-lock wipe down)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (sample venting and stage purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (Grade 5.0) | `>= 99.999%` |

- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-lithography developed and soft-baked electron-beam resist patterned over 180nm polysilicon/gate oxide stack, dry and free of residual developer, solvent films, or micro-bridging.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Throughput Poly Gate CD Metrology and Wafer-Level Uniformity Mapping

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-POLY-007`  
**Classification:** Technical / Metrology & Inline Process Control  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN / SkyWater SKY130 MPW Compatible)  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type:** Buy  

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Recipe & Die Map   │
│        Setup         │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Automated Die     │
│  Stepping & Dynamic  │
│        Focus         │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Multivariate CD    │
│      Extraction      │
│└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│     Wafer-Level      │
│   Uniformity & SPC   │
│        Gating        │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Automated Wafer Alignment & Coordinate Registration
1. Load patterned poly gate 200mm/300mm wafer into high-throughput automated Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) FOUP load port.
2. Initialize global wafer alignment using standard optical pre-alignment followed by automated high-contrast pattern recognition on primary global alignment fiducials.
3. Align coordinate grid system to SkyWater SKY130 manufacturing grid resolution of **0.005 µm (5 nm)**. Verify that stage positioning jitter remains $< 2.0\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 2: Automated Sampling Plan & Die-Stepping Configuration
1. Program a high-throughput 49-site or 81-site wafer-level sampling map spanning Center, Mid-Radius, and Edge zones (with edge-exclusion $= 3\text{ mm}$).
2. For each sampled die, define automated measurement locations across:
   - **DRAM Cell Array:** Access transistor wordline gates within the $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ folded bitline cell matrix.
   - **Periphery CMOS Logic:** Minimum drawn poly gate length regions.
   - **Poly-Active Intersection:** Overlap sites between gate poly and active diffusion areas.

#### Step 3: Low-Dose Dynamic Beam Setup & Focus Stabilization
1. Set CD-SEM primary electron beam acceleration voltage ($V_{\text{acc}}$) between $300\text{ V} - 500\text{ V}$ and beam current between $8\text{ pA} - 15\text{ pA}$ to eliminate resist/poly charging and minimize beam shrinkage.
2. Enable continuous optical/laser autofocus combined with dynamic secondary electron focus tracking at each die coordinate prior to frame integration.
3. Acquire images using fast line-scan averaging (16 to 32 frame integration cycles) over a calibrated $1.0\text{ µm} \times 1.0\text{ µm}$ field-of-view (FOV).

#### Step 4: Line Profile Extraction & Feature Measurement
1. Execute multi-threshold edge detection (50% threshold algorithm) along the normalized secondary electron intensity profile across the polysilicon feature edges.
2. Extract critical dimensions:
   - **Memory Array Access Transistor:** Measure nominal wordline poly gate length target $L = 180\text{ nm}$ across the dense array pitch ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - **Periphery Gate Logic:** Measure minimum drawn poly gate length target of $150\text{ nm}$ ($0.15\text{ µm}$) and verify adjacent poly spacing ($\ge 0.21\text{ µm}$).
   - **Active Diffusion Width:** Extract underlying active width target of $220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\text{ µm}$) in cell array and minimum $150\text{ nm}$ ($0.15\text{ µm}$) in logic.
   - **Overlay Residual Vector:** Quantify poly-to-active layer displacement $(\Delta X, \Delta Y)$ at dedicated optical/SEM vernier test structures.

#### Step 5: Wafer-Level Uniformity Mapping & SPC Lot Gating
1. Aggregate CD measurements across all sites and compute the wafer-level mean ($\mu$), standard deviation ($\sigma$), range ($3\sigma$), and full wafer CD uniformity percentage:
   $$\text{CDU} = \frac{3\sigma}{\mu_{\text{CD}}} \times 100\%$$
2. Construct full-wafer contour maps (radial vs. azimuthal variations) to detect across-wafer spatial signatures (e.g., center-to-edge falloff from etch loading or EBDW proximity dosage gradients).
3. If measured metrics meet all Acceptance Criteria, route wafer forward to Poly Gate RIE Etch / Source-Drain Implantation; otherwise, trigger engineering review or resist rework.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░░░                             │
 Overlay Residual┤░░░░░░░░                             │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒      │
Active Diff Width┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒      │
Peri Poly Gate CD┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓      │
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓      │
Array Wordline CD┤█████████████████████████████████████│
                 │█████████████████████████████████████│
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       45       90       135     180 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Exact Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Access Transistor Gate Length ($L_{\text{array}}$)** | `180` | $\pm 10\%$ ($162 - 198$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Periphery Minimum Poly Gate Length ($L_{\text{peri}}$)** | `150` | $\pm 10\%$ ($135 - 165$) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Wafer-Level Poly Gate CD Uniformity ($3\sigma / \mu$)** | $\le 8.0$ | Max $\le 10.0$ | $\%$ |
| **Poly Gate to Active Diffusion Overlay Error ($|\vec{\Delta}|$)** | $\le 20.0$ | Max $\le 35.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

1. **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
   - Physical placement grid resolution: **$0.005\text{ µm}$ ($5\text{ nm}$)**.
   - Minimum poly gate length: **$0.15\text{ µm}$ ($150\text{ nm}$)**; minimum poly gate spacing: **$0.21\text{ µm}$**.
   - Minimum active diffusion width: **$0.15\text{ µm}$ ($150\text{ nm}$)**.
   - Overlay error budget between gate poly and active diffusion: **$\le 35\text{ nm}$**.
   - DUV exposure: $\lambda = 248\text{ nm}$, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$, minimum resolvable half-pitch: **$152\text{ nm}$**.

2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - 180nm $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline unit cell access transistor channel length: **$L = 180\text{ nm}$**, width: **$W = 220\text{ nm}$**.
   - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target: **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$**.

3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
   - Cell architecture pitch: Wordline and bitline pitch of **$360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$**.
   - Stacked capacitor target capacitance: **$25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ per cell** for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Gate dielectric physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated high-throughput CD-SEM mapping across a 200mm wafer generates multi-gigabyte coordinate datasets and image streams. The system architecture must guarantee real-time pattern recognition lock at 180nm poly pitches (minimum 210nm space) without beam-induced charging distortions. Calibration drift between the 49-point wafer grid inspection sites must be actively compensated through automated pitch-standard recalibration every 5 wafers to prevent artificial radial CD gradients.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct-write e-beam resist (HSQ or chemically amplified resists like UV6/ZEP520A) exhibits severe electron-beam proximity effects and post-exposure shrinkage during CD-SEM inspection. The CD-SEM recipe must utilize low landing energy (<= 500 eV) and minimal dwell time (<= 100 ns/pixel) to mitigate beam-induced carbon deposition and resist slimming. For 180nm nominal poly gate length (with SKY130 150nm minimum gate length compatibility), across-chip and across-wafer CD variation (3-sigma) must remain within +/- 5nm (<= 3.3%) to ensure matched subthreshold swing and drive current across DRAM array pass-transistors and peripheral logic.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-source dependency on proprietary CD-SEM reference pitch standards (e.g., MRS-4 / VLSI pitch standards calibrated to NIST/METAS) presents a lead-time vulnerability. Furthermore, specialized ultra-high vacuum turbo molecular pumps and field-emission electron gun filament assemblies have lead times exceeding 26 weeks; spare field-emission source tips and certified calibration gratings must be dual-sourced or held in local safety stock.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Balancing measurement cycle time against spatial statistical significance is critical. A full 49-point wafer map with 5-site intra-die sampling yields 245 sites per wafer; at 12 seconds per site, metrology throughput falls below 1.2 wafers per hour (WPH). The metrology team must down-sample routine production monitor wafers to a stratified 25-point polar radial map (< 5 minutes per wafer) to prevent severe queue bottlenecking between post-develop inspection (ADI) and reactive-ion gate etch (AEI).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Electron beam-induced charging and resist slimming causing systematic measurement bias (> 8nm CD shrinkage) and false out-of-spec rejections.
1. Pattern-recognition navigation failure on non-repeating DRAM sense-amplifier periphery logic due to grain contrast noise in underlying gate dielectric/diffusion interfaces.
1. Misalignment of wafer coordinate system from notch/flat centering runout causing CD measurements to be sampled off-target in the active-to-poly contact overlap zone.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-2-01` | **49-Point Automated CD-SEM Wafer-Level Gate Uniformity and 3-Sigma Dispersion Mapping** | Automated Low-Voltage Critical Dimension SEM (Landing Energy: 500 V, Beam Current: 8 pA, Field Emission Source, Ultra-High Vacuum Chamber < 5e-7 Pa) calibrated against NIST-traceable 100nm pitch standard. | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM loadlock and pump down to operating vacuum (< 5e-4 Pa transition). 2. Align wafer using optical notch detection and 3-point high-contrast global alignment marks. 3. Navigate automatically to 49 predefined radial coordinate sites (9 center/inner, 16 mid-radius, 24 outer-edge with 3mm edge exclusion). 4. At each site, acquire secondary electron image of isolated and dense 180nm poly lines at 150,000x magnification using 500 eV landing energy with line-integration scan (16 frames, frame integration time 800ms). 5. Compute median critical dimension (CD) using 50% threshold algorithm across 2.0 um line length and calculate wafer-level mean CD, range, and 3-sigma standard deviation. | `Wafer mean poly gate CD must be 180.0 nm +/- 6.0 nm (174.0 nm to 186.0 nm); total across-wafer 3-sigma CD variation must be <= 7.2 nm (<= 4.0% of nominal CD); pattern recognition auto-lock success rate >= 98.0% (<= 1 fail per 49 sites).` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-2-02` | **CD-SEM Beam Shrinkage and Measurement Precision Repeatability Evaluation** | CD-SEM with automated multi-pass recipe execution, real-time beam position monitor, and edge-roughness analysis software package. | 1. Position beam at designated calibration die site containing nominal 180nm poly gate test structures. 2. Perform 10 consecutive measurement cycles at the exact same location with 0s delay to quantify electron-beam damage / resist slimming rate (nm/exposure). 3. Shift stage by 500 nm along line axis to fresh site and execute 20 dynamic reload/re-measurement repetitions with stage unclamp/reclamp cycles. 4. Calculate dynamic measurement repeatability (precision 3-sigma) and cumulative resist slimming slope. | `Dynamic 3-sigma measurement repeatability must be <= 1.2 nm; cumulative beam-induced CD slimming after 3 consecutive scans at single site must not exceed 2.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Bunny Suit with Hood, Nitrile Cleanroom Gloves (ESD-safe, powder-free, double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 Approved UV/Safety Glasses, Cleanroom ESD Safety Shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For IPA skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and flush skin with copius DI water for 15 minutes. For eye contact: Immediately flush eyes at cleanroom eye wash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. For Nitrogen asphyxiation hazard: Move victim immediately to fresh, well-ventilated air; initiate artificial respiration or oxygen administration if breathing is labored; seek immediate emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom laminar air flow (Class 100 / ISO 5) with recirculating HEPA/ULPA filtration. CD-SEM dry vacuum roughing pumps and loadlock vent systems ducted to dedicated solvent exhaust with negative static pressure >= 0.5 in. w.g. Ambient O2 room monitoring sensors calibrated with alarm thresholds set at 19.5% (warning) and 18.0% (evacuation).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent wipe waste and cleanroom swabs contaminated with IPA must be collected in grounded, self-closing dedicated solvent waste containers labeled with hazardous waste disposal placards and vented to cleanroom volatile organic chemical (VOC) exhaust. No liquid chemical effluent discharged to municipal drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen (Gas / Cryogenic Liquid boil-off for loadlock purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-EBDW exposure and aqueous develop (TMAH or solvent rinse), spin-dried, and post-develop hard-baked resist patterns over 180nm polysilicon/thin gate dielectric stack (free from moisture, scum, and visual particulate defects).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Inspected resist patterns cleared of electrostatic surface charge, non-crosslinked resist intact, ready for dry reactive ion etch (RIE) poly gate pattern transfer without carbon film accumulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess ambient air exposure beyond 60 minutes results in atmospheric airborne molecular contamination (AMC) absorption (amines and moisture uptake into resist), causing severe resist footing, CD swelling (> 10nm), and subsequent gate channel width variation post-etch.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> High-throughput automated CD-SEM wafer metrology protocol successfully deployed for 180nm poly gate patterning on 200mm wafers, delivering high-density 49-point wafer-level uniformity contour maps, across-wafer 3-sigma CD metrics, and validated resist slimming-compensated metrology recipes compliant with open-source DRAM peripheral and array specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `WP2132_CDSEM_LineEdge_Roughness_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `WP2132_Calibration_Pitch_Standard_Verification.tiff`

| `ASSERT-01` | **Wafer-level mean critical dimension of isolated 180nm poly gate lines across 49 measurement sites** | `180.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Automated CD-SEM algorithm at 50% image threshold over 49-point standard wafer map. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Wafer-level 3-sigma CD non-uniformity across full 200mm wafer (excluding 3mm edge)** | `6.0 nm` | <= 7.2 nm | Statistical population variance computation of the 49-site CD-SEM dataset. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dynamic gauge repeatability and reproducibility (GR&R) precision (3-sigma) of CD-SEM measurement tool** | `0.9 nm` | <= 1.2 nm | 20-cycle dynamic load-unload repeatability test on designated calibration die. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> The metrology work package is signed off when all 49 wafer sites are successfully acquired with 0 pattern-recognition failures, wafer-level mean CD is verified between 175.0 nm and 185.0 nm with 3-sigma dispersion <= 7.2 nm, dynamic gauge repeatability 3-sigma is <= 1.2 nm, and all deliverable CSV and contour map artifacts are archived to the process database.

nodes.sop_content:
An industrial Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been authored and documented in [`docs/sop_met_180_ler_lwr_psd_extraction.md`](./docs/sop_met_180_ler_lwr_psd_extraction.md).

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    High-Res CD-SEM     │
│   Image Acquisition    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Edge Detection &    │
│       Coordinate       │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Spatial Covariance &  │
│  FFT PSD Calculation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Metrology Parameter   │
│     Deconvolution      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **CD-SEM Automated High-Resolution Image Acquisition**:
   - Align the wafer to the memory cell array targeting 180nm polysilicon access gates ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, Wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Set low landing energy ($300\text{ eV} - 500\text{ eV}$) and low emission beam current ($8\text{ pA} - 12\text{ pA}$) to suppress resist shrinkage and charging.
   - Acquire secondary electron top-down images with field-of-view (FOV) scan length $\ge 2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ along the gate edge, matching the $5\text{ nm}$ ($0.005\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) physical grid resolution.

2. **Edge Detection and Fluctuation Digitization**:
   - Extract left edge $x_L(y)$ and right edge $x_R(y)$ coordinate profiles at vertical sampling step $\Delta y = 5\text{ nm}$.
   - Compute line width profile $W(y) = x_R(y) - x_L(y)$ verifying baseline gate width against minimum drawn gate specification ($\ge 150\text{ nm}$).
   - Apply 1st/2nd-order polynomial detrending to eliminate long-wavelength wafer-scale tilt and bow, yielding zero-mean fluctuation functions $\delta x(y)$ and $\delta W(y)$.

3. **Discrete FFT Power Spectral Density Extraction**:
   - Compute 1D Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) $\widetilde{\delta x}(f)$ over spatial frequencies $f \in [1/L_{\text{meas}}, 1/(2\Delta y)] = [0.0005\text{ nm}^{-1}, 0.1\text{ nm}^{-1}]$.
   - Calculate raw PSD:
     $$PSD(f) = \frac{1}{L_{\text{meas}}} |\widetilde{\delta x}(f)|^2$$
   - Average PSD spectra across $\ge 32$ parallel access gate scans to suppress stochastic noise.

4. **Palasantzas Model Fitting & SEM Noise Deconvolution**:
   - Fit averaged spectra to the Palasantzas roughness equation:
     $$PSD(f) = \frac{2 \sigma^2 \xi}{\left(1 + (2\pi f \xi)^2\right)^{\alpha + 0.5}} + N_{\text{SEM}}$$
   - Deconvolve white shot noise floor $N_{\text{SEM}}$ at high frequencies ($f > 0.05\text{ nm}^{-1}$) to isolate true process roughness parameters: correlation length $\xi$, roughness exponent $\alpha$, and unbiased $3\sigma_{\text{LER}} / 3\sigma_{\text{LWR}}$.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                       Physical Metrology Constraints   
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░                             │
  Overlay Budget (nm)┤░░░░                             │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Bitline/WL Pitch (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
       Grid Step (nm)┤▓                                │
                     │▓                                │
      Nominal CD (nm)┤█████████████████                │
                     │█████████████████                │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      90      180     270    360 
```

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Poly Gate CD ($\langle W \rangle$)** | $180 \pm 5.0$ (Minimum drawn gate: $\ge 150$) | $\text{nm}$ | Automated CD-SEM across access transistors |
| **Line-Width Roughness ($3\sigma_{\text{LWR}}$)** | $\le 5.0$ (Matching manufacturing grid step) | $\text{nm}$ | Deconvolved spatial integral $\sqrt{\int PSD(f) df}$ |
| **Line-Edge Roughness ($3\sigma_{\text{LER}}$)** | $\le 3.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Palasantzas fitted model root area |
| **Poly Gate to Diffusion Overlay Shift** | $\le 35$ | $\text{nm}$ | Optical/SEM overlay target displacement |
| **Array Wordline Pitch** | $360\text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | High-density DRAM array pitch verification |

---

### Literature Citations & Physical Reference Verification
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Placement grid step resolution: $0.005\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum drawn poly gate length: $0.15\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$); minimum poly gate spacing: $0.21\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.
  - Gate-to-active permissible overlay error: $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
  - DUV 248nm KrF lithography ($NA = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40 \rightarrow \text{half-pitch } 152\text{ nm}$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Leakage constraint: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ sub-threshold and junction leakage at 85°C.
  - Cell capacitance target: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ with high-k stack ($\kappa > 15$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric: $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - Cell retention threshold: $> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded bitline DRAM architecture (8F^2 cell area = 0.259 um^2), the access transistor gate length defines subthreshold leakage and retention time. High-frequency LER/LWR directly modulates the effective channel length (L_eff), leading to localized drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL) and threshold voltage (V_th) roll-off. Extracting the Power Spectral Density (PSD) is non-negotiable because standard 3-sigma LWR collapses high-, mid-, and low-frequency roughness into a single scalar, masking spatial roughness wavelengths (correlation length xi and roughness exponent alpha) that propagate into gate dielectric breakdown and cell-to-cell retention variance across the 256/512-cell bitline array.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: CD-SEM edge detection algorithms suffer from high-frequency SEM image noise (shot noise from secondary electron emission at low beam currents, e.g., 500 V, 8 pA). Without rigorous bias subtraction in the frequency domain, the white noise floor at high spatial frequencies (f > 1/(2*pixel_size)) artificially inflates the extracted unbiased LWR (LWR_unbiased = sqrt(3*sigma_raw^2 - 3*sigma_noise^2)). The PSD extraction protocol must fit the Palasantzas or modified Gaussian model across spatial frequencies from 1 um^-1 to 250 um^-1, extracting the zero-frequency PSD plateau PSD(0), correlation length xi, and Hurst roughness exponent alpha to decouple lithographic polymer aggregate effects from tool noise.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated high-throughput CD-SEM offline analysis tools (such as Fractilia MetroLER or ProSEM) require proprietary licensing, dedicated server clusters, and calibrated SEM recipe parameters. Delays in deploying automated image acquisition recipes or discrepancies between e-beam exposure tool vendors (e.g., Vistec/Raith EBDW) and CD-SEM image magnification calibration standards will bottleneck metrology turnaround time, idling downstream reactive-ion etch (RIE) pilot runs and consuming precious Q-time budgets.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology queue times represent critical dead-time in the 180nm MPW tapeout workflow. Wafer transit from the EBDW developer station to CD-SEM high-vacuum chamber must be strictly synchronized with wafer-level staging protocols. If offline PSD extraction takes >4 hours per test coupon or fails automated image quality thresholds (e.g., poor signal-to-noise ratio from insufficient frame integration), poly gate RIE dispatch will miss fab scheduling windows, delaying the gate-level milestone.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Noise floor under-subtraction or over-subtraction in CD-SEM PSD spectrum, resulting in unphysical negative PSD values or an artificial 15-25% overestimation of unbiased LWR.
1. Electron-beam induced resist shrinkage and hydrocarbon carbon contamination during repeated high-magnification CD-SEM scanning, permanently altering the resist line profile prior to poly RIE.
1. Alias folding of high-frequency roughness into low-frequency domains due to insufficient SEM pixel resolution (Nyquist frequency lower than polymer aggregate roughness frequency).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-3-01` | **Unbiased LWR PSD Extraction and Spatial Frequency Parameter Fitting** | Automated Low-Voltage Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM, 500 eV landing energy, 8 pA beam current) equipped with high-resolution frame-averaging (16 frames) and MetroLER/PSD analytical extraction engine. | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM vacuum loadlock (<5e-4 Pa) and navigate to the 180nm dense and isolated poly gate test arrays across 9 field locations (center, inner ring, outer ring). 2. Acquire top-down CD-SEM images at 150kX magnification, field of view 1.5 um x 1.5 um, 1024 x 1024 pixels (pixel size = 1.46 nm/pixel), utilizing 16-frame integration to maximize SE signal. 3. Detect line edges along gate lines using a 50% threshold derivative algorithm over a minimum line length of 1.2 um (evaluating >800 scan lines per feature). 4. Compute the 1D discrete line-width variation delta_W(y) and calculate the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) power spectral density PSD(f). 5. Subtract the white noise floor estimated from the high-frequency tail (f > 200 um^-1) to derive the unbiased PSD curve. 6. Fit the unbiased PSD to the Palasantzas model: PSD(f) = PSD(0) / (1 + (2*pi*f*xi)^2)^(1 + alpha), extracting PSD(0), correlation length xi, and roughness exponent alpha. | `Unbiased LWR (3-sigma) <= 5.4 nm (<= 3.0% of 180nm target CD); correlation length xi within 15 nm <= xi <= 35 nm; Hurst roughness exponent alpha >= 0.50; white noise floor subtraction residual error < 5%.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-1-3-3-02` | **SEM Electron Dose Shrinkage Impact on LER/LWR Stability** | Low-Voltage In-line CD-SEM with programmable beam exposure dosing and line-edge rough edge tracking software. | 1. Set electron beam acceleration to 500 V, probe current to 8 pA. 2. Perform consecutive automated scans (1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 passes) on the identical 180nm gate resist segment. 3. Measure nominal line width (CD), raw 3-sigma LER, raw 3-sigma LWR, and high-frequency noise floor for each pass. 4. Calculate the CD shrinkage rate delta_CD/pass and the differential shift in extracted correlation length xi and PSD(0) as a function of cumulative electron dose. | `Total line-width shrinkage after standard measurement pass (16 frame integration) <= 1.8 nm (< 1.0% of 180nm CD); shift in unbiased LWR between Pass 1 and standard recipe <= 0.4 nm; no visible hydrocarbon deposition or edge profile blistering.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive footwear, Non-shedding face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with residual solvent residues, wash affected area immediately with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. In case of vapor inhalation from open developer/solvent staging, immediately move the victim to fresh outdoor air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For eye contact, flush eyes at the emergency eyewash station for a minimum of 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open; seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: CD-SEM vacuum turbomolecular and roughing pump exhaust lines must be hard-ducted directly to the dedicated cleanroom VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) exhaust scrubber system. Loadlock venting areas must maintain minimum 0.5 m/s laminar airflow capture velocity with continuous clean dry air (CDA) / N2 purging.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Wafers containing organic e-beam resist are solid hazardous waste and must be collected in closed, antistatic solvent-rated disposal bins. Solvent cleaning wipes contaminated with trace anisole or IPA must be placed in sealed, designated flammable/VOC waste containers vented under an approved fume hood for high-temperature incineration by licensed hazardous materials handlers.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Developed, deionized water / solvent rinsed, and spin-dried e-beam resist (ZEP520A) lines on dry thermal gate oxide / polysilicon stack; free of standing moisture or post-develop scum.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: CD-SEM inspected, vacuum-desorbed resist patterns verified within CD and LWR limits; pristine surface ready for dry poly-silicon reactive-ion etching (RIE).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air exposure causes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (amines and organic siloxanes) onto patterned resist sidewalls, inducing resist footing, profile deformation, and uncalibrated etch rate retardation during poly gate RIE.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full wafer extraction of unbiased 1D Line-Edge Roughness (LER) and Line-Width Roughness (LWR) Power Spectral Density (PSD) on 180nm poly gate patterns across dense and isolated DRAM array test keys. The extracted metrics decouple CD-SEM measurement noise from intrinsic lithographic polymer roughness, confirming compliance with 180nm gate CD tolerances, low-frequency DIBL limits, and capacitance budget criteria prior to dry poly-Si reactive ion etching.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

| `ASSERT-03` | **Critical Dimension SEM measurement-induced shrinkage after standard inspection recipe** | `0.8 nm` | <= 1.8 nm | Pre- and post-inspection automated CD measurements comparing initial scan to 16-frame integrated final inspection. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

testcases.title: Unbiased LWR PSD Extraction and Spatial Frequency Parameter Fitting
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Low-Voltage Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM, 500 eV landing energy, 8 pA beam current) equipped with high-resolution frame-averaging (16 frames) and MetroLER/PSD analytical extraction engine.
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm poly gate lines patterned via EBDW in positive e-beam resist (ZEP520A or equivalent, 300nm thickness on 100nm poly-Si / 3.5nm SiO2 gate stack), post-exposure baked, developed, rinse-dried, and verified free of macroscopic pattern collapse or scumming.
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer into CD-SEM vacuum loadlock (<5e-4 Pa) and navigate to the 180nm dense and isolated poly gate test arrays across 9 field locations (center, inner ring, outer ring).
2. Acquire top-down CD-SEM images at 150kX magnification, field of view 1.5 um x 1.5 um, 1024 x 1024 pixels (pixel size = 1.46 nm/pixel), utilizing 16-frame integration to maximize SE signal.
3. Detect line edges along gate lines using a 50% threshold derivative algorithm over a minimum line length of 1.2 um (evaluating >800 scan lines per feature).
4. Compute the 1D discrete line-width variation delta_W(y) and calculate the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) power spectral density PSD(f).
5. Subtract the white noise floor estimated from the high-frequency tail (f > 200 um^-1) to derive the unbiased PSD curve.
6. Fit the unbiased PSD to the Palasantzas model: PSD(f) = PSD(0) / (1 + (2*pi*f*xi)^2)^(1 + alpha), extracting PSD(0), correlation length xi, and roughness exponent alpha.

testcases.procedure:
1. Set electron beam acceleration to 500 V, probe current to 8 pA.
2. Perform consecutive automated scans (1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 passes) on the identical 180nm gate resist segment.
3. Measure nominal line width (CD), raw 3-sigma LER, raw 3-sigma LWR, and high-frequency noise floor for each pass.
4. Calculate the CD shrinkage rate delta_CD/pass and the differential shift in extracted correlation length xi and PSD(0) as a function of cumulative electron dose.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total line-width shrinkage after standard measurement pass (16 frame integration) <= 1.8 nm (< 1.0% of 180nm CD); shift in unbiased LWR between Pass 1 and standard recipe <= 0.4 nm; no visible hydrocarbon deposition or edge profile blistering.

ppe_required: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (double-gloving)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses
Antistatic ESD-safe cleanroom coat and conductive footwear
Non-shedding face mask
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin contact with residual solvent residues, wash affected area immediately with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. In case of vapor inhalation from open developer/solvent staging, immediately move the victim to fresh outdoor air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For eye contact, flush eyes at the emergency eyewash station for a minimum of 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open; seek immediate ophthalmological evaluation.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: CD-SEM vacuum turbomolecular and roughing pump exhaust lines must be hard-ducted directly to the dedicated cleanroom VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) exhaust scrubber system. Loadlock venting areas must maintain minimum 0.5 m/s laminar airflow capture velocity with continuous clean dry air (CDA) / N2 purging.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Wafers containing organic e-beam resist are solid hazardous waste and must be collected in closed, antistatic solvent-rated disposal bins. Solvent cleaning wipes contaminated with trace anisole or IPA must be placed in sealed, designated flammable/VOC waste containers vented under an approved fume hood for high-temperature incineration by licensed hazardous materials handlers.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Developed, deionized water / solvent rinsed, and spin-dried e-beam resist (ZEP520A) lines on dry thermal gate oxide / polysilicon stack; free of standing moisture or post-develop scum.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: CD-SEM inspected, vacuum-desorbed resist patterns verified within CD and LWR limits; pristine surface ready for dry poly-silicon reactive-ion etching (RIE).
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding cleanroom air exposure causes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (amines and organic siloxanes) onto patterned resist sidewalls, inducing resist footing, profile deformation, and uncalibrated etch rate retardation during poly gate RIE.

expected_result.summary: Full wafer extraction of unbiased 1D Line-Edge Roughness (LER) and Line-Width Roughness (LWR) Power Spectral Density (PSD) on 180nm poly gate patterns across dense and isolated DRAM array test keys. The extracted metrics decouple CD-SEM measurement noise from intrinsic lithographic polymer roughness, confirming compliance with 180nm gate CD tolerances, low-frequency DIBL limits, and capacitance budget criteria prior to dry poly-Si reactive ion etching.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Unbiased 3-sigma Line-Width Roughness (LWR_unbiased) across dense 180nm gate lines
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Fast Fourier Transform PSD calculation with high-frequency SEM white noise floor subtraction on CD-SEM edge profiles (MetroLER/Fractilia methodology).

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Roughness spatial correlation length (xi) extracted from Palasantzas model fitting
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Nonlinear least-squares fitting of Palasantzas PSD model over spatial frequencies from 1 um^-1 to 200 um^-1.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Critical Dimension SEM measurement-induced shrinkage after standard inspection recipe
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Pre- and post-inspection automated CD measurements comparing initial scan to 16-frame integrated final inspection.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All 9 field locations exhibit unbiased LWR <= 5.4 nm, Palasantzas correlation length between 15 nm and 35 nm, and total inspection-induced gate CD shrinkage <= 1.8 nm, with quantitative verification signed off by the Metrology Engineer and approved by the Lithography Lead for immediate transfer to Poly-Si Gate RIE.
