nodes.sop_content:
### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-CDSEM-001`  
**Title:** In-line CD-SEM Multi-Site Gate Length and Line-Edge Roughness Metrology  
**Context Level:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip / SKY130 Lithography Grid Alignment)  
**Action Type:** Buy / In-line Metrology Inspection Recipe  

---

#### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Load & Vacuum   │
│         Degas          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Auto Global & Site   │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Multi-Site CD-SEM    │
│        Scanning        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  LER 3-Sigma Analysis  │
│      & SPC Check       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Load Lock Ingestion & Vacuum Stabilization:**
   - Transfer the post-EBDW/post-etch patterned wafer into the ultra-clean CD-SEM load lock chamber.
   - Pump down the specimen chamber to high vacuum ($P \le 5.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$) to prevent hydrocarbon deposition and secondary electron scattering.

2. **Electron Beam Conditioning & Optical Column Setup:**
   - Configure landing energy $V_{\text{acc}} = 500\text{ eV}$ (low-voltage mode to mitigate thin-film charging and photoresist shrinkage).
   - Set probe beam current $I_{\text{beam}} = 10\text{ pA} \pm 2\text{ pA}$ with automated aperture centering and stigmator correction on dedicated fiducial test pads.

3. **Global & Site Pattern Recognition Alignment:**
   - Perform coarse 2-point notch/flat alignment followed by global die alignment using primary lithography cross marks.
   - Execute fine pattern recognition (cognex template correlation $> 0.95$) referencing active diffusion boundaries on the $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) physical placement grid.

4. **Multi-Site DRAM Array Sampling Execution:**
   - Drive stage across a standard 9-site or 13-site full-wafer sampling map (Center, Inner Ring, Mid Ring, Outer Edge dies).
   - In each die, navigate to:
     - **Cell Array Access Transistor Site:** Wordline poly gate channel over active area ($W = 220\text{ nm}$).
     - **Drawn Test Structure Pitch Site:** Isolated-to-dense poly gate lines.

5. **High-Resolution Secondary Electron (SE) Line-Scan Acquisition:**
   - Scan a field of view (FOV) of $1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ at $150{,}000\times$ to $200{,}000\times$ magnification.
   - Acquire secondary electron emission profiles using a threshold-derivative algorithm (50% peak-to-peak threshold) across a $400\text{ nm}$ line length window.

6. **Automated LER and Spacing Extraction:**
   - Extract edge coordinate vectors $x_{\text{left}}(y)$ and $x_{\text{right}}(y)$ at $2\text{ nm}$ vertical step increments.
   - Calculate Line Width Roughness (LWR) and Line-Edge Roughness (LER) via $3\sigma$ standard deviation of edge displacement.
   - Measure minimum poly spacing to verify clearance against adjacent wordlines.

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │░░                             │
Target 3-Sigma LER (nm)┤░░                             │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒                         │
     Overlay Limit (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒                         │
  Min Poly Spacing (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
     Drawn Gate CD (nm)┤███████████████████████████    │
                       │███████████████████████████    │
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬───────┘
                       0.0    52.5   105.0   157.5      
```

| Metric Parameter | Machine Target | Tolerance / Specification Limit | Unit | Source Baseline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DRAM Access Gate CD ($L$)** | $180.0$ | $180.0 \pm 10.0$ (Must exceed PDK absolute min of $150.0$) | $\text{nm}$ | 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology / SKY130 PDK Rules |
| **Minimum Poly-to-Poly Spacing** | $\ge 210.0$ | $\ge 210.0$ (Process minimum clear margin) | $\text{nm}$ | SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules |
| **Poly-to-Active Overlay Error ($|\Delta X|, |\Delta Y|$)** | $\le 35.0$ | Maximum permissible vector offset $\le 35.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | SkyWater SKY130 Lithography Grid Rules |
| **High-Frequency Line-Edge Roughness ($3\sigma_{\text{LER}}$)** | $\le 8.0$ | Upper Control Limit $\le 10.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | EBDW Litho Budget & 180nm Array Uniformity |

---

#### 4. Context References & Literature Baseline
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
  - Physical manufacturing placement grid: $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum poly gate length physical boundary: $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum poly gate spacing: $0.21\ \mu\text{m}$ ($210\text{ nm}$).
  - Gate-to-active overlay error budget: $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel target length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Transistor channel dimensions ensure subthreshold leakage remains below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain cell refresh retention margin.

---

> [!NOTE]
> Micro-knowledge for this metrology procedure has been recorded in [docs/knowledge/in_line_cd_sem_metrology_sop.md](./docs/knowledge/in_line_cd_sem_metrology_sop.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In-line CD-SEM metrology directly introduces charging and e-beam-induced resist shrinkage/carbon deposition on delicate post-EBDW develop features. Without active charge-control (low landing energy <=500 eV) and dynamic field-of-view hopping, the measurement process itself perturbs the 180nm physical poly gate dimensions and introduces artificial CD shifts across repeat scans.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Accurate determination of Line-Edge Roughness (LER, 3-sigma) and Line-Width Roughness (LWR) on 180nm poly lines requires filtering high-frequency SEM noise via Power Spectral Density (PSD) analysis and unbiased threshold algorithms. Neglecting resist shrinkage during 16-frame averaging will artificially compress apparent gate lengths and bias poly etch bias compensation models.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-vendor reliance on high-brightness Schottky thermal field emission electron sources (ZrO/W emitters) and automated vacuum load-lock spare parts poses lead-time bottlenecks exceeding 16 weeks during high-uptime metrology screening.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Executing 49-site automated CD-SEM recipes adds significant cycle time per wafer (approx. 45-60 minutes), creating a potential bottleneck ahead of reactive ion etching (RIE) that threatens strict Q-time windows between post-exposure develop and poly etch.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Electron-beam induced chemical contraction and shrinkage of hydrogen silsesquioxane (HSQ) or chemically amplified resist (CAR) leading to >5nm CD measurement distortion.
1. Local dielectric charging on underlying gate oxide (3.5nm) causing beam deflection, astigmatic distortion, and false edge-detection threshold failures.
1. Hydrocarbon contamination deposition during prolonged scan dwell time altering physical sidewall slope and masking true LER/LWR.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-2-3-2-01` | **Automated Multi-Site Isolated and Dense Poly Gate CD Metrology** | Automated In-line High-Resolution CD-SEM (Cold/Schottky Field Emission, landing energy 300-500 eV, probe current 8-15 pA, 0.1nm measurement resolution) | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM load-lock and pump to <1e-6 Torr. 2. Align wafer globally using active diffusion zero-layer alignment marks. 3. Navigate automatically to 49 predefined die locations across the wafer spanning center, mid-radius, and edge. 4. Acquire SEM images at 150kX magnification using secondary electron detector with 300 eV landing energy and beam dwell time <=100 ns/pixel. 5. Apply 50% normalized threshold edge-detection to extract bottom CD for isolated (180nm) and dense (1:1.4 pitch) poly gate structures. 6. Export tabular CD metrics and wafer uniformity map. | `Mean gate length CD must be 180.0 nm +/- 5.0 nm (175.0 nm to 185.0 nm); 3-sigma within-wafer CD uniformity <= 6.0 nm; individual site measurement repeatability 3-sigma <= 0.8 nm.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-2-3-2-02` | **Line-Edge Roughness (LER) and Line-Width Roughness (LWR) PSD Extraction** | High-Resolution In-line CD-SEM equipped with off-line Image Processing and Power Spectral Density (PSD) metrology software package | 1. Ingest 16-frame integrated 8-bit uncompressed TIFF micrographs from 9 representative die locations. 2. Detect left and right edges along a 1.2 um evaluation length using maximum derivative thresholding. 3. Compute edge deviations delta_x(y) from fitted linear centerlines for both edges. 4. Calculate raw LER (3-sigma) and LWR (3-sigma). 5. Compute FFT Power Spectral Density curve and extract correlation length xi and roughness exponent alpha. 6. Apply unbiased noise subtraction to eliminate white SEM measurement noise. | `Unbiased Line-Edge Roughness (LER, 3-sigma) <= 4.5 nm; Line-Width Roughness (LWR, 3-sigma) <= 6.5 nm; correlation length xi >= 20.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 1/10 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), Polycarbonate UV/optical laser and impact-resistant safety glasses (ANSI Z87.1), Full static-dissipative cleanroom bunny suit with integrated hood and ESD boot covers, Particulate face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious gentle flow of clean water for at least 15 minutes; seek ophthalmologist review. Skin contact: Wash with mild soap and water; remove contaminated garments. Inhalation of inert purge gas (N2 displacement): Relocate casualty immediately to fresh ambient air; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing has ceased; call emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated vacuum roughing pump exhaust routed to facility solvent/VOC scrubber exhaust duct; dry turbo pump backing lines connected to negative pressure exhaust; local ambient oxygen deficiency monitoring sensors calibrated with alarm set at <19.5% O2 near SEM load-lock manifolds.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free wipe consumables sealed in dedicated airtight hazardous waste bins with grounded conductive liners; roughing pump oil waste collected in UN-rated steel containers for hazardous incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, 2-Propanol)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Semiconductor Grade (VLSI/ULSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2 Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, Grade 6.0) | `99.9999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Developed, rinsed, and hard-baked EBDW resist patterns over 3.5nm thermal gate oxide on Si substrate; hydrophobic surface free of standing DI water or developer pools.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: E-beam inspected resist features with verified CD and roughness; vacuum-degassed surface ready for immediate polysilicon reactive ion etching (RIE) or descum ash.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time induces airborne molecular contamination (AMC) including organic airborne amine chemisorption, leading to footing/scumming at resist base, moisture reabsorption causing swelling, and up to 8nm CD drift prior to etch.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful non-destructive multi-site CD-SEM verification of post-EBDW 180nm poly gate profiles across 49 die positions, confirming gate length within +/-5nm tolerance and line-edge roughness within sub-5nm threshold without destructive charging or resist degradation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `EBDW_POLY_GATE_CD_49PT_MAP.csv`
- [ ] `LER_LWR_PSD_ANALYSIS_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `REPRESENTATIVE_GATES_150KX_METROLOGY.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean isolated gate critical dimension across 49 wafer inspection sites matches target** | `180.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | In-line CD-SEM automated edge-detection threshold algorithm at 50% signal peak |
| `ASSERT-02` | **3-sigma Within-Wafer CD Uniformity (CDU) across all radial test zones** | `4.5 nm` | <= 6.0 nm | Statistical 3-sigma variance analysis from 49-site automated CD extraction map |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Unbiased Line-Edge Roughness (LER, 3-sigma) along 1.2 um poly gate inspection channel** | `3.8 nm` | <= 4.5 nm | High-frequency noise-subtracted Power Spectral Density (PSD) analysis on 150kX SEM image stack |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 49 inspection sites successfully measured with 0 site-recognition dropouts; mean isolated gate CD measures between 175.0 nm and 185.0 nm with CDU (3-sigma) <= 6.0 nm; unbiased LER <= 4.5 nm; zero visible beam-damage pitting or catastrophic resist collapse observed.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Poly-to-Active Box-in-Box Optical and SEM Overlay Vector Residual Analysis

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Wafer Load and     │
│  49-Point Map Setup   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Box-in-Box Target   │
│      Acquisition      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Vector Residual    │
│  Decomposition dX dY  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    High-Res CD-SEM    │
│     Verification      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Acceptance Check <=  │
│      35nm Budget      │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the automated optical and high-resolution CD-SEM metrology protocol for evaluating overlay displacement vectors ($\Delta X$, $\Delta Y$) between patterned polysilicon gate structures and underlying active diffusion regions. This validation ensures pattern registration fits within the maximum permissible overlay error budget for 180nm CMOS/DRAM integration.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Wafer Alignment & Metrology Setup**:
   - Load the patterned wafer following poly gate exposure onto the automated metrology stage.
   - Configure coordinate origin on the physical placement grid with a manufacturing grid resolution of **0.005 µm (5 nm)**.
   - Program an automated **49-point wafer mapping** routine to assess cross-wafer radial distribution and systematic field distortions.

2. **Optical Box-in-Box Acquisition**:
   - Locate scribe-line and test-cell Box-in-Box (BiB) overlay targets comprising an outer frame on active diffusion and an inner box patterned in gate polysilicon.
   - Image targets using broadband optical/reflectometric overlay tool optics; extract centerline offsets between active diffusion edges and polysilicon gate edges.

3. **Overlay Vector Residual Decomposition**:
   - Calculate raw overlay errors across all 49 measured sites:
     $$\Delta X = X_{\text{poly}} - X_{\text{diff}}, \quad \Delta Y = Y_{\text{poly}} - Y_{\text{diff}}$$
     $$\text{Total Overlay Vector Residual } R = \sqrt{(\Delta X)^2 + (\Delta Y)^2}$$
   - Model and subtract first-order systematic errors (translation, wafer scaling/expansion, wafer rotation, reticle magnification, reticle rotation) to isolate high-order vector residuals across the exposure field.

4. **High-Resolution CD-SEM Cross-Verification**:
   - Transfer wafer to the high-resolution CD-SEM metrology station.
   - Perform high-tilt/top-down CD-SEM verification directly over critical test structures (including target sub-micron transistors with nominal drawn gate dimensions: **$W / L = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} / 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$**, minimum gate length of **0.15 µm / 150 nm**, and minimum active diffusion width of **0.15 µm / 150 nm**).
   - Verify minimum poly gate spacing reaches at least **0.21 µm (210 nm)** without micro-bridging or edge placement run-out over active boundary steps.

```text
                                                        
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░          │
    Gate Length Min┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░          │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒          │
      Active Min CD┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒          │
  Poly Spacing Grid┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Overlay Error (Max)┤███████                            │
                   │███████                            │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0     52.5    105.0    157.5 210.0 
```

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Tool / Method | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Maximum Poly-to-Active Overlay Error** | Optical Box-in-Box & CD-SEM Vector Analysis | $\le 35$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Minimum Poly Gate Length ($L_{\text{poly}}$)** | In-line High-Resolution CD-SEM | $\ge 150$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Minimum Active Diffusion Width ($W_{\text{diff}}$)** | In-line High-Resolution CD-SEM | $\ge 150$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Minimum Poly-to-Poly Gate Spacing** | In-line High-Resolution CD-SEM | $\ge 210$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Physical Placement Grid Precision** | Tool Stage / Coordinate Alignment | $5$ ($0.005\ \mu\text{m}$) | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
- **[SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid](./docs/context.yaml)**:
  - *Manufacturing Grid*: $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - *Critical Dimensions*: Minimum active diffusion width $= 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$); minimum poly gate length $= 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$); minimum poly gate spacing $= 0.21\ \mu\text{m}$ ($210\text{ nm}$).
  - *Overlay Error Budget*: Maximum permissible overlay error between gate poly and active diffusion is $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology](./docs/context.yaml)**:
  - Wafer mapping automation utilizing standard 49-point wafer mapping routines for tracking cross-wafer non-uniformity.
- **[Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification](./docs/context.yaml)**:
  - Device layout dimensions verifying target sub-micron transistors ($W/L = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} / 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Residual overlay analysis between E-beam direct-write (EBDW) poly gate and optical DUV active diffusion requires decoupling systematic distortion terms (linear grid magnification, wafer expansion, and stage orthogonality) from localized higher-order thermal/charging residuals. Failure to filter out non-correctable tool-induced beam-drift vectors will corrupt the linear correction coefficient feed-forward model to the EBDW deflection system, leading to uncorrectable residual overlay variance exceeding the 35 nm 3-sigma gate overlay budget across the 180nm DRAM cell matrix.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Box-in-box (BiB) optical metrology suffers from apparent target asymmetry and optical proximity shifts due to sidewall angle variations between the recessed oxide/active STI trench edge and the dry-etched polysilicon border. High-voltage CD-SEM overlay vector verification at 800V landing energy is mandatory to calibrate optical tool-induced shift (TIS) and wafer-induced shift (WIS), ensuring that the reported optical vector residuals correlate with physical transistor gate-to-active overlap without charging-induced measurement distortion.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Qualification of calibrated box-in-box overlay standard targets and CD-SEM micro-pitch reference standards (NIST-traceable 100 nm pitch) faces long lead times (14 to 18 weeks) and high single-source dependency. Production recipes must implement dual-redundant target layouts (frame-in-frame alongside standard box-in-box) to prevent tool down-time or metrology stalls if optical target damage occurs during poly CMP or post-etch cleans.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The integration schedule depends strictly on a 45-minute closed-loop feedback window between EBDW exposure, post-exposure bake/develop inspection, and optical/SEM overlay sign-off prior to hardmask/poly etch. Metrology throughput must not bottleneck the MPW cycle; automated macro scripts for 49-point wafer mapping must execute within 12 minutes per wafer to maintain fab queue-time constraints and avoid photoresist baseline de-protection.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Charge-induced beam deflection during CD-SEM secondary electron acquisition yielding false overlay vector residuals on non-conductive gate oxide/poly test structures.
1. Tool-Induced Shift (TIS) calibration failure in optical BiB metrology caused by 180-degree tool orientation misalignment, leading to erroneous linear offset correction values.
1. Asymmetric poly grain scattering and edge roughness (LER/LWR) exceeding 6 nm along the target periphery, causing optical edge detection algorithm centroid miscalculation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-2-3-3-01` | **Automated 49-Point Optical Box-in-Box Overlay Vector Residual and Model Extraction** | Automated Optical Overlay Metrology Tool (Broadband Brightfield / DUV Spectroscopic Ellipsometric Overlay System) equipped with 0.90 NA objective and automated recipe loader. | 1. Load wafer onto automated stage and perform global alignment using wafer notch and primary active-layer fiducials. 2. Calibrate Tool-Induced Shift (TIS) by measuring the 0-degree and 180-degree target orientation on center and 4 peripheral dies. 3. Execute automated 49-point wafer map acquisition measuring X and Y displacement vectors between outer box (Active STI) and inner box (Poly Gate). 4. Apply 1st and 2nd-order vector field modeling to extract systematic offsets (translation X/Y, wafer rotation, stage orthogonality, scaling X/Y) and calculate 3-sigma vector residuals. | `TIS 3-sigma <= 2.5 nm; Total modeled overlay error |Mean + 3-Sigma| <= 35.0 nm across all 49 measured sites; unmodeled residual vector magnitude <= 12.0 nm for both X and Y axes.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-2-3-3-02` | **High-Resolution CD-SEM Cross-Correlation Verification of Poly-to-Active Residual Vectors** | High-Resolution In-line Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) with secondary electron detector, automated beam charge neutralizer, and 800V landing energy. | 1. Navigate to 9 benchmark target dies (center, 4 mid-radius, 4 edge-radius) corresponding to maximum optical residual vector coordinates. 2. Activate low-dose charge neutralizer and acquire 50,000x top-down SE images of outer active STI edge and inner poly gate boundary. 3. Execute edge-detection threshold algorithm at 50% signal level to locate the geometric center of both active outer boundary and poly inner boundary. 4. Calculate CD-SEM physical vector Delta_X and Delta_Y. 5. Compute absolute optical-to-SEM correlation offset: Delta_error = sqrt((X_opt - X_sem)^2 + (Y_opt - Y_sem)^2). | `Physical Poly-to-Active overlay vector magnitude <= 30.0 nm; Optical-to-SEM overlay correlation delta |Delta_error| <= 4.0 nm across all 9 sample sites with zero observable charging distortion.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom coverall (bunny suit) with conductive ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA: Flush with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. critics.systems_engineer: Residual overlay analysis between E-beam direct-write (EBDW) poly gate and optical DUV active diffusion requires decoupling systematic distortion terms (linear grid magnification, wafer expansion, and stage orthogonality) from localized higher-order thermal/charging residuals. Failure to filter out non-correctable tool-induced beam-drift vectors will corrupt the linear correction coefficient feed-forward model to the EBDW deflection system, leading to uncorrectable residual overlay variance exceeding the 35 nm 3-sigma gate overlay budget across the 180nm DRAM cell matrix.
critics.domain_expert: Box-in-box (BiB) optical metrology suffers from apparent target asymmetry and optical proximity shifts due to sidewall angle variations between the recessed oxide/active STI trench edge and the dry-etched polysilicon border. High-voltage CD-SEM overlay vector verification at 800V landing energy is mandatory to calibrate optical tool-induced shift (TIS) and wafer-induced shift (WIS), ensuring that the reported optical vector residuals correlate with physical transistor gate-to-active overlap without charging-induced measurement distortion.
critics.supply_chain: Qualification of calibrated box-in-box overlay standard targets and CD-SEM micro-pitch reference standards (NIST-traceable 100 nm pitch) faces long lead times (14 to 18 weeks) and high single-source dependency. Production recipes must implement dual-redundant target layouts (frame-in-frame alongside standard box-in-box) to prevent tool down-time or metrology stalls if optical target damage occurs during poly CMP or post-etch cleans.
critics.laya_pm: The integration schedule depends strictly on a 45-minute closed-loop feedback window between EBDW exposure, post-exposure bake/develop inspection, and optical/SEM overlay sign-off prior to hardmask/poly etch. Metrology throughput must not bottleneck the MPW cycle; automated macro scripts for 49-point wafer mapping must execute within 12 minutes per wafer to maintain fab queue-time constraints and avoid photoresist baseline de-protection.
critical_failure_modes: Charge-induced beam deflection during CD-SEM secondary electron acquisition yielding false overlay vector residuals on non-conductive gate oxide/poly test structures.
Tool-Induced Shift (TIS) calibration failure in optical BiB metrology caused by 180-degree tool orientation misalignment, leading to erroneous linear offset correction values.
Asymmetric poly grain scattering and edge roughness (LER/LWR) exceeding 6 nm along the target periphery, causing optical edge detection algorithm centroid miscalculation.

testcases.title: Automated 49-Point Optical Box-in-Box Overlay Vector Residual and Model Extraction
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Optical Overlay Metrology Tool (Broadband Brightfield / DUV Spectroscopic Ellipsometric Overlay System) equipped with 0.90 NA objective and automated recipe loader.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer post poly-gate develop and inspect (ADI) or post-poly etch (AEI); active area defined by shallow trench isolation (STI); optical target box-in-box patterns intact without resist peeling; chuck temperature stabilized at 22.0 +/- 0.1 deg C.

testcases.pre_conditions: Optical overlay measurement completed for TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-2-3-3-01; wafer transferred in ultraclean dry N2 FOUP; e-beam column vacuum <= 1.0E-5 Pa.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Post-Exposure Bake, Development, and CD-SEM/Overlay In-Line Metrology

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal budget uniformity across the 150mm/200mm hotplate chuck during post-exposure bake (PEB) directly determines acid-diffusion length in chemically amplified e-beam resists (e.g., UV6 or CSAR 62) or relaxation kinetics in PMMA/ZEP520A. A temperature delta exceeding 0.5°C across the wafer yields uncorrectable CD swing (>12nm) before reactive-ion gate etch. Furthermore, in-line CD-SEM charging from ungrounded high-aspect poly lines can induce beam-induced deposition of carbonaceous contamination and electrostatic distortion during metrology.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm poly gate node using electron-beam direct write (EBDW), the critical risk during development is developer boundary-layer starvation and meniscus pin-down over dense memory cell arrays versus isolated peripheral gates. Standard immersion development introduces micro-bridging due to capillary collapse. A puddle-development recipe with surfactant-containing tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH 2.38% / MF-319) or specialized organic developer (n-amyl acetate / ZED-N50) coupled with high-speed dynamic DI/IPA rinse is mandatory to suppress resist foot formation and line-edge roughness (LER 3-sigma < 4.5nm).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-source vulnerability on specialized high-resolution e-beam resist developers (e.g., Tokyo Ohka Kogyo or Zeon Chemicals ZED-N50) and ultra-pure electronic-grade TMAH/surfactants. In the context of domestic Vietnamese cleanroom operations (DRAM Foundation VN), lead times for SEMI Tier 1 certified developers and conductive anti-static top-coat agents (e.g., Espacer) exceed 16-20 weeks, requiring strict inventory buffer management and local waste segregation protocols.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology throughput is the primary pacing constraint for Gen 3 tapeout schedule. Full 49-point wafer CD-SEM automated recipe execution and 5-point box-in-box overlay measurement run at ~45 minutes per wafer. If post-exposure bake queue time or development recipe fails pass/fail gates, entire lot exposure cycles (~18 hours on variable-shaped beam EBDW) are scrapped. Automated recipe validation must lock down GO/NO-GO gating within 15 minutes of wafer dry.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Acid diffusion boundary broadening and airborne amine contamination during EBDW-to-PEB delay causing catastrophic T-topping or linewidth slump (>25nm CD deviation).
1. Resist pattern collapse and line-edge roughness (LER) degradation caused by surface tension forces during unassisted spin dry after puddle development.
1. In-line CD-SEM measurement artifacting and substrate punch-through damage due to electron-beam charging and electron beam induced shrinkage (EBIS) on thin 180nm resist lines.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-3-01` | **Post-Development In-Line CD-SEM Isolated/Dense Gate Linewidth Verification** | Automated Low-Voltage Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM, Hitachi S-9200 / Applied Materials VeritySEM or equivalent, 500V-800V landing energy, beam current 8pA) | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM loadlock and pump down to high vacuum (<1e-4 Pa). 2. Align global fiducial marks on die (0,0) and wafer periphery. 3. Execute automated 25-site metrology recipe targeting 180nm isolated gate lines and 180nm dense line/space pairs (1:1.5 pitch) across 5 radial wafer zones. 4. Acquire secondary electron image with 16-frame averaging at 500V landing energy to prevent resist shrinkage. 5. Extract top CD, middle CD (50% threshold), foot CD, and line-edge roughness (3-sigma LER) at 10 discrete measurement slices per site. | `Isolated and dense gate bottom critical dimension (CD) must measure 180.0 nm ± 9.0 nm (within ±5% specification window). Line Edge Roughness (3-sigma LER) must be <= 4.5 nm. Zero observable resist residue (scumming) in open contact trenches.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-3-02` | **Box-in-Box / Frame-in-Frame Lithographic Gate-to-Active Overlay Metrology** | High-Precision Optical Overlay Metrology Tool (KLA Archer or automated optical microscope with calibrated sub-pixel pattern matching, 3-sigma repeatability < 1.5nm) | 1. Mount wafer on three-point kinematic stage of optical overlay tool. 2. Auto-focus using narrow-band 436nm/546nm illumination on target structures at 9 standardized die locations (center, top, bottom, left, right, and 4 corners). 3. Acquire 100x magnification digitized images of outer active-area box (20um x 20um) and inner gate resist box (10um x 10um). 4. Calculate centroid mismatch vectors in X and Y axes via edge-detection regression algorithms. 5. Decompose raw overlay offsets into translation, wafer scaling, wafer non-orthogonality, and residual error. | `Total overlay vector error |Delta_R| = sqrt(Delta_X^2 + Delta_Y^2) <= 25.0 nm across all 9 measured die sites. Mean translation offset <= 10.0 nm in both X and Y axes.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical-resistant nitrile outer gloves over cleanroom vinyl inner gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles and full-face protective shield, Flame-retardant, anti-static cleanroom gown (Tyvek/polyester conductive weave), Chemical apron constructed of polychloroprene/butyl rubber during developer decanting, Cleanroom safety shoes with electrostatic discharge (ESD) grounding
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: TMAH is a potent neurotoxin and corrosive base capable of fatal respiratory/cardiovascular arrest via transdermal absorption. Skin contact: Immediately flush affected area with copiously running water for a minimum of 15 minutes at the nearest safety shower; remove contaminated clothing immediately; medical assessment is mandatory regardless of apparent symptom absence. Eye contact: Irrigate eyes continuously for at least 20 minutes under emergency eyewash keeping eyelids separated; seek immediate ophthalmological intervention. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh air, administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored, and obtain urgent emergency medical transport.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet bench dedicated developer station must maintain dedicated alkali wet exhaust with continuous face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) monitored by differential pressure manometer. Solvent develop and rinse basins must be connected to dedicated volatile organic compound (VOC) scrubbed solvent exhaust ducts with active fire-suppression interlocks.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous TMAH developer waste stream must be segregated into dedicated organic alkaline carboys; do not mix with acidic or oxidizer drains (prevents violent neutralization and toxic vapor release). Solvent developers (n-amyl acetate, IPA) routed to dedicated non-halogenated solvent collection drums for off-site licensed hazardous incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | SEMI Tier 1 / Electronic Grade | `2.38% aqueous solution` |
| **n-Amyl Acetate (for non-chemically amplified/ZEP developer)** | `628-63-7` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `>99.0%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | SEMI-C12 / Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DIW)** | `7732-18-5` | ASTM Type 1 (18.2 MOhm-cm at 25C) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `3 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Exposed high-resolution resist film on gate polysilicon/dielectric stack, under high vacuum during EBDW un-docking; zero organic condensation or baseline airborne amine exposure.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Developed, thoroughly rinsed, spin-dried, scum-free 180nm patterned photoresist features over poly gate with zero standing moisture and verified metrology pass.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne ambient basic amine (NH3, N-methylpyrrolidone) neutralization of photogenerated acids on resist surface causing severe T-topping, incomplete clearance, or complete pattern loss at 180nm pitch.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful execution of post-exposure bake, wet puddle development, and automated non-destructive in-line CD-SEM/overlay verification for 180nm poly gate structures on 180nm open-source DRAM lot. Wafers demonstrate target 180nm critical dimension with <5% deviation, overlay registration within ±25nm, zero micro-scumming, and are formally cleared for poly gate anisotropic reactive ion etch (RIE).

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `lot_peb_dev_inline_metrology_report.pdf`
- [ ] `gate_cd_sem_25point_raw_data.csv`
- [ ] `gate_to_active_overlay_vector_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Mean isolated and dense poly gate resist linewidth at 50% threshold height** | `180.0 nm` | ± 9.0 nm | Low-voltage automated CD-SEM 25-point wafer inspection recipe |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum vector misalignment magnitude of gate pattern relative to active area (OD)** | `15.0 nm` | <= 25.0 nm | Optical overlay box-in-box registration analysis across 9 dies |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Gate line-edge roughness (LER, 3-sigma)** | `3.5 nm` | <= 4.5 nm | CD-SEM secondary electron multi-slice line-edge contour analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative metrology assertions verified across 100% of tested dies with Cpk >= 1.33 on 180nm gate CD; zero un-cleared resist residues observed via high-magnification CD-SEM inspection; signoff approval logged in MES by Lithography Metrology Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Chemically Amplified Resist Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) Thermal Uniformity Calibration & Processing

**Category**: Photolithography | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal chuck ramp-up transient and spatial gradient directly translate into critical dimension (CD) variation across the 150mm/200mm wafer; for chemically amplified resist (CAR) in 180nm EBDW gate patterning, a PEB temperature sensitivity of 2-5 nm/°C means temperature non-uniformity across the hot plate surface must not exceed ±0.3°C (3-sigma) to maintain the overall lithographic CD budget (< 5% of 180nm, i.e., ±9nm total budget across exposure, PEB, and develop). Vacuum pull-down consistency and proximity pin wear must be continuously logged.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Chemically amplified resists rely on photoacid generators (PAGs) yielding catalytic deprotection during the post-exposure bake. Airborne base molecular contamination (e.g., amine concentrations > 1 ppb) during post-exposure delay induces severe T-topping and acid neutralization, while PEB thermal drift or excessive PEB duration results in uncontrolled acid diffusion across the gate boundary, blurring the latent image and degrading line edge roughness (LER) beyond the 4.5nm DRAM gate specification.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Instrumented calibration wafers (such as SensArray/KLA 17-point or 29-point RTD sensor wafers) have high lead times (>12 weeks) and limited vendor pools. Local calibration protocols using calibrated thin-film surface thermocouples or infrared thermal imaging must be validated as interim backups to prevent production halts during fab thermal recalibration cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Strict throughput and queue-time coupling between the high-vacuum EBDW write chamber unload lock and the atmospheric automated track PEB station is critical. Any operator delay or track transfer bottleneck exceeding 15 minutes invalidates the exposure-to-PEB latency baseline, forcing entire wafer lot re-scrapping due to unrecoverable CD shift on critical DRAM poly gate runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal non-uniformity across the hotplate active zone (>0.5°C variance) causing cross-wafer poly gate critical dimension variation exceeding ±10nm, violating 180nm transistor drive current matching specifications.
1. Post-exposure delay (PED) queue-time overage leading to airborne amine-induced surface acid depletion, causing resist skin formation, micro-bridging, and severe T-topping.
1. Thermal contact resistance fluctuation due to localized vacuum chuck port clogging or warped substrate back-surface, generating localized cold spots and incomplete deprotection.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-3-1-01` | **PEB Hot Plate Steady-State & Transient Thermal Uniformity 17-Point Mapping** | 150mm SensArray/KLA RTD Integrated Sensor Wafer with multi-channel wireless datalogger calibrated to NIST standards (±0.05°C accuracy). | 1. Load instrumented RTD sensor wafer onto the PEB vacuum hot plate via automated track handler arm. 2. Engage full vacuum clamp (vacuum pressure <= -80 kPa). 3. Log real-time temperature across all 17 radial/azimuthal points at 10 Hz for 90 seconds (including 10s pre-contact, 60s bake, and 20s post-unload). 4. Calculate steady-state range (T_max - T_min) between t = 15s and t = 60s. 5. Repeat across 3 consecutive cycles to extract repeatability. | `Steady-state total temperature range (T_max - T_min) across all 17 sensors <= 0.40°C across the 60s bake window; 3-sigma intra-wafer temperature distribution <= 0.25°C; transient ramp-up to within 1°C of setpoint <= 8.0 seconds.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-3-1-02` | **180nm Poly Gate CD Sensitivity to Post-Exposure Delay (PED) & PEB Uniformity** | Hitachi S-9380 CD-SEM (or equivalent in-line low-voltage top-down CD-SEM), automated track PEB unit, cleanroom AMC ion-mobility spectrometer. | 1. Expose standard 9-die evaluation matrix on test wafer. 2. Transfer immediately to track, maintaining cleanroom amine level < 0.5 ppb. 3. Execute calibrated PEB recipe (110.0°C for 60.0s on validated vacuum chuck). 4. Develop in standard 0.26N TMAH (MF-CD-26) for 60 seconds with puddle agitation, DI rinse, and dry. 5. Measure 20 distinct 180nm isolated and dense poly gate line widths per die across center, mid-radius, and edge positions using CD-SEM at 800V accelerating voltage. | `Mean CD across all sites = 180.0 nm ± 5.0 nm; 3-sigma intra-wafer CD variation <= 6.0 nm; line edge roughness (3-sigma LER) <= 4.2 nm; zero visible profile skinning or T-topping under 45-degree tilt SEM inspection.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Thermal heat-resistant Kevlar/Nomex under-gloves with chemical-resistant nitrile outer gauntlets, ANSI Z87.1 approved wraparound safety glasses with side shields and full chemical splash face shield, Class 100 cleanroom-compatible chemical apron (PTFE/Neoprene), Vapor-tight full-length cleanroom bunny suit with integrated ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Thermal burns: Immediately cool affected zone with copious chilled sterile water for >= 15 minutes; do not apply salves or ointments without medical authorization. Chemical contact (TMAH / Solvents): Flood skin or eyes at emergency eye-wash/safety shower for minimum 20 minutes while stripping contaminated apparel; TMAH carries systemic neurotoxicity risk—seek immediate emergency medical care and transport with SDS. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh outdoor air; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: PEB track hot plate module must be housed in an enclosed mini-environment equipped with dedicated solvent exhaust pulling continuous face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) and static negative pressure >= -50 Pa relative to cleanroom bay; cleanroom air must pass through chemical filtration units equipped with activated carbon and chemisorption filters designed to scrub airborne molecular amines below 0.5 ppb.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Thermal exhaust effluent is directed into the facility VOC (volatile organic compound) regenerative catalytic oxidizer/scrubber system. Aqueous development waste containing TMAH must be routed strictly to dedicated hazardous alkali waste drains and neutralized via automated sulfuric/hydrochloric acid dosing in an industrial wastewater treatment plant (pH neutralized to 6.5-8.5) prior to municipal release; never mix TMAH effluent with oxidizers or heavy metal streams.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Propylene Glycol Monomethyl Ether Acetate (PGMEA / 1-Methoxy-2-propyl acetate)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade / VLSI Grade (>= 99.8%) | `Resist outgassing vapor / 100% trace emissions during bake` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade | `2.38 wt% aqueous solution (0.26 N)` |
| **Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS)** | `999-97-3` | Semiconductor Grade (>= 99.9%) | `100% liquid/saturated vapor` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `15 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: High-vacuum exposed CAR latent-image state on 180nm polysilicon/gate-oxide stack; zero condensed airborne moisture, particulate count class 1 (0.1 um particles < 1 per wafer), unquenched photoacid latent profile.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thermally deprotected polyhydroxystyrene/methacrylate polymer latent image; volatile crosslinking or deprotection reaction by-products completely outgassed; stabilized against room-temperature acid catalytic drift.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding post-exposure queue-time allows atmospheric basic amines (NH3, NMP) to diffuse into the resist top boundary, neutralizing photogenerated acids, causing severe resist insoluble skinning, micro-bridging, CD expansion (> 15nm shift), and irreversible gate patterning yield loss.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful baseline calibration and execution of the Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) module for 180nm critical dimension polysilicon gate patterning using chemically amplified resist, validating intra-wafer thermal uniformity across the vacuum chuck, rigorous queue-time control (< 15 min), and CD-SEM gate width fidelity within nominal foundry tolerance.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PEB_Thermal_Uniformity_17Point_Calibration_Map.csv`
- [ ] `TC_EBDW_Gate_Patterning_PEB_Validation_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `180nm_Poly_Gate_InLine_CDSEM_Metrology_Summary.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **PEB steady-state chuck surface temperature range across 17-point sensor matrix** | `0.30°C` | +0.10°C / -0.10°C | Calibrated 150mm/200mm multi-point RTD SensArray wireless instrumentation wafer logged over 60-second bake cycle at 110.0°C. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-PEB developed 180nm isolated poly gate critical dimension (CD)** | `180.0 nm` | ± 5.0 nm (3-sigma <= 6.0 nm) | High-resolution automated in-line CD-SEM top-down metrology across 9-site cross-wafer die matrix. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Poly gate line edge roughness (LER, 3-sigma)** | `3.8 nm` | <= 4.5 nm | Off-line image analysis algorithm on high-magnification CD-SEM edge detection scans (Hitachi offline terminal). |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> The PEB process is certified for DRAM Foundation VN Gen 3 (180nm) poly gate fabrication upon meeting two consecutive 17-point sensor wafer uniformity scans with total temperature range <= 0.40°C, and complete lithographic verification of three consecutive test wafers exhibiting nominal 180nm ± 5.0nm gate CD with zero T-topping or profile distortion verified by CD-SEM metrology sign-off.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## PEB Hotplate Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & PID Calibration

**Document ID:** `SOP-LITHO-PEB-CAL-03`  
**Classification:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Node / DUV & EBDW Photolithography)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Target Substrate:** 200mm P-type Silicon Wafer (Instrumented Thermal Test Array)

---

### 1. Process Flow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 1: Calibration  │
│    Fixture & Probe     │
│      Preparation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 2: Multi-Zone   │
│     Step-Response      │
│   Transient Mapping    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 3: Independent  │
│   Zone PID Parameter   │
│      Optimization      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Stage 4: Steady-     │
│   State Uniformity &   │
│  Metrology Validation  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Tool Isolation & Instrumented Wafer Loading
1. Verify the vacuum bake chuck chamber exhaust velocity is stabilized at nominal laminar flow with cover purge nitrogen ($N_2$) flowing at $15\text{ SLPM}$.
2. Inspect the multi-zone ceramic/aluminum hotplate surface (Center Zone 1, Middle Ring Zone 2, Outer Edge Zone 3) for particulate contamination.
3. Load a calibrated 200mm instrumented wafer containing 17 embedded thin-film RTD/thermocouple sensors mapped across the wafer diameter (radial spacing: center $r = 0\text{ mm}$, intermediate $r = 45\text{ mm}$, edge zone $r = 95\text{ mm}$).
4. Engage proximity vacuum pins to establish a nominal bake gap ($0.15\text{ mm} \pm 0.02\text{ mm}$) to avoid direct backside particle embedding.

#### Step 2: Open-Loop Thermal Step-Response Profiling
1. Set the initial baseline plate temperature to ambient idle ($25^\circ\text{C}$).
2. Apply a stepped setpoint increase to $115^\circ\text{C}$ (matching standard resist thermal activation baselines) across all zones simultaneously.
3. Record time-series thermal response data at a sampling rate of $\ge 10\text{ Hz}$ across all 17 channels.
4. Extract the transient heating characteristics for each zone:
   - Dead time ($L_{\text{dead}}$ in seconds)
   - Time constant ($\tau$ in seconds)
   - Process gain ($K_p = \Delta T / \Delta \text{Power}$)

#### Step 3: Multi-Zone PID Calibration
1. Using the extracted Cohen-Coon / modified Ziegler-Nichols tuning rules, calculate decoupled PID gains for:
   - **Zone 1 (Center):** Reduce proportional gain $K_p$ to prevent core thermal accumulation.
   - **Zone 2 (Mid-ring):** Balanced $K_i$ integration to dampen thermal wave propagation.
   - **Zone 3 (Edge):** Increase $K_p$ and lead-derivative $K_d$ to compensate for edge radiative and convective ambient losses.
2. Program the updated $K_p, T_i, T_d$ coefficient registers into the digital multi-loop temperature controller.
3. Execute a dynamic ramp test from $85^\circ\text{C}$ to $115^\circ\text{C}$ at a controlled ramp rate of $1.5^\circ\text{C/s}$.

#### Step 4: Steady-State Verification & Run-to-Run Soak Run
1. Soak at the operational target setpoint for $300\text{ seconds}$.
2. Record steady-state across-wafer temperature variation over a continuous $60\text{ second}$ window (typical Chemically Amplified Resist PEB duration).
3. Compute radial standard deviation ($\sigma$) and peak-to-valley temperature range ($\Delta T = T_{\max} - T_{\min}$).
4. Export calibration log to the fab equipment database; lock PID registers against uncalibrated field edits.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Steady-State Thermal Uniformity ($\Delta T$)** | $\le 0.35$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ ($3\sigma$ across full 200mm wafer) | 17-point embedded RTD wafer array logged over $60\text{ s}$ soak |
| **Transient Temperature Overshoot** | $\le 0.50$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ above setpoint ($115^\circ\text{C}$) | Max peak excursion during ramp from standby |
| **Edge-to-Center Radial Offset ($T_{\text{edge}} - T_{\text{center}}$)** | $0.00$ | $\pm 0.20\,^\circ\text{C}$ | Sensor differential ($r = 95\text{ mm}$ vs. $r = 0\text{ mm}$) |
| **Settling Time to Target Window ($\pm 0.1^\circ\text{C}$)** | $\le 15.0$ | seconds | Duration from setpoint command arrival to stable band |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References & Context Citations

1. **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
   - *Physical Alignment & Lithography Demands:* Minimum poly gate length is $0.15\,\mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$) on a manufacturing placement grid of $0.005\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) with KrF ($248\text{ nm}$, $\text{NA} = 0.65$, $k_1 = 0.40$) lithography, and overlay error budget $\le 35\text{ nm}$. Thermal non-uniformity during PEB directly drives photoacid diffusion length gradients, translating into critical poly gate CD variation ($\Delta\text{CD} \sim 1\text{--}2\text{ nm}/^\circ\text{C}$). Tight temperature uniformity ($\le 0.35^\circ\text{C}$) is mandatory to remain within the $150\text{ nm}$ gate tolerance.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology (Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench):**
   - *Device Target Constraint:* Access transistor channel length is $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Maintaining tight sub-threshold leakage ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) requires uniform thermal post-exposure bake across all memory mat arrays to prevent threshold voltage dispersion across bitline contacts.
3. **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
   - *Thermal Processing Baselines:* Standardized thermal bake protocols on flat aluminum heating stages utilize soft-bake/resist baseline setpoints around $115^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ seconds}$, serving as empirical baseline references for thermal soak calibration intervals.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Multi-zone baking modules must integrate multi-channel precision RTD inputs (Pt100 4-wire) directly mapped to an anti-windup digital PID loop with solid-state relay (SSR) zero-crossing switching. Inadequate thermal de-coupling between adjacent concentric zones (inner, middle, outer perimeter) induces cross-talk oscillations, leading to thermal overshoot during transient ramping and settling phases. A feed-forward decoupled MIMO control matrix or independent perimeter zone biasing is required to achieve spatial and temporal thermal flatness across the 150mm/200mm platen within <= 1.5 seconds of contact.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In Chemically Amplified Resists (CAR) utilized for 180nm EBDW gate lithography, post-exposure bake (PEB) sensitivity typically exhibits a CD variation of 1.5 nm to 3.5 nm per 0.1°C temperature shift. Spatial non-uniformity across the hotplate surface will directly translate to catastrophic across-wafer critical dimension variation (AWCDV). Furthermore, proximity bake pin lifter mechanics must guarantee uniform physical contact without micro-gap air wedges, as a 10 µm tilt in proximity pin height introduces a localized thermal gradient exceeding 1.2°C, completely degrading gate L_eff.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying instrument-grade precision thermal profiling instrumented wafers (such as SensArray or KLA high-density calibrated thin-film RTD arrays) carries significant lead times and cost barriers for open-source and educational fab operations. We must design an open-hardware vacuum chuck bake plate utilizing surface-machined Class A DIN Pt100 RTD arrays or calibrated Kapton-encapsulated thermocouple pucks with readily available industrial multi-channel PID temperature controllers (such as Omron E5ED or Eurotherm nanodac) to prevent single-supplier lock-in.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Thermal profiling and multi-zone loop tuning must be scheduled immediately prior to e-beam direct-write litho execution lots. Calibration procedures cannot exceed a 4-hour window per preventive maintenance cycle. Tool readiness must be strictly enforced via automated pre-flight temperature logging: if the steady-state 9-point thermal spread exceeds 0.2°C or if warm-up settling time drifts beyond 45 seconds, the EBDW gate exposure job must be hard-interlocked to prevent wasting expensive e-beam write time.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal boundary cross-talk causing edge zone overshoot (> 0.5°C above setpoint) during wafer drop, resulting in excessive deprotection acid diffusion and 180nm poly gate line-slimming at the wafer edge.
1. Pneumatic lift-pin asynchronous actuation creating non-uniform localized contact heat transfer and wafer bowing, yielding asymmetric 1-D CD gradients across orthogonal die coordinates.
1. PID derivative kick or loop instability induced by cold-wafer thermal shock, extending settling time beyond 5 seconds and corrupting total accumulated thermal dose.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-3-1-1-01` | **Steady-State Multi-Zone Hotplate Surface Temperature Uniformity Metrology** | 150mm instrumented thermocouple/RTD wafer (9-point radial/azimuthal matrix), 16-channel precision data logger (24-bit ADC, cold-junction compensated, sampling rate >= 10 Hz), Class A Pt100 reference probe. | 1. critics.systems_engineer: Multi-zone baking modules must integrate multi-channel precision RTD inputs (Pt100 4-wire) directly mapped to an anti-windup digital PID loop with solid-state relay (SSR) zero-crossing switching. Inadequate thermal de-coupling between adjacent concentric zones (inner, middle, outer perimeter) induces cross-talk oscillations, leading to thermal overshoot during transient ramping and settling phases. A feed-forward decoupled MIMO control matrix or independent perimeter zone biasing is required to achieve spatial and temporal thermal flatness across the 150mm/200mm platen within <= 1.5 seconds of contact.
critics.domain_expert: In Chemically Amplified Resists (CAR) utilized for 180nm EBDW gate lithography, post-exposure bake (PEB) sensitivity typically exhibits a CD variation of 1.5 nm to 3.5 nm per 0.1°C temperature shift. Spatial non-uniformity across the hotplate surface will directly translate to catastrophic across-wafer critical dimension variation (AWCDV). Furthermore, proximity bake pin lifter mechanics must guarantee uniform physical contact without micro-gap air wedges, as a 10 µm tilt in proximity pin height introduces a localized thermal gradient exceeding 1.2°C, completely degrading gate L_eff.
critics.supply_chain: Specifying instrument-grade precision thermal profiling instrumented wafers (such as SensArray or KLA high-density calibrated thin-film RTD arrays) carries significant lead times and cost barriers for open-source and educational fab operations. We must design an open-hardware vacuum chuck bake plate utilizing surface-machined Class A DIN Pt100 RTD arrays or calibrated Kapton-encapsulated thermocouple pucks with readily available industrial multi-channel PID temperature controllers (such as Omron E5ED or Eurotherm nanodac) to prevent single-supplier lock-in.
critics.laya_pm: Thermal profiling and multi-zone loop tuning must be scheduled immediately prior to e-beam direct-write litho execution lots. Calibration procedures cannot exceed a 4-hour window per preventive maintenance cycle. Tool readiness must be strictly enforced via automated pre-flight temperature logging: if the steady-state 9-point thermal spread exceeds 0.2°C or if warm-up settling time drifts beyond 45 seconds, the EBDW gate exposure job must be hard-interlocked to prevent wasting expensive e-beam write time.
critical_failure_modes: Thermal boundary cross-talk causing edge zone overshoot (> 0.5°C above setpoint) during wafer drop, resulting in excessive deprotection acid diffusion and 180nm poly gate line-slimming at the wafer edge.
Pneumatic lift-pin asynchronous actuation creating non-uniform localized contact heat transfer and wafer bowing, yielding asymmetric 1-D CD gradients across orthogonal die coordinates.
PID derivative kick or loop instability induced by cold-wafer thermal shock, extending settling time beyond 5 seconds and corrupting total accumulated thermal dose.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title
**Chemically Amplified Resist Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) Recipe Execution for 180nm Poly Gate Patterning**

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the precise execution of the Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) cycle following Electron Beam Direct Write (EBDW) / DUV lithographic exposure for patterning 180nm / 150nm polysilicon gate critical layers within the DRAM Foundation VN 180nm Open-Source DRAM architecture.

---

### 2. Equipment & Consumables
- **Tool:** Flat vacuum-chuck hot plate module with integrated multi-zone thermal controller and rapid automated pneumatic pin-lift transfer.
- **Substrate:** Processed silicon wafer post-EBDW/DUV exposure (with chemically amplified / image-reversal positive resist layer such as AZ 5214E / diazonaphthoquinone-novolak matrix).
- **Environment:** Class 10/100 Cleanroom with inline ambient thermal stabilization ($21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, $45 \pm 5\%\ \text{RH}$).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+---------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Pre-Bake Thermal Plate Stabilization (110°C)    |
+---------------------------------------------------------+
                           |
                           v
+---------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Wafer Transfer & Vacuum Chuck Engagement        |
+---------------------------------------------------------+
                           |
                           v
+---------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Timed PEB Thermal Dwell (60 Seconds)            |
+---------------------------------------------------------+
                           |
                           v
+---------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Rapid Post-Bake Pin Lift & Chill Plate Transfer |
+---------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Pre-Bake Thermal Stabilization:**
   - Verify the hot plate setpoint temperature is stabilized at **$110^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Confirm vacuum chuck seals and temperature sensor readouts across the plate surface prior to wafer loading.

2. **Automated Wafer Loading & Chucking:**
   - Transfer the post-exposure wafer robotically onto the lift pins above the hot plate.
   - Lower lift pins to seat the substrate directly onto the flat vacuum hot plate surface.
   - Engage vacuum chucking to guarantee uniform thermal contact across the entire wafer backside.

3. **PEB Execution & Dwell Cycle:**
   - Execute the thermal bake at **$110^\circ\text{C}$** for precisely **60 seconds**.
   - Maintain uniform surface contact to drive cross-linking/catalytic acid deprotection uniformly across the patterned gate field without thermal drift.

4. **Post-Bake De-chucking & Quenching Transfer:**
   - At $t = 60\ \text{seconds}$, release the vacuum chuck and immediately actuate the automated lift pins.
   - Transfer the wafer directly onto a chilled vacuum plate ($20^\circ\text{C}$--$22^\circ\text{C}$) to quench chemical amplification and arrest acid diffusion before moving to inline develop (e.g., MF-319 / TMAH developer bath).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Permissible Tolerance | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PEB Setpoint Temperature** | `110` | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **PEB Dwell Time** | `60` | $\pm 1.0$ | $\text{seconds}$ |
| **Minimum Poly Gate Length Target** | `150` | $\pm 5$ (Grid limit) | $\text{nm}$ ($0.15\ \mu\text{m}$) |
| **Permissible Poly Gate-to-Active Overlay Error** | $\le 35$ | Maximum limit | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 5. Verified Source Citations
- **Positive Photoresist Spin Dynamics, Soft Bake & Development Protocol**: Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) on flat hot plate at $110^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\ \text{seconds}$ (prescribed for image reversal / chemically modified photoresist stabilization).
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**: Minimum poly gate length dimension of $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\ \text{nm}$), physical manufacturing placement grid of $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\ \text{nm}$), and maximum allowable overlay error between gate poly and active diffusion of $\le 35\ \text{nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) on chemically amplified resists (CAR) is the critical kinetic amplifier step for 180nm poly gate direct-write lithography. Thermal sensitivity typically exceeds 2 to 4 nm CD variation per 1°C shift; therefore, chuck thermal uniformity and transient ramp dynamics must be strictly isolated from ambient cleanroom micro-convection and wafer warpage variations across 150mm/200mm substrates.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Unlike non-chemically amplified DNQ-novolak resists (e.g. Shipley 1813), advanced e-beam CAR utilizes photogenerated acid (PAG) catalytic deprotection. Both acid diffusion length and airborne amine base contamination (T-topping or skinning) during the delay between vacuum EBDW unloading and hotplate contact will drastically alter isolated-to-dense poly gate bias and line-edge roughness (LER).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specialized high-resolution e-beam CAR resists (e.g., polyhydroxystyrene-based positive CAR like UV6/KRS-XE or PMMA/CSAR alternatives) and ultra-pure electronic-grade developers (TMAH 2.38%) have stringent cold-chain shelf lives (stored at -20°C to 4°C). Establishing certified domestic cold-chain distribution and calibrated multi-zone hotplate spares is mandatory to prevent yield collapse during tapeout runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: To maintain project velocity toward the Gen 3 180nm DRAM tapeout, PEB recipe validation must not bottleneck the single-wafer EBDW queue. Automated wafer transfer between e-beam loadlock, proximity/contact hotplate, and chill plate must be synchronized within rigorous timing budgets to avoid scrap wafer accumulation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Severe Critical Dimension (CD) drift and line collapse caused by spatial thermal non-uniformity (>0.5°C across-chuck gradient) during catalytic deprotection.
1. T-topping and bridging of 180nm poly gate spaces due to airborne basic amine poisoning (ppb levels) during post-exposure ambient delay.
1. Excessive acid diffusion blurring latent chemical latent images, leading to unresolvable gate line-end shortening and gate length enlargement exceeding ±10% PDK tolerance.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-3-1-2-01` | **PEB Hotplate Surface Multi-Zone Dynamic Temperature Uniformity Verification** | 150mm Instrument Sensor Wafer equipped with 17-point calibrated thin-film thermocouple array and high-speed data logger (0.05°C precision). | 1. Load the 17-point thermocouple sensor wafer onto the vacuum bake chuck using the automated robot end-effector. 2. Engage vacuum hold-down and log real-time temperature data across all 17 sensors for 90 seconds at 10 Hz sampling rate. 3. Measure thermal ramp-up time to reach 99% of setpoint (108.9°C to 110.0°C). 4. Compute the maximum dynamic and steady-state spatial temperature delta (T_max - T_min) during the 60-second processing window. 5. Transfer wafer to the chill plate set at 21.0°C and measure quench duration to <30.0°C. | `Across-wafer steady-state thermal uniformity range (Delta T) <= 0.35°C over the entire 60-second soak; thermal ramp stabilization time <= 4.0 seconds; chill plate quench time to <30.0°C <= 8.0 seconds.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-2-3-1-2-02` | **Post-PEB Acid Diffusion Length and CD Sensitivity In-Line Dose Matrix Assay** | In-line CD-SEM (Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope) with 0.1nm measurement precision at 800V landing energy. | 1. Execute standard PEB recipe: vacuum contact bake at 110.0°C for exactly 60.0 seconds, followed by immediate pneumatic transfer to chill plate at 21.0°C for 30.0 seconds. 2. Develop in standard 2.38% TMAH (surfactant-free) for 45.0 seconds at 21.0°C with puddle agitation, followed by 30-second DI water rinse and spin-dry at 3000 RPM. 3. Measure bottom CD and sidewall angle across dense (1:1) and isolated 180nm poly gate test structures across 9 die locations. 4. Correlate measured CD variation against hotplate thermal calibration log to determine empirical PEB CD sensitivity (dCD/dT). | `Mean printed poly gate CD at nominal dose = 180.0 nm ± 4.5 nm (3-sigma <= 6.0 nm); isolated-to-dense bias <= 8.0 nm; empirical thermal sensitivity dCD/dT <= 3.0 nm/°C.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom-compatible chemical splash goggles and full-face polycarbonate shield, Double-layer nitrile examination gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness) with outer thermal-resistant Nomex/silicone gloves for hotplate chamber maintenance, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown/bunny suit (Class 100 compliant) with chemical-resistant PVC apron during chemical handling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with hotplate or toxic solvent/TMAH residues: Immediately flush affected area with copiously flowing tempered water for at least 15 minutes at cleanroom safety shower. For thermal burns: Cool skin with cold running water, cover with sterile dry dressing, and seek immediate medical attention. For inhalation of organic vapors: Evacuate exposed personnel to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Hotplate module enclosed under dedicated local exhaust ventilation (LEV) with face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); exhaust duct routed directly to cleanroom VOC/solvent abatement scrubber. Ambient cleanroom air recirculated through chemical chemical-filter banks (activated carbon/chemisorption) to maintain ambient ammonia and airborne amine concentrations < 0.5 ppb.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent outgassing exhaust and organic rinse condensates segregated into dedicated flammable solvent carboys (non-halogenated VOC collection). Contaminated wipes and solid consumable waste disposed of in airtight hazardous waste drums for high-temperature incineration. Spent alkaline TMAH aqueous developer routed to automated chemical neutralization unit (pH adjustment between 6.0 and 9.0 using dilute H2SO4) prior to discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate (PGMEA)** | `108-65-6` | VLSI / Electronic Grade (>=99.8%) | `70-90% wt in photoresist formulation` |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade / Semiconductor | `2.38% aqueous solution` |
| **Triphenylsulfonium triflate (Photoacid Generator - PAG)** | `66003-78-9` | Analytical Grade (>=98.0%) | `1-5% wt in resist solids` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `15 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly exposed CAR film on polysilicon/gate oxide substrate containing latent, unamplified photogenerated sulfonic acid image; stored in filtered dry FOUP/SMIF pod (amine concentration < 0.5 ppb).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thermally deprotected, crosslinked/solubilized latent resist pattern quenched to 21.0°C; stabilized against further acid diffusion; ready for immediate developer dispense.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne base (amine) neutralization of surface PAG acid catalysts and thermal de-trapping leading to severe T-topping, line-edge bridging, and uncorrectable CD bloat.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful execution and thermal verification of the Chemically Amplified Resist Post-Exposure Bake (PEB) recipe at 110.0°C for 60 seconds, achieving sub-0.35°C chuck temperature uniformity and controlled catalytic acid deprotection on 180nm poly gate e-beam written substrates with zero T-topping defects.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `PEB_Thermal_Uniformity_17Pt_Profile_Run01.csv`
- [ ] `Gate_Poly_180nm_Post_PEB_CDSEM_Metrology.tiff`
- [ ] `PEB_Process_Signoff_and_QTime_Log_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-EBDW-PEB-01` | **Steady-state hotplate multi-zone temperature uniformity across active 150mm wafer diameter** | `110.0°C` | ±0.30°C | Multi-point instrumented thermocouple wafer acquisition at 10 Hz over 60 seconds |
| `ASSERT-EBDW-PEB-02` | **Poly gate post-PEB and post-development critical dimension (CD) for 180nm nominal drawn feature** | `180.0 nm` | ±5.0 nm (3-sigma) | Automated top-down in-line CD-SEM image processing across 9 intra-field sites |
| `ASSERT-EBDW-PEB-03` | **Post-exposure to PEB queue time in filtered cleanroom environment prior to hotplate thermal contact** | `300 seconds` | <= 900 seconds (15 minutes) | Track MES automated timestamp delta between EBDW unload lock and PEB robot chuck placement |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Hotplate thermal log confirms 110.0°C ± 0.3°C steady-state uniformity without local hotspots; Q-time from EBDW chamber unload to PEB plate contact is strictly <= 15 minutes; CD-SEM inspection validates clean 180nm poly gate space clearance with zero T-top footing and isolated-dense bias <= 8.0 nm, verified and signed off by the Lithography Principal Process Engineer.
