# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Residual Overlay Error Budget Decomposition & EBDW Stepper Correction Verification ($\le 35\text{ nm}$)

- **Document ID:** `SOP-LITHO-OVR-035`
- **File Reference:** [sop_residual_overlay_error_budget_decomposition.md](./docs/sop_residual_overlay_error_budget_decomposition.md)
- **Role:** Domain Expert AI — DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council
- **Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm Open-Source DRAM MPW Tapeout)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Active Diffusion    │
│    Layer Alignment    │
│         Marks         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    EBDW Stage Grid    │
│   Coarse Alignment    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Poly Gate EBDW     │
│       Exposure        │
│     L=150nm-180nm     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Critical Dimension   │
│     SEM & Overlay     │
│       Metrology       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Vector Map       │
│    Decomposition &    │
│  Residual Extraction  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Verification:     │
│  Residual Overlay <=  │
│         35nm          │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate & Target Coordinate Registration**:
   - Align to prior Active Diffusion (`diff`) fiducial marks (active feature minimum width $= 0.15\ \mu\text{m} / 150\text{ nm}$).
   - Initialize EBDW laser interferometer stage coordinates snapped to the foundry placement grid resolution of $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
2. **Systematic Global Vector Modeling**:
   - Perform multi-site alignment across wafer die grid coordinates.
   - Decompose gross measured vector map into linear 1st-order components: translation offset $(T_x, T_y)$, wafer expansion/scaling $(S_x, S_y)$, and rotation $(\Theta_x, \Theta_y)$.
3. **EBDW Stepper Feedback Correction Execution**:
   - Feed modeled systematic offset parameters into the EBDW beam deflection and stage positioning controller.
   - Enforce all stage step corrections in integral quanta of the $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$) grid.
4. **Poly Gate Patterning**:
   - Direct-write DRAM cell access gates with nominal gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (minimum gate length limit $150\text{ nm}$) and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, maintaining inter-gate spacing $\ge 0.21\ \mu\text{m}$.
5. **CD-SEM Metrology & Overlay Vector Extraction**:
   - Measure relative shift $(\Delta X_i, \Delta Y_i)$ between poly gate centerline and underlying active diffusion edge across designated metrology marks.
6. **Residual Budget Decomposition & Gating**:
   - Subtract modeled systematic vectors from raw metrology vectors to extract uncorrectable residuals:
     $$\vec{\Delta}_{\text{residual}} = \vec{\Delta}_{\text{measured}} - \vec{\Delta}_{\text{systematic}}$$
   - Evaluate maximum wafer-level statistical error ($|\mu| + 3\sigma_{\text{residual}}$) against the $35\text{ nm}$ specification.

---

### 3. Error Budget & Metric Visualization

```text
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │███████████████████████████████████│
 Total Error Budget┤███████████████████████████████████│
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Poly-to-Active Spec┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
  Uncorrected Resid┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
    EBDW Stage Grid┤░░░░░░                             │
                   │░░░░░░                             │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0      8.8    17.5     26.2   35.0 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Overlay Error ($|\mu| + 3\sigma$)** | $\le 35$ | $\text{nm}$ | CD-SEM / Automated Metrology |
| **EBDW Grid Quantization** | $0.005\ (5)$ | $\mu\text{m}\ (\text{nm})$ | EBDW Stage Encoder Log |
| **Poly Gate Drawn / CD Length** | $150\text{ to }180 \pm 10\%$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM Profile |
| **Poly Gate-to-Gate Spacing** | $\ge 0.21\ (210)$ | $\mu\text{m}\ (\text{nm})$ | Top-down SEM Inspection |

---

### 5. Verified Context Citations
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid**:
  - Maximum permissible gate poly-to-active diffusion overlay error: $\le 35\text{ nm}$.
  - Manufacturing physical placement grid resolution: $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - Minimum poly gate length: $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$); minimum spacing: $0.21\ \mu\text{m}$; minimum active diffusion width: $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology (Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench)**:
  - DRAM access transistor geometry: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Allocating a <=35nm total overlay error budget for gate poly-to-active requires decomposing systematic stage displacement, thermal expansion, mark distortion, and residual unmodeled high-order field distortion. With an EBDW tool operating on a 5nm manufacturing grid, mechanical stepper stages and laser interferometer feedback must maintain residual uncorrectable grid placement error below 12nm (3-sigma) to prevent budget starvation of downstream optical metrology uncertainty (<=8nm) and chemical shrink variations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct-write electron beam correction models rely on 6-parameter affine transformations (translation, magnification, rotation, skew/orthogonality) supplemented by second/third-order polynomial correction maps. However, substrate charging on dielectric isolation and space-charge beam deflection can induce non-linear vector distortions across 100um write fields; verifying residual overlay post-correction requires dense Box-in-Box or AIM (Advanced Imaging Metrology) optical scatterometry arrays cross-correlated against high-resolution CD-SEM registration benchmarks.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: N/A
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The Gen 3 validation milestone must freeze EBDW stepper correction models within 2 tapeout iterations. Failure to isolate residual overlay errors below 35nm prior to poly-gate etch will compromise transfer characteristics and drain-source overlap capacitance, inducing yield fallout across 180nm DRAM test arrays.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Substrate charging and beam drift during EBDW exposure causing dynamic beam deflection and non-correctable residual overlay skew > 35nm.
1. High-order thermo-mechanical expansion of the wafer chuck inducing unmodeled intrafield scaling mismatch between active silicon alignment targets and gate poly.
1. Mark asymmetry and poor optical contrast of active alignment marks following chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP), biasing metrology measurement by > 15nm.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-3-3-3-01` | **Dense Field Systematic vs. Residual Overlay Vector Decomposition** | Automated Optical Overlay Metrology Tool (e.g., KLA Archer series) and High-Resolution Critical Dimension SEM (CD-SEM) calibrated with NIST-traceable pitch standard. | 1. Load wafer into EBDW system and execute automated 4-point active mark global alignment and 16-point intrafield local alignment. 2. Apply first-order affine stepper correction model (translation Dx/Dy, scaling Mx/My, rotation Theta, orthogonality Orth). 3. Expose poly gate layer test layout containing 49-point overlay target arrays per field across 25 fields. 4. Post-exposure develop and bake under class 1 cleanroom conditions. 5. Transfer to optical overlay tool; measure Box-in-Box delta-X and delta-Y at all 1,225 site coordinates. 6. Compute residual vector error: Residual(x,y) = Measured(x,y) - Model(x,y). 7. Cross-check 20 corner and center sites via CD-SEM top-down image registration. | `Total residual overlay vector magnitude (Mean + 3-sigma) <= 35.0 nm across all measured intrafield and interfield sites; systematic model fit residual R^2 >= 0.98.` |
| `TC-EBDW-GATE-PATTERNING-3-3-3-02` | **EBDW Beam Drift and Stepper Correction Stability Under Continuous Exposure** | Laser Interferometer Stage Closed-Loop Monitor, Optical Overlay Metrology System, and Environmental Telemetry Logging System. | 1. Initiate continuous multi-field exposure run spanning 4 hours across consecutive silicon wafers. 2. Re-measure stage position drift via dual-axis laser interferometer at 15-minute intervals. 3. Measure overlay registration mark displacement on field 1 (start) vs. field 25 (end of 4-hour cycle). 4. Calculate dynamic drift component of overlay budget: Drift = sqrt((dX_end - dX_start)^2 + (dY_end - dY_start)^2). 5. Decompose residual stage correction error vectors against environmental temperature and pressure logs. | `Total beam and stage positional drift over 4 hours must not exceed 10.0 nm; maximum single-point residual overlay across entire batch must not exceed 35.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses, Chemical-resistant apron for solvent dispense, Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately flush contaminated area with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes. In case of TMAH exposure, treat skin immediately as a systemic neurotoxin and chemical burn hazard; remove clothing under safety shower and call cleanroom medical emergency. Eye contact: Rinse thoroughly at emergency eye wash station for >= 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Inhalation: Move victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated solvent exhaust laminar flow hood with minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s); e-beam tool vacuum roughing pumps must be vented directly to scrubbed toxic/solvent exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate organic developer solvents (MIBK/IPA) into dedicated halogen-free organic solvent drums; collect TMAH waste into aqueous alkaline waste carboys for controlled neutralization (target pH 6.0-9.0) prior to wastewater plant transfer.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Methyl Isobutyl Ketone (MIBK)** | `108-10-1` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / ULSI) | `> 99.5%` |
| **Isopropanol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (MOS) | `> 99.9%` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade | `2.38%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Planarized active silicon substrate post-gate oxidation (Tox ~ 3.5nm - 4.0nm) and polysilicon deposition, free of organic contamination (contact angle < 10 deg) and surface particulate defects (< 5 adders at 100nm size threshold).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Exposed and developed e-beam resist pattern over polysilicon, post-bake completed (110 deg C / 90 s), residual scum cleared in open alignment boxes, ready for reactive-ion poly gate etching.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne molecular contamination (amine absorption) and native oxide growth inducing resist foot formation, leading to severe gate CD variation and overlay measurement bias exceeding 15nm due to optical edge distortion.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful decomposition of the gate poly-to-active overlay error budget on 180nm open-source DRAM test layouts, verifying that EBDW stepper correction models constrain 3-sigma residual overlay errors strictly within <= 35nm across all 200mm wafer fields.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `overlay_budget_decomposition_report.pdf`
- [ ] `ebdw_residual_vector_map.csv`
- [ ] `cd_sem_registration_validation_images.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total 3-sigma gate poly-to-active residual overlay error (intrafield and interfield combined)** | `32.0 nm` | <= 35.0 nm maximum limit | Automated Box-in-Box optical overlay metrology sampled across 1,225 field sites per wafer. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **EBDW systematic affine model correlation coefficient (R-squared)** | `0.985` | +/- 0.015 | Least-squares linear regression decomposition of translation, rotation, magnification, and non-orthogonality components. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Uncorrected beam and stage thermal/mechanical drift over 4-hour continuous exposure window** | `7.5 nm` | <= 10.0 nm | Dual-axis laser interferometer differential displacement logging and repeat-mark SEM coordinate verification. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal acceptance requires all quantitative assertions to pass across 3 consecutive 200mm test wafers, with 100% of measured overlay sites exhibiting total residual vectors <= 35.0nm, signed off by the Lithography Domain Expert, Systems Metrology Lead, and LAYA Program Manager.

# Standard Operating Procedure: 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation

Overall milestone managing the translation from open-source experimental DRAM cell layouts to commercial 180nm CMOS Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) foundry fabrication.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Adapting a commercial 180nm CMOS MPW baseline for an open-source DRAM architecture introduces extreme layout and verification mismatches: standard digital/analog MPW DRC and LVS decks do not natively support dense stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) or deep trench mask layers without custom foundry rule-deck extensions. Signal integrity on shared bitline contacts (pitch <= 360nm) requires full 3D parasitic extraction (field solver) rather than standard 2.5D RC extraction to avoid underestimating bitline-to-wordline coupling and alpha-induced soft-error margins.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Commercial standard 180nm logic processes lack the dedicated high-thermal-budget steps required for high-k MIM or crown polysilicon capacitor activation (ONO or Ta2O5/Al2O3 dielectric targeting kappa > 15). Attempting to achieve the mandated minimum 28 fF/cell storage capacitance inside an 8F^2 (0.259 um^2) footprint without native trench/stacked modules forces either planar MOM/MIM workarounds with bloated cell area (>50F^2) or unauthorized post-processing steps that degrade front-end access transistor sub-threshold leakage (>1 fA/cell at 85°C).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW shuttles operate on rigid quarterly schedules with strict tapeout freeze windows. Custom layer additions (e.g., custom capacitor top/bottom plate masks) disqualify designs from standard multi-tenant reticle pricing, escalating costs from shared-shuttle tiers (~$10k-$25k) to dedicated mask sets (> $120k). Furthermore, dual-sourcing or transferring open-source PDK GDSII decks across foundries (e.g., SkyWater 130nm to TSMC/UMC/SilTerra 180nm) creates legal IP boundary conflicts and non-standard packaging yield hazards.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The tapeout timeline faces severe critical path compression between PDK DRC/LVS rule clearance, foundry tapeout review signoff, and e-beam reticle data preparation (MDP). Attempting an academic/open-source DRAM cell tapeout on an unmodified commercial MPW without pre-cleared Foundry Waiver Agreements for non-Manhattan capacitor geometries and density rule violations will trigger immediate shuttle rejection at the tapeout gate.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node capacitance collapse (<12 fF vs 28 fF target) due to dielectric thickness variation or aspect-ratio voiding in non-standard tungsten contact plugs.
1. Access transistor threshold shift (Vth droop > 150 mV) and junction leakage exceeding 5 fA/cell caused by thermal budget overshoot during post-FEOL capacitor annealing.
1. Shuttle tapeout gate disqualification due to unresolved dummy metal density, non-standard antenna violations, or unapproved DRC waivers on custom cell arrays.

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level C cleanroom garment system with static dissipative ESD footwear, Double-layer nitrile cleanroom gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness, ASTM D6319 compliant), Chemical splash apron and full-face polycarbonate shield during test bench solvent maintenance, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser eye protection during probe station optical inspection
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin exposure to acid or organic solvents: flush affected area immediately with eyewash or safety shower for a minimum of 15 minutes while removing contaminated cleanroom gear. For solvent inhalation: evacuate immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. In case of accidental ingestion: do NOT induce vomiting; seek emergency medical care immediately with SDS sheets available.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom air exchange under ISO 5 (Class 100) laminar flow; local chemical fume extraction hoods operating at minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) with real-time differential pressure interlocks and organic vapor scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate all spent flammable organic solvents into dedicated grounded stainless steel hazardous waste drums for licensed off-site reclamation. Neutralize acidic wafer-clearing solutions in an automated continuous effluent neutralization system (pH target 6.5 - 8.5) prior to cleanroom drainage release.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 180nm CMOS PDK Setup, Rule Deck Integration & 1T1C DRC/LVS Rule Customization

---

### 1. Architectural & Verification Workflow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["PDK File Hierarchy & Tech Layer Initialization"] --> B["1T1C Custom Layer Definition (COB / MIM / ONO)"]
    B --> C["Physical DRC Deck Customization (L, W, Pitch)"]
    C --> D["LVS Device Extraction Rule Customization (Pass NMOS + 1C)"]
    D --> E["Electrical Overdrive & High-Voltage Compliance (V_PP >= 2.5V-2.8V)"]
    E --> F["Clean DRC / LVS Signoff & Extraction Run"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: PDK Environment Setup & Toolchain Configuration
1. Initialize the 180nm CMOS PDK environment variables and tool mapping (e.g., KLayout, Magic, OpenROAD, or commercial EDA flow).
2. Configure grid resolution to the foundational manufacturing grid (typically 5 nm grid resolution for 180nm node).
3. Set up tech files (`.lyt`, `.tech`, or `.tf`) verifying core GDS layer numbers for active diffusion (`DIFF`), polysilicon gate (`POLY`), contact (`CONT`), metal 1 (`M1`), and tungsten vias (`VIA1` / `W-plug`).

#### Step 2: Custom 1T1C Layer & Geometry Integration
1. Define custom layer mapping for the capacitor-over-bitline (COB) / metal-insulator-metal (MIM) crown structure and top-plate node:
   - Layer `CAP_BTM` (Storage node plug / bottom electrode contact).
   - Layer `CAP_DIEL` (ONO / high-$k$ dielectric mask, effective $\kappa > 15$).
   - Layer `CAP_TOP` (Common plate reference voltage layer).
2. Configure layout geometry rules for the access NMOS transistor:
   - Channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Shared bitline contact layout topology between adjacent cell pairs (8F² / 6F² folded bitline configuration).

#### Step 3: Physical DRC Rule Deck Customization
1. **Gate Dimension Rules**:
   - Enforce exact access NMOS gate length check: `L_gate == 180 nm` (flagging any undersized or oversized gate channels inside the memory array core).
   - Enforce gate width: `W_gate == 220 nm`.
2. **Capacitor Crown & Plug Spacing**:
   - Set minimum spacing between adjacent storage node plugs (`W-plug`) to prevent node-to-node bridging.
   - Constrain dielectric overlap and plate margin around `CAP_BTM` boundaries.
3. **High-Voltage Spacing Constraints**:
   - Establish increased design-rule spacing on wordline paths driven by boosted wordline voltages ($V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V}\text{ to }2.8\text{ V}$), ensuring poly-to-poly and metal spacing prevents dielectric breakdown and TDDB under $V_{PP}$ conditions.

#### Step 4: LVS Device Extraction Deck Customization
1. **Pass NMOS Recognition**:
   - Define extraction rule for access transistor `MN_PASS` recognizing gate terminal tied to Wordline (`WL`), source terminal connected to Bitline contact (`BL`), and drain terminal connected to Storage Node (`SN`).
   - Validate extracted parameters: $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
2. **Capacitor Recognition & Parameter Extraction**:
   - Write custom subcircuit extraction rule `C_STORAGE`:
     ```text
     extract device cap (CAP_BTM, CAP_TOP) with terminals (SN, V_PLATE)
     ```
   - Calibrate extraction area/perimeter capacitance coefficients to match target storage capacitance: minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.
3. **Array Continuity & Node Isolation**:
   - Verify netlist cross-checks confirming no shorting between common reference plate (`V_PLATE` / $V_{DD}/2$) and active substrate/well regions.

#### Step 5: Verification & Extraction Run
1. Execute full DRC verification over the 1T1C test matrix macro; review DRC output report to ensure $0$ rule violations.
2. Execute LVS comparison between schematic 1T1C netlist and extracted GDS layout; ensure 100% net, pin, and instance equivalence.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
             180nm 1T1C Physical & Electrical Targets   
           ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
           │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■│
   W_g (nm)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■│
           │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░        │
   L_g (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░        │
   V_th (V)┤▒                                          │
           │▒                                          │
   V_PP (V)┤▓▓                                         │
           │▓▓                                         │
C_cell (fF)┤██████                                     │
           │██████                                     │
           └┬──────────┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬┘
            0         55        110        165      220 
```

| Metric ID | Parameter | Verification Method | Target Spec | Tolerance / Limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **AC-01** | Access Transistor Dimensions | DRC / LVS Extraction | $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | Exactly $\pm 0\text{ nm}$ DRC grid error |
| **AC-02** | Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_{\text{cell}}$) | Post-Layout LVS/PEX | $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ | $\ge 28.0\text{ fF/cell}$ minimum |
| **AC-03** | Total Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$) | SPICE Simulation at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ | Maximum ceiling limit |
| **AC-04** | Wordline Boost Overdrive Voltage ($V_{PP}$) | DRC Deck High-Voltage Rule Check | $2.5\text{ V}\text{ to }2.8\text{ V}$ | Full clearance under boosted $V_{PP}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources & Citations
- **Source: High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
  - Access transistor threshold voltage $V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{ V to }0.7\text{ V}$ (nominal $0.6\text{ V}$).
  - Full write without threshold loss requirement: boosted wordline driver $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\text{ V to }2.8\text{ V}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Physical geometry: gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node structure: tungsten plug (W-plug), ONO / high-$k$ stack with effective $\kappa > 15$.
  - Target storage capacitance: minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Leakage requirement: sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-1-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-1-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

# Standard Operating Procedure: 1T1C Unit Cell Layout & Shared-Contact Active Area Design

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F^2 folded bitline architecture at the 180nm node, sharing the bitline contact across two adjacent access transistors introduces severe parasitic capacitance (C_BL) coupling to wordlines and adjacent active diffusion islands. Routing of the wordline pitch (360-400nm) and bitline pitch must preserve sufficient sense margin (delta V_BL >= 150mV) under worst-case bitline-to-cell capacitance ratios (C_BL/C_s <= 8). The access transistor aspect ratio (W=220nm, L=180nm) must be verified against back-bias substrate sensitivity to prevent sub-threshold leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The active area (OD/RX) layout for shared bitline contacts demands precise optical proximity correction (OPC) on line-end extensions to avoid bridging or corner rounding, which causes asymmetric drain junction areas between twin cells. Furthermore, positioning the tungsten storage node plug (SN contact) directly over the source diffusion requires stringent overlay margins (< 25nm 3-sigma) to prevent punch-through to the wordline spacer or substrate isolation (STI) edge leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm standard CMOS MPW tapeouts (e.g., TSMC 0.18um, SilTerra, or SkyWater 130/180nm variants) typically lack native DRAM crown/trench high-k capacitor modules (Ta2O5/Al2O3). Fabricating the 28 fF storage capacitor without a specialized DRAM add-on requires utilizing native multi-layer MIM (Metal-Insulator-Metal) capacitors or high-density vertical fringe metal capacitors (MOM/VPP), which may balloon the unit cell area beyond the theoretical 8F^2 (0.259 um^2) unless non-standard foundry process steps are formally qualified.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Custom 1T1C layout integration must adhere to standard MPW design rule checks (DRC), layout versus schematic (LVS), and antenna rules within foundry schedule deadlines. Tapeout signoff cannot absorb custom mask redesign cycles; therefore, design margins on active diffusion enclosure of contact plugs (>= 30nm) and wordline end-cap overlaps must be frozen early with automated regression checks prior to tapeout submission.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. STI-diffusion edge dishing and leakage caused by lithographic line-end pullback at the shared bitline contact node.
1. Overlay misalignment between contact plug (W-plug) and active area inducing catastrophic shorting to the p-well substrate.
1. Excessive sub-threshold or trap-assisted gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) exceeding 1 fA/cell, degrading data retention below 64 ms at 85°C.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-01` | **1T1C Shared-Contact Active Area DRC/LVS and Parasitic Extraction Verification** | Calibre DRC/LVS & StarRC Extraction Toolsuite running on Linux EDA Server | 1. Ingest GDSII layout into Calibre nmDRC engine with strict DRAM array rule extensions enabled. 2. Execute LVS comparison against full-custom 1T1C transistor-level schematic netlist including dummy boundary cells. 3. Run StarRC field-solver parasitic extraction to extract coupled bitline capacitance (C_BL) and storage node parasitic capacitance (C_sn). 4. Calculate total storage capacitance including target capacitor model (28 fF) and verify C_BL/C_s ratio across process corners (FF, TT, SS). | `Zero DRC violations, zero LVS discrepancies (device count and port pin matches 100%), and extracted bitline parasitics C_BL <= 180 fF per 64-cell column segment with C_BL/C_s ratio <= 6.5.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-02` | **Access Transistor Sub-threshold and Junction Leakage TCAD/SPICE Simulation** | Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre RF Circuit Simulator with BSIM4 Model | 1. Configure access transistor drain at V_DD = 1.8V (representing stored '1') and bitline at 0V (standby unselected state). 2. Set wordline gate voltage V_WL = 0V. 3. Apply substrate back-bias V_sub = -0.5V. 4. Run DC operating point sweep and transient retention simulation over a 128 ms window at 85°C. 5. Integrate total current escaping storage node node to determine cumulative leakage. | `Off-state leakage current I_off <= 0.85 fA at V_ds = 1.8V and T = 85°C; total retained storage node voltage after 64 ms >= 1.45V (corresponding to retained charge Q_rem >= 40.6 fC with C_s = 28 fF).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A chemical splash apron and neoprene chemical-resistant sleeves, Heavy-duty butyl rubber over-gloves paired with Class 100 cleanroom nitrile under-gloves, Full-face polycarbonate chemical splash shield (ANSI Z87.1 certified), Continuous-flow supplied-air respirator or acid-gas chemical cartridge half-mask respirator
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately rinse affected area with copious laminar water for exactly 2 minutes, then aggressively massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel into skin using a gloved hand; continue application every 15 minutes until emergency medical transport arrives. Provide calcium gluconate subcutaneous injection protocol for medical personnel. For Piranha contact: Deluge flush under emergency shower for >= 15 minutes, remove contaminated PPE, do not apply neutralizing bases directly to burning tissue.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous dedicated scrubbed laminar wet-bench acid exhaust with face velocity maintained at 100-120 FPM (0.51-0.61 m/s), integrated with automatic low-flow differential pressure interlocks (< 0.25 in. w.g. triggers alarm and cuts chemical delivery).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluorinated acid drains directly routed to industrial fluoride waste precipitation system utilizing calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) to precipitate calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge, followed by dual-stage pH neutralization to 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (BOE 6:1)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI / Semiconductor Grade | `6.8% HF / 34.6% NH4F aqueous` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha Clean)** | `7664-93-9` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C12) | `96.0% H2SO4` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C10) | `30.0% H2O2` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched active area contact openings (W-plug vias) with photoresist stripped and dilute-HF pre-metal native oxide etched.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Chemical vapor deposited Ti/TiN barrier liner passivating silicon contact interfaces prior to chemical vapor deposition of bulk tungsten (W) contact fill.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide re-growth (> 0.8 nm SiO2) at the silicon/silicide interface within high-aspect-ratio contact holes, elevating specific contact resistance (R_c) from < 15 ohm to > 350 ohm and causing non-functional cell read/write access.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F^2 folded bitline architecture at the 180nm node, sharing the bitline contact across two adjacent access transistors introduces severe parasitic capacitance (C_BL) coupling to wordlines and adjacent active diffusion islands. Routing of the wordline pitch (360-400nm) and bitline pitch must preserve sufficient sense margin (delta V_BL >= 150mV) under worst-case bitline-to-cell capacitance ratios (C_BL/C_s <= 8). The access transistor aspect ratio (W=220nm, L=180nm) must be verified against back-bias substrate sensitivity to prevent sub-threshold leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.
critics.domain_expert: The active area (OD/RX) layout for shared bitline contacts demands precise optical proximity correction (OPC) on line-end extensions to avoid bridging or corner rounding, which causes asymmetric drain junction areas between twin cells. Furthermore, positioning the tungsten storage node plug (SN contact) directly over the source diffusion requires stringent overlay margins (< 25nm 3-sigma) to prevent punch-through to the wordline spacer or substrate isolation (STI) edge leakage.
critics.supply_chain: Commercial 180nm standard CMOS MPW tapeouts (e.g., TSMC 0.18um, SilTerra, or SkyWater 130/180nm variants) typically lack native DRAM crown/trench high-k capacitor modules (Ta2O5/Al2O3). Fabricating the 28 fF storage capacitor without a specialized DRAM add-on requires utilizing native multi-layer MIM (Metal-Insulator-Metal) capacitors or high-density vertical fringe metal capacitors (MOM/VPP), which may balloon the unit cell area beyond the theoretical 8F^2 (0.259 um^2) unless non-standard foundry process steps are formally qualified.
critics.laya_pm: Custom 1T1C layout integration must adhere to standard MPW design rule checks (DRC), layout versus schematic (LVS), and antenna rules within foundry schedule deadlines. Tapeout signoff cannot absorb custom mask redesign cycles; therefore, design margins on active diffusion enclosure of contact plugs (>= 30nm) and wordline end-cap overlaps must be frozen early with automated regression checks prior to tapeout submission.
critical_failure_modes: STI-diffusion edge dishing and leakage caused by lithographic line-end pullback at the shared bitline contact node.
Overlay misalignment between contact plug (W-plug) and active area inducing catastrophic shorting to the p-well substrate.
Excessive sub-threshold or trap-assisted gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) exceeding 1 fA/cell, degrading data retention below 64 ms at 85°C.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Active Area Island & Dual-Cell Shared Contact Diffusion Layout

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C architecture, sharing the bitline diffusion contact between dual access transistors minimizes active footprint, but induces tight parasitic coupling and severe narrow-width/corner stress effects on the shallow trench isolation (STI) boundary. If the active area island corner rounding during 248nm KrF DUV photolithography is unmitigated, effective transistor width fluctuates beyond +-5%, impacting sensing margin and read/write access speed. Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) dog-bone serifs must be strictly parameterized on the diffusion corners.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node (access channel L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm), the junction leakage at the shared bitline drain/substrate interface must not compromise the sub-1 fA/cell leakage target at 85°C. Excessive silicide encroachment (TiSi2/CoSi2) or micro-trenching damage during contact etch creates deep trap states within the space-charge region, triggering Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) generation and trap-assisted tunneling that degrade data retention and refresh margin well below the 64 ms JEDEC specification.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW runs impose rigid standard design rules (DRC) and fixed mask reticle schedules. Implementing non-standard sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) or aggressive diffusion-to-contact enclosure within the shared dual-cell junction risks foundry engineering review holds or DRC rule waivers. We must constrain the layout enclosure and spacing to validated foundry MPW baseline rule decks (e.g. TSMC 0.18um or SilTerra 0.18um) to prevent mask spin rejections and wafer start delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-cell layout signoff directly gated physical verification for the entire 1T1C core array tile. Tapeout schedule margin allows zero iterations for post-OPC DRC violations. The active island geometry and shared contact landing pad must freeze by milestone M2 to enable parasitic extraction (PEX) corner simulations and peripheral decoder pitch matching on schedule without incurring multi-project wafer shuttle penalties.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Silicide spiking or contact punch-through across the shallow n+/p-well junction at the shared bitline node, causing catastrophic leakage (>100 pA) and stuck-at-0 retention failure.
1. STI divot formation and active corner rounding causing parasitic corner-conduction transistors with low threshold voltage (Vt drop >150 mV), resulting in intolerable sub-threshold leakage between adjacent cell storage nodes.
1. Misalignment of the shared contact plug beyond 25 nm onto the active-isolation boundary, resulting in catastrophic contact-to-substrate short circuits or high contact resistance R_c > 150 Ohm.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-1-01` | **Dual-Cell Shared Bitline Diffusion Contact Resistivity & TLM Parameter Extraction** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer connected to a semi-automated cryogenic/hot chuck wafer prober (MPI TS2000-SE) with Kelvin 4-wire sensing needles. | 1. Force DC current sweep I_force from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA across adjacent TLM pads across all gap intervals d. 2. Measure corresponding voltage drop V_meas with 4-point Kelvin resolution to extract total resistance R_T(d). 3. Perform linear regression on R_T versus d: extract slope (R_s/W) to calculate sheet resistance R_s, and Y-intercept to obtain twice the contact resistance (2*R_c). 4. Calculate transfer length L_T and specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Specific contact resistivity rho_c must be <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2; single shared bitline contact resistance R_c must be <= 45.0 Ohm; linear regression coefficient R^2 must be >= 0.998.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-1-02` | **Shared Junction Off-State Reverse Leakage and Area/Perimeter Component Extraction** | Keithley 4200A-SCS Parameter Analyzer configured with 4201-SMU preamplifiers providing sub-femtoamp resolution, inside an EMI-shielded dark Faraday cage. | 1. Ground the p-well substrate contact (V_sub = 0.0 V) and tie both adjacent transfer wordlines to V_off = -0.5 V to ensure deep sub-threshold cutoff. 2. Apply reverse bias voltage sweep to the shared bitline diffusion contact from V_diff = 0.0 V to V_dd = 1.80 V in 20 mV increments. 3. Sample reverse leakage current I_leak at V_diff = 1.80 V with an integration time of 64 power line cycles (NPLC = 64). 4. Normalize measured leakage across the 100,000 parallel shared contact nodes. | `Total reverse junction leakage per dual-cell shared node at 85°C and V_diff = 1.80 V must be <= 0.85 fA/node (0.425 fA/cell equivalent); breakdown voltage BV_dss (defined at 1 nA total current) must exceed 3.30 V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical splash apron and full-face shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Heavy-duty butyl/Viton composite over-gloves with nitrile under-gloves, Flame-resistant anti-static cleanroom bunny suit with chemically resistant boots, Emergency personal HF/acid vapor monitoring badge
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid exposure: Immediately flush affected dermal area with emergency safety shower for 120 seconds; continuously massage 2.5% calcium gluconate topical gel into the skin until pain subsides and medical emergency responders arrive. For ocular contact, irrigate with sterile isotonic saline or 1% calcium gluconate eye-wash for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation, administer 100% humidified oxygen and 2.5% nebulized calcium gluconate solution under immediate medical supervision.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous acid/corrosive wet bench laminar exhaust operating at face velocity >= 0.55 m/s (110 FPM) with dual-point differential static pressure monitoring (< -0.25 kPa) interlocked directly with chemical auto-dispense valves; redundant dedicated wet-scrubber exhaust tie-in.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluoride-bearing acidic wastewater drain connected to an automated automated calcium chloride / lime precipitation neutralization skid (yielding insoluble CaF2 precipitate, maintaining effluent fluoride < 10 ppm and pH 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal industrial discharge).

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Dilute Pre-Silicide/Contact Clean)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier C / Ultra-Pure Electronic Grade (UP-S) | `0.5% wt aqueous solution (100:1 DHF)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (SPM/Piranha Clean Component)** | `7722-84-1` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `30% wt aqueous solution` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (SPM/Piranha Clean Component)** | `7664-93-9` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `96% wt concentrated solution` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (SC-1 Standard Clean-1 Component)** | `1336-21-6` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `29% wt NH3 basis` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated, native-oxide-free silicon active diffusion surface immediately following post-contact-etch dilute HF (100:1 DHF) dip and megasonic deionized water rinse (contact angle > 75 degrees).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal atomic layer deposition (ALD) titanium/titanium nitride (Ti/TiN) barrier/adhesion liner seed layer (minimum 5 nm Ti / 10 nm TiN) hermetically capping the contact trench before tungsten CVD plug deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time causes uncontrolled native oxide (SiO2) regrowth (> 8 Angstroms) and airborne molecular contamination (volatile organics, sulfur), causing contact interfacial resistance spikes (R_c > 200 Ohm) and barrier delamination during tungsten plug CMP.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical layout verification, parasitic extraction signoff, and empirical test coupon validation for the 180nm 8F2 dual-cell active area island and shared bitline diffusion contact, demonstrating compliant specific contact resistivity, zero DRC/LVS/antenna errors, and sub-1 fA off-state junction leakage.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_8f2_shared_active_layout_signoff.gds`
- [ ] `dual_cell_tlm_contact_resistivity_metrics.csv`
- [ ] `shared_bitline_drc_lvs_pex_validation_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Specific contact resistivity (rho_c) of the shared bitline contact on n+ diffusion** | `3.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2` | <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2 maximum | Kelvin 4-wire DC sweep on on-chip TLM pad series (gap progression 5-80 um) with linear regression Y-intercept extraction. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Dual-cell access transistor active area island physical width (W_active) after OPC optical rule check** | `220 nm` | +- 8 nm (3-sigma optical critical dimension CD variation) | CD-SEM top-down metrology across 30 die sites per wafer post-lithography and post-reactive ion etch. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Normalized reverse junction leakage per dual-cell shared node at 85°C and V_diff = 1.80 V** | `0.45 fA/node` | <= 0.85 fA/node maximum | Keithley 4200A-SCS high-integration DC parameter extraction on 100k-node shared bitline test coupon. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean foundry MPW DRC, LVS, and ERC rule decks with zero waivers on active enclosure of contact; automated Calibre PEX extraction confirming bitline shared contact parasitic capacitance C_par <= 0.12 fF; and physical coupon test proving specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Active Area Island Design Rule Parameterization & $8F^2$ Unit Cell Grid Setup

---

### 1. Process Overview & Grid Architecture Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Define 8F2 Grid:   │
│     Pitch 360nm      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Active Area Island  │
│        Sizing        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Shared Contact    │
│   Diffusion Pitch    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      DRC & Grid      │
│     Verification     │

                    │●●●●                              │
  Capacitance Target┤●●●●                              │
                    │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■                │
  Channel Length (L)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■                │
      Diff Width (W)┤█████████████████████             │
                    │█████████████████████             │
Cell Pitch (F=180nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│

```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Layout & Parameterization Procedure

1. **Cell Grid Definition ($8F^2$ Footprint Setup)**:
   - Configure layout grid snap resolution to $1\,\text{nm}$ (manufacturing grid).
   - Set the feature size $F = 180\,\text{nm}$.
   - Establish orthogonal grid pitches:
     - Wordline (WL) Pitch $= 2F = 360\,\text{nm}$ (within the $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$ design window).
     - Bitline (BL) Pitch $= 4F = 720\,\text{nm}$ (or $2F \times 4F$ cell boundary yielding the target unit cell area $A_{\text{cell}} = 8F^2 = 8 \times (0.18\,\mu\text{m})^2 = 0.2592\,\mu\text{m}^2$).

2. **Active Area (OD / Diffusion) Island Parameterization**:
   - Draw the continuous dual-cell active area diffusion island spanning two access transistors sharing a central bitline node:
     - Diffusion Width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
     - Access Transistor Gate Channel Length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$.
   - Position two pass gates per island separated by the central bitline shared node diffusion segment.

3. **Shared Contact Node & Outer Storage Node Geometry**:
   - Layout the central shared bitline diffusion contact area to accommodate a shared bitline tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Set the storage node diffusion contact extensions on both outer ends of the island to receive the storage node capacitor contacts (W-plugs underneath the crown-shaped stacked capacitors).

4. **Dielectric & Design Rule Integrity Check**:
   - Ensure the gate oxide perimeter over the active region is prepared for the thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric ($3.5\,\text{nm}$ physical thickness grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Verify layout design rule constraints (OD enclosing contact, gate extension over OD, and OD-to-OD spacing in adjacent array tracks).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Measurement Tolerance | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pass Transistor Physical Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | $\pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Pass Transistor Active Width ($W$)** | `220` | $\pm 2$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Wordline / Bitline Grid Pitch** | `360` (to `400`) | Exact grid snap / $\pm 1$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cell Stacked Capacitance Budget** | $\ge 28$ (acceptable: `25` to `30`) | $\ge 28.0$ minimum | $\text{fF}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source 1: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Validates $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline layout topologies.
  - Fixes access transistor dimensions: channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
  - Confirms shared bitline contact geometry between two adjacent cells, tungsten plug (W-plug) connection, and minimum storage capacitance budget of $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ (with leakage $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Validates bitline and wordline pitch window of $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$.
  - Confirms gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ and storage capacitance range of $25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Parameterizing an 8F2 unit cell on a 180nm commercial MPW node requires co-optimizing wordline pitch (2F = 360nm) and bitline pitch (4F = 720nm) under STI lithographic corner-rounding constraints. Optical proximity effects at active area line ends (pullback exceeding 35nm) directly threaten the shared-contact enclosure and drive unmodeled junction leakage under substrate bias fluctuations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline topology, two access transistors share a single bitline contact while their isolated storage nodes terminate at opposite active area ends. With an overlay budget capped at <= 35nm and KrF 248nm DUV Rayleigh half-pitch resolution limits (R ~ 152nm at NA=0.65, k1=0.40), the active island perimeter must maintain an active-to-poly enclosure of at least 70nm post-OPC to avoid gate cut-off and subthreshold punch-through during read precharge.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Implementing aggressive 8F2 DRAM layout pitches on an open MPW shuttle (such as SkyWater SKY130 or TSMC 180nm mixed-signal runs) risks mask fracturing rejections or DUV reticle rule violations if non-standard manufacturing grid snapping (< 5nm) is applied. Multi-project wafer runs do not permit custom sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) or phase-shift masks (PSM) on base layers, making conservative spacing rules critical for yield survival.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Delivery milestone for active diffusion parameterization and 8F2 unit cell floorplanning must freeze layout parameterized cells (PCells) within the sprint schedule. Unverified active area geometry changes propagate through contact placement and cell-plate metallization, creating schedule-killing layout versus schematic (LVS) discrepancies across the entire bitcell array matrix.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Active area end-of-line lithographic pullback causing shared contact-to-STI punch-through and extreme sub-surface junction leakage (> 100 nA per node).
1. DUV KrF gate-to-active overlay misalignment exceeding 35nm, resulting in gate dielectric edge breakdown or complete asymmetric channel conductance truncation.
1. Grid snap truncation errors against the 5nm manufacturing grid introducing non-orthogonal geometry fracturings and mask DRC flag rejections.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Import GDSII layout of 32x32 array of 8F2 unit cells into the DRC engine. 2. Run active area island width (diff.1) and active-to-active spacing across STI (diff.2) design rule check decks. 3. Perform 2D lithography aerial contour simulation at lambda=248nm, NA=0.65 to extract line-end pullback and corner rounding. 4. Measure residual enclosure distance from shared contact outer edge to active island boundary across all worst-case overlay shift vectors (+/-35nm X/Y). | `Active diffusion drawn width exactly 180nm +/- 0nm grid deviation; post-litho simulated end-of-line pullback <= 28nm; contact-to-STI enclosure margin >= 45nm under 35nm lateral overlay translation.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-1-1-02` | **Sub-Micron Access Transistor Linear Threshold Voltage and Off-State Leakage Validation** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station | 1. Apply substrate bias V_B = -0.5 V to simulate DRAM well biasing. 2. Set drain-source bias V_DS = 50 mV for linear transconductance extraction. 3. Sweep gate voltage V_GS from -0.5 V to +1.8 V in 10 mV steps and record I_DS. 4. Extract linear threshold voltage (V_thn) via maximum transconductance (g_m) extrapolation. 5. Set V_DS = 1.8 V, V_GS = 0.0 V, and measure off-state drain leakage current I_off. | `Linear threshold voltage V_thn must measure +0.55 V +/- 50 mV (0.50 V to 0.60 V); off-state leakage current I_off must be <= 10 pA/um (<= 3.6 pA for drawn W = 0.36 um) at 25 deg C.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash goggles with ANSI Z87.1 certification, Double-layer heavy-duty butyl rubber chemical gloves over nitrile gloves, Full chemical-resistant PTFE apron and full-face polycarbonate splash shield, Acid-gas certified powered air-purifying respirator (PAPR) during chemical bath replenishment
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF dermal exposure: Immediately flush skin with copious cold water for exactly 2 minutes, then continuously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into the affected area until medical personnel arrive. In case of vapor inhalation: Administer 100% medical oxygen and transfer immediately to an acute burn/toxicology unit. For Piranha contact: Drench under emergency shower for >= 15 minutes, removing contaminated attire.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous laminar wet-bench exhaust operating with a minimum capture face velocity of 0.50 m/s (100 FPM); connected to a dedicated dedicated acid/HF polypropylene scrubber with negative static pressure monitoring and automatic airflow failover alarms.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: HF effluents must be segregated into designated fluoride-bearing waste lines; treated via automated calcium hydroxide [Ca(OH)2] precipitation yielding insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) cake; supernatant pH buffered to 6.5 - 8.5 before discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Buffered Oxide Etch 6:1)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier C / Ultra-Pure Microelectronics Grade | `6.8% HF / 34.6% NH4F` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha Clean Component)** | `7664-93-9` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 4 | `96.0% H2SO4` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Piranha Clean Component)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade / MOS Grade | `30.0% H2O2` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-diffusion RCA-cleaned silicon wafer exhibiting complete hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated native oxide-free surface (contact angle > 75 deg).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry thermal sacrificial screening oxide (10nm +/- 0.5nm SiO2) uniformly grown, passivating active channel areas against atmospheric hydrocarbon contamination.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (> 0.8 nm) and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) organic deposition causing non-uniform channel doping during threshold implant and gate dielectric pinhole defects.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verifiable parametric GDSII cell library for 8F2 unit cell active area layout, establishing complete 5nm grid alignment, DRC zero-error clean deck validation, and lithographic simulation compliance under worst-case overlay shifts.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_8f2_active_area_pcell_v1.0.gds`
- [ ] `calibre_drc_lvs_active_grid_signoff.pdf`
- [ ] `test_transistor_active_diffusion_metrology.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **8F2 unit cell active diffusion island width and length grid conformance** | `0.180 um width, 0.720 um length on 0.005 um grid` | +/- 0.000 um grid snapping error; +/- 0.005 um drawn dimension | Automated DRC boundary coordinate vertex parser against 5nm manufacturing grid. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Shared-contact active diffusion enclosure margin under worst-case overlay error** | `45.0 nm enclosure margin` | -0.0 nm / +15.0 nm (minimum threshold: >= 45.0 nm) | Geometric boolean DRC enclosure extraction at +/-35nm orthogonal poly/active shift vectors. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% zero-violation DRC clean report for active diffusion layer and unit cell grid bounds across a 1024-cell array, with automated TCAD litho aerial contour showing >= 45nm contact enclosure margins under a 35nm overlay translation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dual-Cell Shared Bitline Contact Diffusion Island Polygon Synthesis & Layout
**PDK & Technology Generation:** 180nm CMOS MPW Tapeout (Gen 3)  
**Layout Level:** 8F² Folded Bitline 1T1C Memory Unit Cell  
**Document Link:** [sop_dual_cell_diffusion_layout.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_dual_cell_diffusion_layout.md)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Synthesis Flow

---

### 2. Physical Dimensions & Geometry Chart

                0        90       180       270     360

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Layout Synthesis Procedure

1. **Active Diffusion Island (OD/DIFF) Polygon Initialization:**
   - Instantiate an active area rectangle on the active layer (`OD` / `DIFF`) with total channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure boundary isolation against neighboring cell islands respecting the minimum bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
2. **Dual Wordline Gate Poly Layer Crossing:**
   - Route two parallel poly-silicon gate strips (Wordline $0$ and Wordline $1$) intersecting the active island perpendicularly.
   - Set drawn poly gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ for both access NMOS devices.
   - Enforce poly end-cap extension beyond the OD island edge by standard DRC overhang rules to eliminate edge source-drain punch-through.
3. **Shared Central Bitline Contact Landing Area Formation:**
   - Synthesize the shared diffusion region between the two wordlines to serve as the shared bitline contact pad.
   - Target central spacing between the two $180\text{ nm}$ wordlines to accommodate the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact with symmetric source/drain diffusion enclosures.
4. **Outer Storage Node Contact Diffusion Tabs:**
   - Symmetrically extend the outer ends of the diffusion island on either side of the dual gate conductors to form the two distinct storage node drain contacts.
   - Ensure the area interfaces with upper stacked capacitor contacts (W-plug vias) directly underneath the crown/cylinder storage nodes.
5. **Physical DRC / LVS Extraction & Netlist Validation:**
   - Execute DRC deck verifying active area min-area, active-to-active spacing, poly enclosure on active, and contact-to-gate spacing.
   - Run layout-versus-schematic (LVS) extraction confirming dual NMOS transistors with common source node (BL) and independent storage node drains.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180 \pm 0$ (drawn) | $\text{nm}$ | Physical DRC / GDSII Polygon Ruler |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220 \pm 0$ (drawn) | $\text{nm}$ | Physical DRC / GDSII Polygon Ruler |
| **Bitline & Wordline Grid Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | LVS / DRC Array Pitch Verification |
| **Cell Off-State Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE BSIM Extraction ($V_{DD} = 1.8\text{V}$) |

---

### 5. Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - L = $180\text{ nm}$, W = $220\text{ nm}$, bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ for 8F² folded bitline layout with tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 8F² folded bitline architecture, bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric dry $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$, retention requirement $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Active Area DRC Verification & Diffusion-to-Gate Overlay Margin Metrology Analysis

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > 1T1C Unit Cell Layout & Shared-Contact Active Area Design [Circuit Design] > Active Area Island & Dual-Cell Shared Contact Diffusion Layout [Circuit Design] > Active Area DRC Verification & Diffusion-to-Gate Overlay Margin Metrology Analysis [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM layout at the 180nm node (cell area ~0.259 um2), active area (OD/diffusion) to polysilicon gate (PO) overlay margins directly define access transistor effective channel length (L_eff) and shared-contact junction area. Any systematic or random lithographic drift eating into the end-cap or source/drain extension margins alters the junction capacitance (C_j) and access transistor drive current (I_on), skewing the critical bitline-to-storage-node capacitance ratio (C_b / C_s) beyond the targeted 5:1 to 9:1 operating window. DRC clean status alone is insufficient without optical proximity correction (OPC) aware Monte Carlo overlay yield modeling.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The dual-cell shared contact node connects two adjacent access transistors to a single bitline contact pad. For 180nm commercial MPW rules, minimum gate-to-active overlay tolerance must account for post-CMP dishing and line-end pullback (tip-to-side rounding). If diffusion-to-gate overlay shifts along the channel direction by more than 20nm, the shared source/drain active landing area shrinks asymmetrically, inflating contact resistivity (rho_c) well above the 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm2 boundary dictated by Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) specs, while risking punch-through on the contracted side.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW shuttles impose strict multi-project wafer DRC deck validations and rigid lithography design rules. If custom active area geometries trigger DRC waivers or borderline enclosure violations, the foundry will reject the GDSII/OASIS submission or downgrade wafer fabrication priority, driving cost overruns and delaying prototype tapeout cycles by 3 to 6 months across packaging and automated test equipment (ATE) logistics schedules.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-cell active island DRC verification and overlay metrology signoff sit on the critical path preceding bitline contact module tapeout. Schedule risk escalates rapidly if physical verification fails to flag marginal diffusion end-cap clearances prior to optical rule checking (ORC). Milestone closure mandates 100% automated DRC clearance without manual waiver dependencies, backed by verified overlay CD-SEM metrology reports across nominal and worst-case corner skews.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Lithographic gate-to-diffusion overlay displacement causing severe access transistor asymmetric L_eff shrinkage, threshold voltage roll-off, and off-state subthreshold leakage (I_off > 10 pA/cell) degrading DRAM data retention time.
1. Dual-cell shared bitline contact landing encroachment onto STI/OD boundary due to diffusion pullback, inducing catastrophic junction leakage, junction silicide spiking, and bitline-to-substrate short circuits.
1. Insufficient poly gate end-cap extension over active diffusion edge leading to gate line-end shortening, parasitic edge transistor conduction, and array-wide subthreshold leakage paths.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-1-3-01` | **Automated DRC Clearance & Diffusion-to-Gate Overlay Margin Verification** | Calibre DRC / KLayout DRC Engine with foundry 180nm standard Rule Deck (rev 1.4a) and GDSII stream analyzer | 1. Ingest core array GDSII layout into DRC physical verification suite using foundry-certified standard runset. 2. Execute geometric check rules: OD.W.1 (min active width 220nm), OD.S.1 (min active space 280nm), PO.E.1 (poly gate endcap extension over active >= 180nm), and PO.S.OD (poly-to-active spacing >= 100nm). 3. Extract boundary overlay margins between active island boundary and poly gate edges under +/-25nm grid shift perturbations along X and Y axes. 4. Generate DRC error log and geometric margin distribution histogram. | `Zero DRC violations across all core array cells (0 errors on OD.W.1, OD.S.1, PO.E.1, and PO.S.OD); minimum calculated worst-case physical overlay margin between active edge and poly gate edge must be >= 35.0 nm across all simulated corner shifts.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-1-3-02` | **Shared Bitline Contact Diffusion Enclosure Metrology & TLM Contact Resistivity Extraction** | Automated CD-SEM (Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope) overlay inspection station and automated 4-point probe electrical nanoprober connected to parametric analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Align CD-SEM to the shared-contact active landing areas across 9 wafer sites (center, 4 edge, 4 middle points) and measure physical diffusion-to-contact enclosure (delta_x, delta_y). 2. Measure total resistance R_T across progressively spaced TLM pads at 25 deg C with 100 uA forced current. 3. Perform linear regression on R_T vs. d to extract diffusion sheet resistance R_s (slope * W) and contact resistance R_c (Y-intercept / 2). 4. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Active diffusion contact enclosure must measure >= 45.0 nm on all 4 sides under CD-SEM metrology; specific contact resistivity rho_c must satisfy rho_c <= 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm2 with linear regression R^2 >= 0.998.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash goggles and full-face polycarbonate shield, Double-layer heavy-duty nitrile over fluoropolymer/neoprene chemical resistance gloves, Flame-retardant anti-static cleanroom gowning suit with chemical apron, Closed-toe ESD chemical-resistant safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of HF dermal exposure: Immediately flush affected skin with copious flowing water for 2 minutes, then generously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the exposed area continuously until medical help arrives. For eye contact: Irrigate eyes continuously with sterile isotonic saline or 1% calcium gluconate eye wash solution for 15 minutes. For acid vapor inhalation: Evacuate victim to fresh air immediately and administer oxygen by certified medical staff.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous dedicated scrubbed laminar wet-bench exhaust operating at face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) with real-time negative static pressure interlocks and automated HF/acid vapor toxic gas monitoring detection sensors.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated automated fluoride and corrosive waste drain line routed to an industrial wastewater neutralization facility. Acidic effluent is neutralized with automated calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) dosing to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge, followed by pH buffering between 6.5 and 8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/SEMI Grade 1 | `49% wt aqueous` |
| **Sulfuric Acid** | `7664-93-9` | Electronic Grade (EG) | `96% wt aqueous` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | VLSI / Ultra-Pure | `30% wt aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-gate/pre-salicide active diffusion area chemically stripped of native oxide via dilute HF clean, exhibiting a hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (water contact angle > 70 deg).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Stabilized thermal gate oxide dielectric grown or ultra-thin passivating chemical screening oxide layer (> 1.2 nm thickness) preventing uncontrolled ambient native oxide regrowth.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air exposure causes spontaneous native oxide growth (> 4 Angstroms) and atmospheric hydrocarbon/fluorine chemisorption on exposed diffusion windows, precipitating unrepairable contact resistance spikes (> 5x nominal), interfacial silicide voids, and localized pinhole dielectric breakdown.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> 100% automated physical DRC signoff and CD-SEM/electrical overlay verification for 180nm 8F2 DRAM active island and shared contact layouts, confirming robust gate-to-diffusion enclosure margins and sub-threshold leakage stability compliant with commercial MPW foundry tapeout criteria.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_active_overlay_drc_report.pdf`
- [ ] `active_to_gate_overlay_metrology_data.csv`
- [ ] `shared_contact_enclosure_cdsem_inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry rule deck DRC violation count across 1T1C active diffusion, poly gate, and shared bitline contact layers** | `0` | +0 | Calibre DRC full-chip hierarchical verification log analysis |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Minimum physical gate-to-diffusion overlay margin under simulated lithography alignment variation** | `35.0` | >= 35.0 nm (min threshold) | Automated CAD layout edge-to-edge boolean measurement and CD-SEM cross-wafer metrology |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Specific contact resistivity (rho_c) extracted from active diffusion TLM structures** | `0.85e-7` | <= 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm2 | 4-point probe parametric Kelvin TLM electrical measurement with linear regression extraction |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full physical verification signoff achieved with zero DRC violations on active, poly, and contact layers, verifiable overlay margin exceeding 35.0 nm across all process skews, and empirical TLM contact resistivity validated below 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm2 approved by Lead Integration and Tapeout Signoff Reviewers.
