# Standard Operating Procedure: Access Transistor Gate Routing & 8F2 Wordline Pitch Implementation

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Bondwire loop height (< 150 um) and parasitic bondwire inductance (target < 1.2 nH) must not degrade DDR power distribution network (PDN) or induce simultaneous switching noise (SSN). Pinout strictly conforms to JEDEC TSOP-54 / FBGA-60.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Wafer backgrinding to 150 um must maintain total thickness variation (TTV) < 5 um with zero micro-cracking. Thermosonic gold/copper wirebond ball shear force must exceed 18 gf. Epoxy mold compound (EMC) CTE must match silicon (~3 ppm/K).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Leadframes, ceramic carrier substrates, and Sumitomo/Henkel certified mold compound are COTS. Wafer saw dicing and thermosonic ball bonding can be performed on local lab bonder or contracted to regional OSAT partner.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-80 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Die dicing micro-chipping or thermosonic pad delamination causes open circuit or moisture ingress popcorning during 260°C solder reflow).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dicing blade vibration inducing micro-cracks penetrating active guard ring, leading to moisture degradation.
1. Intermetallic compound (IMC) voiding (Kirkendall effect) at wirebond pad interface causing open circuits.
1. Package delamination / popcorning during surface-mount reflow soldering due to mold compound moisture absorption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-01` | **Thermosonic Ball Wirebond Shear & Wire Pull Mechanical Strength Test** | Dage 4000 / Nordson Microtester Bond Pull & Ball Shear Test System | 1. Position shear chisel 3.0 um above bond pad aluminum metallization. 2. Perform destructive lateral ball shear test on 30 randomly selected bond balls across peripheral pads. 3. Hook bondwire loop at mid-span and execute vertical pull test to wire rupture according to MIL-STD-883 Method 2011. | `Ball shear force >= 18.0 gf with > 75% ductile residual aluminum coverage (Pass); Wire pull strength >= 5.0 gf (Pass).` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) Cold/Hot Wafer Sort Array Pattern Test** | Advantest / Teradyne Automated Wafer Prober with Multi-Contact Epoxy Probe Card | 1. Step probe card pins to die contact pads with 50 um probe overdrive. 2. Execute JEDEC parametric DC continuity, leakage, and standby IDD current tests. 3. Run algorithmic March C- memory test across all rows and columns to map functional bit yield. | `Parametric DC continuity pass (Pass); Standby current IDD2N <= 150 uA (Pass); Array yield >= 90% functional dies (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Conductive ESD grounding wrist strap and heel grounders, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (for die-attach epoxy dispensing), Safety glasses with side shields, Particulate N95 respirator during wafer sawing wheel changes and dicing sludge cleanup
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with uncured epoxy: Wash with copious soap and warm water (do not use solvents like acetone which increase dermal absorption). Eye contact with silica dicing slurry: Flush at eyewash for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dicing saw fully enclosed with continuous high-volume DI water mist shroud. Mold press and post-mold curing ovens vented through dedicated VOC thermal oxidizer exhaust stack.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Silicon dicing slurry centrifuged and segregated into solid cake for non-hazardous landfill. Cured thermoset epoxy scrap disposed of as regulated solid waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Epoxy Novolac Resin (Mold Compound)** | `29690-82-2` | Semiconductor Packaging Grade | `Solid pellet / transfer mold compound` |
| **Amorphous Silica Filler** | `14808-60-7` | Sub-micron spherical particle | `75-88 wt% in epoxy mold compound` |
| **Silver-Filled Conductive Die Attach Adhesive** | `7440-22-4` | Electronic Grade Silver Flake | `70-80 wt% Ag in epoxy base` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Saw-diced wafer mounted on UV dicing tape, clean and dry with zero particulate or water residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Epoxy die-attached, cured, and thermosonically wirebonded to leadframe/substrate pads prior to molding.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric oxidation of exposed aluminum/copper bond pads degrades thermosonic ball bond adhesion, inducing high electrical contact resistance or catastrophic non-stick bond pad lifts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Access Transistor Gate Routing & 8F2 Wordline Pitch Implementation: BEOL metallization, electrical die sort (EDS), wafer backgrinding/dicing, and wirebond plastic encapsulation successfully yield JEDEC-qualified DRAM packaged units.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Electrical_Die_Sort_Wafer_Yield_Map.csv`
- [ ] `Wirebond_Ball_Shear_And_Pull_CPK_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `JEDEC_TSOP54_Final_ATE_SpeedBin_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Wirebond ball shear strength** | `>= 18.0 gf` | Minimum failure load >= 15.0 gf across 30 samples | Dage 4000 micro-tester lateral ball shear per MIL-STD-883 |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Electrical Die Sort (EDS) wafer array functional yield** | `>= 90.0%` | Minimum yield >= 85.0% on prime wafers | Automated wafer probe array test with March C- diagnostic patterns |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Packaged DRAM package coplanarity & lead pitch** | `<= 0.08 mm coplanarity` | JEDEC TSOP-54 mechanical envelope tolerance (+/- 0.05 mm) | Optical 3D coordinate measuring machine (CMM) metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% passing electrical continuity and JEDEC parametric DC checks; destructive wirebond shear CPK >= 1.67 with zero package voiding or delamination detected under scanning acoustic microscopy (C-SAM).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Access Transistor Gate Oxide & 180nm Channel Poly-1 Patterning

**Document Ref:** [sop_access_transistor_gate_oxide_poly1_patterning.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_access_transistor_gate_oxide_poly1_patterning.md)  
**Process Node:** 180nm CMOS DRAM Generation 3  
**Cell Layout:** 8F² Folded Bitline 1T1C Access Transistor Gate Stack  

---

### Process Execution Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Pre-Gate Cleans:    │
│  RCA-1 + RCA-2 + DHF   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dry Thermal Gate    │
│       Oxidation:       │
│   850C-900C, ~3.5 nm   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      LPCVD Poly-1      │
│  Deposition: ~150-200  │
│     nm + In-Situ P     │
│         Doping         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     DUV 248nm KrF      │
│   Lithography: L=180   │
│  nm, Pitch=360-400 nm  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Anisotropic ICP RIE:  │
│        Cl2/HBr         │
│    High-Selectivity    │
│       Poly Etch        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   In-Line Metrology:   │
│  CD-SEM, Ellipsometry  │
│      & Ig Leakage      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Gate Clean & Surface Conditioning**:
   - Perform sequential RCA cleans: **SC-1** ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ 1:1:5, 70°C, 10 min) for organics removal, followed by **SC-2** ($\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ 1:1:6, 70°C, 10 min) for ionic/metallic de-contamination.
   - Dip in 0.5% dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF) for 60 s to strip native oxide; rinse in ultra-pure DI water ($>18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) and spin-rinse-dry with $\text{N}_2$. Maximum furnace queue time $\le 60\text{ min}$.
2. **Dry Thermal Gate Oxidation ($T_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$)**:
   - Load wafer load into vertical diffusion oxidation furnace at 600°C under $\text{N}_2$ blanket; ramp to **850°C – 900°C**.
   - Perform dry thermal oxidation in pure $\text{O}_2$ (with 0.5%–1.0% DCE/HCl for metallic gettering) to grow **$\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$**.
   - Execute in-situ $\text{N}_2$ post-oxidation anneal (POA) at 850°C for 15 min to eliminate interface trap states ($D_{it} < 1 \times 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$). Maximum queue time to Poly-1 deposition $\le 120\text{ min}$.
3. **Poly-1 Gate Deposition & Doping**:
   - Deposit **150 nm to 200 nm** polycrystalline silicon via LPCVD with $\text{SiH}_4$ at 580°C – 620°C.
   - In-situ dope with phosphorus ($\text{PH}_3$ co-flow) to achieve sheet resistance $R_s \le 30\,\Omega/\Box$ to suppress gate poly depletion under wordline boosted voltage ($V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{V to } 2.8\text{V}$).
4. **248nm DUV KrF Photolithography**:
   - Spin-coat organic Bottom Anti-Reflective Coating (BARC) and positive DUV photoresist ($\sim 350\text{ nm}$); soft bake at 100°C.
   - Expose on 248nm KrF excimer stepper with off-axis illumination targeting:
     - Access Transistor Channel Length: **$L = 180\text{ nm}$**
     - Active Area Transistor Width: **$W = 220\text{ nm}$**
     - Wordline / Gate Pitch: **$360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$**
   - Post-exposure bake at 110°C; develop in 2.38% TMAH.
5. **Anisotropic Poly-1 Reactive Ion Etching (RIE)**:
   - Plasma open BARC layer using $\text{CF}_4/\text{O}_2$.
   - Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP) main etch using $\text{Cl}_2/\text{HBr}/\text{O}_2$ for vertical gate profile ($88^\circ - 90^\circ$).
   - Soft-landing over-etch in $\text{HBr}/\text{O}_2$ with $>100:1$ selectivity to the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide, guided by optical emission endpoint detection (EPD @ 288 nm Si line) to prevent silicon active area damage.
   - Strip resist and BARC via downstream $\text{O}_2$ plasma ash followed by solvent wet clean.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                 Target Critical Dimensions & Thickness 
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
      Gate L (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒               │
Transistor W (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒               │
    WL Pitch (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 Tox Physical (A)┤████                                 │
                 │████                                 │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       95       190      285     380 
```

| Parameter | Target Metric | Unit | Spec Limits | Verification Metrology |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | **3.5** | **nm** | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ ($3.3 - 3.7\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | **180** | **nm** | $\pm 10\text{ nm}$ ($170 - 190\text{ nm}$) | In-line CD-SEM (3$\sigma$ across wafer) |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | **220** | **nm** | $\pm 12\text{ nm}$ ($208 - 232\text{ nm}$) | In-line CD-SEM |
| **Wordline / Gate Pitch** | **360 – 400** | **nm** | Within $360\text{ to } 400\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM pitch analyzer |
| **Leakage Current (Subthreshold + Junction)** | **$< 1.0$** | **fA/cell** | $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C | In-line Wafer Acceptance Test (WAT) |
| **Access Transistor Threshold Voltage ($V_{th}$)** | **0.5 – 0.7** | **V** | NMOS enhancement target | In-line Parametric Test (WAT) |

---

### Literature & Context Citations

1. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - *“Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness.”*
   - *“Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately 360 nm to 400 nm.”*
   - *“The storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF (femtofarads) per cell to ensure data retention time > 64 ms at 85°C.”*
2. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - *“Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm. Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.”*
   - *“Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval...”*
3. **Source: High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**
   - *“In 180nm DRAM cells, the pass transistor is an NMOS enhancement device with threshold voltage V_th ~ 0.5V to 0.7V.”*
   - *“V_PP Overdrive Solution: The wordline driver must be supplied by an on-chip boosted high voltage: V_PP = V_DD + V_th + Delta V_overdrive >= 2.5V to 2.8V.”*

The full SOP has been archived in the repository at [sop_access_transistor_gate_oxide_poly1_patterning.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_access_transistor_gate_oxide_poly1_patterning.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Thermal budget integration between gate oxide growth (dry oxidation at 850°C-900°C) and subsequent source/drain implant activations must avoid deforming shallow trench isolation (STI) corners or inducing localized stress that degrades the 1 fA/cell retention leakage target across the 8F2 array matrix.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Achieving an access transistor physical gate oxide thickness (Tox) of 3.5 nm with precise 180nm critical dimension (CD) channel patterning is paramount; any micro-loading or poly footing during anisotropic reactive-ion etching (RIE) will shift the threshold voltage (Vth) and exacerbate sub-threshold junction leakage beyond the 64 ms refresh budget.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursor gases for high-purity thermal oxidation and Poly-1 chemical vapor deposition (electronic-grade Silane SiH4 and semiconductor dry O2) face stringent regional purity constraints and delivery lead times for commercial MPW runs, demanding certified Ultra-High Purity (UHP 99.9999%) lots.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Strict gate oxidation-to-poly deposition queue time (Q-time) must be scheduled to prevent native oxide regrowth and airborne molecular contamination (AMC); misalignment between the cleanroom diffusion furnace and the Poly-1 LPCVD track risks scrap of full commercial lot runs.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Gate oxide early dielectric breakdown (TDDB) and high pinhole density triggered by organic or particulate contamination during the post-clean to pre-oxidation queue window.
1. Poly-1 anisotropic over-etch inducing active area silicon recess/pitting in the shared-contact bitline node, causing drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL) and junction leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.
1. Line-edge roughness (LER) and CD variation in 180nm poly lines leading to severe cell-to-cell access transistor threshold voltage mismatch.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-1-01` | **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness and Uniformity Verification** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (multi-angle, 193nm-800nm) and Cross-Section Transmission Electron Microscopy (HR-TEM) | 1. Load wafer into calibrated spectroscopic ellipsometer stage. 2. Measure optical constants (n, k) and thickness across a 49-point polar map across the 200mm wafer. 3. Select 3 target die (center, mid-radius, edge) and extract FIB-TEM cross-section samples across the access transistor channel active area. 4. Image high-resolution atomic lattice to extract physical oxide thickness (Tox). | `Physical gate oxide thickness Tox = 3.5 nm ± 0.15 nm; wafer 49-point thickness standard deviation (1-sigma) <= 0.08 nm; zero observed crystalline dislocations or interfacial voiding under HR-TEM.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-1-02` | **Access Transistor Poly-1 Gate Critical Dimension and Sidewall Profile Metrology** | Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) and In-Line Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Align CD-SEM to the 8F2 wordline array test pattern. 2. Measure Poly-1 gate line CD at 20 isolated and 20 nested 180nm channel locations across wafer. 3. Perform cross-sectional profile analysis measuring sidewall angle from poly top to active silicon interface. 4. Execute AFM scan across active area boundary to determine silicon recess depth. | `Gate CD = 180 nm ± 8 nm (nested/dense pitch); sidewall profile angle between 88.0° and 90.5°; active area substrate recess post-RIE <= 2.5 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A chemical splash suit with integrated neoprene hood, Butyl rubber outer gloves over secondary nitrile undergloves, Full-face positive-pressure airline respirator (SCBA ready for emergency response), Chemical-resistant safety boots with static-dissipative soles, Face shield meeting ANSI Z87.1 high-impact standard
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately flush affected dermal area with emergency safety shower for 2 minutes, apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel continuously with gloved hand, and transport victim to medical facility with continuous calcium supplementation. For toxic gas (Cl2/SiH4) inhalation: Evacuate immediately to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen via mask, monitor for pulmonary edema, and keep victim warm and strictly immobilized.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet-bench local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at face velocity >= 0.5 m/s with continuous differential pressure monitoring; gas cabinet scrubbers dedicated to pyrophoric/toxic exhausts (burn-wet thermal scrubber for SiH4 and wet acid scrubber for Cl2) maintaining negative cabinet pressure with emergency auto-shutoff valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated effluent drain systems: acidic and fluoride-bearing rinse streams routed to automated fluoride precipitation system using calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) forming insoluble CaF2 sludge; chlorinated gaseous effluents routed through caustic multi-stage packed bed scrubbers using 10% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (pre-gate surface termination)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier C / Ultra-Pure | `0.5% v/v` |
| **Silane (Poly-1 LPCVD precursor)** | `7803-62-5` | Electronic Grade 6N (99.9999%) | `100% Compressed Gas` |
| **Chlorine (Poly-1 RIE etchant gas)** | `7782-50-5` | VLSI Grade 5N | `99.999% Compressed Gas` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (RCA SC-1 clean)** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 5 | `30% aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Atomically flat, particle-free hydrogen-terminated silicon (Si-H) following dilute HF wet clean step with water contact angle > 65 degrees.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Passivated high-purity SiO2 gate dielectric capped under dense un-doped or in-situ doped Poly-1 silicon film without oxidation interfacial contamination.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide formation (> 0.4 nm uncontrolled SiO2), AMC boron/hydrocarbon chemisorption, and moisture-induced interface trap states (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2) resulting in unrecoverable Vth shifts and excessive DRAM storage node leakage.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Access transistor 3.5nm thermal gate dielectric oxidation and 180nm Poly-1 gate patterning validated to support 8F2 folded bitline cell retention of >64 ms at 85°C with sub-threshold off-state leakage strictly bounded below 1 fA per cell.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-1_gate_oxide_ellipsometry_49pt.csv`
- [ ] `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-1_poly1_cd_sem_metrology_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

critics.supply_chain: Precursor gases for high-purity thermal oxidation and Poly-1 chemical vapor deposition (electronic-grade Silane SiH4 and semiconductor dry O2) face stringent regional purity constraints and delivery lead times for commercial MPW runs, demanding certified Ultra-High Purity (UHP 99.9999%) lots.
critics.laya_pm: Strict gate oxidation-to-poly deposition queue time (Q-time) must be scheduled to prevent native oxide regrowth and airborne molecular contamination (AMC); misalignment between the cleanroom diffusion furnace and the Poly-1 LPCVD track risks scrap of full commercial lot runs.

Poly-1 anisotropic over-etch inducing active area silicon recess/pitting in the shared-contact bitline node, causing drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL) and junction leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 8F2 Wordline Continuous Pitch Routing & Poly-Silicide Strapping

### Process Context & Scope
- **Chip / Project**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy**: 8F² Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW $\rightarrow$ Access Transistor Gate Routing & 8F² Wordline Pitch Implementation
- **Generation**: Gen 3 (180 nm) | **Action Type**: Make

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Wordline Driver /   │
│    VPP Decoupling    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Poly Gate Routing   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Salicide Formation  │
│     CoSi2/TiSi2      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   M2 Strapping via   │
│       W-Plugs        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    RC Delay & DRC    │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Gate Dielectric Growth & Poly Deposition Setup**:
   - Ensure the dry thermal oxidation process yields an $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric with physical thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }900^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Deposit in-situ n+ doped polysilicon for the access gate conductor over the active areas.

2. **Access Transistor Patterning & Continuous Wordline Pitch Routing**:
   - Pattern access transistor gate lines across active diffusion areas with critical channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Establish continuous parallel wordline routing across the memory mat maintaining an exact pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ ($2F$ pitch constraint for $8F^2$ cell topology where $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Route wordlines orthogonally over the active diffusion islands, allocating shared-contact regions for the bitline contact between adjacent dual-cell pairs.

3. **Poly-Silicide (Salicide) Cladding Formation**:
   - Form self-aligned silicide ($\text{CoSi}_2$ or $\text{TiSi}_2$) cladding over the exposed top surface of the continuous polysilicon gate lines to depress sheet resistance ($R_s$) along the long wordline run.
   - Maintain sidewall spacer integrity preventing silicide bridging between the wordline gate and adjacent storage node / bitline landing pads.

4. **Low-Resistance Metal Strapping Integration**:
   - Route low-resistivity metal lines (Metal 2/3) in parallel directly above the continuous poly-silicide wordlines.
   - Insert tungsten plug (W-plug) strapping contacts at regular block intervals (e.g., every 32 or 64 cells) bridging the upper metal strap down to the poly-silicide wordline to bypass polysilicon distributed resistance.

5. **$V_{PP}$ Overdrive Voltage Domain Routing & DRC/LVS Signoff**:
   - Connect wordline strapping lines to sub-wordline drivers backed by the on-chip high-voltage charge pump supplying overdrive voltage $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$ (ensuring full restore over $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ with enhancement $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$).
   - Execute DRC rules for pitch ($360\text{ nm - } 400\text{ nm}$), minimum poly spacing, and W-plug enclosure checks.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

```text
              Physical Geometry Budget (180nm 8F2 DRAM) 
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │░                                        │
     EOT (nm)┤░                                        │
             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
Active W (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
  Gate L (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
WL Pitch (nm)┤█████████████████████████████████████████│
             │█████████████████████████████████████████│
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
              0        90        180       270      360 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Pitch** | `360 to 400` | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Optical / GDSII Layout DRC |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | LVS / Critical Dimension (CD-SEM) |
| **Wordline Driver Supply Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | `2.5 to 2.8` | $\text{V}$ | HSPICE / SPICE Electrical Simulation & Voltage Clamp Check |
| **Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$ / EOT)** | `~3.5` (EOT `3 to 4`) | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry / TEM / C-V Extraction |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Cell Leakage** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Static Device Current Profiling ($\text{I}_{\text{off}}$) |

---

### Context Citations
1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](./docs/knowledge/8F2_wordline_routing_strapping.md)**: Confirms access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contact architecture, tungsten plug (W-plug) contacts, and cell leakage target ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
2. **[High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture](./docs/knowledge/8F2_wordline_routing_strapping.md)**: Confirms NMOS enhancement pass transistor threshold $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$, core $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$, and the required boosted wordline overdrive voltage $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$ to eliminate threshold voltage loss during capacitor write operations.
3. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](./docs/knowledge/8F2_wordline_routing_strapping.md)**: Confirms continuous bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric dry oxidation thermal parameters ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$, $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness), EOT ($3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$), and cell capacitance budget ($25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$).

*(Micro-knowledge preserved in [8F2_wordline_routing_strapping.md](./docs/knowledge/8F2_wordline_routing_strapping.md))*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline architecture at the 180nm node (F = 180nm, cell area = 0.2592 um2), wordline pitch is tight at 360nm (180nm line / 180nm space). The primary challenge is array-wide RC delay: unsilicided or poorly strapped polysilicon exhibits sheet resistances (Rs) exceeding 30-50 ohm/sq, which degrades tRCD (row access latency) and creates systematic skew between near-end and far-end cells across a 512-wordline sub-array. Continuous pitch routing without metal strapping every 32 to 64 cells will bottleneck row decoder drive times and induce destructive dI/dt bounce during simultaneous wordline assertion.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Polycide or refractory silicide strapping (specifically WSi2 or TiSi2 on poly gates) must maintain thermal budget compatibility with subsequent ONO/high-k stacked capacitor deposition (650°C-800°C). If titanium silicide is selected, agglomeration and phase transition instability (C49 to C54) at 180nm line widths will trigger open-line failures or catastrophic resistance spikes. Tungsten silicide (WSix) or tungsten poly-metal gate (W/WN/Poly-Si) is mandatory to suppress fluorine outgassing and silicon pitting while maintaining sheet resistance below 5-8 ohm/sq across the continuous array.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten silicide (WSix) target purity (5N5 minimum) and silane/dichlorosilane precursors face single-source lead times for specialized 180nm open-source MPW shuttles. Utilizing non-standard silicide compositions or unverified strapping metallurgy risks rejection by commercial MPW fabs. Layout must strictly conform to foundry baseline DRC/LVS rules for the polysilicon silicide block (SAB/RES) layer and standard tungsten contact plug aspect ratios to avoid mask redesign cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Wordline routing and contact strap insertion directly determine memory core density and DRC clean signoff milestones. If wordline strap stitch contacts (Metal1/Metal2 to Poly) exceed allowable contact-to-active pitch design rules, cell array efficiency will degrade by >12%, jeopardizing the target MPW die budget. Delivery must prioritize automated DRC/ERC clean GDSII stream-out with freeze on wordline pitch by Milestone M2.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Agglomeration and voiding of poly-silicide film at 180nm critical dimension during post-deposition thermal cycles, causing wordline open circuits or localized Rs surge >50 ohm/sq.
1. Bridging shorts between adjacent wordlines across the 180nm lithographic space due to silicide stringers or post-etch polymer residue in high-density continuous pitch routing.
1. Gate dielectric puncture or work function degradation induced by fluorine or refractory metal diffusion through thin barrier layers during high-temperature thermal annealing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-2-01` | **Wordline Sheet Resistance and Poly-Silicide Continuity Verification** | Four-point probe Kelvin structure test vehicle, Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) with automated probe card station. | 1. Force a DC current of 100 uA through the outer force pads of the Kelvin wordline test structure. 2. Measure the differential voltage drop across the inner sense taps separated by 100 squares (36 um physical length at 360nm pitch). 3. Repeat measurement at 10 distinct sub-array locations across the wafer. 4. Calculate sheet resistance Rs = (V_sense / I_force) / 100. 5. Perform thermal ramp to 85°C and record delta-Rs. | `Pass if mean sheet resistance Rs <= 7.5 ohm/sq with standard deviation sigma <= 0.4 ohm/sq across all test sites, and no catastrophic resistance jumps (Rs > 12 ohm/sq) under 85°C thermal stress.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-2-02` | **Adjacent Wordline Inter-Line Dielectric Breakdown & Leakage Test** | Precision Source-Measure Unit (SMU) with sub-femtoamp resolution (Keysight B1500A/B1517A HRSMU) and triaxial probe cabling. | 1. Ground odd wordlines and active substrate. 2. Apply stepped DC bias from 0.0V to 3.6V in 50mV increments on even wordlines. 3. Measure inter-line leakage current at nominal VDD (1.8V) and boosted wordline drive voltage (VPP = 3.3V). 4. Continue ramp up to 5.0V to confirm time-zero dielectric breakdown (TZDB) margin. | `Pass if inter-line leakage current I_leak < 10 pA at V_bias = 3.3V (VPP) across the entire 1000-finger comb, and catastrophic dielectric breakdown voltage V_BD > 4.8V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level C cleanroom garment (flame-retardant Tyvek coverall), Chemical-resistant nitrile inner gloves paired with heavy butyl outer gloves, UV-filtering full-face splash shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Viton chemical apron during wet chemical cleaning/salicide prep
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of HF dermal exposure, flush immediately with copious water for 5 minutes, followed by continuous massage of 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel into the affected area until medical personnel arrive. For WF6 inhalation, remove victim to fresh air, supply 100% humidified oxygen, and seek emergency pulmonary assistance immediately for potential hydrofluoric acid lung edemas.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated corrosive/toxic scrubbing exhaust ducting operating under continuous negative pressure (>100 Pa relative to cleanroom). Automated toxic gas monitoring (TGMS) system with optical electrochemical sensors tuned to HF/WF6 (<0.5 ppm threshold) and pyrophoric silane detectors (<5 ppm threshold) interlocking with pneumatic emergency gas shutoff valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous effluent containing HF residues must be directed to an automated fluoride waste treatment facility using calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) precipitation to generate inert calcium fluoride (CaF2) cake, neutralizing supernatant to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal release. CVD exhaust must run through high-temperature point-of-use thermal burn/wet scrubbers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade (99.999% / 5N) | `100% gas` |
| **Silane** | `7803-62-5` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI 5N5) | `100% pyrophoric gas` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Dilute pre-silicide clean)** | `7664-39-3` | TraceMetal Grade | `0.5% - 1.0% aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated native-oxide-free polysilicon top surface following 100:1 DHF clean and deionized water rinse.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Stoichiometric WSi2.2 film passivated under cap oxide (Si3N4 or TEOS SiO2) with root-mean-square roughness Rq < 0.6 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide (SiO2) regrowth exceeding 0.6 nm prior to silicide deposition causes delamination of the W/poly stack, contact resistance spikes >1000 ohm per strap contact, and severe void nucleation during rapid thermal annealing (RTA).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed and verified full-custom layout, parasitic RC extraction, and physical design rule validation for 8F2 wordline continuous pitch routing (360nm pitch, 180nm L_gate) with integrated tungsten-polycide strapping every 32 cells, fully DRC/LVS/ERC clean against target 180nm commercial DRAM foundry PDK.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WP_8F2_WORDLINE_STRAPPING_LAYOUT_V1.gds`
- [ ] `WORDLINE_RC_PARASITIC_EXTRACT_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_DRC_LVS_SIGNOFF.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Continuous poly-silicide strapped wordline sheet resistance** | `6.0 ohm/sq` | +/- 1.5 ohm/sq | Post-layout 3D Calibre xRC parasitic extraction corroborated by physical Kelvin test structure four-point probe extraction at 25°C. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum sub-array wordline propagation delay (tRCD wordline driver to far-end cell 512)** | `2.80 ns` | +0.35 ns, -0.20 ns | HSPICE transient corner simulation (TT/SS/FF) at 85°C junction temperature, VDD = 1.8V, VPP = 3.3V, driving 512 access transistors. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Continuous wordline physical pitch lithographic fidelity and DRC spacing compliance** | `360.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Calibre DRC geometry verification ruledeck execution with CD-SEM measurement on lithographic pitch calibration verniers. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC errors on poly/silicide/contact layers across the entire 8F2 memory core sub-array, 100% LVS match between schematic netlist and extracted GDSII layout, parasitic wordline RC delay within 3.15 ns worst-case corner, and complete formal signoff by Systems Engineering and Domain Expert leads.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Wordline RC Extraction & High-Voltage $V_{PP}$ Overdrive DRC/LVS Verification

**Council Level**: DRAM Foundation VN — Metrology & Tapeout Verification Council  
**Target Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Commercial MPW Process)  
**Cell Architecture**: $8F^2$ Folded Bitline 1T1C ($F = 180\text{ nm}$, Cell Area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$)

---

### 1. Verification Flow & Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Layout Import &     │
│      Layer Setup       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   HV DRC Rule Check:   │
│   VPP Overdrive Net    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   LVS Verification &   │
│     Substrate Bias     │
│       Isolation        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Parasitic        │
│  Extraction: Wordline  │
│    R_poly/R_metal &    │
│        C_total         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Metrology  │
│       & Signoff        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Layout & Layer Deck Preparation**:
   - Stream in the full-custom $8F^2$ array tile and wordline driver hierarchy in GDSII/OASIS format.
   - Map polysilicon gate layers ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ per access transistor) and wordline strapping layers (Metal 1/Metal 2 stitch contacts).

2. **High-Voltage $V_{PP}$ Overdrive DRC Check**:
   - Tag the wordline driver output nodes, pass-transistor gate nets, and Dickson charge pump output as high-voltage domain ($V_{PP} = 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$).
   - Run DRC using high-voltage clearance rules: enforce expanded thick-gate oxide rules, increased metal-to-metal spacing on $V_{PP}$ traces, and high-voltage well-tap enclosure rules to prevent dielectric breakdown under continuous overdrive.

3. **High-Voltage LVS & Substrate Isolation Verification**:
   - Run Layout-Versus-Schematic (LVS) comparing against the 1T1C folded bitline sub-array netlist.
   - Verify proper bulk and well connections: check that NMOS access devices and driver stages maintain guard rings to prevent latchup during boosted overdrive transient spikes ($V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V}$).
   - Confirm pin and port mapping for $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$, $V_{PP} = 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$, and storage node contacts.

4. **Wordline Parasitic RC Network Extraction**:
   - Run 2.5D/3D field extraction targeting the active wordline across the 256/512 cell array blocks.
   - Extract distributed sheet resistance ($R_{\text{poly}}$ and Metal bypass shunt resistance) along the entire wordline length.
   - Extract distributed capacitances: wordline-to-substrate, wordline-to-bitline crossing capacitance, and overlap capacitance to the storage node contact plug ($W$-plug).
   - Generate a distributed $RC$ netlist (ladder network) for delay and signal integrity characterization.

5. **Storage Node & Bitline Margin Validation**:
   - Verify extracted storage node cell capacitance ($C_s$) and total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$).
   - Compute bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ to verify read margin feasibility before signoff.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
DRAM 180nm Array Key Parameter Metric Budgets
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │░░                                       │
Leakage Limit┤░░                                       │
             │▒▒▒▒▒                                    │
   V_PP Boost┤▒▒▒▒▒                                    │
C_b/C_s Ratio┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                           │
      C_s Min┤█████████████████████████████████████████│
             │█████████████████████████████████████████│
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
              0         7        14        21        28 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Overdrive Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.5\text{ to } 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | High-Voltage DRC/LVS Voltage Domain Verification |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (budget: $25\text{ to } 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Field Solver 3D Parasitic Extraction |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $\le 9:1$ (range: $5:1\text{ to } 9:1$) | Dimensionless ratio | Post-Extraction Network Ratio Calculation |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Post-Layout SPICE Simulation & LVS Device Check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture]**: Overdrive requirement ($V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$) to prevent the 33% threshold voltage write loss ($V_{th} \sim 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$) under $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Channel dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, storage node target $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ with ONO or high-$\kappa$ dielectric, and maximum junction/subthreshold leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets]**: Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$), nominal storage capacitance $25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$, bitline parasitic $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$, and strict capacitance ratio limit $C_b / C_s \le 9:1$.

---
*Micro-knowledge captured in [docs/wordline_rc_vpp_verification.md](./docs/wordline_rc_vpp_verification.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Routing the polysilicon/silicide wordlines across an entire 256-cell or 512-cell sub-array produces a distributed RC ladder where sheet resistance (typically 8-12 ohm/sq for polycide or >30 ohm/sq for unstrapped poly) creates an asymmetrical propagation delay (t_WL_prop > 2.5 ns at the array far-end). This delays pass-transistor turn-on, skewing the sense amplifier latch timing (t_RCD) and degrading charge-sharing margins for distal cells. Metal-1/Metal-2 periodic strapping every 16 or 32 cells is mandatory to suppress the distributed RC constant below 1.2 ns.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline overdrive at V_PP = 2.8V on standard 180nm core oxide (t_ox = 3.8-4.2 nm rated nominally for 1.8V operation) introduces extreme electric field stress across the gate dielectric (E_ox > 6.6 MV/cm). This accelerates Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown (TDDB) and Hot Carrier Injection (HCI) during wordline activation. High-voltage DRC decks must enforce dual-gate oxide rules (5.0V/3.3V thick-oxide I/O devices for drivers) or strictly verify that the access gate oxide lifetime under duty-cycled V_PP pulse conditions exceeds 10 years at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard open-access 180nm commercial MPW runs (such as TSMC 0.18um, GlobalFoundries 180MCU, or TowerJazz 180nm) impose strict rule decks regarding thick-gate oxide module integration and high-voltage spacing. If dual-gate oxide masks (DG/THKOX) or non-standard high-voltage layers are invoked without MPW shuttle slot pre-qualification, fabrication costs spike by 35-50% and tapeout acceptance can be delayed by 2-3 shuttle runs due to wafer-split discrepancies.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Verification schedules for extraction and physical signoff of the memory macro array are prone to bottlenecking during field-solver parasitics extraction. Full 3D field extraction of dense 8F2 folded bitline wordline topologies often causes memory overflow or runtimes >48 hours in open-source engines (e.g., Magic, Netgen, or FastCap). We require boundary-cell hierarchical extraction with partitioned GDS layers to guarantee signoff within the 10-day sprint window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Gate Oxide TDDB Catastrophic Puncture: Prolonged exposure of thin 1.8V core gate oxide to V_PP >= 2.8V overdrive pulses creates percolation defect pathways, resulting in access-gate rupture and shorting V_PP directly to the bitline or substrate.
1. Far-End Wordline Underdrive & Retention Failure: Excessive distributed wordline RC attenuation prevents far-end access transistors from reaching full V_PP during the active window, failing to write full V_DD (1.8V) into the 28 fF storage capacitor and shortening cell retention below 64 ms.
1. High-Voltage Substrate Injection & Latch-up: V_PP driver switching transients exceeding breakdown limits trigger parasitic bipolar conduction (SCR) between high-voltage N-well taps and access transistor P-wells, causing catastrophic latch-up and V_PP rail collapse.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-3-01` | **Full-Array Wordline Distributed RC Extraction and Far-End Slew Verification** | Parasitic Extractor (Calibre xRC / OpenRCX / Magic PEX) coupled with SPICE Transient Simulator (Spectre / Ngspice / Xyce) with sub-picosecond timestep resolution | 1. Run 3D parasitic field extraction on Polysilicon, Contact, M1 strap, and M2 wordline driver layers across 512 bitline pitches. 2. Generate a distributed RCLK network netlist preserving intermediate nodal coordinates along the 512-cell physical length. 3. Instantiate full post-layout netlist into SPICE with nominal BSIM4 180nm model cards (TT corner, 27°C and 85°C). 4. Inject a step-pulse into the wordline driver input (0V to 1.8V rise time = 100 ps, pulse width = 20 ns). 5. Measure node voltage, propagation delay (50% driver in to 50% far-end access gate), and 10%-to-90% transition slew rate at cell index 0, 128, 256, and 512. | `Total lumped wordline series resistance R_WL <= 450 ohms; total lumped capacitance C_WL <= 480 fF; propagation delay to far-end cell (Cell 512) t_prop_50 <= 1.25 ns; far-end 10%-to-90% rise time t_rise <= 1.80 ns at 85°C; far-end peak voltage V_WL_max >= 2.76 V.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-2-3-02` | **High-Voltage V_PP Overdrive Physical DRC and Dielectric Clearance Verification** | Physical Verification Rule Engine (Calibre nmDRC / KLayout DRC-64 / Pegasus) executing 180nm High-Voltage Extension Runset Deck | 1. Ingest GDS-II and bind high-voltage runset configuration enforcing V_PP (2.8V-3.3V) clearance and enclosure rules. 2. Execute minimum spacing checks between V_PP metal lines and adjacent low-voltage (1.8V / 0V) signal rails (M1.S.HV, M2.S.HV). 3. Verify physical overlap and enclosure of THKOX mask over all active access gates and driver transistors tied to the V_PP net (minimum enclosure >= 0.36 um). 4. Run well-proximity and guard-ring continuity checks around all V_PP level-shifters and wordline driver drivers (guard ring N+/P+ tap spacing <= 1.2 um). 5. Export comprehensive DRC run log and coordinate error marker database. | `Zero DRC violations across all HV rules (0 errors in HV_SPACE, HV_ENCLOSURE, THKOX_OVERLAP); 100% LVS match on V_PP net connectivity with zero soft-check substrate diode forward-bias warnings; dielectric breakdown spacing margins >= 0.42 um for all unshielded metal traces carrying 2.8V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) wrist strap and heel grounders (ANSI/ESD S20.20 compliant), Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (powder-free, textured fingertips), Laser safety goggles (OD 5+ at 532nm/1064nm for laser-assisted wafer metrology), Standard cleanroom bunny suit with integrated ESD carbon-grid fibers and safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush with sterile deionized water at emergency eye wash station for minimum 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Remove contaminated apparel and wash skin thoroughly with non-abrasive soap and copious water. Inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if respiration becomes labored. Ingestion: Never induce vomiting in an unconscious individual; seek immediate medical attention with accompanying SDS.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Chemical exhaust fume hood maintaining face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.51 m/s); laboratory laminar flow recirculating clean air filter units with continuous volatile organic compound (VOC) photoionization detection (PID) and automated dry chemical fire suppression.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent collection in dedicated grounded stainless-steel carboys labeled 'Flammable Halogen-Free Solvents'; automated nitrogen blanketing to prevent vapor accumulation; consignment to certified hazardous waste disposal contractor in accordance with EPA RCRA guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 (VLSI Purified > 99.9%) | `99.9% wt` |
| **Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) Vapor Prime** | `999-97-3` | Electronic Grade 99.99% | `100.0% wt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metrology incoming wafer post-polycide etch and M1 deposition: clean, dry, residue-free surface passivated with low-temperature chemical oxide; moisture level < 0.1 ug/cm^2; particulate density < 0.05 defects/cm^2 (> 0.18 um size).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Post-extraction optical and thermal-reflectance verified wafer surface: vacuum-sealed or nitrogen-purged FOUP container; native oxide regrowth < 0.8 nm; metallic cross-contamination < 1e10 atoms/cm^2.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air causes uncontrolled airborne organic contamination adsorption and native oxide thickening (> 1.2 nm) on exposed contacts/metal test pads, inducing non-ohmic high contact resistance (> 50 ohms/via) and distorting physical high-voltage C-V/I-V curve extraction accuracy.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified signoff netlist with extracted parasitic RC models demonstrating full 512-cell wordline activation under 2.8V V_PP overdrive within 1.25 ns, coupled with zero-error DRC/LVS clearance on all thick-oxide high-voltage rules and guard rings.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `VPP_OVERDRIVE_HIGH_VOLTAGE_DRC_LVS_SIGNOFF_SUMMARY.pdf`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Far-end wordline propagation delay from driver 50% activation to cell 512 access gate reaching 1.40V (50% of V_PP = 2.8V)** | `1.08` | +/- 0.15 ns | Post-layout transient SPICE simulation at slow-slow corner (SS), 85 deg C, V_PP = 2.65V min |
| `ASSERT-03` | **High-voltage V_PP DRC rule violations and LVS discrepancies across the macro perimeter** | `0` | +0 / -0 errors | Hierarchical physical DRC/LVS engine verification using foundry-qualified 180nm high-voltage rule deck |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All DRC and LVS checks on the wordline array and V_PP driver network report 0 errors, all quantitative assertions are verified within tolerance across TT, SS, and FF corners at -40°C to 125°C, and the design package receives formal approval from the Metrology and Circuit Design leads.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Landing Pad DRC/LVS Verification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 180nm architecture, the shared bitline contact (BLC) and storage node landing pad (SNLP) layout must balance parasitic capacitance C_b with cell read margin. With a target storage node capacitance C_s of 28 fF and array bitline capacitance bounded between 150 fF and 250 fF to maintain C_b/C_s < 9:1, any design rule margin erosion or misaligned landing pad encroachment on the pass-gate wordline (WL) will induce fatal capacitive coupling (delta_VBL noise > 15 mV) and exacerbate contact resistance (R_c) unbalance across adjacent complementary bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm commercial node rules, the shared BLC opening between adjacent access transistors features tight diffusion enclosure (typically <= 60 nm) and active area overlap. Contact landing directly over salicide-blocked or Ti-silicided active silicon requires strict DRC checks on active enclosure, poly gate-to-contact spacing (>= 70 nm), and SNLP metal-1 boundary overhang. Furthermore, LVS extraction must correctly extract the asymmetric parasitic source/drain junction capacitances and preserve netlist equivalence without shorting the continuous active area islands or dropping sub-resolution contact layers.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial open-access MPW runs (such as SCL or TSMC-compatible 180nm mixed-signal logic/eDRAM shuttles) enforce rigid freeze dates and non-negotiable rule decks. If custom DRC decks for the high-density DRAM cell matrix flag pseudo-errors or illegal waivers at the MPW aggregation stage, reticle tapeout will be rejected. Tooling, reticle write times, and wafer-level test-structure insertions (TLM arrays for R_c validation) must be confirmed compliant with standard foundry DRC/LVS rule versions without demanding specialized proprietary mask licenses.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Layout tapeout for the 8F2 unit cell and core array is on the critical path for the shuttle schedule. Iterative DRC/LVS violations in the dense contact array cause compounding delays in post-layout parasitics extraction (PEX) and corner simulations. We must establish automated regression scripts with Calibre/KLayout DRC/LVS rule decks, ensuring sign-off verification completes within a fixed 24-hour turnaround window prior to final GDSII delivery.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Contact punch-through or bridging between the shared bitline contact and wordline gate poly due to lithographic misalignment or insufficient spacer clearance (< 70 nm).
1. Storage node landing pad short to adjacent active diffusion or pass-gate poly via corner rounding during optical proximity correction (OPC) or insufficient overlay margin.
1. LVS soft-connect or substrate tap extraction failure across continuous active area fingers, causing false net merging or undetectable floating storage nodes in array netlists.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-01` | **Automated Full-Chip DRC Clearance & Contact Enclosure Verification for 8F2 Array** | Siemens EDA Calibre nmDRC / KLayout DRC Engine (Open-Source fallback) with Foundry 180nm Rule Deck rev 2.4 | 1. Ingest GDSII stream into Calibre nmDRC execution environment using foundry 180nm technology rule file. 2. Execute geometric Boolean operations on Layer 6 (DIFF), Layer 10 (POLY), Layer 15 (CONTACT), and Layer 19 (METAL1). 3. Extract and verify critical dimensional rules: CONTACT enclosure by DIFF (min 60 nm), CONTACT to POLY edge clearance (min 70 nm), and METAL1 landing pad enclosure over CONTACT (min 40 nm end-of-line, 30 nm side). 4. Flag and compile coordinate log of all DRC error markers across the memory matrix. | `Total DRC violation count across the cell core and shared contact boundaries must equal exactly 0 errors; zero non-waived rule violations permitted on CONTACT and METAL1 landing layers.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-02` | **Hierarchical LVS Netlist Equivalence & Storage Node Pin Isolation Check** | Siemens EDA Calibre nmLVS / Netgen 1.5 LVS Tool with Spice Netlist Extractor | 1. Extract transistor-level connectivity and parasitic elements from layout GDSII including poly-gate access FETs and shared diffusion regions. 2. Compare layout-extracted device netlist against golden SPICE array schematic using device permutation and pin symmetry checking. 3. Validate extraction of storage node terminal isolation (zero short-circuits to VSS/VDD or adjacent bitlines). 4. Perform ERC (Electrical Rule Check) to verify absence of floating wells, unstamped diffusion nodes, or soft substrate shorts. | `LVS status must report 'NETLISTS MATCH - NO ERRORS'; ERC report must list 0 floating gates, 0 uncontacted diffusions, and 0 soft-connect conflicts; 100% device instance match across all 131,072 cells in the array block.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (double-gloved, class 100 compatible), UV-blocking ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses, Full static-dissipative ESD lab coat, Closed-toe cleanroom ESD safety shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with solvents: Flush immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes. For eye contact: Rinse continuously at emergency eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. For inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air immediately; administer oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Seek emergency medical attention if symptoms persist.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Laboratory workstations and inspection stations must operate under continuous laminar air flow hoods (Class 10/100, ISO 4/5) with dedicated VOC chemical exhaust maintaining duct face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.51 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and liquid solvent residues must be segregated into clearly labeled, grounded, flame-proof hazardous organic waste carboys; strictly no drainage disposal; disposal per EPA/RCRA solvent waste regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI / ULSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Ethanol** | `64-17-5` | Electronic Grade | `95.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched contact vias down to silicide/diffusion interface prior to barrier metallization (Ti/TiN deposition), free of organic residue and particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered or CVD-deposited Ti/TiN barrier layer and W-plug fill, protected under inert purge or sealed transport cassette.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native silicon dioxide regrowing at via bottom (> 1.2 nm native SiO2) causing specific contact resistivity (rho_c) to spike beyond 1e-6 Ohm*cm^2, inducing read signal attenuation and severe bitline sensing failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete DRC/LVS clean tapeout sign-off for the shared bitline contact (BLC) and storage node landing pad (SNLP) layout within the 180nm 8F2 folded bitline cell array, fully conforming to foundry MPW design rules, parasitic capacitance limits, and physical verification specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_8f2_cell_array_drc_signoff.pdf`
- [ ] `dram_8f2_cell_array_lvs_report.csv`
- [ ] `blc_snlp_critical_dimension_overlay_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total DRC violation count across full 8F2 DRAM cell core matrix** | `0` | +0 / -0 | Calibre nmDRC automated batch execution report log parsing |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Minimum Contact-to-Poly Gate edge clearance in dense array** | `70` | +20 nm / -0 nm | GDSII geometric design rule distance measurement query |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Storage Node parasitic capacitance to adjacent Bitline (C_sn_bl)** | `1.2` | +0.3 fF / -0.2 fF | Calibre xACT / PEX field solver parasitic 3D RC extraction |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero unresolved DRC design rule violations, 100% netlist topological and parameter match under nmLVS with zero soft connections or ERC flags, and formal sign-off approval recorded in the foundry MPW tapeout checklist.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Pad Design Rule Deck Setup & Parameter Extraction

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > 1T1C Unit Cell Layout & Shared-Contact Active Area Design [Circuit Design] > Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Landing Pad DRC/LVS Verification [Metrology] > Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Pad Design Rule Deck Setup & Parameter Extraction [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM matrix at the 180nm node, the shared bitline contact (BLC) and storage node landing pad (SNLP) are critical bottlenecks for parasitic capacitance and electrical coupling. If the extracted parasitic capacitance (C_BL) between the shared BLC and adjacent pass-gate wordlines (WL) or storage pads exceeds 180 fF/mm, the bitline charge transfer ratio (C_s / (C_s + C_BL)) will be degraded below the minimum 15% sense margin required for reliable sensing by the cross-coupled PMOS/NMOS regenerative sense amplifier. Furthermore, 180nm lithography limits tight contact enclosure, leading to asymmetric parasitic capacitances between true and complementary bitline pairs (BL and /BL), which induces common-mode-to-differential offset noise exceeding the SA input offset voltage budget of 15 mV.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm design rules, the active area (AA) shared contact must provide low specific contact resistivity while preventing junction leakage under V_PP overdrive (2.5V-2.8V on WL). Standard logic DRC decks impose conservative contact-to-gate spacing (typically >= 220nm) and contact enclosure by active area (>= 60nm), which breaks the 8F2 layout pitch (cell area ~ 0.26 µm²). An aggressive full-custom DRAM DRC deck modification with specialized conditional design rules (e.g., self-aligned contact tolerance or borderline enclosure waivers of <= 30nm) must be developed. For parameter extraction, 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) must accurately capture 3D fringing fields between the landing pad, poly wordlines, and substrate, accounting for barrier metallization (Ti/TiN) sheet resistance and Silicide/Active contact resistance (R_c < 50 Ohm/contact).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard commercial 180nm CMOS MPW foundries strictly prohibit unvalidated sub-resolution or design-rule waivers without foundry fab signoff due to yield fallout risks from contact bridging or unlanded via opens. Enforcing tight contact landing rules on the shared bitline node requires coordination with the foundry device engineering group to calibrate optical proximity correction (OPC) models for high-density DRAM array arrays, or else default standard-logic rule decks will reject the GDSII during mask data preparation (MDP), stalling the shuttle tapeout.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: From a physical layout and project schedule standpoint, implementing custom DRC/LVS deck runsets and 3D PEX extraction tables adds high iteration overhead. If parameter extraction decks do not seamlessly back-annotate into the post-layout SPICE netlist with standardized hierarchical pin definitions, timing closure across the Dickson charge-pump-driven wordline activation and sensing restoration loop will slip the planned foundry shuttle submission deadline by weeks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Contact punch-through or dielectric breakdown between the shared BLC and pass-gate Wordline under boosted V_PP overdrive (2.8V), causing irreversible gate-to-channel or gate-to-bitline leakage shorts.
1. Asymmetric enclosure and contact overlay error resulting in silicon active area corner clipping, escalating storage node junction leakage (I_leak > 10 fA/cell) and reducing retention time below 64 ms at 85°C.
1. Excessive parasitic bitline capacitance imbalance (Delta C_BL > 5% between BL and /BL) causing false read evaluations and sense amplifier lockup on weak data states ('0' or '1').

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-1-01` | **Automated DRAM Cell Shared BLC and SNLP Geometric DRC Deck Rule Verification** | Mentor Graphics Calibre DRC / KLayout DRC Engine with customized 180nm DRAM Design Rule Deck (DRC-180DRAM-REV03.rule) | 1. Compile and execute the custom DRAM rule deck against a 32x32 array test vehicle containing shared bitline contacts and storage node pads. 2. Verify rule checks for Cont.W.1 (minimum contact width = 180nm), Cont.S.1 (contact-to-contact spacing = 220nm), Cont.E.Active (active enclosure = 40nm), and Cont.S.Poly (contact-to-gate clearance = 140nm). 3. Perform automated error density evaluation and verify zero pseudo-errors in periphery-to-array transition boundary regions. | `Pass: Exactly zero DRC violations in the core 8F2 cell array and boundary rings; contact width measured at 180nm +/- 1nm; Poly-to-Contact spacing strictly >= 140nm across all 1024 cells in test vehicle.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-1-02` | **3D Field-Solver PEX Parameter Extraction and Bitline Capacitance Balance Benchmark** | Synopsys StarRC / FastCap 3D Field Solver integrated with ngspice/HSPICE circuit simulator | 1. Run 3D field-solver parasitic extraction on the shared bitline contact, storage node pads, and adjacent pass-gate wordlines with mesh density set to <= 10nm. 2. Extract lumped and distributed RLC netlist containing C_BL-GND, C_BL-WL, C_BL-SN, and inter-bitline coupling C_BL-BLB. 3. Simulate bitline precharge-to-sensing transition at V_BL = 0.9V (V_DD/2) and calculate the differential capacitance offset |C_BL - C_BLB| / C_BL. | `Pass: Extracted total bitline capacitance C_BL <= 150 fF per 256-cell column; contact parasitic series resistance R_BLC <= 45 Ohms per contact; capacitance mismatch |C_BL - C_BLB| / C_BL <= 2.0%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 4 Chemical Splash Apron (Neoprene/Butyl), Heavy-duty chemical resistant gloves (Viton outer, Nitrile inner double-gloving), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield and ANSI Z87.1 certified safety goggles, Acid gas respirator cartridged mask (for pre-clean chemical loading operations)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid exposure: Immediately drench affected area with copious water for 2-3 minutes while removing contaminated PPE; liberally massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel continuously into skin until medical arrival. For eye exposure, flush with sterile eyewash solution or 1% calcium gluconate eye flush for 15 minutes. Inhalation requires immediate high-concentration oxygen administration.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet bench exhaust maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) with negative pressure differential (-25 Pa relative to cleanroom ballroom); continuous ambient HF gas detection system with dual alarm thresholds (0.5 ppm warning, 1.0 ppm evacuation) interlocked with automated scrubber damper systems.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent HF/BOE solutions must be isolated into dedicated fluorinated waste collection drains; neutralized in automated fluoride treatment system via Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) precipitation into insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) sludge, followed by filter pressing. Acid waste neutralization to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (BOE 6:1 solution for contact pre-clean)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Tier 3 / Electronic Grade | `6.8% HF, 34.6% NH4F aqueous` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha Clean H2SO4 component)** | `7664-93-9` | VLSI Grade | `96.0% wt` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Piranha Clean H2O2 component)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade | `30.0% wt` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (CVD TiN barrier precursor)** | `7550-45-0` | 99.999% trace metals basis | `100% pure liquid precursor` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Anisotropic plasma reactive-ion etched (RIE) contact vias through ILD-1 dielectric stopping abruptly on TiSi2 or active area silicon with residual fluorocarbon polymer buildup.

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM matrix at the 180nm node, the shared bitline contact (BLC) and storage node landing pad (SNLP) are critical bottlenecks for parasitic capacitance and electrical coupling. If the extracted parasitic capacitance (C_BL) between the shared BLC and adjacent pass-gate wordlines (WL) or storage pads exceeds 180 fF/mm, the bitline charge transfer ratio (C_s / (C_s + C_BL)) will be degraded below the minimum 15% sense margin required for reliable sensing by the cross-coupled PMOS/NMOS regenerative sense amplifier. Furthermore, 180nm lithography limits tight contact enclosure, leading to asymmetric parasitic capacitances between true and complementary bitline pairs (BL and /BL), which induces common-mode-to-differential offset noise exceeding the SA input offset voltage budget of 15 mV.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm design rules, the active area (AA) shared contact must provide low specific contact resistivity while preventing junction leakage under V_PP overdrive (2.5V-2.8V on WL). Standard logic DRC decks impose conservative contact-to-gate spacing (typically >= 220nm) and contact enclosure by active area (>= 60nm), which breaks the 8F2 layout pitch (cell area ~ 0.26 µm²). An aggressive full-custom DRAM DRC deck modification with specialized conditional design rules (e.g., self-aligned contact tolerance or borderline enclosure waivers of <= 30nm) must be developed. For parameter extraction, 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) must accurately capture 3D fringing fields between the landing pad, poly wordlines, and substrate, accounting for barrier metallization (Ti/TiN) sheet resistance and Silicide/Active contact resistance (R_c < 50 Ohm/contact).
critics.supply_chain: Standard commercial 180nm CMOS MPW foundries strictly prohibit unvalidated sub-resolution or design-rule waivers without foundry fab signoff due to yield fallout risks from contact bridging or unlanded via opens. Enforcing tight contact landing rules on the shared bitline node requires coordination with the foundry device engineering group to calibrate optical proximity correction (OPC) models for high-density DRAM array arrays, or else default standard-logic rule decks will reject the GDSII during mask data preparation (MDP), stalling the shuttle tapeout.
critics.laya_pm: From a physical layout and project schedule standpoint, implementing custom DRC/LVS deck runsets and 3D PEX extraction tables adds high iteration overhead. If parameter extraction decks do not seamlessly back-annotate into the post-layout SPICE netlist with standardized hierarchical pin definitions, timing closure across the Dickson charge-pump-driven wordline activation and sensing restoration loop will slip the planned foundry shuttle submission deadline by weeks.
critical_failure_modes: Contact punch-through or dielectric breakdown between the shared BLC and pass-gate Wordline under boosted V_PP overdrive (2.8V), causing irreversible gate-to-channel or gate-to-bitline leakage shorts.

Asymmetric enclosure and contact overlay error resulting in silicon active area corner clipping, escalating storage node junction leakage (I_leak > 10 fA/cell) and reducing retention time below 64 ms at 85°C.
Excessive parasitic bitline capacitance imbalance (Delta C_BL > 5% between BL and /BL) causing false read evaluations and sense amplifier lockup on weak data states ('0' or '1').
