# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Hierarchical DRC/LVS Deck Execution for Shared Contact & Landing Pad Array

---

### 1. Scope & Execution Context
- **Process Technology Node**: 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Open-Source DRAM (Gen 3).
- **Topology**: 8F² Folded Bitline 1T1C Memory Array with Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB).
- **Critical Targets**: Access NMOS gate length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, channel width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$, shared bitline contact pitch, and storage node landing pad alignment for tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnects.

---

### 2. Hierarchical Execution Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   GDSII Layout Input   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Hierarchical      │
│  Boundary Extraction   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Array Repetition    │
│     Cell Filtering     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Shared Bitline     │
│   Contact DRC Check    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Storage Node Landing  │
│     Pad LVS Match      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  DRC/LVS Verification  │
│        Sign-Off        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Hierarchy Environment Setup & Cell GDS Import**:
   - Initialize the automated DRC/LVS run deck targeting the top-level array macro (`DRAM_8F2_ARRAY_TOP`).
   - Enable hierarchical flattening exclusions for recurring sub-blocks: lock unit cell instances (`CELL_1T1C_8F2`) and shared bitline contacts (`BL_CONTACT_SHARED`) to process repetitions in-cell rather than exploding polygons flat.

2. **Access Transistor Dimension & Enclosure Verification (DRC)**:
   - Run design rule check rules against active diffusion (OD/DIFF) and polysilicon gate (POLY1):
     - Assert access transistor gate length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$ and gate width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
     - Check minimum active area enclosure and gate extension over diffusion.

3. **Shared Bitline Contact Verification**:
   - Validate shared contact pitch placed symmetrically between dual access NMOS drain nodes.
   - Verify minimum contact overlap by metal-1 / bitline strap and diffusion enclosure to eliminate contact landing shifts.

4. **Storage Node Landing Pad & W-Plug Rule Deck Execution**:
   - Execute landing pad enclosure rules for the storage node node contact (SN plug) connecting to the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structure.
   - Verify spacing from storage node landing pad to adjacent wordline and bitline routes to prevent bridging shorts.

5. **Netlist Extraction & Parasitic-Aware LVS Matching**:
   - Extract 1T1C unit cells by recognizing cross-coupled pairs, access NMOS source/drain assignments, and shared bitline connectivity.
   - Cross-reference schematic netlist with extracted layout topology:
     - Match cell storage node terminal ($N_{\text{SN}}$) connectivity to stacked capacitor top/bottom plates.
     - Verify common bitline continuity across 256 or 512 cells per bitline column.
   - Run soft-check verification for substrate well taps and substrate isolation around NMOS array blocks.

---

### 4. Normalized Parameter Baseline Reference

```text
              DRAM Array Physical & Target Budgets    
           ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
           │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
   L Length┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
           │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒         │
    W Width┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒         │
Delta V Win┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
           │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
 C_s Target┤█████████████████████████████████████████│
           │█████████████████████████████████████████│
           └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
            0         7        14        21        28 
```
*(Values: $C_s = 28\,\text{fF}$, $\Delta V_{\text{read}} = 150\,\text{mV peak}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$, $L = 180\,\text{nm}$)*

---

### 5. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Check / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Transistor Geometry ($L \times W$)** | $180 \times 220$ | Exactly $180 \pm 0$ / $220 \pm 0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **8F² Unit Cell Layout Area** | $0.259$ | $\le 0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ |
| **Minimum Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0$ to $30.0$ (nominally $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1$ to $9.0 : 1$ | Max limit $< 10.0 : 1$ | Dimensionless (Ratio) |
| **DRC / LVS Violation Count** | $0$ | Strict $0$ errors / clean sign-off | Violations |

---

### 6. Verified Context Citations
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: Footprint $8F^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$; storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$ (nominal $28\,\text{fF}$); bitline parasitic $C_b = 150\,\text{fF}$ to $250\,\text{fF}$ across 256/512 cells; capacitance ratio $C_b/C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (must not exceed $10:1$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor gate dimensions $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$; shared bitline contact architecture; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with W-plug landing pad; target cell leakage $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at 85°C.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Signal development $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$, generating $100\,\text{mV}$ to $150\,\text{mV}$ differential read margin for $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\,\text{fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical execution of DRC and LVS decks across a dense 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C array requires strict cell boundary abstraction and flattening depth control. If the KLayout DRC or Magic/Netgen LVS run scripts indiscriminately flatten the repetitive 512x512 bitline contact and storage node landing pad matrices, memory exhaustion (>64GB RAM) will trigger OOM kills during Boolean polygon fracturing. The automated flow must isolate the core repetitive unit cell boundary and run hierarchical property checks with explicit boundary halo margin definitions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm commercial node, bitline contact (BLC) and storage node landing pad (SNLP) arrays push standard foundry design rules to the boundary limits. Common failure modes include corner rounding bridging between adjacent active area landing pads, contact-to-gate overlap margin violations under maximum lithographic misalignment (3-sigma overlay error ~35nm), and false LVS shorts caused by non-pin poly gate taps in folded bitline architectures. The DRC deck must include custom 2D optical proximity correction (OPC) space verification and pitch-based conditional rule checks.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automating physical verification with open-source toolchains (KLayout, Magic, Netgen) requires continuous alignment with the commercial 180nm foundry PDK signoff release. Any discrepancy in layer map definitions (GDS layer/datatype numbering) or extraction parameters between open-source decks and foundry-certified Calibre/PVS gold decks directly risks MPW mask rejection, multi-month shuttle delays, and non-refundable mask re-spin tooling fees ($25,000-$40,000 USD).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The automated verification pipeline must execute within a standard CI/CD turnaround budget of less than 20 minutes per macro iteration. Allowing non-convergent hierarchical rule looping or manual error waiver overrides disrupts the tapeout timeline. Clear regression baselines with zero-waiver policies on hard DRC/LVS violations must be enforced prior to physical GDS-II freezing for the foundry MPW shuttle.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Memory stack overflow or infinite looping during polygon fracturing of highly dense 8F2 array arrays caused by improper hierarchical cell boundary hierarchy scoping in open-source verification scripts.
1. Uncaught soft shorts or contact enclosure violations on storage node landing pads due to incorrect poly-to-active extraction rule definitions under worst-case overlay shift.
1. GDS layer-datatype mapping divergence between open-source KLayout/Magic runsets and commercial 180nm foundry signoff specifications leading to fabricated open circuits on bitline contacts.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-2-01` | **Hierarchical Contact Enclosure and Spacing DRC Execution Verification** | Automated headless KLayout 0.28+ batch execution engine running on an 8-core Linux workstation with 64GB RAM, coupled with a custom Python log/report parser. | 1. Ingest target GDS-II file and foundry-aligned 180nm DRC runset into the automated batch script: `klayout -b -r drc_180nm_dram_array.lydrc -rd input_gds=dram_array_8f2.gds -rd report_file=drc_report.lyrdb`. 2. Monitor peak system RAM utilization, CPU time, and hierarchy tree flattening depth during execution. 3. Extract resulting XML-based DRC report (`drc_report.lyrdb`) and aggregate violation categories focusing specifically on CONT enclosure by DIFF (min 40nm), CONT enclosure by M1 (min 30nm), and CONT-to-CONT minimum pitch (min 220nm). | `Total execution runtime must be < 600 seconds with peak RAM < 16 GB. Zero (0) critical DRC violations reported across the entire 512x512 array boundary. Any contact enclosure violation or bridge alert results in immediate FAIL.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-2-02` | **Hierarchical LVS Netlist Extraction and Topology Equivalence Verification** | Netgen 1.5+ and Magic 8.3+ physical layout extraction toolchain integrated via automated Python wrapper with SPICE subcircuit comparator. | 1. Run batch physical device and connectivity extraction via Magic: `magic -dnull -noconsole extract_lvs.tcl` to generate `dram_array_8f2_extracted.spice`. 2. Execute hierarchical netlist comparison using Netgen: `netgen -batch lvs dram_array_8f2_extracted.spice dram_array_8f2_golden.spice /pdk/180nm/setup/180nm_lvs.setup lvs_report.out`. 3. Parse `lvs_report.out` for node mismatches, unpaired components, dummy transistor configurations, and parasitic capacitance balance on paired folded bitlines. | `Netgen output must terminate with 'Circuits match uniquely.' Zero (0) unmatched nodes, zero (0) net shorts, zero (0) floating contacts, and zero (0) extraction parameter discrepancies exceeding 1.0% tolerance on device W/L geometries.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Anti-static ESD wrist strap and grounded ESD heel straps, ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses for server/cleanroom laboratory operation, Nitrile cleanroom gloves (Class 100 compatible) during physical media/wafer inspection transfer
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA wipe solvent, flush immediately with copious amounts of clean running water or eyewash station for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of vapors in server enclosure, remove personnel to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard climate-controlled computing laboratory with ASHRAE TC 9.9 compliant HVAC, continuous positive air displacement, and HEPA particulate filtering (Cleanliness Class ISO 7).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of spent IPA wipes in designated flame-retardant, sealed hazardous solvent containment bins in accordance with local environmental regulations.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`

- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Mask-data-prep (MDP) ready layout archive with embedded signoff checksums, ready for foundry optical pattern generation (OPG) fracturing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding layout signoff queue time relative to foundry MPW cut-off window results in disqualification from the scheduled tapeout shuttle run, postponing physical silicon manufacturing by at least 3 months.

Common failure modes include corner rounding bridging between adjacent active area landing pads, contact-to-gate overlap margin violations under maximum lithographic misalignment (3-sigma overlay error ~35nm), and false LVS shorts caused by non-pin poly gate taps in folded bitline architectures. The DRC deck must include custom 2D optical proximity correction (OPC) space verification and pitch-based conditional rule checks.
critics.supply_chain: Automating physical verification with open-source toolchains (KLayout, Magic, Netgen) requires continuous alignment with the commercial 180nm foundry PDK signoff release. Any discrepancy in layer map definitions (GDS layer/datatype numbering) or extraction parameters between open-source decks and foundry-certified Calibre/PVS gold decks directly risks MPW mask rejection, multi-month shuttle delays, and non-refundable mask re-spin tooling fees ($25,000-$40,000 USD).
critics.laya_pm: The automated verification pipeline must execute within a standard CI/CD turnaround budget of less than 20 minutes per macro iteration. Allowing non-convergent hierarchical rule looping or manual error waiver overrides disrupts the tapeout timeline. Clear regression baselines with zero-waiver policies on hard DRC/LVS violations must be enforced prior to physical GDS-II freezing for the foundry MPW shuttle.
critical_failure_modes: Memory stack overflow or infinite looping during polygon fracturing of highly dense 8F2 array arrays caused by improper hierarchical cell boundary hierarchy scoping in open-source verification scripts.
Uncaught soft shorts or contact enclosure violations on storage node landing pads due to incorrect poly-to-active extraction rule definitions under worst-case overlay shift.
GDS layer-datatype mapping divergence between open-source KLayout/Magic runsets and commercial 180nm foundry signoff specifications leading to fabricated open circuits on bitline contacts.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Landing Pad Enclosure & Parasitic Extraction LVS Metrology Review & Sign-Off

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > 1T1C Unit Cell Layout & Shared-Contact Active Area Design [Circuit Design] > Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Landing Pad DRC/LVS Verification [Metrology] > Landing Pad Enclosure & Parasitic Extraction LVS Metrology Review & Sign-Off [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-1-3-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Landing Pad Enclosure & Parasitic Extraction LVS Metrology Review & Sign-Off: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`
- [ ] `ALD_3D_Crown_TEM_StepCoverage_Analysis.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure: 8F2 Folded Bitline Interconnect & Metal-Fix Routing Integration

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 8F^2 folded bitline topology in a 180nm CMOS commercial MPW context must strictly budget parasitic bitline capacitance (C_BL) against cell storage capacitance (C_s >= 28 fF) to sustain a sensing ratio C_s / (C_s + C_BL) >= 0.12. Inadvertent line-to-line coupling across long parallel M1/M2 runs and metal-fix jumpers induces inter-bitline crosstalk (delta V_noise > 25 mV), degrading differential sense amplifier margin. Metal-fix jumper channels must implement continuous ground/shield shielding or staggered twist permutations without violating MPW standard DRC density limits.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm lithography limits, folded bitline interconnect pitch (F = 180nm, cell area = 8F^2 = 0.2592 um^2) demands capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture with tungsten (W) plug landing pads. Metal-fix routing straps overlaid on Metal 2/Metal 3 must preserve planar topography; excessive via stacking (Via1 to Via2/Via3) without chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) dummy fill compliance will generate depth-of-focus defocus and metal stress-voiding during post-BEOL sintering at 400°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial multi-project wafer (MPW) runs restrict custom backend layer edits and impose rigid tapeout DRC/dummy fill rules. Introducing non-standard metal-fix cut/strap layers or post-passivation laser-fuse link geometries risks shuttle rejection or mask floorplan disqualification. Mask data preparation (MDP) reticle generation schedules must freeze 14 days prior to foundry shutter closure, leaving zero margin for unverified manual metal-fix DRC cleanups.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Interconnect layout tapeout milestone gate ROOT-2-2 mandates full DRC/LVS/PEX signoff across TT/FF/SS corner decks by Week 38. Layout engineering cannot absorb manual routing iterations for spare wordline/bitline metal-fix strapping; automated ECO router scripts must generate DRC-clean reroute patches with deterministic GDSII diff verification within 24 hours of timing-closure feedback.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inter-bitline parasitic capacitance imbalance causing false differential latching during sense amplification read cycles.
1. Tungsten via-plug peel-off or high contact resistance (> 50 Ohm/contact) at the metal-fix jumper interface due to post-CMP slurry entrapment.
1. BEOL dielectric breakdown or stress-induced voiding across tightly pitched Metal-1 bitline pairs under elevated operating bias (V_DD = 1.8V).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-01` | **Post-Layout Parasitic Bitline Capacitance & Symmetry Extraction** | Synopsys StarRC / Cadence Quantus PEX Extraction Engine coupled with Keysight 4156C Precision Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (wafer-prober test structure correlation) | 1. Run rule-based 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) on the integrated GDSII block across Nominal, Min, and Max BEOL corner files. 2. Extract total single-ended bitline capacitance C_BL (BL_true) and complementary bitline capacitance C_BL_bar (BL_comp) including junction, overlap, and metal-to-metal fringing components. 3. Calculate bitline capacitance mismatch: Delta_C_BL = |C_BL - C_BL_bar|. 4. Simulate sense margin delta V_sense = (V_DD / 2) * (C_s / (C_s + C_BL)) with C_s = 28.0 fF at TT, 25°C and SS, 85°C. | `Total bitline capacitance C_BL <= 180.0 fF per 128-cell segment; capacitance imbalance Delta_C_BL <= 1.5 fF (< 1.0% asymmetry); differential sense margin delta V_sense >= 115 mV at 1.8V supply.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-02` | **Metal-Fix Jumper Contact Resistance & Electromigration Stress Verification** | Wafer Probing Station with Keithley 2400 SourceMeter for Kelvin 4-wire DC resistance measurement and high-temperature accelerated EM stress chamber (200°C, 100 hours) | 1. Apply 1.0 mA DC forcing current through Kelvin test pads across the M1-Via1-M2 metal-fix jumper chain. 2. Measure four-point voltage drop to resolve single-via contact resistance R_via. 3. Subject identical test array to accelerated electromigration stress (J = 1.5 MA/cm^2, T = 200°C) for 100 continuous hours. 4. Measure post-stress resistance shift Delta_R / R_0. | `Initial single via-1/metal-fix contact resistance R_via <= 4.5 Ohm/via; post-EM stress resistance shift Delta_R / R_0 <= 5.0% after 100 hours at 200°C with zero open circuits.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Chemical-resistant neoprene/nitrile double gloves, Polycarbonate full-face splash shield (ANSI Z87.1 compliant), Acid/solvent-resistant heavy-duty apron, Cleanroom flame-retardant anti-static coveralls and conductive cleanroom boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF contact: Immediately rinse affected skin with copious flowing water for 5 minutes, then vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the skin until pain subsides; seek immediate emergency medical care. For eye exposure, irrigate with sterile 1% calcium gluconate ophthalmic solution or isotonic saline for 15+ minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench dedicated local exhaust ventilation (LEV) maintaining a continuous face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); continuous HF and acid vapor scrubbing system with automated toxic gas leak detection interlocking wet bench shutoff.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride-containing effluent into dedicated PVDF/fluoropolymer waste drains; treat with excess calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) cake; verify supernatant pH reaches 7.0 - 8.5 before discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (BOE 6:1)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `6.8% HF in NH4F` |
| **Sulfuric Acid** | `7664-93-9` | Semiconductor Grade | `96.0%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade | `30.0%` |

# Standard Operating Procedure: M1-M2 Folded Bitline Contact & Interconnect Parasitic Pitch Synthesis

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline architecture at the 180nm node (F = 180 nm, cell area = 0.259 um2), Metal-1 (M1) runs parallel as the bitline (BL/BLb) with a target tight pitch of 2F = 360 nm (180 nm line / 180 nm space). Sputtered Al-0.5%Cu at 350 nm thickness yields an interconnect aspect ratio near 1.94:1. With inter-metal dielectric (SiO2, k ~ 3.9-4.1) or fluorosilicate glass (FSG, k ~ 3.6), the line-to-line lateral parasitic capacitance (C_BL-BL) dominates total bitline capacitance (C_BL ~ 180-250 fF). Given a minimum cell storage capacitance C_s = 28 fF, excessive C_BL severely degrades the sensing voltage margin delta_V = (V_DD / 2) * (C_s / (C_s + C_BL)) below 100 mV, increasing sensing latency and risking bitline-to-bitline capacitive crosstalk during sensing transitions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Direct contact between M1 bitline and the active silicon drain requires a robust barrier and plug module. Direct aluminum deposition onto silicon or thin salicide causes catastrophic aluminum spiking across shallow trench isolation (STI) and shallow source/drain junction boundaries at post-metal annealing temperatures (400°C). A refractory contact plug architecture (Ti/TiN adhesion/barrier layer followed by chemical vapor deposition of Tungsten, W-plug, planarized via CMP) is mandatory for both Bitline Contact (BLC) and Via-1 (M1-M2). Furthermore, Via-1 pitch between M1 bitlines and M2 wordline strapping lines must maintain minimum enclosure design rules without voiding or micro-bridging in tight 360 nm array pitches.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard open-source/commercial 180nm MPW runs (such as SkyWater 130nm/180nm or TSMC 0.18um BCD/CMOS) impose rigid design rule manual (DRM) constraints on M1/M2 pitch (typically 0.36 um to 0.46 um minimum pitch) and maximum W-plug aspect ratios (~3:1). Specialized high-aspect-ratio contacts or low-k spin-on dielectrics are unavailable on standard shared multi-project reticles, forcing parasitic reduction to rely strictly on routing topology (e.g., bitline twisting/transposition, staggered bitline contacts) rather than proprietary fab materials.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Parasitic extraction (PEX) must accurately capture 3D corner/fringe capacitance matrices for folded bitline pairs before tapeout signoff. Full layout verification against design rule check (DRC) and layout-versus-schematic (LVS) with metal density fill rules must be synchronized with MPW tapeout milestones to prevent mask generation delays caused by optical proximity correction (OPC) failures on sub-200nm line-end spacing.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inter-bitline crosstalk-induced sensing failure due to adjacent BL/BLb lateral coupling exceeding 25% of total bitline capacitance without bitline transposition.
1. Aluminum junction spiking and barrier puncture during forming gas anneal (400°C) from defective TiN/W-plug lining, causing access transistor junction leakage > 100 fA/cell.
1. Stress-induced voiding (SIV) and electromigration failure at M1-Via1-M2 interfaces under continuous write/precharge cycling.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-1-01` | **M1 Bitline Sheet Resistance and Inter-Line Capacitance Extraction** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer connected to Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automatic Probe Station with 4-terminal Kelvin and high-frequency LCR meter (B1520A multi-frequency capacitance measurement unit). | 1. Measure sheet resistance (R_s) of M1 (350 nm Al-0.5%Cu) using 4-point Kelvin probe on 100 um x 100 um van der Pauw structure at 10 mA forced current. 2. Measure line resistance of 1000-cell folded M1 bitline runner (length = 360 um, width = 180 nm). 3. Connect B1520A LCR meter between adjacent complimentary bitline pairs (BL and BLb) at 1 MHz test frequency, 30 mV AC oscillation amplitude, 0V DC bias, with substrate and adjacent shield lines grounded. 4. Record total inter-line capacitance and compute capacitance per unit length (fF/um). | `Sheet resistance R_s <= 0.08 Ohm/sq (target 0.075 Ohm/sq +/- 0.005 Ohm/sq); Total M1 line resistance for 1000-cell bitline <= 160 Ohm; Total inter-bitline coupling capacitance C_coupling <= 0.12 fF/um.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-1-02` | **BLC and Via-1 Kelvin Contact Resistance and Leakage Yield Characterization** | Keysight B1500A Precision IV Unit (HRSMU) with triaxial cabling to low-leakage shielded probe station enclosed in dark box. | 1. Force 10 uA DC current through 10,000-contact chain via Kelvin pads; measure total voltage drop and calculate average contact resistance per plug. 2. Apply 1.8 V reverse bias between isolated BLC plug arrays and p-well substrate at 25°C; record junction leakage current per contact. 3. Elevate hot chuck temperature to 85°C; soak for 15 minutes and repeat leakage measurement across 10,000 contacts. | `Single W-plug contact resistance R_contact <= 5.0 Ohm/plug (chain resistance <= 50 kOhm); Contact junction leakage current <= 1.0 fA/cell contact at 85°C under 1.8 V bias.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile chemical-resistant outer gloves over cleanroom inner gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles and full-face polycarbonate shield, Acid/solvent resistant cleanroom apron (Tychem/PTFE), Viton sleeves for wet chemical bench transfer
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) skin exposure: Immediately flush affected skin area with copious cold water for 1 minute, then continuously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the skin until medical emergency services arrive. In case of WF6 gas exposure or HF inhalation: Evacuate immediately to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen via mask, and summon emergency medical team. For eyes: Flush with sterile saline for at least 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All CVD (WF6) and PVD chambers must exhaust through dedicated, double-walled containment lines connected to point-of-use thermal/wet scrubbers with real-time toxic gas monitoring (TGM) calibrated for fluoride/HF detection at 0.1 ppm threshold. Dedicated acid fume hoods required for wet DHF pre-clean benches with minimum face velocity of 100 LFPM (0.5 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Fluoride-bearing wet chemical effluent from pre-clean wet benches must be routed to automated industrial fluoride neutralization tanks, reacted with excess calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2), adjusted to pH 6.5-8.5, and filter-pressed prior to discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Argon (High Purity Sputtering Gas)** | `7440-37-1` | 99.999% (5N Research Grade) | `100%` |
| **Aluminum-Copper Sputtering Target (Al-0.5wt%Cu)** | `7429-90-5` | 99.999% (5N Pure Metal Alloy) | `99.5% Al, 0.5% Cu` |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (CVD W-plug precursor)** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade 5N | `> 99.999%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Pre-metal native oxide strip)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI Grade | `0.5% (100:1 DHF)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-RIE contact hole patterned and etched down to diffusion/silicide with photoresist stripped via O2 plasma ash and wet solvent residue removed; contact open verified.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dip in 100:1 dilute HF (DHF) completed, surface hydrogen-passivated with native oxide thickness < 0.3 nm, dried via Marangoni IPA vapor dry.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Regrowth of native silicon dioxide (SiO2 > 1.2 nm) inside sub-micron contact holes causing open contact failure or anomalous contact resistance spike (> 100 Ohm/plug) and barrier delamination during subsequent Ti/TiN PVD liner deposition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Synthesized and validated M1-M2 folded bitline contact and parasitic interconnect layout module conforming to 180nm commercial MPW PDK design rules, achieving R_s < 0.08 Ohm/sq, bitline-to-bitline parasitic coupling capacitance < 0.12 fF/um, and W-plug contact resistance < 5 Ohm/plug for sensing margin >= 100 mV.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `M1_M2_Folded_Bitline_Pitch_Synthesis_DRC_LVS_Signoff.pdf`
- [ ] `Parasitic_Extraction_RC_Coupling_Matrix_M1_M2.csv`
- [ ] `TEM_Cross_Section_BLC_Via1_Interconnect_Analysis.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **M1 bitline thin film sheet resistance after 400°C 30-min forming gas anneal** | `0.075 Ohm/sq` | +/- 0.005 Ohm/sq | Four-point Kelvin probe electrical parametric test on van der Pauw structures across 5 wafer sites |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Inter-bitline lateral coupling capacitance (C_BL-BL) per unit length at 360nm pitch** | `0.110 fF/um` | <= 0.120 fF/um | High-frequency (1 MHz) LCR meter characterization on interleaved 1000-cell bitline comb test structure validated against Calibre 3D PEX |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Average contact resistance of tungsten plug Bitline Contact (BLC) and Via-1** | `3.5 Ohm/plug` | <= 5.0 Ohm/plug | Kelvin contact resistance measurement on 10,000-contact chain test array |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC and LVS reports without waivers on M1/M2 pitch, BLC enclosure, and Via-1 spacing; parasitic extraction confirming sense amplifier differential signal delta_V >= 105 mV across TT/SS/FF process corners at 85°C; physical SEM/TEM cross-sections confirming zero voiding in W-plug contacts and uniform M1 thickness of 350 nm +/- 5%.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: M1 Bitline Contact (BLC) and W-Plug Geometry Pitch Synthesis
**Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > 8F² Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing > 8F² Folded Bitline Interconnect & Metal-Fix Routing Integration > M1-M2 Folded Bitline Contact & Interconnect Parasitic Pitch Synthesis  
**Action Type**: Make | **Generation**: Gen 3 (180 nm) | **Context Node**: 180nm 1T1C Folded Bitline DRAM

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Define Unit Cell &   │
│    Active Diffusion    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Synthesize Shared    │
│   BLC W-Plug Contact   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Deposit CVD Ti/TiN   │
│    Liner & Tungsten    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  CMP Planarization to  │
│     ILD Interface      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Pattern M1 Bitline   │
│  Track & Interconnect  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Active Diffusion & Access Transistor Sizing**:
   - Establish the 1T1C access transistor channel dimensions at length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure the gate oxide interface conforms to thermally grown dry $\text{SiO}_2$ target physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$.

2. **Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Geometry & Layout Synthesis**:
   - Lay out the shared central BLC node centered between two adjacent 8F² memory access transistors along the active diffusion run.
   - Constrain the folded bitline interconnect array pitch within the range of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ (matching orthogonal wordline pitch requirements).

3. **Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) Via Formation**:
   - Etch high-aspect-ratio contact vias through the pre-metal interlayer dielectric (ILD) down to the shared source/drain active junction.
   - Sputter/deposit a CVD barrier/adhesion liner (Ti/TiN), followed by conformal chemical vapor deposition (CVD) Tungsten (W) fill to form the vertical contact stud.

4. **Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) & M1 Interface**:
   - Perform tungsten CMP down to the ILD top interface to yield planar W-plugs free of recess dishing.
   - Deposit and pattern Metal 1 (M1) bitline metal lines across the planarized W-plugs along the $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch grid.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               Target Metrics & Design Windows          
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
 Bitline Pitch ┤███████████████████████████████████████│
    Active (W) ┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
Channel L (nm) ┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                        │
               └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬───────┬┘
                0        100       200       300     400
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Exact Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | $380$ | $360 - 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC / CD-SEM Metrology |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | Exact nominal ($\pm 10\%$) | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / DRC Rule Deck |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | Exact nominal ($\pm 10\%$) | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / DRC Rule Deck |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | Max allowable | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Automated Wafer Parametric Test |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact configuration; leakage threshold $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 8F² folded bitline array pitch $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric $\text{SiO}_2$ physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 180nm architecture, the shared Bitline Contact (BLC) plug directly interfaces the common active drain diffusion of two adjacent access transistors to the M1 bitline. The critical system-level bottleneck is RC-delay dispersion across a 512-wordline array segment: if contact resistance Rc deviates above 45 Ohm per plug or contact capacitance exceeds 0.35 fF, the bitline sensing margin (Delta V_BL = V_BLP +/- (C_s / (C_s + C_BL)) * (V_cell - V_BLP)) degrades by >12%, collapsing the sense amplifier latching window below the 15 ns design target under worst-case 1.8V VDD drops.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm lithography (F = 180nm), patterning the W-plug BLC with a 1:1 contact hole (CD = 220 nm +/- 15 nm, height = 480 nm, Aspect Ratio ~2.2:1) directly between poly gate wordlines requires rigorous ILD0 planarization and self-aligned/tightly enclosed overlays. Ti/TiN liner coverage is non-negotiable: a minimum 10 nm PVD/CVD TiN barrier is necessary to suppress WF6 gas attack into n+ Si during CVD tungsten reduction (SiH4 / H2 chemistry), which otherwise precipitates voluntary 'wormholes' and junction leakage exceeding the 1 fA/cell ceiling at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4 precursors for W-CVD deposition, alongside TiCl4/TEMAT for barrier deposition, are vulnerable to specialized electronic-grade gas supply disruptions and transport container certifications (DOT-3AA). Furthermore, CMP slurries containing colloidal silica or fumed alumina with selective ferric nitrate oxidizers require strict batch-to-batch shelf-life control (<6 months at 15-25°C) to prevent slurry crystallization and micro-scratching on the W-plug array.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule critical path depends on synchronizing the contact photolithography mask tapeout with the CMP slurry conditioning window. Tool availability for the AMAT Centura W-CVD and Mirra Mesa CMP tracks must be locked 3 weeks prior to lot arrival. A slippage in W-plug CMP over-polish characterization will stall inline Kelvin/TLM parametric extraction and delay downstream M1 Damascene/RIE patterning by 14 calendar days.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Volcano defect / WF6 junction penetration: TiN barrier thin-edge failure on contact bottom perimeter causing WF6 reaction with substrate silicon, generating SiF4 gas eruptions, micro-voids, and pn-junction leakage > 10 fA/cell.
1. Tungsten plug keyhole voiding: Sub-optimal CVD nucleation (insufficient SiH4 precursor initiation step) causing premature pinch-off at the contact neck, leading to high resistance (>250 Ohm/contact) or open-circuit BLC failures during thermal cycling.
1. BLC-to-Wordline bridging: Overlay misalignment between BLC and poly wordline combined with ILD0 spacer erosion, resulting in catastrophic gate-to-bitline shorts.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-1-1-01` | **Specific Contact Resistivity and Single-Plug Kelvin Resistance Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer connected to Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station | 1. Force 4-wire Kelvin current I_force from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA across the BLC W-plug test pad pair and measure voltage drop V_sense. 2. Calculate single W-plug contact resistance R_c = Delta V / Delta I. 3. Step probe to TLM array, measure R_total across pad spacings d = [5, 10, 20, 40, 80] um at I = 500 uA. 4. Perform linear regression of R_total vs d to extract slope (R_sheet/W) and y-intercept (2*R_c). 5. Compute specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Single BLC W-plug resistance R_c must be <= 45.0 Ohm (Kelvin). Extracted specific contact resistivity rho_c on n+ active area must be <= 2.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2 with linear regression coefficient R^2 >= 0.998.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-1-1-02` | **BLC-to-Wordline Dielectric Breakdown and Off-State Leakage Validation** | Keysight B1505A Power Device Analyzer / High-Voltage SMU with thermal chuck controller | 1. Ground adjacent Poly Wordline comb. 2. Apply voltage ramp to BLC array from 0V to 3.6V (2x nominal VDD) in 50 mV steps with 100 ms dwell time. 3. Record leakage current I_leak at 1.8V and 3.6V. 4. Continue ramp up to dielectric hard breakdown (step to 10V or compliance limit 10 mA) to determine breakdown field E_bd. | `Total array leakage at 1.8V (85°C) must be < 10.0 pA across 10,000 plugs (normalized < 1.0 fA/cell equivalent). Dielectric hard breakdown voltage V_bd must exceed 7.2V (>4 MV/cm across ILD0 sidewall spacer).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B chemical PPE for CVD maintenance / Level C for normal cleanroom operation, Dual-cartridge respirator with multi-gas/acid gas/particulate filter (NIOSH approved for HF/acid fumes), Heavy-duty butyl/fluoropolymer outer gloves over nitrile inner gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles and full-face polycarbonate shield, Flame-resistant, chemical-resistant antistatic cleanroom bunny suit
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: WF6 reacts instantly with atmospheric moisture to release toxic HF and Tungsten oxides. In case of skin contact: Immediately flush with water for 5 minutes, then vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into the affected area until medical personnel arrive. In case of inhalation: Remove victim to fresh air, administer 100% oxygen; if pulmonary edema is suspected, provide nebulized 2.5% calcium gluconate solution under physician direction. Eye exposure: Irrigate with sterile 1% calcium gluconate or copious saline for 15 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous point-of-use dedicated toxic gas scrubber connected to dedicated acid/toxic exhaust (velocity >= 15 m/s). Negative pressure gas cabinet with continuous electrochemical WF6 and pyrophoric SiH4 detectors interlocked with automated pneumatic shutoff valves at 0.5 ppm WF6 threshold.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: W-CMP effluent must be directed to specialized heavy-metal coagulation units: precipitate tungsten as calcium tungstate (CaWO4) using lime/CaCl2 slurry at pH 8.5-9.5, followed by flocculation and sludge dewatering. Acid exhaust scrubbers must use recirculating NaOH/Ca(OH)2 scrub solutions to neutralize fluoride effluents below 10 ppm permissible discharge limits.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (WF6)** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade 5N5 (99.9995%) | `100% Compressed Liquefied Gas` |
| **Silane (SiH4)** | `7803-62-5` | VLSI Grade 6N (99.9999%) | `100% Compressed Gas (or 2% in Ar/H2)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2) in CMP Slurry** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier 3) | `2.0% - 4.0% wt in aqueous slurry` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) Pre-Clean** | `7664-39-3` | Ultra-Pure SLSI Grade | `0.5% - 1.0% Dilute Solution (DHF)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched contact vias post-DHF native oxide strip and in-situ Ar sputter etch; Si active surface hydrogen-terminated and defect-free with native oxide thickness < 0.3 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Planarized W-plug surface post-CMP and post-buff brush scrub; zero residual slurry abrasive particles, W-plug recess < 15 nm, passivated with thin self-limiting WOx under ultra-clean N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes uncontrolled native SiO2 re-growth (>1.2 nm) on bottom contact diffusion, driving contact resistance > 200 Ohm/plug, while moisture condensation initiates galvanic corrosion and severe Ti/TiN barrier peel-off.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical, electrical, and structural signoff of the M1 Bitline Contact (BLC) and W-Plug geometry pitch synthesis within the 180nm 8F2 folded bitline memory cell array, ensuring sub-45 Ohm plug resistance, zero junction poisoning, and robust CMP planarity across all 512-wordline array blocks.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `BLC_WPLUG_KELVIN_TLM_PARAMETRIC_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `BLC_CROSS_SECTION_HRTEM_EDX_ANALYSIS.pdf`
- [ ] `W_CMP_AFM_EROSION_DISROBING_TOPOGRAPHY.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Single-plug Kelvin contact resistance (R_c) of shared Bitline Contact to n+ active area** | `35.0` | +/- 10.0 Ohm | Automated 4-wire Kelvin probe parametric extraction on scribe line test structure (TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-1-1-01) across 25 dies per wafer. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **W-plug contact plug diameter at mid-depth (aspect ratio 2.2:1)** | `220.0` | +/- 15.0 nm | In-line CD-SEM cross-wafer 9-point sampling post-etch and cross-sectional HR-TEM inspection on dense array. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-CMP tungsten plug recess / dishing relative to adjacent ILD0 planar oxide** | `8.0` | <= 12.0 nm maximum | High-resolution Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) 5x5 um scan over dense 8F2 memory array core. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit condition requires 100% yield on Kelvin BLC chains (zero opens on 10,000-plug test vehicle), extracted mean contact resistance <= 45.0 Ohm with 3-sigma spread < 15.0 Ohm, cross-sectional TEM proving continuous >= 10 nm TiN barrier with no WF6 intrusion into n+ diffusion, and written signoff from the Fab Process Integration Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## M1-M2 Folded Bitline Cross-Coupling and Route Pitch Optimization

**Domain Level**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 8F² Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing  
**Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Process & Optimization Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   M1/M2 Track Pitch    │
│       Allocation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Bitline Twist &     │
│     Cross-Coupling     │
│      Minimization      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Parasitic Extraction  │
│     RC Extraction      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Differential Sense   │
│     Margin & Noise     │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Cell Grid & Track Pitch Definition (M1 Bitline Routing)**:
   - Route bitline pairs ($BL$ / $\overline{BL}$) along Metal 1 (M1) at an interconnect route pitch of **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$**, matching the wordline/bitline array grid constraints.
   - Constrain the underlying 1T1C NMOS access transistor dimensions to channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Connect the shared bitline contact between two adjacent memory cells using a tungsten plug (W-plug).

2. **M1-M2 Metal-Fix & Inter-Bitline Twist Integration**:
   - In folded bitline arrays, route complementary lines adjacent to one another. To cancel differential inter-pair cross-coupling capacitance ($C_{c}$), insert periodic bitline twists at $1/4$, $1/2$, and $3/4$ array intervals using Metal 2 (M2) straps and intermediate vias.
   - Route orthogonal Wordline straps or global lines on M2 maintaining the $\ge 360\text{ nm}$ pitch to prevent vertical capacitive coupling into the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) tungsten storage-node contacts.

3. **Parasitic RC Extraction & Cell Charge Budget Balancing**:
   - Perform full-chip parasitic RC extraction on the M1/M2 routing matrix.
   - Verify that the total bitline capacitance ($C_{BL}$) preserves an adequate sense amp charge-sharing ratio with the storage node capacitor:
     $$\Delta V_{BL} = \frac{V_{DD}/2}{1 + C_{BL}/C_{S}}$$
     where storage node capacitance $C_{S}$ is targeted between **$25\text{ fF}$ and $30\text{ fF}$** (minimum **$28\text{ fF}$** budget per cell).

4. **Transient Dynamic Noise & Retention Verification**:
   - Simulate worst-case pattern read/write cycles at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$ and boosted wordline $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$ (generated from the Dickson charge pump to overcome the NMOS pass transistor $V_{th} = 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$).
   - Ensure the total leakage current (sub-threshold and junction) is constrained to retain stored charge without refresh corruption.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with bitline contact shared via W-plug.
   - Stacked COB capacitor budget: minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for noise immunity against coupling capacitance.
   - Target leakage budget: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Interconnect pitch constraints: Wordline and Bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate oxide physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$.
3. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
   - Access NMOS threshold voltage: $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$ at nominal $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$.
   - Wordline drive level requirement: $V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive} \ge 2.5\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$ to prevent $33\%$ loss of stored level.

*Knowledge documentation captured to [m1_m2_folded_bitline_optimization.md](./docs/knowledge/m1_m2_folded_bitline_optimization.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline topology implemented at 180nm, bitline-to-bitline parasitic capacitance (C_BL-BL) across adjacent metal routes directly modulates read sense margin. With target cell capacitance C_s ~ 28 fF and total bitline capacitance C_BL allocated around 150-200 fF, adjacent line capacitive coupling (C_c) exceeding 15% of total C_BL induces severe differential offset during sense amplifier latching, especially under worst-case pattern data toggling (solid '0' against toggling '1's).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Routing bitlines in M1 with wordlines or stitching in M2 requires tight pitch control. At 180nm commercial MPW rules, minimum metal pitch is typically 460-500 nm (240 nm width / 240 nm space). Aggressive route pitch narrowing below 480 nm to shrink array area creates severe lithographic line-end pullback, M1-M2 via enclosure marginalities, and inter-metal dielectric (IMD) sidewall fringing capacitance that degrades differential sense voltage delta_V = (C_s / (2*(C_s + C_BL))) * V_DD.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm foundry MPWs enforce strict design rule manual (DRM) checks and metal density rules (typically 30% to 70% per 50x50 um tile). Deviation from standard back-end-of-line (BEOL) aluminum metallization pitches or non-standard stack height variants requires dedicated mask sets and engineering waivers, escalating tapeout costs and risking rejection during DRC signoff by the shuttle aggregator.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Aggressive M1-M2 parasitic reduction must not jeopardize the shuttle tapeout milestone schedule. Full layout-versus-schematic (LVS) and 3D parasitic extraction (PEX) iterations must freeze with sufficient margin prior to mask tape-in to avoid schedule slippage on the shared MPW multi-project wafer run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline-to-bitline capacitive crosstalk induced false sensing during sense amplifier activation under alternating checkerboard data patterns.
1. M1-M2 inter-layer dielectric breakdown or resistive micro-bridging caused by sub-design-rule spacing under BEOL chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) dishing.
1. Sense margin collapse below 80 mV due to excessive parasitic bitline ground and fringe capacitance dominating over 28 fF cell storage capacitance.

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN 374 compliant), Chemical-resistant neoprene apron and sleeves, Full-face polycarbonate shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Acid-gas certified cleanroom air-purifying half-mask respirator
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of HF contact, immediately flush exposed area with copious clean water for 2 minutes, then liberally massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into skin continuously until medical personnel arrive. For acid inhalation, transfer victim to fresh cleanroom air and administer 100% humidified medical oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet-bench local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating at minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) linked to centralized scrubbed acid exhaust ducting with automatic airflow failure alarms.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate acid waste into dedicated fluoropolymer drain pipes feeding automated pH neutralization system; neutralize using 10% Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble CaF2 sludge prior to municipal effluent discharge.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) surface post-CMP planarized, scrubbed with megasonic DI water, and free of organic residues or slurry particles (defect density < 0.05 defects/cm2).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered Ti/TiN barrier and Al-Cu seed layer deposited without native oxide reformation; surface passivated under ultra-high purity N2 ambient.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide growth and atmospheric moisture absorption on contact interfaces exceeding 45 minutes in cleanroom air leads to excessive contact resistance (>5 Ohms/via) and catastrophic via open/delamination during subsequent rapid thermal annealing (RTA).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Via1/M2 Parasitic RC Extraction and Delay Metrology Verification

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > 8F2 Folded Bitline Interconnect & Metal-Fix Routing Integration [Circuit Design] > M1-M2 Folded Bitline Contact & Interconnect Parasitic Pitch Synthesis [Circuit Design] > Via1/M2 Parasitic RC Extraction and Delay Metrology Verification [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline DRAM matrix at 180nm, Bitline (BL) capacitance and Bitline-Complement (BLB) coupling directly govern the sensing signal margin (Delta-V = (Vcc/2) / (1 + Cbl/Cs)). High parasitic Via1 contact resistance (R_via1) combined with M2 bitline sheet resistance degrades sense amplifier latch timing (t_RCL/t_SENSE) and bitline precharge equalization (t_RP). Metrology must decouple 3D fringing capacitance from intrinsic plate capacitance using dedicated comb-serpentine and Kelvin chain structures across dense array boundaries.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Via1-to-M2 interface integrity in 180nm BEOL relies heavily on Ti/TiN barrier liner deposition uniformity and tungsten plug planarization (W-CMP). Dishing or erosion during CMP leads to step-coverage thinning of aluminum M2 (Al-0.5%Cu), creating non-linear Via1 contact resistance and local electromigration hotspots. The metrology plan must extract sheet resistance (Rs_M2), via resistance per contact (Rc_Via1), and lateral inter-metal capacitance (C_M2-M2) using open-short de-embedding test structures.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Parametric test wafers (PCM) require dedicated multi-pad layouts compatible with standard 2xN automatic parametric probe cards (e.g., Cascade Microtech / FormFactor). Lead times for commercial MPW silicon fab lots can exceed 12-16 weeks; failure to include full Kelvin and ring-oscillator delay structures on the tapeout frame will block post-silicon PDK signoff, forcing an expensive metal-spin cycle ($15k-$30k penalty).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The Via1/M2 metrology test plan must be fully integrated into the MPW tapeout DRC/LVS clean tapeout freeze by Milestone M3. Execution schedules require automated test scripts (Python/SCPI) for sub-femtofarad LCR measurement to prevent characterization bottlenecks when physical dies arrive at the packaging and test house in Ho Chi Minh City.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. W-CMP micro-voiding or TiN barrier punch-through at Via1 causing open/intermittent Kelvin chains with contact resistance exceeding 15 Ohms/via.
1. M2 line-edge roughness and optical proximity under-etching leading to excessive lateral line-to-line fringing capacitance (>0.25 fF/um), collapsing DRAM sense amplifier sensing margins below 80 mV.
1. Inadequate de-embedding of pad parasitic capacitance (C_pad ~ 50-100 fF) corrupting femtofarad-level M1-M2 crossover and folded bitline pitch capacitance extractions.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-1-3-01` | **Via1 Contact Resistance and M2 Interconnect Continuity Kelvin Metrology** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1511B Medium Power SMUs and FormFactor Summit 12000 Semi-Automatic Probe Station | 1. Land 4-point probe needles on dedicated 1000-contact Via1 chain test structure. 2. Force current I_force from -10 mA to +10 mA in 50 equal steps while sensing voltage V_sense across internal Kelvin taps. 3. Extract differential resistance dV/dI. 4. Land on 4-terminal M2 Van der Pauw / bridge structure and force 1 mA to determine M2 sheet resistance (Rs_M2). | `Single Via1 contact resistance must satisfy R_via1 <= 4.5 Ohms/contact (nominal 2.5 - 3.5 Ohms); I-V linearity R-squared >= 0.999 across [-10 mA, +10 mA]; M2 sheet resistance Rs_M2 must be within 75.0 ± 7.5 mOhm/sq.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-2-1-3-02` | **M2 Inter-Bitline Pitch Fringing Capacitance and Open-Short De-Embedding Metrology** | Keysight E4980A Precision LCR Meter (with 4-terminal pair configuration) coupled with Keithley 707B Switching Matrix and ultra-low noise triaxial cabling | 1. Probe de-embedding 'Open' dummy pad structure; measure and record C_pad_open. 2. Probe de-embedding 'Short' dummy pad structure; record residual inductance/resistance. 3. Probe interleaved M2 comb-comb folded bitline pitch array (length L = 2000 um, pitch = 560 nm). 4. Measure parallel equivalent capacitance (Cp) and conductance (G) at 100 kHz and 1 MHz with 0V DC bias. 5. Calculate intrinsic unit capacitance: C_line = (Cp_measured - C_pad_open) / L. | `M2-to-M2 lateral coupling capacitance must be <= 0.18 fF/um at nominal 280nm line / 280nm space; dissipation factor D = G/(2*pi*f*Cp) < 0.01 at 1 MHz; inter-metal dielectric leakage current < 10 pA at 3.3V DC stress.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom ESD Nitrile Gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses, Antistatic dissipative lab coat and grounded ESD heel strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious amounts of clean running water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent fumes, move individual to fresh air. If asphyxiation symptoms arise from N2 displacement in enclosed areas, administer oxygen via trained personnel and seek medical assistance.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probing station must operate in a laminar flow cleanroom bench (ISO Class 5) with active HEPA filtration and localized solvent vapor exhaust canopy rated at minimum 50 FPM face velocity for wipe-down operations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA lint-free cleanroom wipes must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-retardant hazardous waste disposal bins. Liquid IPA solvent effluent must be segregated in marked flammable solvent containers and disposed of per standard local chemical effluent regulations.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Metrological parasitic extraction package validating Via1 specific contact resistance, M2 sheet resistance, and inter-line coupling capacitance for 180nm 8F2 folded bitline DRAM layout, demonstrating complete compliance with 180nm foundry PDK electrical design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `via1_m2_kelvin_resistance_distributions.csv`
- [ ] `m2_bitline_interconnect_capacitance_report.pdf`
- [ ] `pcm_probe_mark_optical_inspection_map.tiff`

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Kelvin Via1 contact resistance per cut** | `3.2 Ohm` | ±0.8 Ohm | 4-wire DC Kelvin current-force voltage-measure sweep on 1000-via test chain using Keysight B1500A |
| `ASSERT-02` | **M2 Folded Bitline Inter-Metal Lateral Capacitance** | `0.145 fF/um` | ±0.020 fF/um | Multi-frequency LCR meter (100 kHz - 1 MHz) parallel capacitance extraction with open-pad de-embedding |

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F2 folded bitline DRAM matrix at 180nm, Bitline (BL) capacitance and Bitline-Complement (BLB) coupling directly govern the sensing signal margin (Delta-V = (Vcc/2) / (1 + Cbl/Cs)). High parasitic Via1 contact resistance (R_via1) combined with M2 bitline sheet resistance degrades sense amplifier latch timing (t_RCL/t_SENSE) and bitline precharge equalization (t_RP). Metrology must decouple 3D fringing capacitance from intrinsic plate capacitance using dedicated comb-serpentine and Kelvin chain structures across dense array boundaries.
critics.domain_expert: Via1-to-M2 interface integrity in 180nm BEOL relies heavily on Ti/TiN barrier liner deposition uniformity and tungsten plug planarization (W-CMP). Dishing or erosion during CMP leads to step-coverage thinning of aluminum M2 (Al-0.5%Cu), creating non-linear Via1 contact resistance and local electromigration hotspots. The metrology plan must extract sheet resistance (Rs_M2), via resistance per contact (Rc_Via1), and lateral inter-metal capacitance (C_M2-M2) using open-short de-embedding test structures.
critics.supply_chain: Parametric test wafers (PCM) require dedicated multi-pad layouts compatible with standard 2xN automatic parametric probe cards (e.g., Cascade Microtech / FormFactor). Lead times for commercial MPW silicon fab lots can exceed 12-16 weeks; failure to include full Kelvin and ring-oscillator delay structures on the tapeout frame will block post-silicon PDK signoff, forcing an expensive metal-spin cycle ($15k-$30k penalty).
critics.laya_pm: The Via1/M2 metrology test plan must be fully integrated into the MPW tapeout DRC/LVS clean tapeout freeze by Milestone M3. Execution schedules require automated test scripts (Python/SCPI) for sub-femtofarad LCR measurement to prevent characterization bottlenecks when physical dies arrive at the packaging and test house in Ho Chi Minh City.
critical_failure_modes: W-CMP micro-voiding or TiN barrier punch-through at Via1 causing open/intermittent Kelvin chains with contact resistance exceeding 15 Ohms/via.
M2 line-edge roughness and optical proximity under-etching leading to excessive lateral line-to-line fringing capacitance (>0.25 fF/um), collapsing DRAM sense amplifier sensing margins below 80 mV.
Inadequate de-embedding of pad parasitic capacitance (C_pad ~ 50-100 fF) corrupting femtofarad-level M1-M2 crossover and folded bitline pitch capacitance extractions.
