# Standard Operating Procedure: DRC/LVS Sign-Off & Parasitic Extraction for Cell Capacitance Verification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 8F2 folded bitline topology requires strict array parasitic balance. Parasitic extraction (PEX) must accurately capture bitline capacitance (C_b) within 150-250 fF and storage node capacitance (C_s) >= 28 fF to maintain C_b/C_s under 9:1. Standard digital 2.5D field solvers fail to account for 3D fringing between stacked crown capacitors and adjacent pass-gate wordlines, risking catastrophic signal attenuation below the sense amplifier differential threshold (ΔV < 100 mV).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW PDK decks (e.g., standard logic CMOS) do not inherently recognize custom DRAM storage capacitor layers or Si3N4/Ta2O5 dielectric stacks with EOT 3-4 nm. nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Full-Chip DRC and Antenna Rule Deck Verification

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Full-chip DRC integration for an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM requires stringent management of hierarchical boundary rules and density fill gradients. Metal fill insertion to satisfy minimum metal density (typically 30% to 70% per metal layer) must not introduce asymmetric capacitive coupling onto balanced bitline pairs (BL/BL_bar), which directly degrades the sensing margin when delta-V is constrained to 100-180 mV across a nominal 28 fF cell and 200 fF bitline parasitic load. Furthermore, wide power mesh straps (M3/M4) terminating near the high-density array edge create critical antenna ratio violations on access transistor polysilicon gates that necessitate distributed diode insertion without disrupting edge dummy cell biasing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In 180nm COB (Capacitor-Over-Bitline) architectures, plasma process-induced damage (PID) during reactive ion etching (RIE) of high-aspect-ratio tungsten contact plugs (W-plugs) and polysilicon/MIM storage nodes poses catastrophic gate dielectric breakdown risks. Antenna rules for 180nm commercial foundry decks impose maximum cumulative antenna area ratios (typically <= 250:1 for gate oxide <= 4.0 nm equivalent thickness, and <= 20:1 during intermediate poly etching). Antenna deck rule definitions must precisely account for perimeter vs. area ratio scaling, ensuring that reverse-biased p-n junction diodes are placed on all wordline drivers and decoder outputs prior to long bitline and global routing runs.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm multi-project wafer (MPW) foundries impose unyielding sign-off rule decks with automated hard-fail gates. Any DRC waiver request for non-standard DRAM array structures—such as sub-pitch dummy capacitor crowns or ungrounded intermediate floating routing—takes 3 to 5 business weeks for fab engineering review, risking tapeout slot forfeiture. Sourcing validated standard cell I/O ESD structures and verified foundry antenna diode cells is mandatory to guarantee zero sign-off waivers prior to wafer shuttle aggregation.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off DRC and antenna verification sits on the critical path 48 hours prior to final GDSII freeze. Tool execution runtime for full-chip flat/hierarchical sign-off on multi-million polygon memory arrays can easily exceed 14 hours if rule deck optimization (hierarchical cell-pruning and bounding box caching) is neglected. The tapeout schedule must strictly allocate 3 iterative run cycles: raw placement check, post-metal-fill verification, and final post-merge antenna waiver sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Gate dielectric puncture on array access NMOS due to cumulative antenna ratio violation exceeding 250:1 during BEOL M1/M2 plasma etching.
1. Sensing amplifier imbalance and read failure caused by asymmetrical metal dummy fill parasitics altering C_b balance between BL and BL_bar beyond the 2% mismatch tolerance.
1. Lithographic bridging or line-end pullback at memory array boundary due to density rule transition gradient violations between dense 8F2 cells and sparse peripheral logic.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-1-01` | **Full-Chip Sign-Off DRC Cleanliness & Density Verification** | Siemens Calibre nmDRC / Synopsys IC Validator automated physical verification engine with commercial 180nm 1P6M foundry sign-off deck (v2.4a) | 1. Import merged full-chip GDSII file (DRAM_180NM_TOP.gds) into verification environment. 2. Configure sign-off environment variables to enable all base DRC layers, high-voltage gate rules (HV_OXIDE), and capacitor stack layers (MIM_CAP/NO_CAP). 3. Execute hierarchical nmDRC rule deck across all layout levels (Well, Diffusion, Poly, Contact, M1-M6, Via1-Via5, Passivation). 4. Extract windowed metal density metrics using a 50 um x 50 um stepping window with 50% overlap across M1 through M6. | `Total DRC violation count must equal exactly 0. Metal layer density across all 50 um x 50 um windows must reside within 30.0% to 70.0% inclusive, with active area (OD) density within 25.0% to 55.0%.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-1-02` | **Process-Induced Damage (PID) Cumulative Antenna Rule Verification** | Calibre PERC / Antenna Engine sign-off deck configured for 180nm dual-gate oxide thickness models (3.5nm core / 7.0nm I/O) | 1. Execute antenna verification deck evaluating individual layer metal-to-gate area ratios: Poly/Gate, M1/Gate, M2/Gate, up to M6/Gate. 2. Calculate cumulative antenna ratios (CAR) including effective diode protection factoring reverse-bias junction perimeter scaling. 3. Query violation database for any unshielded wordline driver outputs, bitline select gates, or sense-amplifier enable transistors. 4. Verify antenna tie-down diodes are located within a 15 um radius of the affected gate. | `Zero antenna ratio violations (Total Errors = 0). Poly area to thin-gate oxide ratio <= 20:1 without diode; cumulative metal antenna ratio (CAR) <= 250:1 without diode; effective CAR <= 2000:1 with standard tiedown diode (diode area >= 0.20 um^2).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe cleanroom lab coat, Anti-static dissipative nitrile gloves (ASTM D257), ANSI Z87.1 certified clear safety spectacles
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For vapor inhalation, remove personnel to fresh air. In case of eye contact, flush eyes thoroughly with continuous potable water for 15 minutes at eyewash station. In case of localized skin contact, rinse with mild soap and copious water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard compute cleanroom / CAD server room HVAC with HEPA filtration (Class 10,000 / ISO 7), 15-20 air changes per hour (ACH), positive pressure differential >= 12.5 Pa, relative humidity maintained at 45% +/- 5% to suppress electrostatic discharge.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes sealed in designated flame-retardant hazardous chemical disposal containers and incinerated in compliance with local RCRA solvent handling protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (cleanroom optical/workstation cleaning grade)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI/MOS) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Digital GDSII/OASIS tapeout database signed off at LVS clean state with verified layout pin mappings and dummy-fill inclusion.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Foundry-certified sign-off database archive containing DRC/Antenna clean GDSII, validated checksums, and signed verification waiver exemption manifests.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Data staleness causing tapeout desynchronization against active foundry PDK rule revisions; foundry shuttle closing gate misses leading to 8-to-12-week tapeout postponement.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full-chip physical verification sign-off completed for 180nm open-source DRAM chip with complete absence of geometric design rule violations, density gradient non-compliances, and process-induced gate oxide antenna breakdown violations.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_FULLCHIP_DRC_SIGNOFF.summary`
- [ ] `DRAM180_ANTENNA_PID_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM180_WAIVER_AND_CHECKSUM_CERTIFICATE.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Zero design rule violations across all 180nm physical mask layers** | `0` | 0 | Calibre nmDRC full-chip batch run with foundry sign-off runset |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Zero antenna ratio and process-induced damage rule violations** | `0` | 0 | Calibre PERC / Antenna cumulative area ratio extraction |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Metal layer global and windowed planarization density compliance** | `50.0%` | +/- 20.0% | Foundry standard 50um x 50um windowed density verification utility |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Foundry sign-off checklist verified with zero DRC violations, zero antenna violations, full mask layer checksums verified via SHA-256 against tapeout manifest, and sign-off approval from both Lead Physical Designer and Foundry Interface Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): GDSII Integration and Hierarchy Flattening for Full-Chip DRC Deck Setup

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Sign-Off & Parasitic Extraction for Cell Capacitance Verification [Metrology] > Full-Chip DRC and Antenna Rule Deck Verification [Metrology] > GDSII Integration and Hierarchy Flattening for Full-Chip DRC Deck Setup [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical GDSII assembly merging dense 8F2 DRAM core arrays (360 nm bitline pitch, 180 nm access gate L, crown stacked capacitor/MIM layers) with standard logic peripheral macros and pad rings introduces significant bounding box fragmentation and cell-call transformations. Flattening strategies must avoid unbounded RAM growth in physical verification engines (such as KLayout or Calibre) while preserving spatial layer mapping integrity (especially non-standard DRAM masks like SN contact, capacitor node, and plate poly) without inducing coordinate grid snapping errors at 1 nm database resolution.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm generation, folded bitline sense amplifiers must pitch-match memory cell columns interleaved at 360 nm. When merging array tiles with sense amp strips and wordline decoders, automated flattening algorithms risk fracturing abutting polygon geometries across cell boundaries, creating artificial notch/space violations (<180 nm minimum space) or failing to merge contiguous VDD/VSS strap geometries. DRC run deck rule files must explicitly enforce selective hierarchy preservation on memory array cores to ensure array-specific relaxed/tighter spacing rules apply only within the core boundary while full-chip antenna rules check accumulated gate oxide ratios across peripheral transitions.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: MPW shuttle tapeout providers (e.g., TSMC 0.18um, SkyWater 130/180nm, or IHP) enforce stringent GDSII stream layer map definitions, text label layer assignments, and maximum polygon point counts (typically 4096 or 8192 points per polygon). Generating monolithic flattened GDSII files exceeding shuttle file-size constraints or misaligning proprietary foundry layer numbers with the open-source OASIS/GDSII export table will result in immediate rejection at tapeout QA review.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off DRC run deck execution schedule is gated by CPU run times on full-chip assembly. Complete flat DRC execution across 1M+ 1T1C bitcells will blow out compute budgets and cause turnaround delays (>12 hours per run); a smart hierarchical cell-pruning or selective array flattening deck setup is critical to guarantee sign-off convergence within the targeted 48-hour pre-tapeout sprint window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Off-grid vertex snapping or coordinate truncation during hierarchy flattening resulting in false DRC grid violations (<0.005 um off-grid) across 180nm poly gates and 360nm bitline pitches.
1. Database layer mapping mismatch during GDSII stream-in, where stacked capacitor storage node (SN) or crown dielectric mask layers are erroneously mapped into standard active/poly masks or dropped entirely.
1. False positive or masked antenna rule violations at peripheral interface boundaries caused by improper hierarchy flattening breaking electrical net connectivity of large metal-fix routing straps.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-1-1-01` | **Full-Chip GDSII Stream Integration and Coordinate Grid Fidelity Verification** | Calibre DRC / KLayout 0.28+ Python Stream Processor, 64-bit Linux Workstation with 128GB RAM | 1. Ingest all block GDSII streams using the master integration assembly script. 2. Execute automated hierarchy flattening up to the top chip level while maintaining cell-level boundary definitions for the DRAM array core. 3. Perform XOR comparison between the pre-flattened sub-cell instances and post-assembly top-level geometries across all layers (DIFF, POLY, CONT, METAL1-METAL4, MIM/CAP_NODE). 4. Run automated off-grid vertex detection script across all merged coordinates. | `XOR geometry mismatch must be exactly 0.000 um2 across all active and interconnect layers. Total off-grid coordinate vertices detected at 1 nm grid precision must equal 0.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-1-1-02` | **Full-Chip DRC Deck Execution and Antenna Ratio Sign-Off Verification** | Commercial/Open-Source DRC Engine (Siemens Calibre nmDRC or KLayout DRC) with 180nm CMOS/DRAM Rule Deck v3.2 | 1. Load the integrated GDSII file into the DRC execution environment with the foundry-qualified 180nm mixed-signal/DRAM run deck. 2. Configure DRC run for full-chip flat/hierarchical checking including antenna rules (gate area to metal perimeter/area ratio). 3. Parse generated DRC summary report (.summary) and error database (.rdb). 4. Filter and categorize violations into fatal errors, core array waivers, and peripheral boundary flags. | `Total fatal DRC violations = 0. Antenna rule violations on wordline gates (WL) and peripheral driver gates must meet antenna ratio < 400:1 (unprotected gate) or < 2000:1 (with reverse-biased ESD diode protection). Total un-waived design rule violations = 0.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Static-dissipative ESD wrist strap (1 Mohm series resistance) for server hardware handling, Ergonomic display anti-glare filtering and wrist support for computational design workstations, Standard cleanroom coat and nitrile gloves (cleanroom Class 1000) during tapeout media transfer in physical metrology suites
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin exposure to IPA: Flush skin with water for 15 minutes. Eye exposure: Rinse eyes cautiously with water at eye wash station for 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move individual to fresh air. Workstation ergonomics: Institute 20-20-20 visual rest intervals to prevent acute ocular strain.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / IT server room HVAC air exchange: 15-20 air changes per hour with positive pressure HEPA filtration; no local chemical exhaust required for software sign-off activities.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of IPA-soaked cleaning wipes in designated sealed, vapor-tight hazardous waste containers according to local hazardous solvent disposal regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) (used for workstation surface and physical media disinfection)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / Cleanroom Grade | `70% v/v in deionized water` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Digital software cleanroom baseline: Validated clean block-level GDSII/OASIS stream files with verified MD5 checksums; zero physical wafer queue time applicable for GDSII data processing.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Tapeout-ready sign-off state: Single monolithic or hierarchically flattened GDSII stream file passing clean XOR checks, clean layer-hash verification, and 100% DRC deck sign-off.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Data freeze schedule expiration: Exceeding the MPW shuttle tapeout freeze window results in tapeout slot forfeiture, loss of fabrication mask deposit, and a 6-month delay to next open shuttle run.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful hierarchical integration and flattening of the 180nm DRAM test chip, merging the 8F2 stacked capacitor cell matrix, interleaved sense amplifier arrays, decoders, and I/O padframe into a unified GDSII stream that achieves zero DRC/antenna violations on the foundry-qualified sign-off run deck.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_top_integrated_signoff.gds`
- [ ] `dram180_fullchip_drc_summary_report.pdf`
- [ ] `dram180_antenna_ratio_extracted_table.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Zero fatal design rule violations across full integrated chip layout** | `0` | 0 | Automated DRC summary parser inspecting Calibre/KLayout DRC run log |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Grid alignment conformity to foundry manufacturing grid** | `0.005 um` | 0.000 um | DRC off-grid vertex extraction check scanning all polygon geometries |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Pre-flattening vs post-flattening core array geometry XOR difference area** | `0.000000 um2` | 0.000000 um2 | Top-level spatial Boolean XOR difference run between array block and integrated chip instance |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal sign-off requires unanimous approval from physical design leads, zero un-waived DRC/Antenna violations in dram180_fullchip_drc_summary_report.pdf, valid GDSII MD5 checksum matching the MPW shuttle submission manifest, and complete structural verification of 360nm bitline pitch continuity across all memory array boundaries.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Full-Chip Design Rule Checking (DRC) and High-Density Array Spacing Sign-Off

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Sequence

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    GDSII Stream In     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Array Hierarchy Scan  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Array Pitch Rules    │
│      360nm-400nm       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Access Transistor    │
│     W220nm L180nm      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Crown Node and     │
│    W-Plug Alignment    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Full-Chip DRC Clean   │
│        Sign-Off        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream-In & Hierarchy Cell Instantiation**:
   - Stream in full-chip layout database containing peripheral standard cells, sense amplifier banks, wordline drivers, and the core 1T1C memory array matrix.
   - Confirm cell boundary tiling and array periodicity conforming to the folded bitline layout grid.

2. **Access Transistor Channel Geometry Verification**:
   - Execute DRC checks on the active diffusion (`OD`) and polysilicon gate (`PO`) interaction within the memory core.
   - Assert exact physical gate channel dimensions for every access transistor:
     - Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$
     - Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$
   - Check gate oxide thin-dielectric rules ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness thermal oxide).

3. **High-Density Array Wordline (WL) & Bitline (BL) Pitch Verification**:
   - Run array-density specific rule decks for parallel runs of wordlines and bitlines across 256/512 cell blocks.
   - Ensure Wordline Pitch and Bitline Pitch conform to the lithographic design rule window: $360\text{ nm} \le \text{Pitch} \le 400\text{ nm}$.
   - Flag any bridge, pinch, or necking violations across array sub-blocks.

4. **Bitline Contact Sharing & W-Plug Storage Node Alignment**:
   - Verify shared bitline contacts between adjacent 1T1C pairs to ensure spacing and enclosure margins are honored.
   - Verify storage node drain contacts and Tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pads under the Crown/Cylinder stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) topology.

5. **Storage Capacitor Footprint & Spacing Sign-Off**:
   - Validate unit cell boundary area: exactly $8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ (for $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Run design rule decks for the Crown/MIM capacitor electrode layers (Ta$_2$O$_5$ / Si$_3$N$_4$ / ONO dielectric spacer layers) to guarantee physical spacing preventing node-to-node shorts.

6. **Full-Chip Multi-Corner DRC DRC Sign-Off Run**:
   - Execute DRC deck across entire chip (periphery, sense amplifiers, ESD rings, pads, and array).
   - Generate summary report; zero errors must be reported.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                        ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                        │■                                 │
 Array Area Margin (8F2)┤■                                 │
                        │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
  Wordline/Bitline Pitch┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
        Storage Cap (Cs)┤▒▒▒▒                              │
                        │▒▒▒▒                              │
Full-Chip DRC Violations┤                                  │
                        │                                  │
                        └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                         0      90       180     270    360 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Condition | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Full-Chip DRC Violations** | `0` | Hard rule (Zero error tolerance) | violations |
| **Unit Cell Footprint ($8F^2$)** | `0.259` | $\pm 0.000$ (At $F = 180\text{ nm}$) | $\mu\text{m}^2$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Dimensions** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | Nominal grid exact match | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Wordline & Bitline Pitch** | `360` to `400` | Within physical spacing window | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Minimum Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ | Range: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 8F² folded bitline layout, COB Crown MIM capacitor with W-plug drain contact, $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: 8F² folded bitline cell area = $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$; $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$); $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$; $C_b / C_s$ ratio between $5:1$ and $9:1$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Stacked capacitor (Crown/Cylinder) with high-k EOT $3 - 4\text{ nm}$, WL/BL pitch $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxidation.

---
*Captured micro-knowledge documented in [180nm_dram_array_drc_signoff.md](./docs/knowledge/180nm_dram_array_drc_signoff.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm 8F2 folded bitline architecture, full-chip DRC verification must address the severe proximity effects at the boundary between the high-density repetitive memory core (pitch 360nm, cell area 0.259 um2) and loose peripheral CMOS logic. Off-grid snapping or sub-resolution grid rounding during GDSII stream-out creates bridging or necking across dense wordline/bitline interfaces. Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) rule deck tags must be strictly isolated between array and periphery to avoid false clean sign-offs.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dense array design rules for stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) require strict pitch consistency: wordline active gate length L=180nm, bitline contact spacing, and crown/cylinder capacitor opening boundaries. Standard logic PDK DRC decks lack the specialized non-standard design rule clearance waivers (e.g. relaxed spacing for dense active area endcaps with dummy poly terminations). Running generic logic DRC yields thousands of pseudo-errors or, worse, permits capacitor node-to-node proximity under 90nm which causes dielectric breakdown during high-k ONO/Ta2O5 deposition.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW shuttle providers enforce automated golden DRC decks (Calibre nmDRC/PVS) that immediately reject non-standard array spacing unless accompanied by certified layer-density waiver documentation and foundry-approved GDS boundary layer markers. Failure to clear DRC deck checks 72 hours prior to tapeout freeze forfeits shuttle slot reservation and causes multi-month project schedule slippage.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The full-chip hierarchical sign-off must enforce deterministic runtimes and clear ownership boundaries. Verification runs on flat 180nm chip databases spanning millions of repeating 1T1C cells cause memory exhaustion and multi-day compute hangs. Hierarchical DRC cell-array exclusions and macro black-boxing must be configured without compromising interconnect verification across sense amplifiers and row/column decoders.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dense capacitor top-electrode or bottom-electrode short to adjacent bitline contact via due to misaligned contact enclosure rules under 20nm lithography overlay error.
1. Array edge bitline bridge or open circuit caused by sudden optical density step-function without dummy transistor transition guard-rings.
1. Foundry tapeout automated rejection due to missing dummy fill density rules (metal density <20% or >70%) violating CMP planarization limits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-1-2-01` | **Hierarchical Full-Chip Calibre nmDRC Sign-Off and Density Verification** | Siemens Calibre nmDRC Engine v2024.2 / Cadence Pegasus DRC running on 64-core Linux Compute Node (RHEL 8.8, 512GB RAM) with 180nm Commercial MPW Golden Rule Deck v3.2 | 1. Set CALIBRE_RUN_ENV with foundry rule deck '180nm_dram_mpw_golden.drc'. 2. Run hierarchical DRC with cell array optimization enabled: 'calibre -drc -hier -turbo 64 180nm_dram_mpw_golden.drc'. 3. Execute layer density check modules for M1-M6, Active, and Poly against min 20% and max 70% window requirements. 4. Parse run log and results database (RDB) for error signatures. 5. Generate summary verification report. | `Total DRC violation count must equal exactly 0 across all layers. Density gradient delta < 15% across any 50um x 50um sliding window. Log execution status: 'CLEAN RUN'.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-1-2-02` | **Dense 8F2 Memory Array and Bitline-to-Capacitor Overlay Spacing Audit** | KLA-Tencor Klarity Layout Defect Review & Cadence Pegasus Interactive Pattern DRC Engine with sub-nanometer coordinate ruler | 1. Extract minimum spacing measurements between adjacent storage node contacts (SN_CONT) across all 512x256 cell blocks. 2. Verify bitline-to-wordline corner-to-corner spacing (nominal >=180nm, array relaxed >=140nm under waiver). 3. Audit active area end-cap extension beyond wordline edge (min 60nm). 4. Measure capacitor cylinder opening outer boundary clearance to adjacent node contact (min 80nm). | `All measured storage node pitch values within 360nm +/- 1.0nm. Zero clearance spacing violations < 80nm. Exact 100% compliance with foundry dense array design rule exception addendum.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Antenna Ratio Rule Verification and Diode Tie-Down Fix Insertion

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Sign-Off & Parasitic Extraction for Cell Capacitance Verification [Metrology] > Full-Chip DRC and Antenna Rule Deck Verification [Metrology] > Antenna Ratio Rule Verification and Diode Tie-Down Fix Insertion [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |

Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-1-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

# Standard Operating Procedure: LVS Netlist Extraction and Device Recognition Sign-Off

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM matrix at the 180nm node, bitline pitch is restricted to 360 nm, requiring interleaved layout of cross-coupled regenerative sense amplifiers. Standard commercial MPW LVS rulesets frequently fail to extract the custom MIM/stacked cell capacitor plate connections properly or misclassify shared-diffusion bitline contact nodes across adjacent access pass gates, causing false topological equivalence or catastrophic undetected short/open discrepancies between the cell plate (V_CP) and substrate bias (V_BB).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Device recognition decks in commercial 180nm foundry PDKs are optimized for planar digital CMOS and standard logic devices. LVS extraction must be augmented with specialized cell boundary/marker layers (e.g., DRAM_CELL, CAP_MIM, DEEP_NWELL) to prevent the extractor from resolving the 1T access NMOS as standard logic NMOS with mismatched threshold implants, while ensuring full pin-mapping consistency for differential folded BL//BL pairs into the column select and sense amplifier restore networks.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Failure to achieve a 100% clean foundry-certified LVS sign-off deck using approved MPW runsets (e.g., Calibre LVS, Pegasus, or KLayout open-PDK ruledecks) causes automated tapeout rejection at the foundry mask data prep (MDP) intake. Re-spins or manual waiver negotiations introduce 6 to 12 weeks of delay and risk loss of committed MPW shuttle reticle slots.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The tapeout schedule depends critically on clear convergence between schematic netlist generation (CDL/SPICE) and extracted GDSII netlists. Any discrepancy between parasitic-extracted capacitance values and nominal schematic model parameters can hide charge-sharing read-margin degradation (V_signal < 150 mV), which stalls physical tapeout sign-off milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Silent LVS short between storage node diffusion and cell plate ground/V_CP caused by missing or misaligned capacitor marker definition in the LVS rule deck.
1. Pin swapping or transposition between true bitline (BL) and complementary bitline (/BL) in interleaved pitch-matched sense amplifier boundary cells, leading to inverted cell charge restoration during destructive readout.
1. Misrecognition of 1T access transistor body terminals, incorrectly tying array substrate bias (V_BB = -0.5V to -1.0V) to logic ground (GND), causing forward bias and thermal runaway during array standby.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM matrix at the 180nm node, bitline pitch is restricted to 360 nm, requiring interleaved layout of cross-coupled regenerative sense amplifiers. Standard commercial MPW LVS rulesets frequently fail to extract the custom MIM/stacked cell capacitor plate connections properly or misclassify shared-diffusion bitline contact nodes across adjacent access pass gates, causing false topological equivalence or catastrophic undetected short/open discrepancies between the cell plate (V_CP) and substrate bias (V_BB).
critics.domain_expert: Device recognition decks in commercial 180nm foundry PDKs are optimized for planar digital CMOS and standard logic devices. LVS extraction must be augmented with specialized cell boundary/marker layers (e.g., DRAM_CELL, CAP_MIM, DEEP_NWELL) to prevent the extractor from resolving the 1T access NMOS as standard logic NMOS with mismatched threshold implants, while ensuring full pin-mapping consistency for differential folded BL//BL pairs into the column select and sense amplifier restore networks.
critics.supply_chain: Failure to achieve a 100% clean foundry-certified LVS sign-off deck using approved MPW runsets (e.g., Calibre LVS, Pegasus, or KLayout open-PDK ruledecks) causes automated tapeout rejection at the foundry mask data prep (MDP) intake. Re-spins or manual waiver negotiations introduce 6 to 12 weeks of delay and risk loss of committed MPW shuttle reticle slots.
critics.laya_pm: The tapeout schedule depends critically on clear convergence between schematic netlist generation (CDL/SPICE) and extracted GDSII netlists. Any discrepancy between parasitic-extracted capacitance values and nominal schematic model parameters can hide charge-sharing read-margin degradation (V_signal < 150 mV), which stalls physical tapeout sign-off milestones.
critical_failure_modes: Silent LVS short between storage node diffusion and cell plate ground/V_CP caused by missing or misaligned capacitor marker definition in the LVS rule deck.

Pin swapping or transposition between true bitline (BL) and complementary bitline (/BL) in interleaved pitch-matched sense amplifier boundary cells, leading to inverted cell charge restoration during destructive readout.

Misrecognition of 1T access transistor body terminals, incorrectly tying array substrate bias (V_BB = -0.5V to -1.0V) to logic ground (GND), causing forward bias and thermal runaway during array standby.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): PDK LVS Rule Deck Configuration & Custom 1T1C Device Extraction Setup

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Sign-Off & Parasitic Extraction for Cell Capacitance Verification [Metrology] > LVS Netlist Extraction and Device Recognition Sign-Off [Metrology] > PDK LVS Rule Deck Configuration & Custom 1T1C Device Extraction Setup [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline DRAM matrix, standard commercial 180nm CMOS PDK LVS decks lack native recognition for stacked or trench 1T1C storage nodes, typically flagging capacitor plate-to-substrate junctions as invalid body ties or net shorts. The extraction deck must explicitly define custom multi-layer boolean operations (e.g., active area boolean AND deep contact AND custom top-plate metal layer) while isolating storage node parasitics from standard digital/analog interconnect extraction rules. Failure to cleanly map cell pins will corrupt hierarchical subcircuit mapping during macro-level full-array LVS sign-off.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Custom device recognition in Magic, Netgen, or Calibre/Pegasus requires rigorous device property extraction for the 1T1C storage cell. Beyond checking simple L and W on the access transistor, the extraction deck must compute the analytical cell capacitance (C_cell) based on top plate perimeter and area equations, as well as access pass-gate source-drain junction capacitance. If cell capacitance is misextracted or lumped into bulk bitline capacitance, the charge sharing equation V_signal = (V_BL - V_cell) / (1 + C_BL / C_cell) becomes untrustworthy, masking catastrophic read sensing margins during post-layout dynamic simulations with regenerative sense amplifiers.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW shuttles enforce strict foundry sign-off decks; deploying a customized LVS deck that defines custom cell layers or alters standard device models requires foundry QA approval and strict layer reservation compliance. If the proprietary GDSII/OASIS tapeout layers for the custom 1T1C capacitor (e.g., dedicated MIMCAP or custom metal sandwich) diverge from the foundry's standard layer map, the mask shop will reject the submission, causing multi-month shuttle tapeout delays and forfeiting reserved reticle slots.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: PDK deck customization must maintain backward compatibility with open-source and commercial EDA toolchains (Netgen, Magic, KLayout, OpenLVS). Delivering an unversioned LVS deck creates verification drift across distributed design teams working on row decoder peripherals and the 1T1C core array. A automated regression test suite must run across unit-cell, 8x8 test arrays, and full 1Kb mini-mats within CI/CD pipelines before any physical layout sign-off freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node false-shorting: Standard substrate tap recognition merges floating access transistor diffusion terminals with ground/well taps due to unmasked guard ring booleans.
1. Capacitor extraction omission: Netgen/Calibre extracts the pass transistor correctly but silently drops the custom 1T1C capacitor element as an unreferenced floating metal polygon, yielding false-positive LVS matches against empty netlists.
1. Bitline-to-cell-plate short masking: Incomplete boolean layer derivation fails to detect dielectric punch-through or direct via contact between folded bitline lines and the common plate potential (V_plate = VDD/2).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-2-1-01` | **Unit 1T1C Cell LVS Recognition and Pin Mapping Verification** | Netgen v1.5.250 / Calibre LVS Engine with custom rule deck parser, SPICE netlist comparator, GDSII stream reader (KLayout 0.28.12) | 1. Ingest unit 1T1C GDSII into LVS extraction engine using the customized 180nm LVS deck. 2. Execute device extraction to generate extracted netlist 'cell_1t1c_extracted.spice'. 3. Execute topological and nodal netlist comparison against 'cell_1t1c.spice' using Netgen. 4. Query the generated LVS report for unrecognized layout polygons, unmatched nets, and terminal remapping. 5. Log exact extracted W, L of access transistor and area/perimeter of the storage capacitor. | `Net comparison must yield zero errors, zero warnings, zero unmatched nets, and zero unmatched devices; extracted transistor channel dimensions must match schematic within 0.000 um; extracted capacitor area must match drawn polygon area of 0.324 um2 exactly.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-2-1-02` | **Multi-Cell 4x4 Folded Bitline Matrix Cross-Coupling and Short Detection Sign-Off** | Automated regression CI test harness, KLayout DRC/LVS engine, Netgen LVS comparator, Python netlist graph parser | 1. Run rule deck extraction on both clean and intentionally shorted 4x4 array layouts. 2. Verify clean matrix extraction produces 16 distinct 1T1C instances and correctly isolates all 4 bitlines and 4 wordlines. 3. Verify shorted matrix extraction correctly detects the electrical bridge and flags an LVS discrepancy. 4. Confirm extracted parasitic netlist lists coupling capacitance between adjacent folded bitlines. | `Clean 4x4 array must achieve 100% net and instance correspondence (16 access FETs, 16 storage caps, 4 BLs, 4 WLs, 1 VPLATE net). The defect testcase must explicitly fail LVS and report 'Net BL0 shorted to net VPLATE' with pinpoint layout coordinate identification within +/-10nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom ESD-safe lab coat, Static dissipative nitrile gloves (Class 100 compliant), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with UV/blue light side shields
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA: Wash affected skin thoroughly with deionized water for 15 minutes. For eye contact: Flush immediately at an emergency eye-wash station for a minimum of 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation if irritation persists. In case of inhalation of vapors: Remove individual to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating HEPA filtration with minimum 45 air changes per hour (ACH); tapeout server computing facilities require continuous conditioned exhaust with positive pressure and 40-50% relative humidity control to prevent electrostatic discharge.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and cleaning substrates must be disposed of in dedicated flame-retardant, grounded flammables waste receptacles; organic solvent liquid effluent routed to central solvent drain for high-temperature incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA for physical cleanroom console / tapeout workstation sanitization)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-LVS layout database validated with zero hard DRC violations, verified layer stream datatypes, and clean boundary-to-boundary cell abuttals.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: LVS clean sign-off archive containing zero netlist discrepancies, fully annotated parasitic capacitance attributes, and cryptographic checksum validation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Queue time expiration between physical extraction freeze and reticle data prep risks tapeout version divergence, unvalidated engineering change orders (ECOs), and mask generation with unverified floating storage node topologies.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Production-ready, foundry-verified 180nm custom LVS rule deck and associated Netgen/Calibre setup files capable of hierarchical extraction, property calculation, and 100% netlist matching for 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cells and multi-kilobit array matrices.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_lvs_custom_1t1c.rule`
- [ ] `lvs_signoff_matrix_validation_report.pdf`
- [ ] `cell_1t1c_extracted_properties.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage capacitor plate recognition boolean integrity across unit cell and 4x4 array** | `100.0%` | 0.0% | Automated Netgen subcircuit pin and instance comparison against golden schematic netlist |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Extracted storage node capacitance (C_cell) value concordance against 3D field solver baseline** | `25.0 fF` | +/-1.5 fF | Parameterized LVS netlist extraction compared against Raphael/FastCap 3D electrostatics simulation |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Access transistor drawn channel length (L) and width (W) dimensional extraction accuracy** | `180 nm / 220 nm` | +/-0.5 nm | KLayout/Netgen geometry extraction engine property query on gate-to-diffusion overlap polygons |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero discrepancies in LVS comparison report across single-cell, 4x4 matrix, and 1Kb array layouts with automated regression script exit code 0, complete parameter extraction within specified tolerances, and formal sign-off approval from both Circuit Design Lead and Tapeout Integration Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Hierarchical GDS Layout Netlist Extraction & Device Recognition Execution

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Sign-Off & Parasitic Extraction for Cell Capacitance Verification [Metrology] > LVS Netlist Extraction and Device Recognition Sign-Off [Metrology] > Hierarchical GDS Layout Netlist Extraction & Device Recognition Execution [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical GDS netlist extraction must maintain strict cell boundary flattening rules for the 8F2 folded bitline array while preserving macro abstraction for peripheral sense amplifiers and row decoders. Failing to parameterize boundary well-proximity effects (WPE) and shallow trench isolation (STI) stress layout parameters during extraction causes device mismatch between the extracted SPICE subcircuits and the golden schematic.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node with a 360nm bitline pitch, 1T1C cell extraction requires precise recognition of the vertical trench or stacked capacitor node pin connections against diffusion contact regions. If recognition rules confuse deep N-well/substrate ties or fail to resolve multi-finger pass transistors with merged source/drain nodes, false pseudo-open circuits or inaccurate gate width/length (W/L) extraction will corrupt array precharge balance simulations.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Extraction deck rule decks must match the commercial foundry MPW run PDK revision (v1.8a) certified for open-source GDS-II toolchains (Magic/Netgen/KLayout). Discrepancies in device recognition layer booleans between internal toolflow versions and foundry sign-off decks risk catastrophic submission rejection or unverified mask production delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The full-chip hierarchical extraction schedule requires memory footprint and runtime bounding on compute nodes. Unchecked flat extraction expansion across the multi-megabit DRAM core risks memory exhaustion and timeout on CI/CD runner nodes, jeopardizing the hard MPW freeze milestone.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Ambiguous device recognition of 3D stacked storage node capacitor dielectric interfaces leading to floating capacitor plate pins in the extracted netlist.
1. Improper subcircuit port order mapping between extracted folded bitline sense amplifier macros and golden schematic symbols, masking fatal cross-coupled latch inversion.
1. Failure to detect shared diffusion shorts across adjacent 8F2 unit cells due to improper active-to-poly contact enclosure extraction in dense array layout.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-2-2-01` | **Hierarchical Device Recognition and Pin Association Sign-Off** | KLayout Batch LVS Engine v0.28+ with Ruby/Python netlist extraction harness and Netgen LVS comparator | 1. Ingest hierarchical GDS into KLayout extraction engine using automated PDK extraction script. 2. Execute boolean layer derivation for active, poly gate, contact, capacitor top plate (MIM/stacked), and metal-1 interconnect. 3. Identify MOSFET channel regions (poly AND active NOT tap) and 1T1C storage node capacitors. 4. Extract subcircuit connectivity matrix, node pinouts, and device geometries (W, L, Area, Perimeter). 5. Export hierarchical SPICE netlist (*.ext.sp) and execute Netgen topological graph comparison against golden schematic netlist (*.sch.sp). | `Device count discrepancy = 0 across all NMOS, PMOS, and storage capacitor instances; Netlist graph isomorphism matching = 100.0%; Unresolved pins/floating ports = 0.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-2-2-02` | **Extracted Geometric Parameter and Cell Capacitance Verification** | Automated SPICE netlist parser with scientific Python numerical evaluator (NumPy/Pandas) | 1. Parse extracted *.ext.sp netlist for all recognized 1T1C array access transistors and cell storage capacitors. 2. Tabulate effective channel length (L_eff), effective channel width (W_eff), drain/source diffusion areas (AD, AS), and extracted cell storage capacitance (C_cell). 3. Compare extracted parameters against layout drawn geometric specifications across 10,000 array instances. 4. Compute mean and standard deviation for dimensional metrics and check against PDK tolerance bands. | `Access transistor drawn L = 180 nm (+/- 1.8 nm, 1.0%), drawn W = 220 nm (+/- 2.2 nm, 1.0%); Extracted storage capacitor nominal capacitance C_cell >= 25.0 fF per unit cell with 0 instances below 24.0 fF.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe lab coat, Anti-static wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses with side shields, Nitrile gloves (Class 100 cleanroom compatible)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For eye contact with cleaning solvent: Immediately flush eyes with copious amounts of water at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes. For skin contact: Wash affected area with mild soap and water. For inhalation: Move to fresh air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard workstation HVAC air exchange rate >= 8 air changes per hour (ACH); dedicated local exhaust laminar flow hood rated at 0.45 m/s face velocity for any solvent cleaning of tapeout terminals.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked cleanroom lint-free wipes in sealed, dedicated hazardous flammables waste bins; dispose of discarded media in designated industrial solid waste streams per local municipal regulations.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`

- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Extracted hierarchical SPICE netlist locked, cryptographically signed, and staged in sealed digital build directory prior to parasitic extraction (PEX) and dynamic timing sign-off.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Database divergence or unsynchronized peripheral metal-fix routing revisions leading to extraction-to-tapeout mismatch, invalidating multi-corner transient simulations.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Discrepancy resolution between full-chip schematic and extracted layout netlist must strictly validate cross-coupled sense amplifier bitline symmetry (BL vs. /BL net capacitance delta < 1.5 fF) and wordline boosted V_PP driver isolation; unmapped parasitic extraction nodes or collapsed subcircuits can mask critical capacitive mismatches that trigger read/restore sense flips.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In 180nm commercial MPW (GF180MCU/180nm CMOS), LVS equivalence checks often fail on dummy cell terminations, deep N-well guard rings, and non-rectangular planar cell capacitor plates. Netlist comparison rules must differentiate intentional topological parallel transistor merges (M-factor) from accidental source/drain cross-wiring in the folded bitline matrix.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW tapeout submission windows (such as Efabless/GF180) enforce rigid GDSII/OASIS and LVS sign-off checklist deadlines; false discrepancy violations arising from mismatching subcircuit pin orders or generic versus foundry-specific primitive model names will trigger immediate mask data rejection and shuttle cycle forfeitures.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The verification pipeline must avoid unbounded discrepancy debug loops by maintaining strict equivalence sign-off milestones: any discrepancy in device count, terminal connectivity, or device metric delta (W/L) exceeding 0% for core access/sense circuits halts the sign-off review cycle within 4 hours.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline parasitic capacitance asymmetry across BL and /BL exceeding 2.0 fF due to undetected layout-versus-schematic metal layer cross-over swapping, causing catastrophic single-ended sense amplifier latch errors during N-sense SAN pulldown.
1. Unrecognized sub-threshold leakage path caused by swapped bulk/well taps in the 1T1C array access transistor layout, resulting in cell retention time collapse below 64 ms under boosted V_PP overdrive.

Ingest schematic SPICE netlist and layout extracted SPICE netlist into Netgen graph equivalence comparator. 2. Apply PDK-specified device merging rules (parallel MOS gates, series resistors, substrate tap aggregation). 3. Perform topological node bipartite graph matching across all power (V_DD, V_PP, V_BB, V_SS), reference (V_BLP), and differential I/O (BL, /BL, SAN, SAP, WL) pins. 4. Parse output error log and generate discrepancy matrix for unmapped nets, dangling ports, and unmatched device instances. | `Total unmatched nets = 0; total unmatched devices = 0; port/pin binding errors = 0 across the entire 8F2 array core and periphery control blocks.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-2-3-02` | **Device Metric & Parasitic Asymmetry Delta Sign-Off on Regenerative Sense Amp Nodes** | Automated Python Netlist Discrepancy Analyzer (using PySpice / SPICE parser) and Cadence Spectre / ngspice comparative operating-point solver | 1. Extract transistor geometries (W, L) for all cross-coupled P-sense (PMOS) and N-sense (NMOS) pairs from both schematic and extracted netlists. 2. Calculate individual metric errors: delta_W = |W_sch - W_ext| / W_sch and delta_L = |L_sch - L_ext| / L_sch. 3. Calculate lumped parasitic extraction capacitance C_BL and C_/BL from the extracted netlist. 4. Compute differential bitline parasitic mismatch: Delta_C_BL = |C_BL - C_/BL|. | `Device metric error delta_W and delta_L <= 0.00% for all array and sense amp transistors; differential bitline capacitive imbalance Delta_C_BL <= 1.20 fF.` |

testcases.pre_conditions: Schematic netlist exported in SPICE format with full hierarchical subcircuit definitions (1T1C core cell, sense amplifier, EQ switches, decoder drivers); extracted layout SPICE netlist generated with parasitics collapsed to terminal lumped equivalents; device property extraction enabled for W, L, and multi-finger instances.
testcases.procedure: 1. Ingest schematic SPICE netlist and layout extracted SPICE netlist into Netgen graph equivalence comparator. 2. Apply PDK-specified device merging rules (parallel MOS gates, series resistors, substrate tap aggregation). 3. Perform topological node bipartite graph matching across all power (V_DD, V_PP, V_BB, V_SS), reference (V_BLP), and differential I/O (BL, /BL, SAN, SAP, WL) pins. 4. Parse output error log and generate discrepancy matrix for unmapped nets, dangling ports, and unmatched device instances.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total unmatched nets = 0; total unmatched devices = 0; port/pin binding errors = 0 across the entire 8F2 array core and periphery control blocks.

testcases.title: Device Metric & Parasitic Asymmetry Delta Sign-Off on Regenerative Sense Amp Nodes
testcases.instrumentation: Automated Python Netlist Discrepancy Analyzer (using PySpice / SPICE parser) and Cadence Spectre / ngspice comparative operating-point solver
testcases.pre_conditions: Graph isomorphism test (TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-2-3-01) passed with 100% topological net/device correspondence; full RC parasitic extraction (PEX) SPICE file generated with designated BL and /BL node designations.
testcases.procedure: 1. Extract transistor geometries (W, L) for all cross-coupled P-sense (PMOS) and N-sense (NMOS) pairs from both schematic and extracted netlists. 2. Calculate individual metric errors: delta_W = |W_sch - W_ext| / W_sch and delta_L = |L_sch - L_ext| / L_sch. 3. Calculate lumped parasitic extraction capacitance C_BL and C_/BL from the extracted netlist. 4. Compute differential bitline parasitic mismatch: Delta_C_BL = |C_BL - C_/BL|.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Device metric error delta_W and delta_L <= 0.00% for all array and sense amp transistors; differential bitline capacitive imbalance Delta_C_BL <= 1.20 fF.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Field Solver Parasitic Extraction for Storage and Bitline Capacitance

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 180nm cell architecture, standard 2.5D rule-based parasitic extraction (PEX) fails to capture 3D electrostatic fringe coupling between the high-aspect-ratio cylindrical/crown storage node capacitor (Cs), the pass transistor gate sidewalls, and adjacent folded bitline (BL/BL#) metal/poly tracks. A full 3D boundary element or finite element field solver must be deployed on the periodic 3x3 array cell tile to extract realistic mutual coupling capacitance matrices; otherwise, the calculated signal margin V_sig = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_b / C_s) will be overestimated by 18-25%, leading to regenerative sense amplifier failure or meta-stability during array read operations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm CMOS planar baseline rules adapted for 1T1C DRAM, maintaining Cs >= 25 fF to 30 fF requires MIM or deep poly-insulator-poly trench/stack structures with high dielectric constant (e.g., Al2O3 or thin Si3N4/SiO2 ONO stacks). The field solver mesh density must resolve sub-50nm dielectric boundary layers and contact plug geometries (storage node contact SNC and bitline contact BLC). Furthermore, the total bitline capacitance C_b must be strictly bounded below 250 fF for a 256-cell bitline architecture to ensure the C_b / C_s ratio remains under 8.5:1; unmodeled corner fringing from neighboring unselected bitlines directly threatens sense amplifier differential resolution.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Full 3D numerical field solver extraction licenses (e.g., FasterCap, Raphael, or Calibre xACT 3D) impose computational run-time bottlenecks on full-array tiles. The tool setup must leverage open-source boundary element solvers (FasterCap / FastCap2) calibrated against commercial MPW foundry test structures. If the cell parasitic netlist deviates from the foundry silicon qualification vehicle, physical mask tapeout freezes may slip past the scheduled foundry MPW shuttle run deadline, incurring multi-month delays and re-spin costs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off extraction for the 8F2 core must not become an open-ended compute science experiment. The team must bound the 3D field solver extraction to a calibrated 3x3 cell matrix plus boundary termination cells, export standard SPEF/DSPF parasitic files within a strict 48-hour turn-around window, and hand over extracted netlists to the dynamic read margin simulation team to close Milestone Gen-3 tapeout verification.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Over-budget bitline parasitic capacitance (C_b > 250 fF) leading to C_b / C_s > 10:1 ratio, which collapses read signal differential voltage below sense amplifier offset threshold (< 100 mV), causing catastrophic destructive read corruption.
1. Under-meshing of high-aspect-ratio storage node sidewalls in 3D field solver, resulting in an artificial 20% underestimation of node-to-substrate and node-to-wordline fringe capacitance, yielding silicon that fails charge retention refresh timing specs (tREF < 64 ms at 85 deg C).
1. Inter-bitline mutual parasitic coupling imbalance (C_BL to BL_bar mismatch > 3%) due to asymmetric boundary cell mesh termination, causing false differential triggering in cross-coupled PMOS sense amplifiers.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-3-01` | **3D Field Solver Storage Node Capacitance (C_s) Extraction on 3x3 Array Matrix** | Validated 3D Poisson/Electrostatic Field Solver (FasterCap / FastCap2 Boundary Element Engine or equivalent Open-Source 3D Field Extraction Flow) with GDSII-to-Boundary-Mesh Preprocessor | 1. Ingest GDSII layer definitions and process stack dielectric parameters (eps_r, thickness, loss tangent) into the 3D field solver preprocessor. 2. Generate triangular boundary conformal mesh with refinement around capacitor electrodes (mesh density <= 5nm at dielectric interfaces). 3. Apply 1.0 V potential to center cell storage node (SN_4) while holding all adjacent storage nodes, bitlines, wordlines, and p-well substrate at 0.0 V ground. 4. Solve 3D electrostatic charge distribution equations to compute capacitance matrix entries C_ii and C_ij. 5. Extract total self-capacitance and mutual coupling capacitances for SN_4. 6. Repeat across process dielectric corner variations (nominal, min_thickness/max_eps, max_thickness/min_eps). | `Center cell storage node capacitance C_s must satisfy: nominal C_s >= 28.0 fF, with all process corner extractions falling strictly within 25.0 fF <= C_s <= 32.0 fF. Mutual parasitic coupling from storage node to adjacent bitline (C_SN_BL) must not exceed 1.2 fF.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-3-02` | **Bitline Total Parasitic Capacitance (C_b) and C_b/C_s Ratio Extraction for 256-Cell Segment** | Boundary Element 3D Field Solver integrated with Periodic Array Extrapolation Script and Automated Matrix Extraction Netlister | 1. Extract per-cell bitline segment parasitic capacitance components: wire line-to-substrate, wire line-to-adjacent bitline, and bitline contact junction capacitance. 2. Scale line capacitance across a full 256-cell folded bitline segment including sense amplifier column access transistor fringe loads. 3. Synthesize lump-sum bitline capacitance netlist C_b_total. 4. Compute capacitance ratio R_cb_cs = C_b_total / C_s_nominal using extracted center cell C_s. 5. Evaluate dynamic differential read margin delta_V = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + R_cb_cs) with V_DD = 1.8 V. | `Total bitline parasitic capacitance C_b for 256 cells must satisfy 150.0 fF <= C_b <= 238.0 fF. The calculated capacitance ratio C_b / C_s must strictly be <= 8.5:1 (nominal target between 6.0:1 and 8.0:1), and differential read signal margin delta_V must be >= 105.0 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard Cleanroom Antistatic Lab Coat (ESD Class 1), Nitrile Examination Gloves (4 mil, Powder-Free), ANSI Z87.1 Approved Safety Glasses with Side Shields
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush with copious amounts of clean water at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes. Skin contact: Wash affected area with mild soap and water. Inhalation of vapors: Move individual to fresh, well-ventilated outdoor air. Ingestion: Rinse mouth thoroughly; do not induce vomiting unless instructed by medical personnel.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating air handling unit with Class 1000 / ISO 6 HEPA filtration; workstation airflow velocity maintained at 0.45 m/s +/- 20% laminar flow. Dedicated local exhaust not required for computational CAD metrology stations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-retardant stainless steel hazardous waste bins for chemical solvent disposal per local EPA cleanroom protocols. No direct drain disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for workstation and metrology touch terminal sanitation** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `70% v/v in deionized water` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Silicon validation test coupon (if physical validation vehicle run in parallel) post-MIM capacitor top-plate chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), hydrofluoric acid (HF) dip cleaned, hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated surface, particle count < 5 defects/cm2 at > 0.18 um.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Passivated wafer test vehicle with 50nm PECVD Si3N4 capping layer intact, dry-nitrogen sealed transfer cassette, or frozen sign-off GDSII/SPEF digital package verified free of structural geometry changes.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrowth (> 1.2 nm) and atmospheric moisture adsorption on exposed high-k/trench capacitor dielectric interfaces, altering physical capacitance by > 15% and invalidating field solver dielectric constant calibration data.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full 3D electrostatic field solver sign-off extraction completed on the 180nm 8F2 folded bitline DRAM array cell. Comprehensive parasitic netlists (C_s, C_b, C_mutual) successfully generated across all process dielectric corners, proving nominal storage capacitance >= 28.0 fF, bitline parasitic capacitance <= 238 fF, capacitance ratio C_b/C_s <= 8.5:1, and differential read margin >= 105 mV, enabling sign-off handoff to dynamic circuit simulation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_8f2_cell_3d_field_solver_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `dram_180nm_parasitic_extraction_signoff_report.pdf`
- [ ] `dram_180nm_cell_array_extracted.spef`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage node nominal capacitance C_s must meet or exceed targeted charge storage threshold** | `28.0 fF` | +/- 2.5 fF | Electrostatic 3D boundary element field solver extraction on nominal 3x3 layout matrix center cell |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Bitline parasitic to storage capacitance ratio C_b / C_s for 256-cell folded array** | `7.5` | +1.0 / -1.5 (maximum upper limit 8.5) | Summed 3D field solver parasitic netlist evaluation across 256-bitline segment divided by nominal C_s |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Storage node to adjacent unselected bitline mutual coupling capacitance C_SN_BL** | `0.85 fF` | <= 1.20 fF maximum | Multi-conductor electrostatic mutual capacitance matrix computation under FasterCap 3D mesh |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 3 quantitative assertions verified within specified tolerances, SPEF/DSPF parasitic files fully ingested into post-layout transient SPICE simulation without convergence errors, differential read sense amplifier signal margin confirmed > 100 mV across all PVT corners (0 deg C to 85 deg C, V_DD +/- 10%), and unconditional written approval granted by Systems Engineer and Lead Metrology Engineer.
