# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): 3D Dielectric Stack and Metal Profile Geometry Definition for Field Solver

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > 8F2 Folded Bitline 1T1C Full-Custom Cell Layout & Metal-Fix Routing for Commercial MPW [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Sign-Off & Parasitic Extraction for Cell Capacitance Verification [Metrology] > Field Solver Parasitic Extraction for Storage and Bitline Capacitance [Metrology] > 3D Dielectric Stack and Metal Profile Geometry Definition for Field Solver [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM architecture, field-solver 3D profile extraction models must account for multi-layer vertical coupling: bitline-to-wordline fringe capacitances, bitline-to-storage node contact coupling, and inter-bitline crosstalk. Defining nominal box dielectric layers without trapezoidal sidewall angles (typically 86°–89° post-RIE), microloading-induced thickness variations, or CMP dishing offsets will introduce a 15–22% systematic error in parasitic extraction (PEX). This directly skews sense amplifier differential sensing margin simulations and bitline capacitance (Cbl) timing budgets.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The dielectric profile for field solver modelling (FasterCap/Raphael/StarRC) must accurately reflect the complex 180nm Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stack. This includes ILD0 (BPSG/TEOS, k ~ 3.9–4.1), Si3N4 etch stops (k ~ 7.0–7.5), the tungsten plug (W-plug) barrier layer (Ti/TiN), and the crown capacitor MIM/ONO dielectric (Ta2O5 or Al2O3 high-k with kappa > 15). Omitting conformal boundary meshes around the bottom storage node crown taper and neglecting the chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) erosion over dense cell arrays vs. peripheral CMOS will cause critical inaccuracies in calculating the target >= 28 fF/cell storage capacitance and bitline parasitic capacitance ratio (Cs/Cb).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW foundries enforce strict fixed PDK metal stack rules (e.g., standard 1P5M/1P6M Al interconnects with standard SiO2/fluorosilicate glass ILD) and proprietary dielectric thickness tables. Customizing high-aspect-ratio 3D field solver geometry decks requires either calibrated cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) / inline critical dimension SEM (CD-SEM) metrology correlation data from the foundry or explicit sign-off waivers for non-standard ONO/MIM topographies to avoid costly design-rule violations and unresolvable fabrication hold-ups.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off schedules for the commercial MPW tapeout rely directly on frozen parasitic netlists. The 3D profile geometry definition must be fully finalized and validated against preliminary test-chip S-parameter or capacitance-voltage (C-V) comb structures within the current sprint. Any ambiguity in the dielectric stack file format or mesh convergence limits will block full-chip DRC/LVS/PEX closure and delay tapeout submission to the shuttle broker.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Field solver boundary mesh divergence or polygon intersecting singularities along trapezoidal crown capacitor sidewalls, causing underprediction of Cs and failing the minimum 28 fF noise immunity floor.
1. Underestimation of bitline-to-bitline fringe capacitance (C_bl_bl) by modeling vertical rectangular metal edges instead of tapered sidewalls with anti-reflective coating (ARC) caps, leading to sense-amp read failure under worst-case solid-1/solid-0 data pattern coupling.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F2 folded bitline 1T1C DRAM architecture, field-solver 3D profile extraction models must account for multi-layer vertical coupling: bitline-to-wordline fringe capacitances, bitline-to-storage node contact coupling, and inter-bitline crosstalk. Defining nominal box dielectric layers without trapezoidal sidewall angles (typically 86°–89° post-RIE), microloading-induced thickness variations, or CMP dishing offsets will introduce a 15–22% systematic error in parasitic extraction (PEX). This directly skews sense amplifier differential sensing margin simulations and bitline capacitance (Cbl) timing budgets.
critics.domain_expert: The dielectric profile for field solver modelling (FasterCap/Raphael/StarRC) must accurately reflect the complex 180nm Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stack. This includes ILD0 (BPSG/TEOS, k ~ 3.9–4.1), Si3N4 etch stops (k ~ 7.0–7.5), the tungsten plug (W-plug) barrier layer (Ti/TiN), and the crown capacitor MIM/ONO dielectric (Ta2O5 or Al2O3 high-k with kappa > 15). Omitting conformal boundary meshes around the bottom storage node crown taper and neglecting the chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) erosion over dense cell arrays vs. peripheral CMOS will cause critical inaccuracies in calculating the target >= 28 fF/cell storage capacitance and bitline parasitic capacitance ratio (Cs/Cb).
critics.supply_chain: Commercial 180nm MPW foundries enforce strict fixed PDK metal stack rules (e.g., standard 1P5M/1P6M Al interconnects with standard SiO2/fluorosilicate glass ILD) and proprietary dielectric thickness tables. Customizing high-aspect-ratio 3D field solver geometry decks requires either calibrated cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) / inline critical dimension SEM (CD-SEM) metrology correlation data from the foundry or explicit sign-off waivers for non-standard ONO/MIM topographies to avoid costly design-rule violations and unresolvable fabrication hold-ups.
critics.laya_pm: Sign-off schedules for the commercial MPW tapeout rely directly on frozen parasitic netlists. The 3D profile geometry definition must be fully finalized and validated against preliminary test-chip S-parameter or capacitance-voltage (C-V) comb structures within the current sprint. Any ambiguity in the dielectric stack file format or mesh convergence limits will block full-chip DRC/LVS/PEX closure and delay tapeout submission to the shuttle broker.
critical_failure_modes: Field solver boundary mesh divergence or polygon intersecting singularities along trapezoidal crown capacitor sidewalls, causing underprediction of Cs and failing the minimum 28 fF noise immunity floor.

Underestimation of bitline-to-bitline fringe capacitance (C_bl_bl) by modeling vertical rectangular metal edges instead of tapered sidewalls with anti-reflective coating (ARC) caps, leading to sense-amp read failure under worst-case solid-1/solid-0 data pattern coupling.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-MET-180-003: 3D Boundary Element Field Solver Execution for Storage Node & Bitline Coupling

### 1. Overview & Objective
This SOP defines the execution protocol for 3D Boundary Element Method (BEM) electrostatic field solving to extract the Maxwell capacitance matrix for an $8F^2$ folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cell in a 180nm commercial MPW tapeout. The extraction ensures accurate validation of the storage capacitor node capacitance ($C_s$), bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$), and mutual crosstalk/coupling capacitances ($C_{c(BL-SN)}$, $C_{c(BL-BL)}$) against architectural noise margin budgets.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Import GDSII and    │
│       Layer Map        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Generate Conformal   │
│    BEM Surface Mesh    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│         Assign         │
│   Permittivities and   │
│    Dielectric Stack    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Set Boundary      │
│     Conditions and     │
│      Excitations       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Solve Laplace      │
│  Equation via Greens   │
│       Functions        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Extract Maxwell     │
│   Capacitance Matrix   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Evaluate Sign-Off    │
│  Budgets and Coupling  │
│         Ratios         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Geometry Import & Boundary Setup
1. Load the sign-off verified GDSII cell layout for the $8F^2$ folded bitline unit cell ($\text{Area} = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
2. Instantiate a $3 \times 3$ cell array window (minimum 9 storage nodes and adjacent folded bitline pairs: $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$) to capture mutual fringing and 3D cross-coupling effects.
3. Configure the access transistor geometry with channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
4. Set bitline and wordline lateral pitches in the solver deck to $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$. Set simulation domain boundaries with periodic boundary conditions along the $X/Y$ array axes and Neumann boundary conditions ($\partial \Phi / \partial n = 0$) on outer bounding box walls.

#### Step 2: Dielectric Profile & Material Parameter Assignment
1. Define the gate dielectric layer as thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with a physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\kappa_{\text{SiO}_2} \approx 3.9$).
2. Model the capacitor-over-bitline (COB) crown-shaped stacked capacitor structure erected over the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
3. Specify the storage capacitor dielectric layer using an ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack with an equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$ and effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
4. Assign inter-layer dielectrics (ILD) surrounding the bitlines and tungsten plugs with standard pre-metal dielectric values ($\kappa \approx 3.9 - 4.1$).

#### Step 3: Conformal Surface Discretization (BEM Meshing)
1. Discretize only the conducting surfaces and dielectric interfaces into 2D triangular/quadrilateral boundary elements (standard BEM formulation: $\nabla^2 \Phi = 0$ solved via free-space and stratified Green’s functions).
2. Set the maximum surface element edge length to $\le 15\text{ nm}$ on the high-curvature corners of the crown capacitor and bitline sidewalls.
3. Set the maximum element edge length to $\le 30\text{ nm}$ across planar conductor plates and interconnect runs.
4. Verify edge conformal mesh alignment across all dielectric-dielectric and conductor-dielectric interfaces with zero non-manifold edges.

#### Step 4: Potential Excitation & Boundary Element Field Solving
1. Apply unit potential excitations ($V_i = 1.0\text{ V}$) sequentially to conductor $i$ (Target Storage Node $\text{SN}_0$, Bitline $\text{BL}$, Complementary Bitline $\overline{\text{BL}}$, and Wordline $\text{WL}$) while tying all other conductors $j \neq i$ and substrate to ground ($0.0\text{ V}$).
2. Solve the Fredholm integral equations of the first/second kind using Fast Multipole Accelerated (FMM) or hierarchical matrix BEM solver routines.
3. Integrate the surface charge density $\sigma = -\varepsilon \frac{\partial \Phi}{\partial n}$ over each conductor boundary surface to calculate the total accumulated charge:
   $$Q_j = \oint_{S_j} \sigma \, dS$$
4. Populate the full short-circuit Maxwell capacitance matrix:
   $$C_{ij} = \frac{Q_j}{V_i}\bigg|_{V_{k \ne i} = 0}$$

#### Step 5: Post-Processing & Capacitance Budget Sign-Off
1. Extract self-capacitance and mutual coupling capacitances:
   - Storage Node Capacitance: $C_s = C_{\text{SN,total}}$
   - Bitline Total Parasitic Capacitance: $C_b$ (scaled across 256 or 512 cells per bitline column block)
   - Coupling Capacitance: $C_{c(BL-SN)}$ and $C_{c(BL-\overline{BL})}$
2. Compute the bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$.
3. Check all extracted parameters against the acceptance criteria below.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
 C_b Low (256-cell)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
        C_s Nominal┤▒▒▒▒▒                              │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒                              │
            C_s Min┤░░░░                               │
                   │░░░░                               │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0     62.5    125.0    187.5 250.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value / Permissible Range | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$ (Nominal: $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Direct 3D BEM surface integral of charge on crown capacitor node at $V_{\text{SN}} = 1.0\text{ V}$. |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150.0 \le C_b \le 250.0$ (for 256-cell to 512-cell array block) | $\text{fF}$ | Integrated sum of BL metal, contact plug, and crossover capacitances across array column. |
| **Bitline-to-Storage Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9.0 : 1$ (Hard ceiling: $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless (Ratio) | Ratio calculation: severe read margin degradation occurs if ratio $\ge 10:1$. |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Junction/sub-threshold extraction verifying retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$. |

---

### 4. Literature References
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Unit cell transistor geometry: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown topology over tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - High-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ or ONO) with effective permittivity $\kappa > 15$.
  - Minimum storage capacitance requirement of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ and leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
  - Folded bitline $8F^2$ physical footprint area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance budget: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ across 256-cell or 512-cell array blocks.
  - Signal read margin capacitance ratio: $5 : 1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9 : 1$ (margin fails if $> 10 : 1$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Crown/cylinder stacked capacitor Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Data retention sign-off: $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting 3D parasitic coupling capacitance between high-aspect-ratio cylindrical storage nodes (SN) and adjacent folded bitlines (BL) using a 3D Boundary Element Method (BEM) solver requires strict grid and mesh convergence criteria. In 180nm/130nm hybrid nodes, 2.5D rule-based RC extractors systematically underestimate 3D fringe and corner capacitance by 18-28% due to non-planar dielectric step coverage and neighboring plate proximity effects. Without hierarchical panel multipole acceleration (FastCap/BEM) tailored to 8F2 unit cells, computational matrix inversion scaling O(N^2) to O(N^3) risks out-of-memory crashes on dense 1024x1024 array segments.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm commercial MPW rules (e.g. SKY130 / S180), drawn metal-1 pitch is 0.34 um with minimum poly-to-active spacing of 0.21 um. The storage node contact (SNC) plug and the storage node itself experience substantial capacitive coupling to both true and complement bitlines (BL / BL_bar). If the storage-node-to-bitline parasitic coupling capacitance (C_sn_bl) exceeds 12% of total cell storage capacitance (C_s ~ 25-30 fF), dynamic bitline signal development during wordline assertion induces severe wordline-induced bitline bounce and common-mode sensing margin degradation (>45 mV margin loss on the sense amplifier). Dielectric permittivity variations (k-value drift in inter-layer dielectric SiO2 vs Si3N4 etch-stop layers) must be bounded in the BEM input model.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial open-source MPW shuttles impose strict GDSII tapeout freeze windows. Proprietary commercial 3D field solvers (such as Ansys Q3D or Synopsys Raphael) require expensive floating token licenses that risk pipeline stalls in open-source consortiums; alternative open-source 3D solvers (FastCap2 / FasterCap) must have validated dielectric profile templates matching foundry techfiles exactly to avoid respin cycles on physical silicon wafers.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Execution time of full-wave or electrostatic 3D BEM solvers on full sub-arrays threatens the physical verification critical path timeline. The signoff flow must decouple full-chip 2.5D extraction from targeted 3x3 and 5x5 8F2 cell mini-array 3D BEM runs, injecting verified coupling coefficients into the corner Spice subcircuit models before final DRC/LVS freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. BEM mesh panel discretization singularity causing negative mutual capacitance coefficients or non-positive-definite Maxwell capacitance matrices.
1. Excessive storage-node-to-bitline coupling ratio (C_sn_bl / C_cell > 0.15) causing sense amplifier read-disturb failure during folded bitline precharge-to-Vdd/2 release.
1. Omission of conformal nitride liner (Si3N4 barrier k=7.0 vs inter-metal SiO2 k=3.9) in the 3D permittivity stack causing >20% absolute extraction error against silicon CV test structures.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

critics.systems_engineer: Extracting 3D parasitic coupling capacitance between high-aspect-ratio cylindrical storage nodes (SN) and adjacent folded bitlines (BL) using a 3D Boundary Element Method (BEM) solver requires strict grid and mesh convergence criteria. In 180nm/130nm hybrid nodes, 2.5D rule-based RC extractors systematically underestimate 3D fringe and corner capacitance by 18-28% due to non-planar dielectric step coverage and neighboring plate proximity effects. Without hierarchical panel multipole acceleration (FastCap/BEM) tailored to 8F2 unit cells, computational matrix inversion scaling O(N^2) to O(N^3) risks out-of-memory crashes on dense 1024x1024 array segments.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm commercial MPW rules (e.g. SKY130 / S180), drawn metal-1 pitch is 0.34 um with minimum poly-to-active spacing of 0.21 um. The storage node contact (SNC) plug and the storage node itself experience substantial capacitive coupling to both true and complement bitlines (BL / BL_bar). If the storage-node-to-bitline parasitic coupling capacitance (C_sn_bl) exceeds 12% of total cell storage capacitance (C_s ~ 25-30 fF), dynamic bitline signal development during wordline assertion induces severe wordline-induced bitline bounce and common-mode sensing margin degradation (>45 mV margin loss on the sense amplifier). Dielectric permittivity variations (k-value drift in inter-layer dielectric SiO2 vs Si3N4 etch-stop layers) must be bounded in the BEM input model.
critics.supply_chain: Commercial open-source MPW shuttles impose strict GDSII tapeout freeze windows. Proprietary commercial 3D field solvers (such as Ansys Q3D or Synopsys Raphael) require expensive floating token licenses that risk pipeline stalls in open-source consortiums; alternative open-source 3D solvers (FastCap2 / FasterCap) must have validated dielectric profile templates matching foundry techfiles exactly to avoid respin cycles on physical silicon wafers.
critics.laya_pm: Execution time of full-wave or electrostatic 3D BEM solvers on full sub-arrays threatens the physical verification critical path timeline. The signoff flow must decouple full-chip 2.5D extraction from targeted 3x3 and 5x5 8F2 cell mini-array 3D BEM runs, injecting verified coupling coefficients into the corner Spice subcircuit models before final DRC/LVS freeze.
critical_failure_modes: BEM mesh panel discretization singularity causing negative mutual capacitance coefficients or non-positive-definite Maxwell capacitance matrices.
Excessive storage-node-to-bitline coupling ratio (C_sn_bl / C_cell > 0.15) causing sense amplifier read-disturb failure during folded bitline precharge-to-Vdd/2 release.
Omission of conformal nitride liner (Si3N4 barrier k=7.0 vs inter-metal SiO2 k=3.9) in the 3D permittivity stack causing >20% absolute extraction error against silicon CV test structures.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Cell Parasitic Model Validation and $C_b/C_s$ Sensing Margin Sign-Off Analysis

- **Document Location**: [`sop_cell_parasitic_sensing_margin_signoff.md`](./docs/sop_cell_parasitic_sensing_margin_signoff.md)
- **Technology Node**: 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout ($F = 180\text{ nm}$)
- **Cell Layout Topology**: $8F^2$ Folded Bitline 1T1C Unit Cell ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$)

---

### Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Layout & Contact    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Field Solver      │
│  Parasitic Extraction  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Calculate C_b / C_s   │
│         Ratio          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Differential Signal   │
│   Delta_V Evaluation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│  Sign-Off Margin Met?  │
└──────┬──────────┬──────┘
    Yes│          │No
       ▼          ▼
┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────┐
│   Sign-Off   │ │  Layout & Metal-Fix  │
│   Approval   │ │     Optimization     │
└──────────────┘ └──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Geometry & Stack Layer Setup**:
   - Import the $8F^2$ folded bitline cell array GDSII layout ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell, access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Set up the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) dielectric parameters ($\text{ONO}$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$).
2. **Deterministic 3D Field Solver Extraction**:
   - Extract the storage node capacitance ($C_s$) including crown/MIM plate area and fringe parasitics over the tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Extract total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) along the 256 or 512 cells per bitline column (comprising bitline conductor lines, line-to-line coupling, plate-to-substrate, and drain junction capacitances).
3. **Capacitance Ratio Sign-Off Check**:
   - Compute the capacitance ratio $\text{Ratio} = C_b / C_s$.
   - Verify that $\text{Ratio}$ falls in the nominal $5:1$ to $9:1$ window and strictly does not exceed $10:1$.
4. **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$) Validation**:
   - Set bitline precharge equalization to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Calculate and simulate wordline charge redistribution:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_b + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right|$$
   - Run transient SPICE simulations of the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latching to confirm differential swing resolution.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                             ┌───────────────────────────┐
                             │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░             │
  Read Signal Delta_V (mV/10)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░             │
                             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
Bitline Parasitic C_b (fF/10)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
        Storage Node C_s (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
          C_b/C_s Ratio (x:1)┤█████████                  │
                             │█████████                  │
                             └┬──────┬─────┬──────┬─────┬┘
                              0      7    14     21    28 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Sign-Off Bound | Unit | Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ (nominal) | $\ge 25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field Solver Extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150.0 \text{ to } 238.0$ | $\le 250.0$ | $\text{fF/bitline}$ | Full Column Extraction (256/512 cells) |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 8.5 : 1$ | $\le 9.0 : 1$ (Hard Max $10.0 : 1$) | - | Ratio Analysis |
| **Read Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\ge 100.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient SPICE Readout Simulation |

---

### 3. Citations & Literature Context

- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: Defines the $8F^2$ cell area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$), $C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}$ to $30\ \text{fF}$ (nominal $28\ \text{fF}$), $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$, and capacitance ratio bounds between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($>10:1$ degradation limit).
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Defines the precharge equalization ($V_{\text{DD}} / 2$), signal development equation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$, and read signal target margin of $100\ \text{mV}$ to $150\ \text{mV}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Defines access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), high-$\kappa$ dielectric constant ($\kappa > 15$), and stacked capacitor over bitline structure.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline topology for 180nm commercial MPW, the parasitic capacitance ratio C_b/C_s is the primary operational bottleneck. The storage cell target of C_s >= 28 fF paired with a bitline parasitic C_b constrained between 150 fF and 250 fF yields a nominal ratio between 5.36:1 and 8.93:1. Exceeding a 9:1 ratio degrades the developed differential voltage delta_V_BL = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_b / C_s) below 90 mV at V_DD = 1.8V, eroding the sensing window against sense-amplifier threshold mismatch and local power-grid IR drops.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Field solver 3D Raphael/FastCap parasitic models must accurately distinguish between inter-layer plate-to-substrate, bitline-to-wordline fringe capacitances, and neighbor bitline-to-bitline coupling (C_bl_bl). In 180nm BEOL stackups, planar MIM or trench/crown capacitors exhibit significant fringe-field line termination on adjacent metal fix routes. If unshielded, adjacent bitline capacitive cross-talk injects common-mode noise into the complementary bitline /BL, causing false evaluation in open/folded hybrid regimes.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: MPW foundry tapeout runs impose rigid standard PDK DRC/LVS decks and density fill requirements. Metal dummy fills introduced to fulfill chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) minimum density criteria (typically >= 20% on M1-M3) modify the effective dielectric environment around bitline wires. If dummy metal shapes are excluded from field solver cell models, physical C_b post-tapeout will drift by +12% to +18% over extracted values, pushing marginally passing 8.5:1 ratios into functional failure.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off timeline requires freezing GDSII layout geometries and parasitic extraction runsets prior to tapeout reality-gate sign-off. Post-layout sign-off cannot proceed on estimated analytical formulas; sign-off criteria must mandate verified SPICE netlists extracted via calibrated field solvers with corner runs (Typ, Fast-Fast, Slow-Slow, Temp -40C to 125C) validated against discrete CV-profiling structures on test coupons.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline-to-storage-node capacitance ratio C_b/C_s exceeds 10:1 due to excessive bitline contact fringe parasitics and CMP dummy fill, collapsing read signal delta_V_BL below sense-amplifier offset threshold (70 mV), leading to systematic read destructive errors.
1. Inter-bitline coupling capacitance (C_bl_bl / C_b > 25%) induces catastrophic pattern-dependent differential noise during simultaneous sense amplifier firing, flipping adjacent sensed logic states.
1. MIM/PIP dielectric thickness variation (+/-10% tox across wafer) causes localized C_s drops below 25 fF, violating cell refresh retention time requirements (t_REF < 64 ms at 85C).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-3-3-01` | **3D Field Solver Extraction and C_b/C_s Ratio Sign-Off Across BEOL Corners** | Synopsys Raphael / Cadence Pegasus 3D Field Solver, Custom Calibrated Python Parasitic Parser, SPICE Circuit Simulator (180nm Commercial MPW PDK) | 1. Execute 3D field solver boundary-element extraction on the 256-wordline x 2-bitline sub-array layout to compute lumped and distributed node capacitances (C_s, C_BL_gnd, C_BL_WL, C_BL_BL). 2. Calculate total bitline parasitic capacitance C_b = C_BL_gnd + C_BL_WL + 2 * C_BL_BL across typical, best-case dielectric (low k, thin metal), and worst-case dielectric (high k, thick metal) process corners. 3. Compute capacitance ratio C_b / C_s for nominal C_s (28 fF) and worst-case degraded C_s (25 fF). 4. Back-annotate distributed RC netlist into SPICE simulation deck and simulate sensing read operation at V_DD = 1.8V, V_precharge = 0.9V across -40C, 27C, and 125C. | `Total bitline parasitic capacitance C_b <= 224 fF; effective storage node capacitance C_s >= 28.0 fF; sign-off capacitance ratio C_b / C_s <= 8.0:1 across all BEOL corners; developed differential bitline signal delta_V_BL >= 100 mV at t = 2.5 ns post-wordline activation.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-2-3-3-3-02` | **Sense-Amplifier Dynamic Sensing Margin & Offset Tolerance Verification** | SPICE Full-Spectrum Monte Carlo Simulation Engine (10,000 runs, local transistor mismatch & global process parameters), High-Speed Differential Probe & Agilent 4156C Parameter Analyzer on PDK Test Structures | 1. Initialize bitline BL and complementary /BL to V_precharge = 0.900 V +/- 2 mV. 2. Charge storage node C_s to data '0' (0.0 V) and data '1' (1.8 V) under worst-case retention leakage condition. 3. Activate access wordline WL to V_PP = 2.8 V (boosted gate drive) to transfer charge onto BL. 4. Apply 10,000-run Monte Carlo mismatch perturbations on the cross-coupled latch sense-amplifier PMOS/NMOS pairs. 5. Enable sense-amplifier strobe signal (SAN/SAP) and record sensing success rate, differential voltage delta_V_BL, and latching resolution time. | `Zero sensing inversion errors across 10,000 Monte Carlo runs (P_error = 0.0 ppm); minimum dynamic sense margin delta_V_BL_min >= 90.0 mV; sense amplifier latch settling time t_sense <= 1.80 ns at nominal corner and <= 2.40 ns at 125C Slow-Slow corner.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/impact safety glasses with side shields, Cleanroom-compatible ESD-safe nitrile gloves (double-gloved, minimum 4 mil thickness), Static-dissipative cleanroom coat and conductive ESD heel grounders/footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious gentle flowing water for at least 15 minutes at cleanroom eye wash station; seek medical evaluation. Skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and wash skin with mild soap and water. Inhalation of compressed nitrogen: Move personnel immediately to fresh air; if breathing is labored or stopped, administer artificial respiration and oxygen by trained staff.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Laboratory and wafer probing stations must maintain minimum 10 air changes per hour with certified laminar flow benches (Class 100 / ISO 5) providing HEPA-filtered downdraft velocity of 0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s. Local solvent exhaust canopy maintained at face velocity >= 0.5 m/s.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent-saturated cleanroom wipes and flushes must be disposed in designated flammable, airtight, grounded hazardous waste containers. No chemical drains or sewer disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F2 folded bitline topology for 180nm commercial MPW, the parasitic capacitance ratio C_b/C_s is the primary operational bottleneck. The storage cell target of C_s >= 28 fF paired with a bitline parasitic C_b constrained between 150 fF and 250 fF yields a nominal ratio between 5.36:1 and 8.93:1. Exceeding a 9:1 ratio degrades the developed differential voltage delta_V_BL = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_b / C_s) below 90 mV at V_DD = 1.8V, eroding the sensing window against sense-amplifier threshold mismatch and local power-grid IR drops.
critics.domain_expert: Field solver 3D Raphael/FastCap parasitic models must accurately distinguish between inter-layer plate-to-substrate, bitline-to-wordline fringe capacitances, and neighbor bitline-to-bitline coupling (C_bl_bl). In 180nm BEOL stackups, planar MIM or trench/crown capacitors exhibit significant fringe-field line termination on adjacent metal fix routes. If unshielded, adjacent bitline capacitive cross-talk injects common-mode noise into the complementary bitline /BL, causing false evaluation in open/folded hybrid regimes.
critics.supply_chain: MPW foundry tapeout runs impose rigid standard PDK DRC/LVS decks and density fill requirements. Metal dummy fills introduced to fulfill chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) minimum density criteria (typically >= 20% on M1-M3) modify the effective dielectric environment around bitline wires. If dummy metal shapes are excluded from field solver cell models, physical C_b post-tapeout will drift by +12% to +18% over extracted values, pushing marginally passing 8.5:1 ratios into functional failure.
critics.laya_pm: Sign-off timeline requires freezing GDSII layout geometries and parasitic extraction runsets prior to tapeout reality-gate sign-off. Post-layout sign-off cannot proceed on estimated analytical formulas; sign-off criteria must mandate verified SPICE netlists extracted via calibrated field solvers with corner runs (Typ, Fast-Fast, Slow-Slow, Temp -40C to 125C) validated against discrete CV-profiling structures on test coupons.
critical_failure_modes: Bitline-to-storage-node capacitance ratio C_b/C_s exceeds 10:1 due to excessive bitline contact fringe parasitics and CMP dummy fill, collapsing read signal delta_V_BL below sense-amplifier offset threshold (70 mV), leading to systematic read destructive errors.
Inter-bitline coupling capacitance (C_bl_bl / C_b > 25%) induces catastrophic pattern-dependent differential noise during simultaneous sense amplifier firing, flipping adjacent sensed logic states.
MIM/PIP dielectric thickness variation (+/-10% tox across wafer) causes localized C_s drops below 25 fF, violating cell refresh retention time requirements (t_REF < 64 ms at 85C).

1. Execute 3D field solver boundary-element extraction on the 256-wordline x 2-bitline sub-array layout to compute lumped and distributed node capacitances (C_s, C_BL_gnd, C_BL_WL, C_BL_BL).

4. Back-annotate distributed RC netlist into SPICE simulation deck and simulate sensing read operation at V_DD = 1.8V, V_precharge = 0.9V across -40C, 27C, and 125C.

# Standard Operating Procedure: GDSII Tapeout Physical Verification, Density Fill & Commercial MPW Pre-Tapeout Sign-Off

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Air exposure exceeding 20 minutes allows uncontrolled spontaneous SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (> 0.4 nm), which severely increases Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and drastically degrades bitcell storage capacitance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of GDSII Tapeout Physical Verification, Density Fill & Commercial MPW Pre-Tapeout Sign-Off: PDK setup, physical verification rule decks, and full-chip GDSII layouts pass 100% DRC/LVS sign-off and satisfy foundry commercial tapeout design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Golden_180nm_PDK_DRC_LVS_Signoff_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Commercial_MPW_Tapeout_GDSII_OASIS_Archive.tar.gz`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Design Rule Check (DRC) Violations** | `0 violations` | Zero tolerance across full chip and seal ring | Automated batch DRC run using KLayout / Pegasus Golden Rule Deck |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Netlist Equivalence** | `100% match` | Zero net/port mismatches, zero floating pins | Hierarchical LVS extraction against golden SPICE schematic |
| `ASSERT-03` | **3D Crown Capacitor ALD Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | `<= 0.80 nm` | +/- 0.05 nm across wafer | High-frequency 1 MHz C-V accumulation capacitance metrology |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% clean DRC/LVS verification logs signed off by lead tapeout architect; checksum of streamed GDSII package validated against foundry MPW shuttle intake submission portal.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Full-Chip Hierarchical DRC & Custom DRAM Capacitor Rule Deck Sign-Off

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical DRC flattening across large 8F^2 memory array tiling risks exponential memory explosion and false positive boundary violations at memory-periphery abutment zones. The rule deck must enforce cell-level cell-boundary encapsulation with strict hierarchical pruning rather than brute-force geometric flattening, ensuring full-chip Calibre/KLayout execution completes within memory and compute bounds while maintaining sub-0.5 nm grid snapping.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Standard commercial 180nm CMOS logic DRC rule decks lack custom layer checks for Crown/MIM capacitor modules (Ta2O5/ONO high-k dielectrics, bottom electrode contact plugs, top plate overlaps). The custom rule deck must strictly validate the 180nm node capacitor pitch (360-400 nm), access transistor drain-to-W-plug enclosure (minimum 35 nm), crown-to-crown aspect ratio spacing (>120 nm to prevent wet-bench collapse/bridging), and dielectric wrap-around enclosures to guarantee >28 fF/cell storage capacitance.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW tapeouts (e.g., TSMC 0.18um, SkyWater 130/180nm, or SilTerra) strictly prohibit non-standard mask layers unless formally integrated into customized wafer-level engineering split runs. Submitting an unvalidated custom capacitor rule deck without signed PDK design waiver agreements will lead to instant MPW mask generation rejection and schedule slips exceeding 12 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The sign-off timeline requires strict alignment between the digital peripheral logic sign-off and custom DRAM macro freeze. If DRC runtimes exceed 6 hours per iteration due to bloated boolean operations in the custom capacitor deck, physical verification will miss the rigid multi-project wafer (MPW) GDSII freeze deadline. Immediate golden freeze of DRC rule revision v1.4 is critical.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Crown capacitor bottom electrode pitch violation (<360 nm) causing inter-cell bridging, dielectric breakdown, and catastrophic refresh leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.
1. Drain diffusion contact to tungsten plug (W-plug) misalignment resulting in open-circuit storage nodes or substrate junction punch-through.
1. Full-chip false clean status caused by missing exclusion tags on custom DRAM capacitor dummy fill geometries, causing DRC mask generation errors.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-1-01` | **Hierarchical Custom DRAM Cell 8F^2 Capacitor Array DRC Boundary and Pitch Verification** | Siemens Calibre nmDRC / KLayout DRC Engine (64-bit multi-threaded Linux Cluster, 128 GB RAM) parsing GDSII/OASIS physical stream | 1. Ingest full-chip GDSII file and instantiate 1024x1024 8F^2 DRAM cell array matrix. 2. # Standard Operating Procedure: Custom DRAM Capacitor & Cell Array DRC Rule Deck Authoring

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Authoring custom Design Rule Check (DRC) decks for non-standard 180nm 1T1C DRAM cells alongside standard foundry logic PDKs introduces severe boundary violation risks. The custom stacked crown/MIM capacitor layers (SN_NODE, CAP_TOP, DIEL) and high-aspect ratio tungsten storage node contact plugs (SNC/SN_VIA) must maintain strict hierarchical clearance from standard CMOS core rules without triggering false positive design rule flags across the periphery sense amplifiers. Furthermore, logical operations must enforce 8F^2 cell grid pitch alignment (0.259 um^2 cell area) and verify that bitline-to-wordline parasitic overlaps do not inflate C_b beyond 250 fF, ensuring the critical C_b / C_s ratio stays strictly between 5:1 and 9:1 against the minimum 28 fF storage cell baseline.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Standard commercial 180nm CMOS PDKs lack native boolean layer operations for deep sub-micron stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) or high-k MIM (Ta2O5/Al2O3 or ONO) modules. The rule deck author must explicitly define geometric constraints: storage node bottom electrode critical dimension (CD = 220 nm), crown-to-crown pitch spacing (>= 160 nm to prevent electrical bridging due to micro-loading during wet etching), and access transistor drain contact enclosure. If the rule deck does not model multi-dielectric overlap margins and plate bias contact enclosures, dielectric breakdown or excessive storage node junction leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C will escape verification, catastrophically degrading retention times well below standard 64 ms refresh cycles.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW shuttles operate under rigid foundry sign-off tapeout freeze schedules and impose hard-stop requirements for clean DRC reports generated exclusively via standard EDA formats (KLayout DRC, Calibre nmDRC, or Pegasus). Introducing custom capacitor mask layers (MIM_MASK, SNC_CONT) requires explicit pre-negotiation and non-standard tooling qualification with the foundry line engineering team. Unqualified custom DRC decks risk rejecting entire MPW reticle frames, causing catastrophic wafer shuttle slot forfeiture and multi-quarter schedule delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: From a metrology and pre-tapeout delivery perspective, DRC rule deck authoring must not become an open-ended loop. The deliverable rule deck must execute within bounded runtimes (< 30 minutes on a 512-kbit DRAM test vehicle array) and integrate automated false-positive suppression for memory array boundary dummy cells. Sign-off milestones require 100% automated regression passing against synthetic defect-injection benchmark layouts prior to frozen GDSII merge.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node crown-to-crown bridging escape: Rule deck fails to flag 2D lithographic corner rounding and spacing violations below 160 nm at cell array boundaries, causing hard shorts between adjacent storage nodes.
1. Parasitic bitline-to-storage-node coupling capacitance underestimation: Deck lacks enclosure and 3D spacing checks between bitline metal layers and the storage node contact plug, ballooning C_b and elevating C_b / C_s above 10:1, killing the differential read sensing window.
1. Dielectric enclosure puncture / edge breakdown: Omission of minimum overlap rules of top electrode (plate line) over the high-k capacitor dielectric layer, exposing the bottom crown edge to direct metal shorting.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-1-1-01` | **Synthetic Array Boundary Defect Injection and Crown Spacing DRC Regression** | KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) and Mentor Calibre nmDRC running automated synthetic regression harness scripts. | 1. Ingest synthetic test vehicle GDSII into DRC pipeline with compiled custom DRAM capacitor rule deck (dram_cap_drc.lydrc / .drc). 2. Execute full DRC run with hierarchical cell caching enabled. 3. Parse generated RDB/ASCII error database against known ground-truth defect coordinate injection list. 4. Measure execution wall-clock time and memory consumption. | `100% true defect capture rate (100/100 injected violations caught with exact coordinates) and exactly 0 false positives reported outside the programmed violation bounding boxes; total execution runtime <= 180 seconds on 8-core CPU.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-1-1-02` | **Full-Chip MPW Core-to-Periphery Boundary Interface Rule Sign-Off Verification** | Calibre nmDRC / KLayout DRC integrated with layout density and antenna rule checking processors. | 1. Run rule deck across full hierarchical layout spanning array-to-periphery transition zones. 2. Verify logical booleans distinguishing custom storage node layers from standard periphery metal/dielectric interconnects. 3. Verify antenna ratio and metal density rules across the memory array boundary. | `Zero (0) unclassified DRC errors; all cell boundary dummy transitions resolve clean without rule waiver; storage node contact (SNC) to active area enclosure conforms >= 40 nm across 100% of tested array instances.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe cleanroom coat, Powder-free nitrile gloves (Mil-Spec 4 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with cleaning solvents, flush immediately with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes. For inhalation, move person into fresh air. This software/metrology EDA deck authoring task operates in an office/data-center computing environment; workstation ergonomics and localized solvent spill kits apply.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA/ULPA laminar flow recirculation (ISO Class 5) with minimum 60 air changes per hour for test hardware benches; computational workstations require standard thermal ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked cleanroom lint-free wipes in dedicated sealed, grounded hazardous waste containers in accordance with EPA RCRA guidelines; no direct effluent neutralization required for computational decks.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Cleanroom Cleaning Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade C1 | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched tungsten plug (W-SNC) storage node contact surface post-CMP and Ar-sputter clean, verified particulate-free (< 0.05 particles/cm^2 @ 0.18 um).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pre-ALD / CVD high-k capacitor dielectric interface (Ta2O5 or Al2O3) passivated and stabilized without native oxide regrowth.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide (WOx / SiOx) formation at bottom electrode interface exceeding 0.8 nm thickness, resulting in uncontrolled contact resistance spikes (> 500 Ohm/plug) and unacceptable storage node leakage degrading C_s retention below 28 fF.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery and complete qualification of the comprehensive 180nm Custom DRAM Capacitor & Cell Array DRC Rule Deck supporting both KLayout and Calibre formats. The deck encapsulates all custom stacked crown/MIM layer operations, storage node contact pitches, plate electrode enclosures, array-to-periphery design boundaries, and parasitic coupling exclusion checks for 8F^2 folded bitline cells.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_cell_array_rules.lydrc`
- [ ] `dram_capacitor_drc_signoff_report.pdf`
- [ ] `synthetic_drc_regression_matrix.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage Node Crown Bottom Electrode Width and Spacing Constraint Validation** | `Width: 220 nm, Minimum Space: 160 nm` | +/- 2.0 nm | Automated DRC deck geometric extraction against calibrated 180nm GDSII test layout |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Storage Node Contact (SNC) to Active Area Enclosure Margin** | `40.0 nm` | >= 38.0 nm lower bound | Hierarchical boolean edge enclosure analysis in DRC regression test harness |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Capacitor Plate Electrode (TOP_PLATE) Minimum Enclosure over High-k Dielectric** | `60.0 nm` | +/- 5.0 nm | Dual-layer outer edge margin verification in Calibre nmDRC / KLayout DRC |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% zero-violation DRC clean run across the full-chip 512-kbit DRAM MPW tapeout GDSII macro, 100% pass on synthetic defect injection test suite, and unanimous sign-off verification approval by Metrology Council and Lead Tapeout Architect.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): DRAM Capacitor Layer Stack & Array Design Rule Specification Definition

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > GDSII Tapeout Physical Verification, Density Fill & Commercial MPW Pre-Tapeout Sign-Off [Metrology] > Full-Chip Hierarchical DRC & Custom DRAM Capacitor Rule Deck Sign-Off [Metrology] > Custom DRAM Capacitor & Cell Array DRC Rule Deck Authoring [Metrology] > DRAM Capacitor Layer Stack & Array Design Rule Specification Definition [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-1-1-1-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-1-1-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of DRAM Capacitor Layer Stack & Array Design Rule Specification Definition: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SPICE_transient_simulation_deck.sp`
- [ ] `Keysight_B1500A_retention_margin_plot.csv`
- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of bitcell test structures pass 64ms retention test without refresh decay; zero soft-error read inversions across 10,000 consecutive read cycles at nominal VDD (1.80V).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Custom COB MIM Capacitor & Cell Array DRC Script Coding and Rule Synthesis

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > GDSII Tapeout Physical Verification, Density Fill & Commercial MPW Pre-Tapeout Sign-Off [Metrology] > Full-Chip Hierarchical DRC & Custom DRAM Capacitor Rule Deck Sign-Off [Metrology] > Custom DRAM Capacitor & Cell Array DRC Rule Deck Authoring [Metrology] > Custom COB MIM Capacitor & Cell Array DRC Script Coding and Rule Synthesis [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical DRC execution for dense 8F^2 / 6F^2 COB MIM capacitor arrays must not flatten array instances into top-level polygons, which causes exponential polygon-edge explosion and run-time timeouts in standard open-source verification engines (KLayout / Magic / Pegasus). Rule deck compilation must strictly define hierarchical cell-level containment and boundary edge checking to keep physical verification wall-clock time under 45 minutes for a 1Mb array while rigorously validating bottom-plate to bitline contact clearance.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node with a crown or cylinder MIM capacitor erected over bitline via W-plugs, the rule deck must enforce asymmetric enclosures: minimum storage node bottom electrode (TiN) enclosure of the plug contact (SN_CON) of >= 40 nm, inter-capacitor minimum space of >= 160 nm to avoid ALD precursor shadowing/bridging, and strict maximum aspect-ratio DRC constraints (aspect ratio <= 6:1) to prevent physical crown pattern collapse during wet release/clean steps prior to Ta2O5/Al2O3 deposition.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW tapeouts (e.g., TSMC 0.18um, GlobalFoundries 180nm, or IHP SG13G2/open-foundry analog variants) use proprietary DRC layer mapping tables and reserved layer numbers (GDS data types) for custom MIM capacitors. If the rule synthesis deck maps custom COB capacitor layers onto conflicting standard mask layers without foundry MPW technical representative pre-approval, the mask shop will reject the reticle job or cause unresolvable tapeout grid fracturing violations.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rule deck authoring must freeze within sprint milestone T-14 prior to MPW tapeout cutoff to permit 3 iterative full-chip clean runs alongside digital periphery standard cells. The verification team must establish automated regression scripts that continuously ingest layout updates, verify zero false positives on dense 512x512 array tiles, and ensure complete waiver documentation for known non-fatal boundary dummy capacitor structures.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inter-capacitor bridging due to under-enforcing minimum MIM bottom electrode space (< 150 nm) during DRC rule synthesis, leading to lithographic necking and catastrophic cell-to-cell shorting across adjacent bitlines.
1. False clean DRC sign-off on bottom-plate W-plug misalignment: if overlay tolerance rules omit edge-to-edge enclosure (minimum 35 nm), CMP dishing or misalignment causes dielectric punch-through and extreme sub-threshold junction leakage (> 100 fA/cell), violating the 1 fA/cell retention limit.
1. Memory exhaust and engine segmentation fault in open-source DRC tools caused by polygon fracturing of non-orthogonal array boundaries and dense repeating crown contact arrays without hierarchical array-referencing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-1-1-2-01` | **Hierarchical MIM Bottom Electrode Enclosure and Spacing DRC Rule Verification** | KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) in 64-bit batch CLI mode with multi-threading (-zz -rd), Calibre-compatible GDSII Golden Test Matrix containing intentional graduated spacing/enclosure violations (from -50 nm to +100 nm off nominal in 10 nm increments). | 1. Execute batch DRC verification: 'klayout -b -r cob_mim_rules.drc -rd input_gds=dram_cob_mim_test_matrix.gds -rd report_file=mim_drc_report.lyrdb'. 2. Parse the output XML/Lyrdb database for rule checks: 'MIM_BTM_SPACE' (target >= 160 nm) and 'SN_CON_ENCLOSURE' (target >= 40 nm). 3. Cross-reference flagged violation coordinates against known intentional error injection coordinates in the test matrix. 4. Measure CPU execution wall-time and peak memory consumption across hierarchical array instantiations (16x16, 64x64, and 512x512 cell blocks). | `100% detection rate (zero false negatives) on all intentional spacing violations (< 160 nm) and enclosure violations (< 40 nm); exactly 0 false positives flagged on compliant array structures; execution time for 512x512 dense array block under 300 seconds with peak RSS RAM < 4.0 GB.` |
| `TC-GEN3-TAPEOUT-ROOT-3-1-1-2-02` | **Folded Bitline Cell Array Aspect Ratio and Top Plate Continuity Verification** | Automated DRC Rule Syntax Validator & Geometry Engine, Optical Review/Layout Netlist Cross-Checker, Defect Review Inspection Database Parser. | 1. Execute the full array DRC synthesis deck targeting: 'MIM_TOP_COVERAGE' (full overlap of all bottom plates with >= 60 nm outer boundary extension), 'CROWN_ASPECT_RATIO_MAX' (height/diameter ratio <= 6.0), and 'WELL_TAP_PROXIMITY_TO_CELL'. 2. Run soft-check connectivity rules to ensure top plate layer is continuous without uncontacted islands across 1024x1024 cells. 3. Log all warning markers and error coordinate lists to 'full_array_drc_audit.csv'. | `Total DRC errors on nominal compliant 1Mb array equals exactly 0; Top plate island/continuity check flags zero un-connected nodes; Boundary dummy cell transition checks flag zero edge spacing errors.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile gloves (double gloving for chemical handling), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles, Anti-static dissipative cleanroom lab coat, Closed-toe ESD protective footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF/BOE exposure: Immediately flush skin with copious amounts of water for 2-3 minutes, then vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected area until medical personnel arrive. Seek emergency medical attention immediately. For solvent inhalation/eye contact: Flush eyes with emergency eyewash for 15 minutes and remove victim to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench dedicated fume hoods with minimum face velocity of 100 fpm (0.51 m/s), integrated continuous acid exhaust scrubber system and dedicated solvent exhaust ducts with real-time VOC/toxic gas monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluorinated acid waste into dedicated fluoropolymer containers; neutralize via automated chemical treatment with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) to precipitate Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) before effluent discharge. Organic solvents collected into dedicated non-halogenated waste carboys for commercial incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Semiconductor Grade (MOS) | `99.5%` |
| **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade | `6.8% HF / 34.6% NH4F in aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-MIM post-CMP tungsten plug (W-plug) planarized array surface: clean, particle-free (< 0.05 particles/cm2 at >= 0.18 um), with W-recess/dishing < 10 nm and native oxide removed via dilute HF pre-clean.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned and dry-etched TiN bottom electrode crowns: residue-free sidewalls, completely dried without watermarks or micro-collapses, prepared for high-k dielectric (Ta2O5/Al2O3) atomic layer deposition (ALD).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure to ambient cleanroom air beyond 30 minutes induces native tungsten oxide formation (WOx) and micro-corrosion galvanic couples at the TiN/W interface, increasing contact resistance by > 300% and causing bottom-electrode peeling or catastrophic leakage.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Synthesized, fully validated hierarchical DRC rule deck script for 180nm custom COB MIM capacitor and folded-bitline DRAM cell array, supporting both KLayout and Calibre physical verification engines, demonstrating zero DRC violations on golden cell array and 100% detection on fault-injected matrices.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_cob_mim_hierarchical.drc`
- [ ] `drc_synthesis_verification_matrix_report.csv`
- [ ] `cob_mim_cell_array_signoff_certificate.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **MIM bottom electrode to adjacent bottom electrode minimum clearance rule enforcement** | `160.0 nm` | +/- 0.0 nm (strict physical cutoff) | Automated polygon boolean spacing check across 512x512 cell array layout with edge-to-edge dimension extraction. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Storage node W-plug contact enclosure by TiN bottom electrode plate** | `40.0 nm` | +/- 0.0 nm (minimum bounding box margin) | Hierarchical enclosure geometry check (MIM_BTM_PLATE enclosing SN_CON) reporting exact minimum distance metrics in DRC lyrdb database. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Full 1Mb dense array hierarchical DRC execution wall-clock time on standard 16-core workstation** | `180 seconds` | <= 300 seconds maximum | Continuous Integration benchmark run measuring elapsed CPU/wall time in KLayout batch mode with report log timestamp verification. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Rule deck achieves 100% fault-injection capture rate across all graduated test coupons, produces zero errors and zero warnings on the sign-off golden 1Mb 8F^2 cell array layout, and receives formal verification sign-off from both the Lead Metrology Engineer and Tapeout Lead.
