### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe cleanroom lab coat (anti-static conductive fiber), Powder-free nitrile gloves (ASTM D6319), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses for cleanroom wafer-inspection workstation usage
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA cleaner: flush immediately with copious cleanroom deionized water for 15 minutes. For inhalation of concentrated IPA vapors: remove victim to fresh uncontaminated air. In case of localized asphyxiation hazard from N2 purge line leaks: evacuate area, ensure forced ventilation, and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard computational office / cleanroom data terminal environment with certified HVAC delivering >= 15 air changes per hour (ACH); dedicated local exhaust canopy over chemical cleaning stations for manual optical reticle/wafer inspection stages.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used cleanroom IPA wipes and contaminated nitrile gloves must be segregated into designated flammable solid hazardous waste receptacles with self-closing lids, stored in explosion-proof cabinet, and collected by a licensed hazardous waste disposal contractor per EPA RCRA rules.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Multi-Project Wafer Shuttle GDSII Tapeout Package & Foundry Sign-Off

Final stream-out of OASIS/GDSII database, metal dummy fill insertion, seal ring boundary integration, and foundry technical question (TQ) resolution.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |
| **Ozone (O3)** | `10028-15-6` | Generated in-situ from UHP O2 | `15-20 wt% in O2 carrier gas (Strong Oxidizer)` |
| **Silica / Ceria CMP Slurry** | `1344-28-1` | Semiconductor Colloidal CMP grade | `15-30 wt% colloidal abrasive slurry` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `20.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `2.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched 3D crown capacitor trench structure post-DHF strip, completely free of native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Uniform ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 high-k dielectric stack with TiN top electrode encapsulation.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Top-Level DRAM Core & Periphery GDSII Stream-Out and Seal Ring Integration

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Top-level stream-out must strictly synchronize the layer translation mapping between the 180nm custom DRAM stack (incorporating crown capacitor storage nodes, cell plates, and high-voltage wordline pump wells) and standard foundry 180nm CMOS baseline rules. Integrating the chip seal ring requires continuous, uninterrupted stress-relief slotted metal tracks (Metal 1 through Top Metal) tied to substrate guard rings to isolate sensitive open-bitline differential sense amplifiers from dicing-induced mechanical shear stresses, micro-cracks, and package-induced thermomechanical warping.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node (F = 180nm, 8F^2 or 6F^2 folded bitline topology), the peripheral CMOS-to-core boundary exhibits severe topographical and optical proximity disparities. Transitioning from dense periodic 360nm-400nm pitch array poly/metal lines to sparse peripheral standard cells causes critical lithographic diffraction and chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) dishing. The seal ring perimeter must maintain strict distance (>15 um) from the array edge and include dummy metal fill tiles conforming to 20-80% density rules to prevent dielectric erosion and edge-die retention degradation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: MPW shuttle tapeout slots at 180nm pure-play silicon foundries enforce rigid electronic design data submission deadlines and automated pre-tapeout QA pipelines. Any discrepancy in the GDSII boundary coordinates, missing seal-ring corner 45-degree chamfers, or unapproved layer designations will result in instant shuttle rejection, causing an irreversible 3-to-4 month shuttle delay and full forfeiture of the non-recurring engineering (NRE) MPW fee.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off risk is concentrated at the final interface between layout-versus-schematic (LVS) blackbox pins and physical stream-out stream layers. The schedule requires a frozen top-level netlist 72 hours prior to GDSII stream-out to execute final flat design-rule checking (DRC), dummy metal insertion, and seal-ring electrical grounding checks without introducing unverified manual edits into the final tapeout archive.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Seal ring discontinuity or crack propagation into the active array caused by missing dicing channel stress-relief slots or insufficient substrate guard-ring tie-downs, leading to moisture ingress and rapid loss of >64 ms retention.
1. Global metal CMP erosion or dielectric peeling along the periphery-to-array transition due to non-uniform dummy fill density, causing shorted bitline contacts or high-resistance power distribution networks.
1. GDSII layer map mismatch between custom DRAM cell capacitor layers (e.g., SN contact, dielectric ONO/Ta2O5, top plate) and foundry standard MPW stream layers, resulting in unexposed or shorted storage capacitors.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-01` | **Hierarchical Top-Level DRC and Seal Ring Continuity Sign-Off Verification** | Calibre nmDRC / KLayout Physical Verification Engine with Foundry 180nm DRC Rule Deck (Rev 2.4+) | 1. Ingest top_dram_core_periphery.gds and assign foundry layer map definitions. 2. Execute full-chip Design Rule Check (DRC) targeting width, spacing, enclosure, and area rules on all active, poly, via, and metal layers (M1 to Top Metal). 3. Run dedicated Seal-Ring Integrity Rule Deck verifying minimum seal-ring width (>= 12.0 um), corner bevel chamfers (45 degrees), and guard-ring contact density. 4. Execute pattern density analysis across a 50 um x 50 um sliding window across the core-to-periphery boundary. 5. Output full violation log and database summary. | `Total fatal DRC violations = 0; Seal ring continuity = 100% (zero perimeter breaks or unclosed loops); Metal density across all 50 um x 50 um windows strictly between 25.0% and 75.0%.` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-02` | **Full-Chip LVS and Substrate Guard-Ring Ground Isolation Verification** | Calibre nmLVS / Synopsys IC Validator with 180nm Mixed-Signal DRAM Rule Deck | 1. Extract device connectivity and parasitic port pins from top_dram_core_periphery.gds. 2. Cross-reference pin labels, substrate taps, well rings, and power domains (VDD_CORE = 1.8V, VPP_PUMP = 3.3V, VBB_SUB = -0.8V, VSS = 0V). 3. Verify continuous low-impedance connection of outer seal-ring substrate taps to designated dedicated clean ground (VSS_SEAL/VSS_SUB). 4. Perform electrical rule check (ERC) for floating wells, latch-up rule spacing, and ungrounded diffusion regions along the die periphery. 5. Compare extracted netlist against golden schematic netlist. | `LVS comparison status = CORRECT (0 net mismatches, 0 device discrepancies); ERC violations = 0; Seal ring substrate tap continuity verified with DC loop resistance < 0.5 Ohm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 Cleanroom Bunny Suit, Nitrile Powder-Free Cleanroom Gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 Approved Chemical Splash Safety Goggles, ESD-Safe Grounding Wrist/Ankle Straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Move personnel immediately to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. Skin Contact: Flush affected dermis with copious flowing water for at least 15 minutes; remove contaminated cleanroom garments. Eye Contact: Flush open eyes with emergency eyewash for 15 minutes while retracting eyelids. Seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Maintain ISO Class 5 (Class 100) laminar airflow workstation with minimum 90 FPM face velocity; dedicated volatile organic compound (VOC) local scrubbed exhaust operational at tapeout review and physical validation terminal areas.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-soaked wipes and calibration swabs in designated airtight flammables disposal containers labeled per RCRA guidelines; vent solvent vapors through dedicated activated carbon bed scrubbers before ambient release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Cleanroom Substrate Degreaser)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Ultra-High Purity Purge Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 6.0 (99.9999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-dicing wafer surface or photomask reticle substrate inspected: organic residue < 0.1 particles/cm2 at >= 0.2 um, dry native passivation intact.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Completed GDSII stream-out physical database signed off and post-tapeout reticle blanks purged under dry UHP N2; moisture content < 5 ppmv.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air exposure causes airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and moisture condensation on reticle surfaces or unpassivated pad openings, causing corrosion of peripheral bond pads and optical defect anomalies during reticle inspection.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified, clean, tapeout-ready GDSII stream-out package for the 180nm DRAM core, peripheral control circuitry, bond-pad frame, and continuous seal ring, with zero DRC/LVS violations and full compliance with 180nm MPW shuttle guidelines.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `top_dram_core_periphery_signoff.gds`
- [ ] `drc_lvs_final_signoff_report.pdf`
- [ ] `density_and_sealring_validation.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total DRC and LVS fatal errors in final stream-out GDSII** | `0` | +0 | Automated Calibre nmDRC and nmLVS batch run against official 180nm Foundry PDK decks |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total Die Seal Ring Width around full die perimeter** | `15.0 um` | +/- 0.5 um | Calibre geometry measurement script cross-checking seal-ring outer-to-inner boundary edges |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dummy metal fill pattern density across core and periphery boundary** | `45.0%` | +/- 15.0% | Optical pattern density analysis engine with 50 um stepped window calculation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Complete sign-off requires 100% clean DRC and LVS reports with zero waivers on active array/seal-ring rules, verified GDSII checksum (MD5) matching the foundry portal manifest, and formal sign-off approval from both Domain Expert and Systems Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure: DRAM Core & Periphery Hierarchical GDSII Assembly and Layer Stream-Out

**Category**: Circuit Design | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical GDSII streaming from mixed analog-periphery and dense memory cell arrays often suffers from uninstantiated subcell transformations, grid rounding errors (snapping 1nm off-grid vertices onto the 5nm foundry manufacturing grid), and missing top-level dummy metal/poly fill layers. Without rigorous layer map table (LMT) validation linking Open-Source layout tools (e.g., KLayout/Magic) to the commercial 180nm MPW foundry layer/datatype conventions, custom cell pins such as wordline (WL) pass-gates and bitline (BL) sense amplifier interconnects risk mapping to unmasked floating layers, invalidating the entire tapeout shuttle submission.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, the 8F^2/6F^2 stacked capacitor (Crown/Cylinder COB) unit cell utilizes tight wordline/bitline pitches (360nm-400nm) and requires exact GDSII layer datatype mapping for the tungsten plug contacts (W-plug), bitline contacts, and MIM/crown storage nodes. Failure to enforce physical design rule compliance during stream-out—specifically capacitor contact overlap margins (>40nm) and boundary enclosure of cell-edge dummy capacitors to mitigate optical proximity effect (OPE) variations—will degrade storage cell capacitance below the critical 25-28 fF threshold and trigger catastrophic sub-threshold/junction leakage (>1 fA/cell at 85°C).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW shuttle aggregators enforce immutable tapeout submission deadlines with strict physical verification gates. Any discrepancy in GDSII stream-out layer naming, missing seal ring guard structures, or non-conformance to the fab's standard layer table (e.g., mismatch between standard GDSII layer numbers and foundry mask numbering) results in immediate shuttle rejection, forfeiting reserved die slots, incurring non-refundable shuttle slot penalties ($15,000-$30,000 USD), and causing a 3- to 6-month delay for the next multi-project wafer run.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Hierarchical assembly of periphery decoders, sense amplifiers, and the core array must lock its top-level floorplan dimensions and stream-out timeline at least 72 hours prior to the shuttle tapeout cutoff. Sign-off tracking requires automated Calibre/KLayout DRC/LVS zero-violation logs and checksum verification. Any ad-hoc manual layout patch at the top level without full flat LVS re-verification introduces unacceptable risk of tapeout slip and project milestone failure.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Layer map mismatch during GDSII stream-out causing Crown/MIM capacitor storage nodes or tungsten plugs to map to dummy/unexposed mask datatypes, resulting in completely unformed cell capacitors on manufactured silicon.
1. Off-grid vertex snapping during hierarchical cell merging, producing acute angle (<90°) lithographic pinch points and bridge/short defects across the 360nm-pitch bitline arrays.
1. Omission or improper grounding/isolation of the periphery-to-core seal ring guard rings, exposing the sensitive 1T1C storage nodes to scribe-line microcracking, moisture intrusion, and latch-up.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-1-01` | **Hierarchical GDSII Layer Mapping and Geometric Grid Snapping Verification** | Automated EDA Physical Verification Suite (Siemens Calibre DRC / KLayout CLI Engine) with 180nm Foundry Layer Map Table (LMT) parser and OASIS/GDSII Database Comparator. | 1. Execute stream-out consistency check by extracting all layer:datatype pairs present in the assembly GDSII against the foundry layer definition table. 2. Run automated off-grid detection scanning all vertices against the foundry 5nm manufacturing grid across both memory core and periphery blocks. 3. Execute top-level flat DRC rule checks targeting minimum spacing (S >= 180nm), minimum area, and acute angles (<90 deg) across Active (OD), Poly (PO), Contact (CO), Metal1-Metal3 (M1-M3), and Capacitor Node (SN/CAP) layers. 4. Generate structured DRC summary report. | `Zero missing or unmapped layer:datatype pairs; exactly 0 off-grid vertices (snapped to 5.0 nm manufacturing grid); zero acute angle violations; total fatal DRC errors = 0 across the entire die hierarchy.` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-1-02` | **Core-Periphery Hierarchical LVS and Boundary Contact Continuity Check** | Siemens Calibre nmLVS / KLayout Layout-vs-Schematic Engine, CDL netlist parser, and SPICE interconnect parameter extractor. | 1. Run hierarchical device recognition to identify 180nm core access transistors (L=180nm, W=220nm), stacked storage capacitors (target >=28 fF), and periphery 1.8V/3.3V transistors. 2. Extract parasitic interconnect nets and stitch peripheral decoder outputs to core wordlines and sense amplifiers to bitlines. 3. critics.systems_engineer: Hierarchical GDSII streaming from mixed analog-periphery and dense memory cell arrays often suffers from uninstantiated subcell transformations, grid rounding errors (snapping 1nm off-grid vertices onto the 5nm foundry manufacturing grid), and missing top-level dummy metal/poly fill layers. Without rigorous layer map table (LMT) validation linking Open-Source layout tools (e.g., KLayout/Magic) to the commercial 180nm MPW foundry layer/datatype conventions, custom cell pins such as wordline (WL) pass-gates and bitline (BL) sense amplifier interconnects risk mapping to unmasked floating layers, invalidating the entire tapeout shuttle submission.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm node, the 8F^2/6F^2 stacked capacitor (Crown/Cylinder COB) unit cell utilizes tight wordline/bitline pitches (360nm-400nm) and requires exact GDSII layer datatype mapping for the tungsten plug contacts (W-plug), bitline contacts, and MIM/crown storage nodes. Failure to enforce physical design rule compliance during stream-out—specifically capacitor contact overlap margins (>40nm) and boundary enclosure of cell-edge dummy capacitors to mitigate optical proximity effect (OPE) variations—will degrade storage cell capacitance below the critical 25-28 fF threshold and trigger catastrophic sub-threshold/junction leakage (>1 fA/cell at 85°C).
critics.supply_chain: Commercial MPW shuttle aggregators enforce immutable tapeout submission deadlines with strict physical verification gates. Any discrepancy in GDSII stream-out layer naming, missing seal ring guard structures, or non-conformance to the fab's standard layer table (e.g., mismatch between standard GDSII layer numbers and foundry mask numbering) results in immediate shuttle rejection, forfeiting reserved die slots, incurring non-refundable shuttle slot penalties ($15,000-$30,000 USD), and causing a 3- to 6-month delay for the next multi-project wafer run.
critics.laya_pm: Hierarchical assembly of periphery decoders, sense amplifiers, and the core array must lock its top-level floorplan dimensions and stream-out timeline at least 72 hours prior to the shuttle tapeout cutoff. Sign-off tracking requires automated Calibre/KLayout DRC/LVS zero-violation logs and checksum verification. Any ad-hoc manual layout patch at the top level without full flat LVS re-verification introduces unacceptable risk of tapeout slip and project milestone failure.
critical_failure_modes: Layer map mismatch during GDSII stream-out causing Crown/MIM capacitor storage nodes or tungsten plugs to map to dummy/unexposed mask datatypes, resulting in completely unformed cell capacitors on manufactured silicon.
Off-grid vertex snapping during hierarchical cell merging, producing acute angle (<90°) lithographic pinch points and bridge/short defects across the 360nm-pitch bitline arrays.
Omission or improper grounding/isolation of the periphery-to-core seal ring guard rings, exposing the sensitive 1T1C storage nodes to scribe-line microcracking, moisture intrusion, and latch-up.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Array Macro & Periphery Hierarchical Layout Placement & Global Pin Alignment

### Scope & Context
- **Foundry / Process Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) / Gen 3.
- **Hierarchy Level**: Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) Shuttle GDSII Tapeout Package & Foundry Sign-Off $\rightarrow$ Top-Level DRAM Core & Periphery GDSII Stream-Out and Seal Ring Integration $\rightarrow$ DRAM Core & Periphery Hierarchical GDSII Assembly and Layer Stream-Out $\rightarrow$ **Array Macro & Periphery Hierarchical Layout Placement & Global Pin Alignment**.
- **Action Type**: `Make`

---

### Process Execution Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 1: Floorplan &   │
│    Macro Placement     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 2: Pitch & Pin   │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 3: Power Grid &  │
│    Shield Strapping    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 4: DRC/LVS &    │
│  Parasitic Extraction  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Step 1: Array Macro Instantiation & Relative Periphery Floorplanning**
   - Instantiate the dense memory array sub-blocks based on 1T1C unit cell dimensions: folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\ \text{nm}$) or open bitline $6F^2$ footprint ($0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
   - Ensure the internal cell layout preserves the access transistor channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, with shared bitline contacts between adjacent cells.
   - Floorplan periphery macros abutted to the array:
     - **Sense Amplifier (SA) Strip**: Direct pitch-matched interface to the bitline columns (256 or 512 cells per bitline).
     - **Sub-Wordline Driver (SWD) / Row Decoder**: Direct interface to array wordline rows.

2. **Step 2: Boundary Grid Pitch Snapping & Global Pin Alignment**
   - Align all boundary routing pins for Bitlines (BL / $\overline{\text{BL}}$) and Wordlines (WL) strictly to an on-grid interconnect pitch of **$360\ \text{nm}$ to $400\ \text{nm}$**.
   - Align tungsten plug (W-plug) contact vias and capacitor-over-bitline (COB) stacked capacitor landing pads directly over drain nodes without offsetting boundary coordinates.
   - Verify zero-jog straight-line interface between array boundary bitlines and peripheral sense amplifier input ports to avoid asymmetric parasitic coupling.

3. **Step 3: Global Interconnect & Power Strapping**
   - Route global column/row select lines and array power meshes ($V_{\text{DD}}$, $V_{\text{SS}}$, $V_{\text{BLP}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$) across periphery channels.
   - Maintain uniform dielectric spacing (matching equivalent oxide thickness criteria of EOT $3\ \text{nm}$ to $4\ \text{nm}$ for cell capacitors, gate oxide physical thickness $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$) to suppress inter-metal coupling.

4. **Step 4: Hierarchical Boundary Verification & Sign-Off Extraction**
   - Run hierarchical Design Rule Checking (DRC) and Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) across the array-to-periphery boundary.
   - Perform boundary parasitic extraction (PEX) on the integrated bitlines to verify that the total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) does not violate the target budget.

---

### Parameter Budget & Acceptance Metrics

```text
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │██████                             │
  BL Pitch (/10 nm)┤██████                             │
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
C_b/C_s Ratio (*10)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                      │
       C_b Max (fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
       C_s Nom (fF)┤░░░░░                              │
                   │░░░░░                              │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0     62.5    125.0    187.5 250.0 
```

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

1. **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)**:
   - **Target Metric**: $\mathbf{25\ \text{fF}\ \text{to}\ 30\ \text{fF}}$ per cell (Nominal: $\mathbf{28\ \text{fF}}$).
2. **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)**:
   - **Target Metric**: $\mathbf{150\ \text{fF}\ \text{to}\ 250\ \text{fF}}$ per bitline (for 256 or 512 cells per bitline).
3. **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)**:
   - **Target Metric**: $\mathbf{5:1\ \text{to}\ 9:1}$ (Strict limit: must **not exceed $10:1$**).
4. **Boundary Interconnect Pitch (Bitline & Wordline)**:
   - **Target Metric**: $\mathbf{360\ \text{nm}\ \text{to}\ 400\ \text{nm}}$ pitch with $0\ \text{nm}$ grid alignment offset.
5. **Cell Sub-Threshold & Junction Leakage**:
   - **Target Metric**: $<\mathbf{1\ \text{fA/cell}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (ensuring data retention time $>\mathbf{64\ \text{ms}}$).

---

### Verified Local Literature Citations
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Transistor $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$; $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ layouts; $C_s \ge 28\ \text{fF}$; leakage $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source 2**: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets* (Footprints: $6F^2 = 0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$; $C_s = 25\ \text{fF}\ \text{to}\ 30\ \text{fF}$; $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}\ \text{to}\ 250\ \text{fF}$ for 256/512 cells/BL; $C_b / C_s$ ratio between $5:1$ and $9:1$, threshold $< 10:1$).
- **Source 3**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Retention $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; EOT $3\ \text{to}\ 4\ \text{nm}$; BL/WL pitch $360\ \text{nm}\ \text{to}\ 400\ \text{nm}$; gate oxide physical thickness $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$).

---

*Captured into micro-knowledge base:* [sop_array_macro_periphery_layout_placement.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_array_macro_periphery_layout_placement.md)

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical layout placement of the dense DRAM array macro alongside peripheral standard-cell logic creates severe boundary impedance and RC discontinuities. If macro halo margins and routing pitch grids between the custom array pitch (sub-micron bitline/wordline contacts) and peripheral standard cells (180nm fixed routing tracks on M1/M2/M3) are not integer-aligned, OpenROAD global routing will suffer track blockage, antenna rule violations, and excessive via stacking at the array-periphery boundary.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline drivers, bitline sense amplifiers, and precharge equalization circuits sit right at the periphery-to-array transition. Pitch matching between the analog DRAM bitline sense-amp pitch and the digital periphery column decoders must maintain perfect collinear pin alignment on Metal 2 and Metal 3; even a 5nm off-grid layout snap causes lithographic bridging or necking under 180nm optical proximity correction (OPC) rules during reticle manufacturing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW shuttle runs enforce rigid tapeout deadlines and automated foundry DRC sign-off decks. Any hierarchical GDSII stream-out with unplaced macros, unresolved off-grid pin alignment errors, or unmerged layer numbers will trigger hard foundry reject flags, risking shuttle slot forfeiture and substantial re-spin penalties.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Floorplanning milestones require definitive sign-off on macro bounding box coordinates, power ring widths, and global pin coordinate manifests before releasing the top-level block to final automated clock tree synthesis and parasitic extraction. Failure to lock macro pin locations early propagates layout churn across both digital control logic and analog sensing work packages.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sub-grid pin placement causing fatal lithography short/open DRC violations at macro interface boundaries during foundry sign-off
1. Bitline/Wordline sense-amplifier pitch misalignment causing parasitic cross-coupling capacitance (C_c > 20% of bitline capacitance) and degraded sensing margin
1. Power Distribution Network (PDN) strap discontinuity across the periphery-to-array boundary resulting in unacceptable IR drop (> 50 mV) during burst read/write operations

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-1-1-01` | **Hierarchical Macro Boundary DRC & Global Pin Grid Collinearity Verification** | KLayout Batch Mode (v0.28+) with 180nm DRC Deck, OpenROAD CLI pin-density & grid audit scripts | 1. Execute OpenROAD pin report script 'report_pin_placement -hierarchical' to extract (X, Y) coordinates and layer IDs of all interface pins. 2. Stream out full flat and hierarchical GDSII using 'write_gds'. 3. Execute KLayout DRC sign-off rule deck against the streamed GDSII checking layer spacings, boundary overlap (Halo >= 5.0 um), and pin on-grid compliance (grid = 5 nm). 4. Run geometrical collinearity script comparing peripheral driver output pin coordinates against DRAM macro input pad coordinates across M1, M2, and M3. | `Zero KLayout DRC errors across all metal layers (M1-M5); 100% of macro interface pins aligned to manufacturing track pitch with 0.000 um grid offset; minimum macro-to-periphery halo spacing >= 5.000 um.` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-1-1-02` | **Boundary Power Grid Continuity & Dynamic IR Drop Sign-Off** | OpenROAD OpenRCX parasitic extractor, TritonRoute/PDN analyzer, and SPICE transient solver (Ngspice / Xyce) | 1. Extract parasitic RC network of the top-level power mesh and array macro boundary straps using OpenRCX. 2. Apply worst-case concurrent switching vector simulating 64-bit array sensing and peripheral buffer activation (peak transient current = 45 mA). 3. Execute transient nodal voltage analysis over a 50 ns window. 4. Measure dynamic IR drop at the innermost sense-amp power taps relative to the external pad ring. | `Peak dynamic IR drop at all array macro interface power pins must not exceed 54 mV (<= 3.0% of nominal 1.8V VDD); zero dangling power mesh nodes or discontinuous strap violations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard anti-static wrist strap / ESD-safe coat for compute server hardware maintenance, Ergonomic display safety eyewear compliant with ANSI Z87.1
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For chemical splash during server cleaning: Flush eyes or skin immediately with clean water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move person to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard climate-controlled CAD compute room ventilation maintaining 6-8 air changes per hour (ACH) and relative humidity between 40% and 55% to prevent ESD events.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked lint-free cleanroom wipes in sealed, flammables-rated hazardous waste bins compliant with local environmental health and safety regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (Electronics Cleaning Solvent for Server/Workstation Maintenance)** | `67-63-0` | Technical Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Digital GDSII/OASIS design database verified and checked into Git repository with clean git commit SHA.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Integrated top-level GDSII stream-out ready for final dummy metal fill insertion and tapeout sign-off.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Not applicable to purely computational EDA layout stage; version control timeout risk managed by strict configuration freeze prior to MPW shuttle tapeout cutoff.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete hierarchical layout placement of the DRAM array macro and surrounding periphery logic with 100% DRC-clean global pin alignment, verified power distribution continuity, and validated GDSII stream-out for 180nm MPW tapeout packaging.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `top_dram_core_periphery_placed.gds`
- [ ] `pin_alignment_and_grid_audit_report.csv`
- [ ] `macro_boundary_klayout_drc_signoff.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Interface pin grid offset between array macro pins and peripheral standard-cell routing tracks** | `0.000 um` | +/- 0.000 um (zero off-grid snap) | Automated geometry parsing script against KLayout layout database and OpenROAD pin report |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Macro-to-standard-cell halo clearance around array boundary** | `5.000 um` | +/- 0.050 um | KLayout DRC automated dimensional check rule (Halo_Clearance_Check) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum dynamic IR drop across array interface power straps during simultaneous read burst** | `38.5 mV` | <= 54.0 mV (<= 3.0% of 1.8V VDD) | OpenRCX extraction followed by SPICE transient nodal simulation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC/LVS violations reported by KLayout 180nm decks, complete pin alignment across all array-periphery interfaces with zero unrouted or off-grid nets, and signed approval from both systems_engineer and domain_expert on final streamed GDSII.

Any hierarchical GDSII stream-out with unplaced macros, unresolved off-grid pin alignment errors, or unmerged layer numbers will trigger hard foundry reject flags, risking shuttle slot forfeiture and substantial re-spin penalties.
critics.laya_pm: Floorplanning milestones require definitive sign-off on macro bounding box coordinates, power ring widths, and global pin coordinate manifests before releasing the top-level block to final automated clock tree synthesis and parasitic extraction. Failure to lock macro pin locations early propagates layout churn across both digital control logic and analog sensing work packages.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Top-Level Power Grid Stitching, Custom DRAM Layer Boolean Mask Operations & Stream-Out
**Project**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm) | **Action Type**: Make  
**Target Architecture**: 1T1C Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB), $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ Topology  
**Documentation Record**: [`docs/knowledge/sop_top_level_power_grid_boolean_streamout.md`](./docs/knowledge/sop_top_level_power_grid_boolean_streamout.md)

---

### Process Execution Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Hierarchical Block   │
│    Assembly: Core +    │
│       Periphery        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Top-Level Power Grid  │
│  Stitching: VDD, VPP,  │
│       VBLP, GND        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Custom DRAM Layer    │
│  Boolean Operations:   │
│    SN-CUP, PLT, VIA    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Sign-Off DRC/LVS &   │
│    Dummy Metal Fill    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   GDSII Stream-Out &   │
│        Checksum        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Top-Level Hierarchical Instantiation & Placement Alignment
1. Instantiate the physical macros for the sub-blocks in the chip-level floorplan:
   - DRAM Core Mat array (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, unit cell pitch along bitline and wordline: $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$).
   - Regenerative cross-coupled Sense Amplifier (SA) stripe blocks (interfacing bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$).
   - Decoders, wordline pump drivers, and equalization logic.
2. Align bitline columns to sense amplifier pitch without orthogonal grid off-pitch stepping.

#### Step 2: Multi-Domain Power Grid Routing & Stitching
1. Stitch top-level power mesh rails on Upper Metal (Metal 4 / Metal 5) across core and periphery boundary pins:
   - **$V_{PP}$ Overdrive Mesh**: Connect high-voltage boosted lines ($2.6\text{ V}\text{ to }2.8\text{ V}$) directly to wordline driver output stages for access transistor gate overdrive ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$).
   - **$V_{BLP}$ Precharge Supply**: Route precision reference mesh tied to $V_{DD} / 2$ to equalization switches and cross-coupled sense amplifier common source references ($\text{SAN} / \text{SAP}$).
   - **$V_{DD}$ & $\text{GND}$ Power Mesh**: Interconnect digital core logic ($V_{DD}$ nominal) and substrate tap tie-downs.
2. Place via matrices at every metal-layer crossing point between core rails and peripheral power rings to minimize dynamic IR drop during sense amp activation ($\text{SAN}$ pulldown followed by $\text{SAP}$ pullup at $1\text{ to }2\text{ ns}$ delay).

#### Step 3: Custom DRAM Layer Boolean Mask Synthesis
Apply boolean layer operations via the layout engine (e.g., KLayout / Calibre rule deck) to generate the custom DRAM stacked capacitor mask set:
1. **Storage Node Contact (`SNC`)**:
   $$\text{Layer\_SNC} = (\text{Contact\_Active} \text{ AND } \text{Core\_Region}) \text{ NOT } \text{Bitline\_Contact}$$
   Generate tungsten plug (W-plug) contact definitions connecting the drain of the access transistor ($W = 220\text{ nm}$) to the bottom plate.
2. **Capacitor Crown/Cylinder Cavity (`CAP_CUP`)**:
   $$\text{Layer\_CUP} = \text{SNC\_Pad} \text{ ENCLOSURE } \ge 30\text{ nm}$$
   Synthesize the 3D crown/cylinder capacitor opening layer across the cell field to receive high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, or $\text{ONO}$ with effective $\kappa > 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$).
3. **Common Plate Electrode (`PLT`)**:
   $$\text{Layer\_PLT} = \text{Core\_Array\_Active\_Envelope} \text{ GROW } 500\text{ nm}$$
   Define the continuous top plate electrode covering the memory array, biased at $V_{DD}/2$.

#### Step 4: Full-Chip Sign-Off DRC, LVS, & Antenna Checks
1. Run Design Rule Check (DRC) validating bitline/wordline line-to-space design rules ($360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$ pitch) and minimum gate length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
2. Perform Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) extracting:
   - 1T1C storage capacitor nodes ($C_{cell} \ge 25\text{ fF}$).
   - Gate oxide physical dielectric properties ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxidation $\text{SiO}_2$).
3. Insert dummy metal fill patterns on periphery metal levels excluding the sensitive crown capacitor array envelope.

#### Step 5: GDSII Stream-Out & Integrity Check
1. Export hierarchical GDSII database:
   - Units: User unit = `1.0 um`, Database unit = `0.001 um` ($1\text{ nm}$ resolution).
   - Set output layer map matching foundry MPW stream-in specifications.
2. Calculate and record MD5 / SHA-256 checksum of the generated `.gds` file.

---

| 1 | **Unit Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_{cell}$)** | $\ge 28$ (acceptable range: $25\text{ to }30$) | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout extraction (PEX) / LVS |
| 2 | **Data Retention Time (@ 85°C, leakage $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$)** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Circuit simulation / Dynamic charge decay sign-off |
| 3 | **Boosted Wordline Overdrive Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.6\text{ to }2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Top-level power grid static/dynamic IR drop analysis |
| 4 | **Capacitor High-$\kappa$ Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | $3\text{ to }4$ | $\text{nm}$ | Process cross-section specification / DRC Layer Rule Verification |

---

### Citations & Literature Traceability
1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Transistor geometries: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with W-plug drain contact.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ / $\text{ONO}$ ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Cell capacitance minimum: $28\text{ fF}$ (noise & alpha-particle soft-error immunity), sub-threshold/junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Source: Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**
   - Equalization reference: $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Wordline boost overdrive: $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V}\text{ to }2.8\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$).
   - Sequential sensing activation: $\text{SAN}$ pull-down followed by $\text{SAP}$ pull-up with $1\text{ to }2\text{ ns}$ delay.
3. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - 1T1C $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ layout with retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$).
   - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$).
   - Access gate thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{–}900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Top-level power grid stitching across the core DRAM macro and peripheral standard cell logic must balance strict IR drop targets against electro-migration (EM) limits. The core macro operates with multiple discrete supply rails (VDD=1.8V, VPP=2.8V boosted wordline rail, VBB=-0.5V substrate bias, and VARY=1.2V core array supply), while periphery digital logic shares a standard 1.8V/3.3V supply. Custom Boolean layer derivation (e.g., generating deep N-well isolation, high-voltage wordline gate oxide masks, and stacked capacitor bottom/top electrode blockouts) introduces extreme risk of unintended pinholes or parasitic latchup guard ring breaks if boolean sizing or layer polarity logic in the GDSII stream-out decks (KLayout/Calibre) diverges from the foundry's 180nm mixed-signal/embedded DRAM DRC manual.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Custom DRAM layer Boolean operations are sensitive to grid snapping and acute-angle generation. Generating the Crown/MIM capacitor plate masks (ONO/Ta2O5-Al2O3 dielectric window, storage node contact SN_CONT, and bottom electrode BE_POLY) requires exact logical AND/NOT operations against active diffusion (OD) and wordline poly (PO) to avoid unlanded tungsten plugs. Furthermore, running boolean union across power grid stripes on Metal 4/Metal 5 without explicit via-overlap enclosure checks will trigger catastrophic via starvation or floating strap segments along the memory core boundary, compromising VPP regulation during burst activate cycles.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW shuttles enforce strict tapeout freeze windows and automated mask data preparation (MDP) rule checks. Non-standard custom layers generated for academic/open-source DRAM processing (such as custom capacitor mask layers beyond the standard 1P5M or 1P6M baseline) require pre-negotiated foundry layer-map agreements (GDS layer numbers and data types). Failure to validate foundry-assigned stream-out layer maps before GDSII delivery results in immediate shuttle rejection, loss of the non-refundable MPW tapeout slot, and minimum 4-month tapeout delays.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The stream-out schedule must account for DRC/LVS turnaround times, seal-ring assembly, and dummy metal fill insertion. Any iterative patch on boolean mask scripts after hierarchical stream-out risks desynchronizing schematic-versus-layout netlists. Power grid stitching sign-off and layer stream-out must freeze 72 hours prior to the shuttle cutoff date to allow full-chip clean Calibre/Pegasus DRC/LVS, density gradient signoff, and optical proximity correction (OPC) verification.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Boolean mask inversion or layer-type desynchronization in stream-out deck leading to missing deep N-well (DNW) isolation under the negative substrate bias (VBB) pump and VPP drivers, causing forward-biased p-n junctions and full chip latchup upon power-on.
1. Via starvation and insufficient metal enclosure at periphery-to-core power strap boundary stitches, inducing excessive static/dynamic IR drop (>150 mV on VPP/VARY) and causing wordline under-boost and data retention failure.
1. Off-grid vertex snapping and non-manhattan polygon artifacts created during custom layer Boolean NOT operations, causing fatal mask fracture errors during foundry e-beam lithography data preparation.

Execute DRC deck containing custom Boolean derivations: Crown Cap Open = (CAP_BLOCK AND OD) NOT PO; Deep N-Well = DNW_IN OR (VBB_WELL_ENCLOSURE SIZEOK 2.5um). 2. Run GDSII layout XOR comparison against pre-boolean structural boundaries to verify no unauthorized layer deletions or bounding box shifts. 4. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (certified Class 100 / ISO 5), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Static-dissipative ESD lab coat and ESD heel grounders, Acid-resistant neoprene gloves (during wet bench reticle inspection cleaning)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with Piranha mixture, flush immediately with copious cold water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE; seek immediate medical attention. In case of eye contact, rinse eyes at dedicated emergency eye wash station for minimum 20 minutes holding eyelids open. For inhalation of acid vapors, immediately relocate exposed personnel to fresh air and administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical mask preparation and cleaning hoods must maintain minimum face velocity of 100 LFPM (linear feet per minute) with continuous negative pressure; exhaust must route directly to an automated packed-bed acid scrubber system.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent Piranha solutions must be allowed to cool and fully outgas self-generated exothermic oxygen in vented containment vessels before slow neutralization with 10% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) to pH 6.5-8.5; spent solvents (IPA) collected in dedicated segregated flammables drums for hazardous solvent incineration.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Piranha-cleaned, DI-water rinsed, and dry N2 spun photolithographic reticle substrate / wafer with native oxide thickness < 1.2 nm and zero organic particulate residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS) primed or dielectric mask barrier passivated surface sealed under inert nitrogen purge ready for optical exposure or vacuum stream deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air causes airborne moisture condensation and organic siloxane adsorption, resulting in reticle haze, photoresist lift-off, and pinhole bridging in custom sub-200nm capacitor contact vias.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful tapeout stream-out of the top-level 180nm DRAM chip package comprising stitched multi-voltage power meshes (VDD, VPP, VARY, VBB, VSS), fully synthesized and validated custom DRAM boolean mask layers (capacitor blockouts, deep n-well isolations, high-voltage wordline gate oxides), and zero-defect foundry-compliant GDSII/OASIS sign-off.

| `ASSERT-02` | **Residual DRC, ERC, and off-grid snap error count in streamed-out final GDSII across all custom DRAM boolean mask layers** | `0` | 0 (zero tolerance) | Calibre DRC full-chip hierarchical signoff rule check |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Minimum physical enclosure of storage node contact (SN_CONT) by Crown/MIM bottom capacitor electrode poly (BE_POLY)** | `60` | +/- 5 nm (min >= 55 nm) | Automated KLayout GDSII boolean edge distance measurement script |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> The package is formally accepted when top_chip_dram180_tapeout_signoff.gds achieves 100% clean DRC/LVS/ERC verification under foundry MPW decks, power mesh IR drop across all voltage domains is strictly <= 5% of nominal rail voltage, and GDS layer numbers match the foundry-ratified shuttle stream-out map with signed approval from systems engineering and domain expert.

Via starvation and insufficient metal enclosure at periphery-to-core power strap boundary stitches, inducing excessive static/dynamic IR drop (>150 mV on VPP/VARY) and causing wordline under-boost and data retention failure.
Off-grid vertex snapping and non-manhattan polygon artifacts created during custom layer Boolean NOT operations, causing fatal mask fracture errors during foundry e-beam lithography data preparation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Full-Chip Streamed GDSII Layer Mapping, Structural Hierarchy Verification & Tapeout Audit

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-GDS-001`  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Knowledge Record:** [docs/knowledge/sop_gdsii_layer_mapping_audit.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_gdsii_layer_mapping_audit.md)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Verification Pipeline

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stream-In GDSII     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Verify Layer Map    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Hierarchy & Cell    │
│       Tree Audit       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Physical Dimension &  │
│      Pitch Check       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Foundry Sign-Off    │
│         Audit          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream-In & Database Unit Initialization**
   - Stream in top-level composite GDSII (`dram_top.gds`) into the metrology/sign-off engine.
   - Assert database unit resolution: grid step size $\le 1\text{ nm}$ (user unit = $1.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$, database unit = $0.001\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
   - Parse top-level bounding box including periphery and full seal ring integration.

2. **Foundry Layer & Data-Type Map Alignment Audit**
   - Load foundry 180nm technology layer map table (`tech.layermap`).
   - Validate layer assignment and data-type binding for all critical masks:
     - Active / Diffusion (`OD`, `DIFF`)
     - Gate Poly / Wordline (`PO`, `POLY`)
     - Tungsten Plug / Contact (`W-plug`, `CONT`)
     - Capacitor Storage Node / Crown Bottom Electrode (`SN_CROWN`, `MIM`)
     - High-$\kappa$ Dielectric mask ($Ta_2O_5$ / $Al_2O_3$ / ONO)
     - Capacitor Plate Top Electrode (`PLATE`)
     - Bitline Contact (`BC`) & Metal 1 Bitline (`BL`)
     - Back-End-of-Line (BEOL) interconnects (`M1`-`M3`), Vias, and Passivation.
   - Flag and abort execution if any undefined layer/data-type pairs are identified.

3. **Structural Hierarchy & Cell-Tree Integrity Verification**
   - Traverse the layout hierarchy from `TOP_DRAM_CORE` down to the leaf unit cells:
     - Verify instantiation of the 1T1C bit cell (`CELL_8F2` or `CELL_6F2`).
     - Audit shared bitline contact topology: confirm exactly one bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.
     - Validate array block granularity: verify 256 or 512 cells per bitline column segment.
   - Check for unreferenced cells, orphan polygons, multi-cut via offsets, and non-orthogonal orientations within memory subarrays.

4. **Critical Array Dimension & Metrology Extraction**
   - Measure 1T1C NMOS access transistor dimensions across sample array cells:
     - Channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
     - Channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Verify array lithographic pitch rules:
     - Wordline (WL) pitch: $360\text{ nm} \le \text{Pitch}_{\text{WL}} \le 400\text{ nm}$.
     - Bitline (BL) pitch: $360\text{ nm} \le \text{Pitch}_{\text{BL}} \le 400\text{ nm}$.
   - Audit cell footprint bounds:
     - Folded bitline ($8F^2$): cell footprint area $= 0.259\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$.
     - Open bitline ($6F^2$): cell footprint area $= 0.194\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Confirm crown/cylinder capacitor tungsten plug ($W\text{-plug}$) landing and overlap over the access transistor drain contact.

5. **Foundry Tapeout Sign-Off Mask Package Generation**
   - Generate full-chip layer parity checksums (CRC-32/SHA-256) per layer.
   - Export automated tapeout metrology checklist report (`GDS_AUDIT_SIGNOFF.rpt`) confirming seal ring continuity and layer-map conformance.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                 Target Physical Parameters (180nm Node)
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░                                    │
 Gate Ox EOT (nm)┤░                                    │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
Transistor L (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
 BL/WL Pitch (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
  Cell Area (um2)┤█                                    │
                 │█                                    │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       90       180      270     360 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Lower Limit | Nominal Target | Upper Limit | Units | Audit Method |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $180$ | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | GDS polygon edge distance |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $220$ | $220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Active diffusion width check |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | $360$ | $380$ | $400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Array pitch metrology check |
| **1T1C Cell Footprint Area ($8F^2$ Folded)** | $0.259$ | $0.259$ | $0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Cell boundary area extraction |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget** | $25$ | $28$ | $30$ | $\text{fF}$ | Dielectric stack extraction ($EOT = 3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$) |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5:1$ | $7:1$ | $9:1$ | ratio | Array extraction ($256\text{--}512$ cells/BL) |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | — | — | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Post-layout junction model |

---

### 4. Verified Context Literature Citations

1. **Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench***
   - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells.
   - Crown-shaped polysilicon / MIM structure erected via tungsten plug ($W\text{-plug}$).
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric ($Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ / ONO, $\kappa > 15$).
   - Capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; sub-threshold/junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering***
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ guaranteeing data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
   - Wordline and Bitline pitch: $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate dielectric physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $SiO_2$.

3. **Source: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets***
   - Cell footprints: $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area $= 0.259\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$; $6F^2$ open bitline cell area $= 0.194\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$): $150\text{ fF to }250\text{ fF}$ for $256\text{ to }512$ cells/bitline.
   - Critical capacitance ratio: $C_b / C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (hard degradation ceiling at $10:1$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Hierarchical GDSII assembly must guarantee absolute zero layer-map aliasing between standard logic cells, analog sense amplifier blocks, and dedicated DRAM capacitor/cell array layers. Missing top-level cell instances, unresolved references (unbound subcircuits/orphaned references), or mismatched coordinate origin offsets (0,0 alignment) risk disastrous mask reticle misplacement and broken die-level seal ring integrity.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 180nm DRAM tapeout, folded bitline sense amplifier pitch matching (360 nm pitch) requires extreme lithographic and layer assignment discipline. Ensure deep N-well, bitline contact, and capacitor contact layers are strictly mapped to commercial MPW fab layer-datatype specifications without accidental boolean merge drops or grid-snapping rounding errors that violate 5 nm manufacturing snapping grids.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW shuttles operate on rigid fab freeze cutoff dates. A layout data exchange format rejection due to unmapped GDSII layer datatypes, OASIS translation corruption, or checksum discrepancies immediately forfeits the wafer slot, leading to a minimum 3-to-6-month shuttle delay and full loss of fabrication capital.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tapeout audit criteria must enforce 100% clean rule deck execution across DRC, ERC, and LVS without outstanding waivers on core array periphery interfaces. Sign-off checklists and OASIS/GDSII md5 checksum manifests must be archived and validated prior to the formal multi-party sign-off review.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Layer-datatype index mismatch between Cadence/KLayout stream-out mapping tables and commercial 180nm foundry mask specs, causing missing contacts or shorted diffusion implants on reticles.
1. Hierarchy flattening errors or circular cell reference loops causing memory overflow, dropped folded bitline sense amplifier sub-arrays, or corrupted cell boundary bounding boxes.
1. Grid rounding distortion shifting fine-pitch DRAM bitlines (360 nm pitch) off the 5 nm manufacturing snapping grid, triggering catastrophic lithographic non-conformance.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-1-3-01` | **Automated Hierarchical GDSII Structure and Layer Mapping Verification** | Calibre DRC/Hierarchical Engine or KLayout Python API (v0.28+) Stream-In Parser with SHA-256 Checksum Validator | 1. Ingest streamed-out top-level DRAM GDSII file and compute SHA-256 hash. 2. Parse structural hierarchy tree and verify all leaf cells resolve to the root cell without dangling instances. 3. Interrogate all polygon geometries across all layers (0 to 255) and datatypes against the foundry mapping definition. 4. Run automated off-grid vertex detection against the 5 nm manufacturing snapping grid. | `Total unresolved cell references = 0; unmapped layer/datatype polygon count = 0; off-grid vertices = 0; SHA-256 checksum matches release manifest identically.` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-1-1-3-02` | **Die Boundary, Seal Ring Continuity, and Critical Pitch Metrology Audit** | Automated Design Rule Checker (Calibre nmDRC / KLayout DRC Engine) with Optical Metrology Pattern Recognition Rule Deck | 1. Execute DRC rule deck targeting seal ring enclosure, overlap, and continuous metal/via stack enclosure. 2. Extract die bounding box dimensions and measure scribe-line clear-to-edge clearances. 3. Perform automated coordinate pitch audits on memory array bitline tracks (folded bitline pitch nominal 360 nm) and sense amplifier contact arrays. | `DRC seal ring violations = 0; outer die size strictly 1520.000 um x 1520.000 um ± 0.005 um; array bitline center-to-center pitch = 360.0 nm ± 0.1 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard ESD-safe cleanroom coat, Nitrile gloves (powder-free, static-dissipative), ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA wipe solution: Flush eyes or skin immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes. For digital metrology fatigue or posture strain: follow standard ergonomics protocols.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard ISO Class 5 (Class 100) cleanroom laminar air flow or climate-controlled engineering computing lab with HEPA filtration and positive static pressure (minimum 15 Pa).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of used surface IPA wipes in dedicated sealed, flame-resistant solid waste bins designated for volatile organic solvents; recycle electronic media in accordance with e-waste guidelines.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for workstation optical screen/media wipe** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `70% v/v in DI Water` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Digital stream-out freeze complete; pristine CAD environment with GDSII file integrity locked with read-only permissions and verified cryptographic checksum.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Audited GDSII/OASIS package cryptographically sealed, signed by lead integration researcher, and uploaded to foundry secure FTP tapeout server.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding tapeout shuttle upload window causes missing the foundry mask-shop generation cycle, resulting in complete multi-project wafer drop and 4-month project hold.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full-chip streamed GDSII hierarchical database successfully verified with zero unmapped layers, zero DRC/LVS violations, continuous seal ring integration, and verified 360 nm folded bitline sense amplifier pitch matching.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_top_fullchip_stream_audit_report.pdf`
- [ ] `gds_layer_mapping_hierarchy_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `tapeout_signoff_sha256_manifest.txt`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Unmapped or orphaned GDSII layers and datatypes count across full chip** | `0` | 0 | Automated KLayout/Calibre Stream-In Layer Audit Script parsing all records |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Die bounding box dimension X and Y coordinates** | `1520.000 um` | ±0.005 um | DRC boundary coordinate extraction metrology |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline sense amplifier layout pitch matching nominal array pitch** | `360.0 nm` | ±0.1 nm | Automated pattern-based pitch measurement over 1024 sense amplifier array columns |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% pass across all quantitative assertions, zero unresolved GDSII cell references, zero unmapped layer datatypes, zero critical DRC/LVS violations, and unanimous digital sign-off signatures from Systems Engineer and Domain Expert.
