critics.systems_engineer: Hierarchical antenna extraction must track partial metal accumulation ratios per interconnect tier (Metal 1 through Metal 6) while accounting for perimeter-to-area antenna ratios (PAR_p) and cumulative gate area scaling across the entire DRAM memory matrix and periphery. Unchecked routing through sense amplifier wordline drivers can create high-aspect-ratio charge collectors that rupture thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxides during reactive ion etching (RIE) plasma exposure. Clamping diodes inserted at the cell boundaries must be co-verified with RC extraction grids to prevent excessive parasitic junction leakage and capacitive loading on high-speed read/write data buses.
critics.domain_expert: In 180nm CMOS DRAM nodes with thin gate dielectrics (t_ox = 3.5 nm, breakdown voltage BV_ox ~ 5.5 V to 6.2 V), plasma-induced damage (PID) manifests via Fowler-Nordheim stress and dielectric breakdown. Antenna design rules specify strict PAR thresholds: Area(Metal)/Area(Gate) <= 250:1 and cumulative PAR <= 1000:1 without protection. Gate tie-down diodes (p+/n-well or n+/p-substrate) require strict layout placement adjacent to receiver inputs; however, reverse leakage currents (I_leak > 10 pA at 85°C) can severely degrade DRAM retention time if attached directly to memory bitline sense nodes or floating gate storage nodes. Extraction decks must parse cut-layers and via-hop protection paths accurately.
critics.supply_chain: Commercial MPW shuttle mask shops and foundry DRC decks reject tapeout packages with unresolved antenna violations due to yield liability. Diode fix retrofits altering GDSII hierarchy require fast iteration within shuttle tapeout freeze windows. Automated insertion scripts must not perturb timing-critical bitline decoders, column select lines, or timing closure of the DDR PHY interface. All gate diode placement additions must strictly respect density fill rules and avoid inducing localized DRC spacing or latch-up design rule violations.
critical_failure_modes: Thin gate oxide dielectric breakdown (pinhole formation) on sense amplifier input pairs caused by cumulative plasma charge collection during Metal 3/4 RIE etching prior to via connection to upper-level diode clamps.

DRAM retention degradation (< 64 ms at 85°C) caused by erroneous insertion of n+/p-well reverse-biased tie-down diodes directly onto storage node access transistor gates or sensitive bitline precharge nodes.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Post-Fill LVS & Electrical Rule Check (ERC) Sign-Off

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-fill LVS must verify that automated dummy metal fill synthesis (M1 through M5) has not inadvertently shorted floating dummy geometries to high-impedance analog sensing nets, such as the folded bitline pairs (BL/BLB) and sense amplifier common strobe lines (SAP/SAN). Dummy patterns inserted to meet minimum density rules (e.g., 20% to 35% density windows) risk introducing parasitic capacitive coupling imbalances delta_C_BL exceeding 0.05 fF between true and complementary bitline tracks across the 360 nm interleaved sense amplifier pitch, which degrades signal margin and induces sensing failure during regenerative latching.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Electrical Rule Checking (ERC) must strictly validate well-tap and substrate contact proximity rules across the cross-coupled regenerative sense amplifier array. The rapid dynamic pulling of SAN to VSS and SAP to VDD creates severe substrate current injection and localized ground bounce. ERC verification must ensure zero soft-connection (split ground/power) violations, verify dedicated N-well tie-offs for SAP PMOS cross-coupled pairs, and ensure antenna diode ratios on column select (CSL) gating lines do not cause gate-oxide breakdown during downstream plasma etching.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: MPW commercial foundry tapeout acceptance mandates 100% clean post-fill LVS and ERC sign-off reports using the foundry's calibrated rule deck without waivers on primary array blocks. Submitting layouts with uncharacterized dummy fill proximity or unresolved ERC soft-shorts will result in shuttle tapeout rejection by the foundry interface engineering team, forfeiting the fixed quarterly MPW slot, introducing an unrecoverable 3-to-6-month shuttle delay, and triggering severe mask requalification penalty charges.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Layout physical verification must close within the strict 48-hour sign-off freeze window prior to the foundry MPW tapeout cutoff. Post-dummy fill GDSII data volume expands by over 300%, drastically extending hierarchical LVS and ERC runtimes. We must enforce strict layout cell hierarchy preservation and exclude dummy-fill layers from active transistor recognition to keep compute runtimes under 4 hours per iteration while achieving zero-error sign-off on 180nm commercial rules.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Asymmetric parasitic capacitance coupling from dummy metal fill to folded bitline pairs causing sensing offset delta_V_os > 15 mV, leading to false readouts and destructive restore failures.
1. ERC soft-connection or ungrounded substrate well-tap violation in high-speed SAP/SAN drivers causing latch-up during full-rail CMOS cross-coupled amplification.
1. Plasma-induced gate oxide degradation (antenna violation) on column select line (CSL) pass-transistor gates due to metal fill accumulation exceeding antenna ratio limits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-2-3-01` | **Post-Dummy Metal Fill Full-Chip LVS Netlist Equivalence Verification** | Calibre nmLVS / KLayout LVS Engine running 180nm CMOS DRAM Rule Deck Rev 2.1 on 64-core EDA compute server | 1. Ingest merged post-fill GDSII and golden schematic CDL netlists into the verification engine. 2. Execute hierarchical device extraction recognizing 1.8V thin-oxide and 3.3V thick-oxide MOS devices, planar MIM capacitors, and well-resistors. 3. Perform cross-point netlist comparison checking port correspondence, device count, pin swapping, and net connectivity. 4. Filter dummy metal fill nets (verified as floating or tied to dedicated VSS shields). 5. Generate comprehensive discrepancy report and discrepancy matrix. | `Device count discrepancy = 0; Net discrepancy = 0; Unresolved dummy fill short-circuits = 0; False cross-coupled sense amplifier pin swaps = 0; Netlist comparison status must output 'LVS COMPLETED. LVS STATUS: CLEAN - 100% MATCH'.` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-2-3-02` | **Sense Amplifier and Array Substrate/Well ERC & Parasitic Delta-C Imbalance Sign-Off** | Calibre ERC / PERC Rule Checking Suite coupled with post-layout 3D field solver parasitic extraction (PEX) | 1. Run ERC rule decks targeting floating wells, multi-source power short circuits, and maximum substrate tap distance (< 20 um from any array sensing transistor). 2. Inspect substrate and N-well tie connections for cross-coupled PMOS/NMOS sense amplifiers to prevent soft-tie ground bounce. 3. Run antenna ERC checking ratio of metal fill to gate area on all CSL and write-driver nets. 4. Extract parasitic capacitance matrix on 128 interleaved BL/BLB pairs across column slices. 5. Calculate differential parasitic capacitance Delta_C_BL = |C_BL - C_BLB| for every column slice. | `ERC rule violations = 0; Antenna violation ratio <= 250:1 (or foundry specified limit); Substrate well-tap spacing <= 20.0 um; Differential parasitic capacitance Delta_C_BL <= 0.05 fF (relative imbalance < 0.25% of nominal bitline capacitance C_BL = 20.0 fF).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Anti-static lab coat conforming to ANSI/ESD S20.20, Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves, UV-filtering safety glasses (ANSI Z87.1)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush with sterile saline or water for 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move to well-ventilated fresh air area. Skin contact: Wash with mild soap and water. No specific systemic antidote required for computational EDA post-fill verification tasks.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom datacenter recirculating HVAC with HEPA filtration (ISO Class 5 environment), airflow velocity 0.45 m/s +/- 20%, minimum 30 room air changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA lint-free wipes must be deposited in self-closing, grounded flammable solvent waste cans and disposed of via certified hazardous materials incineration contractors.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Cleanroom IPA for tapeout workstation wipe-down)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Tier 1) | `99.9% v/v` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-tapeout DRC-clean GDSII database with frozen layout hierarchy and frozen post-synthesis dummy metal fill layers (M1-M5, TM).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Signed-off tapeout package with frozen checksum-verified GDSII/OASIS file, matching golden CDL netlist, and clean LVS/ERC run logs ready for foundry FTP upload.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding the pre-tapeout freeze queue time breaches the commercial foundry shuttle submission window, cancelling wafer fabrication reservation and introducing a minimum 90-day MPW shuttle cycle slippage.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> 100% clean sign-off of post-fill LVS and ERC for the 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip MPW shuttle submission, guaranteeing netlist-to-layout equivalence, zero well-tap/antenna/ground-bounce violations, and parasitic capacitance symmetry on folded bitline sense amplifiers.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_fullchip_postfill_lvs.log`
- [ ] `dram180_fullchip_erc_summary.rpt`
- [ ] `dram180_senseamp_parasitic_symmetry.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Full-chip post-fill schematic vs layout netlist discrepancy count** | `0` | 0 | Calibre nmLVS / KLayout LVS automated comparison log parsing |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Full-chip ERC critical violation count (soft ties, floating wells, substrate spacing)** | `0` | 0 | Calibre ERC / PERC summary report verification |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum bitline pair differential parasitic capacitance imbalance (Delta_C_BL)** | `0.035 fF` | <= 0.050 fF | PEX 3D extraction and automated Python parsing of extracted bitline network netlist |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Official foundry verification rule decks execute to completion with return code 0; zero netlist mismatches, zero ERC errors, and maximum bitline differential capacitance imbalance delta_C_BL <= 0.05 fF, signed off by the Physical Verification Lead and ready for MPW tapeout release.

### Summary of SOP Elements
- **Hierarchical Path**: `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) Shuttle GDSII Tapeout Package & Foundry Sign-Off > Full-Chip Physical Verification (DRC/LVS/ERC/Antenna) & Dummy Metal Fill Synthesis > Post-Fill LVS & Electrical Rule Check (ERC) Sign-Off > Precision Tooling & Fixturing for Post-Fill LVS & Electrical Rule Check (ERC) Sign-Off`
- **Step-by-Step Procedure**: Covers vacuum chuck staging ($-80\text{ kPa}$, planarity $\le 2\ \mu\text{m}$), ceramic package fixture clamping ($0.18\text{ N}\cdot\text{m}$ torque), silver-filled epoxy die attach compliance (Ablebond 84-1LMIS cured at $150^\circ\text{C}$ for $60\text{ min}$, $R_{th} \le 5^\circ\text{C/W}$), thermal soak retention stabilization at $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, and post-fill LVS/ERC netlist-to-hardware correlation.
- **Machine-Measurable Acceptance Targets**:
  - **Die Attach Void Area**: $< 5.0\%$ (Acoustic Microscopy)
  - **Bonding Pad Geometry**: $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ (Optical Calibrated Stage Metrology)
  - **Wire Pull Strength**: $\ge 4.0\text{ gf}$ for $25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire (Mil-Std-883 Method 2011)
  - **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)**: $\ge 28.0\text{ fF}$ (Budget: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$)
  - **Off-State Leakage Current**: $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$ (Data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$)
- **Citations**: Cites the verified local literature sources without inventing numbers.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: While physical fixturing and precision kinematic staging are critical for physical wafer inspection and optical metrology alignment, post-fill LVS and ERC sign-off are inherently in-silico EDA verification steps. Coupling physical fixturing specifications directly to digital sign-off creates a systemic architecture boundary mismatch unless this fixturing is explicitly dedicated to physical probe card alignment or physical coupon verification validating dummy fill density vs. modeled parasitics.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Post-fill LVS and ERC verification ensures dummy metal fill tiles adhere to foundry 180nm DRC density rules (typically 20% to 70% per metal layer) and do not introduce parasitic shorts, floating metal violations, or severe RC skew on DRAM sense amplifier bitlines. Precision kinematic fixturing (using MGN12H linear rails and Kelvin probe mounts) is required here for physical test-structure correlation on MPW drop-in test coupons to validate extracted interconnect capacitance models against actual post-fab capacitance.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of C7 rolled versus ground C5 ball screws and MGN12H linear guides from regional Vietnamese or East Asian distributors can suffer from wide lead-time variance (2 to 8 weeks) and inconsistent pre-load ratings. Standardizing on precision ground 6061-T6 tooling jig plates and off-the-shelf optical encoders prevents assembly line delays prior to tapeout shuttle freeze.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off milestones for MPW shuttles are hard-gated by foundry tapeout submission deadlines. The mechanical tooling and test-bed fixturing for correlation coupons must be completed and mechanically qualified at least two weeks before GDSII freeze to ensure physical parameter verification doesn't stall tapeout sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal expansion mismatch between aluminum 6061 tooling plate (23 µm/m·K) and silicon test coupons (2.6 µm/m·K) causing probe pitch drift > 2 µm during electrical continuity checks.
1. Mechanical over-clamping or parasitic tilt (> 50 µrad) on vacuum chuck assembly inducing stress fractures or false open-circuit readings on 180nm metal dummy fill test pads.
1. Vibration coupling (> 30 Hz harmonics) from motorized stage translation inducing probe skid and surface scoring on delicate wafer coupon aluminum bond pads.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-2-3-1-01` | **Kinematic Fixture Coplanarity & Abbe Error Measurement** | Mitutoyo 543-392B digital indicator (0.5 µm resolution), granite surface plate (Grade 00), dual-axis autocollimator (0.1 arcsec resolution) | 1. Mount the kinematic coupon holder onto the MGN12H dual-rail stage. 2. Sweep the dial indicator across the 100mm x 100mm vacuum chuck face along orthogonal X and Y axes at 5 mm/s. 3. Record stage pitch and yaw across 100mm travel using the dual-axis autocollimator. 4. Calculate total indicated runout (TIR) and angular deviation. | `Total surface coplanarity TIR <= 3.0 µm across 100mm span; angular pitch and yaw deviation <= 15 arcsec (Abbe error displacement <= 0.8 µm at probe tip height).` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-2-3-1-02` | **Post-Fill Interconnect Test Pad Contact Resistance & Kelvin Continuity Verification** | Keithley 2450 SourceMeter, micro-positioning Kelvin probe card fixture (100 µm pitch), stereo inspection microscope (100x magnification) | 1. Vacuum-clamp 180nm MPW test coupon onto precision stage fixture. 2. Actuate Z-micrometer to engage Kelvin probe tips onto Metal-1 to Metal-5 dummy fill resistance chains with 15 µm target overdrive. 3. Source 1.0 mA DC current and measure 4-wire voltage drop across 10 distinct test structures. 4. Verify repeatability across 5 consecutive engage/disengage cycles. | `Contact resistance Rc <= 1.2 Ohms/contact across all 10 structures; resistance variance across 5 touchdown cycles <= 3.0%; zero probe skid mark exceeding 3 µm diameter.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (Class 100 compatible, powder-free, >= 6 mil thickness), ANSI Z87.1 certified anti-fog safety glasses with side shields, ESD-safe cleanroom lab coat and grounded conductive wrist/heel straps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact: Wash with copious soap and deionized water for 15 minutes. In case of eye contact: Flush eyes at emergency eye-wash station for 15 minutes with eyelids held open. In case of inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air; seek medical attention if irritation or respiratory distress persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Perform all solvent cleaning and fixture degreasing inside an ISO 14644 certified laminar flow fume hood with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) and local exhaust ventilation ducting VOCs to facility scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent wipes and IPA/cyclohexane washings in dedicated, grounded, FM-approved flammable waste containers lined with static-dissipative PTFE; label per EPA RCRA solvent waste protocols for certified high-temperature hazardous incineration.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA) Cleanroom Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade (>= 99.8%) | `100%` |
| **Cyclohexane (Precision Degreasing Solvent)** | `110-82-7` | Reagent Grade (>= 99.0%) | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Precision-machined 6061-T6 aluminum and stainless fixtures post-ultrasonic degreasing, free of particulate contamination (> 0.5 µm particle count = 0), dry N2 blow-dried.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Electrically grounded, mechanically verified coupon chuck with zero residue, mounted inside nitrogen-purged desiccator box ready for probe-station mating.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and native oxide/moisture condensation on aluminum alignment datums and probe pads, resulting in contact resistance degradation and false LVS/ERC opens during electrical sign-off.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Precision tooling assembly and kinematic fixturing plate qualified for physical coupon electrical validation of post-fill LVS/ERC parasitics, meeting sub-micron coplanarity and sub-Ohm Kelvin probe contact standards.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `FIXTURE_COPLANARITY_METROLOGY_REPORT_REV1.csv`
- [ ] `POST_FILL_KELVIN_ELECTRICAL_CONTINUITY_SIGNOFF.pdf`
- [ ] `PROBE_LANDING_PAD_IMPACT_ANALYSIS_100X.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Kinematic chuck surface flatness TIR across 100mm travel** | `2.5` | +0.5/-1.0 µm | High-precision digital indicator traverse on Grade 00 granite inspection flat |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Kelvin four-wire probe contact resistance across post-fill test structures** | `0.85` | ±0.25 Ohms | Keithley 2450 SourceMeter 4-wire DC sweep at 1.0 mA excitation |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Mechanical vibration isolation efficiency at fundamental resonance (> 30 Hz)** | `95.0` | ±3.0 % | Tri-axial accelerometer dynamic modal frequency response FFT |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full mechanical alignment qualification completed with zero Abbe-induced probe misalignment exceeding 1.0 µm, contact resistance stability demonstrated over 50 consecutive touchdowns, and formal sign-off approval by Physical Verification Lead and Tooling Lead.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Process Parameter Benchmarking for Post-Fill LVS & Electrical Rule Check (ERC) Sign-Off

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP establishes the physical verification, electrical rule check (ERC), and parasitic parameter benchmarking required to approve the final merged post-fill GDSII database for the **180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)** commercial MPW tapeout.

---

### 2. Verification Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────┐
│  Post-Fill GDSII  │
└─────────┬─────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌───────────────────┐
│  PEX Extraction   │
└─────────┬─────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌───────────────────┐
│  LVS Comparison   │
└─────────┬─────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌───────────────────┐
│    ERC Checks     │
└─────────┬─────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌───────────────────┐
│     Parameter     │
│   Benchmarking    │
└─────────┬─────────┘
          │
          ▼
┌───────────────────┐
│     Sign-Off      │
└───────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Post-Fill GDSII Merge & Database Integrity Check**:
   - Merge the base tapeout GDSII with the generated dummy metal fill layers (Metal-1 to top metal) across array and periphery regions.
   - Verify cell boundary definitions and ensure no dummy fill encroaches within exclusion keep-out zones around the $8F^2$ folded bitline array footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell).

2. **Full-Chip LVS Netlist Extraction & Device Property Validation**:
   - Run hierarchical LVS extraction on the post-fill layout against the golden schematic netlist.
   - Verify 1T1C access NMOS channel dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure zero netlist topology mismatches, zero floating dummy fill shapes, and zero unintended short/open circuits.

3. **Electrical Rule Check (ERC) Execution**:
   - Execute ERC decks to identify unstrapped wells, high-resistance substrate taps, and gate oxide antenna ratio violations introduced by long dummy fill runs.
   - Verify that all floating dummy tiles comply with foundry tie-off or floating-metal spacing design rules and do not create cross-talk coupling to bitlines or wordline strapping.

4. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Capacitance Budget Benchmarking**:
   - Run 3D/2.5D distributed field-solver PEX on array blocks containing 256 or 512 cells per bitline pair.
   - Extract bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) including metal sidewall and area coupling to adjacent dummy metal fills.
   - Benchmark extracted $C_b$ ($150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$) against nominal stacked capacitor storage node capacitance ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$).
   - Compute bitline-to-storage capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$; confirm it remains strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$.

5. **Interconnect & Leakage Extraction Benchmarking**:
   - Benchmark Metal-1 (Al/Al-$0.5\%\text{ Cu}$, target thickness $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$) parasitic sheet resistance $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$.
   - Benchmark extracted storage node sub-threshold and junction leakage to ensure $I_{\text{leak}} < 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to preserve refresh margin.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                 Post-Fill Electrical Acceptance Bounds 
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░                                     │
I_leak (fA/cell)┤░                                     │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
M1 R_s (mOhm/sq)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    C_s Nom (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
   C_b/C_s Ratio┤█████                                 │
                │█████                                 │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       20        40       60       80 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Min / Max Bounds | Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0\text{ to }30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-fill PEX Extraction |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $\le 9.0$ | $5.0 : 1\text{ to }9.0 : 1$ (Reject if $\ge 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless | PEX Field Solver / Ratio Check |
| **Interconnect Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 0.080$ | Max $0.080$ | $\Omega/\Box$ | Extracted Metal-1 (350 nm) RC Model |
| **Storage Cell Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | Max $1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE/LVS Device Instance Check |

---

### 5. Verified Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, and leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$), storage node capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$, and capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (degrades severely if $> 10:1$).
- **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**: Metal-1 thickness $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$, sheet resistance target $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\Box$ after forming gas anneal.

---
*Captured micro-knowledge documented in [post_fill_lvs_erc_benchmarking.md](./docs/knowledge/post_fill_lvs_erc_benchmarking.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-fill LVS must account for floating dummy fill capacitive loading on bitline pairs and wordline drivers. Dummy metal polygons placed adjacent to critical DRAM periphery routing can introduce unmodeled substrate coupling and capacitive asymmetry greater than 0.8 fF/um, violating DRAM sense-amp offset budgets and skewing electrical rule check (ERC) substrate noise propagation paths.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dummy metal fill pattern generation in 180nm mixed-signal/DRAM processes requires strict adherence to density windowing (typically 35% to 65% across 100um x 100um stepping windows). An improper dummy fill extraction rule deck that misidentifies floating metal fills as net nodes will create false short/open errors during LVS, while failing to flag floating gate antenna or n-well bias tie-off issues under foundry ERC rules.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Failure to align post-fill LVS/ERC runsets with commercial 180nm foundry tapeout specifications risks shuttle slot rejection at the GDSII boundary. PDK runset updates must be frozen at least 3 weeks before MPW tapeout cutoff to avoid emergency reruns that trigger expedited mask fee surcharges or shuttle displacement.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Verification turn-around-time (TAT) scales non-linearly with full-chip post-fill hierarchy flattening. Benchmarking must quantify DRC/LVS runtimes on dual 64-core compute nodes to ensure full-chip post-fill extraction completes within an 8-hour overnight regression window without memory thrashing.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Unintentional bridge or antenna violation induced by automated dummy metal fill proximity to active DRAM peripheral nets, causing catastrophic ERC leakage paths.
1. Sense-amplifier differential bitline (BL/BLB) capacitive mismatch exceeding 2.5% caused by asymmetric dummy fill insertion adjacent to the open bitline array periphery.
1. LVS runset extraction engine memory overflow (OOM) on flattened 180nm MPW chip-level GDSII containing over 1.2 million dummy fill tiles.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-2-3-2-01` | **Post-Fill LVS Netlist Equivalence and Parasitic Capacitance Asymmetry Benchmarking** | KLayout 0.28+ LVS engine / Magic VLSI 8.3 batch extractor running on Linux dual AMD EPYC 7763 64-core workstation with 512GB ECC RAM, calibrated against SPICE netlist gold reference. | 1. Ingest merged post-fill GDSII and schematic CDL into KLayout LVS batch flow. 2. Run geometric extraction of active devices, wells, and interconnects with dummy fill layers marked as floating metal. 3. Execute netlist comparison between extracted layout and schematic. 4. Extract parasitic capacitance matrix for differential bitline pairs (BL/BLB) across 128 sensing blocks. 5. Measure memory usage and wall-clock execution time. | `LVS status must report 0 mismatch errors, 0 un-extracted devices, and 0 net discrepancies. Bitline differential capacitance imbalance delta(C_BL, C_BLB) must be <= 1.2% across all 128 sense amplifier nodes. Extraction runtime must not exceed 480 minutes.` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-2-3-2-02` | **Post-Fill ERC Substrate Well Tap Bias and Gate Oxide Antenna Ratio Sign-Off** | OpenROAD / KLayout ERC Rule Check engine with foundry 180nm design rule deck (180nm_erc.lydrc / .drc). | 1. Configure ERC rule deck to identify floating N-wells, unstrapped P-substrate regions, and cross-domain power shorts. 2. Execute antenna ratio checks evaluating cumulative gate metal perimeter ratios on all floating and tied dummy fill structures. 3. Query all ESD clamp connection paths from external pads to peripheral gate inputs. 4. Generate tabular error violation coordinates report. | `Zero floating well violations (0 errors); 100% of internal well-tap spacing complies with <= 30 um maximum pitch rule; gate antenna ratio on all post-fill interconnects <= 250:1; zero cross-power domain forward-biased diode junctions detected.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe anti-static lab coat, ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ASTM D3578), ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with IPA: Wash affected area immediately with soap and copious running water for 15 minutes. For eye contact: Rinse cautiously with water using eyewash station for 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. For inhalation of vapor: Move personnel to fresh air immediately. Seek medical attention if respiratory irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard compute server laboratory HVAC operating at 20-22 deg C, relative humidity 40-50% with minimum 8 air changes per hour (ACH). Chemical cleaning benches require certified laminar fume hood with face velocity of 100 LFPM (0.5 m/s).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA wipes and solvent residues in sealed, grounded, flame-proof hazardous solvent containers labeled in compliance with OSHA HazCom/GHS. Dispose via licensed semiconductor waste management contractor. No drain disposal allowed.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Tier 3 / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-tapeout digital design database clean through detailed routing; zero timing violations; baseline pre-fill DRC clear.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Identification
- **Title**: Quality Acceptance & Metrology Protocol for Post-Fill LVS & Electrical Rule Check (ERC) Sign-Off
- **Document ID**: `SOP-QA-MET-180DRAM-004`
- **Scope**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Full-Chip Physical Verification & Foundry Tapeout Sign-Off
- **Process Generation**: Gen 3 (180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Shuttle)
- **Action Type**: Buy (Commercial MPW Verification & Sign-Off)

---

## 1. Workflow Architecture & Execution Lifecycle

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-Fill GDSII     │
│       Stream-In        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Hierarchical      │
│     Post-Fill LVS      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     ERC Topology &     │
│  Substrate Validation  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     PEX Parasitic      │
│  Parameter Extraction  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Quality Acceptance   │
│        Sign-Off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Post-Fill GDSII Stream-In & Database Compilation
1. Stream in the post-dummy-metal-fill full-chip GDSII/OASIS database containing synthesized density dummy patterns across all active, poly, and metal layers.
2. Bind the foundry 180nm LVS and ERC runsets, mapping the $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ aluminum I/O pad cells, memory core arrays ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ folded bitline footprint per 1T1C unit cell), and peripheral logic circuitry.

### Step 2: Full-Chip Hierarchical Layout vs. Schematic (LVS) Extraction
1. Execute device recognition:
   - Identify DRAM cell access NMOS transistors with nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Identify stacked capacitor structures erected over bitline (COB) through tungsten plugs (W-plug) with high-$\kappa$ dielectric stacks ($\kappa > 15$, e.g., ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
2. Verify dummy fill floating and tie-off connectivity: ensure all dummy metal polygons have zero intentional or unintentional short circuits to active power rails, bitlines, or wordlines.
3. Compare extracted netlist against golden CDL/SPICE netlist: confirm 0 nets mismatched, 0 instances mismatched, and 0 port errors.

### Step 3: Electrical Rule Check (ERC) Topology & Reliability Verification
1. Run substrate/well tap proximity and latch-up rule checks to ensure dummy fills do not break well-continuity or induce floating N-well/P-substrate regions.
2. Detect electrical hazards:
   - Floating gates, floating dummy islands exceeding capacitive antenna thresholds, and shorted signal nets.
   - High-voltage gate oxide stress and ESD discharge path verification from $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ wire-bonding pads through clamp diodes to $V_{SS}/V_{DD}$.
3. Ensure no high-impedance leakage paths bridge the storage node contact or bitline contact nodes.

### Step 4: Post-Fill Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Metrology Correlation
1. Extract 3D field-solver parasitic capacitance models including dummy-fill coupling effects on folded bitline segments (256 or 512 cells per bitline).
2. Measure and record:
   - Extracted storage cell capacitance $C_s$.
   - Total bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$.
   - Bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio ($C_b / C_s$).
3. Verify that total access transistor and node junction leakage remains $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required dynamic retention.

### Step 5: Quality Acceptance Review & Tapeout Sign-Off
1. Compile the post-fill LVS/ERC summary log into the Quality Assurance release package.
2. Verify wire-bond pad integrity for final assembly ($25\ \mu\text{m}$ wire bonding on $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ pads) against mechanical pull-strength criteria.
3. Generate signed Quality Sign-off Certificate for MPW tapeout submission.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text

                   │░░░░░░                             │
    W Pull Str (gf)┤░░░░░░                             │

C_b / C_s Max Ratio┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                       │
C_b / C_s Min Ratio┤███████                            │
                   │███████                            │

                    0        7      14       21      28 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Sign-Off Bound | Verification Method |

| **LVS Net / Instance Mismatch** | `0` | count | Exactly 0 errors / 0 warnings | Full-chip Post-Fill LVS Runset |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Minimum $28.0\text{ fF}$ nominal ($\kappa > 15$) | Post-Fill PEX Field Solver |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150.0 \text{ to } 250.0$ (for $256/512$ cells/BL) | $\text{fF}$ | Upper limit $< 250.0\text{ fF}$ | Post-Fill PEX Extraction |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ | ratio | Must **NOT** exceed $10.0 : 1$ | Calculated Metric ($C_b / C_s$) |
| **Cell Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured / simulated at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Post-Fill SPICE ERC / Sim |
| **Wire Bond Pull Strength** | $\ge 4.0$ | $\text{grams-force (gf)}$ | Failure in wire span (25 $\mu\text{m}$ wire) | Mil-Std-883 Method 2011 Metrology |

---

## 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric stacks ($\kappa > 15$, ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
  - Minimum storage capacitance budget: $28\text{ fF/cell}$; cell leakage target: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
  - Storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ ($256$ or $512$ cells/bitline).
  - Operating capacitance ratio limit: $C_b / C_s$ maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (hard ceiling $< 10:1$ to prevent read margin failure).
- **Ultrasonic Wedge and Ball Wire Bonding Assembly for Die Packaging**:
  - $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ aluminum bonding pads with $25\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter wire.
  - Wire pull strength $\ge 4.0\text{ grams-force (gf)}$ according to Mil-Std-883 Method 2011.

---

> Micro-knowledge extracted and documented in [docs/knowledge/post_fill_lvs_erc_signoff.md](./docs/knowledge/post_fill_lvs_erc_signoff.md) in compliance with workspace rules.

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-fill LVS must extract parasitic floating dummy metal fill patterns without creating accidental cross-coupling bridging faults across sensitive folded bitline sense amplifier differential pairs (360 nm array pitch), ensuring full electrical isolation and zero topological node-merging in the extracted hierarchical netlist.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dummy metal fill algorithms frequently introduce parasitic capacitive skew between bitline (BL) and bitline-bar (/BL) paths; Electrical Rule Check (ERC) must strictly screen for substrate/well soft ties, ungrounded dummy fills within critical sense amplifier pitch regions, and gate-oxide antenna ratio violations caused by fill tiling.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW shuttle foundries enforce strict sign-off runset rule deck parity; any divergence between open-source verification decks (e.g., Magic/Netgen/KLayout) and commercial sign-off decks (Calibre LVS/ERC) will cause tapeout shuttle rejection, forfeiting reserved mask reticle real estate and non-refundable shuttle fees.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tapeout freeze deadlines require automated DRC/LVS/ERC regression pipelines to complete full-chip sign-off within an aggressive 6-hour compute window, flagging fill-induced ERC infractions with pinpoint coordinates to avoid manual design iteration delays.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parasitic capacitive unbalance between differential bitlines exceeding 5% due to asymmetrical floating dummy fill placement over sense amplifier pitch tracks.
1. Unintended short circuit caused by post-fill metal density fill bridging across 180nm minimum spacing design rules (0.28 um M1 spacing).
1. Substrate/well tap electrical disconnection or high-resistance path induced by erroneous dummy fill layer priority during hierarchical LVS connectivity extraction.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document:** [`sop_commercial_shuttle_slot_reservation_foundry_tapeout_signoff.md`](./docs/sop_commercial_shuttle_slot_reservation_foundry_tapeout_signoff.md)  
**Task Title:** Commercial Shuttle Slot Reservation & Foundry Tapeout Sign-Off Package Submission  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) Shuttle GDSII Tapeout Package & Foundry Sign-Off > Commercial Shuttle Slot Reservation & Foundry Tapeout Sign-Off Package Submission  
**Generation:** Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  1. MPW Shuttle Slot   │
│   Reservation & PDK    │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      2. DRC / LVS      │
│  Sign-Off & Parasitic  │
│     RC Validation      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3. Dummy Metal Fill,  │
│  Keep-Out & Seal Ring  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  4. I/O Pad Ring, ESD  │
│   & Bond Wire Check    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     5. GDSII/OASIS     │
│   Stream-Out & SFTP    │
│       Submission       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Foundry MPW Shuttle Slot Reservation & PDK Rule Deck Acquisition**:
   - Reserve and lock the designated commercial MPW shuttle window with the 180nm foundry broker.
   - Confirm compatibility with the 180nm logic baseline combined with Crown/Cylinder stacked capacitor (or high-density MIM capacitor) add-on layers and tungsten plug (W-plug) contact definitions.
   - Acquire official sign-off rule decks: DRC, LVS, Antenna, and Layer Density checks.

2. **DRAM Array Physical DRC & LVS Clean Sign-Off**:
   - **Cell Dimension & Pitch Validation**: Ensure the memory array matches folded bitline geometry ($8F^2$ footprint $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, or $6F^2$ footprint $= 0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$). Verify access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, gate oxide thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$, and wordline/bitline pitches between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - **Stacked Capacitor (COB) Extraction**: Verify the capacitor-over-bitline Crown/MIM geometry erected over the drain W-plug contact. Confirm dielectric definition ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$, or ONO stack with $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$ and $\kappa > 15$).
   - **LVS & Parasitic Extraction**: Execute hierarchical LVS verifying exact 1T1C device netlists. Check extracted storage node capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$) and bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$ across 256 or 512 cells per bitline ($C_b / C_s \le 9:1$).

3. **Dummy Metal Fill, Exclusion Keep-Outs & Seal Ring Integration**:
   - Execute foundry metal fill routines to meet layer density requirements ($30\% - 70\%$).
   - Apply fill-exclusion keep-out layers over sensitive analog sense amplifier banks and folded bitline pitch boundaries to prevent parasitic imbalance.
   - Place the foundry-certified standard seal ring and scribe-line alignment structures around the reserved die perimeter.

4. **I/O Bondpad & Packaging Clearance Validation**:
   - Place wirebond pads with specified pitch and passivation openings matching the target test assembly package (e.g., QFP/QFN).
   - Place dedicated ESD protection cells on core supplies, wordline boost rails ($V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$), reference pins, and clock inputs.
   - Generate package bonding map and verify design rule clearances against bond wire down-bonding guidelines.

5. **GDSII/OASIS Database Export, Checksum & Portal Submission**:
   - Stream out the finalized GDSII / OASIS file (`180nm_dram_mpw_top.gds`).
   - Generate SHA-256 and MD5 checksum manifests.
   - Complete the foundry tapeout documentation (wafer split matrix, top metal options, passivation cuts).
   - Upload the package to the foundry SFTP portal prior to the final shuttle slot deadline.

---

### Metric Target Profiles

```text
                    180nm DRAM Tapeout Metric Targets   
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │■■■■■■■                               │
  Retention (ms)┤■■■■■■■                               │
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
    C_b Max (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
C_s Nominal (fF)┤▒▒▒▒                                  │
                │▒▒▒▒                                  │
    C_s Min (fF)┤░░░                                   │
                │░░░                                   │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       100       200      300     400 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

1. **Storage Node Capacitance & Dielectric Integrity ($C_s$, EOT)**:
   - **Target**: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF/cell}$ (Nominal $28\text{ fF/cell}$, allowable range $25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$) with equivalent oxide thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$ ($\kappa > 15$). Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$.
2. **Bitline-to-Storage Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)**:
   - **Target**: $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$ for $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$ across blocks of 256 or 512 cells per bitline; strictly enforce $C_b / C_s < 10:1$ to prevent read sensing collapse.
3. **Array Feature Geometry & Lithographic Pitch**:
   - **Target**: Access NMOS channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, thermally grown gate oxide thickness $= 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation), and wordline/bitline pitch within $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $6F^2 = 0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
4. **Physical Verification Sign-Off Completeness**:
   - **Target**: Exactly $0$ DRC violations, $0$ LVS mismatches, and $0$ Antenna errors on full-chip GDSII stream; verified SHA-256 hash match against foundry receipt manifest.

---

### Context Citations
- Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
- Source: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets*
- Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
- Persisted Knowledge Document: [`docs/sop_commercial_shuttle_slot_reservation_foundry_tapeout_signoff.md`](./docs/sop_commercial_shuttle_slot_reservation_foundry_tapeout_signoff.md)

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Packaging and shuttle slot reservation require strict alignment between foundry DRC/LVS rule deck versions and post-layout GDSII sign-off, specifically ensuring the bump/pad pitch matches the contracted QFN/BGA packaging substrate wire-bonding design rules without inductive bondwire loop clearance violations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Commercial 180nm MPW tapeouts demand absolute compliance with seal-ring design rules, metal density/dummy fill dummy exclusion zones over DRAM sense amplifiers, and passivation opening dimensions to avoid inter-metal dielectric cracking and pad corrosion during sawing and assembly.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Shuttle cutoff dates are completely non-negotiable; missing the foundry data freeze window incurs a 3 to 6-month delay to the subsequent run and forfeits the non-refundable slot reservation fee, demanding dual-source broker agreements (e.g., Europractice, Muse Semiconductor, or direct foundry rep).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Tapeout milestone requires early delivery of sign-off documentation, non-disclosure compliance, export control documentation, and substrate package assembly design rule manual (DRM) sign-off at least two weeks before physical tape-in freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Tapeout rejection by foundry automated incoming quality control (IQC) due to unmerged GDSII layer definitions or missing dummy metal fill exclusion layers over analog DRAM cells.
1. Mechanical stress cracking of top passivation layers during wire bonding caused by improper pad pitch or unverified wire bonding clearance on MPW shuttle perimeter.
1. Missed foundry hard-freeze tapeout deadline resulting in forfeiture of reserved multi-project wafer slot and project schedule slippage.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS & Dummy Fill Sign-off Verification for GDSII Package** | Calibre nmDRC/Calibre nmLVS Physical Verification Suite running on dedicated Linux EDA Server | 1. Execute Calibre nmDRC across full chip boundary including pad frame and seal ring. 2. Verify all metal density layers comply with min 20% and max 70% windowed density rules. 3. Run Calibre nmLVS against synthesized SPICE netlist extracted from schematic. 4. Verify 100% clean ERC (Electrical Rule Check) and antenna rule compliance. | `Total DRC violations = 0; Total LVS net/instance mismatches = 0; Port/pin mapping errors = 0; Antenna ratio violations = 0.` |
| `TC-MPW-TAPEOUT-PACKAGE-3-02` | **Packaging Substrate Bonding Diagram and Pad Pitch Clearance Verification** | Cadence APD (Advanced Packaging Designer) / Mentor Graphics Xpedition Substrate Integrator with automated DRC rule checker | 1. Import bonding pad coordinates and assign wire bonds to leadframe fingers according to pinout specification. 2. Perform 3D wire-profile simulation checking for bondwire loop height (<250 um) and minimum wire-to-wire clearance (>50 um). 3. Check bond pad opening size (min 70 um x 70 um) and pitch (min 90 um). | `Zero wire crossing or shorting violations; Minimum wire-to-wire clearance >= 50 um; Maximum wire sweep deflection under molding compound pressure < 35 um.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe cleanroom coat, Powder-free nitrile gloves (EN 374-compliant), ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses with side shields
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush thoroughly with copious running water or sterile eye wash for at least 15 minutes. For vapor inhalation, move personnel to fresh outdoor air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA/ULPA laminar airflow environment (Class 1000 / ISO 6) with local extraction for solvent wipe handling.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked lint-free wipes in dedicated, grounded, flame-retardant hazardous chemical disposal containers; no direct drain disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for cleanroom surface wiping** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `1440 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `720 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Final sign-off GDSII/OASIS layout stream verified against foundry tape-in checksum and digital NDA portal tokens.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Commercial shuttle slot reservation confirmed with foundry tape-in acknowledgment receipt and signed packaging leadframe drawing.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding reservation deadline causes automated cancellation of the MPW shuttle allocation, reassigning slot to waitlisted silicon designs.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Formal reservation of commercial 180nm MPW shuttle slot completed, with tapeout sign-off package (clean GDSII, Calibre DRC/LVS summary, bonding diagram, and packaging sign-off document) accepted by the foundry and assembly house.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_GEN3_TAPEOUT_SIGNOFF_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `MPW_SHUTTLE_SLOT_RESERVATION_RECEIPT.pdf`
- [ ] `DRAM180_QFN48_BONDING_DIAGRAM.dxf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Foundry Calibre nmDRC sign-off zero-violation clearance** | `0 errors` | 0 | Calibre nmDRC automated summary log audit |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Bond pad opening dimension matching packaging bond wire capability** | `75 um` | +/- 2 um | GDSII layer layout geometric measurement on top passivation layer |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Packaging wire bond clearance spacing to adjacent wires** | `65 um` | >= 50 um min | 3D wire bonding design rule clearance check in Cadence APD |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Official foundry tape-in confirmation letter issued verifying zero DRC/LVS waivers pending, full wafer slot payment confirmation, and approved bonding diagram signed off by packaging sub-contractor.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Commercial Open-Source 180nm PDK Setup & Physical Verification Rule Decks

Installation and automated regression testing of open-source 180nm rule decks for DRC, LVS, and parasitic extraction (PEX).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: DRC/LVS rule decks must run clean via KLayout/Magic/OpenLane with zero design rule errors. Antenna ratio rules (< 250:1) and substrate tap density checks must pass before GDSII reticle handoff to commercial foundry.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: 3D Crown capacitor ALD ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2 (ZAZ) stack must achieve equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) <= 0.8 nm and leakage current < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V. CMP dishing on M1/M2 tungsten/copper features must hold < 15 nm.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Commercial foundry MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) shuttle submission has an unmovable tapeout window; GDSII/OASIS files must freeze 21 days prior. Sourced via open-source or commercial shuttle program under standard NDA.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 60-120 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: CRITICAL (A single DRC rule deck discrepancy or LVS short-circuit ruins the entire multi-thousand dollar commercial shuttle run and incurs a 4-6 month spin delay).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC/LVS hierarchy discrepancy causing undetected metal-to-metal bridging or floating substrate tap.
1. ALD precursor pulse/purge saturation drift inducing pinhole dielectric breakdown in crown capacitor array.
1. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) over-polish causing severe interconnect erosion and open circuits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Golden Rule Deck Physical Sign-Off** | KLayout / Magic / Pegasus Industrial Physical Verification Batch Engine | 1. Run 180nm DRC rule deck across 100% of mask layers (well, diffusion, poly, contact, M1-M3, pad). 2. Execute Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) netlist extraction against golden SPICE schematic. 3. Verify antenna ratio violations (< 250:1) and substrate noise isolation guard rings. | `DRC clean: 0 violations (Pass); LVS netlist match: 100% topological equivalence with 0 discrepancy (Pass).` |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-02` | **3D Crown Capacitor High-k Dielectric TEM & C-V Metrology** | Field-Emission TEM (FEI/Thermo Fisher) & High-Frequency C-V Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A) | 1. Prepare FIB lamella cross-section through 3D crown capacitor trench structure. 2. Measure physical film thickness and step coverage across bottom, sidewall, and top crown lip via HR-TEM. 3. Perform high-frequency (1 MHz) C-V sweep to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) and dielectric breakdown voltage. | `ALD step coverage >= 95% (Pass); EOT <= 0.8 nm (Pass); Dielectric leakage < 1.0 fA/cell at 1.0V (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive ESD booties, Pyrophoric precursor handling apron and dual-layer fluoropolymer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and UV-blocking safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Pyrophoric precursor emergency: TMA spontaneously ignites upon contact with air or moisture! Do NOT use water on metal alkyl fires. Smother immediately with dry vermiculite, dry sand, or Class D metal fire extinguisher. In case of ozone inhalation, move patient to fresh air immediately and administer supplemental oxygen.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ultra-high vacuum ALD exhaust manifold connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal decomposition burn-box and wet chemical scrubber. Continuous gas leak detection monitors for TMA/TEMAZ and ozone.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent ALD bubbler purging into mineral oil bubblers with inert argon ballast. CMP slurry effluent collected in settling basin, flocculated with alum, and neutralized to pH 6.5-8.0.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Trimethylaluminum (TMA)** | `75-24-1` | Electronic Grade (99.999% trace metals) | `Pyrophoric liquid ALD precursor` |
| **Tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)zirconium (TEMAZ)** | `175923-04-3` | High-purity ALD grade | `Liquid precursor for ZrO2 dielectric` |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-EDA-180-001  
**Title:** 180nm Open-Source PDK Ingestion and Toolchain Integration Setup  
**Classification:** EDA & PDK / Foundry Tapeout & PDK  
**Node Generation:** Gen 3 (180nm / Mature 180nm–130nm Hybrid Technology)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP establishes the ingestion, submodule population, liberty timing file regeneration, and EDA toolchain environment configuration for open-source mature 180nm/180nm–130nm hybrid technology PDKs (e.g., SkyWater open-source technology stack) supporting DRAM Foundation VN digital, analog, and custom array peripheral blocks.

---

### 2. Verified Literature & Architecture Context
- **Process Technology Stack:** Mature 180nm–130nm hybrid technology featuring:
  - Internal core voltage: $1.8\,\text{V}$ nominal
  - I/O operating voltage: $5.0\,\text{V}$ (operable at $2.5\,\text{V}$)
  - High-voltage capability: $10\,\text{V}$ regulated supply, extended-drain HV NMOS and PMOS
  - Metallization & Interconnect: 1 level of local interconnect (li1) + 5 levels of metal (met1 to met5)
  - Passive & Embedded Elements: High sheet-$\rho$ poly resistors, optional Metal-Insulator-Metal (MiM) capacitors, inductor-capable stack, and embedded SONOS non-volatile cells.
- **Upstream Repositories:** `google/skywater-pdk`, `foss-eda-tools.googlesource.com/skywater-pdk`.
- **Primary Source References:** *SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Overview & Architecture*.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           PDK Ingestion Workflow                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1: Clone PDK Repo]                                                         |
|         │                                                                         |
|         ▼                                                                         |
|  [Step 2: Submodule Ingestion (~7GB payload, SUBMODULE_VERSION=latest)]           |
|         │                                                                         |
|         ▼                                                                         |
|  [Step 3: Timing Liberty Regeneration (`make timing`)]                            |
|         │                                                                         |
|         ▼                                                                         |
|  [Step 4: Toolchain Integration Setup (OpenROAD, FASoC/BAG, Magic/KLayout)]       |
|         │                                                                         |
|         ▼                                                                         |
|  [Step 5: Technology Stack & Layer Map Integrity Audit]                           |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Upstream Repository Ingestion
1. Set workspace target directory and clone the base PDK repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/google/skywater-pdk.git pdk/skywater-pdk
   cd pdk/skywater-pdk
   ```

#### Step 2: Full Submodule Synchronization & Ingestion
1. Download all required standard cell libraries and analog/primitive models using parallel submodule population (handling payload allocation of approximately $7\,\text{GB}$):
   ```bash
   export SUBMODULE_VERSION=latest
   make submodules -j3 || make submodules -j1
   ```

#### Step 3: Liberty Timing File Regeneration
1. Trigger automated regeneration of `.lib` timing liberty files across characterization corners:
   ```bash
   make timing
   ```
2. Verify all standard digital cell library liberty decks are unpacked and validated under `libraries/` directory.

#### Step 4: Flow Integration & Environment Binding
1. Bind environment variables for target EDA flows:
   - **Digital Flow:** Point OpenROAD ASIC flow and OpenLane to the generated tech LEF, macro LEF, and regenerated `.lib` files.
   - **Analog & Memory Peripheral Flow:** Bind primitive model decks (`cells_primitive`) for analog generators (such as FASoC, Berkeley Analog Generator / BAG) and SPICE simulators.
   - **Physical Verification:** Integrate rule decks into Magic and KLayout for DRC/LVS.
   ```bash
   export PDK_ROOT="$(pwd)"
   export PDK="sky130A"
   ```

#### Step 5: Technology Stack Verification
1. Inspect the loaded design rules and technology definition to confirm layer stack instantiation:
   - 1 local interconnect layer (`li1`)
   - 5 metal routing layers (`met1`, `met2`, `met3`, `met4`, `met5`)
   - 1.8V core logic, 5.0V I/O devices, and 10V regulated device model libraries.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-PDK-01** | Total Ingested PDK Submodule Payload Footprint | $\approx 7$ | $\text{GB}$ (gigabytes) | Automated disk allocation check (`du -sh pdk/`) |
| **AC-PDK-02** | Interconnect Routing Metal Layers | $5$ routing layers + $1$ local interconnect layer | Count (Integer) | Automated parse of tech LEF / GDS layer-map |
| **AC-PDK-03** | Core Nominal Supply Voltage Model Mapping | $1.8$ | $\text{V}$ (volts) | SPICE model & Liberty nominal voltage header query |
| **AC-PDK-04** | Dual I/O Supply Voltage Operational Capability | $5.0$ (nominal) / $2.5$ (operable) | $\text{V}$ (volts) | SPICE/Lib operating condition corner check |
| **AC-PDK-05** | High-Voltage Regulated Supply Tolerance | $10$ | $\text{V}$ (volts) | HV extended-drain device model netlist inspection |

---

### 5. Literature Sources & Verification References
- **[SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Overview & Architecture]**:
  - Submodule payload footprint: `~7GB at time of writing`, submodule command: `SUBMODULE_VERSION=latest make submodules -j3 || make submodules -j1`.
  - Timing regeneration target: `make timing`.
  - Hybrid 180nm–130nm process stack definition: `1.8V internal with 5.0V I/Os (operable at 2.5V)`, `1 level of local interconnect`, `5 levels of metal`, `10V regulated supply`, `HV extended-drain NMOS and PMOS`.
  - EDA integration references: OpenROAD ASIC tool flow, FASoC, and Berkeley Analog Generator (BAG).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Ingesting open-source 180nm PDK assets (such as SkyWater SKY130/180 hybrid or IHP SG13G2/GF180MCU) requires an automated pipeline parsing GDSII/OASIS tech layers, LEF macro abstractions, Liberty (.lib) timing models, and SPICE model cards across heterogeneous open EDA tools (OpenROAD, Magic, KLayout, Netgen, Ngspice). Inconsistencies between commercial signoff definitions and open-source rule decks—especially grid quantization errors (5nm vs 1nm manufacturing grids) and contact enclosure tolerances—cause downstream DRC false positives or tapeout-blocking LVS discrepancies.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DRAM peripheral logic and sense amplifier front-end designs depend heavily on precise Vth matching, subthreshold leakage characterization, and high-voltage (HV) gate oxide handling (e.g. 5.0V I/O devices used for wordline overdrive up to 3.3V/5.0V). The ingested PDK must provide high sheet rho poly resistors, MiM capacitor models, and calibrated BSIM3v3/BSIM4 model decks with verified temperature corners (-40C to 125C). Without explicit extraction decks for substrate tap spacing and local interconnect parasitics, sense amplifier offset voltages will exceed the 15mV budget.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source PDK distribution relies on multi-gigabyte git submodules and remote tarballs subject to upstream release drift, upstream SHA commit mutations, and unverified third-party mirror outages. Procurement and ingestion must enforce immutable cryptographic commit hashing (SHA-256 tarball pinning), local air-gapped mirroring, and explicit dual-licensing audit (Apache 2.0 / BSD vs foundry proprietary non-disclosure addenda) to prevent IP contagion and toolchain breakages during MPW submission.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Toolchain setup milestones risk timeline slip if standard cell library characterization and DRC/LVS deck qualification are treated as serial, downstream tasks. Toolchain integration must validate DRC/LVS pass rates on golden test structures within Sprint 1, locking down exact tool revisions (OpenROAD commit hash, KLayout 0.28+, Magic 8.3+) to ensure multi-engineer environment determinism across both cloud CI and local workstations.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Layer map mismatch between KLayout DRC tech files and Magic extraction definitions, causing unflagged well-spacing violations and fatal latchup paths in DRAM peripheral driver circuits.
1. Incompatible Liberty timing syntax or missing non-linear delay model (NLDM) look-up tables in 180nm standard cells, resulting in OpenROAD static timing analysis (STA) crash or 10x pessimistic setup/hold slack violations.
1. Failure to model deep N-well (DNW) isolation and high-voltage wordline gate-oxide breakdown in SPICE BSIM cards, risking catastrophic dielectric breakdown during DRAM wordline boost pulsing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-1-01` | **Automated Golden Cell DRC Cleanliness and Deck Consistency Test** | KLayout Batch Mode (v0.28+) with Python standalone runner, Magic VLSI (v8.3+) batch engine, and automated diff parser | 1. Execute headless KLayout DRC on all golden standard cells and analog macro blocks (minimum 150 unique cells including D-flip-flops, level shifters, and sense amp primitives) using 'klayout -b -r 180nm_drc.lydrc -rd input_layout=cells.gds -rd report_file=drc_report.xml'. 2. Execute headless Magic DRC on identical GDSII layouts using 'magic -dnull -noconsole run_magic_drc.tcl'. 3. Parse generated XML and text violation logs; correlate rule violation IDs between both EDA decks. | `Total DRC violations across all golden standard cells must be strictly 0 for both KLayout and Magic decks. Inter-deck rule coverage mismatch must be 0% on standard DRC checks (diffusion width, poly-to-active spacing, metal pitch, contact enclosure).` |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-1-02` | **Subcircuit LVS Netlist Equivalence and Parasitic Extraction Verification** | Netgen LVS (v1.5+), Magic extraction engine, and Ngspice (v39+) transient simulation harness | 1. Run Netgen LVS comparing schematic CDL netlist against layout-extracted netlist: 'netgen -batch lvs cell_layout.spice cell_schematic.spice 180nm_setup.tcl lvs_report.out'. 2. Validate port naming, transistor aspect ratios (W/L), dummy poly identification, and passive component pin matching. 3. Execute Ngspice transient simulation (50ns duration) on extracted netlist to measure inverter chain propagation delay against schematic simulation. | `Netgen LVS report must return 'Equivalence: Circuits match uniquely' with 0 device, pin, or net mismatches. Delay delta between schematic and extracted post-layout simulation must not exceed +/- 8.0%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Anti-static ESD wrist strap and grounding cord (ANSI/ESD S20.20 compliant), Standard laboratory safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Nitrile protective gloves (powder-free, 4 mil thickness) for handling hardware server blades and media
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air. Eye Contact: Flush thoroughly with eyewash station water for at least 15 minutes. Skin Contact: Wash affected area with mild soap and water. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; seek immediate medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard computer server room HVAC system maintaining 20-22°C, relative humidity 40-50%, and minimum 15 air exchanges per hour; local fume extraction hood required if solvent wiping workstation surfaces.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-saturated lint-free cleanroom wipes in an approved, grounded, flame-resistant hazardous waste container; seal and label for certified chemical waste transfer.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: PDK repository cloned with verified cryptographic checksums and pristine uncharacterized file permissions.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: PDK file hierarchy validated, compiled into target EDA formats (LEF, GDS, techfile, SPICE models), and verified DRC/LVS clean.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Configuration drift between upstream bug-fix commits and uncommitted local rule deck overrides leading to unverified tapeout databases.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete, automated, reproducible 180nm open-source PDK ingestion and verification pipeline integrated into containerized CI/CD, providing turnkey compatibility for OpenROAD, Magic, KLayout, Netgen, and Ngspice with 100% verified DRC/LVS cleanliness on core DRAM standard cell and peripheral library components.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `pdk_ingestion_verification_report.pdf`
- [ ] `standard_cell_drc_lvs_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `pdk_toolchain_integration_manifest.json`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Standard cell library KLayout DRC pass rate across golden library cell count** | `100.0%` | 0.0% | Automated headless KLayout execution log audit script |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Netgen schematic-vs-layout equivalence matching rate across standard cell and sense amp macros** | `100.0%` | 0.0% | Netgen automated exit code check (exit code 0 and string match 'Circuits match uniquely') |
| `ASSERT-03` | **PDK automated continuous integration build and regression runtime on standard 8-core build runner** | `15.0` | +/- 2.5 minutes | CI pipeline execution timestamp log benchmarking |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All golden standard cells and reference DRAM peripheral macros pass KLayout DRC and Netgen LVS with zero errors; toolchain container successfully generates post-route GDSII and timing signoff reports with zero fatal exceptions, and deliverable artifacts are cryptographically signed by the EDA Lead and Systems Engineer.
