# Standard Operating Procedure: Custom DRAM 8F2 COB Cell DRC/LVS Rule Deck Adaptation and Layer Definition

**Category**: Physical Verification | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Adapting standard logic 180nm foundry DRC/LVS decks for an 8F2 Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture requires synthesizing non-standard design layers (SN_CONTACT, CAP_BOTTOM, HIGH_K, CAP_TOP/PLATE) while enforcing strict 0.259 um2 unit cell boundaries. The extraction engine must distinguish normal planar MOSFET contacts from high-aspect-ratio tungsten storage node plugs (SN contact) that land on the access transistor drain (W=220nm, L=180nm) without generating false spacing violations against orthogonal bitlines. Furthermore, substrate noise extraction and parasitic bitline capacitance (Cb target: 150-250 fF) must be calibrated in the LVS rule deck to prevent severe degradation of the Cb/Cs sensing ratio beyond the 9:1 margin threshold.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 8F2 folded bitline COB cell at 180nm, bitlines pass beneath the storage capacitors, requiring bitline contact (BC) and storage node contact (SNC) to operate under aggressive design rules: minimum contact-to-gate space (<= 45 nm overlay margin) and critical pitch of 2F = 360 nm. The DRC deck must implement strict enclosure and end-of-line (EOL) checks for the bottom electrode plate to prevent crown-to-crown dielectric punch-through. For LVS, the extraction deck must accurately model the 3D MIM/ONO capacitor as a dedicated 2-terminal cell instance (Cs nominal >= 28 fF) connected between the storage node net and the common cell plate (VCELL = VDD/2) rather than collapsing it into standard interconnect parasitics.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard open-source 180nm MPW runs (such as SkyWater 130/180nm or open commercial foundry equivalents) typically do not offer native high-k dielectric (Ta2O5/Al2O3) MIM capacitor module masks as standard line items. The layer map adaptations must clearly demarcate standard base masks from custom post-fab/R&D backend-of-line (BEOL) module masks. If these custom layers require non-standard reticle additions or e-beam lithography steps for low-volume tapeout, wafer procurement costs and shuttle qualification lead times will increase by 8 to 14 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rule deck adaptation schedule is tightly bounded by the tapeout freeze date; sign-off verification cannot wait for full physical silicon test vehicles. We need synthetic unit-cell, 2x2, and 16x16 macro arrays validated against both open-source (KLayout DRC/LVS, Magic) and commercial (Calibre/Pegasus) verification engines to ensure syntax and extraction parity. Any ambiguity in layer boolean definitions (e.g., cell plate polarity or contact overlap rules) directly risks delaying physical mask data preparation (MDP) sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. LVS soft-connect or short-circuit misidentification between storage node tungsten plug and adjacent bitline trace due to missing 3D vertical hierarchy layer boolean operators.
1. DRC false-clean sign-off on crown capacitor perimeter spacing under optical proximity correction (OPC) boundary conditions, inducing inter-cell dielectric breakdown and refresh failures.
1. Extraction engine failure to recognize common cell plate net (VCELL) biasing, causing floating-body node errors or massive false port-mismatch reports across large memory array blocks.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-2-01` | **Automated DRC Synthetic Matrix Validation for 8F2 COB Unit Cell and Array Pitch Rules** | KLayout batch DRC engine (v0.28+) and Siemens EDA Calibre nmDRC runner with automated error geometry parser and coordinate logging. | 1. Compile the custom 8F2 COB DRC rule deck containing adapted boolean layers (DIFF, POLY_WL, M1_BL, SNC_WPLUG, MIM_BTM, HIGH_K, MIM_TOP). 2. Execute batch DRC verification against the golden clean layout. 3. Execute batch DRC against perturbed layouts with injected DRC violations (-10 nm to +10 nm in 1 nm increments). 4. Extract violation coordinates, error classification types, and polygon count reports via Python CLI parsing script. | `Zero false-positive DRC violations on golden clean layout; 100% detection rate (zero false negatives) on injected layout perturbations spanning SNC-to-gate spacing (< 45 nm) and crown plate clearance (< 180 nm) within 0.1 nm coordinate precision.` |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-2-02` | **COB 1T1C Device Extraction and Netlist Topology Equivalence in LVS** | KLayout Deep LVS extraction module and Calibre nmLVS comparison tool coupled with SPICE parser and netlist topology graph comparator. | 1. Compile the adapted LVS rule deck defining active diffusion, access gate pin assignments, storage plug connectivity, and MIM/ONO capacitor recognition. 2. Run device extraction to generate extracted SPICE netlist from 1024-cell array layout. 3. Execute topological netlist graph comparison against golden schematic CDL netlist. 4. Verify extracted capacitance parameters and terminal polarity of the storage node capacitor instances. | `LVS clean report with 0 net mismatches, 0 port discrepancies, 0 unextracted device terminals; extracted cell storage capacitance per instance must fall within 28.0 fF +/- 2.8 fF (10% target extraction tolerance).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A fully encapsulating vapor protective suit with positive pressure SCBA for hazardous gas line maintenance, Cleanroom-compatible heavy-duty Viton outer gloves over double nitrile examination gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical impact face shield combined with anti-fog safety spectacles, Static-dissipative chemical-resistant neoprene overboots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of HF exposure: Immediately flush skin with copious cold water for 1 minute, then liberally apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel and massage continuously into affected area until emergency medical responders arrive; for inhalation of toxic fluorides (WF6/HF), evacuate victim to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen, and provide immediate calcium gluconate inhalation nebulizer treatment under medical supervision.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative-pressure exhaust ducting dedicated to acid and pyrophoric/fluorinated vapors with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) at all fume hoods; automated air monitoring with continuous toxic fluoride/hydride gas detection sensors interlocked to fab emergency gas shutoff (EGS).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: All acid and fluoride-bearing liquid effluents routed to segregated high-fluoride waste treatment sumps; neutralized with hydrated lime (Calcium Hydroxide, Ca(OH)2) to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) sludge, maintaining final discharge pH strictly between 6.5 and 8.5.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (WF6) for W-Plug Deposition** | `7783-82-6` | Semiconductor Grade (99.999% 5N) | `100% gas balance` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) for Pre-Contact Native Oxide Strip** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `49% aqueous solution (diluted to 10:1 BOE)` |
| **Tantalum Ethoxide (Ta(OC2H5)5) for High-k Capacitor Dielectric ALD** | `6074-84-6` | Ultra-High Purity ALD Grade (99.999%) | `99.8% liquid precursor` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade | `2.38% aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dilute HF-cleaned, hydrogen-terminated silicon active diffusion storage node contact surface, free of chemical oxide (native oxide thickness < 0.2 nm via spectroscopic ellipsometry).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Chemical vapor deposited Ti/TiN adhesion/barrier liner followed by continuous chemical-mechanical planarized (CMP) W-plug flush with inter-layer dielectric (ILD) top boundary.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Regrowth of native interfacial silicon oxide (SiO2 > 0.8 nm) inducing excessive storage node contact resistance (> 5 kOhm/plug), leading to RC write-time failure and cell refresh degradation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified, syntax-compatible, and empirically validated open-source DRC and LVS rule deck bundle supporting custom 180nm 8F2 Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) DRAM unit cells, array matrices, and peripheral sense-amplifier macros across KLayout and Calibre physical verification environments.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_cob_8f2_drc_rules_v1.0.lydrc`
- [ ] `dram180_cob_8f2_lvs_rules_v1.0.lylvs`
- [ ] `drc_lvs_regression_validation_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage node unit cell area strictly adheres to 8F2 folded bitline footprint at F = 180 nm** | `0.2592` | +/- 0.001 um2 | Automated polygon area extraction tool measurement on clean GDSII boundary cell 'DRAM_8F2_UNIT' |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Extracted storage node cell capacitance for unit cell layout** | `28.5` | +/- 2.5 fF | 3D field solver parasitic extraction (FastCap / Calibre xACT) integrated with LVS parameter extraction |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Detection recall rate of synthetic physical rule violations across cell and array regression matrix** | `100.0` | 0.0% | Automated test harness comparing injected synthetic violation coordinates against DRC error output database |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero unresolved DRC violations on complete 1Mb test array layout, 100% LVS netlist equivalence with zero topological mismatches against schematic CDL netlist, and successful generation of signoff checksum hash verified by Physical Verification Lead.

The Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been authored and documented in [`docs/sop_custom_dram_gds_layer_map_cob_mask_definition.md`](./docs/sop_custom_dram_gds_layer_map_cob_mask_definition.md).

### Summary of SOP Highlights

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Step 1: Layer Map   │
│      Definition      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Step 2: Active &   │
│   Gate Definition    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Step 3: Bitline &   │
│   W-Plug Formation   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Step 4: Capacitor   │
│  Over Bitline Mask   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Step 5: Physical   │
│  Verification & DRC  │
│         Rule         │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

#### 1. Procedural Execution & Physical Parameters
- **Unit Cell & Gate Dimensions**: Access NMOS channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, with gate oxide thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$.
- **Interconnect Pitch**: Wordline and bitline pitch strictly parameterized to $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$. Bitline contact (`CONT_BL`, `10:0`) shared between adjacent cell pairs in the $8F^2$ topology.
- **COB Stack Formation**: Buried tungsten plug (`SN_PLUG`, `15:0`) isolated from bitline conductors (`MET1_BL`, `11:0`) by $\ge 90\text{ nm}$; bottom crown electrode (`CAP_BOT`, `18:0`) erected above bitline; high-$\kappa$ dielectric (`CAP_DIEL`, `19:0`, $\kappa > 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$) capped with common top plate (`CAP_TOP`, `20:0`).

#### 2. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░                                   │
Cell Leakage (85C)┤░                                   │
                  │▒▒                                  │
   Cb/Cs Ratio Max┤▒▒                                  │
 Cb Max (512-cell)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
            Cs Min┤█████                               │
                  │█████                               │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                  0.0     62.5     125.0   187.5  250.0 
```

1. **Cell Footprint Area**: Nominal target **$0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$** ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
2. **Access Transistor Dimensions**: $L = 180\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ ($171\text{ to }189\text{ nm}$), $W = 220\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ ($209\text{ to }231\text{ nm}$).
3. **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)**: Minimum **$25.0\text{ fF/cell}$ to $30.0\text{ fF/cell}$** (nominal target **$28.0\text{ fF/cell}$**).
4. **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$) & Ratio**: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells per BL); $C_b / C_s$ ratio maintained strictly between **$5:1$ and $9:1$** ($< 10:1$).
5. **Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage**: **$< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** ensuring refresh retention time **$> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$**.

#### 3. Literature Citations
- *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
- *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets*
- *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Adapting standard 180nm CMOS logic baseline layers to accommodate a stacked Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture requires rigorous mapping of non-standard topological masks (Storage Node Contact SNC, Storage Node Plate SNP, Dielectric MIM/ONO, and Top Plate PL) without breaking baseline logic DRC layers. Overlay budgets between the Bitline Contact (BLC) and the Storage Node Contact (SNC) plug within the 8F^2 unit cell (0.259 um^2, L=180nm, W=220nm) exhibit zero marginal tolerance for mask misregistration. An unvalidated layer map risks causing short circuits between adjacent storage nodes and the bitline stack or creating false positive extraction errors in Calibre/KLayout LVS engines due to undefined connectivity pins.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm, an 8F^2 folded bitline COB layout requires a minimum storage capacitance Cs >= 28 fF to maintain a Cb/Cs ratio <= 9:1 against a 256/512-cell bitline parasitic budget (Cb = 150-250 fF). The GDS layer definition must explicitly define the high-aspect-ratio crown/cylinder etch mask and the high-k (Ta2O5/Al2O3) or ONO thin-film dielectric boundaries. If the GDS layer map fails to reserve separate physical masks for the tungsten storage node plug (W-plug/SNC) versus standard logic Contact (CONT/M1C), the chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) stop layers and selective RIE tapers will over-etch the bitline polysilicon/tungsten suicide (WSix) straps, causing catastrophic cell retention leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard 180nm open-source commercial MPW runs (such as SkyWater or standard mixed-signal fabs) natively support standard 5-to-6 metal CMOS stacks and do not include the 3 to 4 specialized mask steps required for crown COB capacitors (SNC mask, Bottom Electrode Plate mask, Capacitor Dielectric mask, Top Plate Plate Contact mask). Attempting to insert custom mask layers into a standard commercial multi-project wafer shuttle without formal foundry custom tapeout sign-off and validated reticle mask assignment tables will trigger immediate foundry rejection at pre-flight tape-in verification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The physical verification deck and GDS layer mapping deliverable must strictly decouple baseline foundry CMOS GDS layer/datatype pairs (e.g., standard layers 1-68) from the proprietary DRAM extension layers (e.g., layers 150-165). If layer numbers overlap with standard foundry utility, dummy-fill, or seal-ring layers, EDA tools will corrupt full-chip DRC clean runs and jeopardize the MPW submission milestone. Clear sign-off documentation, layer map translation tables, and continuous integration DRC test cases are required before any layout freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. GDS layer/datatype collision between custom DRAM COB storage masks (SNC/MIM) and standard foundry CMP dummy metal fill generation layers, leading to automated destruction of capacitor plates during optical proximity correction (OPC) and mask data preparation (MDP).
1. Bitline-to-Storage Node Contact bridging caused by inadequate lateral enclosure rules and mask overlay error (exceeding 25nm overlay budget) in the GDS DRC deck for the 8F^2 unit cell.
1. LVS soft-connect or pin short extraction failure where EDA extraction engines short the cell plate (PL) to circuit ground or substrate due to improper substrate/well layer definitions in the COB topological layer stack.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-2-1-01` | **Automated Layer Map Stream-In Integrity & Unit Cell Geometric DRC Validation** | KLayout Batch Mode (v0.28+) / Siemens Calibre nmDRC engine with custom DRAM techfile runset. | 1. Execute stream-in compilation of test GDSII array using custom layer map definitions via headless CLI parser. 2. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A cleanroom particulate suit with ESD grounding, Full face shield over chemical splash goggles, Heavy-duty double-layered butyl/fluoropolymer chemical handling gloves, Acid-resistant neoprene chemical apron and chemical safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid exposure: Immediately flush skin with copious emergency eyewash/shower water for 2-3 minutes, followed by continuous massage of 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the affected area until medical personnel arrive. In case of inhalation of HF or WF6 hydrolysis fumes, administer 100% oxygen and 2.5% nebulized calcium gluconate under medical supervision. For Trimethylaluminum fire: Smother with dry sand, vermiculite, or Class D dry powder; NEVER use water or CO2 extinguisher on TMA.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative-pressure exhaust enclosures (>= 1500 CFM) connected directly to dedicated Point-of-Use (POU) toxic gas thermal wet scrubbers. Continuous toxic gas monitoring systems (TGMS) for HF and WF6 calibrated at 0.5 ppm action limit with automated interlocks to pneumatic shutoff valves.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous fluoride-bearing effluents routed through automated automated chemical waste treatment systems: two-stage calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) precipitation to form insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) cake, pH neutralized between 6.5 and 8.5 before discharge. Organometallic ALD scrubber effluent collected into specialized flammable hazardous waste containment drums.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrofluoric acid (dHF) dip-cleaned silicon/polysilicon surface, native-oxide-free, hydrogen-passivated (Si-H terminated) storage node contact plug.

critics.systems_engineer: Adapting standard 180nm CMOS logic baseline layers to accommodate a stacked Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture requires rigorous mapping of non-standard topological masks (Storage Node Contact SNC, Storage Node Plate SNP, Dielectric MIM/ONO, and Top Plate PL) without breaking baseline logic DRC layers. Overlay budgets between the Bitline Contact (BLC) and the Storage Node Contact (SNC) plug within the 8F^2 unit cell (0.259 um^2, L=180nm, W=220nm) exhibit zero marginal tolerance for mask misregistration. An unvalidated layer map risks causing short circuits between adjacent storage nodes and the bitline stack or creating false positive extraction errors in Calibre/KLayout LVS engines due to undefined connectivity pins.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm, an 8F^2 folded bitline COB layout requires a minimum storage capacitance Cs >= 28 fF to maintain a Cb/Cs ratio <= 9:1 against a 256/512-cell bitline parasitic budget (Cb = 150-250 fF). The GDS layer definition must explicitly define the high-aspect-ratio crown/cylinder etch mask and the high-k (Ta2O5/Al2O3) or ONO thin-film dielectric boundaries. If the GDS layer map fails to reserve separate physical masks for the tungsten storage node plug (W-plug/SNC) versus standard logic Contact (CONT/M1C), the chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) stop layers and selective RIE tapers will over-etch the bitline polysilicon/tungsten suicide (WSix) straps, causing catastrophic cell retention leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.
critics.supply_chain: Standard 180nm open-source commercial MPW runs (such as SkyWater or standard mixed-signal fabs) natively support standard 5-to-6 metal CMOS stacks and do not include the 3 to 4 specialized mask steps required for crown COB capacitors (SNC mask, Bottom Electrode Plate mask, Capacitor Dielectric mask, Top Plate Plate Contact mask). Attempting to insert custom mask layers into a standard commercial multi-project wafer shuttle without formal foundry custom tapeout sign-off and validated reticle mask assignment tables will trigger immediate foundry rejection at pre-flight tape-in verification.
critics.laya_pm: The physical verification deck and GDS layer mapping deliverable must strictly decouple baseline foundry CMOS GDS layer/datatype pairs (e.g., standard layers 1-68) from the proprietary DRAM extension layers (e.g., layers 150-165). If layer numbers overlap with standard foundry utility, dummy-fill, or seal-ring layers, EDA tools will corrupt full-chip DRC clean runs and jeopardize the MPW submission milestone. Clear sign-off documentation, layer map translation tables, and continuous integration DRC test cases are required before any layout freeze.
critical_failure_modes: GDS layer/datatype collision between custom DRAM COB storage masks (SNC/MIM) and standard foundry CMP dummy metal fill generation layers, leading to automated destruction of capacitor plates during optical proximity correction (OPC) and mask data preparation (MDP).
Bitline-to-Storage Node Contact bridging caused by inadequate lateral enclosure rules and mask overlay error (exceeding 25nm overlay budget) in the GDS DRC deck for the 8F^2 unit cell.

LVS soft-connect or pin short extraction failure where EDA extraction engines short the cell plate (PL) to circuit ground or substrate due to improper substrate/well layer definitions in the COB topological layer stack.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 8F² COB Cell Geometric DRC Rule Deck Implementation & Coding

**Project:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Discipline:** Physical Verification / Custom DRAM PDK Rule Deck Implementation  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Gen 3 (Folded Bitline, Stacked Capacitor-Over-Bitline)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Layer Definition and  │
│      GDS Mapping       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Access Transistor    │
│    180nm DRC Rules     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Bitline and Shared   │
│     Contact Rules      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Stacked Capacitor    │
│   Crown and SN Rules   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│        DRC Deck        │
│    Verification and    │
│        Signoff         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### 1. Custom Layer Table Definition & GDSII Layer Mapping
- Declare and map custom DRAM array layers alongside standard CMOS layers:
  - Active Diffusion (`DIFF` / `OD`): GDS `1/0`
  - Polysilicon Wordline (`POLY` / `WL`): GDS `2/0`
  - Shared Bitline Contact (`BLC` / `CB`): GDS `15/0`
  - Bitline Metal/Polycide (`BL`): GDS `16/0`
  - Storage Node Contact Tungsten Plug (`SNC` / `W_PLUG`): GDS `20/0`
  - Stacked Crown Capacitor Bottom Electrode (`CROWN_BOT`): GDS `25/0`
  - Capacitor Dielectric / Top Plate (`CROWN_TOP`): GDS `26/0`
  - Array Boundary Marker (`DRAM_8F2_MARK`): GDS `99/0`

#### 2. Access Transistor DRC Rule Implementation (Folded 8F²)
- **Gate Length ($L$):** Implement exact check for access transistor channel length:
  $$\text{WIDTH } POLY \text{ INSIDE } DRAM\_8F2\_MARK == 0.180\,\mu\text{m}$$
- **Channel Width ($W$):** Implement active diffusion width check:
  $$\text{WIDTH } DIFF \text{ INSIDE } DRAM\_8F2\_MARK == 0.220\,\mu\text{m}$$
- **Gate Oxide Verification:** Enforce thermal dry oxidation gate dielectric layer with physical thickness $3.5\,\text{nm}$.
- **Wordline Pitch:** Enforce minimum wordline pitch:
  $$\text{PITCH } (WL) \ge 0.360\,\mu\text{m} \quad (\text{allowed range: } 0.360\,\mu\text{m} \text{ to } 0.400\,\mu\text{m})$$

#### 3. Shared Bitline & Contact Geometrical Rules
- **Shared Contact Geometry:** Check shared drain bitline contact (`BLC`) shared between two adjacent memory cells.
- **Bitline Pitch:** Enforce bitline metal/polycide pitch:
  $$\text{PITCH } (BL) \ge 0.360\,\mu\text{m} \quad (\text{allowed range: } 0.360\,\mu\text{m} \text{ to } 0.400\,\mu\text{m})$$
- **Total Unit Cell Area Verification:** Derive the unit memory cell footprint bounding polygon within the folded bitline layout:
  $$\text{AREA } (\text{Cell\_8F2}) == 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2 \quad (\pm 0.005\,\mu\text{m}^2, \text{ representing } 8F^2 \text{ at } F = 180\,\nm)$$

#### 4. Stacked Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) DRC Implementation
- **Tungsten Plug (`W-plug`):** Implement minimum enclosure of `SNC` (tungsten plug) by active storage drain and bottom electrode pad.
- **Crown/Cylinder Structure:** Define minimum inner spacing and outer diameter for crown-shaped polysilicon or MIM (Metal-Insulator-Metal) storage node.
- **Dielectric & EOT Integration Rule:** Enforce thickness and spacing checks for ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack to maintain equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) within $3.0\,\text{nm}$ to $4.0\,\text{nm}$ ($\kappa > 15$).

#### 5. Deck Compilation, Regression, & DRC Clean Sign-off
- Compile the geometric rule deck targeting standard physical verification engines (e.g., KLayout `drc` engine / Magic).
- Run against an array block of 256 and 512 cells per bitline.
- Verify zero false violations and complete boundary-cell wrap compliance.

---

### Geometric & Electrical Target Metrics

```text
                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                        │░░░                           │
       Min Cell Cap (fF)┤░░░                           │
                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
   Line Pitch BL/WL (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Access Transistor W (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓           │
                        │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓           │
Access Transistor L (nm)┤████████████████              │
                        │████████████████              │
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                         0     90      180    270   360 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Rule & Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Footprint Area** | **$0.259$** | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Bounding polygon DRC extraction on $8F^2$ array boundary at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$. |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions** | **$L = 180$, $W = 220$** | $\text{nm}$ | 2D edge-to-edge geometric width and length checking on channel layer. |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | **$360 \text{ to } 400$** | $\text{nm}$ | Minimum center-to-center / edge-to-edge pitch check on $WL$ (`POLY`) and $BL$ layers. |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 28$** (nominally $25 \text{ to } 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Post-layout extraction of crown capacitor structure ($EOT = 3.0 \text{ to } 4.0\,\text{nm}$, $\kappa > 15$). |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | **$5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$** (strict max $< 10.0 : 1$) | dimensionless ratio | Array extraction for 256/512 cells/BL ($C_b = 150 \text{ to } 250\,\text{fF}$). |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target** | **$< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE corner simulation for sub-threshold and junction leakage to support retention $> 64\,\text{ms}$. |

---

### Verified Context Citations
1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - Access transistor dimensions $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Shared bitline contact between adjacent cells.
   - Stacked crown capacitor erected via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - ONO / $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Storage capacitance target of minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ and leakage $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ cell area footprint $= 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$.
   - Storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25 \text{ to } 30\,\text{fF}$ (nominally $28\,\text{fF}$).
   - Bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150 \text{ to } 250\,\text{fF}$ across 256/512 cells.
   - Bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ bounded between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (must not exceed $10:1$).
3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
   - Minimum cell retention $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch $= 360\,\text{nm} \text{ to } 400\,\text{nm}$.
   - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $= 3 \text{ to } 4\,\text{nm}$.
   - Gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ ($850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 8F2 folded bitline COB cell architecture requires geometric DRC rule decks that tightly constrain both lateral design rules (minimum active area pitch of 360 nm and wordline pitch of 360 nm) and vertical stack clearances. Standard 180nm foundry digital CMOS decks do not incorporate rules for buried bitline contacts (BC) passing beneath capacitor storage nodes (SN) or crown/cylinder capacitor plate enclosures. A naive extension of digital DRC without dedicated multi-layer clearance checks between bitline Tungsten (W) plugs and Storage Node Contacts (SNC) will overlook parasitic cross-coupling risks and short circuits caused by overlay misalignment, directly threatening the C_b/C_s budget (<9:1).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm, an 8F2 unit cell has an area of exactly 0.259 um^2 (unit cell dimensions 2F x 4F = 360 nm x 720 nm). The DRC deck must codify strict geometric constraints: active area (OD) width W = 220 nm, poly gate length L = 180 nm, bitline contact (BLC) sharing between paired cells with >= 40 nm contact enclosure, and storage node contact landing pad extension >= 35 nm. Furthermore, capacitor-over-bitline (COB) requires rule definitions for the high-aspect-ratio cylinder storage node contact (aspect ratio ~8:1) including maximum allowable aspect-ratio dependent etch pitch, minimum node-to-node spacing of 180 nm, and capacitor top-plate boundary enclosures to prevent inter-cell leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Implementing custom DRC layers (e.g., SN, SNC, PLT, BLC) on top of open-source foundry 180nm PDKs (such as SkyWater or generic open 180nm MPW runs) must strictly map to existing reticle masking layers or defined MPW add-on modules. If custom DRC rules demand non-standard mask levels without verified photomask vendor tooling or foundry e-beam lithography compliance, the tapeout schedule will face qualification delays and unbudgeted non-recurring engineering (NRE) tooling charges.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rule deck coding in open-source EDA formats (KLayout DRC / Magic / OpenROAD) must achieve full functional equivalence with commercial Golden Signoff DRC (Calibre nmDRC). Failure to freeze exact layer boolean definitions, error reporting formats, and regression suites within the sprint timeline risks undetected physical layout violations propagating into GDSII/OASIS streaming, compromising the MPW tapeout milestone.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node contact (SNC) to bitline (BL) lateral bridging due to unconstrained corner-to-corner design rules under maximum lithographic overlay error (+/- 35 nm).
1. Insufficient storage node capacitor bottom electrode area leading to cell capacitance C_s dropping below 28 fF, driving C_b/C_s > 10:1 and resulting in sense amplifier read failure.

critics.systems_engineer: The 8F2 folded bitline COB cell architecture requires geometric DRC rule decks that tightly constrain both lateral design rules (minimum active area pitch of 360 nm and wordline pitch of 360 nm) and vertical stack clearances. Standard 180nm foundry digital CMOS decks do not incorporate rules for buried bitline contacts (BC) passing beneath capacitor storage nodes (SN) or crown/cylinder capacitor plate enclosures. A naive extension of digital DRC without dedicated multi-layer clearance checks between bitline Tungsten (W) plugs and Storage Node Contacts (SNC) will overlook parasitic cross-coupling risks and short circuits caused by overlay misalignment, directly threatening the C_b/C_s budget (<9:1).
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm, an 8F2 unit cell has an area of exactly 0.259 um^2 (unit cell dimensions 2F x 4F = 360 nm x 720 nm). The DRC deck must codify strict geometric constraints: active area (OD) width W = 220 nm, poly gate length L = 180 nm, bitline contact (BLC) sharing between paired cells with >= 40 nm contact enclosure, and storage node contact landing pad extension >= 35 nm. Furthermore, capacitor-over-bitline (COB) requires rule definitions for the high-aspect-ratio cylinder storage node contact (aspect ratio ~8:1) including maximum allowable aspect-ratio dependent etch pitch, minimum node-to-node spacing of 180 nm, and capacitor top-plate boundary enclosures to prevent inter-cell leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.
critics.supply_chain: Implementing custom DRC layers (e.g., SN, SNC, PLT, BLC) on top of open-source foundry 180nm PDKs (such as SkyWater or generic open 180nm MPW runs) must strictly map to existing reticle masking layers or defined MPW add-on modules. If custom DRC rules demand non-standard mask levels without verified photomask vendor tooling or foundry e-beam lithography compliance, the tapeout schedule will face qualification delays and unbudgeted non-recurring engineering (NRE) tooling charges.
critics.laya_pm: Rule deck coding in open-source EDA formats (KLayout DRC / Magic / OpenROAD) must achieve full functional equivalence with commercial Golden Signoff DRC (Calibre nmDRC). Failure to freeze exact layer boolean definitions, error reporting formats, and regression suites within the sprint timeline risks undetected physical layout violations propagating into GDSII/OASIS streaming, compromising the MPW tapeout milestone.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 1T1C Device Extraction & LVS Rule Deck Benchmark Validation

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation > Commercial Open-Source 180nm PDK Setup & Physical Verification Rule Decks > Custom DRAM 8F2 COB Cell DRC/LVS Rule Deck Adaptation and Layer Definition > 1T1C Device Extraction & LVS Rule Deck Benchmark Validation  
**Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make | **Author**: Domain Expert AI (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Persisted Documents**:
- SOP Document: [sop_1t1c_device_extraction_lvs.md](./docs/knowledge/sop_1t1c_device_extraction_lvs.md)
- Micro-Knowledge Document: [micro_knowledge_1t1c_lvs_benchmark.md](./docs/knowledge/micro_knowledge_1t1c_lvs_benchmark.md)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Layout GDS / Netlist  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Device Recognition &  │
│    Layer Derivation    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   1T Access FET & 1C   │
│    Node Extraction     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  LVS Comparison BL/WL  │
│      Connectivity      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Benchmark Acceptance  │
│       Evaluation       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Input Netlist & Layout Benchmark Ingestion**:
   - Ingest the schematic netlist containing the folded bitline complementary pair (`BL`, `/BL`), wordline (`WL`), equalization circuitry ($V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\ \text{V}$ precharge), and the 1T1C access transistor ($M_{access}$) coupled to storage capacitor ($C_s$).
   - Load the layout GDSII for the $8F^2$ folded bitline cell footprint ($A_{cell} = 8F^2 = 8 \times (0.18\ \mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).

2. **Layer Derivation & Device Recognition Rule Formulation**:
   - Derive the access NMOS gate region by boolean operations: `DIFF` AND `POLY` NOT `PPLUS` inside `PWELL` / substrate.
   - Map terminal pins: Access transistor Drain to `BL` contact, Source to internal Storage Node (`SN`), and Gate to Wordline (`WL`).
   - Define the Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) extraction layer: Storage node plate `CAP_BOT` (connected to `SN`), capacitor dielectric, and common top cell plate `CAP_TOP` (biased at $V_{DD}/2$).

3. **Device Parameter Extraction**:
   - Extract channel length and width of the access device against the target sub-micron geometry ($W / L = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} / 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ target baseline, nominal $L = 180\ \text{nm}$).
   - Extract storage node capacitance: verify extracted value satisfies $C_s \ge 25.0\ \text{fF}$ to $30.0\ \text{fF}$ (nominal $28.0\ \text{fF}$).
   - Extract parasitic bitline capacitance for 256/512 cells per bitline: verify baseline within $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$.

4. **Topology Matching & LVS Rule Validation**:
   - Run the LVS engine comparison between extracted layout netlist and golden schematic netlist.
   - Confirm $1:1$ port matching for pins (`BL`, `/BL`, `WL`, `V_PLATE`, `V_WELL`) with zero unwired nets, false opens, shorts, or floating storage nodes.

5. **Read Margin & Transistor Parameter Sanity Validation**:
   - Confirm the capacitance ratio:
     $$\frac{C_b}{C_s} \in [5:1, 9:1] \quad (\le 10:1 \text{ strict maximum limit})$$
   - Confirm differential readout signal development margin:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_b + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \ge 100\ \text{mV} \text{ to } 150\ \text{mV}$$
   - Verify access NMOS static parameters: linear threshold voltage $V_{thn} = +0.55\ \text{V} \pm 50\ \text{mV}$ (at $V_{DS} = 50\ \text{mV}$), $I_{on} \ge 500\ \mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ (at $V_{GS} = 1.8\ \text{V}$), $I_{off} \le 10\ \text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$ (at $V_{GS} = 0\ \text{V}$), with $I_{on} / I_{off} > 10^7$.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
C_s (Upper Min)┤███████████████████████████████████████│
  C_s (Nominal)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒   │

               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘

```

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Physical Folded 8F² Footprint | $0.259$ | $0.250 - 0.270$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | DRC / GDS Cell Boundary Extraction |
| **AC-02** | Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | $28.0$ | $25.0 - 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | LVS Extracted Device Parameter |
| **AC-03** | Bitline / Storage Cap Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | $7.0 : 1$ | $5.0 : 1 - 9.0 : 1$ (Max $\le 10.0 : 1$) | ratio | Column Parasitic Extraction (256/512 cells) |
| **AC-04** | Access NMOS Threshold Voltage ($V_{thn}$) | $+0.55$ | $+0.50 - +0.60$ | $\text{V}$ | Linear $g_m$ Extrapolation at $V_{DS} = 50\ \text{mV}$ |
| **AC-05** | Differential Read Margin ($\Delta V$) | $120$ | $100 - 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Readout Transient Simulation ($C_s = 25\ \text{fF}, C_b = 250\ \text{fF}$) |

---

### Literature Citations

1. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$.
   - Storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}$ to $30\ \text{fF}$ (nominally $28\ \text{fF}$).
   - Bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$ for 256/512 cells/BL.
   - Ratio $C_b / C_s = 5:1$ to $9:1$ (degradation threshold $> 10:1$).
2. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Equalization to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\ \text{mV} \text{ to } 150\ \text{mV}$ for $C_s = 25\ \text{fF}$ and $C_b = 250\ \text{fF}$.
3. **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**:
   - Access transistor geometry target: $W / L = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} / 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ ($180\ \text{nm}$).
   - $V_{thn} = +0.55\ \text{V} \pm 50\ \text{mV}$ at $V_{DS} = 50\ \text{mV}$.
   - $I_{on} \ge 500\ \mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$ ($V_{GS} = 1.8\ \text{V}$), $I_{off} \le 10\ \text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$ ($V_{GS} = 0\ \text{V}$), $I_{on} / I_{off} > 10^7$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 1T1C device extraction deck must rigorously resolve topological ambiguities between standard CMOS logic MOSFETs and 8F2 Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) cell access transistors, specifically discriminating the shared recessed bitline junction from the isolated storage node plug. Failure to encode cell-specific recognition layers (e.g., DRAM_CELL marker, SN_PLUG, and PLATE layers) leads to false netlist short/open topology violations and corrupts the hierarchical parasitic extraction (PEX) engine, preventing accurate simulation of read-sense margin and cell retention time.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical LVS extraction in open-source engines (e.g., KLayout pycell/lvs, Magic) must validate non-standard 3D capacitor geometries against SPICE subcircuits. For a Gen 3 180nm 8F2 cell, the access transistor subthreshold swing must remain S <= 75 mV/dec with sub-threshold off-state leakage I_off <= 10 pA/um to guarantee the mandatory 64 ms refresh retention window across the -40 deg C to +85 deg C envelope, while the storage node contact extraction must precisely account for the junction-to-substrate perimeter and area diode parameters.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial MPW tapeout runs on 180nm mixed-signal/embedded-DRAM platforms impose stringent GDSII/OASIS layer assignment rules. Re-purposing standard foundry metal layers for the storage node bottom electrode (BE) and top plate (TE) without verified foundry DRC/LVS waiver agreements risks hard tool rejection at the foundry tapeout mask data preparation (MDP) gate, triggering NRE re-spin penalties and schedule delays exceeding 12 to 16 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The physical verification benchmark must achieve zero-false-positive and zero-false-negative LVS clean sign-off across a benchmark suite of at least 1,024 test cell instances before freezing the PDK rule deck. Milestone sign-off must not slip past the tapeout freeze date; automated CI regression runs comparing KLayout LVS against golden Calibre LVS must execute cleanly within 15 minutes per benchmark run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage Node Merging and Netlist Disconnection: Omission of cell boundary boolean sizing logic in the LVS rule deck causes adjacent storage nodes across 8F2 wordline passes to merge into a single node or misidentify the capacitor dielectric, resulting in an unflagged cell-to-cell short circuit.
1. Threshold and Leakage Inversion Error: Incorrect recognition of halo and low-doped drain (LDD) implant layers for memory access NMOS versus standard 1.8V peripheral NMOS produces inaccurate SPICE model card assignment, underestimating access transistor junction leakage by more than 2 orders of magnitude.
1. Bitline/Plate Grounding Ambiguity: Failure to resolve high-impedance floating cell plate nets from chip-level analog ground (VSS/VBB) during LVS pin mapping leads to false pass reports while the physical plate remains completely unpolarized.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |

critics.systems_engineer: The 1T1C device extraction deck must rigorously resolve topological ambiguities between standard CMOS logic MOSFETs and 8F2 Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) cell access transistors, specifically discriminating the shared recessed bitline junction from the isolated storage node plug. Failure to encode cell-specific recognition layers (e.g., DRAM_CELL marker, SN_PLUG, and PLATE layers) leads to false netlist short/open topology violations and corrupts the hierarchical parasitic extraction (PEX) engine, preventing accurate simulation of read-sense margin and cell retention time.
critics.domain_expert: Physical LVS extraction in open-source engines (e.g., KLayout pycell/lvs, Magic) must validate non-standard 3D capacitor geometries against SPICE subcircuits. For a Gen 3 180nm 8F2 cell, the access transistor subthreshold swing must remain S <= 75 mV/dec with sub-threshold off-state leakage I_off <= 10 pA/um to guarantee the mandatory 64 ms refresh retention window across the -40 deg C to +85 deg C envelope, while the storage node contact extraction must precisely account for the junction-to-substrate perimeter and area diode parameters.
critics.supply_chain: Commercial MPW tapeout runs on 180nm mixed-signal/embedded-DRAM platforms impose stringent GDSII/OASIS layer assignment rules. Re-purposing standard foundry metal layers for the storage node bottom electrode (BE) and top plate (TE) without verified foundry DRC/LVS waiver agreements risks hard tool rejection at the foundry tapeout mask data preparation (MDP) gate, triggering NRE re-spin penalties and schedule delays exceeding 12 to 16 weeks.
critics.laya_pm: The physical verification benchmark must achieve zero-false-positive and zero-false-negative LVS clean sign-off across a benchmark suite of at least 1,024 test cell instances before freezing the PDK rule deck. Milestone sign-off must not slip past the tapeout freeze date; automated CI regression runs comparing KLayout LVS against golden Calibre LVS must execute cleanly within 15 minutes per benchmark run.
critical_failure_modes: Storage Node Merging and Netlist Disconnection: Omission of cell boundary boolean sizing logic in the LVS rule deck causes adjacent storage nodes across 8F2 wordline passes to merge into a single node or misidentify the capacitor dielectric, resulting in an unflagged cell-to-cell short circuit.

Threshold and Leakage Inversion Error: Incorrect recognition of halo and low-doped drain (LDD) implant layers for memory access NMOS versus standard 1.8V peripheral NMOS produces inaccurate SPICE model card assignment, underestimating access transistor junction leakage by more than 2 orders of magnitude.

Bitline/Plate Grounding Ambiguity: Failure to resolve high-impedance floating cell plate nets from chip-level analog ground (VSS/VBB) during LVS pin mapping leads to false pass reports while the physical plate remains completely unpolarized.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Physical Verification Sign-off Deck Benchmark Validation and Extraction Calibration

**Category**: Metrology | **Generation**: Gen 3 (nm)


---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Calibrating parasitic RC extraction decks (PEX/QRC) against physical wafer metrology rather than synthetic TCAD requires closed-loop de-embedding of test coupon pad parasitics. If the spectroscopic ellipsometry film thicknesses for interlayer dielectrics (ILD) and cross-sectional SEM/AFM profiles for metal lines are not systematically correlated with S-parameter or Kelvin bridge DC measurements, the physical verification deck will introduce systematic skew into the DRAM sensing margin simulations, corrupting tRCD and tRP sign-off corners.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node for DRAM peripheral and open-bitline cell arrays, optical dispersion modeling via Cauchy (n(lambda) = A + B/lambda^2 + C/lambda^4) for thick oxide/nitride stacks requires rigorous calibration across 240nm to 800nm spectral ranges. Neglecting the extinction coefficient k in absorbing anti-reflective coatings (BARC) or underestimating the sidewall angle (SWA) variation of polysilicon wordlines introduces up to 12% capacitance overestimation in 2.5D field solver rule decks, leading to false DRC/LVS flags or pessimistic bitline capacitance (Cbl) budgets.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated spectroscopic reflectometry and variable-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry (VASE) calibration standards (NIST-traceable SiO2/Si reference wafers) have lead times exceeding 16 weeks. Furthermore, relying on foundry-proprietary Golden Calibre runsets while generating an open-source (Magic/KLayout/OpenRCX) compatible rule deck risks licensing friction; open-source calibration structures must be designed entirely using non-proprietary MPW coupon layouts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off benchmark validation sits directly on the critical path to tapeout GDSII freeze. Any delay in closing the delta between optical film metrology, electric parametric test (e-test), and the OpenRCX extraction deck pushes the foundry MPW submission window by a minimum of one quarter, burning substantial non-recurring engineering (NRE) capital.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interlayer dielectric (ILD1/ILD2) thickness mismatch between Cauchy optical ellipsometry fitting and TEM physical cross-section exceeding 5%, causing severe parasitic capacitance miscalibration across M1-to-WL couplings.
1. Miscorrelation of 2D/3D field solver mesh density in open-source extraction engines (OpenRCX) leading to non-convergence or under-extraction of fringe capacitances (Cfringe) on dense DRAM bitline contact plugs (CB/SN).
1. Inadequate de-embedding of test pad contact resistance in Kelvin and serpentine test structures, contaminating sheet resistance (Rsheet) extraction tables.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-3-01` | **Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) Stack Optical Metrology and PEX Dielectric Constant Calibration** | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (210-1000 nm, 65°-75° variable incident angle) with 49-point wafer mapping and 4-Point Probe Sheet Resistance Station | 1. Load coupon wafer onto the automated vacuum chuck and align fiducials. 2. Execute a 49-point polar mapping scan measuring Psi and Delta across 240-800 nm. 3. Fit data using a Sellmeier/Cauchy dispersion model to extract physical thickness (t_ILD) and refractive index n at 632.8 nm across all 49 sites. 4. Measure dielectric breakdown voltage and CV-quasistatic capacitance on dedicated MOS capacitor dot structures. 5. Feed extracted t_ILD and calculated relative permittivity (eps_r) into the physical verification extraction rule deck config. 6. Execute 3D field solver extraction on a benchmark M1-over-substrate comb structure and compare against measured C-V dot capacitance. | `Dielectric thickness uniformity across 49 points must satisfy 1-sigma < 1.2 nm. Mean extracted thickness delta versus target (650 nm) must be <= ±2.0 nm. Simulated vs measured fringe/area capacitance delta must be <= 3.0%.` |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-3-02` | **Multi-Layer Interconnect Serpentine and Comb Benchmark Extraction vs Physical Parametric Validation** | Semi-automatic Cryogenic/Thermal Analytical Probe Station with Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer (HR-SMU modules) | 1. Contact 4-point Kelvin pads for Metal 1 serpentine test structure (length 50,000 um, width 0.28 um). 2. Force I_force = 1.0 mA DC; sense V_sense to compute total line resistance R_line and sheet resistance R_sq. 3. Switch to interleaved comb capacitor pads (spacing 0.28 um, total run 100,000 um) and measure total line-to-line capacitance C_total at 100 kHz (100 mV AC excitation). 4. Run OpenRCX physical verification extraction on identical layout GDS benchmark coupon using calibrated techfile. 5. Perform automated discrepancy extraction comparing measured R_sq, R_line, and C_total against OpenRCX SPEF netlist values. | `Extracted resistance R_sq deviation between measured and OpenRCX extracted values must be <= 2.5%. Extracted line-to-line coupling capacitance C_total discrepancy must not exceed ±4.0% across all 9 die quadrants.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser-blocking safety glasses, Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) safe flame-retardant cleanroom lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure (if verifying test coupons via oxide dip): Immediately flush skin with copious cold water for 2 minutes, then liberally massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into the affected area, reapplying every 10 minutes until emergency medical services arrive. For eye contact, flush with sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye solution or normal saline for 15 minutes. For IPA exposure: Flush affected skin/eyes with tap water for 15 minutes; provide fresh air if vapors cause dizziness.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench operations must be performed under continuous laminar downward flow with localized wet scrubbed exhaust ducting maintaining face velocity of 0.5 ± 0.1 m/s (100 FPM). Ellipsometer and probe stations require dedicated enclosure exhaust with dry N2 blow-off exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate all aqueous fluoride-bearing waste into dedicated fluoropolymer containers. Treat fluoride effluent with saturated Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2), maintaining pH between 8.5 and 9.5 prior to certified hazardous disposal. Spent IPA must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-rated stainless steel solvent receptacles.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade (SEMI C4) | `> 99.8%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (buffered, BOE 6:1) - for oxide strip coupon check** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C8) | `6.8% HF : 34.6% NH4F` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (N2 gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 (UHP) | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly CMP-planarized, post-megasonic DI rinsed, spin-dried ILD oxide surface, free of organic residues, metallic contamination (< 1E10 atoms/cm2), and particulate defectivity (> 0.2 um defect count < 10 per 200mm wafer).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Spectroscopically characterized, non-destructive optical probed dielectric surface; clean, native-oxide stable, packaged under dry nitrogen purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive queue time in cleanroom air leads to airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (volatile organic compounds and airborne boron/phosphorus siloxanes) and moisture absorption into unannealed TEOS/USG dielectric layers, skewing refractive index n by > 0.015 and distorting relative permittivity eps_r by > 5%, resulting in flawed extraction techfile generation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete empirical calibration of the 180nm Open-Source DRAM Physical Verification and Parasitic Extraction Deck (PEX) closing the loop between non-destructive optical ellipsometry, electrical parametric test vehicle measurements, and open-source sign-off rule decks (KLayout DRC/LVS, OpenRCX).

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `ILD_Dielectric_Spectroscopic_49pt_Map_Report.csv`
- [ ] `OpenRCX_Extraction_Benchmark_Correlation_Signoff.pdf`
- [ ] `Kelvin_Serpentine_Parametric_Verification_Data.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Optical spectroscopic ellipsometry ILD1 thickness fitting mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) across 49 points** | `0.35%` | <= 0.50% | Sellmeier optical dispersion model regression fitting against variable angle reflectometry/ellipsometry data. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **OpenRCX extraction rule deck capacitance error vs Keysight B1500A multi-frequency comb test coupon measurements** | `2.1%` | <= 3.5% | Comparison of SPEF-extracted lumped and distributed C_fringe/C_area values against 100 kHz C-V parametric bridge data. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **KLayout DRC/LVS physical sign-off deck execution clean rate on 180nm DRAM test array benchmark cell** | `100.0%` | 0 violations (false positives == 0) | Automated rule deck regression run across golden DRAM array GDS layout benchmarks. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal sign-off requires zero false-positive DRC/LVS flags across the standard 180nm DRAM core benchmark layout, RC extraction variance <= 3.5% across all metal layers against physical e-test parametric structures, and formal sign-off checklist approval by both the Systems Engineer and Lead Metrology Domain Expert.

testcases.procedure: 1. Load coupon wafer onto the automated vacuum chuck and align fiducials. 2. Execute a 49-point polar mapping scan measuring Psi and Delta across 240-800 nm. 3. Fit data using a Sellmeier/Cauchy dispersion model to extract physical thickness (t_ILD) and refractive index n at 632.8 nm across all 49 sites. 4. Measure dielectric breakdown voltage and CV-quasistatic capacitance on dedicated MOS capacitor dot structures. 5. Feed extracted t_ILD and calculated relative permittivity (eps_r) into the physical verification extraction rule deck config. 6. Execute 3D field solver extraction on a benchmark M1-over-substrate comb structure and compare against measured C-V dot capacitance.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Dielectric thickness uniformity across 49 points must satisfy 1-sigma < 1.2 nm. Mean extracted thickness delta versus target (650 nm) must be <= ±2.0 nm. Simulated vs measured fringe/area capacitance delta must be <= 3.0%.

testcases.title: Multi-Layer Interconnect Serpentine and Comb Benchmark Extraction vs Physical Parametric Validation
testcases.instrumentation: Semi-automatic Cryogenic/Thermal Analytical Probe Station with Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer (HR-SMU modules)
testcases.pre_conditions: Passivated wafer coupon containing calibrated Kelvin cross-bridges, serpentine resistors, and interleaved comb capacitors for Poly, M1, and M2 layers. Chamber purged with dry N2 to dew point < -40 °C at 25 °C.
testcases.procedure: 1. Contact 4-point Kelvin pads for Metal 1 serpentine test structure (length 50,000 um, width 0.28 um). 2. Force I_force = 1.0 mA DC; sense V_sense to compute total line resistance R_line and sheet resistance R_sq. 3. Switch to interleaved comb capacitor pads (spacing 0.28 um, total run 100,000 um) and measure total line-to-line capacitance C_total at 100 kHz (100 mV AC excitation). 4. Run OpenRCX physical verification extraction on identical layout GDS benchmark coupon using calibrated techfile. 5. Perform automated discrepancy extraction comparing measured R_sq, R_line, and C_total against OpenRCX SPEF netlist values.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Extracted resistance R_sq deviation between measured and OpenRCX extracted values must be <= 2.5%. Extracted line-to-line coupling capacitance C_total discrepancy must not exceed ±4.0% across all 9 die quadrants.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom compatible nitrile gloves (double gloving)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/laser-blocking safety glasses
Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) safe flame-retardant cleanroom lab coat

cas_chemicals.name: Hydrofluoric Acid (buffered, BOE 6:1) - for oxide strip coupon check

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For HF exposure (if verifying test coupons via oxide dip): Immediately flush skin with copious cold water for 2 minutes, then liberally massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into the affected area, reapplying every 10 minutes until emergency medical services arrive. For eye contact, flush with sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye solution or normal saline for 15 minutes. For IPA exposure: Flush affected skin/eyes with tap water for 15 minutes; provide fresh air if vapors cause dizziness.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Wet chemical bench operations must be performed under continuous laminar downward flow with localized wet scrubbed exhaust ducting maintaining face velocity of 0.5 ± 0.1 m/s (100 FPM). Ellipsometer and probe stations require dedicated enclosure exhaust with dry N2 blow-off exhaust ducting.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Segregate all aqueous fluoride-bearing waste into dedicated fluoropolymer containers. Treat fluoride effluent with saturated Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2), maintaining pH between 8.5 and 9.5 prior to certified hazardous disposal. Spent IPA must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-rated stainless steel solvent receptacles.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly CMP-planarized, post-megasonic DI rinsed, spin-dried ILD oxide surface, free of organic residues, metallic contamination (< 1E10 atoms/cm2), and particulate defectivity (> 0.2 um defect count < 10 per 200mm wafer).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Spectroscopically characterized, non-destructive optical probed dielectric surface; clean, native-oxide stable, packaged under dry nitrogen purge.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Excessive queue time in cleanroom air leads to airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption (volatile organic compounds and airborne boron/phosphorus siloxanes) and moisture absorption into unannealed TEOS/USG dielectric layers, skewing refractive index n by > 0.015 and distorting relative permittivity eps_r by > 5%, resulting in flawed extraction techfile generation.

expected_result.summary: Complete empirical calibration of the 180nm Open-Source DRAM Physical Verification and Parasitic Extraction Deck (PEX) closing the loop between non-destructive optical ellipsometry, electrical parametric test vehicle measurements, and open-source sign-off rule decks (KLayout DRC/LVS, OpenRCX).

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Optical spectroscopic ellipsometry ILD1 thickness fitting mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) across 49 points
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Sellmeier optical dispersion model regression fitting against variable angle reflectometry/ellipsometry data.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: OpenRCX extraction rule deck capacitance error vs Keysight B1500A multi-frequency comb test coupon measurements
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Comparison of SPEF-extracted lumped and distributed C_fringe/C_area values against 100 kHz C-V parametric bridge data.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: KLayout DRC/LVS physical sign-off deck execution clean rate on 180nm DRAM test array benchmark cell
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated rule deck regression run across golden DRAM array GDS layout benchmarks.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Formal sign-off requires zero false-positive DRC/LVS flags across the standard 180nm DRAM core benchmark layout, RC extraction variance <= 3.5% across all metal layers against physical e-test parametric structures, and formal sign-off checklist approval by both the Systems Engineer and Lead Metrology Domain Expert.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: DRC/LVS Sign-off Test Coupon Suite & Golden Testcase Preparation

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Coupon Layout Prep   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  DRC Benchmark Suite   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  LVS Extraction Suite  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Signoff Tapeout     │
│        Approval        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the physical layout construction, rule deck calibration, and extraction sign-off verification for the test coupon suite and golden testcases targeted for the 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip MPW tapeout.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: Unit Cell & Test Coupon Layout Construction
1. Instantiate the foundational 1T1C DRAM access NMOS device with:
   - Channel Length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$
   - Channel Width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$
2. Place adjacent memory cells sharing a common tungsten plug (W-plug) bitline contact to minimize parasitic diffusion area.
3. Lay out the golden test coupon suite covering both layout topologies:
   - **Folded Bitline ($8F^2$) Coupon**: Cell area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
   - **Open Bitline ($6F^2$) Coupon**: Cell area $= 0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
4. Construct the stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) crown-shaped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) test structures directly over the drain contact plug with an ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
5. Construct bitline array matrix coupon blocks for both 256 cells/bitline and 512 cells/bitline configurations.

#### Step 2: DRC Sign-off Rule Deck Execution & Validation
1. Execute the 180nm physical verification DRC sign-off deck against the layout coupon suite.
2. Verify strict compliance on critical dimension (CD) rules:
   - Gate poly length check ($180\text{ nm}$ minimum gate pitch/spacing).
   - W-plug contact-to-active enclosure and spacing.
   - COB crown capacitor minimum enclosure, spacing, and aspect ratio tolerances.
3. Ensure zero DRC design rule violations across all cell arrays and boundary dummy cells.

#### Step 3: LVS Extraction Calibration & Parasitic Validation
1. Execute device recognition and connectivity extraction across the test coupon netlists.
2. Calibrate parasitic extraction rules (PEX) against analytical capacitance budgets:
   - Extract storage node capacitance ($C_s$).
   - Extract bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) across array coupons of 256 and 512 cells per bitline.
   - Verify the extraction model maintains the bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio ($C_b / C_s$) within nominal operating limits.
3. Validate access transistor junction and sub-threshold leakage extraction models at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

#### Step 4: Golden Testcase Sign-off Package Preparation
1. Freeze and archive GDSII/OASIS coupon layout cells along with golden SPICE netlists.
2. Sign off the runset configuration scripts for automated CI/regression physical verification.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value / Limit | Physical Units | Pass/Fail Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25.0$ to $30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Measured extracted nominal $C_s \ge 28.0\text{ fF/cell}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150.0$ to $250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted array block ($256$ or $512$ cells/BL) $\le 250.0\text{ fF}$ |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1$ to $9.0 : 1$ (Hard Limit: $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless (Ratio) | Fail if $C_b / C_s \ge 10.0 : 1$ (read margin degradation limit) |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Extracted sub-threshold + junction leakage $< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ |
| **Physical Unit Cell Area ($8F^2$ Folded BL)** | $0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Must match target geometry within $0.000\ \mu\text{m}^2$ DRC grid |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
- **Source 1**: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets*
  - Verified: $8F^2$ cell area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$), $6F^2$ cell area ($0.194\ \mu\text{m}^2$); storage capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$); bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells/BL); capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ bound between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (severe degradation if $> 10:1$).
- **Source 2**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Verified: Unit cell geometry length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; tungsten plug (W-plug) shared bitline contact; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB); dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 3**: *SkyWater 130nm Open PDK Overview & Architecture*
  - Verified: Open PDK structure and tool-flow benchmark methodology.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Sign-off test coupons must validate not only standard digital logic DRC/LVS rules, but specifically the DRAM-critical design rules: folded bitline 360 nm pitch (2F), active area diagonal jogging, 1T1C storage node contact (SNC) landing pads, and inter-metal dielectric spacing for parasitic capacitance matching. If the golden testcase suite fails to isolate systematic false positives in the dense array versus true electrical violations in sense amplifier pitch-matching logic, physical verification sign-off will bottleneck MPW submission timelines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 8F^2 folded bitline topology (0.259 um^2 per cell at F=180nm), wordline-to-bitline and bitline-to-storage-node capacitive coupling dominates the read margin. The DRC/LVS deck must rigorously verify 3D proximity rules, dummy pattern fill exclusion zones over sense amplifiers, and recognize the custom 1T1C 28 fF capacitor sub-circuit without collapsing parallel storage nodes into an erroneous single lumped element during LVS netlist reduction.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source PDK physical verification decks (Magic, KLayout, OpenROAD) frequently diverge from foundry sign-off decks (Calibre, Pegasus). If test coupon testcases and rule deck calibrations do not achieve 100% parity across both open-source and proprietary golden sign-off runs prior to mask freeze, the MPW vendor will reject the GDSII/OASIS release, resulting in delayed fabrication slots and re-spin costs exceeding $45,000.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Coupons must be partitioned into modular 50 um x 50 um metrology pads and inline CD-SEM targets compatible with foundry inline optical review and wafer scribe-line allocation. Golden testcase synthesis and LVS benchmark extraction must be fully automated in CI/CD regressions to complete in under 2 hours without manual intervention.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. LVS netlist reduction incorrectly merges adjacent 1T1C cell storage nodes sharing a common plate node (V_PL), masking unintended short circuits between neighboring storage nodes.
1. DRC corner-rounding and litho-bias rule deck discrepancies fail to flag minimum enclosure violations of bitline contacts over active diffusion jog boundaries, causing catastrophic open-bitline defects post-CMP.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-3-1-01` | **Dense Folded Bitline Array DRC Rule Deck Parity & Pitch Violation Benchmark** | KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) / Mentor Calibre DRC v2022.4 inline batch runner, GDSII/OASIS layout viewer, CD-SEM automated layout inspection correlation engine. | 1. Execute automated DRC rule deck across 'dram_8f2_array_coupon.gds' using the open-source KLayout batch verification script. 2. Record coordinates and error classes for all reported geometric and electrical design rule violations. 3. Execute reference foundry golden sign-off deck (Calibre nmDRC) on the identical coupon. 4. Cross-tabulate reported violations, false positive flags, and missed edge checks (false negatives) across layers M1, POLY, DIFF, and CONTACT. 5. Validate CD-SEM metrology alignment coordinates against layout marker coordinates. | `DRC violation reporting parity between open-source and golden sign-off deck must be exactly 100.0% (0 false negatives, 0 false positives) on all intentional pitch violations down to 140 nm; zero unhandled DRC exceptions in 360 nm pitch cell array.` |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-3-1-02` | **1T1C Folded Bitline Sense Amp LVS Netlist Extraction & Device Recognition Validation** | Netgen v1.5 / KLayout LVS / Calibre nmLVS comparison engine, SPICE parser, CD-SEM electrical probe correlation station. | 1. Stream out GDSII for the 1024-cell folded bitline coupon with V_PL (cell plate), BL, BL_bar, WL, SAP, and SAN routing. 2. Run extraction deck to generate extracted SPICE netlist including 1T1C storage capacitor entities (nominal target Cs = 28 fF) and parasitic bitline capacitance Cb. 3. Perform LVS comparison against golden reference schematic. 4. Run parameter extraction check verifying reported cell capacitor nominal values and aspect ratio compliance. 5. Inspect pin-swapping and short/open reporting diagnostics under intentionally induced storage node bridge defects. | `LVS status must report 'NETLISTS MATCH' with exactly 0 net errors, 0 device errors, and 0 pin misalignments; extracted Cs value must calculate within 28.0 fF +/- 1.4 fF across all 1024 instances with 0 merged node anomalies.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/chemical safety glasses, Class 100 cleanroom antistatic ESD coat and shoe covers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with solvent cleaners during metrology test coupon preparation: flush affected area immediately with eyewash or safety shower for a minimum of 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, evacuate person to fresh air and seek medical attention if irritation or respiratory distress persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Coupon solvent cleaning and optical metrology inspection must occur within a dedicated laminar flow hood with minimum 100 FPM face velocity and integrated VOC exhaust ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA and acetone solvent rinses must be collected into designated, grounded conductive solvent waste containers labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'; do not drain dispose or mix with aqueous or acid waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier 3) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly developed/stripped physical coupon wafer post-metal etch with clean hydrophobic native oxide or passivated top metal surface (M1/M2/Al pad).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry, contamination-free, particle-verified coupon ready for inline CD-SEM and automated optical inspection (< 5 particles > 0.18 um per coupon die).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air exposure causes airborne moisture and organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC) adsorption onto open metrology structures, skewing CD-SEM edge detection and yielding false physical dimension non-conformances.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed physical verification golden coupon suite including fully DRC/LVS clean GDSII/OASIS layouts, comprehensive rule deck cross-matching reports, and extraction calibration files for 180nm 1T1C 8F^2 folded bitline DRAM arrays.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_signoff_coupon_suite.gds`
- [ ] `drc_lvs_benchmark_parity_report.csv`
- [ ] `extraction_capacitance_calibration_summary.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Open-source vs foundry sign-off DRC violation parity on intentional rule-breaking matrix** | `100.0` | +/- 0.0% | Automated diff analysis of KLayout DRC vs Calibre nmDRC ASCII error log reports |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Folded bitline storage cell capacitor extracted nominal value** | `28.0 fF` | +/- 5.0% | Post-layout parasitic netlist extraction (PEX/C-extract) and SPICE sub-circuit device instance evaluation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
