# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Sign-off Rule Deck Benchmark Execution & Boundary Discrepancy Debugging

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm CMOS Commercial MPW Tapeout & PDK Implementation [Foundry Tapeout & PDK] > Commercial Open-Source 180nm PDK Setup & Physical Verification Rule Decks [EDA & PDK] > Physical Verification Sign-off Deck Benchmark Validation and Extraction Calibration [Metrology] > Sign-off Rule Deck Benchmark Execution & Boundary Discrepancy Debugging [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 3 (nm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: DRC/LVS: 0 Violations, ALD EOT <= 0.8 nm, CMP Dishing < 15 nm.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Automated Batch DRC/LVS & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated physical verification sign-off deck flows between open-source engines (Magic/Klayout) and commercial golden standards (Calibre/PVS) often produce false-positive or false-negative boundary discrepancies at macro interfaces. Hierarchical cell instantiations with off-grid placements or unflattened DRAM array boundaries risk silent fracturing deviations when translating GDSII/OASIS stream records onto the 5 nm manufacturing grid.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm commercial DRAM bitcell matrices, edge termination capacitors and dummy bitline wordline perimeter rings exhibit severe optical proximity effects (OPE) and Rayleigh resolution constraints (k1=0.40, NA=0.65, 248nm KrF DUV). Rule decks must enforce rigorous 150 nm CD poly gate rules, 210 nm spacing, and an overlay margin under 35 nm. A mismatch in Boolean layer derivation rules between sign-off decks can mask lethal diffusion-poly bridging or contact misalignment across cell boundaries.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) shuttle aggregation by silicon brokers (e.g., Efabless/GF/SkyWater) mandates exact, zero-discrepancy tapeout sign-off against the foundry primary golden DRC/LVS deck. Discrepancies between internal open-source verification pipelines and the commercial fab sign-off result in shuttle rejection, multi-month delay cycles, and direct re-spin penalties exceeding $15,000 to $30,000 per tapeout slot.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off rule deck calibration must be completely closed and automated within the continuous integration CI/CD pipeline without blocking physical tapeout milestones. Edge discrepancy resolution on boundary cells must converge in less than 48 hours to ensure DRAM macro IP freeze dates remain uncompromised before shuttle freeze deadlines.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Lithography grid snapping error: Layer translation between 5 nm manufacturing grid and floating-point geometry engines causes sub-resolution sliver polygon errors across boundary cells.
1. False clean DRC/LVS pass: Open-source rule deck omits conditional spacing checks for wide metal-1 pitches (>0.34 um) and end-of-line enclosure on 170 nm x 170 nm contacts, permitting fab mask rule violations.
1. Hierarchy boundary shadowing: DRC engine fails to evaluate context-dependent halo rings around high-density 1T1C DRAM bitcell arrays, causing catastrophic inter-macro short circuits.

Extract transistor netlist from layout using target open-source sign-off extraction rule deck with parasitics. 2. - **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush eyes immediately with copious gentle stream of potable water for at least 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move individual to fresh air. Skin contact: Wash affected area thoroughly with mild soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA/ULPA HVAC laminar flow air exchange rate (minimum 45 to 60 air changes per hour) with localized bench exhaust for wipe solvent vapors.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## PEX Extraction Model Calibration & Cell Parasitic Correlation Verification

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-PEX-003`  
**Node:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > Foundry Tapeout & PDK > EDA & PDK > Metrology  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm CMOS (Gen 3)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│   PEX Layer Stack   │
│        Setup        │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  1T1C Test Pattern  │
│     Extraction      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   3D Field Solver   │
│      Benchmark      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Correlation and   │
│  Parameter Tuning   │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│    Sign-off Deck    │
│       Release       │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Physical Calibration & Extraction Procedure

#### Step 1: Technology File & Stack Parameter Definition
1. Configure the Parasitic Extraction (PEX) technology deck with the 180nm backend-of-line (BEOL) and front-end-of-line (FEOL) profiles.
2. Define the gate oxide and high-$\kappa$ dielectric layer stack for the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) topology:
   - Access transistor gate oxide: Set corresponding thickness for $V_{thn} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$.
   - Capacitor dielectric: ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
3. Define the tungsten plug (W-plug) contact resistivity and geometries connecting the storage node drain to the crown-shaped bottom electrode.

#### Step 2: Test Vehicle & Array Layout Instantiation
1. Extract layout test structures across three configurations:
   - **Discrete Baseline:** Long-channel reference ($W/L = 20\,\mu\text{m} / 5\,\mu\text{m}$), intermediate ($W/L = 10\,\mu\text{m} / 1.0\,\mu\text{m}$), and sub-micron transistor ($W/L = 2.0\,\mu\text{m} / 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - **Unit Cell Layout:** 1T1C 8F$^2$ folded bitline footprint ($\text{Cell Area} = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$, access NMOS $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, shared bitline contact).
   - **Memory Sub-Array:** Array block consisting of 256 and 512 cells per folded bitline pair.

#### Step 3: PEX Rule Deck Extraction vs. 3D Field Solver Benchmark
1. Run golden 3D quasi-static electromagnetic field solver simulations on the 1T1C crown capacitor and adjacent metal routing (bitline, wordline).
2. Execute the rule-based PEX deck on the GDSII layout to extract:
   - Storage node capacitance ($C_s$).
   - Total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) including junction capacitance, bitline-to-wordline fringe coupling, and bitline-to-substrate capacitance.
3. Compare the PEX lumped/distributed RC network against 3D field solver models.

#### Step 4: Model Tuning & Correlation Verification
1. Tune fringe capacitance coefficients, sidewall coupling factors, and dielectric thickness parameters in the PEX deck until extraction errors converge within tolerance.
2. Validate the parasitic ratio $C_b / C_s$ across corner matrices (typical, fast, slow BEOL).
3. Verify access transistor junction and sub-threshold leakage extraction models at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to ensure the cell refresh interval budget is maintained.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │■■■■■■■■■■                          │
I_on/I_off (log10)┤■■■■■■■■■■                          │
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░                        │
       C_b/C_s Max┤░░░░░░░░░░░░                        │
       C_b/C_s Opt┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                          │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                          │
           C_s Nom┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                  │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
           C_s Min┤████████████████████████████████    │
                  │████████████████████████████████    │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0        7       14      21       28 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25.0$ to $30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | PEX Extraction & 3D Field Solver |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150.0$ to $250.0$ (for $256$ to $512$ cells/BL) | $\text{fF}$ | Array PEX Distributed Netlist Extraction |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1$ to $9.0 : 1$ (Must not exceed $10.0 : 1$) | dimensionless | Post-extraction calculation |
| **Transistor $I_{on} / I_{off}$ Ratio** | $> 10^7$ ($I_{on} \ge 500\,\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$, $I_{off} \le 10\,\text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$ at $V_{DS}=1.8\text{V}$) | dimensionless | SPICE DC Sweep on Extracted Sub-micron Netlist |
| **Cell Leakage Current** | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Extraction |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: Footprint ($8F^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$), $C_s \ge 25\text{--}30\text{ fF}$ ($28\text{ fF}$ nominal), $C_b = 150\text{--}250\text{ fF}$, ratio $C_b / C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$ ($< 10:1$).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), COB crown capacitor, dielectric stack $\kappa > 15$, leakage $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Stage 3 Reality Gate: Discrete Long-Channel MOSFET & CMOS Inverter Verification**: Device dimensions ($20/5\,\mu\text{m}$, $10/1.0\,\mu\text{m}$, $2.0/0.18\,\mu\text{m}$), $V_{thn} = +0.55\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$, $I_{on} \ge 500\,\mu\text{A}/\mu\text{m}$, $I_{off} \le 10\,\text{pA}/\mu\text{m}$, $I_{on} / I_{off} > 10^7$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The parasitic extraction (PEX) engine must be strictly correlated against both 3D field-solver simulations (e.g., FastCap/FastHenry) and empirical test-structure S-parameters. Neglecting inter-layer fringe capacitance (especially between wordline gate topography and folded bitline metal runners) will skew timing closure simulations, leading to sense amplifier false-triggering or margin collapse during DRAM read cycles.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating dielectric film thicknesses exclusively via standard planar ellipsometry without accounting for aspect-ratio-dependent CMP dishing and ILD recess yields systematic PEX underestimation. Cauchy model dispersion parameters for nitride spacer films (Psi/Delta angles) and gate oxide (3.5 nm nominal) must map across 49 wafer sites to bound corner parasitics accurately for 180nm cell pitch.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Calibrated test structures require dedicated parametric test die on multi-project wafer (MPW) reticles. Wafer allocations with commercial foundries must freeze test coupon geometries 12 weeks ahead of tapeout, and any PDK rule-deck extraction mismatch risks reticle redesign cycles with 14-week lead times.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: PEX rule calibration sign-off is a gating predecessor for DRAM bitcell array tapeout sign-off. Cross-correlation between open-source extraction tools (Magic/OpenPDKs/KLayout) and foundry golden decks must be completed within 10 engineering days to prevent holding up physical layout DRC/LVS closure.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Over-extraction of bitline-to-wordline coupling capacitance leading to artificial sense-margin timing failure and unnecessary array pitch bloating.
1. Underestimation of storage node contact-to-bitline fringe parasitic capacitance causing refresh degradation and retention-time failure under high-temperature corners.
1. Uncalibrated ILD thickness variation across dense vs. sparse array arrays causing systematic mismatch between schematic spice simulation and silicon post-layout extraction.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-3-3-01` | **Comb-and-Serpentine Interconnect Capacitance Correlation vs. PEX Rule Deck** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter, probe station with thermal chuck at 25°C | 1. Connect 4-terminal Kelvin sensing to comb-comb and serpentine test structures of nominal 180nm spacing across Metal-1 and Metal-2 layers. 2. Apply a 100 mV AC test signal at 100 kHz, 1 MHz, and 10 MHz frequencies with 0V DC bias. 3. Measure total line-to-line parallel capacitance (Cp) and dissipation factor (D). 4. De-embed pad and interconnect lead parasitic capacitances using dedicated open/short structures. 5. Compare physical measured capacitance against extracted netlist capacitance generated by the PEX rule deck. | `Measured de-embedded capacitance must match PEX rule deck extracted values within ±5.0% for line-to-line capacitance and within ±7.5% for cross-layer fringe capacitance across all 49 measured sites.` |
| `TC-PDK-DRC-LVS-SETUP-3-3-02` | **DRAM Cell Bitline-to-Substrate and Wordline Coupling Capacitance Verification** | Agilent 4294A Precision Impedance Analyzer, Cascade Microtech RF Probe Station, Sub-femtoamp Source Measure Unit (SMU) | 1. Ground adjacent dummy wordlines and unselected bitlines. 2. Apply 50 mV AC oscillation at 1 MHz to selected bitline test pads while biasing substrate/well at 0V. 3. Measure lumped bitline parasitic capacitance (C_BL) across 128-cell bitline segment. 4. Sweep DC bias from -0.5V to +1.8V to evaluate voltage-dependent depletion/junction parasitic capacitance components. 5. Extract RC time constant via pulsed transient response with 1 ns rise-time pulse generator. | `Total bitline parasitic capacitance per cell must be <= 1.25 fF/cell, and correlation between PEX-extracted capacitance model and measured C_BL must demonstrate Pearson correlation coefficient r >= 0.98 with deviation < 6.0%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, 6 mil thickness minimum), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom smock and hood, ESD-safe conductive footwear with heel grounders
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Immediately flush eyes with cleanroom eyewash saline solution for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Remove contaminated clothing and wash skin with non-abrasive soap and copious water. Inhalation: Relocate individual to fresh clean air; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing is labored and seek immediate medical evaluation. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting; contact local poison control center and emergency services immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Local chemical bench laminar flow hood exhaust with face velocity maintained between 80-100 LFM (linear feet per minute); dedicated volatile solvent exhaust ducting connected to thermal oxidizer or cleanroom VOC abatement system.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate solvent waste into dedicated FM-approved flammable liquid containers labeled for solvent mixtures; do not mix with aqueous or halogenated waste; dispose of through licensed chemical waste contractor in compliance with industrial environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Semiconductor Grade | `99.5%` |
| **Nitrogen (Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP, Grade 5.0) | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-passivation annealed and planarized wafer with dry oxide/nitride passivated top metal pads free of organic residue and particulate contamination (Class 100 cleanroom condition).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Clean, probe-scrub inspected wafer surface purged and vacuum-sealed in a dry nitrogen-filled wafer cassette carrier (relative humidity < 5%).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption in exposed low-k/dielectric films and native oxide/copper oxidation on test pads causing contact resistance escalation and artificial drift in high-frequency parasitic capacitance/impedance extraction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.systems_engineer: The parasitic extraction (PEX) engine must be strictly correlated against both 3D field-solver simulations (e.g., FastCap/FastHenry) and empirical test-structure S-parameters. Neglecting inter-layer fringe capacitance (especially between wordline gate topography and folded bitline metal runners) will skew timing closure simulations, leading to sense amplifier false-triggering or margin collapse during DRAM read cycles.
critics.domain_expert: Calibrating dielectric film thicknesses exclusively via standard planar ellipsometry without accounting for aspect-ratio-dependent CMP dishing and ILD recess yields systematic PEX underestimation. Cauchy model dispersion parameters for nitride spacer films (Psi/Delta angles) and gate oxide (3.5 nm nominal) must map across 49 wafer sites to bound corner parasitics accurately for 180nm cell pitch.
critics.supply_chain: Calibrated test structures require dedicated parametric test die on multi-project wafer (MPW) reticles. Wafer allocations with commercial foundries must freeze test coupon geometries 12 weeks ahead of tapeout, and any PDK rule-deck extraction mismatch risks reticle redesign cycles with 14-week lead times.
critics.laya_pm: PEX rule calibration sign-off is a gating predecessor for DRAM bitcell array tapeout sign-off. Cross-correlation between open-source extraction tools (Magic/OpenPDKs/KLayout) and foundry golden decks must be completed within 10 engineering days to prevent holding up physical layout DRC/LVS closure.
critical_failure_modes: Over-extraction of bitline-to-wordline coupling capacitance leading to artificial sense-margin timing failure and unnecessary array pitch bloating.
Underestimation of storage node contact-to-bitline fringe parasitic capacitance causing refresh degradation and retention-time failure under high-temperature corners.
Uncalibrated ILD thickness variation across dense vs. sparse array arrays causing systematic mismatch between schematic spice simulation and silicon post-layout extraction.

testcases.title: Comb-and-Serpentine Interconnect Capacitance Correlation vs. PEX Rule Deck
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter, probe station with thermal chuck at 25°C
testcases.pre_conditions: Parametric test wafer after Metal-1 and Metal-2 CMP and passivation; wafer mapped across 49 points with spectroscopic ellipsometry for inter-metal dielectric (IMD) thickness; calibrated open/short de-embedding structures verified.
testcases.procedure: 1. Connect 4-terminal Kelvin sensing to comb-comb and serpentine test structures of nominal 180nm spacing across Metal-1 and Metal-2 layers. 2. Apply a 100 mV AC test signal at 100 kHz, 1 MHz, and 10 MHz frequencies with 0V DC bias. 3. Measure total line-to-line parallel capacitance (Cp) and dissipation factor (D). 4. De-embed pad and interconnect lead parasitic capacitances using dedicated open/short structures. 5. Compare physical measured capacitance against extracted netlist capacitance generated by the PEX rule deck.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Measured de-embedded capacitance must match PEX rule deck extracted values within ±5.0% for line-to-line capacitance and within ±7.5% for cross-layer fringe capacitance across all 49 measured sites.

testcases.title: DRAM Cell Bitline-to-Substrate and Wordline Coupling Capacitance Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Agilent 4294A Precision Impedance Analyzer, Cascade Microtech RF Probe Station, Sub-femtoamp Source Measure Unit (SMU)
testcases.pre_conditions: Full DRAM array parametric test structure with accessible isolated bitline pairs and wordlines; gate oxide thickness validated at 3.5 nm ± 0.05 nm via spectroscopic reflectometry.
testcases.procedure: 1. Ground adjacent dummy wordlines and unselected bitlines. 2. Apply 50 mV AC oscillation at 1 MHz to selected bitline test pads while biasing substrate/well at 0V. 3. Measure lumped bitline parasitic capacitance (C_BL) across 128-cell bitline segment. 4. Sweep DC bias from -0.5V to +1.8V to evaluate voltage-dependent depletion/junction parasitic capacitance components. 5. Extract RC time constant via pulsed transient response with 1 ns rise-time pulse generator.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total bitline parasitic capacitance per cell must be <= 1.25 fF/cell, and correlation between PEX-extracted capacitance model and measured C_BL must demonstrate Pearson correlation coefficient r >= 0.98 with deviation < 6.0%.
